      of the receipt of the petition or of the suspension of the resolution or both.  If the resolution is not repealed by the board, the board shall submit to the voters
      of the area to be taxed, at the next regularly-scheduled November election, the question
      as to whether the tax shall be levied.  The question as it will appear on the ballot shall be filed with the county clerk
      not later than the second Tuesday in August preceding the regular election.  The question shall be so framed that the voter may by his vote answer “for” or “against.”
      If a majority of the votes cast upon the question oppose its passage, the resolution
      shall not go into effect.  If a majority of the votes cast upon the question favor its passage, the resolution
      shall go into effect as of January 1 of the year succeeding the year in which the
      election is held.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 76. City-County Metropolitan Sewer, Sewer Construction, and Sanitation Districts›Sewer Construction Districts›KY REV ST 76.300. Petition for establishment of sewer construction district
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 76. City-County Metropolitan Sewer, Sewer Construction, and Sanitation Districts › Sewer Construction Districts › KY REV ST 76.300. Petition for establishment of sewer construction district
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 76.300. Petition for establishment of sewer construction district (2023)
content:
The county judge/executive of any county in which a metropolitan sewer district has
   been established, upon petition of twenty-five percent (25%) of the resident freeholders
   therein may establish a sewer construction district for the purpose of providing sewers
   and/or drainage facilities to serve the district.  The petition shall describe the territory intended to be included in the district,
   and the sewer and drainage conditions and facilities existing in this territory.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 76. City-County Metropolitan Sewer, Sewer Construction, and Sanitation Districts›Sewer Construction Districts›KY REV ST 76.315. Sewer construction district commissioners; appointment, terms, removal; officers
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 76. City-County Metropolitan Sewer, Sewer Construction, and Sanitation Districts › Sewer Construction Districts › KY REV ST 76.315. Sewer construction district commissioners; appointment, terms, removal; officers
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 76.315. Sewer construction district commissioners; appointment, terms, removal; officers (2023)
content:
(1)  If the county judge/executive orders such district established, the county judge/executive
      shall, with the approval of the fiscal court, appoint three (3) commissioners, from
      among the residents of the sewer construction district.  One (1) of the commissioners shall be appointed for a term of two (2) years, one
      (1) for a term of three (3) years and one (1) for a term of four (4) years from the
      date of first appointment.  Upon expiration of the term of office of each of these commissioners, the county
      judge/executive shall, with the approval of the fiscal court, appoint a commissioner
      to succeed him, to serve for a term of four (4) years.  The commissioners shall elect a chairman, a secretary and a treasurer.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 76. City-County Metropolitan Sewer, Sewer Construction, and Sanitation Districts›Sewer Construction Districts›KY REV ST 76.325. Powers of commission
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 76. City-County Metropolitan Sewer, Sewer Construction, and Sanitation Districts › Sewer Construction Districts › KY REV ST 76.325. Powers of commission
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 76.325. Powers of commission (2023)
content: The powers of the commission shall be:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 76. City-County Metropolitan Sewer, Sewer Construction, and Sanitation Districts›Sewer Construction Districts›KY REV ST 76.310. City or metropolitan sewer district not included in sewer construction district without consent
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 76. City-County Metropolitan Sewer, Sewer Construction, and Sanitation Districts › Sewer Construction Districts › KY REV ST 76.310. City or metropolitan sewer district not included in sewer construction district without consent
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 76.310. City or metropolitan sewer district not included in sewer construction district without consent (2023)
content:
The district shall not include the whole or any part of any incorporated city or any
   metropolitan sewer district except with the consent of the legislative or managing
   board of the city or district.  With such consent, the resident property owners of the city or district will be
   considered as individual freeholders within the sewer construction district.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 76. City-County Metropolitan Sewer, Sewer Construction, and Sanitation Districts›Sewer Construction Districts›KY REV ST 76.305. Notice and proceedings for establishment of sewer construction district; appeal
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 76. City-County Metropolitan Sewer, Sewer Construction, and Sanitation Districts › Sewer Construction Districts › KY REV ST 76.305. Notice and proceedings for establishment of sewer construction district; appeal
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 76.305. Notice and proceedings for establishment of sewer construction district; appeal (2023)
content:
(1)  When the petition is filed the county clerk shall give notice of the filing by
      publication pursuant to KRS Chapter 424 and by posting notices in three (3) public
      places within the proposed district.  Within thirty (30) days after the publication, any freeholder of the proposed district
      may file objections, and the county judge/executive shall set the case for hearing
      at the first rule day after expiration of said thirty (30) days.  If the county judge/executive finds that the establishment of such district is reasonably
      necessary for the public health, convenience and comfort of the residents of the district,
      he shall make an order establishing the district and designating it by name and number.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 76. City-County Metropolitan Sewer, Sewer Construction, and Sanitation Districts›Sewer Construction Districts›KY REV ST 76.330. Commission to make survey and report to county judge/executive of economic feasibility of construction; certification by metropolitan district
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 76. City-County Metropolitan Sewer, Sewer Construction, and Sanitation Districts › Sewer Construction Districts › KY REV ST 76.330. Commission to make survey and report to county judge/executive of economic feasibility of construction; certification by metropolitan district
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 76.330. Commission to make survey and report to county judge/executive of economic feasibility of construction; certification by metropolitan district (2023)
content:
The commission shall, before entering upon any construction work or any contracts
   therefor, make a survey of the territory within the district, and report to the county
   judge/executive as to plans for sewer and/or drainage construction and as to the estimated
   cost thereof, with recommendations as to whether or not such construction is economically
   feasible.  With such report shall be submitted a report and certification from the metropolitan
   sewer district as to whether or not the project is feasible from a technical and economic
   standpoint.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 76. City-County Metropolitan Sewer, Sewer Construction, and Sanitation Districts›Sewer Construction Districts›KY REV ST 76.335. Notice and hearing of exceptions
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 76. City-County Metropolitan Sewer, Sewer Construction, and Sanitation Districts › Sewer Construction Districts › KY REV ST 76.335. Notice and hearing of exceptions
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 76.335. Notice and hearing of exceptions (2023)
content:
When the report is filed, the clerk shall, within five (5) days, cause notice of the
   filing of the report to be given by publication pursuant to KRS Chapter 424 and by
   notices posted in three (3) public places within the sewer construction district.  The hearing shall be held not more than twenty (20) days from the first published
   notice.  Property owners may file exceptions to said report at any time up to the day the
   proceeding is docketed.  The county judge/executive may hear the proceeding on that day, unless further time
   be required.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 76. City-County Metropolitan Sewer, Sewer Construction, and Sanitation Districts›Sewer Construction Districts›KY REV ST 76.326. Compliance with KRS 65A.010. to § 65A.090
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 76. City-County Metropolitan Sewer, Sewer Construction, and Sanitation Districts › Sewer Construction Districts › KY REV ST 76.326. Compliance with KRS 65A.010. to § 65A.090
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 76.326. Compliance with KRS 65A.010. to § 65A.090 (2023)
content: The board shall comply with the provisions ofKRS 65A.010to65A.090.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 76. City-County Metropolitan Sewer, Sewer Construction, and Sanitation Districts›Sewer Construction Districts›KY REV ST 76.320. Corporate powers of commission
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 76. City-County Metropolitan Sewer, Sewer Construction, and Sanitation Districts › Sewer Construction Districts › KY REV ST 76.320. Corporate powers of commission
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 76.320. Corporate powers of commission (2023)
content:
The commission thereby created shall be the governing body of the sewer construction
   district and shall be a body corporate, with power to contract and be contracted with,
   to sue and be sued and to adopt a corporate seal.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 76. City-County Metropolitan Sewer, Sewer Construction, and Sanitation Districts›Sewer Construction Districts›KY REV ST 76.340. Classification and report of land affected or benefited by sewer construction and operation
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 76. City-County Metropolitan Sewer, Sewer Construction, and Sanitation Districts › Sewer Construction Districts › KY REV ST 76.340. Classification and report of land affected or benefited by sewer construction and operation
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 76.340. Classification and report of land affected or benefited by sewer construction and operation (2023)
content:
If a plan for construction of sewers and/or drains is approved by the county judge/executive,
   the commissioners shall then examine the real estate in the sewer construction district
   that may be affected or benefited by construction and operation of such sewers or
   drains included in such approved plans, and shall classify the land into such number
   of classes as the commission deems advisable, and shall report its classification
   and the ratio of benefits for each class, from such sewers or drains to be constructed.  This report as to classification shall include a general description of the land
   in each class with the names of the owners.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 76. City-County Metropolitan Sewer, Sewer Construction, and Sanitation Districts›Sewer Construction Districts›KY REV ST 76.355. Performance under plan
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 76. City-County Metropolitan Sewer, Sewer Construction, and Sanitation Districts › Sewer Construction Districts › KY REV ST 76.355. Performance under plan
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 76.355. Performance under plan (2023)
content:
When the classification and ratio between classes on any specific plan, has been finally
   determined, the commission may carry out the plan itself, or contract for construction
   of said sewers and/or drains included in the plan by the metropolitan sewer district
   or otherwise.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 76. City-County Metropolitan Sewer, Sewer Construction, and Sanitation Districts›Sewer Construction Districts›KY REV ST 76.345. Notice and hearing of exceptions to classification report
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 76. City-County Metropolitan Sewer, Sewer Construction, and Sanitation Districts › Sewer Construction Districts › KY REV ST 76.345. Notice and hearing of exceptions to classification report
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 76.345. Notice and hearing of exceptions to classification report (2023)
content:
When this report of classification of benefits is filed, the clerk shall, within five
   (5) days, cause notice of the filing of same to be given by publication pursuant to
   KRS Chapter 424, and by notices posted in three (3) public places within the sewer
   construction district.  The hearing shall be held not more than twenty (20) days from the first published
   notice.  Property owners may file exceptions to said report at any time up to the day the
   proceeding is docketed.  The county judge/executive may hear the proceeding on that day, unless further time
   be required.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 76. City-County Metropolitan Sewer, Sewer Construction, and Sanitation Districts›Sewer Construction Districts›KY REV ST 76.360. Assessment of benefited property; lien of assessment; payment
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 76. City-County Metropolitan Sewer, Sewer Construction, and Sanitation Districts › Sewer Construction Districts › KY REV ST 76.360. Assessment of benefited property; lien of assessment; payment
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 76.360. Assessment of benefited property; lien of assessment; payment (2023)
content:
When the cost of construction of the planned sewers and/or drains has been ascertained,
   the commission shall assess the property benefited in accordance with the classification
   and area or other basis previously determined.  From that date the assessment shall constitute a lien against the property.  The landowner may pay the assessment in full at any time within thirty (30) days
   after notice of assessment.  Every property owner not paying the full amount of his assessment within thirty
   (30) days shall be presumed to have consented to the issuing of sewer construction
   bonds.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 76. City-County Metropolitan Sewer, Sewer Construction, and Sanitation Districts›Sewer Construction Districts›KY REV ST 76.350. Appeals
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 76. City-County Metropolitan Sewer, Sewer Construction, and Sanitation Districts › Sewer Construction Districts › KY REV ST 76.350. Appeals
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 76.350. Appeals (2023)
content:
An order of the county judge/executive confirming, modifying or disapproving a report
   of commissioners of sewer construction district as to a plan of construction or as
   to classification of property or ratio of benefits may be appealed to the Circuit
   Court by the commission or any property holder.  In the Circuit Court the appeal shall be docketed on the equity docket and the trial
   shall be de novo.  Decisions of the Circuit Court may be appealed to the Court of Appeals.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 76. City-County Metropolitan Sewer, Sewer Construction, and Sanitation Districts›Sewer Construction Districts›KY REV ST 76.366. Financing by revenue bonds
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 76. City-County Metropolitan Sewer, Sewer Construction, and Sanitation Districts › Sewer Construction Districts › KY REV ST 76.366. Financing by revenue bonds
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 76.366. Financing by revenue bonds (2023)
content:
(1)  Any sewer construction district created in the manner provided inKRS 76.300to76.325, both inclusive, may if the commissioners of such sewer construction district deem
      it feasible, build, or acquire or enlarge sewer or drainage facilities, including
      treatment plants, without resort to the right to levy assessments for the cost of
      such sewer or drainage facilities, including treatment plants, as is provided inKRS 76.340to76.365, both inclusive, and may obtain the funds with which to build, acquire or enlarge
      such system by the issuance of revenue bonds, payable solely from the revenue to be
      derived from the operation of such system.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 76. City-County Metropolitan Sewer, Sewer Construction, and Sanitation Districts›Sewer Construction Districts›KY REV ST 76.365. Issuance of sewer construction bonds for amount of unpaid assessments; interest, maturity, payment
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 76. City-County Metropolitan Sewer, Sewer Construction, and Sanitation Districts › Sewer Construction Districts › KY REV ST 76.365. Issuance of sewer construction bonds for amount of unpaid assessments; interest, maturity, payment
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 76.365. Issuance of sewer construction bonds for amount of unpaid assessments; interest, maturity, payment (2023)
content:
(1)  If all assessments are not paid in full by thirty (30) days after notice of assessment,
      the commission may issue bonds for the amount of the unpaid assessments, and shall
      give notice that it proposes to issue bonds, giving the amount of bonds to be issued,
      and the time they will become payable.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 76. City-County Metropolitan Sewer, Sewer Construction, and Sanitation Districts›Sewer Construction Districts›KY REV ST 76.420. Apportionment warrants; effect of section
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 76. City-County Metropolitan Sewer, Sewer Construction, and Sanitation Districts › Sewer Construction Districts › KY REV ST 76.420. Apportionment warrants; effect of section
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 76.420. Apportionment warrants; effect of section (2023)
content:
(1)  Any sewer construction district created in the manner provided inKRS 76.300to76.400may, if the commissioners of such district deem it feasible, instead of issuing bonds
      as provided inKRS 76.365, issue apportionment warrants, using the procedures after assessment set out inKRS 184.150to184.250, “board of directors” being read as “commission” and the references to roads being read as references to sewers and drains, including
      treatment plants.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 76. City-County Metropolitan Sewer, Sewer Construction, and Sanitation Districts›Sewer Construction Districts›KY REV ST 76.368. Power to discontinue water service
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 76. City-County Metropolitan Sewer, Sewer Construction, and Sanitation Districts › Sewer Construction Districts › KY REV ST 76.368. Power to discontinue water service
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 76.368. Power to discontinue water service (2023)
content:
In the event a sewer construction district elects to proceed underKRS 76.366and76.367it is granted the same authority relative to the cutting off of the water supply
   of its delinquent users as is a sanitation district underKRS 220.510, when written request for such cutting off is made by the commission to the water
   supplier.  In the event this power is used the plans of the sewer district shall only require
   prior approval by the metropolitan sewer district as already provided inKRS 76.330, and in such event the water supplier may require the sewer commission to supply
   an agent with full authority to receive payments or accept arrangements to pay the
   delinquent charges, together with interest and penalties thereon, to be present when
   the water is cut off and the water supplier may bill the sewer commission its actual
   expenses involved.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 76. City-County Metropolitan Sewer, Sewer Construction, and Sanitation Districts›Sewer Construction Districts›KY REV ST 76.367. Refunding with revenue bonds
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 76. City-County Metropolitan Sewer, Sewer Construction, and Sanitation Districts › Sewer Construction Districts › KY REV ST 76.367. Refunding with revenue bonds
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 76.367. Refunding with revenue bonds (2023)
content:
If any district has previously issued bonds secured entirely or partially by the right
   to levy an assessment as provided byKRS 76.340to76.365, both inclusive, and such bonds are redeemed prior to maturity, bonds to refund same
   may be issued secured solely by the revenue of said systems in the manner provided
   inKRS 76.366.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 76. City-County Metropolitan Sewer, Sewer Construction, and Sanitation Districts›Sewer Construction Districts›KY REV ST 76.370. Dissolution of district
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 76. City-County Metropolitan Sewer, Sewer Construction, and Sanitation Districts › Sewer Construction Districts › KY REV ST 76.370. Dissolution of district
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 76.370. Dissolution of district (2023)
content:
On completion of collection of assessments, distribution of funds and retirement of
   all bonds, a sewer construction district may be dissolved by order of the county judge/executive.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 76. City-County Metropolitan Sewer, Sewer Construction, and Sanitation Districts›Sewer Construction Districts›KY REV ST 76.369. Effect of provisions for financing with revenue bonds
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 76. City-County Metropolitan Sewer, Sewer Construction, and Sanitation Districts › Sewer Construction Districts › KY REV ST 76.369. Effect of provisions for financing with revenue bonds
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 76.369. Effect of provisions for financing with revenue bonds (2023)
content:
KRS 76.366and76.367shall not repeal nor reduce any existing rights or duties of a sewer construction
   district, and the commissioners thereof, but shall constitute an additional and alternate
   method of financing.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 76. City-County Metropolitan Sewer, Sewer Construction, and Sanitation Districts›Sewer Construction Districts›KY REV ST 76.395. Construction of KRS § 76.390
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 76. City-County Metropolitan Sewer, Sewer Construction, and Sanitation Districts › Sewer Construction Districts › KY REV ST 76.395. Construction of KRS § 76.390
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 76.395. Construction of KRS § 76.390 (2023)
content:
The provisions ofKRS 76.390shall not repeal or reduce any existing rights or duties of sewer construction districts
   or the commissioners thereof, but shall constitute an additional method of financing
   which may be used in conjunction withKRS 76.300to76.385, or may be an alternate method.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 76. City-County Metropolitan Sewer, Sewer Construction, and Sanitation Districts›Sewer Construction Districts›KY REV ST 76.380. Governmental nature of commission's function
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 76. City-County Metropolitan Sewer, Sewer Construction, and Sanitation Districts › Sewer Construction Districts › KY REV ST 76.380. Governmental nature of commission's function
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 76.380. Governmental nature of commission's function (2023)
content:
The creation of a sewer construction district, and the carrying out of its corporate
   purposes are in all respects in the interest of public health and for a public purpose.  A sewer construction district performs a governmental function in the exercise of
   the powers conferred upon it, and it shall be required to pay no taxes or assessments
   upon any property owned or acquired by it, or upon its activities in the operation
   and maintenance of its facilities.  Bonds issued by a sewer construction district and income therefrom are exempt from
   taxation.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 76. City-County Metropolitan Sewer, Sewer Construction, and Sanitation Districts›Sewer Construction Districts›KY REV ST 76.390. Additional or alternate method of financing construction
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 76. City-County Metropolitan Sewer, Sewer Construction, and Sanitation Districts › Sewer Construction Districts › KY REV ST 76.390. Additional or alternate method of financing construction
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 76.390. Additional or alternate method of financing construction (2023)
content:
Any sewer construction district created in the manner provided inKRS 76.300to76.325may, if the commissioners of such district deem it advisable, use the authority and
   procedures granted to incorporated municipalities byKRS 107.010to107.220.  When applied to sewer construction districts, terms used inKRS 107.010to107.220shall be construed to mean the following:  “city” means “district”;  “ordinance” means “resolution”;  “clerk” means “secretary of district”;  “governing body” means “district commissioners”;  “mayor or chairman of board of directors” means “chairman of the district.”

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 76. City-County Metropolitan Sewer, Sewer Construction, and Sanitation Districts›Sewer Construction Districts›KY REV ST 76.375. Bond of commissioners and treasurer
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 76. City-County Metropolitan Sewer, Sewer Construction, and Sanitation Districts › Sewer Construction Districts › KY REV ST 76.375. Bond of commissioners and treasurer
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 76.375. Bond of commissioners and treasurer (2023)
content:
The commissioners shall give bond in such amount as the county judge/executive may
   require.  The treasurer shall give bond in such amount as the commission may require.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 76. City-County Metropolitan Sewer, Sewer Construction, and Sanitation Districts›Sewer Construction Districts›KY REV ST 76.385. County attorney to represent commission; additional counsel
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 76. City-County Metropolitan Sewer, Sewer Construction, and Sanitation Districts › Sewer Construction Districts › KY REV ST 76.385. County attorney to represent commission; additional counsel
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 76.385. County attorney to represent commission; additional counsel (2023)
content:
The county attorney shall represent the commission, but the commission may employ
   additional counsel when the amount of its legal work requires this.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 76. City-County Metropolitan Sewer, Sewer Construction, and Sanitation Districts›Sewer Construction Districts›KY REV ST 76.415. Effect of KRS 76.405. and § 76.410
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 76. City-County Metropolitan Sewer, Sewer Construction, and Sanitation Districts › Sewer Construction Districts › KY REV ST 76.415. Effect of KRS 76.405. and § 76.410
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 76.415. Effect of KRS 76.405. and § 76.410 (2023)
content:
The provisions ofKRS 76.405and76.410shall not repeal or reduce any existing rights or duties of sewer construction districts
   or commissioners thereof, but shall constitute merely a procedure for annexation by
   sewer construction districts.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 76. City-County Metropolitan Sewer, Sewer Construction, and Sanitation Districts›Sewer Construction Districts›KY REV ST 76.410. Exception to limitation of KRS § 220.535
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 76. City-County Metropolitan Sewer, Sewer Construction, and Sanitation Districts › Sewer Construction Districts › KY REV ST 76.410. Exception to limitation of KRS § 220.535
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 76.410. Exception to limitation of KRS § 220.535 (2023)
content:
Language inKRS 220.535, limiting the powers of annexation to a sanitation district in a county not containing
   a city of the first class, shall not be applicable to sewer construction districts
   which may use this method of annexation, even if they are located in a county containing
   a city of the first class, and the secretary of the Energy and Environment Cabinet
   shall function in regard to annexations by them in the same manner and under the same
   procedures as set out inKRS 220.535to220.537as he would in his capacity as commissioner of sanitation districts for any sanitation
   district.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 76. City-County Metropolitan Sewer, Sewer Construction, and Sanitation Districts›Sewer Construction Districts›KY REV ST 76.400. Exemption from KRS 76.085; exception
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 76. City-County Metropolitan Sewer, Sewer Construction, and Sanitation Districts › Sewer Construction Districts › KY REV ST 76.400. Exemption from KRS 76.085; exception
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 76.400. Exemption from KRS 76.085; exception (2023)
content:
Any sewer construction district created in the manner provided inKRS 76.300to76.325is exempt from the provisions ofKRS 76.085, subsections (2)and(3), except when said sewer construction district empties its effluent into mains or
   plants operated by metropolitan sewer district.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 76. City-County Metropolitan Sewer, Sewer Construction, and Sanitation Districts›Sewer Construction Districts›KY REV ST 76.405. Alternate method of annexation
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 76. City-County Metropolitan Sewer, Sewer Construction, and Sanitation Districts › Sewer Construction Districts › KY REV ST 76.405. Alternate method of annexation
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 76.405. Alternate method of annexation (2023)
content:
Any sewer construction district created in the manner provided inKRS 76.300to76.325may, if the commissioners of such district deem it advisable, use the authority and
   procedures granted to sanitation districts byKRS 220.535to220.537to annex territory to the district, “board of directors” being read as “commission.”

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 76. City-County Metropolitan Sewer, Sewer Construction, and Sanitation Districts›Wastewater Collection Projects›KY REV ST 76.600. Authority to provide for, construct and finance wastewater collection projects
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 76. City-County Metropolitan Sewer, Sewer Construction, and Sanitation Districts › Wastewater Collection Projects › KY REV ST 76.600. Authority to provide for, construct and finance wastewater collection projects
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 76.600. Authority to provide for, construct and finance wastewater collection projects (2023)
content:
Existing metropolitan sewer districts created pursuant to the provisions ofKRS 76.010to76.210may provide for, construct, and finance wastewater collection projects according
   to the financing plan set forth in KRS Chapters 76 and 107.  This authority is in addition to any authority otherwise conferred upon any metropolitan
   sewer district.  If any metropolitan sewer district has undertaken any proceedings under any other
   law to construct a project, it may abandon such proceedings and proceed under the
   provisions of KRS Chapters 76 and 107.  It is the purpose of KRS Chapters 76 and 107 to extend permissive authority to metropolitan
   sewer districts to finance wastewater collection projects according to the assessed
   value basis, whereby benefited properties shall be assessed the cost of such projects
   according to benefits conferred upon such properties.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 76. City-County Metropolitan Sewer, Sewer Construction, and Sanitation Districts›Wastewater Collection Projects›KY REV ST 76.620. Approval required
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 76. City-County Metropolitan Sewer, Sewer Construction, and Sanitation Districts › Wastewater Collection Projects › KY REV ST 76.620. Approval required
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 76.620. Approval required (2023)
content:
In undertaking wastewater collection projects under KRS Chapters 76 and 107, metropolitan
   sewer districts are vested with exclusive authority to plan, design, initiate, finance,
   and carry out construction of the projects solely according to the requirements and
   procedures of KRS Chapters 76 and 107.  However, no project may be financed, no bonds may be issued, nor benefited property
   assessed for benefits conferred until the project has been approved by the fiscal
   court of the county of the affected district.  In the event any benefited property is situated within a city of the first class
   encompassed by the district, the project shall also be approved by ordinance enacted
   by the governing body of that city.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 76. City-County Metropolitan Sewer, Sewer Construction, and Sanitation Districts›Wastewater Collection Projects›KY REV ST 76.630. Removal or relocation of municipal, municipally-owned utility or water district service equipment or appliances
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 76. City-County Metropolitan Sewer, Sewer Construction, and Sanitation Districts › Wastewater Collection Projects › KY REV ST 76.630. Removal or relocation of municipal, municipally-owned utility or water district service equipment or appliances
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 76.630. Removal or relocation of municipal, municipally-owned utility or water district service equipment or appliances (2023)
content:
The provisions ofKRS 76.120notwithstanding, whenever any district shall determine that it is necessary that
   any fire plugs, water pipes, mains, and conduits, and other water service related
   equipment and appliances, belonging to any municipality or a municipally-owned utility,
   or any water district established pursuant to KRS Chapter 74, must be removed or relocated
   on, over or under a highway, city street, county road, or other public way, in order
   to construct, reconstruct, relocate or improve a drainage ditch, storm sewer, sanitary
   sewer, or any drainage or sewage facility connected therewith, the municipality or
   municipally-owned utility or the water district shall relocate or remove same in accordance
   with the reasonable needs of the metropolitan sewer district;  and the costs and expenses
   of such relocation or removal, including the costs of installing such facilities in
   a new location and the costs of any land, or any rights or interests in lands, and
   any other rights, acquired to accomplish such relocation or removal, shall be ascertained
   and paid by the district as a part of the cost of improving, constructing or reconstructing
   such drainage or sewage facilities, provided such additional costs to the district
   do not result in an increase in the assessment against the benefited properties.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 76. City-County Metropolitan Sewer, Sewer Construction, and Sanitation Districts›Wastewater Collection Projects›KY REV ST 76.610. Use of authority and procedures granted municipalities; terms in KRS Chapter 107. defined
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 76. City-County Metropolitan Sewer, Sewer Construction, and Sanitation Districts › Wastewater Collection Projects › KY REV ST 76.610. Use of authority and procedures granted municipalities; terms in KRS Chapter 107. defined
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 76.610. Use of authority and procedures granted municipalities; terms in KRS Chapter 107. defined (2023)
content:
Any metropolitan sewer district created in the manner provided in this chapter may,
   if the board of such district deems it advisable, use the authority and procedures
   granted to incorporated municipalities byKRS 107.010to107.220.  When applied to metropolitan sewer districts, terms used inKRS 107.010to107.220shall be construed to mean the following:  “city” or “municipality” means “metropolitan sewer district” (except that inKRS 107.090(1)(d),107.130,107.140(2)(a) and (c), and107.150referring to city taxes the term “city” shall continue to mean “city”);  “ordinance” means “resolution”;  “clerk” means “secretary of the metropolitan sewer district”;  and “mayor or chairman of the board of directors” means “chairman of board of the metropolitan sewer district.”

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 76. City-County Metropolitan Sewer, Sewer Construction, and Sanitation Districts›Wastewater Collection Projects›KY REV ST 76.640. Enforcement powers
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 76. City-County Metropolitan Sewer, Sewer Construction, and Sanitation Districts › Wastewater Collection Projects › KY REV ST 76.640. Enforcement powers
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 76.640. Enforcement powers (2023)
content:
(1)  Any metropolitan sewer district which has initiated a wastewater collection project
      under the provisions of KRS Chapters 76 and 107 may enforce payment of annual improvement
      benefit assessments levied in respect of such project and may enforce rules and regulations
      relative to this project by directing the company or governmental unit providing water
      services to any benefited property to discontinue water services until:  (a) the improvement
      benefits and penalties are duly paid and (b) the regulations and rules shall have
      been duly complied with and any defaults have been cured.  However, a metropolitan sewer district shall indemnify the company or governmental
      unit providing water services from any liability for damages for terminating water
      services upon the direction of a district.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control›KY REV ST 77.010. Creation and boundaries of districts
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control › KY REV ST 77.010. Creation and boundaries of districts
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 77.010. Creation and boundaries of districts (2023)
content:
(1)  In each county of the Commonwealth there is hereby created an air pollution control
      district.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control›KY REV ST 77.005. Definitions for chapter
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control › KY REV ST 77.005. Definitions for chapter
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 77.005. Definitions for chapter (2023)
content: As used in this chapter, unless the context requires otherwise:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control›KY REV ST 77.015. Action of fiscal court and city legislative body necessary to activate district
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control › KY REV ST 77.015. Action of fiscal court and city legislative body necessary to activate district
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 77.015. Action of fiscal court and city legislative body necessary to activate district (2023)
content:
(1)  An air pollution control district shall not transact any business or exercise
      any of its powers under this chapter until or unless the fiscal court of the county
      within which such district is situated, by proper resolution, declares at any time
      hereafter that there is need for an air pollution control district to function in
      such county, provided:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control›KY REV ST 77.025. Notice of hearings
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control › KY REV ST 77.025. Notice of hearings
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 77.025. Notice of hearings (2023)
content:
Notice of the public hearing shall be given by the county conducting the hearing by
   publication pursuant to KRS Chapter 424.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control›KY REV ST 77.030. Resolution of fiscal court to be based upon findings of fact
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control › KY REV ST 77.030. Resolution of fiscal court to be based upon findings of fact
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 77.030. Resolution of fiscal court to be based upon findings of fact (2023)
content:
The fiscal court may adopt a resolution declaring that there is need for an air pollution
   control district to function if from the evidence received at such public hearing
   it finds:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control›KY REV ST 77.040. Form and sufficiency of resolution and ordinance
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control › KY REV ST 77.040. Form and sufficiency of resolution and ordinance
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 77.040. Form and sufficiency of resolution and ordinance (2023)
content:
(1)  A resolution of the fiscal court declaring that there is need for an air pollution
      control district to function is sufficient if it finds that there is need for an air
      pollution control district to function, and finds in substantially the wording ofKRS 77.030that both the conditions enumerated therein exist.  No further detail is necessary.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control›KY REV ST 77.020. Public hearings for determination of whether district shall function
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control › KY REV ST 77.020. Public hearings for determination of whether district shall function
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 77.020. Public hearings for determination of whether district shall function (2023)
content:
The fiscal court of any county desiring to place its air pollution control district
   in operation and the legislative body of the largest city in such county must hold
   separate public hearings prior to and for the purpose of determining whether or not
   there is need for an air pollution control district to function.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control›KY REV ST 77.035. Ordinance of city legislative body to be based upon findings of fact
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control › KY REV ST 77.035. Ordinance of city legislative body to be based upon findings of fact
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 77.035. Ordinance of city legislative body to be based upon findings of fact (2023)
content:
The legislative body of the largest city in the county may adopt an ordinance declaring
   that there is need for an air pollution control district to function if from the evidence
   received at such public hearing it finds:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control›KY REV ST 77.045. Certified copies of resolution and ordinance admissible in evidence
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control › KY REV ST 77.045. Certified copies of resolution and ordinance admissible in evidence
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 77.045. Certified copies of resolution and ordinance admissible in evidence (2023)
content:
(1)  A copy of a resolution of the fiscal court declaring that there is need for an
      air pollution control district, duly certified by the county clerk, is admissible
      in evidence in any suit, action or proceeding.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control›KY REV ST 77.060. General powers of district
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control › KY REV ST 77.060. General powers of district
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 77.060. General powers of district (2023)
content:
(1)  The district shall have power to sue and be sued, contract and be contracted
      with, make rules and regulations and do all other things necessary to carry out the
      provisions of this chapter.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control›KY REV ST 77.055. District to function immediately following activation; Conclusiveness of activation and organization
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control › KY REV ST 77.055. District to function immediately following activation; Conclusiveness of activation and organization
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 77.055. District to function immediately following activation; Conclusiveness of activation and organization (2023)
content:
(1)  Upon the adoption of the resolution by the fiscal court of the county in which
      the district is to function, and, where necessary pursuant toKRS 77.015, the passage of the ordinance by the legislative body of the largest city within
      such county, the district shall immediately begin to function.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control›KY REV ST 77.050. Name and corporate powers of district
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control › KY REV ST 77.050. Name and corporate powers of district
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 77.050. Name and corporate powers of district (2023)
content:
The district shall be known by and under the name of Air Pollution Control District
   of..... County, and under such name shall be a public body corporate and a political
   subdivision of the Commonwealth.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control›KY REV ST 77.110. Persons ineligible to membership on boards or employment by district
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control › KY REV ST 77.110. Persons ineligible to membership on boards or employment by district
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 77.110. Persons ineligible to membership on boards or employment by district (2023)
content:
Any person having any interest in the sale or control of any air pollution prevention
   equipment or apparatus which might be used effectively to reduce the emission of air
   contaminants shall not be eligible to be a member of an air pollution control board
   or of a hearing board, or to be the secretary-treasurer of an air pollution control
   board, or an air pollution control officer, or any assistant, deputy, clerk, attache,
   or employee of an air pollution control officer or secretary-treasurer, or to be any
   other employee of an air pollution control board or district.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control›KY REV ST 77.070. Air pollution control board, membership; qualifications; vacancies; removal; effect of compact; membership of board upon establishment of consolidated local government
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control › KY REV ST 77.070. Air pollution control board, membership; qualifications; vacancies; removal; effect of compact; membership of board upon establishment of consolidated local government
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 77.070. Air pollution control board, membership; qualifications; vacancies; removal; effect of compact; membership of board upon establishment of consolidated local government (2023)
content:
(1)  In a county containing a consolidated local government or a city with a population
      equal to or greater than twenty thousand (20,000) based upon the most recent federal
      decennial census, the air pollution control board of the air pollution control district
      shall consist of seven (7) members, three (3) of whom shall be appointed by the county
      judge/executive, subject to the approval of the fiscal court, and four (4) of whom
      shall be appointed by the mayor.  The mayoral appointments shall be subject to the approval of the legislative body
      of the city.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control›KY REV ST 77.080. Meetings of board
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control › KY REV ST 77.080. Meetings of board
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 77.080. Meetings of board (2023)
content:
(1)  Regular meetings of each air pollution control board shall be held at least once
      in each calendar month.  The time and place of the meetings shall be fixed by the board.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control›KY REV ST 77.075. Air pollution control board members to serve without compensation
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control › KY REV ST 77.075. Air pollution control board members to serve without compensation
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 77.075. Air pollution control board members to serve without compensation (2023)
content:
All air pollution control board members shall serve without compensation other than
   recovery of actual expenses from the district funds.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control›KY REV ST 77.120. Compensation of officers and employees
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control › KY REV ST 77.120. Compensation of officers and employees
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 77.120. Compensation of officers and employees (2023)
content:
The air pollution control board shall determine the compensation of, and pay from
   district funds, the secretary-treasurer of the air pollution control board, his assistants,
   deputies, clerks, attaches, and other employees, the air pollution control officer,
   his assistants, deputies, clerks, attaches, and other employees, the members of the
   hearing board, and all other employees of the air pollution control board.  The salaries and compensation paid shall be in line with that paid by the county,
   or the largest city within the county, for similar services.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control›KY REV ST 77.125. Appropriations by city and county
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control › KY REV ST 77.125. Appropriations by city and county
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 77.125. Appropriations by city and county (2023)
content:
In order to provide money for carrying out the purposes of this chapter, the fiscal
   court of a county within which the air pollution control district has been activated
   and the legislative body of a city qualified to appoint members of the board pursuant
   toKRS 77.070within such county, if there be any such city, may annually appropriate funds to
   such district.  If there be such city within the county, the appropriation shall be in such proportion
   as may be agreed upon between the city legislative body and the fiscal court.  Such funds shall be deposited in the treasury of the air pollution control district.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control›KY REV ST 77.090. Air pollution control officer, assistants, deputies and other employees in counties not containing a consolidated local government or a city with a population of 20,000. or more
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control › KY REV ST 77.090. Air pollution control officer, assistants, deputies and other employees in counties not containing a consolidated local government or a city with a population of 20,000. or more
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 77.090. Air pollution control officer, assistants, deputies and other employees in counties not containing a consolidated local government or a city with a population of 20,000. or more (2023)
content:
(1)  In all counties other than those provided for inKRS 77.070or77.085, the air pollution control board of the air pollution control district may appoint
      an air pollution control officer, and may provide for assistants, deputies, clerks,
      attaches and other persons to be employed by the air pollution control officer, and
      the times at which they shall be appointed.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control›KY REV ST 77.065. County officers are ex officio officers and other personnel of district; exception for county containing city of first class or consolidated local government or county where largest city has population of 20,000. or more; effect of compact; employees of district upon establishment of consolidated local government
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control › KY REV ST 77.065. County officers are ex officio officers and other personnel of district; exception for county containing city of first class or consolidated local government or county where largest city has population of 20,000. or more; effect of compact; employees of district upon establishment of consolidated local government
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 77.065. County officers are ex officio officers and other personnel of district; exception for county containing city of first class or consolidated local government or county where largest city has population of 20,000. or more; effect of compact; employees of district upon establishment of consolidated local government (2023)
content:
(1)  The members of the fiscal court of a county shall be, and they are hereby designated
      as, and empowered to act as, ex officio the air pollution control board of the air
      pollution control district in such county.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control›KY REV ST 77.085. Election of chairman and vice chairman; secretary-treasurer and air pollution control officer; deputies, assistants, and other employees
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control › KY REV ST 77.085. Election of chairman and vice chairman; secretary-treasurer and air pollution control officer; deputies, assistants, and other employees
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 77.085. Election of chairman and vice chairman; secretary-treasurer and air pollution control officer; deputies, assistants, and other employees (2023)
content:
(1)  An air pollution control board operating underKRS 77.070shall, in July of each year, elect from its members a chairman and a vice chairman
      who shall be of different political party affiliation.  The board shall employ a competent secretary-treasurer and an air pollution control
      officer, neither of whom shall be a member of the board.  The secretary-treasurer and the air pollution control officer shall devote their
      entire time and attention exclusively to the services of the board.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control›KY REV ST 77.155. Prohibited emission of air contaminants
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control › KY REV ST 77.155. Prohibited emission of air contaminants
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 77.155. Prohibited emission of air contaminants (2023)
content:
(1)  A person shall not, nor shall an agent or employee of a person, nor shall a person
      as agent or employee of another, discharge into the atmosphere from any single source
      of emission whatsoever, any air contaminant in quantities and for a period or periods
      in excess of applicable emission standards established by regulation by the air pollution
      control board.  Exceeding these standards shall constitute a rebuttable presumption of violation
      of this section.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control›KY REV ST 77.100. Bond of secretary-treasurer, air pollution control officer and other officers and employees
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control › KY REV ST 77.100. Bond of secretary-treasurer, air pollution control officer and other officers and employees
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 77.100. Bond of secretary-treasurer, air pollution control officer and other officers and employees (2023)
content:
An air pollution control board shall require the secretary-treasurer and the air pollution
   control officer each to execute bond, and may exact from such of its other officers
   and employees bonds as it may deem expedient.  All such bonds shall be payable to the district in such sums as the board may fix
   with approved corporate surety, and premiums therefor shall be paid by the district.  Such bonds shall obligate the makers thereof to faithfully perform the duties of
   their respective offices and positions and to fully account for and pay over all money,
   property or other thing of value of the district, which may come to their hands, respectively.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control›KY REV ST 77.095. Employment of professional, technical or other advisers, experts and employees
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control › KY REV ST 77.095. Employment of professional, technical or other advisers, experts and employees
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 77.095. Employment of professional, technical or other advisers, experts and employees (2023)
content:
The air pollution control board of any air pollution control district in the Commonwealth
   may employ and remove at pleasure professional and technical advisers, experts, and
   other employees, skilled or unskilled, as it deems requisite for the performance of
   its duties.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control›KY REV ST 77.105. Hearing board; membership, qualifications, term, removal
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control › KY REV ST 77.105. Hearing board; membership, qualifications, term, removal
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 77.105. Hearing board; membership, qualifications, term, removal (2023)
content:
(1)  The air pollution control board of an air pollution control district shall appoint
      a hearing board to consist of three (3) members, none of whom is a member of the air
      pollution control board, and only two (2) of whom may be of the same political party
      affiliation.  Two (2) members of the hearing board shall have been admitted to practice law in
      this Commonwealth.  Both shall be residents and freeholders of the district.  Neither shall be otherwise employed by the air pollution control district or by
      any other municipal corporation or political subdivision of the Commonwealth.  The third member of the hearing board shall be an engineer by profession, and shall
      be a graduate of a recognized university or college and shall be thoroughly familiar
      with the theory and practice of the construction and operation of furnaces and combustion
      devices, or in the theory of the prevention and control of air pollution.  The latter member shall not be otherwise employed by the air pollution control district
      or the air pollution control board appointing the hearing board, but may be an employee
      of some other political subdivision or municipal corporation of the Commonwealth.  He need not reside nor own property within the district.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control›KY REV ST 77.115. Air pollution control board is governing body of district; duties, responsibilities, and regulatory authority of board; vehicle exhaust testing program; limitations; exemptions
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control › KY REV ST 77.115. Air pollution control board is governing body of district; duties, responsibilities, and regulatory authority of board; vehicle exhaust testing program; limitations; exemptions
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 77.115. Air pollution control board is governing body of district; duties, responsibilities, and regulatory authority of board; vehicle exhaust testing program; limitations; exemptions (2023)
content:
(1)  The air pollution control board is hereby declared to be the governing body of
      an air pollution control district, and shall manage and control all the affairs and
      property of such district, and shall exercise all the powers of such district not
      otherwise delegated by this chapter.  In a county where a city-county compact underKRS 79.310to79.330is in effect or in a county where a consolidated local government has been established,
      the air pollution control board shall assume all of the duties and responsibilities
      of the hearing board appointed underKRS 77.105, and the hearing board shall be abolished.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control›KY REV ST 77.140. Accounting; audits and attestation procedures
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control › KY REV ST 77.140. Accounting; audits and attestation procedures
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 77.140. Accounting; audits and attestation procedures (2023)
content:
(1)  The air pollution control board created pursuant toKRS 77.070shall install and maintain a modern and efficient system of accounting and keep financial
      records.  The board, however, may select and use the finance department of the consolidated
      local government or city to do its financial accounting and make its disbursements
      in a manner as may be agreed upon by and between the board and the director of finance
      of the consolidated local government or city, which work shall be done by the finance
      department without compensation from the board.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control›KY REV ST 77.127. Air quality trust fund
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control › KY REV ST 77.127. Air quality trust fund
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 77.127. Air quality trust fund (2023)
content:
(1)  In a county containing a consolidated local government or a city of the first
      class or a city having a population equal to or greater than twenty thousand (20,000)
      based upon the most recent federal decennial census, there is established within the
      air pollution control district a special trust fund to be known as the “air quality trust fund” to be used for conducting and funding air quality research and development projects,
      special nonrecurring air quality projects, and air quality education programs approved
      by the air pollution control board to assist in implementing the policies and purposes
      of this chapter.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control›KY REV ST 77.130. Fiscal year
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control › KY REV ST 77.130. Fiscal year
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 77.130. Fiscal year (2023)
content:
The fiscal year of an air pollution control board district shall begin on the first
   day of July of each year and end with June 30 next following.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control›KY REV ST 77.145. Duties of air pollution control officer; powers as peace officer
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control › KY REV ST 77.145. Duties of air pollution control officer; powers as peace officer
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 77.145. Duties of air pollution control officer; powers as peace officer (2023)
content:
(1)  The air pollution control officer shall observe and enforce, within his air pollution
      control district:

title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control › KY REV ST 77.160. Operations exempted from provisions of KRS § 77.155

content: The provisions ofKRS 77.155shall not be applicable:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control›KY REV ST 77.150. Prohibitions inapplicable unless district activated
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control › KY REV ST 77.150. Prohibitions inapplicable unless district activated
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 77.150. Prohibitions inapplicable unless district activated (2023)
content:
The provisions ofKRS 77.150to77.175do not apply within any air pollution control district unless and until, pursuant
   to resolution and ordinance as provided inKRS 77.010to77.060, such air pollution control district may function and exercise its powers.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control›KY REV ST 77.165. Right of entry and inspection powers of air pollution control officer, assistants and deputies
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control › KY REV ST 77.165. Right of entry and inspection powers of air pollution control officer, assistants and deputies
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 77.165. Right of entry and inspection powers of air pollution control officer, assistants and deputies (2023)
content:
The air pollution control officer, his deputies and assistants, during reasonable
   hours, for the purpose of enforcing or administering this chapter or of any order,
   regulation or rule prescribed pursuant thereto, may enter every building, premises,
   or other place, except a building designed for and used exclusively as a private residence
   and may stop, detain and inspect any vehicles whether designed for and used on a public
   highway, rails, or in any other manner.  No person shall in any way deny, obstruct, or hamper such entrance, or such stopping,
   detaining or inspection of such vehicle, or refuse to stop such a vehicle upon the
   lawful order of the air pollution control officer, his deputy or assistant.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control›KY REV ST 77.135. Budget; contingent fund; compliance with KRS 65A.010. to § 65A.090
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control › KY REV ST 77.135. Budget; contingent fund; compliance with KRS 65A.010. to § 65A.090
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 77.135. Budget; contingent fund; compliance with KRS 65A.010. to § 65A.090 (2023)
content:
(1)  It shall be the duty of the secretary-treasurer of an air pollution control board
      formed pursuant toKRS 77.070, during or before the month of May of each year, to prepare and certify to the consolidated
      local government or fiscal court of the county and to the legislative body of the
      city, for their joint consideration, a preliminary budget showing the total funds
      which, in the judgment of the air pollution control board, will be needed for the
      various departments of the district, together with a statement showing the estimated
      balances, if any, which will be available on July 1 for expenditure during the next
      fiscal year following the certification of said statement, and also indicating, as
      nearly as may be possible, what additional funds or assets (other than appropriations)
      will be or will become available for expenditure during that year.  The board shall also furnish to the consolidated local government or the fiscal
      court and the city legislative body any other information or data available to it
      which the consolidated local government, the fiscal court, or the city legislative
      body may request.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control›KY REV ST 77.175. Violations may be enjoined
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control › KY REV ST 77.175. Violations may be enjoined
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 77.175. Violations may be enjoined (2023)
content:
Any violation of any provision ofKRS 77.150to77.175may be enjoined in a civil action brought by the air pollution control board, the
   air pollution control officer, or any person aggrieved by such violation.  Such abatement may be in addition to the fine hereinafter provided.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control›KY REV ST 77.180. Orders, rules and regulations
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control › KY REV ST 77.180. Orders, rules and regulations
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 77.180. Orders, rules and regulations (2023)
content:
(1)  The air pollution control board of an air pollution control district may make
      and enforce all needful orders, rules, and regulations necessary or proper to accomplish
      the purposes of this chapter for the administration of such district, and may perform
      all other acts necessary or proper to accomplish the purposes of this chapter.

title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control › KY REV ST 77.230. Powers of hearing board after public hearing
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 77.230. Powers of hearing board after public hearing (2023)
content: After a public hearing, the hearing board may:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control›KY REV ST 77.185. Public hearing to be held before enactment of orders, rules, or regulations; adoption of procedural rules for the promulgation of regulations
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control › KY REV ST 77.185. Public hearing to be held before enactment of orders, rules, or regulations; adoption of procedural rules for the promulgation of regulations
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 77.185. Public hearing to be held before enactment of orders, rules, or regulations; adoption of procedural rules for the promulgation of regulations (2023)
content:
(1)  The air pollution control board shall not enact any order, rule, or regulation
      until it first holds a public hearing thereon.  It shall give notice of the public hearing by publication pursuant to KRS Chapter
      424.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control›KY REV ST 77.170. Stricter local regulation not preempted; local ordinances not superseded; exceptions
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 77. Air Pollution Control › KY REV ST 77.170. Stricter local regulation not preempted; local ordinances not superseded; exceptions
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 77.170. Stricter local regulation not preempted; local ordinances not superseded; exceptions (2023)
content:
(1)  Except for subsection (3) of this section, the General Assembly does not, by
      the provisions of this chapter, intend to occupy the field except for requiring a
      county air pollution control board to exempt from the requirements of a vehicle exhaust
      testing program vehicles registered to military personnel on active duty whose duty
      station is outside of a county.  Except for subsection (3) of this section, the provisions of this chapter do not
      prohibit the enactment or enforcement of any local ordinance stricter than the provisions
      ofKRS 77.150to77.180and stricter than the rules and regulations adopted pursuant toKRS 77.180to77.240, which local ordinance prohibits, regulates, or controls air pollution.
