title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title X. Elections › Chapter 116. Voter Registration › KY REV ST 116.035. Determination of voter's residence
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 116.035. Determination of voter's residence (2023)
content:
The following rules, so far as applicable, shall be observed in determining the residence
   of a person offering to vote:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 109. Local Solid Waste Management›KY REV ST 109.160. Condemnation of property
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 109. Local Solid Waste Management › KY REV ST 109.160. Condemnation of property
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 109.160. Condemnation of property (2023)
content:
The board may by resolution recite the need, order the condemnation on behalf of the
   waste management district of any real property or interest therein that in the opinion
   of the board is necessary for the proposed construction or use of a solid waste management
   facility.  Proceedings for condemnation shall be conducted in the manner prescribed in the
   Eminent Domain Act of Kentucky.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 109. Local Solid Waste Management›KY REV ST 109.140. Use of funds
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 109. Local Solid Waste Management › KY REV ST 109.140. Use of funds
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 109.140. Use of funds (2023)
content:
All funds derived from taxes, service charges, sales or other income resulting from
   the operation of a waste management district shall if collected or held by another
   person be paid to and expended by the district to carry out its duties, functions,
   and responsibilities.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 109. Local Solid Waste Management›KY REV ST 109.115. Districts; establishment; powers; directors, appointment and removal; board of directors in county not containing a consolidated local government; board of directors in county containing a consolidated local government
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 109. Local Solid Waste Management › KY REV ST 109.115. Districts; establishment; powers; directors, appointment and removal; board of directors in county not containing a consolidated local government; board of directors in county containing a consolidated local government
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 109.115. Districts; establishment; powers; directors, appointment and removal; board of directors in county not containing a consolidated local government; board of directors in county containing a consolidated local government (2023)
content:
(1)  A single county, or two (2) or more counties may create a waste management district
      in accordance with the procedures ofKRS 65.182.  Waste management districts shall have all powers and authority set forth inKRS 109.041.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 109. Local Solid Waste Management›KY REV ST 109.190. Status of existing districts
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 109. Local Solid Waste Management › KY REV ST 109.190. Status of existing districts
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 109.190. Status of existing districts (2023)
content:
Garbage and refuse districts established pursuant to this chapter prior to June 17,
   1978, whether de jure or de facto, unless the cabinet finds that such do not comply
   with the Federal Resource Conservation and Recovery Act as amended and with the state
   solid waste management plan, shall be deemed waste management districts and shall
   have all of the powers and duties of waste management districts as set forth in this
   chapter.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 109. Local Solid Waste Management›KY REV ST 109.150. Acquisition of property by waste management district
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 109. Local Solid Waste Management › KY REV ST 109.150. Acquisition of property by waste management district
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 109.150. Acquisition of property by waste management district (2023)
content:
The waste management district may acquire by bequest, gift, grant or purchase such
   real and personal property or any interest therein as may be necessary to accomplish
   its purposes.  Title to all property acquired by the waste management district shall be vested
   solely in the name of the district.  With the approval of the department the waste management district may apply for
   and receive funds available under federal legislation such as grants and loans for
   the purpose of improving solid waste management.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 109. Local Solid Waste Management›KY REV ST 109.280. Exercise of powers in urban-county governments
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 109. Local Solid Waste Management › KY REV ST 109.280. Exercise of powers in urban-county governments
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 109.280. Exercise of powers in urban-county governments (2023)
content:
(1)  In urban-county governments powers delegated in this chapter to the county judge/executive
      shall be exercised by the official in whom the chief executive power is vested.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 109. Local Solid Waste Management›KY REV ST 109.170. Issuance of bonds
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 109. Local Solid Waste Management › KY REV ST 109.170. Issuance of bonds
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 109.170. Issuance of bonds (2023)
content:
For the purpose of acquiring, creating and maintaining collection systems and solid
   waste management facilities any waste management district may pursuant to the provisions
   of KRS Chapter 58 borrow money and issue negotiable revenue bonds.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 109. Local Solid Waste Management›KY REV ST 109.310. Collection of solid waste pick-up fees; combination with property tax bill; notice; waiver if owner of property is not the occupant; assessment of fines or fees
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 109. Local Solid Waste Management › KY REV ST 109.310. Collection of solid waste pick-up fees; combination with property tax bill; notice; waiver if owner of property is not the occupant; assessment of fines or fees
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 109.310. Collection of solid waste pick-up fees; combination with property tax bill; notice; waiver if owner of property is not the occupant; assessment of fines or fees (2023)
content:
(1)  A county or urban-county government may collect solid waste pick-up fees which
      are delinquent three (3) consecutive months or more by combining the delinquent fees
      with the property tax bill for the property where the solid waste pick-up is made.  The fees shall be limited to a return on capital expenditures and to cover operational
      costs.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 109. Local Solid Waste Management›KY REV ST 109.260. City providing solid waste management services pending implementation of approved plan
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 109. Local Solid Waste Management › KY REV ST 109.260. City providing solid waste management services pending implementation of approved plan
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 109.260. City providing solid waste management services pending implementation of approved plan (2023)
content:
(1)  No provision of this chapter shall preclude a city from providing solid waste
      management services pending implementation of the approved solid waste management
      plan submitted by a county or district pursuant toKRS 224.43-340.  Any county or waste management district that includes the provision of solid waste
      management services to a city in its approved solid waste management plan shall provide
      the city with written notice at least one (1) year prior to the date it intends to
      provide such service to the city.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 109. Local Solid Waste Management›KY REV ST 109.300. Purpose of KRS 109.310. to § 109.320
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 109. Local Solid Waste Management › KY REV ST 109.300. Purpose of KRS 109.310. to § 109.320
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 109.300. Purpose of KRS 109.310. to § 109.320 (2023)
content:
(1)  It is the purpose ofKRS 109.310to109.320to further the intention of the General Assembly of the Commonwealth of Kentucky
      as expressed inKRS 109.011that the primary responsibility for adequate solid waste collection, disposal and
      resource recovery rests with counties, and to assist local governments to carry out
      those responsibilities.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title X. Elections›Chapter 116. Voter Registration›KY REV ST 116.013. “Voter” defined
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title X. Elections › Chapter 116. Voter Registration › KY REV ST 116.013. “Voter” defined
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 116.013. “Voter” defined (2023)
content: Unless the context otherwise requires, the word “voter” means any name contained in any registration list.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title X. Elections›Chapter 116. Voter Registration›KY REV ST 116.025. Eligibility to vote
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title X. Elections › Chapter 116. Voter Registration › KY REV ST 116.025. Eligibility to vote
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 116.025. Eligibility to vote (2023)
content:
(1)  Every person who is a citizen of the United States, a resident of this state,
      and a resident of the precinct in which he or she offers to vote on or before the
      day preceding the closing of the registration books for any primary, general, or special
      election, who possesses on the day of any election the qualifications set forth inSection 145 of the Constitution, exclusive of the durational residency requirements, who is not disqualified under
      that section or under any other statute, and who is registered as provided in this
      chapter, may vote for all officers to be elected by the people and on all public questions
      submitted for determination at that election, in the precinct in which he or she is
      qualified to vote.  Any person who shall have been convicted of any election law offense which is a
      felony shall not be permitted to vote until his or her civil rights have been restored
      by executive pardon.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units›Chapter 109. Local Solid Waste Management›KY REV ST 109.270. Establishment of district by citizen petition and election; election on plan; dissolution or modification of districts
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title IX. Counties, Cities, and Other Local Units › Chapter 109. Local Solid Waste Management › KY REV ST 109.270. Establishment of district by citizen petition and election; election on plan; dissolution or modification of districts
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 109.270. Establishment of district by citizen petition and election; election on plan; dissolution or modification of districts (2023)
content:
(1)  When the citizens of a county desire to have such county establish a solid waste
      management plan and as of January 1, 1984, the fiscal court has failed to establish
      a plan, a number of citizens equivalent to ten percent (10%) of the votes cast in
      the county for the office receiving the greatest total vote at the last general election,
      shall file a petition in the county of their residence asking that a solid waste management
      plan be established.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title X. Elections›Chapter 116. Voter Registration›KY REV ST 116.037. Designation of precincts in area ceded or leased to the government of the United States
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title X. Elections › Chapter 116. Voter Registration › KY REV ST 116.037. Designation of precincts in area ceded or leased to the government of the United States
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 116.037. Designation of precincts in area ceded or leased to the government of the United States (2023)
content:
In each county having within its boundaries a geographical area which has been ceded
   or leased to the government of the United States, the county clerk shall designate
   the precincts to which voters claiming Kentucky residence for voting purposes shall
   be assigned.  If the ceded or leased territory extends beyond a single county, the county clerk
   in each county encompassing a part of the territory shall assign voters to the appropriate
   precincts.  In making the assignments of absentee voters in any county that contains all or
   portions of more than one (1) congressional or state legislative district, any advantage
   shall be given to the district containing the largest territory.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title X. Elections›Chapter 116. Voter Registration›KY REV ST 116.0455. Voter registration through motor vehicle driver's license application
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title X. Elections › Chapter 116. Voter Registration › KY REV ST 116.0455. Voter registration through motor vehicle driver's license application
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 116.0455. Voter registration through motor vehicle driver's license application (2023)
content:
(1)  (a) Each motor vehicle driver's license application, including any renewal application,
         submitted to the appropriate motor vehicle authority shall serve as an application
         for voter registration unless the applicant fails to sign the voter registration application.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title X. Elections›Chapter 116. Voter Registration›KY REV ST 116.046. Voter registration forms for public high schools, area technology centers, and private schools; public education program
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title X. Elections › Chapter 116. Voter Registration › KY REV ST 116.046. Voter registration forms for public high schools, area technology centers, and private schools; public education program
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 116.046. Voter registration forms for public high schools, area technology centers, and private schools; public education program (2023)
content:
(1)  The county clerk shall provide voter registration forms annually to each principal
      or assistant principal of every public high school, each area technology center, and
      private schools, and each school shall have a designated person who shall be responsible
      for informing students and school personnel of the availability of the registration
      forms and assist them in properly registering.  The completed forms shall be returned to the county clerk, for official registration
      by the county clerk.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title X. Elections›Chapter 116. Voter Registration›KY REV ST 116.047. Forgery, alteration, destruction or failure to return completed registration form
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title X. Elections › Chapter 116. Voter Registration › KY REV ST 116.047. Forgery, alteration, destruction or failure to return completed registration form
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 116.047. Forgery, alteration, destruction or failure to return completed registration form (2023)
content:
Any individual who forges or fraudulently alters a form completed by the prospective
   registrant, who willfully destroys a completed registration form or who willfully
   fails to return a completed form to the county clerk for official registration by
   the county clerk shall be subject to the penalties described for Class D felonies.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title X. Elections›Chapter 116. Voter Registration›KY REV ST 116.0452. Standards for timely receipt of voter registration application; removal of names from registration books; confidentiality of registration location
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title X. Elections › Chapter 116. Voter Registration › KY REV ST 116.0452. Standards for timely receipt of voter registration application; removal of names from registration books; confidentiality of registration location
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 116.0452. Standards for timely receipt of voter registration application; removal of names from registration books; confidentiality of registration location (2023)
content:
(1)  For the purpose of determining whether a voter registration application is received
      during the period in which registration books are open underKRS 116.045(2), an application shall be deemed timely received:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title X. Elections›Chapter 116. Voter Registration›KY REV ST 116.045. Voter registration, transfer, or change of party affiliation; availability of forms
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title X. Elections › Chapter 116. Voter Registration › KY REV ST 116.045. Voter registration, transfer, or change of party affiliation; availability of forms
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 116.045. Voter registration, transfer, or change of party affiliation; availability of forms (2023)
content:
(1)  Any person may register as a voter during the period registration is open if
      he or she possesses, or will possess on the day of the next regular election, the
      qualifications set forth inKRS 116.025.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title X. Elections›Chapter 116. Voter Registration›KY REV ST 116.055. Qualifications for voting in a primary
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title X. Elections › Chapter 116. Voter Registration › KY REV ST 116.055. Qualifications for voting in a primary
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 116.055. Qualifications for voting in a primary (2023)
content: (1)  Before a person shall be qualified to vote in a primary, he or she:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title X. Elections›Chapter 116. Voter Registration›KY REV ST 116.048. Voter registration agencies
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title X. Elections › Chapter 116. Voter Registration › KY REV ST 116.048. Voter registration agencies
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 116.048. Voter registration agencies (2023)
content:
(1)  The following agencies are designated as voter registration agencies in accordance
      with the National Voter Registration Act of 1993:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title X. Elections›Chapter 116. Voter Registration›KY REV ST 116.065. Verification of applications
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title X. Elections › Chapter 116. Voter Registration › KY REV ST 116.065. Verification of applications
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 116.065. Verification of applications (2023)
content:
Each application for registration, change of affiliation, transfer of registration,
   federal provisional ballot, absentee ballot, or federal provisional absentee ballot,
   as absentee ballots and federal provisional absentee ballots are provided for byKRS 117.076,117.077,117.085, and117.229shall be verified by a written declaration by the applicant that it is made under
   the penalties of perjury.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title X. Elections›Chapter 116. Voter Registration›KY REV ST 116.085. Transfer of registration; change of residence; name change
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title X. Elections › Chapter 116. Voter Registration › KY REV ST 116.085. Transfer of registration; change of residence; name change
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 116.085. Transfer of registration; change of residence; name change (2023)
content:
(1)  When a voter changes his place of residence to another location within the county,
      the clerk shall, upon application of the voter in person, by mail, or through the
      Transportation Cabinet, transfer the voter's registration record to the proper precinct.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title X. Elections›Chapter 116. Voter Registration›KY REV ST 116.112. Voter registration purge program; inactive voter list
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title X. Elections › Chapter 116. Voter Registration › KY REV ST 116.112. Voter registration purge program; inactive voter list
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 116.112. Voter registration purge program; inactive voter list (2023)
content:
(1)  The State Board of Elections shall establish a voter registration purge program
      using the change-of-address information supplied by the United States Postal Service
      through its licensees or other sources to identify voters whose addresses may have
      changed.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title X. Elections›Chapter 116. Voter Registration›KY REV ST 116.155. Forms for registration; information required
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title X. Elections › Chapter 116. Voter Registration › KY REV ST 116.155. Forms for registration; information required
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 116.155. Forms for registration; information required (2023)
content:
All forms pertaining to registration shall be prescribed and furnished by the State
   Board of Elections.  The registration form shall include the voter's name;  date of birth;  membership
   in a political party, political organization, or political group as defined inKRS 118.015, or independent status;  Social Security number, if any;  mailing and residence addresses,
   if different;  and such other information as the State Board of Elections may deem
   necessary.  No person shall be denied the right to register because of the failure to include
   his Social Security number.  All forms which require a voter's signature shall provide for verification by the
   signer thereof.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title X. Elections›Chapter 117A . Uniform Military and Overseas Voters Act›KY REV ST 117A.040. Voting precinct and address of overseas voter; administrative regulations
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title X. Elections › Chapter 117A . Uniform Military and Overseas Voters Act › KY REV ST 117A.040. Voting precinct and address of overseas voter; administrative regulations
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 117A.040. Voting precinct and address of overseas voter; administrative regulations (2023)
content:
(1)  In registering to vote, an overseas voter who is eligible to vote in the Commonwealth
      of Kentucky shall use and shall be assigned to the voting precinct of the address
      of the last place of residence of the voter in the Commonwealth of Kentucky, or, in
      the case of a voter described byKRS 117A.010(1)(e), the address of the last place of residence in the Commonwealth of Kentucky of the
      parent or legal guardian of the voter.  If that address is no longer a recognized residential address, the voter shall be
      assigned an address for voting purposes.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title X. Elections›Chapter 117. Regulation of Elections›KY REV ST 117.001. Definitions for chapter
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title X. Elections › Chapter 117. Regulation of Elections › KY REV ST 117.001. Definitions for chapter
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 117.001. Definitions for chapter (2023)
content: As used in this chapter, unless the context otherwise requires:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title X. Elections›Chapter 116. Voter Registration›KY REV ST 116.135. Appeal from decision of county board
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title X. Elections › Chapter 116. Voter Registration › KY REV ST 116.135. Appeal from decision of county board
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 116.135. Appeal from decision of county board (2023)
content:
Appeals from the decision of the county board of elections may be taken to the Circuit
   Court within ten (10) days following the final decision of the board.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title X. Elections›Chapter 116. Voter Registration›KY REV ST 116.165. Falsification of signature or verification
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title X. Elections › Chapter 116. Voter Registration › KY REV ST 116.165. Falsification of signature or verification
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 116.165. Falsification of signature or verification (2023)
content:
Any person who falsely signs and verifies any form requiring verification shall be
   guilty of perjury and subject to the penalties therefor.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title X. Elections›Chapter 116. Voter Registration›KY REV ST 116.113. Removal of voter's name by state board upon notice of death, declaration of incompetency, or conviction of felony or out-of-state registration; notice to county clerk
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title X. Elections › Chapter 116. Voter Registration › KY REV ST 116.113. Removal of voter's name by state board upon notice of death, declaration of incompetency, or conviction of felony or out-of-state registration; notice to county clerk
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 116.113. Removal of voter's name by state board upon notice of death, declaration of incompetency, or conviction of felony or out-of-state registration; notice to county clerk (2023)
content:
(1)  Upon receipt of notification from the Cabinet for Health and Family Services
      or other reliable sources of the death of a person, the State Board of Elections shall
      within five (5) days cause the removal of the name of that person from the voter registration
      records it maintains, except that no voter's name may be removed during the period
      of time the registration books are closed for any primary, general, or special election.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title X. Elections›Chapter 116. Voter Registration›KY REV ST 116.095. Access to registration records; redaction of Social Security numbers
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title X. Elections › Chapter 116. Voter Registration › KY REV ST 116.095. Access to registration records; redaction of Social Security numbers
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 116.095. Access to registration records; redaction of Social Security numbers (2023)
content:
The county clerk shall permit any citizen, at all reasonable hours, to inspect or
   make copies of any registration record, without any fee.  He or she shall, upon request, furnish to any citizen a copy of the registration
   records, for which he or she may charge necessary duplicating costs not to exceed
   fifty cents ($0.50) per page.  If a registered voter's Social Security number is included on his or her registration
   information, the Social Security number shall be redacted by the county clerk before
   it is duplicated and furnished to the citizen requesting the copy and before it is
   inspected or duplicated by the citizen.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title X. Elections›Chapter 116. Voter Registration›KY REV ST 116.145. Fee for registration
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title X. Elections › Chapter 116. Voter Registration › KY REV ST 116.145. Fee for registration
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 116.145. Fee for registration (2023)
content:
The fee for registration of all voters shall be paid to the county clerk by the state
   in the amount of twenty-five cents ($0.25) for each person registered.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title X. Elections›Chapter 116. Voter Registration›KY REV ST 116.200. Roster of voters eligible to vote in city and school board elections; information to be provided to county clerk
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title X. Elections › Chapter 116. Voter Registration › KY REV ST 116.200. Roster of voters eligible to vote in city and school board elections; information to be provided to county clerk
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 116.200. Roster of voters eligible to vote in city and school board elections; information to be provided to county clerk (2023)
content:
(1)  (a) On or before January 1, 2011, each city clerk, except in consolidated local
         governments and urban-county governments, shall provide the clerk of the county or
         counties in which the city is located with a list of all properties within the city
         and a map of the city boundaries for the county clerk to maintain a roster of voters
         who are eligible to vote in city elections.  A county clerk may accept the list of city properties in an electronic format and
         the city clerk may provide a copy of the city's boundary map maintained by the Kentucky
         Commonwealth Office of Technology, Division of Geographic Information Systems;  and

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title X. Elections›Chapter 117A . Uniform Military and Overseas Voters Act›KY REV ST 117A.090. Deadline for valid military-overseas ballot
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title X. Elections › Chapter 117A . Uniform Military and Overseas Voters Act › KY REV ST 117A.090. Deadline for valid military-overseas ballot
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 117A.090. Deadline for valid military-overseas ballot (2023)
content:
To be valid, a military-overseas ballot shall be received by the appropriate local
   election official not later than the time established by the election laws generally
   for the closing of the polls, which time shall not include the extra hour during which
   those voters may vote who were waiting in line to vote at the scheduled poll closing
   time.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title X. Elections›Chapter 117A . Uniform Military and Overseas Voters Act›KY REV ST 117A.030. Powers and duties of State Board of Elections
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title X. Elections › Chapter 117A . Uniform Military and Overseas Voters Act › KY REV ST 117A.030. Powers and duties of State Board of Elections
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 117A.030. Powers and duties of State Board of Elections (2023)
content:
(1)  The State Board of Elections is responsible for implementing this chapter and
      the Commonwealth of Kentucky's responsibilities under the Registration and Voting
      by Absent Uniformed Services Voters and Overseas Voters in Elections for Federal Office
      Act,52 U.S.C. secs. 20301to20311.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title X. Elections›Chapter 117A . Uniform Military and Overseas Voters Act›KY REV ST 117A.010. Definitions for chapter
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title X. Elections › Chapter 117A . Uniform Military and Overseas Voters Act › KY REV ST 117A.010. Definitions for chapter
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 117A.010. Definitions for chapter (2023)
content: As used in this chapter, unless the context otherwise requires:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title X. Elections›Chapter 117A . Uniform Military and Overseas Voters Act›KY REV ST 117A.005. Short title
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title X. Elections › Chapter 117A . Uniform Military and Overseas Voters Act › KY REV ST 117A.005. Short title
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 117A.005. Short title (2023)
content: This chapter may be cited as the Uniform Military and Overseas Voters Act.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title X. Elections›Chapter 117A . Uniform Military and Overseas Voters Act›KY REV ST 117A.060. Application by covered voter; declaration; informing election official that voter is covered
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title X. Elections › Chapter 117A . Uniform Military and Overseas Voters Act › KY REV ST 117A.060. Application by covered voter; declaration; informing election official that voter is covered
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 117A.060. Application by covered voter; declaration; informing election official that voter is covered (2023)
content:
(1)  A covered voter who is registered to vote in the Commonwealth of Kentucky may
      apply for a military-overseas ballot using either the regular absentee ballot application
      in use in the voter's jurisdiction underKRS 117.085, or the federal postcard application, or the application's electronic equivalent.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title X. Elections›Chapter 117A . Uniform Military and Overseas Voters Act›KY REV ST 117A.050. Registration to vote; postcard application or equivalent; declaration accompanying federal ballot; electronic transmission system
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title X. Elections › Chapter 117A . Uniform Military and Overseas Voters Act › KY REV ST 117A.050. Registration to vote; postcard application or equivalent; declaration accompanying federal ballot; electronic transmission system
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 117A.050. Registration to vote; postcard application or equivalent; declaration accompanying federal ballot; electronic transmission system (2023)
content:
(1)  To apply to register to vote, in addition to any other approved method, a covered
      voter may use a federal postcard application, or the application's electronic equivalent.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title X. Elections›Chapter 117A . Uniform Military and Overseas Voters Act›KY REV ST 117A.020. Elections to which voting procedures apply
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title X. Elections › Chapter 117A . Uniform Military and Overseas Voters Act › KY REV ST 117A.020. Elections to which voting procedures apply
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 117A.020. Elections to which voting procedures apply (2023)
content: The voting procedures in this chapter apply to:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title X. Elections›Chapter 117A . Uniform Military and Overseas Voters Act›KY REV ST 117A.100. Use of federal write-in absentee ballot
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title X. Elections › Chapter 117A . Uniform Military and Overseas Voters Act › KY REV ST 117A.100. Use of federal write-in absentee ballot
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 117A.100. Use of federal write-in absentee ballot (2023)
content:
A covered voter may use a federal write-in absentee ballot to vote for all offices
   and ballot measures in an election described inKRS 117A.020.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title X. Elections›Chapter 117A . Uniform Military and Overseas Voters Act›KY REV ST 117A.110. Counting of valid military-overseas ballot
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title X. Elections › Chapter 117A . Uniform Military and Overseas Voters Act › KY REV ST 117A.110. Counting of valid military-overseas ballot
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 117A.110. Counting of valid military-overseas ballot (2023)
content:
A valid military-overseas ballot cast in accordance withKRS 117A.090shall be counted if it is received by the appropriate local election official not
   later than the time established by the election laws generally for the closing of
   the polls, which time shall not include the extra hour during which those voters may
   vote who were waiting in line to vote at the scheduled poll closing time, and the
   ballot may not be rejected on the basis that it has a late postmark, an unreadable
   postmark, or no postmark.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title X. Elections›Chapter 117A . Uniform Military and Overseas Voters Act›KY REV ST 117A.070. Application for military-overseas ballot
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title X. Elections › Chapter 117A . Uniform Military and Overseas Voters Act › KY REV ST 117A.070. Application for military-overseas ballot
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 117A.070. Application for military-overseas ballot (2023)
content:
An application for a military-overseas ballot is timely if received by the close of
   business hours seven (7) days before the election.  An application for a military-overseas ballot for a primary, whether or not timely,
   is effective as an application for a military-overseas ballot for the regular election.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title X. Elections›Chapter 117A . Uniform Military and Overseas Voters Act›KY REV ST 117A.080. Transmission of ballot and balloting materials to covered voters; electronic transmission
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title X. Elections › Chapter 117A . Uniform Military and Overseas Voters Act › KY REV ST 117A.080. Transmission of ballot and balloting materials to covered voters; electronic transmission
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 117A.080. Transmission of ballot and balloting materials to covered voters; electronic transmission (2023)
content:
(1)  For an election described inKRS 117A.020, not later than forty-five (45) days before the election or, if the forty-fifth day
      before the election is a weekend or holiday, not later than the business day preceding
      the forty-fifth day, the election official in each jurisdiction charged with distributing
      a ballot and balloting materials shall transmit a ballot and balloting materials to
      all covered voters who by that date submit a valid military-overseas ballot application.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title X. Elections›Chapter 117A . Uniform Military and Overseas Voters Act›KY REV ST 117A.140. Electronic mail address; standing request for electronic delivery
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title X. Elections › Chapter 117A . Uniform Military and Overseas Voters Act › KY REV ST 117A.140. Electronic mail address; standing request for electronic delivery
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 117A.140. Electronic mail address; standing request for electronic delivery (2023)
content:
(1)  The local election official shall request an electronic mail address from each
      covered voter who applies to register to vote after July 1, 2014.  An electronic mail address provided by any voter may not be made available to the
      public or any individual or organization other than an authorized agent of the local
      election official and is exempt from disclosure under the Kentucky Open Records Act,KRS 61.870to61.884.  The address may be used only for official communication with the voter about the
      voting process, including transmitting military-overseas ballots and election materials
      if the voter has requested electronic transmission, and verifying the voter's mailing
      address and physical location.  The request for an electronic mail address shall describe the purposes for which
      the electronic mail address may be used and include a statement that any other use
      or disclosure of the electronic mail address is prohibited.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title X. Elections›Chapter 117A . Uniform Military and Overseas Voters Act›KY REV ST 117A.130. Electronic information about receipt of application and ballot
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title X. Elections › Chapter 117A . Uniform Military and Overseas Voters Act › KY REV ST 117A.130. Electronic information about receipt of application and ballot
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 117A.130. Electronic information about receipt of application and ballot (2023)
content:
The State Board of Elections, in coordination with local election officials, shall
   implement an electronic free-access system by which a covered voter may determine
   by telephone, electronic mail, or Internet whether:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title X. Elections›Chapter 117A . Uniform Military and Overseas Voters Act›KY REV ST 117A.150. Sample ballot
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title X. Elections › Chapter 117A . Uniform Military and Overseas Voters Act › KY REV ST 117A.150. Sample ballot
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 117A.150. Sample ballot (2023)
content:
(1)  At least fifty (50) days before a regularly scheduled election and forty-five
      (45) days before an election not regularly scheduled, an official in each jurisdiction
      charged with printing and distributing ballots and balloting material shall make available
      a sample ballot that includes all of the ballot measures and federal, state, and local
      offices provided inKRS 117A.020that will be on the ballot on the date of the election, and shall provide an electronic
      copy of the sample ballot to the Secretary of State and to the State Board of Elections.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title X. Elections›Chapter 117A . Uniform Military and Overseas Voters Act›KY REV ST 117A.170. Injunction and other equitable relief
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title X. Elections › Chapter 117A . Uniform Military and Overseas Voters Act › KY REV ST 117A.170. Injunction and other equitable relief
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 117A.170. Injunction and other equitable relief (2023)
content:
A court may issue an injunction or grant other equitable relief appropriate to ensure
   substantial compliance with, or enforce, this chapter on application by:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title X. Elections›Chapter 117A . Uniform Military and Overseas Voters Act›KY REV ST 117A.120. Declaration concerning material misstatement of fact
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title X. Elections › Chapter 117A . Uniform Military and Overseas Voters Act › KY REV ST 117A.120. Declaration concerning material misstatement of fact
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 117A.120. Declaration concerning material misstatement of fact (2023)
content:
A military-overseas ballot shall include or be accompanied by a declaration signed
   by the voter that a material misstatement of fact in completing the ballot may be
   grounds for a conviction of perjury under the laws of the United States or the Commonwealth
   of Kentucky.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title X. Elections›Chapter 117A . Uniform Military and Overseas Voters Act›KY REV ST 117A.180. Application and construction
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title X. Elections › Chapter 117A . Uniform Military and Overseas Voters Act › KY REV ST 117A.180. Application and construction
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 117A.180. Application and construction (2023)
content:
In applying and construing this uniform act, consideration shall be given to the need
   to promote uniformity of the law with respect to its subject matter among states that
   enact it.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title X. Elections›Chapter 118A. Election of Judges›KY REV ST 118A.040. Circuit Judges
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title X. Elections › Chapter 118A. Election of Judges › KY REV ST 118A.040. Circuit Judges
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 118A.040. Circuit Judges (2023)
content:
(1)  Circuit Judges shall be elected from the judicial circuits established in KRS
      Chapter 23A.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title X. Elections›Chapter 118. Conduct of Elections›KY REV ST 118.015. Definitions for chapter
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title X. Elections › Chapter 118. Conduct of Elections › KY REV ST 118.015. Definitions for chapter
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 118.015. Definitions for chapter (2023)
content: As used in this chapter, unless the context otherwise requires:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title X. Elections›Chapter 117A . Uniform Military and Overseas Voters Act›KY REV ST 117A.160. Mistakes and omissions that do not invalidate documents or ballots; notarization or authentication not required
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title X. Elections › Chapter 117A . Uniform Military and Overseas Voters Act › KY REV ST 117A.160. Mistakes and omissions that do not invalidate documents or ballots; notarization or authentication not required
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 117A.160. Mistakes and omissions that do not invalidate documents or ballots; notarization or authentication not required (2023)
content:
(1)  If a voter's mistake or omission in the completion of a document under this chapter
      does not prevent determining whether a covered voter is eligible to vote, the mistake
      or omission does not invalidate the document.  Failure to satisfy a nonsubstantive requirement, such as using paper or envelopes
      of a specified size or weight, does not invalidate a document submitted under this
      chapter.  In a write-in ballot authorized by this chapter or in a vote for a write-in candidate
      on a regular ballot, if the intention of the voter is discernible under the Commonwealth
      of Kentucky's uniform definition of what constitutes a vote, an abbreviation, misspelling,
      or other minor variation in the form of the name of a candidate or a political party
      shall be accepted as a valid vote.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title X. Elections›Chapter 117A . Uniform Military and Overseas Voters Act›KY REV ST 117A.190. Chapter may modify or supersede federal act
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title X. Elections › Chapter 117A . Uniform Military and Overseas Voters Act › KY REV ST 117A.190. Chapter may modify or supersede federal act
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 117A.190. Chapter may modify or supersede federal act (2023)
content:
To the extent permitted by Section 102 of the Electronic Signatures in Global and
   National Commerce Act,Pub. L. No. 106-229,15 U.S.C. sec. 7002, this chapter may modify or supersede provisions of that act.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title X. Elections›Chapter 118. Conduct of Elections›KY REV ST 118.025. Voting to be by secret paper ballot; general laws applicable; time for holding elections
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title X. Elections › Chapter 118. Conduct of Elections › KY REV ST 118.025. Voting to be by secret paper ballot; general laws applicable; time for holding elections
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 118.025. Voting to be by secret paper ballot; general laws applicable; time for holding elections (2023)
content:
(1)  Except as otherwise provided by law, voting in all primaries and elections shall
      be by secret paper ballot.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title X. Elections›Chapter 118. Conduct of Elections›KY REV ST 118.035. Hours polls to be open; employees to be allowed time off to vote, to apply for or execute absentee ballot, and to serve or train to be election officer
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title X. Elections › Chapter 118. Conduct of Elections › KY REV ST 118.035. Hours polls to be open; employees to be allowed time off to vote, to apply for or execute absentee ballot, and to serve or train to be election officer
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 118.035. Hours polls to be open; employees to be allowed time off to vote, to apply for or execute absentee ballot, and to serve or train to be election officer (2023)
content:
(1)  The polls shall be opened on the day of a primary, special election, or regular
      election at 6 a.m., prevailing time, and shall remain open until each voter who is
      waiting in line at the polls at 6 p.m., prevailing time, has voted.  At 6 p.m., prevailing time, if voters are waiting at the polls to vote, the precinct
      election sheriff shall announce that a voter wishing to vote must immediately get
      in line.  When all voters waiting at the polls at that time are in line, the precinct election
      sheriff shall then determine which voter is the last in line, and that voter shall
      be the last voter permitted to vote.  The precinct election sheriff shall wait in line with the last voter who shall be
      permitted to vote until that voter has voted and shall inform a voter who subsequently
      arrives at the polls that no one shall be permitted to vote after the last voter in
      line at 6 p.m., prevailing time.  After the last voter waiting in line at 6 p.m., prevailing time, has voted, the
      polls shall then be closed.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title X. Elections›Chapter 118A. Election of Judges›KY REV ST 118A.090. Determination of order of names on ballot for regular election; Secretary of State's duties; ballot labels; ballot position unalterable; district, circuit, or numbered division candidate with most votes elected
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title X. Elections › Chapter 118A. Election of Judges › KY REV ST 118A.090. Determination of order of names on ballot for regular election; Secretary of State's duties; ballot labels; ballot position unalterable; district, circuit, or numbered division candidate with most votes elected
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 118A.090. Determination of order of names on ballot for regular election; Secretary of State's duties; ballot labels; ballot position unalterable; district, circuit, or numbered division candidate with most votes elected (2023)
content:
(1)  For the regular election, the order of names on the ballot for each district
      or circuit, and numbered division if divisions exist, shall be determined by lot at
      a public drawing to be held in the office of the Secretary of State at 2 p.m., standard
      time, on the Thursday following the first Tuesday after the first Monday in June preceding
      the regular election, except as provided inKRS 118A.100(6).

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title X. Elections›Chapter 118. Conduct of Elections›KY REV ST 118.027. Suspension or revision of election statutes
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title X. Elections › Chapter 118. Conduct of Elections › KY REV ST 118.027. Suspension or revision of election statutes
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 118.027. Suspension or revision of election statutes (2023)
content:
Except as required byKRS 39A.100related to the emergency powers granted to the Governor and Secretary of State as
   to the time and place for holding elections, no government official other than the
   General Assembly may suspend or revise any statute pertaining to elections.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title X. Elections›Chapter 118. Conduct of Elections›KY REV ST 118.045. Display of American flag at voting location
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title X. Elections › Chapter 118. Conduct of Elections › KY REV ST 118.045. Display of American flag at voting location
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 118.045. Display of American flag at voting location (2023)
content:
(1)  Every voting location on the day upon which any election is held shall, during
      voting hours, display an American flag of dimensions of reasonable size, which shall
      be firmly attached to the main entrance of the voting location so that it will be
      readily visible to the general public.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title X. Elections›Chapter 118A. Election of Judges›KY REV ST 118A.030. Judges of the Court of Appeals
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title X. Elections › Chapter 118A. Election of Judges › KY REV ST 118A.030. Judges of the Court of Appeals
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 118A.030. Judges of the Court of Appeals (2023)
content:
(1)  Judges of the Court of Appeals shall be elected from the same districts as are
      justices of the Supreme Court.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title X. Elections›Chapter 118A. Election of Judges›KY REV ST 118A.045. Election of family court judges
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title X. Elections › Chapter 118A. Election of Judges › KY REV ST 118A.045. Election of family court judges
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 118A.045. Election of family court judges (2023)
content:
(1)  Family court judges shall be elected from the judicial circuits established in
      KRS Chapter 23A and to a family court division so designated by the Supreme Court
      pursuant toSection 112(6) of the Constitution of Kentucky.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title X. Elections›Chapter 118A. Election of Judges›KY REV ST 118A.050. District Judges
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title X. Elections › Chapter 118A. Election of Judges › KY REV ST 118A.050. District Judges
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 118A.050. District Judges (2023)
content: (1)  District Judges shall be elected from judicial districts.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title X. Elections›Chapter 118A. Election of Judges›KY REV ST 118A.010. Definitions; applicability of provisions of KRS Chapter § 118
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title X. Elections › Chapter 118A. Election of Judges › KY REV ST 118A.010. Definitions; applicability of provisions of KRS Chapter § 118
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 118A.010. Definitions; applicability of provisions of KRS Chapter § 118 (2023)
content: As used in this chapter, unless the context otherwise requires:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title X. Elections›Chapter 118A. Election of Judges›KY REV ST 118A.020. Justices of the Supreme Court
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title X. Elections › Chapter 118A. Election of Judges › KY REV ST 118A.020. Justices of the Supreme Court
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 118A.020. Justices of the Supreme Court (2023)
content:
Justices of the Supreme Court shall be elected from the Supreme Court districts established
   by KRS Chapter 21A.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title X. Elections›Chapter 118A. Election of Judges›KY REV ST 118A.080. Denial of right to have name placed on ballot; restoration; ineligibility of Senior Status Special Judge
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title X. Elections › Chapter 118A. Election of Judges › KY REV ST 118A.080. Denial of right to have name placed on ballot; restoration; ineligibility of Senior Status Special Judge
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 118A.080. Denial of right to have name placed on ballot; restoration; ineligibility of Senior Status Special Judge (2023)
content:
(1)  No person who was a candidate for nomination for any office of the Court of Justice
      in a primary and who, before the succeeding regular election, is declared by the final
      judgment of any court of competent jurisdiction to have violated, in the primary,
      any provision of KRS Chapter 121, or to be responsible for such violation by others,
      shall have his or her name placed on the ballot for any office to be voted for in
      the succeeding regular election.  However, if such judgment is subsequently reversed prior to the time of printing
      of the ballots, the candidate's name shall be restored on the ballot.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title X. Elections›Chapter 118A. Election of Judges›KY REV ST 118A.060. Petition for nomination; examination of petition; form and order of names on ballot; Secretary of State's duties; ballot position unalterable; certification of nomination
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title X. Elections › Chapter 118A. Election of Judges › KY REV ST 118A.060. Petition for nomination; examination of petition; form and order of names on ballot; Secretary of State's duties; ballot position unalterable; certification of nomination
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 118A.060. Petition for nomination; examination of petition; form and order of names on ballot; Secretary of State's duties; ballot position unalterable; certification of nomination (2023)
content:
(1)  Except as provided inKRS 118A.100, no person's name shall appear on a ballot, including an absentee ballot, for an
      office of the Court of Justice without first having been nominated as provided in
      this section.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title X. Elections›Chapter 118A. Election of Judges›KY REV ST 118A.100. Filling vacancy for unexpired term; filling nomination when nominees unavailable; ineligibility of Senior Status Special Judge
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title X. Elections › Chapter 118A. Election of Judges › KY REV ST 118A.100. Filling vacancy for unexpired term; filling nomination when nominees unavailable; ineligibility of Senior Status Special Judge
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 118A.100. Filling vacancy for unexpired term; filling nomination when nominees unavailable; ineligibility of Senior Status Special Judge (2023)
content:
(1)  Candidates for an unexpired term of a judicial office to be filled at a regular
      election shall be nominated at the primary next preceding the regular election in
      the manner prescribed inKRS 118A.060if the vacancy occurs not later than the second Friday in December preceding the
      primary.  If the vacancy occurs on or after that date, the election to fill the unexpired
      term shall be held in accordance with the procedures described in this section andSection 152 of the Constitution of Kentucky.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title X. Elections›Chapter 118A. Election of Judges›KY REV ST 118A.130. Candidate's name to appear but once
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title X. Elections › Chapter 118A. Election of Judges › KY REV ST 118A.130. Candidate's name to appear but once
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 118A.130. Candidate's name to appear but once (2023)
content: No judicial candidate's name shall appear on any ballot more than once.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title X. Elections›Chapter 118A. Election of Judges›KY REV ST 118A.160. Hours for filing; inspection
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title X. Elections › Chapter 118A. Election of Judges › KY REV ST 118A.160. Hours for filing; inspection
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 118A.160. Hours for filing; inspection (2023)
content:
All nomination or candidacy papers filed under this chapter shall during normal business
   hours be subject to inspection by any person.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title X. Elections›Chapter 118A. Election of Judges›KY REV ST 118A.150. Certification of candidates; ballots; effect of death or withdrawal of candidate; penalty
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title X. Elections › Chapter 118A. Election of Judges › KY REV ST 118A.150. Certification of candidates; ballots; effect of death or withdrawal of candidate; penalty
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 118A.150. Certification of candidates; ballots; effect of death or withdrawal of candidate; penalty (2023)
content:
(1)  In certification of candidates for judicial office, no reference shall be made
      to political affiliation.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title X. Elections›Chapter 118A. Election of Judges›KY REV ST 118A.140. Register of candidates; display of information on Web site
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title X. Elections › Chapter 118A. Election of Judges › KY REV ST 118A.140. Register of candidates; display of information on Web site
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 118A.140. Register of candidates; display of information on Web site (2023)
content:
(1)  The Secretary of State shall keep a book entitled “Register of Candidates for
      Nomination to Offices of the Court of Justice.”  The Secretary of State shall enter in that book the name and place of residence of
      each candidate for nomination to the office of justice or judge in the primary, the
      date of receipt of his or her nomination papers, and petitions for candidacy filed
      pursuant toKRS 118A.100.  The book shall be a public record.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title X. Elections›Chapter 118A. Election of Judges›KY REV ST 118A.190. Issuance of certificates by State Board of Elections; tie votes
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title X. Elections › Chapter 118A. Election of Judges › KY REV ST 118A.190. Issuance of certificates by State Board of Elections; tie votes
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 118A.190. Issuance of certificates by State Board of Elections; tie votes (2023)
content:
(1)  The State Board of Elections shall issue certificates of nomination or election
      for all primary and regular elections as provided in this section.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title X. Elections›Chapter 118B. Districts for United States House of Representatives›Congressional Districts›KY REV ST 118B.100. Division of Commonwealth into congressional districts
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title X. Elections › Chapter 118B. Districts for United States House of Representatives › Congressional Districts › KY REV ST 118B.100. Division of Commonwealth into congressional districts
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 118B.100. Division of Commonwealth into congressional districts (2023)
content:
The Commonwealth of Kentucky is divided into six (6) congressional districts as provided
   byKRS 118B.110to118B.160.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title X. Elections›Chapter 118B. Districts for United States House of Representatives›Generalities›KY REV ST 118B.010. 2022. redistricting; explanation of sources; official maps
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title X. Elections › Chapter 118B. Districts for United States House of Representatives › Generalities › KY REV ST 118B.010. 2022. redistricting; explanation of sources; official maps
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 118B.010. 2022. redistricting; explanation of sources; official maps (2023)
content: For the purpose of this chapter:

title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title X. Elections › Chapter 118B. Districts for United States House of Representatives › Congressional Districts › KY REV ST 118B.120. Second Congressional District
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 118B.120. Second Congressional District (2023)
content: The Second Congressional District shall consist of the following territory:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title X. Elections›Chapter 119. Election Offenses and Prosecutions›KY REV ST 119.076. Clerk's failure to place candidate's name on ballot
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title X. Elections › Chapter 119. Election Offenses and Prosecutions › KY REV ST 119.076. Clerk's failure to place candidate's name on ballot
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 119.076. Clerk's failure to place candidate's name on ballot (2023)
content:
Any county clerk who willfully and knowingly refuses or fails to have the name of
   any candidate printed upon the official ballot in the manner provided by law shall
   be guilty of a Class D felony.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title X. Elections›Chapter 118B. Districts for United States House of Representatives›Congressional Districts›KY REV ST 118B.110. First Congressional District
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title X. Elections › Chapter 118B. Districts for United States House of Representatives › Congressional Districts › KY REV ST 118B.110. First Congressional District
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 118B.110. First Congressional District (2023)
content: The First Congressional District shall consist of the following territory:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title X. Elections›Chapter 118B. Districts for United States House of Representatives›Congressional Districts›KY REV ST 118B.130. Third Congressional District
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title X. Elections › Chapter 118B. Districts for United States House of Representatives › Congressional Districts › KY REV ST 118B.130. Third Congressional District
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 118B.130. Third Congressional District (2023)
content: The Third Congressional District shall consist of the following territory:

title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title X. Elections › Chapter 118B. Districts for United States House of Representatives › Congressional Districts › KY REV ST 118B.150. Fifth Congressional District

content: The Fifth Congressional District shall consist of the following territory:
