   shall be indemnified from liability asserted by any person on the bonds or notes of
   the authority, or any personal liability or accountability by reason of:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 175B. Kentucky Public Transportation Infrastructure Authority›KY REV ST 175B.075. Moneys received under chapter are trust funds; permitted investment of project revenue bond proceeds
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 175B. Kentucky Public Transportation Infrastructure Authority › KY REV ST 175B.075. Moneys received under chapter are trust funds; permitted investment of project revenue bond proceeds
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 175B.075. Moneys received under chapter are trust funds; permitted investment of project revenue bond proceeds (2023)
content:
(1)  All moneys received under this chapter, whether as proceeds from the sale of
      project revenue bonds or revenues, shall be trust funds to be held and applied solely
      as provided in this chapter.  The trust indenture or any other document authorizing the issuance of project revenue
      bonds or the collection of any revenues shall provide that any officer, bank, or trust
      company with which the moneys are deposited shall act as trustee of the moneys and
      shall hold and apply them for the purposes outlined in this chapter, subject to the
      provisions of this chapter and the proceedings or trust indenture.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 176. Department of Highways›KY REV ST 176.053. Trees along rights-of-way; proceeds from sale of products
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 176. Department of Highways › KY REV ST 176.053. Trees along rights-of-way; proceeds from sale of products
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 176.053. Trees along rights-of-way; proceeds from sale of products (2023)
content:
(1)  The Department of Highways is authorized to plant or set trees on and along any
      and all rights-of-way of highways or state property adjacent thereto, and to cut and
      sell wood, lumber, or forest products therefrom.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 176. Department of Highways›KY REV ST 176.051. Department to eradicate noxious weeds and invasive plants on rights-of-way; advertisement of program; administrative regulations
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 176. Department of Highways › KY REV ST 176.051. Department to eradicate noxious weeds and invasive plants on rights-of-way; advertisement of program; administrative regulations
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 176.051. Department to eradicate noxious weeds and invasive plants on rights-of-way; advertisement of program; administrative regulations (2023)
content:
(1)  The Department of Highways shall keep all state rights-of-way free of all of
      the following, which are noxious weeds and invasive plants:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 176. Department of Highways›KY REV ST 176.060. Roads under construction; regulation of traffic; temporary roads
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 176. Department of Highways › KY REV ST 176.060. Roads under construction; regulation of traffic; temporary roads
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 176.060. Roads under construction; regulation of traffic; temporary roads (2023)
content:
The department may stop or regulate all traffic over any road being constructed or
   improved until it is ready to be opened to the public, and may designate other roads
   for the accommodation of traffic until the construction is completed.  The department may establish temporary roads while such construction is going on,
   and may make arrangements with landowners for necessary temporary rights-of-way, and
   may contract and pay for such rights-of-way out of appropriations from the state road
   fund by certifying the costs to the Finance and Administration Cabinet.  The temporary road shall be opened for travel at least two (2) weeks before work
   is begun on the road proposed to be constructed or improved.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 175B. Kentucky Public Transportation Infrastructure Authority›KY REV ST 175B.080. Operation and maintenance of projects constitute performance of essential governmental functions; tax-free status of projects and project revenue bonds
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 175B. Kentucky Public Transportation Infrastructure Authority › KY REV ST 175B.080. Operation and maintenance of projects constitute performance of essential governmental functions; tax-free status of projects and project revenue bonds
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 175B.080. Operation and maintenance of projects constitute performance of essential governmental functions; tax-free status of projects and project revenue bonds (2023)
content:
The exercise of the powers granted by this chapter shall be in all respects for the
   benefit of the people of the Commonwealth, for the increase of their commerce and
   prosperity, and for the improvement of their health and living conditions.  Because the operation and maintenance of projects by any authority created pursuant
   to this chapter will constitute the performance of essential governmental functions:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 176. Department of Highways›KY REV ST 176.070. Advertisement for bids
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 176. Department of Highways › KY REV ST 176.070. Advertisement for bids
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 176.070. Advertisement for bids (2023)
content:
(1)  After surveys, plans, specifications and estimates have been completed for any
      road or section thereof, and the type and character of the road has been determined,
      and the right-of-way obtained, the bureau shall advertise by publication pursuant
      to KRS Chapter 424, for bids on the work, and may contract for the purchase of all
      materials necessary for the construction and maintenance of roads.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 176. Department of Highways›KY REV ST 176.057. Certain railroad property to be considered roads; use of funds for maintenance and repair
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 176. Department of Highways › KY REV ST 176.057. Certain railroad property to be considered roads; use of funds for maintenance and repair
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 176.057. Certain railroad property to be considered roads; use of funds for maintenance and repair (2023)
content:
For the purposes of this chapter and KRS Chapter 178 on and after July 1, 2010, railroad
   crossings, railroad spurs that access industrial parks, and shortline railroads at
   or near intersections with roadways shall be considered roads.  The industrial access road fund within the Transportation Cabinet and other funds
   specified by the secretary or requested by the secretary of the Cabinet for Economic
   Development may be used for their maintenance and repair.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 175B. Kentucky Public Transportation Infrastructure Authority›KY REV ST 175B.095. Evaluation of project condition prior to bond retirement; evaluation of tolls upon transfer of ownership; transfer of funds; actions required prior to and upon bond retirement or termination of partnership
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 175B. Kentucky Public Transportation Infrastructure Authority › KY REV ST 175B.095. Evaluation of project condition prior to bond retirement; evaluation of tolls upon transfer of ownership; transfer of funds; actions required prior to and upon bond retirement or termination of partnership
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 175B.095. Evaluation of project condition prior to bond retirement; evaluation of tolls upon transfer of ownership; transfer of funds; actions required prior to and upon bond retirement or termination of partnership (2023)
content:
(1)  Not more than one (1) year prior to the scheduled retirement of all bonds issued
      to finance a project, the department shall undertake an evaluation of the condition
      of the project to determine if the project has significant maintenance, reconstruction,
      or rebuilding needs.  The evaluation shall be completed no less than one hundred eighty (180) days prior
      to the scheduled retirement of the bonds.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 175B. Kentucky Public Transportation Infrastructure Authority›KY REV ST 175B.105. Conflict of interest for officers or employees of an authority
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 175B. Kentucky Public Transportation Infrastructure Authority › KY REV ST 175B.105. Conflict of interest for officers or employees of an authority
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 175B.105. Conflict of interest for officers or employees of an authority (2023)
content:
Officers or employees of an authority shall not have any direct interest in the sale
   or purchase of any project revenue bonds authorized by that authority.  Violation of this section shall be punishable by fine of not more than one thousand
   dollars ($1,000) or by imprisonment for not more than one (1) year, or both.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 175B. Kentucky Public Transportation Infrastructure Authority›KY REV ST 175B.090. Maintenance and repair of projects; restoration of or compensation for damaged private property; permitted leases
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 175B. Kentucky Public Transportation Infrastructure Authority › KY REV ST 175B.090. Maintenance and repair of projects; restoration of or compensation for damaged private property; permitted leases
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 175B.090. Maintenance and repair of projects; restoration of or compensation for damaged private property; permitted leases (2023)
content:
(1)  Each project constructed or operated under this chapter shall be maintained and
      kept in good condition and repair by the developing authority, which may contract
      with the department or with any local highway department for maintenance of a project.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 176. Department of Highways›KY REV ST 176.010. Definitions for chapter
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 176. Department of Highways › KY REV ST 176.010. Definitions for chapter
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 176.010. Definitions for chapter (2023)
content: As used in this chapter, unless the context requires otherwise:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 176. Department of Highways›KY REV ST 176.082. Reciprocal preference to be given to resident bidders on construction projects
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 176. Department of Highways › KY REV ST 176.082. Reciprocal preference to be given to resident bidders on construction projects
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 176.082. Reciprocal preference to be given to resident bidders on construction projects (2023)
content:
(1)  Prior to a contract being awarded for the construction phase of a project, a
      resident bidder of the Commonwealth shall be given a preference against a nonresident
      bidder registered in any state that gives or requires a preference to bidders from
      that state.  The preference shall be equal to the preference given or required by the state of
      the nonresident bidder and shall be applied after the opening of the bids.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 175B. Kentucky Public Transportation Infrastructure Authority›KY REV ST 175B.085. Project revenue bonds are authorized investment securities
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 175B. Kentucky Public Transportation Infrastructure Authority › KY REV ST 175B.085. Project revenue bonds are authorized investment securities
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 175B.085. Project revenue bonds are authorized investment securities (2023)
content:
Project revenue bonds issued by an authority under this chapter shall be securities
   in which all public officers and public bodies of the Commonwealth and its political
   subdivisions, all insurance companies, trust companies, banking associations, investment
   companies, executors, trustees and other fiduciaries, and all other persons who are
   authorized to invest in bonds or other similar obligations, including capital in their
   control or belonging to them, are authorized to invest.  The project revenue bonds shall be securities which may properly and legally be
   deposited with and received by any state or municipal officer or any agency or political
   subdivision of the Commonwealth for any purpose for which the deposit of bonds or
   other obligations of the Commonwealth is now or may hereafter be authorized by law.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 176. Department of Highways›KY REV ST 176.054. Obtaining trees to carry out KRS § 176.053
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 176. Department of Highways › KY REV ST 176.054. Obtaining trees to carry out KRS § 176.053
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 176.054. Obtaining trees to carry out KRS § 176.053 (2023)
content:
The Energy and Environment Cabinet shall furnish to the Department of Highways such
   seedlings or young trees as the department may require, or as may be available.  The Department of Highways shall pay to the Energy and Environment Cabinet the reasonable
   value thereof as may be agreed upon between such departments.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 175B. Kentucky Public Transportation Infrastructure Authority›KY REV ST 175B.115. Project planning or work done prior to establishment of an authority
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 175B. Kentucky Public Transportation Infrastructure Authority › KY REV ST 175B.115. Project planning or work done prior to establishment of an authority
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 175B.115. Project planning or work done prior to establishment of an authority (2023)
content:
For a project for which preliminary planning or other work has been undertaken prior
   to the establishment of an authority, the authority shall follow all previous agreements,
   records of decision, or contracts entered into by the Commonwealth, subject to any
   modification necessary as a result of the implementation of this chapter.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 176. Department of Highways›KY REV ST 176.020. Appointment of state highway engineer; divisions within the department
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 176. Department of Highways › KY REV ST 176.020. Appointment of state highway engineer; divisions within the department
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 176.020. Appointment of state highway engineer; divisions within the department (2023)
content:
(1)  With prior approval of the Governor and the secretary in writing, the commissioner
      of highways shall appoint as state highway engineer, a civil engineer who has had
      at least six (6) years executive engineering experience in the design, supervision,
      and construction of highways.  He shall be the technical advisor to the commissioner of highways, and under the
      direction of the commissioner, he shall supervise all construction and maintenance
      work of the department and perform such other duties as are assigned to him by the
      commissioner.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 176. Department of Highways›KY REV ST 176.095. Contractor's deposit of securities with department
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 176. Department of Highways › KY REV ST 176.095. Contractor's deposit of securities with department
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 176.095. Contractor's deposit of securities with department (2023)
content:
(1)  Where any percent of a contract price or a certain fixed sum shall have been
      retained pursuant to the provisions of subsection (1) ofKRS 176.090, the contractor may from time to time withdraw the whole or any portion of the amount
      retained for payments to the contractor pursuant to the terms of the contract and
      substitute therefor securities of the following classes which are upon deposit with
      a custodian designated by the commissioner of the department and approved by the secretary
      of the Finance and Administration Cabinet:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 176. Department of Highways›KY REV ST 176.050. Duties of department
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 176. Department of Highways › KY REV ST 176.050. Duties of department
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 176.050. Duties of department (2023)
content: (1)  The department shall:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 176. Department of Highways›KY REV ST 176.090. Provisions of contract; partial and complete payment; bonds, bids, etc., to be filed
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 176. Department of Highways › KY REV ST 176.090. Provisions of contract; partial and complete payment; bonds, bids, etc., to be filed
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 176.090. Provisions of contract; partial and complete payment; bonds, bids, etc., to be filed (2023)
content:
(1)  The contract shall state the time when the work shall be begun and completed,
      and the time and manner of payment.  The department may require that a certain percent of the contract price, or a certain
      fixed sum shall not be paid to the contractor until a fixed time after completion
      and acceptance of the work.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 176. Department of Highways›KY REV ST 176.055. Dissemination of information concerning roads and highways
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 176. Department of Highways › KY REV ST 176.055. Dissemination of information concerning roads and highways
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 176.055. Dissemination of information concerning roads and highways (2023)
content:
(1)  The Department of Highways may purchase space in magazines, newspapers, and other
      publications and may cause to be made and circulated all maps, prints, plans, lithographs,
      engravings, photographs, drawings, art work, and other specialized work deemed necessary
      in the dissemination of information concerning its roads and highways.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 176. Department of Highways›KY REV ST 176.080. Bond or check to accompany bid; opening of bids; awarding of contracts; security; bids may be rejected; advertisement for new bids
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 176. Department of Highways › KY REV ST 176.080. Bond or check to accompany bid; opening of bids; awarding of contracts; security; bids may be rejected; advertisement for new bids
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 176.080. Bond or check to accompany bid; opening of bids; awarding of contracts; security; bids may be rejected; advertisement for new bids (2023)
content:
(1)  Each bidder shall accompany his bid with a bond or certified check payable to
      the State Treasurer for a reasonable sum, fixed by the department, guaranteeing that
      he will enter into a contract with the department for doing the work if the work is
      awarded to him.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 176. Department of Highways›KY REV ST 176.121. Construction work by department employees
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 176. Department of Highways › KY REV ST 176.121. Construction work by department employees
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 176.121. Construction work by department employees (2023)
content:
The Department of Highways may cause any road construction or reconstruction to be
   done by employees of the department instead of through contractors when, in the opinion
   of the commissioner as expressed in an official order, any of the following conditions
   is found to exist:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 176. Department of Highways›KY REV ST 176.126. Use of department goods and materials restricted to rights-of-way
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 176. Department of Highways › KY REV ST 176.126. Use of department goods and materials restricted to rights-of-way
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 176.126. Use of department goods and materials restricted to rights-of-way (2023)
content:
No goods or materials belonging to or under control of the department shall be used
   in work of any nature beyond the right-of-way limits of any public road, nor shall
   any person accept or permit the use of such goods or materials on private property.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 176. Department of Highways›KY REV ST 176.085. Compliance with workers' compensation insurance and unemployment insurance laws required; foreign entity to obtain certificate of authority; penalty
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 176. Department of Highways › KY REV ST 176.085. Compliance with workers' compensation insurance and unemployment insurance laws required; foreign entity to obtain certificate of authority; penalty
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 176.085. Compliance with workers' compensation insurance and unemployment insurance laws required; foreign entity to obtain certificate of authority; penalty (2023)
content:
(1)  (a) No contract for building, construction, reconstruction, renovation, demolition,
         or other type work on any state road, waterway, or aviation-related work, shall be
         awarded by any agency, department, or office of the Commonwealth of Kentucky or any
         political subdivision of the Commonwealth of Kentucky to any person until that person
         assures, by affidavit, that all contractors and subcontractors employed, or that will
         be employed, under the provisions of the contract shall be in compliance with Kentucky
         requirements for workers' compensation insurance according to KRS Chapter 342 and
         unemployment insurance according to KRS Chapter 341.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 176. Department of Highways›KY REV ST 176.100. Deviation from contract
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 176. Department of Highways › KY REV ST 176.100. Deviation from contract
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 176.100. Deviation from contract (2023)
content:
No contractor shall deviate from the provisions, plans or specifications upon which
   a contract has been awarded without first having obtained written authority from the
   department to do so.  If the contractor does deviate without such authority, neither the State of Kentucky,
   the Department of Highways, the Finance and Administration Cabinet nor the State Treasurer
   shall pay or be liable for any work or material not fully provided for in the original
   contract.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 176. Department of Highways›KY REV ST 176.110. Breach of contract; cancellation to keep expenditures within annual income
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 176. Department of Highways › KY REV ST 176.110. Breach of contract; cancellation to keep expenditures within annual income
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 176.110. Breach of contract; cancellation to keep expenditures within annual income (2023)
content:
(1)  If any person having a contract with the department fails to carry out the contract,
      the department may cancel the contract and reaward it without advertisement if it
      can obtain a qualified contractor to perform the work at the original contract price
      or for less.  Otherwise the work shall be advertised as required by law.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 176. Department of Highways›KY REV ST 176.128. Effect of KRS 176.122. to § 176.128
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 176. Department of Highways › KY REV ST 176.128. Effect of KRS 176.122. to § 176.128
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 176.128. Effect of KRS 176.122. to § 176.128 (2023)
content:
Nothing inKRS 176.122to176.128shall be so construed as to prevent the lawful execution of other granted powers
   necessary to accomplish the purposes of the Department of Highways.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 176. Department of Highways›KY REV ST 176.124. Work of department personnel restricted to rights-of-way
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 176. Department of Highways › KY REV ST 176.124. Work of department personnel restricted to rights-of-way
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 176.124. Work of department personnel restricted to rights-of-way (2023)
content:
No officer, agent or employee of the Commonwealth of Kentucky, Department of Highways,
   shall perform or cause to be performed any work or provide or cause to be provided
   services of any nature beyond the right-of-way limits of any public road, nor shall
   any person accept the work or services of any officer, agent or employee of the department
   on private property.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 176. Department of Highways›KY REV ST 176.130. Certificates of eligibility for contractors; application; when necessary
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 176. Department of Highways › KY REV ST 176.130. Certificates of eligibility for contractors; application; when necessary
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 176.130. Certificates of eligibility for contractors; application; when necessary (2023)
content:
(1)  Every person who seeks to procure, bid upon, or offer to bid upon any contract
      with the department for the construction or maintenance of any public road or any
      section thereof, before procuring a proposal form or submitting any bid to obtain
      such contract, shall procure a certificate of eligibility from the department to bid
      on such work.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 176. Department of Highways›KY REV ST 176.160. Issuance or denial of certificate; effect
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 176. Department of Highways › KY REV ST 176.160. Issuance or denial of certificate; effect
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 176.160. Issuance or denial of certificate; effect (2023)
content:
(1)  After obtaining such information as it deems necessary relative to the qualification
      of the applicant, the department shall determine whether or not the applicant is eligible
      to bid upon road contracts.  The department shall promptly notify all applicants of its final action on their
      applications.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 176. Department of Highways›KY REV ST 176.150. Information required with application for certificate of eligibility
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 176. Department of Highways › KY REV ST 176.150. Information required with application for certificate of eligibility
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 176.150. Information required with application for certificate of eligibility (2023)
content:
(1)  No applicant shall be given a certificate of eligibility unless his financial
      statement and the investigation made by the department show that he possesses net
      current assets or working capital sufficient in the judgment of the department to
      render it probable that he can satisfactorily execute his contracts and meet obligations
      therein incurred.  All applications for certificates shall expressly authorize the department to obtain
      all information which it deems pertinent with respect to the financial status, assets,
      and liabilities of the applicant from any persons having business transactions with
      the applicant, and shall expressly authorize all those persons to furnish any information
      requested from them by the department.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 176. Department of Highways›KY REV ST 176.170. Administrative hearing; appeal
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 176. Department of Highways › KY REV ST 176.170. Administrative hearing; appeal
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 176.170. Administrative hearing; appeal (2023)
content:
(1)  Any applicant aggrieved by the decision of the department made pursuant toKRS 176.160may, within ten (10) days after receiving notification of the decision, request in
      writing an administrative hearing which shall be conducted in accordance with KRS
      Chapter 13B.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 176. Department of Highways›KY REV ST 176.122. Definitions for KRS 176.122. to § 176.128
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 176. Department of Highways › KY REV ST 176.122. Definitions for KRS 176.122. to § 176.128
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 176.122. Definitions for KRS 176.122. to § 176.128 (2023)
content: As used inKRS 176.122to176.128, unless the context requires otherwise:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 176. Department of Highways›KY REV ST 176.190. Revocation of certificate; notice; hearing
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 176. Department of Highways › KY REV ST 176.190. Revocation of certificate; notice; hearing
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 176.190. Revocation of certificate; notice; hearing (2023)
content:
A certificate of eligibility may be revoked by the department only after a written
   notice is given to the qualified bidder and an opportunity given to him for an administrative
   hearing conducted in accordance with KRS Chapter 13B.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 176. Department of Highways›KY REV ST 176.180. Limitation on certificate; rehearing
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 176. Department of Highways › KY REV ST 176.180. Limitation on certificate; rehearing
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 176.180. Limitation on certificate; rehearing (2023)
content:
(1)  In issuing a certificate of eligibility to any applicant, the department may
      limit the scope of the certificate as to the number or type of projects, or the amount
      of work that the contractor may bid upon.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 176. Department of Highways›KY REV ST 176.140. Determination of eligibility to bid
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 176. Department of Highways › KY REV ST 176.140. Determination of eligibility to bid
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 176.140. Determination of eligibility to bid (2023)
content:
(1)  The department shall determine who shall be eligible to bid upon any contract
      with the department for the construction or maintenance of any public road or section
      thereof.  The department may adopt rules and regulations and make investigations and examinations
      to determine the financial status, experience, responsibility, business ability, previous
      record, sufficiency of plant and equipment, and any other pertinent facts necessary
      to determine the eligibility of the proposed bidder.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 176. Department of Highways›KY REV ST 176.210. Lists of qualified bidders may be made public
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 176. Department of Highways › KY REV ST 176.210. Lists of qualified bidders may be made public
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 176.210. Lists of qualified bidders may be made public (2023)
content:
The department may make public from time to time lists of qualified bidders.  Such lists shall be general in character and shall not indicate the size of the
   contracts with respect to which the bidders have qualified.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 176. Department of Highways›KY REV ST 176.200. Subcontractor to be named
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 176. Department of Highways › KY REV ST 176.200. Subcontractor to be named
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 176.200. Subcontractor to be named (2023)
content:
Before making an award the department may require the bidder to name the subcontractor
   whom he intends to employ for the various divisions of the work bid upon.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 176. Department of Highways›KY REV ST 176.220. Bids from unqualified bidders
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 176. Department of Highways › KY REV ST 176.220. Bids from unqualified bidders
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 176.220. Bids from unqualified bidders (2023)
content:
The department shall not consider any bid filed with it by any person not holding
   a certificate of eligibility.  Bids from unqualified bidders which are discovered by the department before they
   are read, shall be returned to the bidders without being read.  If the department finds subsequent to the opening of bids that facts exist which
   would disqualify the lowest bidder, or that such bidder is not responsible and competent,
   the department shall reject such bid, despite the previous qualification of the bidder.  The department shall not award any contract to any bidder not qualified to bid thereon
   at the time the bids are opened.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 176. Department of Highways›KY REV ST 176.270. Finance and Administration Cabinet to furnish income estimates
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 176. Department of Highways › KY REV ST 176.270. Finance and Administration Cabinet to furnish income estimates
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 176.270. Finance and Administration Cabinet to furnish income estimates (2023)
content:
On or before June 1 of each year, the Finance and Administration Cabinet shall furnish
   to the Department of Highways estimates of income for the ensuing fiscal year.  Upon the request of the Department of Highways the Finance and Administration Cabinet
   shall, from time to time, furnish revised estimates of income.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 176. Department of Highways›KY REV ST 176.250. Duties of department in regard to county roads
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 176. Department of Highways › KY REV ST 176.250. Duties of department in regard to county roads
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 176.250. Duties of department in regard to county roads (2023)
content: The department shall:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 176. Department of Highways›KY REV ST 176.240. Federal aid for road building; cooperation by department; allocation of funds
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 176. Department of Highways › KY REV ST 176.240. Federal aid for road building; cooperation by department; allocation of funds
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 176.240. Federal aid for road building; cooperation by department; allocation of funds (2023)
content:
(1)  The department may contract with the federal government in regard to the survey,
      construction and maintenance of roads under any Act of Congress providing federal
      aid to the states in road construction, and may, subject to the rules of the United
      States Secretary of Agriculture, make plans for and supervise the construction of
      federal aid roads, and may do all things necessary to fully carry out the cooperation
      contemplated.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 176. Department of Highways›KY REV ST 176.410. County or multicounty covered wooden bridge authority; membership of authority; duties and functions of authority
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 176. Department of Highways › KY REV ST 176.410. County or multicounty covered wooden bridge authority; membership of authority; duties and functions of authority
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 176.410. County or multicounty covered wooden bridge authority; membership of authority; duties and functions of authority (2023)
content:
(1)  Except as provided byKRS 176.400, at the request of citizens or organizations of a county or multicounty region, the
      Heritage Division of the Kentucky Heritage Council shall certify to the Governor the
      creation of a county or multicounty covered wooden bridge authority for that county
      or multicounty region.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 176. Department of Highways›KY REV ST 176.400. Covered wooden bridges; administrative control; title; maintenance
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 176. Department of Highways › KY REV ST 176.400. Covered wooden bridges; administrative control; title; maintenance
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 176.400. Covered wooden bridges; administrative control; title; maintenance (2023)
content:
(1)  Administrative control of covered wooden bridges designated as state shrines
      shall be shared by the Transportation Cabinet, the Department of Parks, the Kentucky
      Heritage Council, and the authorities created underKRS 176.410.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 176. Department of Highways›KY REV ST 176.430. Transportation Cabinet to study needs of highways and develop recommended six (6) year road plan that identifies individual transportation projects; proposed biennial highway construction plan; factors to be considered in development of each project; monthly transmission of project data to General Assembly; cabinet may expend funds necessary to complete authorized projects; digitized maps
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 176. Department of Highways › KY REV ST 176.430. citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 176.430. Transportation Cabinet to study needs of highways and develop recommended six (6) year road plan that identifies individual transportation projects; proposed biennial highway construction plan; factors to be considered in development of each project; monthly transmission of project data to General Assembly; cabinet may expend funds necessary to complete authorized projects; digitized maps (2023)
content:
(1)  The Transportation Cabinet shall undertake a continuing study of the needs of
      the highways under its jurisdiction for the purpose of bringing existing facilities
      to acceptable standards or for the replacement of existing facilities when required.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 176. Department of Highways›KY REV ST 176.280. Legal service; duty of county attorneys
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 176. Department of Highways › KY REV ST 176.280. Legal service; duty of county attorneys
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 176.280. Legal service; duty of county attorneys (2023)
content:
The county attorneys shall each render legal service to the department in carrying
   out its duties.  The services so rendered shall be without additional compensation, and no county
   attorney shall be required to render service outside his county.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 176. Department of Highways›KY REV ST 176.431. content:
(1)  (a) Notwithstanding any conflicting provisions of this chapter and KRS Chapters
         45A and 177, each fiscal year, the Transportation Cabinet is authorized to utilize

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 176. Department of Highways›KY REV ST 176.260. Fiscal year of department
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 176. Department of Highways › KY REV ST 176.260. Fiscal year of department
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 176.260. Fiscal year of department (2023)
content:
The fiscal year for the Department of Highways which commences on April 1, 1950, shall
   be extended up to and including June 30, 1951, and thereafter the fiscal year for
   the department shall begin July 1, and end June 30.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 176. Department of Highways›KY REV ST 176.432. Fiscal-year-to-date funding status reports on highway construction contingency account
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 176. Department of Highways › KY REV ST 176.432. Fiscal-year-to-date funding status reports on highway construction contingency account
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 176.432. Fiscal-year-to-date funding status reports on highway construction contingency account (2023)
content:
(1)  The department shall transmit, on a quarterly basis, electronic data to the General
      Assembly through the Legislative Research Commission giving a fiscal-year-to-date
      funding status report on the highway construction contingency account established
      underKRS 45.247.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 176. Department of Highways›KY REV ST 176.5065. Motorcycle safety education program fund
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 176. Department of Highways › KY REV ST 176.5065. Motorcycle safety education program fund
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 176.5065. Motorcycle safety education program fund (2023)
content:
(1)  The motorcycle safety education program fund is established as a restricted fund
      in the State Treasury.  Moneys in the fund are hereby appropriated for the purposes set forth inKRS 176.5061to176.5069.  Moneys in the fund shall be utilized to provide motorcycle training courses as established
      inKRS 176.5062and for implementation of the program, including reimbursement of entities that offer
      approved motorcycle rider education courses.  The Transportation Cabinet may deduct up to ten percent (10%) of available program
      funds per fiscal year for administrative costs from the motorcycle safety education
      program fund.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 176. Department of Highways›KY REV ST 176.415. Flags to be displayed at rest areas; human trafficking hotline telephone number to be prominently displayed in each rest area restroom
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 176. Department of Highways › KY REV ST 176.415. Flags to be displayed at rest areas; human trafficking hotline telephone number to be prominently displayed in each rest area restroom
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 176.415. Flags to be displayed at rest areas; human trafficking hotline telephone number to be prominently displayed in each rest area restroom (2023)
content:
(1)  The Department of Highways shall display the following flags at each rest area
      along the Commonwealth's interstate and turnpike system:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 176. Department of Highways›KY REV ST 176.500. Mississippi River Parkway Commission of Kentucky; members; duties; reimbursement for expenses
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 176. Department of Highways › KY REV ST 176.500. Mississippi River Parkway Commission of Kentucky; members; duties; reimbursement for expenses
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 176.500. Mississippi River Parkway Commission of Kentucky; members; duties; reimbursement for expenses (2023)
content:
(1)  The Mississippi River Parkway Commission of Kentucky is hereby established to
      serve as the local coordinating agency for the development of the Great River Road
      along the Mississippi River from Canada to the Gulf of Mexico.  The commission shall be attached to the Office of the Secretary of the Tourism,
      Arts and Heritage Cabinet for administrative purposes.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 176. Department of Highways›KY REV ST 176.433. State contingency funding code for six-year road plan
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 176. Department of Highways › KY REV ST 176.433. State contingency funding code for six-year road plan
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 176.433. State contingency funding code for six-year road plan (2023)
content:
The Transportation Cabinet shall create a new funding code to be used in the six (6)
   year road plan to be known as state contingency funds and the abbreviation the cabinet
   shall use for this funding code shall be SC.  The state contingency funding code shall be in addition to all other funding codes
   used by the cabinet in the six (6) year road plan and shall be used to identify all
   projects funded with moneys from the highway construction contingency account established
   underKRS 45.247.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 176. Department of Highways›KY REV ST 176.505. Motorcycle Advisory Commission for Highway Safety established
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 176. Department of Highways › KY REV ST 176.505. Motorcycle Advisory Commission for Highway Safety established
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 176.505. Motorcycle Advisory Commission for Highway Safety established (2023)
content:
(1)  The Motorcycle Advisory Commission for Highway Safety is established as an advisory
      body to assist the Transportation Cabinet in ensuring that highway design, construction,
      and maintenance policies and procedures consider the specific needs of motorcyclists.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 176. Department of Highways›KY REV ST 176.440. State highway engineer to provide cost estimate for any project that legislator desires in six year road plan
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 176. Department of Highways › KY REV ST 176.440. State highway engineer to provide cost estimate for any project that legislator desires in six year road plan
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 176.440. State highway engineer to provide cost estimate for any project that legislator desires in six year road plan (2023)
content:
The state highway engineer shall provide a cost estimate for any project that a member
   of the General Assembly desires to be considered for advancement or inclusion in the
   six (6) year road plan.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 176. Department of Highways›KY REV ST 176.5061. Motorcycle safety education program; standards; administrative regulations
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 176. Department of Highways › KY REV ST 176.5061. Motorcycle safety education program; standards; administrative regulations
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 176.5061. Motorcycle safety education program; standards; administrative regulations (2023)
content:
(1)  The Transportation Cabinet shall establish a motorcycle safety education program.  The program shall provide for instructor training courses, instructor approval,
      and rider training courses for novice riders that shall be held at locations accessible
      to Kentucky residents.  The program may provide for the following:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 176. Department of Highways›KY REV ST 176.5064. Powers of cabinet
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 176. Department of Highways › KY REV ST 176.5064. Powers of cabinet
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 176.5064. Powers of cabinet (2023)
content:
(1)  The cabinet may enter into contracts with public or private entities for course
      delivery and for the provision of services or materials necessary for implementation
      of the program.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 176. Department of Highways›KY REV ST 176.506. Membership of commission; officers; meetings
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 176. Department of Highways › KY REV ST 176.506. Membership of commission; officers; meetings
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 176.506. Membership of commission; officers; meetings (2023)
content:
(1)  The Motorcycle Advisory Commission for Highway Safety shall be composed of seven
      (7) members, appointed as follows:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 176. Department of Highways›KY REV ST 176.5062. Motorcycle rider training courses; exemption from test for motorcycle permit or operator’s license
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 176. Department of Highways › KY REV ST 176.5062. Motorcycle rider training courses; exemption from test for motorcycle permit or operator’s license
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 176.5062. Motorcycle rider training courses; exemption from test for motorcycle permit or operator’s license (2023)
content:
(1)  The motorcycle safety education program shall offer motorcycle rider training
      courses designed to develop and instill the knowledge, attitudes, habits, and skills
      necessary for the proper operation of a motorcycle.  The courses shall be taught by instructors approved underKRS 176.5063and shall include no fewer than eight (8) hours of hands-on instruction for a novice
      course.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 176. Department of Highways›KY REV ST 176.5066. Revenues relating to motorcycle safety education program fund; report
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 176. Department of Highways › KY REV ST 176.5066. Revenues relating to motorcycle safety education program fund; report
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 176.5066. Revenues relating to motorcycle safety education program fund; report (2023)
content:
The Transportation Cabinet shall report monthly to the Interim Joint Committee on
   Appropriations and Revenue on the revenues deposited into the motorcycle safety education
   program fund, the expenditures incurred, and the available balance in the fund.  In addition, the cabinet shall identify the safety programs provided, the cost of
   the programs, location, and number of attendees.  To facilitate the timely reporting of data under this section, the cabinet shall
   enter into agreements with entities that provide the training to require monthly billing
   and attendance records.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 176. Department of Highways›KY REV ST 176.5063. Instructors; requirements for approval; approval of nonresidents; review of status every two years
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 176. Department of Highways › KY REV ST 176.5063. Instructors; requirements for approval; approval of nonresidents; review of status every two years
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 176.5063. Instructors; requirements for approval; approval of nonresidents; review of status every two years (2023)
content:
(1)  The cabinet shall approve instructors for the motorcycle rider training courses.  A person shall not be approved as an instructor unless the person meets the requirements
      of this section and administrative regulations of the cabinet and holds a currently
      valid instructor certification issued by the governing body of a program approved
      underKRS 176.5062(6)(b).

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 176. Department of Highways›KY REV ST 176.5067. Motorcycle Safety Education Commission; membership; terms; meetings; Commission attached to Office of Highway Safety within the Department of Highways for administrative purposes
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 176. Department of Highways › KY REV ST 176.5067. Motorcycle Safety Education Commission; membership; terms; meetings; Commission attached to Office of Highway Safety within the Department of Highways for administrative purposes
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 176.5067. Motorcycle Safety Education Commission; membership; terms; meetings; Commission attached to Office of Highway Safety within the Department of Highways for administrative purposes (2023)
content:
(1)  The Motorcycle Safety Education Commission is established as an independent body
      to help foster the growth and development of the motorcycle safety education program
      established underKRS 15A.350.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 176. Department of Highways›KY REV ST 176.5069. Annual report; submitted to Governor and Legislative Research Commission and available for public review
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 176. Department of Highways › KY REV ST 176.5069. Annual report; submitted to Governor and Legislative Research Commission and available for public review
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 176.5069. Annual report; submitted to Governor and Legislative Research Commission and available for public review (2023)
content:
The cabinet shall prepare an annual report on the program to be submitted to the Governor
   and the Legislative Research Commission and made available to the public for review
   during the cabinet's normal business hours.  The report shall include:

citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 176.5068. Responsibilities of Motorcycle Safety Education Commission (2023)
content: The Motorcycle Safety Education Commission shall have the following responsibilities:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 176. Department of Highways›KY REV ST 176.990. Penalties
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 176. Department of Highways › KY REV ST 176.990. Penalties
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 176.990. Penalties (2023)
content:
(1)  Any person who violates the provisions ofKRS 176.122to176.128shall be guilty of a misdemeanor and shall upon conviction be fined not less than
      one hundred dollars ($100) nor more than five hundred dollars ($500).  Each day in which work is performed or materials furnished in violation of the provisions
      ofKRS 176.122to176.128shall constitute a separate offense.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 177. State and Federal Highways; Limited Access Facilities; Turnpikes; Road Bonds; Billboards; Recyclers›Definitions›KY REV ST 177.010. Definitions for KRS 177.010. to § 177.890

citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 177.010. Definitions for KRS 177.010. to § 177.890 (2023)
content: As used inKRS 177.010to177.890, unless the context otherwise requires:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 177. State and Federal Highways; Limited Access Facilities; Turnpikes; Road Bonds; Billboards; Recyclers›Highways›KY REV ST 177.021. Department may acquire rights-of-way for primary system; power of cities
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 177. State and Federal Highways; Limited Access Facilities; Turnpikes; Road Bonds; Billboards; Recyclers › Highways › KY REV ST 177.021. Department may acquire rights-of-way for primary system; power of cities
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 177.021. Department may acquire rights-of-way for primary system; power of cities (2023)
content:
The Department of Highways is authorized to acquire and bear the cost of new or additional
   rights-of-way needed for establishment, improvement, construction, reconstruction,
   maintenance or repair of a public road or a city street which has been designated
   by the Department of Highways as a part of the state primary road system.  All cities are authorized to deed any right-of-way owned by such cities to the Commonwealth
   of Kentucky if the right-of-way is to become part of the state primary road system.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 176. Department of Highways›KY REV ST 176.520. Location of construction waste sites
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 176. Department of Highways › KY REV ST 176.520. Location of construction waste sites
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 176.520. Location of construction waste sites (2023)
content:
Waste sites identified inKRS 176.050shall be on property owned by the state or a city, county, or other governmental
   agency and have the potential to be turned into industrial parks under the provisions
   ofKRS 176.050.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 176. Department of Highways›KY REV ST 176.525. Use of identified potential industrial park sites as construction waste sites; deeding of site to local government; consultation with local government officials in site identification
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 176. Department of Highways › KY REV ST 176.525. Use of identified potential industrial park sites as construction waste sites; deeding of site to local government; consultation with local government officials in site identification
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 176.525. Use of identified potential industrial park sites as construction waste sites; deeding of site to local government; consultation with local government officials in site identification (2023)
content:
(1)  During the construction phase of a new road construction project, potential industrial
      park sites identified during the design phase shall be used as waste sites by the
      department or the contractor who was awarded the project.  Waste shall include, but not be limited, to nonhazardous nonsoluble construction
      material, steel, concrete, brick, asphalt, rock, dirt, or other fill material, but
      shall not include vegetation resulting from land clearing and grubbing, utility line
      maintenance, seasonal and storm-related cleanup, or any hazardous material or hazardous
      waste as defined inKRS 174.405.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 176. Department of Highways›KY REV ST 176.991. Penalties
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 176. Department of Highways › KY REV ST 176.991. Penalties
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 176.991. Penalties (2023)
content:
(1)  Any person who willfully burns, defaces or destroys a covered bridge designated
      as a state shrine by the Kentucky Heritage Commission or by the heritage division
      shall be fined not more than five hundred dollars ($500) or confined in the county
      jail for not less than thirty (30) days or more than six (6) months or both.  This shall be in addition to other penalties.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 177. State and Federal Highways; Limited Access Facilities; Turnpikes; Road Bonds; Billboards; Recyclers›Highways›KY REV ST 177.025. Removal of snow from certain state roads by county plows on order of county judge/executive
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 177. State and Federal Highways; Limited Access Facilities; Turnpikes; Road Bonds; Billboards; Recyclers › Highways › KY REV ST 177.025. Removal of snow from certain state roads by county plows on order of county judge/executive
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 177.025. Removal of snow from certain state roads by county plows on order of county judge/executive (2023)
content:
The provisions ofKRS 67.078and67.710notwithstanding, a county judge/executive may order county plows to remove snow from
   any state road the plow must travel on to reach a county road to be cleared.  The county judge/executive shall not be required to declare an emergency for him
   to order county plows to remove snow from state roads.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 177. State and Federal Highways; Limited Access Facilities; Turnpikes; Road Bonds; Billboards; Recyclers›Highways›KY REV ST 177.020. State primary roads to be designated and controlled by the Department of Highways; notice to fiscal court and affected citizens; rural secondary road system; maintenance; administrative regulations
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 177. State and Federal Highways; Limited Access Facilities; Turnpikes; Road Bonds; Billboards; Recyclers › Highways › KY REV ST 177.020. State primary roads to be designated and controlled by the Department of Highways; notice to fiscal court and affected citizens; rural secondary road system; maintenance; administrative regulations
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 177.020. State primary roads to be designated and controlled by the Department of Highways; notice to fiscal court and affected citizens; rural secondary road system; maintenance; administrative regulations (2023)
content:
(1)  The state primary road system shall consist of such public roads and city streets
      within the state as the Department of Highways determines shall be established, constructed,
      or maintained by the Department of Highways.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 177. State and Federal Highways; Limited Access Facilities; Turnpikes; Road Bonds; Billboards; Recyclers›Highways›KY REV ST 177.035. Cost of relocation of publicly and privately owned utility equipment and appliances to be borne by department; conditions
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 177. State and Federal Highways; Limited Access Facilities; Turnpikes; Road Bonds; Billboards; Recyclers › Highways › KY REV ST 177.035. Cost of relocation of publicly and privately owned utility equipment and appliances to be borne by department; conditions
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 177.035. Cost of relocation of publicly and privately owned utility equipment and appliances to be borne by department; conditions (2023)
content:
(1)  If the department determines that it is necessary for any fireplugs, pipes, mains,
      conduits, cables, wires, towers, poles, and other equipment and appliances, belonging
      to any municipality or a municipally owned utility, or any water district established
      pursuant to KRS Chapter 74, any water association established pursuant to KRS Chapter
      273, any local school district, or any sanitation district established pursuant to
      KRS Chapter 220, to be removed or relocated on, along, over, or under a highway, in
      order to construct, reconstruct, relocate, or improve any highway, the municipality,
      municipally owned utility, water district, local school district, or the sanitation
      district shall relocate or remove them in accordance with the order of the department.  The costs and expenses of relocation or removal required by this section, including
      the costs of installing facilities in a new location, and the cost of any lands, or
      any rights or interest in lands, and any other rights, acquired to accomplish the
      relocation or removal, shall be ascertained and paid by the department as a part of
      the cost of improving or constructing highways.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 177. State and Federal Highways; Limited Access Facilities; Turnpikes; Road Bonds; Billboards; Recyclers›Highways›KY REV ST 177.030. Cost of construction to be borne by state; state may accept donations
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 177. State and Federal Highways; Limited Access Facilities; Turnpikes; Road Bonds; Billboards; Recyclers › Highways › KY REV ST 177.030. Cost of construction to be borne by state; state may accept donations
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 177.030. Cost of construction to be borne by state; state may accept donations (2023)
content:
The cost of construction of the primary roads shall be borne entirely by the state,
   or by the state and federal government, where the roads are built in cooperation,
   and they shall be maintained entirely by the state, but any county, municipality or
   person may make donations to the state in aid of the construction or maintenance of
   any road.  The state may accept any donation on the terms and conditions prescribed by the
   department.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 177. State and Federal Highways; Limited Access Facilities; Turnpikes; Road Bonds; Billboards; Recyclers›Highways›KY REV ST 177.037. Community boundary signs; commemorative boundary signs for city or unincorporated urban place
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 177. State and Federal Highways; Limited Access Facilities; Turnpikes; Road Bonds; Billboards; Recyclers › Highways › KY REV ST 177.037. Community boundary signs; commemorative boundary signs for city or unincorporated urban place
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 177.037. Community boundary signs; commemorative boundary signs for city or unincorporated urban place (2023)
content:
(1)  The Department of Highways may install and maintain signs recognizing the boundary
      of a city, town, or community whether incorporated or unincorporated.  These signs shall be installed regardless of whether the community has a post office,
      if the Department of Highways had previously erected signs recognizing the city, town,
      or community.  The signs shall be placed at the official community boundaries.  If the community does not have official boundaries, the signs shall be installed
      at the community boundaries as determined by the built-up area.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 177. State and Federal Highways; Limited Access Facilities; Turnpikes; Road Bonds; Billboards; Recyclers›Highways›KY REV ST 177.042. Designation of city streets by commissioner of highways; record; statement to city
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 177. State and Federal Highways; Limited Access Facilities; Turnpikes; Road Bonds; Billboards; Recyclers › Highways › KY REV ST 177.042. Designation of city streets by commissioner of highways; record; statement to city
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 177.042. Designation of city streets by commissioner of highways; record; statement to city (2023)
content:
The commissioner of highways on and after July 1, 1942, may designate such city streets
   or portions thereof, including viaducts and bridges, as in his discretion are connecting
   links of state or federal maintained highways or that he may in his discretion determine
   to be necessary feeder streets and necessary to produce an adequate system of highways.  The Department of Highways shall prepare and cause a record of such city streets
   so designated and upon each such designation it shall furnish to each city a statement
   of the streets so designated in that city.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 177. State and Federal Highways; Limited Access Facilities; Turnpikes; Road Bonds; Billboards; Recyclers›Highways›KY REV ST 177.047. Permission of department required for obstructions or excavations in streets
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 177. State and Federal Highways; Limited Access Facilities; Turnpikes; Road Bonds; Billboards; Recyclers › Highways › KY REV ST 177.047. Permission of department required for obstructions or excavations in streets
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 177.047. Permission of department required for obstructions or excavations in streets (2023)
content:
Any city or person who enters upon such designated city connecting link streets or
   rights of way thereof, for the purpose of laying conduits, pipes, poles or wires therein,
   thereon or thereunder or makes any obstruction thereon or any excavation thereunder,
   which necessitates any change in the condition or structure thereof, shall do so as
   provided by regulations prescribed by the Department of Highways.  The Department of Highways may prescribe rules and regulations for the protection
   of city connecting link streets, under which such work shall be done, and require
   indemnity for any damage occasioned by work done under the regulations.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 177. State and Federal Highways; Limited Access Facilities; Turnpikes; Road Bonds; Billboards; Recyclers›Highways›KY REV ST 177.043. Powers of department as to designated city streets; agreements
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 177. State and Federal Highways; Limited Access Facilities; Turnpikes; Road Bonds; Billboards; Recyclers › Highways › KY REV ST 177.043. Powers of department as to designated city streets; agreements
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 177.043. Powers of department as to designated city streets; agreements (2023)
content:
On and after July 1, 1942, the Department of Highways may maintain and repair, construct
   and reconstruct under its control and supervision such city streets so designated
   by the commissioner of highways, and may make appropriations and expenditures out
   of its fund for such purposes.  The department may enter into any and all contracts inclusive of agreements with
   cities and with any federal agencies authorized so to do for such purpose.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 177. State and Federal Highways; Limited Access Facilities; Turnpikes; Road Bonds; Billboards; Recyclers›Highways›KY REV ST 177.055. Construction and maintenance of urban roads and streets
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 177. State and Federal Highways; Limited Access Facilities; Turnpikes; Road Bonds; Billboards; Recyclers › Highways › KY REV ST 177.055. Construction and maintenance of urban roads and streets
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 177.055. Construction and maintenance of urban roads and streets (2023)
content:
(1)  An incorporated area or unincorporated urban place may elect, with the concurrence
      of the Department of Highways, to construct, reconstruct, or maintain urban roads
      and streets which are included in the Department of Highways' state primary road system
      and are maintained by the Department of Highways.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 177. State and Federal Highways; Limited Access Facilities; Turnpikes; Road Bonds; Billboards; Recyclers›Highways›KY REV ST 177.050. Construction of roads with county funds; repayment to county
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 177. State and Federal Highways; Limited Access Facilities; Turnpikes; Road Bonds; Billboards; Recyclers › Highways › KY REV ST 177.050. Construction of roads with county funds; repayment to county
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 177.050. Construction of roads with county funds; repayment to county (2023)
content:
If any county desires to construct any part of a public road before the state is prepared
   to construct it, such county shall ask the department for permission to do so.  When such request is made the department shall immediately investigate the request,
   and if they find that the county has funds available to construct such road and will
   pay for the construction thereof, the department may take up the construction of such
   road, as soon as the county has taken such steps as the department requires to make
   available subject to its order sufficient funds to pay for the construction of the
   road.  When the county has satisfied these requirements, the department may proceed to
   construct the road in the same way and under the same regulations that it constructs
   other roads.  The department shall keep careful account of the money advanced by the county to
   the state, and when the project of which the road is a part has been completed, the
   state shall refund to the county the money advanced upon proper certification of the
   department, if the road is to be accepted by the commissioner of highways as a part
   of the state primary road system.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 177. State and Federal Highways; Limited Access Facilities; Turnpikes; Road Bonds; Billboards; Recyclers›Highways›KY REV ST 177.057. Required consultation on highway access prior to purchase of property for school facility
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation › Chapter 177. State and Federal Highways; Limited Access Facilities; Turnpikes; Road Bonds; Billboards; Recyclers › Highways › KY REV ST 177.057. Required consultation on highway access prior to purchase of property for school facility
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 177.057. Required consultation on highway access prior to purchase of property for school facility (2023)
content:
A local school district shall not purchase property for the construction of any school
   facility until the district consults with the Kentucky Transportation Cabinet, Department
   of Highways, Frankfort Office, to determine if the property to be purchased currently
   has adequate highway access or if highway access is planned for a future date by the
   Transportation Cabinet.  If the property to be purchased does not currently have adequate highway access
   or if the Transportation Cabinet does not plan future highway access to the property,
   the cabinet shall so notify the local school district in writing.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XV. Roads, Waterways, and Aviation›Chapter 177. State and Federal Highways; Limited Access Facilities; Turnpikes; Road Bonds; Billboards; Recyclers›Highways›KY REV ST 177.060. Payment for right-of-way

citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 177.060. Payment for right-of-way (2023)
content:
(1)  Except as otherwise provided in this section and inKRS 177.070, all cost of acquiring any necessary land or right-of-way for primary road purposes
      and all damages incurred shall be paid by the county.
