citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 227.410. Definitions for KRS 227.410; prohibition of sale or installation of unventable type gas fuel room heaters; exceptions; enforcement (2023)
content: (1)  As used in this section:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians›Fire Prevention and Protection›KY REV ST 227.336. Findings; correction of violations; fees
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians › Fire Prevention and Protection › KY REV ST 227.336. Findings; correction of violations; fees
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 227.336. Findings; correction of violations; fees (2023)
content:
(1)  Whenever the state fire marshal or any deputy state fire marshal appointed or
      employed by him or her makes any finding set forth in subsection (1) ofKRS 227.330, or finds any property in violation of any provision ofKRS 227.200to227.410or any regulations adopted thereunder, in lieu of the order required inKRS 227.330(1), he or she shall notify the owner or his or her agent in writing of such specific
      finding and violation and instruct him or her to correct the violation within a period
      of time not to exceed sixty (60) days.  Should the owner fail to make the required corrections within the specified time,
      the state fire marshal may proceed to take any other action authorized in this chapter.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians›Electrical Permits and Inspections›KY REV ST 227.460. Application of KRS 227.450. to § 227.500
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians › Electrical Permits and Inspections › KY REV ST 227.460. Application of KRS 227.450. to § 227.500
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 227.460. Application of KRS 227.450. to § 227.500 (2023)
content:
(1)KRS 227.450to227.500shall not apply to installations under the exclusive control of electric utilities
      for the purpose of communication, metering, or for the generation, control, transformation,
      transmission, and distribution of electric energy located in buildings used exclusively
      by utilities for such purposes or located outdoors on property owned or leased by
      the utility or on public highways, streets or roads, or outdoors by established rights
      on private property.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians›Fire Prevention and Protection›KY REV ST 227.340. Notice of hearing when property owner unknown
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians › Fire Prevention and Protection › KY REV ST 227.340. Notice of hearing when property owner unknown
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 227.340. Notice of hearing when property owner unknown (2023)
content:
Whenever the state fire marshal, his deputy, or other officer has reason to believe
   that a fire hazard should be corrected and he is unable to determine after a diligent
   search the owner of any property to be affected, he shall, in addition to notice required
   in KRS Chapter 13B, post notice of a hearing concerning the hazard in a conspicuous
   place on or near the property and shall also publish notice pursuant to KRS Chapter
   424 in the county in which the property is located.  The hearing shall be held in accordance with KRS Chapter 13B at the time and place
   specified in the notice as if the notice had been served on the owner.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians›Fire Prevention and Protection›KY REV ST 227.350. Records of orders, rules, and regulations; admissibility and presumptions as evidence
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians › Fire Prevention and Protection › KY REV ST 227.350. Records of orders, rules, and regulations; admissibility and presumptions as evidence
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 227.350. Records of orders, rules, and regulations; admissibility and presumptions as evidence (2023)
content:
The state fire marshal shall keep a permanent record of all summary orders, orders,
   rules, and regulations.  Each such summary order, order, rule, or regulation shall be admissible in any prosecution
   for the violation of any of its provisions.  Provisions of a summary order or an order, rule, or regulation shall be presumed
   to be lawful and to fix a reasonable and proper requirement and standard of safety
   from fire loss.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians›Fire Prevention and Protection›KY REV ST 227.335. Appeal of orders
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians › Fire Prevention and Protection › KY REV ST 227.335. Appeal of orders
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 227.335. Appeal of orders (2023)
content:
(1)  An appeal from the state fire marshal shall be taken only from a final order
      on hearing.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians›Fire Prevention and Protection›KY REV ST 227.370. Inspection of property by fire chief or other department personnel; inspection and investigation reports
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians › Fire Prevention and Protection › KY REV ST 227.370. Inspection of property by fire chief or other department personnel; inspection and investigation reports
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 227.370. Inspection of property by fire chief or other department personnel; inspection and investigation reports (2023)
content:
(1)  The chief of the fire department of a city, or any officer or member of his department
      designated by him for that purpose, is authorized to inspect all property for the
      purpose of ascertaining and causing to be corrected any conditions likely to cause
      fire loss, or determining the cause or origin of any fire loss, or discovering any
      violation of a law or ordinance relating to fire prevention and protection.  This authority shall apply to the interior of occupied, private dwellings only when
      a fire loss has occurred therein or when the officer has reason to believe that unsafe
      conditions exist in the building.  Inspections of property in the territory served by the fire department shall be
      made as often as practicable or as often as the city legislative body may direct.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians›Fire Prevention and Protection›KY REV ST 227.390. Officer may remedy fire hazard if owner fails to do so; expense
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians › Fire Prevention and Protection › KY REV ST 227.390. Officer may remedy fire hazard if owner fails to do so; expense
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 227.390. Officer may remedy fire hazard if owner fails to do so; expense (2023)
content:
If any owner fails to comply with an order issued pursuant toKRS 227.380or with an order as modified on appeal to the commissioner, the officer may cause
   the property to be repaired, or removed if repair is not feasible, and all fire hazard
   conditions remedied, at the expense of the owner.  Such expense may be enforced against any property of such owners and the officer
   and those employed to do the work or who furnish materials or equipment therefor shall
   have a lien for such expense on the real estate or property involved.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians›Fire Prevention and Protection›KY REV ST 227.395. Class B firefighting foam; restricted use during training or testing
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians › Fire Prevention and Protection › KY REV ST 227.395. Class B firefighting foam; restricted use during training or testing
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 227.395. Class B firefighting foam; restricted use during training or testing (2023)
content: (1)  As used in this section:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians›Fire Prevention and Protection›KY REV ST 227.360. Procedure in case of noncompliance with state fire marshal's or fire inspector's order
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians › Fire Prevention and Protection › KY REV ST 227.360. Procedure in case of noncompliance with state fire marshal's or fire inspector's order
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 227.360. Procedure in case of noncompliance with state fire marshal's or fire inspector's order (2023)
content:
If any owner fails to comply with a summary order or an order of the state fire marshal,
   his authorized designee or a fire inspector, or with an order as modified on appeal,
   the state fire marshal may cause the property to be repaired, or removed if repair
   is not feasible, or all fire hazard conditions remedied, at the expense of the owner.  Such expense may be enforced against any property of such owner, and the state fire
   marshal and those employed by him to do the work or who furnish materials or equipment
   therefor, shall have a lien for such expense on the real estate property involved.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians›Electrical Permits and Inspections›KY REV ST 227.470. Cooperative agreements between local governments
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians › Electrical Permits and Inspections › KY REV ST 227.470. Cooperative agreements between local governments
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 227.470. Cooperative agreements between local governments (2023)
content:
(1)  Any action authorized by the provisions ofKRS 227.450to227.500to be accomplished by a city or county may be undertaken cooperatively by two (2)
      or more local governments upon a resolution by the governing body of each local government
      to do so.  Such cooperative agreements shall conform to the provisions of KRS Chapter 65.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians›Fire Prevention and Protection›KY REV ST 227.380. Fire chief may order fire hazard removed; appeal
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians › Fire Prevention and Protection › KY REV ST 227.380. Fire chief may order fire hazard removed; appeal
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 227.380. Fire chief may order fire hazard removed; appeal (2023)
content:
(1)  Whenever the chief of the fire department or any officer or member of his department
      designated by him for that purpose finds any property which, for want of repairs,
      lack of sufficient fire escapes, age, dilapidated condition, or any other cause, is
      especially liable to fire loss, or whenever an officer finds in any property, combustible
      or explosive matter or inflammable materials likely to result in fire loss, he shall
      order it to be remedied.  The order shall forthwith be conformed to by the owner of the property.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians›Mobile Homes and Recreational Vehicles›KY REV ST 227.610. Licensing of retailers; liability insurance required
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians › Mobile Homes and Recreational Vehicles › KY REV ST 227.610. Licensing of retailers; liability insurance required
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 227.610. Licensing of retailers; liability insurance required (2023)
content:
The department or its designee shall license retailers underKRS 227.550to227.660.  The issuance of a license shall be contingent upon the applicant's chief managing
   officer passing a test administered by the department.  Before issuing a license, the department shall require proof of liability insurance
   which shall name the department in the certificate of insurance, and the license shall
   be null and void if there is a lapse of coverage in insurance.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians›Electrical Permits and Inspections›KY REV ST 227.491. Certification of an electrical installation by an inspector; invalidation by another inspector prohibited; certification and inspection of electrical installation without seal prohibited; other duties of inspector; sanctions for inspector's failure to comply
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians › Electrical Permits and Inspections › KY REV ST 227.491. Certification of an electrical installation by an inspector; invalidation by another inspector prohibited; certification and inspection of electrical installation without seal prohibited; other duties of inspector; sanctions for inspector's failure to comply
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 227.491. Certification of an electrical installation by an inspector; invalidation by another inspector prohibited; certification and inspection of electrical installation without seal prohibited; other duties of inspector; sanctions for inspector's failure to comply (2023)
content:
(1)  An electrical inspector who certifies an electrical installation shall furnish
      and attach an approval sticker, bearing his or her signature and certification number
      in a conspicuous place on the main service entrance equipment.  He or she shall also provide the owner of the electrical installation or his or
      her authorized agent with a certificate of approval if the same is requested.  A complete record of each inspection shall be kept by the inspector, and these records
      shall be made available to the department upon its request.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians›Fire Prevention and Protection›KY REV ST 227.400. Owner to keep property safe from fire; public and employees to be kept out of unsafe buildings; volunteers only to be used for private company's employee fire brigade
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians › Fire Prevention and Protection › KY REV ST 227.400. Owner to keep property safe from fire; public and employees to be kept out of unsafe buildings; volunteers only to be used for private company's employee fire brigade
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 227.400. Owner to keep property safe from fire; public and employees to be kept out of unsafe buildings; volunteers only to be used for private company's employee fire brigade (2023)
content:
(1)  No owner shall fail to furnish and use reasonable adequate protection and safeguards
      against fire loss, or fail to adopt and use processes and methods reasonably adequate
      to render such places safe from fire loss.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians›Electrical Permits and Inspections›KY REV ST 227.489. Electrical inspectors required to be certified
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians › Electrical Permits and Inspections › KY REV ST 227.489. Electrical inspectors required to be certified
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 227.489. Electrical inspectors required to be certified (2023)
content:
The commissioner shall require electrical inspectors to be certified.  Examinations shall be based on the National Electrical Code incorporated in the
   Uniform State Building Code and the standards of safety prescribed by the department.  Electrical inspectors who have been engaged in the inspection of electrical light
   and power wiring installations, based on the requirements of the National Electrical
   Code, for a period of three (3) years, may be certified on the basis of knowledge
   of this subject and experience.  No certificate shall be denied, suspended, or revoked unless the applicant or certificate
   holder is afforded the opportunity for a hearing in accordance with KRS Chapter 13B.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians›Mobile Homes and Recreational Vehicles›KY REV ST 227.550. Definitions for KRS 227.550. to 227.660, 227.990, and § 227.992
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians › Mobile Homes and Recreational Vehicles › KY REV ST 227.550. Definitions for KRS 227.550. to 227.660, 227.990, and § 227.992
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 227.550. Definitions for KRS 227.550. to 227.660, 227.990, and § 227.992 (2023)
content: As used inKRS 227.550to227.660,227.990, and227.992, unless the context requires a different definition:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians›Electrical Permits and Inspections›KY REV ST 227.480. Authority to require permits; proof of licensure under KRS Chapter 227A; exemptions; inspectors; inspection standards
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians › Electrical Permits and Inspections › KY REV ST 227.480. Authority to require permits; proof of licensure under KRS Chapter 227A; exemptions; inspectors; inspection standards
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 227.480. Authority to require permits; proof of licensure under KRS Chapter 227A; exemptions; inspectors; inspection standards (2023)
content:
(1)  (a) A city, county, urban-county government, charter county, or consolidated
         local government or the state shall, according to the Uniform State Building Code
         as it pertains to the plan review and inspection responsibilities of local governments
         or the state, require any person to obtain a permit before commencing construction,
         alteration, or repairs of any electrical system.

content:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians›Electrical Permits and Inspections›KY REV ST 227.492. Investigation of misconduct of electrical inspector
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians › Electrical Permits and Inspections › KY REV ST 227.492. Investigation of misconduct of electrical inspector
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 227.492. Investigation of misconduct of electrical inspector (2023)
content:
It shall be the duty of the commissioner to investigate alleged misconduct of any
   electrical inspector certified underKRS 227.489when, in the opinion of the commissioner, there is sufficient evidence to suggest
   that misconduct exists.  Any party may seek redress from the commissioner when alleged misconduct of an electrical
   inspector is deemed to have worked an undue hardship on the party.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians›Electrical Permits and Inspections›KY REV ST 227.500. Authority to fix penalty
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians › Electrical Permits and Inspections › KY REV ST 227.500. Authority to fix penalty
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 227.500. Authority to fix penalty (2023)
content:
(1)  A city, county, urban-county, charter county, or consolidated local government
      may fix as a penalty for the violation of any ordinance or resolution passed under
      the provisions ofKRS 227.200to227.500, a fine of not less than twenty-five dollars ($25) nor more than two hundred fifty
      dollars ($250), or imprisonment for not more than ninety (90) days, or both.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians›Electrical Permits and Inspections›KY REV ST 227.495. Additional powers of electrical inspectors; sanctions for misconduct

Seal required prior to sale or use as a dwelling of previously owned manufactured or mobile home transported into Commonwealth; homes installed before July 13, 2004, excepted
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians › Mobile Homes and Recreational Vehicles › KY REV ST 227.605. Class B1. Seal required prior to sale or use as a dwelling of previously owned manufactured or mobile home transported into Commonwealth; homes installed before July 13, 2004, excepted
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 227.605. Class B1. Seal required prior to sale or use as a dwelling of previously owned manufactured or mobile home transported into Commonwealth; homes installed before July 13, 2004, excepted (2023)
content:
(1)  No person shall transport into the Commonwealth of Kentucky any previously owned
      manufactured or mobile home for the purpose of resale or use as a dwelling in the
      Commonwealth of Kentucky, unless the previously owned manufactured or mobile home
      has a B1 Seal attached to it prior to resale or use as a dwelling.  The application and certification procedures for the attachment of the B1 Seal prior
      to the resale or occupancy of the manufactured or mobile home shall be established
      by the department through the promulgation of administrative regulations in accordance
      with KRS Chapter 13A.  Nothing in this section shall require a person who owns a manufactured or mobile
      home in another state and who transports that manufactured or mobile home into the
      Commonwealth of Kentucky to use as that person's dwelling to obtain a Class B seal.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians›Mobile Homes and Recreational Vehicles›KY REV ST 227.590. Administrative regulations
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians › Mobile Homes and Recreational Vehicles › KY REV ST 227.590. Administrative regulations
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 227.590. Administrative regulations (2023)
content:
(1)  The department, subject to any applicable requirements ofKRS 198B.030(8), shall establish and enforce administrative regulations reasonably required to effectuate
      the provisions ofKRS 227.550to227.660and to carry out the department's responsibilities as a state administrative agency
      for the enforcement and administration of the federal act.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians›Mobile Homes and Recreational Vehicles›KY REV ST 227.580. Certificates of acceptability; requirements for issuance
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians › Mobile Homes and Recreational Vehicles › KY REV ST 227.580. Certificates of acceptability; requirements for issuance
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 227.580. Certificates of acceptability; requirements for issuance (2023)
content:
(1)  It is unlawful for any manufacturer to manufacture, import, or sell manufactured
      homes within this state unless that manufacturer has been issued a certificate of
      acceptability for such manufactured homes from the department or its designee.  This subsection shall not apply to manufactured homes manufactured in this state
      and designated for delivery to and sale in another state.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians›Mobile Homes and Recreational Vehicles›KY REV ST 227.600. title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 227. citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 227.600. Seal required on manufactured homes, mobile homes, and recreational vehicles offered for sale; seal for manufactured homes and mobile homes purchased in another state (2023)
content:
(1)  Any retailer who has acquired a previously owned manufactured home, mobile home,
      or recreational vehicle without a seal shall apply to the department for the appropriate
      seal by submitting an affidavit that the unit has been brought up to or meets reasonable
      standards established by the department for previously owned manufactured homes, mobile
      homes, or recreational vehicles.  Those manufactured homes or mobile homes taken in trade shall be reinspected and
      certified.  A numbered Class B1 Seal shall be affixed by the retailer to the unit prior to sale.  A seal shall not be required if the retailer submits an affidavit that the unit
      will not be resold for use by the public.  A retailer shall not transport or install a manufactured or mobile home which is
      to be used for residential purposes which does not have a Class B1 Seal.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians›Fireworks›KY REV ST 227.700. “Fireworks” defined; exceptions
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians › Fireworks › KY REV ST 227.700. “Fireworks” defined; exceptions
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 227.700. “Fireworks” defined; exceptions (2023)
content:
As used inKRS 227.700to227.750, “fireworks” means any composition or device for the purpose of producing a visible or an audible
   effect by combustion, deflagration, or detonation, and which meets the definition
   of “consumer fireworks” as defined inKRS 227.702or “display” fireworks as defined inKRS 227.706and as set forth in the United States Department of Transportation's (DOT) hazardous
   materials regulations. “Fireworks” does not include:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians›Mobile Homes and Recreational Vehicles›KY REV ST 227.650. Inspection powers; training programs for local government personnel
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians › Mobile Homes and Recreational Vehicles › KY REV ST 227.650. Inspection powers; training programs for local government personnel
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 227.650. Inspection powers; training programs for local government personnel (2023)
content:
(1)  The department is empowered to inspect all mobile homes which are not covered
      by the federal act and previously owned recreational vehicles for which it has issued
      a seal of approval.

Procedure for denial, suspension, or revocation of license or certificate of acceptability; dispute resolution process; appeal
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 227.640. Procedure for denial, suspension, or revocation of license or certificate of acceptability; dispute resolution process; appeal (2023)
content:
(1)  The department or its designee may deny the application for a license, certification,
      or certificate of acceptability within thirty (30) days after receipt thereof by written
      notice to the applicant, stating the grounds for the denial.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians›Mobile Homes and Recreational Vehicles›KY REV ST 227.625. Liability insurance; prerequisite for license
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians › Mobile Homes and Recreational Vehicles › KY REV ST 227.625. Liability insurance; prerequisite for license
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 227.625. Liability insurance; prerequisite for license (2023)
content:
(1)  Before any license is issued or renewed, the applicant shall file or have on
      file with the department a liability insurance policy issued by an insurance carrier
      authorized to transact insurance business within the Commonwealth of Kentucky.  The policy of insurance shall be issued in the name of the applicant licensee.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians›Mobile Homes and Recreational Vehicles›KY REV ST 227.660. State inspectors
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians › Mobile Homes and Recreational Vehicles › KY REV ST 227.660. State inspectors
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 227.660. State inspectors (2023)
content:
Subject to KRS Chapters 18A and 64, the department may set qualifications for, employ,
   and fix the compensation of state inspectors as the department deems necessary to
   carry out the functions ofKRS 227.550to227.650.  To carry outKRS 227.550to227.650, the department may authorize the state inspectors to travel within or outside the
   state for the purposes of inspecting the manufacturing facilities for manufactured
   homes or for any other purpose in connection withKRS 227.550to227.650.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians›Fireworks›KY REV ST 227.708. Legality of items described in KRS § 227.702
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians › Fireworks › KY REV ST 227.708. Legality of items described in KRS § 227.702
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 227.708. Legality of items described in KRS § 227.702 (2023)
content:
(1)  Items described inKRS 227.702are legal for retail sale provided all applicable federal and state requirements
      with respect thereto are met.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians›Mobile Homes and Recreational Vehicles›KY REV ST 227.665. Recreational and park vehicles to be constructed in accordance with ANSI standards
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians › Mobile Homes and Recreational Vehicles › KY REV ST 227.665. Recreational and park vehicles to be constructed in accordance with ANSI standards
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 227.665. Recreational and park vehicles to be constructed in accordance with ANSI standards (2023)
content:
(1)  All recreational vehicles sold, leased, or offered for sale or lease by a retailer
      to a consumer in this state shall be constructed in accordance with the most recent
      ANSI standards on recreational vehicles.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians›Fireworks›KY REV ST 227.704. Novelties and trick noisemakers defined
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians › Fireworks › KY REV ST 227.704. Novelties and trick noisemakers defined
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 227.704. Novelties and trick noisemakers defined (2023)
content:
Items listed in this section are classified as novelties and trick noisemakers and
   are not classified as consumer fireworks by the United States Department of Transportation,
   and their transportation, storage, retail sale, possession, sale, and use shall be
   allowed throughout the state at all times.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians›Fireworks›KY REV ST 227.702. Consumer fireworks defined
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians › Fireworks › KY REV ST 227.702. Consumer fireworks defined
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 227.702. Consumer fireworks defined (2023)
content:
As used inKRS 227.700to227.750, “consumer fireworks” means fireworks that are suitable for use by the public, designed primarily to produce
   visible effects by combustion, and that comply with the construction, chemical composition,
   and labeling regulations of the United States Consumer Product Safety Commission.  The types, sizes, and amount of pyrotechnic contents of these devices are limited
   as enumerated in this section.  Some small devices designed to produce audible effects are included, such as whistling
   devices, ground devices containing fifty (50) mg. or less of explosive composition,
   and aerial devices containing one hundred thirty (130) mg. or less of explosive composition.
   Consumer fireworks are further defined by the Consumer Product Safety Commission in
   CPSC,16 C.F.R. pts. 1500and15071, are classified as Division 1.4G explosives by the United States Department of Transportation,
   and include the following:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians›Fireworks›KY REV ST 227.706. Display fireworks defined
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians › Fireworks › KY REV ST 227.706. Display fireworks defined
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 227.706. Display fireworks defined (2023)
content:
As used inKRS 227.700to227.750, “display fireworks” means pyrotechnic devices or large fireworks designed primarily to produce visible
   or audible effects by combustion, deflagration or detonation.  This term includes, but is not limited to, firecrackers containing more than two
   (2) grains (130 mg) of explosive composition, aerial shells containing more than forty
   (40) grams of pyrotechnic composition, and other display pieces which exceed the limits
   for classification as “consumer fireworks.”   Display fireworks are defined by the Consumer Product Safety Commission in CPSC,16 C.F.R. pts. 1500and15071, and are classified as Class B explosives by the United States Department of Transportation.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians›Fireworks›KY REV ST 227.715. Requirements for sale of certain consumer fireworks

citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 227.715. Requirements for sale of certain consumer fireworks (2023)
content:
Except as provided inKRS 227.710, the consumer fireworks described inKRS 227.702may be offered for sale, sold at retail, or kept with the intent to sell, only if
   the following requirements are met:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians›Fireworks›KY REV ST 227.730. Exempted sale and use of explosives or signaling flares
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians › Fireworks › KY REV ST 227.730. Exempted sale and use of explosives or signaling flares
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 227.730. Exempted sale and use of explosives or signaling flares (2023)
content:
Nothing inKRS 227.710to227.750shall prevent the retail sale and use of explosives or signaling flares used in the
   course of ordinary business or industry, or gold star producing sparklers, which contain
   no magnesium or chlorate, toy snakes which contain no mercury, smoke novelties and
   party novelties, which contain less than twenty-five hundredths (25/100) of a grain
   of explosive mixture, or shells or cartridges used as ammunition in firearms, or blank
   cartridges for a show or theatre, or for signal or ceremonial purposes in athletics
   or sports, or for use by military organizations, or the sale of any kind of fireworks
   provided the same are to be shipped by the seller directly out of the state.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians›Fireworks›KY REV ST 227.720. Bond for public display permit
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians › Fireworks › KY REV ST 227.720. Bond for public display permit
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 227.720. Bond for public display permit (2023)
content:
No permit shall be issued underKRS 227.710unless the applicant shall give bond or evidence of liability insurance deemed adequate
   by the official to whom application for the permit is made, in a sum not less than
   one million dollars ($1,000,000). However, the local fire chief or state fire marshal may require a larger amount if
   in their judgment the situation requires it, conditioned for the payment of all damages
   which may be caused thereby either to a person or to property by reason of the permitted
   display, and arising from any acts of the licensee, his agents, employees or subcontractors.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians›Fireworks›KY REV ST 227.750. Seizure and sale of fireworks stored and held in violation of chapter; notice of proposed disposal of fireworks required; administrative hearing; KRS 227.700. to 227.750. not to conflict with local ordinances
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians › Fireworks › KY REV ST 227.750. Seizure and sale of fireworks stored and held in violation of chapter; notice of proposed disposal of fireworks required; administrative hearing; KRS 227.700. to 227.750. not to conflict with local ordinances
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 227.750. Seizure and sale of fireworks stored and held in violation of chapter; notice of proposed disposal of fireworks required; administrative hearing; KRS 227.700. to 227.750. not to conflict with local ordinances (2023)
content:
(1)  The state fire marshal, or any fire department having jurisdiction which has
      been deputized to act on behalf of the state fire marshal, shall cause to be removed
      at the expense of the owner all stocks of fireworks which are stored and held in violation
      of this chapter.  After a period of sixty (60) days, the seized fireworks may be offered for sale
      by closed bid to a properly certified fireworks wholesaler.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians›Fire Safety Standards for Cigarettes›KY REV ST 227.772. Reduced cigarette ignition propensity standards; test methods; certification; reports and recommendations
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 227. citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 227.772. Reduced cigarette ignition propensity standards; test methods; certification; reports and recommendations (2023)
content:
(1)  (a) Except as provided in subsection (7) of this section, no cigarettes shall
         be sold or offered for sale in this state or offered for sale or sold to persons located
         in this state unless the cigarettes have been tested in accordance with the test method
         and meet the performance standards specified in this section, a written certification
         has been filed by the manufacturer with the state fire marshal in accordance withKRS 227.774, and the cigarettes have been marked in accordance withKRS 227.776.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians›Fire Safety Standards for Cigarettes›KY REV ST 227.770. Definitions for KRS 227.770. to § 227.784

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians›Fire Safety Standards for Cigarettes›KY REV ST 227.776. Cigarette labels to indicate fire standards compliance
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians › Fire Safety Standards for Cigarettes › KY REV ST 227.776. Cigarette labels to indicate fire standards compliance
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 227.776. Cigarette labels to indicate fire standards compliance (2023)
content:
A manufacturer shall place on each individual package of cigarettes the letters “FSC”
   or “FS” which signify “Fire Standards Compliance,” indicating compliance with the
   fire safety performance standard set forth inKRS 227.772(1)(d).  The letters shall appear in eight (8) point type and be permanently printed, stamped,
   engraved, or embossed on the package at or near the UPC Code, if present.

      attesting that:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians›Fire Safety Standards for Cigarettes›KY REV ST 227.782. Fire prevention and public safety fund
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians › Fire Safety Standards for Cigarettes › KY REV ST 227.782. Fire prevention and public safety fund
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 227.782. Fire prevention and public safety fund (2023)
content:
(1)  There is hereby established in the State Treasury a special fund to be known
      as the fire prevention and public safety fund.  The fund shall consist of all moneys recovered as penalties underKRS 227.778and moneys collected for fees pursuant toKRS 227.715.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians›Ground-Fault Circuit-Interrupter›KY REV ST 227.800. Definitions
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians › Ground-Fault Circuit-Interrupter › KY REV ST 227.800. Definitions
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 227.800. Definitions (2023)
content: As used inKRS 227.800to227.810, unless the context otherwise requires:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians›Fire Safety Standards for Cigarettes›KY REV ST 227.784. Nonapplicability of KRS 227.770. to 227.784. to cigarettes for sale outside Kentucky; adoption of federal standards; local regulation preempted
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians › Fire Safety Standards for Cigarettes › KY REV ST 227.784. Nonapplicability of KRS 227.770. to 227.784. to cigarettes for sale outside Kentucky; adoption of federal standards; local regulation preempted
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 227.784. Nonapplicability of KRS 227.770. to 227.784. to cigarettes for sale outside Kentucky; adoption of federal standards; local regulation preempted (2023)
content:
(1)  Nothing inKRS 227.770to227.784shall be construed to prohibit any person or entity from manufacturing or selling
      cigarettes that do not meet the requirements ofKRS 227.772if the cigarettes are or will be stamped for sale in another state or are packaged
      for sale outside the United States and that person or entity has taken reasonable
      steps to ensure that the cigarettes will not be sold or offered for sale to persons
      located in this state.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians›Fire Safety Standards for Cigarettes›KY REV ST 227.780. Administrative regulations; Department of Revenue inspections; examinations by Attorney General and state fire marshal
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians › Fire Safety Standards for Cigarettes › KY REV ST 227.780. Administrative regulations; Department of Revenue inspections; examinations by Attorney General and state fire marshal
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 227.780. Administrative regulations; Department of Revenue inspections; examinations by Attorney General and state fire marshal (2023)
content:
(1)  The state fire marshal may promulgate administrative regulations if necessary
      to carry out the purposes ofKRS 227.770to227.784in accordance with the provisions of KRS Chapter 13A.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians›Fire Safety Standards for Cigarettes›KY REV ST 227.778. Penalties
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians › Fire Safety Standards for Cigarettes › KY REV ST 227.778. Penalties
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 227.778. Penalties (2023)
content:
(1)  A manufacturer, wholesale dealer, or any other person or entity who knowingly
      sells or offers to sell cigarettes, other than through retail sale, in violation ofKRS 227.772, for the first offense shall be liable for a civil penalty not to exceed ten thousand
      dollars ($10,000) per each sale of the cigarettes and, for a subsequent offense, be
      liable for a civil penalty not to exceed twenty-five thousand dollars ($25,000) per
      each sale of the cigarettes, except that in no case shall the penalty against the
      person or entity exceed one hundred thousand dollars ($100,000) for each thirty (30)
      day period.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians›Ground-Fault Circuit-Interrupter›KY REV ST 227.810. Requirement for ground-fault circuit-interrupter installation on public fountains and pools; standards to be adopted by administrative regulations; prohibition of exemption by local governmental action
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians › Ground-Fault Circuit-Interrupter › KY REV ST 227.810. Requirement for ground-fault circuit-interrupter installation on public fountains and pools; standards to be adopted by administrative regulations; prohibition of exemption by local governmental action
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 227.810. Requirement for ground-fault circuit-interrupter installation on public fountains and pools; standards to be adopted by administrative regulations; prohibition of exemption by local governmental action (2023)
content:
(1)  A ground-fault circuit-interrupter shall be installed on all existing and new
      fountains and pools that are located in a public place within the Commonwealth, in
      accordance with standards set forth in the National Electrical Code adopted by administrative
      regulations of the department.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians›Penalties›KY REV ST 227.991. Penalties
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians › Penalties › KY REV ST 227.991. Penalties
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 227.991. Penalties (2023)
content: Any person, firm, or corporation who violates subsections (2), (3), (4) or (5) ofKRS 227.410shall be fined not less than ten dollars ($10) and not more than fifty dollars ($50).

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 227A. Electricians and Electrical Contractors›KY REV ST 227A.010. Definitions for KRS 227A.010. to § 227A.140
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 227A. Electricians and Electrical Contractors › KY REV ST 227A.010. Definitions for KRS 227A.010. to § 227A.140
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 227A.010. Definitions for KRS 227A.010. to § 227A.140 (2023)
content: As used inKRS 227A.010to227A.140, unless the context otherwise requires:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians›Penalties›KY REV ST 227.992. Penalty
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians › Penalties › KY REV ST 227.992. Penalty
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 227.992. Penalty (2023)
content:
Any person who willfully manufactures a manufactured home, sells, or offers for sale
   a manufactured home, mobile home, or recreational vehicle in this state in violation
   ofKRS 227.550to227.660shall be guilty of a misdemeanor and upon conviction thereof shall be punishable
   by a fine of not more than one thousand dollars ($1,000) or by confinement in the
   county jail for a period of not more than thirty (30) days, or both.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians›Penalties›KY REV ST 227.990. Penalties
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 227. Fire Prevention and Protection; Electricians › Penalties › KY REV ST 227.990. Penalties
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 227.990. Penalties (2023)
content:
(1)  Except for manufactured homes manufactured under the federal act, any person
      who violates any provision of this chapter or any provision of a lawful order, rule,
      or regulation made under the provisions of this chapter, or who induces another to
      violate any provisions of this chapter or of any lawful order, rule, or regulation
      made thereunder, upon conviction thereof shall be fined not less than twenty-five
      dollars ($25) nor more than one thousand dollars ($1,000), or confined in the county
      jail for not more than sixty (60) days, or both.  Each day such violations exist shall, in the discretion of the courts, be considered
      as a separate offense.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 227A. Electricians and Electrical Contractors›KY REV ST 227A.020. Prohibitions; local licensing programs
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 227A. Electricians and Electrical Contractors › KY REV ST 227A.020. Prohibitions; local licensing programs
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 227A.020. Prohibitions; local licensing programs (2023)
content:
(1)  A person who is not licensed as an electrical contractor shall not represent
      himself or herself to the public as an electrical contractor or use any terms, titles,
      or abbreviations which express or imply that the person is a licensed electrical contractor.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 227A. Electricians and Electrical Contractors›KY REV ST 227A.050. Fees; revolving fund
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 227A. Electricians and Electrical Contractors › KY REV ST 227A.050. Fees; revolving fund
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 227A.050. Fees; revolving fund (2023)
content:
(1)  All fees and other moneys received by the department under the provisions ofKRS 227A.010to227A.140shall be deposited in the State Treasury to the credit of a revolving fund for use
      by the department in administering the provisions ofKRS 227A.010to227A.140.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 227A. Electricians and Electrical Contractors›KY REV ST 227A.040. Powers and duties of department
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 227A. Electricians and Electrical Contractors › KY REV ST 227A.040. Powers and duties of department
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 227A.040. Powers and duties of department (2023)
content: (1)  The department shall administer and enforceKRS 227A.010to227A.140and shall evaluate the qualifications of applicants for licensure.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 227A. Electricians and Electrical Contractors›KY REV ST 227A.030. Limitations on applicability of KRS 227A.010. to § 227A.140
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 227A. Electricians and Electrical Contractors › KY REV ST 227A.030. Limitations on applicability of KRS 227A.010. to § 227A.140
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 227A.030. Limitations on applicability of KRS 227A.010. to § 227A.140 (2023)
content:
(1)  The provisions ofKRS 227A.010to227A.140shall not apply to installations under the exclusive control of electric utilities
      for the purpose of communication, metering, or for the generation, control, transformation,
      transmission, and distribution of electric energy located in buildings used exclusively
      by utilities for those purposes or located outdoors on property owned or leased by
      the utility or on public highways, streets, or roads, or outdoors by established rights
      on private property.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 227A. Electricians and Electrical Contractors›KY REV ST 227A.060. Qualifications for licensure; provisional license
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 227A. Electricians and Electrical Contractors › KY REV ST 227A.060. Qualifications for licensure; provisional license
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 227A.060. Qualifications for licensure; provisional license (2023)
content:
(1)  The department shall issue a license as an “electrical contractor” to an applicant
      who meets the following requirements:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 227A. Electricians and Electrical Contractors›KY REV ST 227A.070. Licensure by endorsement
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 227A. Electricians and Electrical Contractors › KY REV ST 227A.070. Licensure by endorsement
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 227A.070. Licensure by endorsement (2023)
content:
Upon application to the department and payment of all applicable fees, the department
   shall license by endorsement an applicant who is registered, licensed, or certified
   in another state if the requirements for registration, licensing, or certification
   in the issuing state are substantially equal to the requirements for licensing in
   the Commonwealth of Kentucky and the applicant is in good standing in the issuing
   state.  The department shall license an applicant by endorsement only if the issuing state
   extends similar reciprocity to Kentucky citizens licensed underKRS 227A.010to227A.140.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 227A. Electricians and Electrical Contractors›KY REV ST 227A.090. Examinations
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 227A. Electricians and Electrical Contractors › KY REV ST 227A.090. Examinations
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 227A.090. Examinations (2023)
content:
(1)  The department shall select and approve an examination to be used in determining
      the competency of persons to be licensed underKRS 227A.010to227A.140.  Examinations selected and approved for each level of licensing shall be nationally
      recognized examinations which have been determined through proper validation techniques
      to measure successfully an individual's competency to perform the licensed practice.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 227A. Electricians and Electrical Contractors›KY REV ST 227A.120. Appeal of disciplinary action
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 227A. Electricians and Electrical Contractors › KY REV ST 227A.120. Appeal of disciplinary action
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 227A.120. Appeal of disciplinary action (2023)
content:
Any party aggrieved by a disciplinary action of the department may bring an action
   in the Circuit Court of Franklin County under the provisions of KRS Chapter 13B.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 227A. Electricians and Electrical Contractors›KY REV ST 227A.140. Effect of disassociation of licensee on electrical contractor or other business; interim period for use of recently deceased licensee’s master electrician’s license
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 227A. Electricians and Electrical Contractors › KY REV ST 227A.140. Effect of disassociation of licensee on electrical contractor or other business; interim period for use of recently deceased licensee’s master electrician’s license
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 227A.140. Effect of disassociation of licensee on electrical contractor or other business; interim period for use of recently deceased licensee’s master electrician’s license (2023)
content:
(1)  A master electrician who ceases to be associated with the electrical contractor
      and is the representative by which the licensed electrical contractor qualifies shall
      immediately report his or her disassociation to the department or the authorized local
      licensing program.  The master electrician shall be responsible for all work done under his or her license
      until the department or the authorized local licensing program is notified by the
      master electrician that he or she is no longer associated with the electrical contractor.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 227A. Electricians and Electrical Contractors›KY REV ST 227A.100. Fees; application for renewal or reinstatement of license
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 227A. Electricians and Electrical Contractors › KY REV ST 227A.100. Fees; application for renewal or reinstatement of license
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 227A.100. Fees; application for renewal or reinstatement of license (2023)
content:
(1)  Each licensee licensed under the provisions ofKRS 227A.010to227A. 140 shall annually, on or before the last day of the licensee's birth month, pay
      to the department a renewal fee as established in administrative regulations promulgated
      by the department.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 227A. Electricians and Electrical Contractors›KY REV ST 227A.150. Limitation on applicability of KRS 227A.010. to 227A.140. to low-voltage installer certificate holder
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 227A. Electricians and Electrical Contractors › KY REV ST 227A.150. Limitation on applicability of KRS 227A.010. to 227A.140. to low-voltage installer certificate holder
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 227A.150. Limitation on applicability of KRS 227A.010. to 227A.140. to low-voltage installer certificate holder (2023)
content:
Nothing inKRS 227A.010to227A.140shall apply to low-voltage, power-limited installations for control or coordination
   of interconnected devices separated from a power source by a Class 2 or Class 3 transformer
   installed by a low-voltage installer certificate holder.  The department shall set the standards for experience and testing for issuance of
   a low-voltage installer certificate by administrative regulation and may charge a
   fee to be set by the department by administrative regulation but not to exceed the
   actual cost of issuance of the certificate.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 227A. Electricians and Electrical Contractors›KY REV ST 227A.110. Disciplinary actions
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 227A. Electricians and Electrical Contractors › KY REV ST 227A.110. Disciplinary actions
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 227A.110. Disciplinary actions (2023)
content:
(1)  The department may, following a hearing pursuant to KRS Chapter 13B, impose sanctions
      specified inKRS 227A.040upon proof that the licensee has:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 229. Boxing and Wrestling›KY REV ST 229.035. Promoter license requirement; approval of show dates; bond
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 229. Boxing and Wrestling › KY REV ST 229.035. Promoter license requirement; approval of show dates; bond
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 229.035. Promoter license requirement; approval of show dates; bond (2023)
content:
(1)  No person shall conduct or advertise a show without a promoter license issued
      by the commission to conduct the show.  Show dates shall be approved as determined through the promulgation of an administrative
      regulation.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 229. Boxing and Wrestling›KY REV ST 229.031. Report as to tickets sold and receipts; tax on gross receipts; notification when supplying broadcast facilities; examination of books and records
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 229. Boxing and Wrestling › KY REV ST 229.031. Report as to tickets sold and receipts; tax on gross receipts; notification when supplying broadcast facilities; examination of books and records
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 229.031. Report as to tickets sold and receipts; tax on gross receipts; notification when supplying broadcast facilities; examination of books and records (2023)
content:
(1)  Every person conducting an unarmed combat show, other than those holding a permit
      under subsection (1) ofKRS 229.061, shall furnish to the commission a written report, verified by the person, if an
      individual, or by some officer, if a corporation or association, showing the number
      of tickets sold for the show, the amount of the gross receipts from this sale, and
      any other matters prescribed by the commission.  He or she shall also pay to the commission a tax of twenty-five dollars ($25) or
      five percent (5%) of the gross receipts from the sale of all tickets to the show,
      whichever is greater.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 227A. Electricians and Electrical Contractors›KY REV ST 227A.130. Penalties for violation of KRS § 227A.020
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 227A. Electricians and Electrical Contractors › KY REV ST 227A.130. Penalties for violation of KRS § 227A.020
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 227A.130. Penalties for violation of KRS § 227A.020 (2023)
content:
Any person who violates or aids in the violation of any provision ofKRS 227A.020shall be guilty of a misdemeanor and upon conviction shall be fined not less than
   five hundred dollars ($500) nor more than five thousand dollars ($5,000), or sentenced
   to jail for not less than ten (10) nor more than one hundred eighty (180) days, or
   both.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 229. Boxing and Wrestling›KY REV ST 229.011. Definitions for chapter
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 229. Boxing and Wrestling › KY REV ST 229.011. Definitions for chapter
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 229.011. Definitions for chapter (2023)
content:
As used in this chapter unless the context clearly indicates otherwise the following
   definitions shall apply:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 229. Boxing and Wrestling›KY REV ST 229.061. Permits for schools and charitable organizations
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 229. Boxing and Wrestling › KY REV ST 229.061. Permits for schools and charitable organizations
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 229.061. Permits for schools and charitable organizations (2023)
content:
(1)  The commission may issue a permit, without the payment of any taxes or license
      fee, to any accredited college, university, school, Young Men's Christian Association,
      Young Men's Hebrew Association, or organization that in the judgment of the commission
      is of like character, to hold an unarmed combat show upon a sufficient showing that
      the matches or exhibitions are to be held by and between bona fide students or members
      of the accredited colleges, universities, schools, Young Men's Christian Associations,
      Young Men's Hebrew Associations, or organizations that in the judgment of the commission
      are of like character.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 229. Boxing and Wrestling›KY REV ST 229.065. Licenses required for wrestling training
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 229. Boxing and Wrestling › KY REV ST 229.065. Licenses required for wrestling training
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 229.065. Licenses required for wrestling training (2023)
content:
(1)  No person shall provide training or instruction for any wrestling show without
      holding a promoter license granted by the commission.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 229. Boxing and Wrestling›KY REV ST 229.111. Health examination of contestants
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 229. Boxing and Wrestling › KY REV ST 229.111. Health examination of contestants
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 229.111. Health examination of contestants (2023)
content:
Contestants in a boxing, kickboxing, muay thai, or mixed martial arts show shall be
   examined by a reputable licensed physician appointed by the commission, and shall
   meet the health and fitness requirements as established in administrative regulations
   promulgated by the commission before participating in a boxing, kickboxing, muay thai,
   or mixed martial arts show.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 229. Boxing and Wrestling›KY REV ST 229.055. Rounds limitation of boxing, kickboxing, or muay thai contest or exhibition; boxing show contracts to be filed with commission before show
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 229. Boxing and Wrestling › KY REV ST 229.055. Rounds limitation of boxing, kickboxing, or muay thai contest or exhibition; boxing show contracts to be filed with commission before show
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 229.055. Rounds limitation of boxing, kickboxing, or muay thai contest or exhibition; boxing show contracts to be filed with commission before show (2023)
content:
(1)  A boxing, kickboxing, or muay thai contest or exhibition shall not consist of
      more than twelve (12) rounds.  The duration of the rounds shall be determined by the commission through the promulgation
      of an administrative regulation.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 229. Boxing and Wrestling›KY REV ST 229.025. Administrative regulations; license requirement; license fees; license age requirement
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 229. Boxing and Wrestling › KY REV ST 229.025. Administrative regulations; license requirement; license fees; license age requirement
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 229.025. Administrative regulations; license requirement; license fees; license age requirement (2023)
content:
(1)  Every licensee shall be subject to the administrative regulations promulgated
      by the commission.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 229. Boxing and Wrestling›KY REV ST 229.045. Sanctioning bodies; requirements; administrative regulation
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 229. Boxing and Wrestling › KY REV ST 229.045. Sanctioning bodies; requirements; administrative regulation
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 229.045. Sanctioning bodies; requirements; administrative regulation (2023)
content:
(1)  USA Boxing is the only sanctioning body recognized to conduct combat sports not
      covered under this chapter.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 229. Boxing and Wrestling›KY REV ST 229.141. Structures used for unarmed combat shows, requirements
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 229. Boxing and Wrestling › KY REV ST 229.141. Structures used for unarmed combat shows, requirements
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 229.141. Structures used for unarmed combat shows, requirements (2023)
content:
All structures or parts of structures used, or intended to be used, for an unarmed
   combat show shall conform to any building codes, safety codes, and local laws that
   apply to the structure or the location and use of the structure.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 229. Boxing and Wrestling›KY REV ST 229.131. Decisions rendered, how; administrative regulations
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 229. Boxing and Wrestling › KY REV ST 229.131. Decisions rendered, how; administrative regulations
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 229.131. Decisions rendered, how; administrative regulations (2023)
content:
Decisions may be rendered in any unarmed combat show permitted by this chapter in
   the discretion of the commission and by any method it prescribes through the promulgation
   of administrative regulations.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 229. Boxing and Wrestling›KY REV ST 229.155. Executive director; duties; interagency agreements
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 229. Boxing and Wrestling › KY REV ST 229.155. Executive director; duties; interagency agreements
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 229.155. Executive director; duties; interagency agreements (2023)
content:
(1)  To carry out the functions relating to the commission's duties and responsibilities
      and to afford the full experience and resources of the Public Protection Cabinet,
      the secretary of the Public Protection Cabinet may appoint an executive director pursuant
      toKRS 12.050.  The secretary of the Public Protection Cabinet or the secretary's designee shall
      act as executive director in the absence of the executive director.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 229. Boxing and Wrestling›KY REV ST 229.151. Kentucky Boxing and Wrestling Commission; membership; officers; compensation; expenses; quorum
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 229. Boxing and Wrestling › KY REV ST 229.151. Kentucky Boxing and Wrestling Commission; membership; officers; compensation; expenses; quorum
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 229.151. Kentucky Boxing and Wrestling Commission; membership; officers; compensation; expenses; quorum (2023)
content:
(1)  The Kentucky Boxing and Wrestling Commission is hereby created and established
      as an agency of state government charged with the responsibility for regulatory oversight
      and the establishment of sound policies and procedures governing the conduct of unarmed
      combat within the Commonwealth of Kentucky.  The commission shall be organized within the Public Protection Cabinet.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 229. Boxing and Wrestling›KY REV ST 229.200. Suspension, reprimand, revocation, probation, or refusal of licenses; grounds; penalties for violation of chapter
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 229. Boxing and Wrestling › KY REV ST 229.200. Suspension, reprimand, revocation, probation, or refusal of licenses; grounds; penalties for violation of chapter
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 229.200. Suspension, reprimand, revocation, probation, or refusal of licenses; grounds; penalties for violation of chapter (2023)
content:
(1)  The commission may suspend, reprimand, revoke, probate, or refuse to renew or
      issue a license if it has reason to believe the licensee or applicant has:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 229. Boxing and Wrestling›KY REV ST 229.190. Appeals; hearings
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 229. Boxing and Wrestling › KY REV ST 229.190. Appeals; hearings

content:

      taken underKRS 229.200may be appealed, and upon appeal an administrative hearing shall be conducted in
      accordance with KRS Chapter 13B.  The commission may provide for hearing officers or impanel not less than three (3)
      of its members to conduct hearings.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 230. Horse Racing and Showing›General Provisions›KY REV ST 230.080. Change of horse's name; determination of class; misrepresentation of performance
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 230. Horse Racing and Showing › General Provisions › KY REV ST 230.080. Change of horse's name; determination of class; misrepresentation of performance
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 230.080. Change of horse's name; determination of class; misrepresentation of performance (2023)
content:
(1)  No person shall change the name of any horse for the purpose of entry for competition
      in any contest of speed, after the horse has once contested for a prize or stake,
      except as provided by the code of rules of the association under which the contest
      is advertised to be conducted.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 229. Boxing and Wrestling›KY REV ST 229.240. Peace officers to prevent unauthorized shows
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 229. Boxing and Wrestling › KY REV ST 229.240. Peace officers to prevent unauthorized shows
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 229.240. Peace officers to prevent unauthorized shows (2023)
content:
All peace officers, who are informed or who have reason to believe that a show in
   violation of this chapter or administrative regulations promulgated in accordance
   with this chapter is taking place or will be taking place within their jurisdiction,
   shall suppress and prevent it.  For this purpose any peace officer may enter any place where a show is being or
   will be held or where there is training or preparation for a wrestling show and may
   arrest without a warrant any person who does not submit satisfactory proof that he
   or she has the license or permit required by this chapter.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 229. Boxing and Wrestling›KY REV ST 229.250. Disbursal of fees and charges collected by Kentucky Boxing and Wrestling Commission
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 229. Boxing and Wrestling › KY REV ST 229.250. Disbursal of fees and charges collected by Kentucky Boxing and Wrestling Commission
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 229.250. Disbursal of fees and charges collected by Kentucky Boxing and Wrestling Commission (2023)
content:
(1)  The fees and charges collected by the Kentucky Boxing and Wrestling Commission
      shall be paid into the State Treasury and credited to a separate revolving or trust
      and agency fund account established for the purpose of administrating this chapter.  The cost and expenses of administering this chapter, including compensation to members
      of the commission, its officers, and employees shall be paid out of the State Treasury
      upon warrants of the secretary of the Finance and Administration Cabinet according
      to law.  The total expense of administering this chapter shall not exceed the fees and other
      charges collected by the commission and available in the revolving or trust and agency
      fund account.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 230. Horse Racing and Showing›General Provisions›KY REV ST 230.070. Entering horse under assumed name or out of proper class prohibited
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 230. Horse Racing and Showing › General Provisions › KY REV ST 230.070. Entering horse under assumed name or out of proper class prohibited
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 230.070. Entering horse under assumed name or out of proper class prohibited (2023)
content:
No person shall knowingly enter or cause to be entered for competition, or compete,
   for a prize or stake, or drive any horse, under an assumed name, or out of its proper
   class, where the prize or stake is to be decided by a contest of speed.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 229. Boxing and Wrestling›KY REV ST 229.260. Kentucky Boxing and Wrestling Commission Medical Advisory Panel; membership; compensation; duties; conduct of meetings
