content: No person who has been granted a permit shall allow:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 231. Places of Entertainment›KY REV ST 231.090. Appeal from decision denying or granting permit
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 231. Places of Entertainment › KY REV ST 231.090. Appeal from decision denying or granting permit
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 231.090. Appeal from decision denying or granting permit (2023)
content:
(1)  From the decision of the county judge/executive refusing to grant the permit,
      the applicant may appeal to the Circuit Court, where the appeal shall be tried as
      an action in equity, and the evidence shall be heard in open court.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 231. Places of Entertainment›KY REV ST 231.060. County clerk to docket and publish application
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 231. Places of Entertainment › KY REV ST 231.060. County clerk to docket and publish application
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 231.060. County clerk to docket and publish application (2023)
content:
When the application is filed with the county clerk he shall have a notice that the
   application has been filed, published pursuant to KRS Chapter 424 in the county.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 231. Places of Entertainment›KY REV ST 231.120. Forfeiture of permit for violation of chapter
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 231. Places of Entertainment › KY REV ST 231.120. Forfeiture of permit for violation of chapter
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 231.120. Forfeiture of permit for violation of chapter (2023)
content:
Upon the conviction of the owner or manager of a place of entertainment for a violation
   of any of the provisions of this chapter:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 231. Places of Entertainment›KY REV ST 231.100. County judge/executive to fix hours of operation
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 231. Places of Entertainment › KY REV ST 231.100. County judge/executive to fix hours of operation
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 231.100. County judge/executive to fix hours of operation (2023)
content:
The county judge/executive shall, by an order entered in his order book, fix reasonable
   hours of operation for places of entertainment throughout the county.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 231. Places of Entertainment›KY REV ST 231.080. Hearing for or against granting of permit
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 231. Places of Entertainment › KY REV ST 231.080. Hearing for or against granting of permit
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 231.080. Hearing for or against granting of permit (2023)
content:
After the expiration of thirty (30) days from the date on which the application is
   filed, the county judge/executive shall hear evidence in support of or in opposition
   to the granting of the permit.  Any person desiring to oppose the permit shall have filed in writing allegations
   that show cause as to why the application should not be granted.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 231. Places of Entertainment›KY REV ST 231.125. Forfeiture for violation of alcoholic beverage control laws
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 231. Places of Entertainment › KY REV ST 231.125. Forfeiture for violation of alcoholic beverage control laws
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 231.125. Forfeiture for violation of alcoholic beverage control laws (2023)
content:
The conviction of the owner or manager of a place of entertainment for violation of
   the alcohol beverage control laws may be an additional ground for revocation and forfeiture
   of the place of entertainment permit by the county judge/executive.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 231. Places of Entertainment›KY REV ST 231.180. Showing “X” or “R” rated movies in certain previews prohibited
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 231. Places of Entertainment › KY REV ST 231.180. Showing “X” or “R” rated movies in certain previews prohibited
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 231.180. Showing “X” or “R” rated movies in certain previews prohibited (2023)
content:
No movie theater, drive-in theater, or other facility requiring a fee for admission
   shall show a “X” or “R” rated movie in their previews if a “G” or “GP” movie is playing.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 232. Nudist Societies›KY REV ST 232.010. Nudist defined
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 232. Nudist Societies › KY REV ST 232.010. Nudist defined
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 232.010. Nudist defined (2023)
content:
As used in this chapter, “nudist” means any person who displays any part of his private person naked before persons
   of the opposite sex, not his husband or wife, at their solicitation or with their
   consent, for religious or health purposes, excepting for purposes of examination and
   treatment by physicians.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 231. Places of Entertainment›KY REV ST 231.990. Penalties
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 231. Places of Entertainment › KY REV ST 231.990. Penalties
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 231.990. Penalties (2023)
content:
(1)  Any person who violatesKRS 231.020shall be fined not more than two hundred dollars ($200) or confined in the county
      jail not more than ninety (90) days, or both.  Each day that a place of entertainment is operated without a permit shall be a separate
      offense.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 231. Places of Entertainment›KY REV ST 231.130. Peace officers to visit
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 231. Places of Entertainment › KY REV ST 231.130. Peace officers to visit
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 231.130. Peace officers to visit (2023)
content:
The sheriff, deputy sheriff and county patrolmen of each county shall visit places
   of entertainment regularly.  Upon their observing any violation of this chapter, by the owner or manager, they
   shall make arrests without warrants for violations committed within their presence.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 232. Nudist Societies›KY REV ST 232.041. Inspection of society; register of members required
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 232. Nudist Societies › KY REV ST 232.041. Inspection of society; register of members required
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 232.041. Inspection of society; register of members required (2023)
content:
Each licensed nudist society shall be subject to such reasonable inspection by the
   sheriff or deputies designated by him as may reasonably be deemed necessary to enforceKRS 232.010to232.041and232.991, and acting in a reasonable manner sheriffs or deputy sheriffs shall have the right
   to go upon the private property and gain access to the buildings or inclosures of
   licensed nudist societies.  The owner, operator, or person in charge of a nudist society shall keep a register
   of names and addresses of members of the society which shall be made available for
   inspection by proper authorities upon order of the county judge/executive.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 232. Nudist Societies›KY REV ST 232.991. Operating society without license, penalty
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 232. Nudist Societies › KY REV ST 232.991. Operating society without license, penalty
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 232.991. Operating society without license, penalty (2023)
content:
Any person who owns or operates a nudist society, whether for religious or health
   purposes, without a valid license from the county judge/executive shall be fined not
   less than five hundred ($500) nor more than one thousand dollars ($1,000), or imprisoned
   in the county jail for not less than ten (10) nor more than thirty (30) days, or both
   fined and imprisoned.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 232. Nudist Societies›KY REV ST 232.021. License required for operation of society; application; fee; expiration; renewal
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 232. Nudist Societies › KY REV ST 232.021. License required for operation of society; application; fee; expiration; renewal
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 232.021. License required for operation of society; application; fee; expiration; renewal (2023)
content:
No person shall own or operate a nudist society unless he first secures a license
   from the county judge/executive in the county in which the nudist society will be
   located.  Any person who desires a license shall file an application with the county clerk
   setting forth the name and address of the owner of the premises upon which the nudist
   society will be located and the name of the operator, the occupation of the owner
   or operator, the reason for forming the society and its purpose, the location of the
   area of the proposed nudist society, and a description of the physical facilities
   and precautions to be taken which will assure privacy of members and concealment and
   reasonable isolation of the nudists from the public.  If the county judge/executive finds that the character of the applicant is good,
   the nudist society is proposed to be conducted for religious or health purposes, the
   facilities appear adequate and the nudist society will be so located or screened or
   housed, and so operated, as to give reasonable assurance that its activities will
   be effectively concealed and its members reasonably isolated from the ordinary view
   and presence of the general public, the county judge/executive shall issue the license
   upon payment of a fee of one hundred dollars ($100).  Each license to operate a nudist society shall expire one (1) year from issuance
   but may be renewed annually upon payment of a renewal fee of fifty dollars ($50).

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 233. Abatement of Houses of Prostitution›KY REV ST 233.010. House of prostitution defined
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 233. Abatement of Houses of Prostitution › KY REV ST 233.010. House of prostitution defined
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 233.010. House of prostitution defined (2023)
content:
As used in this chapter, “house of prostitution” means any building, erection or other place used for the purpose of lewdness, assignation
   or prostitution.  It includes the ground upon which the building stands, and all improvements upon
   that ground.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 232. Nudist Societies›KY REV ST 232.031. Revocation of license; grounds
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 232. Nudist Societies › KY REV ST 232.031. Revocation of license; grounds
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 232.031. Revocation of license; grounds (2023)
content:
A license to operate a nudist society may be revoked by order of the county judge/executive
   at any time, following a hearing upon reasonable notice to the licensee and a finding
   by the county judge/executive that:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 233. Abatement of Houses of Prostitution›KY REV ST 233.070. Witnesses for relator may be granted immunity from prosecution
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 233. Abatement of Houses of Prostitution › KY REV ST 233.070. Witnesses for relator may be granted immunity from prosecution
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 233.070. Witnesses for relator may be granted immunity from prosecution (2023)
content:
The Commonwealth's attorney, county attorney or other attorney representing the relator
   may, with the approval of the court, grant immunity from prosecution to any witness
   who testifies for the relator.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 233. Abatement of Houses of Prostitution›KY REV ST 233.020. House of prostitution a nuisance; to be enjoined and abated
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 233. Abatement of Houses of Prostitution › KY REV ST 233.020. House of prostitution a nuisance; to be enjoined and abated
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 233.020. House of prostitution a nuisance; to be enjoined and abated (2023)
content:
Any person who erects, establishes, continues, maintains, owns, occupies, leases or
   subleases a house of prostitution shall be guilty of a nuisance, and the house of
   prostitution, the furniture, fixtures, musical instruments and all other contents
   of the house of prostitution are declared a nuisance, and shall be enjoined and abated
   as provided by this chapter.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 233. Abatement of Houses of Prostitution›KY REV ST 233.040. Injunction proceedings to be instituted against persons convicted of keeping house of prostitution
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 233. Abatement of Houses of Prostitution › KY REV ST 233.040. Injunction proceedings to be instituted against persons convicted of keeping house of prostitution
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 233.040. Injunction proceedings to be instituted against persons convicted of keeping house of prostitution (2023)
content:
(1)  If any person is convicted in any court of this state of maintaining a house
      of prostitution, the county attorney or prosecuting attorney of the court in which
      the conviction has occurred shall, or any citizen of the state may, institute injunction
      proceedings against that person in a court of equity.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 233. Abatement of Houses of Prostitution›KY REV ST 233.080. Dismissal of action; costs if action groundless
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 233. Abatement of Houses of Prostitution › KY REV ST 233.080. Dismissal of action; costs if action groundless
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 233.080. Dismissal of action; costs if action groundless (2023)
content:
If the complaint is filed by a citizen, it shall be dismissed only upon a sworn statement
   by the relator and his attorney, setting forth the reasons why the action should be
   dismissed.  Dismissal shall be approved by the Commonwealth's or county attorney in writing
   or in open court.  If the court is of the opinion that the action ought not to be dismissed, it may
   direct the Commonwealth's or county attorney to prosecute the action to judgment.  If an action is continued more than one (1) month, any citizen may be substituted
   for the relator and prosecute the action to judgment.  If the action is brought by a citizen, and the court finds there was no reasonable
   ground for the action, the costs may be taxed to that citizen.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 233. Abatement of Houses of Prostitution›KY REV ST 233.030. Commonwealth's or county attorney or citizen may have house of prostitution enjoined
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 233. Abatement of Houses of Prostitution › KY REV ST 233.030. Commonwealth's or county attorney or citizen may have house of prostitution enjoined
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 233.030. Commonwealth's or county attorney or citizen may have house of prostitution enjoined (2023)
content:
The Commonwealth's attorney or county attorney, or any citizen of the county in which
   the house of prostitution is located, may maintain an action in equity in the name
   of the state, upon the relation of the Commonwealth's attorney, county attorney or
   citizen, to perpetually enjoin the house of prostitution, the person conducting or
   maintaining it and the owner or agent of the building or ground upon which it is located.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 233. Abatement of Houses of Prostitution›KY REV ST 233.050. Temporary injunction granted if house of prostitution shown to exist
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 233. Abatement of Houses of Prostitution › KY REV ST 233.050. Temporary injunction granted if house of prostitution shown to exist
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 233.050. Temporary injunction granted if house of prostitution shown to exist (2023)
content:
Upon the presentation of a petition alleging that a house of prostitution exists,
   the court may grant a temporary injunction without bond, if the existence of the house
   of prostitution is made to appear to the satisfaction of the court by evidence in
   the form of affidavit, depositions, oral testimony or otherwise, as the relator may
   elect.  Three (3) days' written notice of the application shall be given the defendant before
   the hearing.  When a temporary injunction has been granted it shall be binding on the defendant
   throughout the state, and any violation of its provisions shall be a contempt.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 233. Abatement of Houses of Prostitution›KY REV ST 233.100. Order of abatement; fixtures to be sold and building closed; sheriff's fees
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 233. Abatement of Houses of Prostitution › KY REV ST 233.100. Order of abatement; fixtures to be sold and building closed; sheriff's fees
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 233.100. Order of abatement; fixtures to be sold and building closed; sheriff's fees (2023)
content:
(1)  If the existence of a house of prostitution is established, an order of abatement
      shall be entered as a part of the judgment.  That order shall direct the removal from the house of prostitution of all fixtures,
      furniture, musical instruments or other movable property used in conducting the house
      of prostitution, the sale of them in the manner provided for the sale of chattels
      under execution, the effectual closing of the premises against their use for any purpose,
      and keeping them closed for a period of one (1) year, unless sooner released.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 233. Abatement of Houses of Prostitution›KY REV ST 233.090. Injunction not to issue if owner tries to prevent nuisance
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 233. Abatement of Houses of Prostitution › KY REV ST 233.090. Injunction not to issue if owner tries to prevent nuisance
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 233.090. Injunction not to issue if owner tries to prevent nuisance (2023)
content:
No injunction shall issue against an owner, nor shall an order be entered requiring
   any premises to close or be kept closed, if the owner and his agent have in good faith
   attempted to prevent those premises from being used as a house of prostitution.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 233. Abatement of Houses of Prostitution›KY REV ST 233.120. Release of premises when cost paid and bond filed; termination of action
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 233. Abatement of Houses of Prostitution › KY REV ST 233.120. Release of premises when cost paid and bond filed; termination of action
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 233.120. Release of premises when cost paid and bond filed; termination of action (2023)
content:
If the owner, agent or lessee of premises against which an injunction has been issued,
   appears in court, pays all costs of the proceeding and files a bond, with surety approved
   by the clerk and qualified as required byKRS 454.185, in the full value of the premises as ascertained by the court, conditioned that
   he will immediately abate the house of prostitution and prevent it from being established
   or kept within a period of one (1) year, the court may, if satisfied of his good faith,
   order the premises released to the owner, agent or lessee and the order of abatement
   canceled so far as it relates to the premises.  If the bond is given and costs are paid before judgment and the order of abatement,
   the action shall be terminated as to those premises.  The release of the premises under this section shall not release it from any other
   judgment, lien or liability, to which it may be subject.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 233. Abatement of Houses of Prostitution›KY REV ST 233.110. Proceeds of sale to pay costs of action; residue to defendant
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 233. Abatement of Houses of Prostitution › KY REV ST 233.110. Proceeds of sale to pay costs of action; residue to defendant
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 233.110. Proceeds of sale to pay costs of action; residue to defendant (2023)
content:
Proceeds of the sale of the personal property, as provided inKRS 233.100, shall be applied in the payment of the costs of the action and abatement, and the
   balance, if any, shall be paid to the defendant.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 233. Abatement of Houses of Prostitution›KY REV ST 233.130. Costs of action a lien on premises; personalty to be sold first
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 233. Abatement of Houses of Prostitution › KY REV ST 233.130. Costs of action a lien on premises; personalty to be sold first
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 233.130. Costs of action a lien on premises; personalty to be sold first (2023)
content:
The costs of an action to abate a house of prostitution shall constitute a lien upon
   the premises and the judgment shall provide for the enforcement of that lien, but
   any personal property seized underKRS 233.100shall be sold first and the proceeds applied to the payment of those costs before
   the realty is sold.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 233. Abatement of Houses of Prostitution›KY REV ST 233.140. Relator's attorney allowed fee
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 233. Abatement of Houses of Prostitution › KY REV ST 233.140. Relator's attorney allowed fee
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 233.140. Relator's attorney allowed fee (2023)
content:
Whenever a permanent injunction issues or when the case has been disposed of underKRS 233.120, the court shall allow to the attorney for the relator a reasonable fee, which shall
   be taxed as a part of the costs of the action.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 233. Abatement of Houses of Prostitution›KY REV ST 233.150. Violation of injunction or order; trial for
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 233. Abatement of Houses of Prostitution › KY REV ST 233.150. Violation of injunction or order; trial for
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 233.150. Violation of injunction or order; trial for (2023)
content:
(1)  In case of a violation of any injunction granted under this chapter, the court
      may summarily try and punish the offender.  The proceedings shall be commenced by filing with the clerk of the court an affidavit,
      setting out the alleged facts constituting the violation, upon which the court shall
      cause an order of arrest to issue.  The trial may be had upon affidavit, but either party may at any stage of the proceedings
      demand the production and oral examination of the witnesses.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids›Safety Provisions›KY REV ST 234.100. Definitions for KRS 234.100. to 234.160. and § 234.990
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids › Safety Provisions › KY REV ST 234.100. Definitions for KRS 234.100. to 234.160. and § 234.990
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 234.100. Definitions for KRS 234.100. to 234.160. and § 234.990 (2023)
content:
(1)  As used inKRS 234.100to234.160and234.990the term “liquefied petroleum gas” means and includes any material which is composed predominantly of any of the following
      hydrocarbons, or mixtures of them, whether in the liquid or in the gaseous states:
      propane, propylene, butane (normal butane or isobutane), and butylene.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids›Safety Provisions›KY REV ST 234.120. License and minimum liability insurance requirements; fees; more than one place of business; proof of financial responsibility; license suspension or revocation
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids › Safety Provisions › KY REV ST 234.120. License and minimum liability insurance requirements; fees; more than one place of business; proof of financial responsibility; license suspension or revocation
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 234.120. License and minimum liability insurance requirements; fees; more than one place of business; proof of financial responsibility; license suspension or revocation (2023)
content:
(1)  Subject to the exceptions provided in subsection (2), no person shall engage
      in any of the businesses set out in this subsection without first having provided
      proof to the commissioner of ability to respond in damages for personal injury and
      property damages in the amount prescribed, and having obtained from the commissioner
      the required license or licenses and paid the prescribed fee therefor:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 233. Abatement of Houses of Prostitution›KY REV ST 233.990. Penalties
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 233. Abatement of Houses of Prostitution › KY REV ST 233.990. Penalties
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 233.990. Penalties (2023)
content:
Any person found guilty of violating an injunction granted under this chapter, or
   of entering or using premises directed to be closed as provided inKRS 233.100, shall be fined not less than two hundred dollars ($200) nor more than one thousand
   dollars ($1,000), or be confined in the county jail not less than three (3) nor more
   than six (6) months, or both.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids›Safety Provisions›KY REV ST 234.160. Deposit and disposition of fees
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids › Safety Provisions › KY REV ST 234.160. Deposit and disposition of fees
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 234.160. Deposit and disposition of fees (2023)
content:
All moneys collected under the provisions ofKRS 234.100to234.160shall be paid into the State Treasury and credited to a trust and agency fund to
   be used by the Department of Housing, Buildings and Construction solely for the administration
   and enforcement ofKRS 234.100to234.160and234.990.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids›Safety Provisions›KY REV ST 234.175. Certification of equipment installation; compliance with administrative regulations and manufacturer's instructions; immunity from liability; exception
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids › Safety Provisions › KY REV ST 234.175. Certification of equipment installation; compliance with administrative regulations and manufacturer's instructions; immunity from liability; exception
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 234.175. Certification of equipment installation; compliance with administrative regulations and manufacturer's instructions; immunity from liability; exception (2023)
content:
(1)  Domestic and commercial gas-consuming equipment and appliances shall not be installed
      unless their correctness as to design, construction, and performance is certified
      by:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids›Safety Provisions›KY REV ST 234.150. Standards of National Fire Protection Association authorized
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids › Safety Provisions › KY REV ST 234.150. Standards of National Fire Protection Association authorized
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 234.150. Standards of National Fire Protection Association authorized (2023)
content:
It is hereby declared that regulations in substantial conformity with the published
   standards of the National Fire Protection Association for the design, installation
   and construction of containers and pertinent equipment for the storage and handling
   of liquefied petroleum gases as recommended by the National Fire Protection Association
   shall be deemed to be in substantial conformity with the general accepted standards
   of safety concerning the same subject matter.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids›Safety Provisions›KY REV ST 234.140. Regulations
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids › Safety Provisions › KY REV ST 234.140. Regulations
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 234.140. Regulations (2023)
content:
(1)  The commissioner, after a public hearing thereon, shall make, promulgate, and
      enforce regulations setting forth minimum general standards covering the design, construction,
      location, installation, and operation of equipment for storing, handling, transporting
      by tank truck, tank trailer, and utilizing liquefied petroleum gases, and specifying
      the odorization of said gases and the degree thereof.  Said regulations shall be such as are reasonably necessary for the protection of
      the health, welfare and safety of the public and persons using such materials, and
      shall be in substantial conformity with the generally accepted standards of safety
      concerning the same subject matter.  Regulations concerning the construction of buildings relating to liquefied petroleum
      gases shall conform to the uniform state building code after said code is promulgated.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids›Safety Provisions›KY REV ST 234.130. Issuance, expiration, and renewal of licenses
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids › Safety Provisions › KY REV ST 234.130. Issuance, expiration, and renewal of licenses
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 234.130. Issuance, expiration, and renewal of licenses (2023)
content:
The initial license required underKRS 234.120shall be issued by the department and shall expire on the last day of the licensee's
   birth month in the next even-numbered year.  The department may reduce the license fee on a pro rata basis for initial licenses
   issued for less than twenty-four (24) months.  Renewed licenses shall expire on the last day of the licensee's birth month of each
   numbered year after the issuance of the renewed license.  Renewal fees shall be the same as the initial license fee.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids›Safety Provisions›KY REV ST 234.171. Advisory board; membership; functions
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids › Safety Provisions › KY REV ST 234.171. Advisory board; membership; functions
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 234.171. Advisory board; membership; functions (2023)
content:
The commissioner of housing, buildings and construction may appoint an advisory board
   composed of persons actively engaged in the liquefied petroleum gas industry in the
   State of Kentucky.  The board shall give the commissioner the benefit of its technical knowledge to
   aid him or her in supervising and regulating the liquefied petroleum gas industry.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids›Safety Provisions›KY REV ST 234.180. Plans for storage plants; submission; approval; contents
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids › Safety Provisions › KY REV ST 234.180. Plans for storage plants; submission; approval; contents
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 234.180. Plans for storage plants; submission; approval; contents (2023)
content:
(1)  For plants storing liquefied petroleum gases, and used for the dispensing of
      liquefied petroleum gases in liquid state into container or containers, for resale,
      plans shall be submitted, in duplicate, to the Department of Housing, Buildings and
      Construction, and shall be approved by the department before construction is started.  Plans so submitted shall show the following information as a minimum:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids›Safety Provisions›KY REV ST 234.190. Use of or work upon liquefied petroleum gas container without consent of owner prohibited; removal or replacement request
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids › Safety Provisions › KY REV ST 234.190. Use of or work upon liquefied petroleum gas container without consent of owner prohibited; removal or replacement request
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 234.190. Use of or work upon liquefied petroleum gas container without consent of owner prohibited; removal or replacement request (2023)
content:
(1)  No person shall sell, install, fill, refill, deliver or permit to be delivered,
      or use in any manner any liquefied petroleum gas container unless the container is
      owned by the person or its use is authorized by its owner.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids›Safety Provisions›KY REV ST 234.220. Label required on container or apparatus from which sale is made
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids › Safety Provisions › KY REV ST 234.220. Label required on container or apparatus from which sale is made
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 234.220. Label required on container or apparatus from which sale is made (2023)
content:
No dealer shall sell or deliver kerosene, coal oil, fuel oil, stove oil, range oil,
   furnace oil or other Class B liquid except from a container having the name of the
   liquid sold plainly marked or labeled on the container, or on the pump or delivery
   equipment serving such container.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids›Safety Provisions›KY REV ST 234.230. Class A liquid to be purged from tank and piping before use with Class B liquid
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids › Safety Provisions › KY REV ST 234.230. Class A liquid to be purged from tank and piping before use with Class B liquid
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 234.230. Class A liquid to be purged from tank and piping before use with Class B liquid (2023)
content:
No compartment of a tank vehicle which has contained a Class A liquid on the prior
   loading shall be loaded with Class B liquid until such compartment and all piping
   and accessory delivery equipment connected thereto have been drained of all Class
   A liquid and then flushed with a quantity of Class B liquid sufficient to clear them
   of any remaining Class A liquid;  or cleared of Class A liquid by some equally effective
   method.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids›Safety Provisions›KY REV ST 234.250. Prohibited use of tanks having common outlet on manifold
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids › Safety Provisions › KY REV ST 234.250. Prohibited use of tanks having common outlet on manifold
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 234.250. Prohibited use of tanks having common outlet on manifold (2023)
content:
In the event that compartments of a tank vehicle are connected to a common outlet
   or manifold, no compartment so connected shall contain Class A liquids while any other
   compartment so connected contains Class B liquids.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids›Safety Provisions›KY REV ST 234.210. Sales of certain liquids prohibited
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids › Safety Provisions › KY REV ST 234.210. Sales of certain liquids prohibited
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 234.210. Sales of certain liquids prohibited (2023)
content:
No person shall have for sale, sell, give or deliver to another any product known,
   advertised, sold or offered for sale as kerosene, coal oil, fuel oil, stove oil, range
   oil, furnace oil, distillate or diesel fuel, or by a trade name commonly identified
   with any such product, unless the product constitutes a Class B liquid.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids›Safety Provisions›KY REV ST 234.200. Definitions for KRS 234.200. to § 234.260
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids › Safety Provisions › KY REV ST 234.200. Definitions for KRS 234.200. to § 234.260
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 234.200. Definitions for KRS 234.200. to § 234.260 (2023)
content: As used inKRS 234.200to234.260, unless the context requires otherwise:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids›Propane Gas Industry›KY REV ST 234.282. Association authorized to hold referendum
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids › Propane Gas Industry › KY REV ST 234.282. Association authorized to hold referendum
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 234.282. Association authorized to hold referendum (2023)
content:
Upon being certified by the commissioner, the association inKRS 234.280(1)shall be fully authorized and empowered to hold a referendum among producers, suppliers,
   and retail marketers on the question of whether the industry shall levy upon itself
   an assessment for the purpose stated inKRS 234.270to234.302.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids›Safety Provisions›KY REV ST 234.240. Class A liquid to be purged from pumps, meters and hoses before use with Class B liquid
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids › Safety Provisions › KY REV ST 234.240. Class A liquid to be purged from pumps, meters and hoses before use with Class B liquid
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 234.240. Class A liquid to be purged from pumps, meters and hoses before use with Class B liquid (2023)
content:
In the event that a tank vehicle is equipped with a pump, meter, and hose, or any
   combination thereof, such equipment shall not be used for the delivery of Class B
   liquid if its prior use has been for Class A liquid, unless it has first been flushed
   with a quantity of Class B liquid sufficient to effectively clear it of all Class
   A liquid;  or cleared of Class A liquid by some equally effective method.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids›Propane Gas Industry›KY REV ST 234.274. Authority for administrative regulations
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids › Propane Gas Industry › KY REV ST 234.274. Authority for administrative regulations
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 234.274. Authority for administrative regulations (2023)
content:
The commissioner may promulgate administrative regulations in accordance with KRS
   Chapter 13A to implement the provisions ofKRS 234.270to234.302.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids›Propane Gas Industry›KY REV ST 234.270. Declaration of public policy
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids › Propane Gas Industry › KY REV ST 234.270. Declaration of public policy
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 234.270. Declaration of public policy (2023)
content:
It is declared to be in the interest of the public welfare that persons involved in
   the production, transportation, and sale of propane and the manufacture and distribution
   of propane utilization equipment shall be permitted and encouraged to act jointly
   and in cooperation to develop programs to enhance consumer and employee safety, to
   provide research and development, and to inform and educate the public about safety
   and other issues associated with the use of propane.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids›Propane Gas Industry›KY REV ST 234.272. Definitions for KRS 234.270. to § 234.302
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids › Propane Gas Industry › KY REV ST 234.272. Definitions for KRS 234.270. to § 234.302
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 234.272. Definitions for KRS 234.270. to § 234.302 (2023)
content: As used inKRS 234.270to234.302, unless the context otherwise requires:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids›Safety Provisions›KY REV ST 234.260. When separate delivery equipment required for Class A and Class B liquids
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids › Safety Provisions › KY REV ST 234.260. When separate delivery equipment required for Class A and Class B liquids
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 234.260. When separate delivery equipment required for Class A and Class B liquids (2023)
content:
No manifold, pump, meter, or hose shall be used for the delivery of Class A and Class
   B liquids on the same trip.  Flushing, as provided inKRS 234.240, shall not be done during the course of deliveries.  If the use of a manifold, pump, meter, or hose is required for the delivery of Class
   A and Class B liquids on the same trip, then separate delivery equipment shall be
   provided.  Such equipment shall be tagged or painted to clearly indicate the class of liquid
   for which it is used.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids›Propane Gas Industry›KY REV ST 234.280. Application to conduct referendum; content of application form; publication of form
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids › Propane Gas Industry › KY REV ST 234.280. Application to conduct referendum; content of application form; publication of form
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 234.280. Application to conduct referendum; content of application form; publication of form (2023)
content:
(1)  Any existing industry trade organization which is fairly representative of the
      propane industry in Kentucky, such as the Kentucky Propane Gas Association, may at
      any time after July 15, 1998, make application to the commissioner on forms prescribed
      by the department for certification and approval for the purpose of conducting a referendum
      among producers, suppliers, and retail marketers upon the question of levying an assessment
      under the provisions ofKRS 234.270to234.302and collecting and utilizing the assessment for the purpose stated in the referendum.  The application forms shall include, but not be limited to, the following:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids›Propane Gas Industry›KY REV ST 234.278. Referendum to permit assessment; purpose of assessments
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids › Propane Gas Industry › KY REV ST 234.278. Referendum to permit assessment; purpose of assessments
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 234.278. Referendum to permit assessment; purpose of assessments (2023)
content:
Producers, suppliers, and retail marketers of propane shall be permitted by referendum,
   subject to the provisions ofKRS 234.270to234.302, to levy upon themselves an assessment on odorized propane and provide for the collection
   of the assessment for the purpose of financing or contributing toward the financing
   of a program of research, market development, and education to increase the consumption,
   use, sale, and markets for propane and toward the financing of programs to enhance
   consumer and employee education and safety.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids›Propane Gas Industry›KY REV ST 234.284. Referendum to be statewide; basing voting rights; question for voters
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids › Propane Gas Industry › KY REV ST 234.284. Referendum to be statewide; basing voting rights; question for voters
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 234.284. Referendum to be statewide; basing voting rights; question for voters (2023)
content:
Any referendum conducted under the provisions ofKRS 234.270to234.302shall be held on a statewide basis.  Voting rights in the referendum shall be based on the volume of propane produced
   or odorized propane sold in the Commonwealth in the previous calendar year and shall
   be proportional to the gallons sold.  In the referendum, persons eligible for participation shall vote upon the question
   of whether there shall be levied an annual assessment in the amount set forth in the
   call for the referendum.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids›Propane Gas Industry›KY REV ST 234.286. Commissioner to supervise referendum; expenses; conducting referendum; voter to certify volume of propane represented by vote; mechanism for notification of eligible voters
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids › Propane Gas Industry › KY REV ST 234.286. Commissioner to supervise referendum; expenses; conducting referendum; voter to certify volume of propane represented by vote; mechanism for notification of eligible voters
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 234.286. Commissioner to supervise referendum; expenses; conducting referendum; voter to certify volume of propane represented by vote; mechanism for notification of eligible voters (2023)
content:
(1)  The manner, conduct, and management of any referendum held under the provisions
      ofKRS 234.270to234.302shall be under the supervision and direction of the commissioner.  Any and all expenses in connection with the initial referendum shall be borne by
      the association conducting the referendum.  Any and all expenses in connection with subsequent referenda shall be borne by the
      council.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids›Propane Gas Industry›KY REV ST 234.276. Association meeting or activity not considered illegal or in restraint of trade
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids › Propane Gas Industry › KY REV ST 234.276. Association meeting or activity not considered illegal or in restraint of trade
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 234.276. Association meeting or activity not considered illegal or in restraint of trade (2023)
content:
No association meeting or activity undertaken to carry out the provisions ofKRS 234.270to234.302and intended to benefit all persons involved in the production, transportation, and
   sale of propane and the manufacture and distribution of propane utilization equipment
   shall be deemed or considered illegal or in restraint of trade.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids›Propane Gas Industry›KY REV ST 234.288. Referendum results; issuance of order; initial and annual assessments
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids › Propane Gas Industry › KY REV ST 234.288. Referendum results; issuance of order; initial and annual assessments
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 234.288. Referendum results; issuance of order; initial and annual assessments (2023)
content:
(1)  The results of the referendum, as certified by the independent auditing firm,
      shall be submitted to the commissioner within thirty (30) days of certification.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids›Propane Gas Industry›KY REV ST 234.290. Kentucky Propane Education and Research Council; appointment of members; terms and compensation
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids › Propane Gas Industry › KY REV ST 234.290. Kentucky Propane Education and Research Council; appointment of members; terms and compensation
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 234.290. Kentucky Propane Education and Research Council; appointment of members; terms and compensation (2023)
content:
(1)  There is hereby established the Kentucky Propane Education and Research Council
      composed of eleven (11) members appointed by the commissioner.  Five (5) members shall represent retail marketers, five (5) members shall represent
      producers and suppliers, and one (1) member shall be the public member as defined
      inKRS 234.272.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids›Propane Gas Industry›KY REV ST 234.292. Annual assessment; requirements of council
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids › Propane Gas Industry › KY REV ST 234.292. Annual assessment; requirements of council
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 234.292. Annual assessment; requirements of council (2023)
content:
(1)  The council shall establish the annual assessment subject to the limitations
      ofKRS 234.288(3)to be paid by the owner of odorized propane at the time of odorization or at the
      time of import of odorized propane into the state.  The assessment shall be made based on the volume of odorized propane sold for final
      use within the Commonwealth.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids›Propane Gas Industry›KY REV ST 234.296. Request for refund of assessment; requirements
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids › Propane Gas Industry › KY REV ST 234.296. Request for refund of assessment; requirements
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 234.296. Request for refund of assessment; requirements (2023)
content:
If the referendum is carried in the affirmative and the assessment is levied and collected
   as provided, any person upon and against whom the assessment shall have been levied
   and collected under the provisions ofKRS 234.270to234.302, if dissatisfied with the assessment and the result thereof, may demand of and shall
   receive from the council a refund of the assessment collected, if the demand for refund
   is made in writing within thirty (30) days from the date on which the assessment is
   collected.  Each refund request shall be accompanied by written proof of the assessment charged.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids›Propane Gas Industry›KY REV ST 234.298. Petition for termination of council and assessment program by referendum vote; timing of referendum; termination proceedings
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids › Propane Gas Industry › KY REV ST 234.298. Petition for termination of council and assessment program by referendum vote; timing of referendum; termination proceedings
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 234.298. Petition for termination of council and assessment program by referendum vote; timing of referendum; termination proceedings (2023)
content:
(1)  Upon petition to the commissioner by producers, suppliers, and retail marketers
      representing thirty-five percent (35%) of the volume of propane in each class, the
      council shall conduct a referendum to determine if the industry favors termination
      of the council and the assessment.  Termination shall not take effect unless it is approved by persons representing
      a majority of the total volume of odorized propane voted in the retail marketer class
      and by persons representing a majority of the total volume of propane voted in the
      producer and supplier class.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids›Propane Gas Industry›KY REV ST 234.294. Funds; use; disbursement
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids › Propane Gas Industry › KY REV ST 234.294. Funds; use; disbursement
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 234.294. Funds; use; disbursement (2023)
content:
The funds, including donations from individuals, associations, concerns, corporations,
   and grants from state or federal governmental agencies, shall be used for the purpose
   of promoting and stimulating, by research, market development, and education, the
   increased use and sale of propane and increased consumer and employee safety.  None of these funds shall be used to lobby as defined inKRS 6.611.  The council shall use and disburse the funds as follows:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids›Propane Gas Industry›KY REV ST 234.300. Propane pricing
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids › Propane Gas Industry › KY REV ST 234.300. Propane pricing
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 234.300. Propane pricing (2023)
content:
In all cases, the price of propane shall be determined by market forces.  Consistent with the antitrust laws, the council may take no action and no provision
   ofKRS 234.270to234.302may be interpreted as establishing an agreement to pass along to consumers the cost
   of the assessments provided for inKRS 234.270to234.302.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids›Tax on Liquefied Petroleum Gas Used as Motor Fuel›KY REV ST 234.321. Collection of excise tax on liquefied petroleum gas; exemptions
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids › Tax on Liquefied Petroleum Gas Used as Motor Fuel › KY REV ST 234.321. Collection of excise tax on liquefied petroleum gas; exemptions
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 234.321. Collection of excise tax on liquefied petroleum gas; exemptions (2023)
content:
(1)  The tax imposed byKRS 234.320shall not be collected when the liquefied petroleum gas sold by the dealer is used
      to propel motor vehicles on the public highways, either within or without this state,
      when the motor vehicles using the liquefied petroleum gas are equipped with carburetion
      systems approved by the Energy and Environment Cabinet or a fuel system that meets
      federal vehicle safety standards contained in49 C.F.R. pt. 571.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids›Tax on Liquefied Petroleum Gas Used as Motor Fuel›KY REV ST 234.330. Dealer's license requirement
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids › Tax on Liquefied Petroleum Gas Used as Motor Fuel › KY REV ST 234.330. Dealer's license requirement
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 234.330. Dealer's license requirement (2023)
content: (1)  A license shall be required of each liquefied petroleum gas motor fuel dealer.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids›Propane Gas Industry›KY REV ST 234.302. Violations; restraining order and preliminary injunction
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids › Propane Gas Industry › KY REV ST 234.302. Violations; restraining order and preliminary injunction
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 234.302. Violations; restraining order and preliminary injunction (2023)
content:
When in the judgment of the council or an association certified underKRS 234.280, a person has engaged in or is about to engage in any acts or practices that constitute
   a violation of any of the provisions ofKRS 234.270to234.302, the council or the certified association may make application to the Franklin Circuit
   Court for an order enjoining the act or acts or practices, and obtain a restraining
   order and preliminary injunction against the person.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids›Tax on Liquefied Petroleum Gas Used as Motor Fuel›KY REV ST 234.320. Imposition of excise tax
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids › Tax on Liquefied Petroleum Gas Used as Motor Fuel › KY REV ST 234.320. Imposition of excise tax
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 234.320. Imposition of excise tax (2023)
content:
(1)  An excise tax at the rate levied inKRS 138.220(1)and(2)is hereby levied and shall be paid by the liquefied petroleum gas motor fuel dealer
      to the department on all taxable liquefied petroleum gas motor fuel delivered to the
      licensed liquefied petroleum gas motor fuel user-seller or withdrawn by the liquefied
      petroleum gas motor fuel dealer to propel motor vehicles on the public highways, either
      within or without this state.  An allowance of one percent (1%) of the tax shall be made to the liquefied petroleum
      gas motor fuel dealer to cover unaccountable losses, bad debts, and handling and reporting
      the tax.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids›Tax on Liquefied Petroleum Gas Used as Motor Fuel›KY REV ST 234.310. Definitions for KRS 234.310. to § 234.440
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids › Tax on Liquefied Petroleum Gas Used as Motor Fuel › KY REV ST 234.310. Definitions for KRS 234.310. to § 234.440
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 234.310. Definitions for KRS 234.310. to § 234.440 (2023)
content: As used inKRS 234.310to234.440, unless the context requires otherwise:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids›Tax on Liquefied Petroleum Gas Used as Motor Fuel›KY REV ST 234.370. Dealer's monthly return
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids › Tax on Liquefied Petroleum Gas Used as Motor Fuel › KY REV ST 234.370. Dealer's monthly return
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 234.370. Dealer's monthly return (2023)
content:
(1)  Every liquefied petroleum motor fuel dealer licensee shall file with the department,
      on forms prescribed by the department, a monthly tax return.  The return shall be made under penalty of perjury and shall show such information
      as the department may require.  The licensee shall file the return on or before the twenty-fifth day of the next
      succeeding calendar month following the month to which it relates.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids›Tax on Liquefied Petroleum Gas Used as Motor Fuel›KY REV ST 234.350. Surrender or cancellation of license
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids › Tax on Liquefied Petroleum Gas Used as Motor Fuel › KY REV ST 234.350. Surrender or cancellation of license
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 234.350. Surrender or cancellation of license (2023)
content:
(1)  If a licensee at any time files a false monthly report of the information required,
      or fails or refuses to file the monthly report or to pay the full amount of the tax
      or violates any other provision ofKRS 234.310to234.440, without a showing that the failure was due to reasonable cause, the department may
      cancel the license and suspend the privilege of acting as a liquefied petroleum gas
      motor fuel dealer.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids›Tax on Liquefied Petroleum Gas Used as Motor Fuel›KY REV ST 234.340. Dealer's bond
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids › Tax on Liquefied Petroleum Gas Used as Motor Fuel › KY REV ST 234.340. Dealer's bond
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 234.340. Dealer's bond (2023)
content:
(1)  Every liquefied petroleum gas motor fuel dealer shall file with the department
      a corporate bond, cash bond, or securities approved by the department in a minimum
      amount of five hundred dollars ($500) and in a maximum amount of four (4) months'
      liability for taxes imposed underKRS 234.310to234.440but not to exceed fifty thousand dollars ($50,000).  If, however, a liquefied petroleum gas motor fuel dealer is bonded as provided inKRS 138.330the department may waive the bonding requirement in this section provided a rider
      is attached to the bond to guarantee payment of all liquefied petroleum gas motor
      fuel taxes together with all penalties and interest thereon and secure faithful compliance
      with the provisions ofKRS 234.310to234.440.  The applicant for a license shall be the principal obligor and this state shall
      be the obligee.  The bond shall be conditioned upon the prompt filing of true reports and the payment
      by the licensee to the department of all taxes levied underKRS 234.310to234.440, together with all penalties and interest thereon and generally upon faithful compliance
      with the provisions ofKRS 234.310to234.440.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids›Tax on Liquefied Petroleum Gas Used as Motor Fuel›KY REV ST 234.390. Use by user-seller in own vehicles
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids › Tax on Liquefied Petroleum Gas Used as Motor Fuel › KY REV ST 234.390. Use by user-seller in own vehicles
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 234.390. Use by user-seller in own vehicles (2023)
content:
Any holder of a liquefied petroleum gas motor fuel user-seller license, using liquefied
   petroleum gas as a motor fuel to propel motor vehicles upon the highways may fuel
   his own vehicles from storage where nontaxable liquefied petroleum gas is stored provided:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids›Tax on Liquefied Petroleum Gas Used as Motor Fuel›KY REV ST 234.360. Records that are required to be kept
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids › Tax on Liquefied Petroleum Gas Used as Motor Fuel › KY REV ST 234.360. Records that are required to be kept
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 234.360. Records that are required to be kept (2023)
content:
(1)  Every liquefied petroleum gas motor fuel dealer licensee shall maintain complete
      records of inventories, purchases, sales, use and other dispositions of liquefied
      petroleum gas.  Such records, together with manifests of lading, invoices, correspondence, and other
      papers pertaining to liquefied petroleum gas motor fuel shall be retained for a minimum
      of two (2) years, and if requested by the department, shall be made available for
      examination by the department.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids›Tax on Liquefied Petroleum Gas Used as Motor Fuel›KY REV ST 234.380. Computation of tax
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids › Tax on Liquefied Petroleum Gas Used as Motor Fuel › KY REV ST 234.380. Computation of tax
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 234.380. Computation of tax (2023)
content:
Liquefied petroleum gas motor fuel dealers using, selling, and/or delivering liquefied
   petroleum gas to motor vehicles, or into storage for use in motor vehicles, shall
   report and pay the state tax at the rate levied inKRS 138.220(1)and(2)on all such fuel to the Department of Revenue.  The dealer shall issue an invoice to the customer whenever the sale or delivery
   is consummated giving the invoice date, name and address of the customer, and number
   of taxable gallons sold or delivered.  The number of taxable gallons to be invoiced shall be determined in the following
   manner by the dealer:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids›Tax on Liquefied Petroleum Gas Used as Motor Fuel›KY REV ST 234.400. Department's power to audit licensee's books
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids › Tax on Liquefied Petroleum Gas Used as Motor Fuel › KY REV ST 234.400. Department's power to audit licensee's books
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 234.400. Department's power to audit licensee's books (2023)
content:
The department may audit the books and records of each licensee and make such other
   investigations as it deems necessary to determine whether or not the tax and other
   requirements imposed byKRS 234.310to234.440have been met.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids›Tax on Liquefied Petroleum Gas Used as Motor Fuel›KY REV ST 234.420. Civil penalties for violation of KRS § 234.370
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids › Tax on Liquefied Petroleum Gas Used as Motor Fuel › KY REV ST 234.420. Civil penalties for violation of KRS § 234.370
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 234.420. Civil penalties for violation of KRS § 234.370 (2023)
content: Any person who violates any provision ofKRS 234.370shall be subject to the uniform civil penalties imposed pursuant toKRS 131.180and interest at the tax interest rate as defined inKRS 131.010(6)shall be paid as a part of the tax.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids›Tax on Liquefied Petroleum Gas Used as Motor Fuel›KY REV ST 234.430. Prohibited actions
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids › Tax on Liquefied Petroleum Gas Used as Motor Fuel › KY REV ST 234.430. Prohibited actions
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 234.430. Prohibited actions (2023)
content: With respect toKRS 234.310to234.440, it is unlawful for any person to:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids›Tax on Liquefied Petroleum Gas Used as Motor Fuel›KY REV ST 234.410. Form of tax payment
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids › Tax on Liquefied Petroleum Gas Used as Motor Fuel › KY REV ST 234.410. Form of tax payment
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 234.410. Form of tax payment (2023)
content:
The reports required byKRS 234.370shall be accompanied by a certified or cashier's check payable to the State Treasurer,
   for the amount of tax due for the preceding calendar month computed as provided inKRS 234.380, except that the department may waive this requirement and accept the check of the
   licensee if he is of sound financial condition and has established a good record of
   compliance with the requirements ofKRS 234. 310 to 234.440.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids›Tax on Liquefied Petroleum Gas Used as Motor Fuel›KY REV ST 234.440. Administration of KRS 234.310. to 234.430. and this section
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids › Tax on Liquefied Petroleum Gas Used as Motor Fuel › KY REV ST 234.440. Administration of KRS 234.310. to 234.430. and this section
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 234.440. Administration of KRS 234.310. to 234.430. and this section (2023)
content:
(1)  The department shall administer the taxes provided inKRS 234.310to234.430and this section and may prescribe, adopt and enforce regulations relating to the
      administration and enforcement thereof.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 235. Boats and Boating›KY REV ST 235.050. Application for title and registration; accompanying documents
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 235. Boats and Boating › KY REV ST 235.050. Application for title and registration; accompanying documents
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 235.050. Application for title and registration; accompanying documents (2023)
content:
(1)  Except as otherwise provided in this chapter, before the owner or operator of
      each motorboat required to be registered and numbered byKRS 235.040may operate it or permit its operation upon the waters of this state, the owner shall
      apply for title and registration to the county clerk of the county in which he resides,
      except, if the motorboat is to be operated principally in a county other than the
      county of the owner's residence the owner may apply for title and registration to
      the county clerk of the county in which the motorboat is to be principally operated.  A motorboat last titled and registered in another state and purchased by a person
      for operation in this state shall be first titled and registered in this state by
      and in the name of the purchaser and not in the name of the seller.  The application for title and registration shall be accompanied by:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 235. Boats and Boating›KY REV ST 235.030. Title and administration of chapter
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 235. Boats and Boating › KY REV ST 235.030. Title and administration of chapter
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 235.030. Title and administration of chapter (2023)
content:
This chapter shall be known as the State Boating Act and shall be administered by
   the Department of Fish and Wildlife Resources, which is administratively attached
   to the Tourism, Arts and Heritage Cabinet only for those limited functions and purposes
   expressly requested by the department to be performed by the Tourism, Arts and Heritage
   Cabinet.  The department shall have sole discretion as to which functions shall be deemed
   necessary for the efficient operation of the department and the properties in its
   custody and control. The Transportation Cabinet shall be responsible for administering the boat numbering,
   registration, and titling requirements.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 235. Boats and Boating›KY REV ST 235.040. Requirement that motorboats be registered and numbered
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 235. Boats and Boating › KY REV ST 235.040. Requirement that motorboats be registered and numbered
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 235.040. Requirement that motorboats be registered and numbered (2023)
content:
Every motorboat on the waters of this state shall be numbered and currently registered
   in accordance with the provisions of this chapter.  No person shall operate or give permission for the operation of any motorboat on
   such waters unless the motorboat is registered and numbered in accordance with this
   chapter, or in accordance with a federally approved numbering system of another state,
   and unless:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 235. Boats and Boating›KY REV ST 235.010. Definitions for chapter
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 235. Boats and Boating › KY REV ST 235.010. Definitions for chapter
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 235.010. Definitions for chapter (2023)
content: As used in this chapter, unless the context clearly requires a different meaning:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids›Penalties›KY REV ST 234.990. Penalties
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 234. Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Other Flammable Liquids › Penalties › KY REV ST 234.990. Penalties
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 234.990. Penalties (2023)
content: (1)  Any person who violates any of the provisions ofKRS 234.100to234.160shall be guilty of a violation.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals›Chapter 235. Boats and Boating›KY REV ST 235.060. Issuance of licenses by county clerk and by department
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XIX. Public Safety and Morals › Chapter 235. Boats and Boating › KY REV ST 235.060. Issuance of licenses by county clerk and by department
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 235.060. Issuance of licenses by county clerk and by department (2023)
content:
All original, renewal and duplicate licenses for the operation of motorboats shall
   be issued by the county clerk in the county in which the motorboat is registered,
