content: For the purposes of administeringKRS 241.066and241.067:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages›Chapter 241. Alcoholic Beverages; Administration and Control›KY REV ST 241.080. Powers of distilled spirits administrator and malt beverages administrator as to issuance of licenses
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages › Chapter 241. Alcoholic Beverages; Administration and Control › KY REV ST 241.080. Powers of distilled spirits administrator and malt beverages administrator as to issuance of licenses
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 241.080. Powers of distilled spirits administrator and malt beverages administrator as to issuance of licenses (2023)
content:
The distilled spirits administrator may approve and issue or deny any state license
   authorizing traffic in distilled spirits and wine.  The malt beverages administrator may approve and issue or deny any state license
   authorizing traffic in malt beverages.  Both the distilled spirits administrator and the malt beverages administrator may
   approve and issue or deny state licenses authorizing the traffic in alcoholic beverages.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages›Chapter 241. Alcoholic Beverages; Administration and Control›KY REV ST 241.230. Appointment and duties of administrator, investigators, and clerks; constitutional oath
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages › Chapter 241. Alcoholic Beverages; Administration and Control › KY REV ST 241.230. Appointment and duties of administrator, investigators, and clerks; constitutional oath
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 241.230. Appointment and duties of administrator, investigators, and clerks; constitutional oath (2023)
content:
(1)  The urban-county administrator in each urban-county government and any investigators
      and clerks deemed necessary for the proper conduct of the office, shall be appointed
      by the mayor.  The urban-county administrator, and the urban-county administrator's investigators,
      shall have full police powers of peace officers, and their jurisdiction shall be coextensive
      with the urban-county governments.  They may inspect any premises where alcoholic beverages are manufactured, sold,
      stored, or otherwise trafficked in, without first obtaining a search warrant.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages›Chapter 241. Alcoholic Beverages; Administration and Control›KY REV ST 241.140. Functions of county administrator; jurisdiction
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages › Chapter 241. Alcoholic Beverages; Administration and Control › KY REV ST 241.140. Functions of county administrator; jurisdiction
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 241.140. Functions of county administrator; jurisdiction (2023)
content:
Each county administrator shall have the same duties and functions regarding local
   license applications and renewals as the department with respect to state licenses.  Each county administrator shall have the same duties and functions regarding local
   license penalization as the board with respect to state license penalization.  If any city appoints its own administrator underKRS 241.160, the county administrator in that county shall have jurisdiction over only that portion
   of the county which lies outside the corporate limits of that city, unless the city
   does not have an adequate police force.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages›Chapter 241. Alcoholic Beverages; Administration and Control›KY REV ST 241.160. Wet or moist cities with population of 3,000. or more and consolidated local governments required to have city administrators; city administrators permitted in smaller cities
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages › Chapter 241. Alcoholic Beverages; Administration and Control › KY REV ST 241.160. Wet or moist cities with population of 3,000. or more and consolidated local governments required to have city administrators; city administrators permitted in smaller cities
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 241.160. Wet or moist cities with population of 3,000. or more and consolidated local governments required to have city administrators; city administrators permitted in smaller cities (2023)
content:
(1)  The legislative body of any wet or moist city with a population equal to or greater
      than three thousand (3,000) or a consolidated local government shall by ordinance
      create the office of city alcoholic beverage control administrator, or shall assign
      the duties of this office to a presently established city office.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages›Chapter 241. Alcoholic Beverages; Administration and Control›KY REV ST 241.190. Functions of city administrator
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages › Chapter 241. Alcoholic Beverages; Administration and Control › KY REV ST 241.190. Functions of city administrator
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 241.190. Functions of city administrator (2023)
content:
Each city administrator shall have the same duties and functions regarding local license
   applications and renewals as the department with respect to state licenses.  Each city administrator shall have the same duties and functions regarding local
   license penalization as the board with respect to state license penalization.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages›Chapter 241. Alcoholic Beverages; Administration and Control›KY REV ST 241.110. County judge/executive as county administrator; appointment of person other than county judge/executive; investigators and clerks; powers and jurisdiction; constitutional oath
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages › Chapter 241. Alcoholic Beverages; Administration and Control › KY REV ST 241.110. County judge/executive as county administrator; appointment of person other than county judge/executive; investigators and clerks; powers and jurisdiction; constitutional oath
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 241.110. County judge/executive as county administrator; appointment of person other than county judge/executive; investigators and clerks; powers and jurisdiction; constitutional oath (2023)
content:
(1)  The fiscal court of any county in which traffic in alcoholic beverages is not
      forbidden under KRS Chapter 242 may by resolution declare that regulation of the traffic
      in that county is necessary.  The county judge/executive shall immediately constitute a county alcoholic beverage
      control administrator for the county.  However, the county judge/executive may decline to accept this office, or after
      accepting the office, the county judge/executive may resign from the office, and in
      either event, notwithstanding the provisions ofKRS 241.120to and includingKRS 241.150, the county judge/executive may promptly appoint a person at least thirty (30) years
      of age, who at the time of the appointment has been a citizen of the state and a resident
      of that county for at least two (2) years next preceding the date of appointment,
      and who is able to qualify to serve at the pleasure of the county judge/executive
      as county alcoholic beverage control administrator for that county.  Before entering upon the duties of county alcoholic beverage control administrator
      appointed by the county judge/executive, the appointee shall take the oath prescribed
      bySection 228 of the Constitution.  Upon the qualification and appointment of this person as county alcoholic beverage
      control administrator for the county, the person shall immediately notify the department.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages›Chapter 241. Alcoholic Beverages; Administration and Control›KY REV ST 241.170. Appointment of city administrator and employees in cities of first class or consolidated local government; police powers; right to inspect premises; appointment in other cities; qualifications of city administrators and employees; administrator to take Constitutional oath
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages › Chapter 241. Alcoholic Beverages; Administration and Control › KY REV ST 241.170. Appointment of city administrator and employees in cities of first class or consolidated local government; police powers; right to inspect premises; appointment in other cities; qualifications of city administrators and employees; administrator to take Constitutional oath
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 241.170. Appointment of city administrator and employees in cities of first class or consolidated local government; police powers; right to inspect premises; appointment in other cities; qualifications of city administrators and employees; administrator to take Constitutional oath (2023)
content:
(1)  The city administrator in each city of the first class or the administrator in
      a consolidated local government, and any investigators and clerks deemed necessary
      for the proper conduct of this office, shall be appointed by the mayor.  The city administrator in each city of the first class or the administrator in a
      county containing a consolidated local government, and the administrator's investigators,
      shall have full police powers of peace officers, and their jurisdiction shall be coextensive
      with boundaries of the city of the first class or the boundaries of the county in
      a county containing a consolidated local government.  They may inspect any premises where alcoholic beverages are manufactured, sold,
      stored, or otherwise trafficked in, without first obtaining a search warrant.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages›Chapter 241. Alcoholic Beverages; Administration and Control›KY REV ST 241.090. Police powers of administrators and investigators
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages › Chapter 241. Alcoholic Beverages; Administration and Control › KY REV ST 241.090. Police powers of administrators and investigators
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 241.090. Police powers of administrators and investigators (2023)
content:
State administrators and all investigators shall have the full police powers of peace
   officers, and their jurisdiction shall be coextensive with the state.  They may inspect any premises where alcoholic beverages are manufactured, sold,
   stored, or otherwise trafficked in, without first obtaining a search warrant.  They may confiscate any contraband property. The jurisdiction and police powers of state administrators and all investigators during
   an emergency declared under KRS Chapter 39A shall be subject to the limitations ofKRS 39A.090.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages›Chapter 241. Alcoholic Beverages; Administration and Control›KY REV ST 241.120. Disqualification of county judge/executive; how vacancy filled; appointee
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages › Chapter 241. Alcoholic Beverages; Administration and Control › KY REV ST 241.120. Disqualification of county judge/executive; how vacancy filled; appointee
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 241.120. Disqualification of county judge/executive; how vacancy filled; appointee (2023)
content:
(1)  The county judge/executive shall be disqualified to act as county administrator
      by any fact that would disqualify a person underKRS 241.100from acting as a member of the board.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages›Chapter 241. Alcoholic Beverages; Administration and Control›KY REV ST 241.150. Appeals from decision or order of county administrator to board
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages › Chapter 241. Alcoholic Beverages; Administration and Control › KY REV ST 241.150. Appeals from decision or order of county administrator to board
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 241.150. Appeals from decision or order of county administrator to board (2023)
content:
Appeals from a decision or order of a county administrator may be taken to the board
   by filing a notice of appeal with the board within thirty (30) days after the decision
   or order of the county administrator is mailed or delivered by personal service.  The notice of appeal shall specify the county administrator by name and shall identify
   the decision or order, or part of the decision or order, being appealed.  The notice shall contain a certificate that a copy of the notice has been served
   on the county administrator and shall be accompanied by a copy of the decision or
   order being appealed.  Matters at issue shall be heard by the board as upon an original proceeding.  Appeals from decisions or orders of the county administrator shall be governed by
   KRS Chapter 13B.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages›Chapter 241. Alcoholic Beverages; Administration and Control›KY REV ST 241.200. Appeals from decisions or orders of city administrator
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages › Chapter 241. Alcoholic Beverages; Administration and Control › KY REV ST 241.200. Appeals from decisions or orders of city administrator
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 241.200. Appeals from decisions or orders of city administrator (2023)
content:
Appeals from a decision or order of each city administrator may be taken to the board
   by filing a notice of appeal with the board within thirty (30) days after the decision
   or order of the city administrator is mailed or delivered by personal service.  The notice of appeal shall specify the city administrator by name and shall identify
   the decision or order, or part of the decision or order, being appealed.  The notice shall contain a certificate that a copy of the notice has been served
   on the city administrator and shall be accompanied by a copy of the decision or order
   being appealed.  Matters at issue shall be heard by the board as upon an original proceeding.  Appeals from decisions or orders of the city administrator shall be governed by
   KRS Chapter 13B.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages›Chapter 241. Alcoholic Beverages; Administration and Control›KY REV ST 241.220. Urban-county administrator
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages › Chapter 241. Alcoholic Beverages; Administration and Control › KY REV ST 241.220. Urban-county administrator
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 241.220. Urban-county administrator (2023)
content:
The legislative body of any urban-county government in which traffic in alcoholic
   beverages is not forbidden by KRS Chapter 242 shall by ordinance create the office
   of urban-county alcoholic beverage control administrator.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages›Chapter 241. Alcoholic Beverages; Administration and Control›KY REV ST 241.260. Appeals from urban-county administrator's decision or order
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages › Chapter 241. Alcoholic Beverages; Administration and Control › KY REV ST 241.260. Appeals from urban-county administrator's decision or order
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 241.260. Appeals from urban-county administrator's decision or order (2023)
content:
Appeals from a decision or order of each urban-county administrator may be taken to
   the board by filing a notice of appeal with the board within thirty (30) days after
   the decision or order of the urban-county administrator is mailed or delivered by
   personal service.  The notice of appeal shall specify the urban-county administrator by name and shall
   identify the decision or order, or part of the decision or order, being appealed.  The notice shall contain a certificate that a copy of the notice has been served
   on the urban-county administrator and shall be accompanied by a copy of the decision
   or order being appealed.  Matters at issue shall be heard by the board as upon an original proceeding.  Appeals from decisions or orders of the urban-county administrator shall be governed
   by KRS Chapter 13B.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages›Chapter 241. Alcoholic Beverages; Administration and Control›KY REV ST 241.990. Penalties
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages › Chapter 241. Alcoholic Beverages; Administration and Control › KY REV ST 241.990. Penalties
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 241.990. Penalties (2023)
content:
Any person who after an opportunity to be heard is found by the commissioner to have
   violated any of the provisions ofKRS 241.100, or acted as county administrator in violation of subsection (1) ofKRS 241.120, or acted as city administrator or a city employee in violation of subsection (3)
   ofKRS 241.170, or acted as an urban-county administrator in violation ofKRS 241.230, shall automatically vacate his office or position, and upon conviction by a court,
   he shall be guilty of a Class D felony.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages›Chapter 242. Alcoholic Beverages; Local Option›KY REV ST 242.015. Definitions for chapter
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages › Chapter 242. Alcoholic Beverages; Local Option › KY REV ST 242.015. Definitions for chapter
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 242.015. Definitions for chapter (2023)
content:
As used in this chapter, unless the context otherwise requires, the words and terms
   defined inKRS 241.010have the meaning given to them inKRS 241.010.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages›Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations›Alcoholic Beverages Generally›KY REV ST 244.010. Definitions
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages › Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations › Alcoholic Beverages Generally › KY REV ST 244.010. Definitions
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 244.010. Definitions (2023)
content:
As used in this chapter, unless the context requires otherwise, the words and terms
   defined inKRS 241.010have the meaning given to them inKRS 241.010.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages›Chapter 241. Alcoholic Beverages; Administration and Control›KY REV ST 241.250. Functions and duties of urban-county administrator
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages › Chapter 241. Alcoholic Beverages; Administration and Control › KY REV ST 241.250. Functions and duties of urban-county administrator
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 241.250. Functions and duties of urban-county administrator (2023)
content:
Each urban-county administrator shall have the same duties and functions regarding
   local license applications and renewals as the department with respect to state licenses.  Each urban-county administrator shall have the same duties and functions regarding
   local license penalization as the board with respect to state license penalization.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages›Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations›Alcoholic Beverages Generally›KY REV ST 244.030. Soliciting orders; when prohibited
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages › Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations › Alcoholic Beverages Generally › KY REV ST 244.030. Soliciting orders; when prohibited
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 244.030. Soliciting orders; when prohibited (2023)
content:
(1)  No licensee under KRS Chapters 241 to 244 shall employ any canvasser or solicitor
      for the purpose of receiving an order from a consumer for any alcoholic beverages
      at the residence or place of business of the consumer, nor shall any such licensee
      receive or accept any order that has been solicited or received at the residence or
      place of business of the consumer.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages›Chapter 243. Alcoholic Beverages; Licenses and Taxes›KY REV ST 243.015. Definitions for chapter
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages › Chapter 243. Alcoholic Beverages; Licenses and Taxes › KY REV ST 243.015. Definitions for chapter
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 243.015. Definitions for chapter (2023)
content:
As used in this chapter, unless the context otherwise requires, the words and terms
   defined inKRS 241.010have the meaning given to them inKRS 241.010.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages›Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations›Alcoholic Beverages Generally›KY REV ST 244.040. Sales for cash only
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages › Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations › Alcoholic Beverages Generally › KY REV ST 244.040. Sales for cash only
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 244.040. Sales for cash only (2023)
content:
(1)  A brewer or distributor shall not sell alcoholic beverages to any person in this
      state for any consideration except for cash paid at or before the time of delivery.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages›Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations›Alcoholic Beverages Generally›KY REV ST 244.050. “Treating” prohibited; exceptions
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages › Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations › Alcoholic Beverages Generally › KY REV ST 244.050. “Treating” prohibited; exceptions
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 244.050. “Treating” prohibited; exceptions (2023)
content:
A retail licensee shall not sell, give away, or deliver any alcoholic beverage at
   retail in any quantity for less than paid or current wholesale cost, except upon written
   request and approval by the administrators, pursuant to a bona fide “close out” sale,
   or as provided byKRS 243.0305,243.0307,243.155, and243.157.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages›Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations›Alcoholic Beverages Generally›KY REV ST 244.060. Licensee to purchase from and sell only to persons authorized to sell or purchase
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages › Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations › Alcoholic Beverages Generally › KY REV ST 244.060. Licensee to purchase from and sell only to persons authorized to sell or purchase
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 244.060. Licensee to purchase from and sell only to persons authorized to sell or purchase (2023)
content:
(1)  No licensee shall purchase or agree to purchase any alcoholic beverages from
      any person within or without this state, who is not licensed to sell the beverages
      to the particular purchaser at the time of the agreement to sell, nor give any order
      for any alcoholic beverages to any person who is not a holder of a special agent's
      or solicitor's license if this license is required.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages›Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations›Alcoholic Beverages Generally›KY REV ST 244.083. Licensee to display notice as to sale to minors
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages › Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations › Alcoholic Beverages Generally › KY REV ST 244.083. Licensee to display notice as to sale to minors
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 244.083. Licensee to display notice as to sale to minors (2023)
content:
Every retail licensee shall display at all times in a prominent place a printed card
   at least eight (8) inches by eleven (11) inches in size which shall show, in thirty
   (30) point or larger type, substantially as follows:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages›Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations›Alcoholic Beverages Generally›KY REV ST 244.105. Gift card for alcoholic beverages to be redeemed only by persons 21. and older
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages › Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations › Alcoholic Beverages Generally › KY REV ST 244.105. Gift card for alcoholic beverages to be redeemed only by persons 21. and older
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 244.105. Gift card for alcoholic beverages to be redeemed only by persons 21. and older (2023)
content:
No person under the age of twenty-one (21) may redeem a gift card or any portion of
   a gift card for the purchase of alcoholic beverages.  A person holding a license underKRS 243.030or243.040may redeem a gift card for the purchase of alcoholic beverages if the person presenting
   the card is twenty-one (21) years of age or older.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages›Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations›Alcoholic Beverages Generally›KY REV ST 244.090. Persons whom licensees may not employ; exceptions
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages › Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations › Alcoholic Beverages Generally › KY REV ST 244.090. Persons whom licensees may not employ; exceptions
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 244.090. Persons whom licensees may not employ; exceptions (2023)
content:
(1)  A person holding any license shall not knowingly employ in connection with the
      licensed business any person who:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages›Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations›Alcoholic Beverages Generally›KY REV ST 244.080. Retail sales to certain persons prohibited; affirmative defense in prosecution for selling to a minor
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages › Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations › Alcoholic Beverages Generally › KY REV ST 244.080. Retail sales to certain persons prohibited; affirmative defense in prosecution for selling to a minor
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 244.080. Retail sales to certain persons prohibited; affirmative defense in prosecution for selling to a minor (2023)
content:
A retail licensee, or the licensee's agent, servant, or employee, shall not sell,
   give away, or deliver any alcoholic beverages, or procure or permit any alcoholic
   beverages to be sold, given away, possessed by, or delivered to:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages›Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations›Alcoholic Beverages Generally›KY REV ST 244.085. Minors not to possess or purchase liquor nor to misrepresent age; use of fraudulent identification; prohibition against minors remaining on premises where alcoholic beverages sold
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages › Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations › Alcoholic Beverages Generally › KY REV ST 244.085. Minors not to possess or purchase liquor nor to misrepresent age; use of fraudulent identification; prohibition against minors remaining on premises where alcoholic beverages sold
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 244.085. Minors not to possess or purchase liquor nor to misrepresent age; use of fraudulent identification; prohibition against minors remaining on premises where alcoholic beverages sold (2023)
content:
(1)  A person under twenty-one (21) years of age shall not enter any premises licensed
      for the sale of alcoholic beverages for the purpose of purchasing or receiving any
      alcoholic beverages.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages›Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations›Alcoholic Beverages Generally›KY REV ST 244.120. Retail premises not to be disorderly; acts constituting disorderly behavior
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages › Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations › Alcoholic Beverages Generally › KY REV ST 244.120. Retail premises not to be disorderly; acts constituting disorderly behavior
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 244.120. Retail premises not to be disorderly; acts constituting disorderly behavior (2023)
content:
(1)  A retail licensee, a patron, or the licensee's agents, servants, or employees
      shall not cause, suffer, or permit the licensed premises to be disorderly.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages›Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations›Alcoholic Beverages Generally›KY REV ST 244.125. Prohibition against possession of loaded firearm in room where alcoholic beverages are being sold by the drink
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages › Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations › Alcoholic Beverages Generally › KY REV ST 244.125. Prohibition against possession of loaded firearm in room where alcoholic beverages are being sold by the drink
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 244.125. Prohibition against possession of loaded firearm in room where alcoholic beverages are being sold by the drink (2023)
content:
(1)  Except as provided in subsection (3) of this section, no person shall be in possession
      of a loaded, as defined inKRS 237.060, firearm while actually within the room where alcoholic beverages are being sold
      by the drink of a building on premises licensed to sell distilled spirits and wine
      at retail by the drink for consumption on the licensed premises pursuant to KRS Chapter
      243.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages›Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations›Alcoholic Beverages Generally›KY REV ST 244.110. Retail premises to furnish clear view from sidewalk or entrance
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages › Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations › Alcoholic Beverages Generally › KY REV ST 244.110. Retail premises to furnish clear view from sidewalk or entrance
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 244.110. Retail premises to furnish clear view from sidewalk or entrance (2023)
content:
The entrance of any premises for which a quota retail package license or a quota retail
   drink license has been issued shall be of clear glass and permit an unobstructed view.  The premises shall be erected and maintained to furnish a clear view of the premises
   from the sidewalk, or, if the premises are not on the street level, from the entrance.  No partition, box, stall, screen, curtain, or other device shall obstruct the view
   or the general observation of persons, but partitions, subdivisions, or panels that
   are not higher than forty-eight (48) inches from the floor shall not be construed
   as obstructing the view or the general observation of persons.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages›Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations›Alcoholic Beverages Generally›KY REV ST 244.170. Apparatus for unlawful manufacture prohibited
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages › Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations › Alcoholic Beverages Generally › KY REV ST 244.170. Apparatus for unlawful manufacture prohibited
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 244.170. Apparatus for unlawful manufacture prohibited (2023)
content:
No person shall buy, bargain, sell, loan, own, possess or knowingly transport any
   apparatus designed for the unlawful manufacture of alcoholic beverages.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages›Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations›Alcoholic Beverages Generally›KY REV ST 244.130. Advertising to comply with regulations of board; types of advertising not prohibited
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages › Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations › Alcoholic Beverages Generally › KY REV ST 244.130. Advertising to comply with regulations of board; types of advertising not prohibited
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 244.130. Advertising to comply with regulations of board; types of advertising not prohibited (2023)
content:
(1)  A licensee may advertise or cause to be advertised in any manner any product
      that the licensee is licensed to manufacture or sell unless prohibited by administrative
      regulations promulgated by the board.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages›Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations›Alcoholic Beverages Generally›KY REV ST 244.165. Unlawful sale and shipment by out-of-state seller directly to a Kentucky consumer; penalty
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages › Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations › Alcoholic Beverages Generally › KY REV ST 244.165. Unlawful sale and shipment by out-of-state seller directly to a Kentucky consumer; penalty
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 244.165. Unlawful sale and shipment by out-of-state seller directly to a Kentucky consumer; penalty (2023)
content:
(1)  Except as provided inKRS 243.027to243.029, it shall be unlawful for any person in the business of selling alcoholic beverages
      in another state or country to deliver or ship or cause to be delivered or shipped
      any alcoholic beverage directly to any Kentucky consumer who does not hold a valid
      wholesaler or distributor license issued by the Commonwealth.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages›Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations›Alcoholic Beverages Generally›KY REV ST 244.150. Licensee to keep records
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages › Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations › Alcoholic Beverages Generally › KY REV ST 244.150. Licensee to keep records
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 244.150. Licensee to keep records (2023)
content:
Each licensee shall keep and maintain upon the licensed premises, or make readily
   available upon request of the department or the Department of Revenue, adequate books
   and records of all transactions involved in the manufacture, distribution, or sale
   of alcoholic beverages, in the manner required by administrative regulations of the
   department and the Department of Revenue.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages›Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations›Alcoholic Beverages Generally›KY REV ST 244.167. Unlawful acts relating to wholesalers or distributors

citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 244.167. Unlawful acts relating to wholesalers or distributors (2023)
content: (1)  It is unlawful:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages›Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations›Alcoholic Beverages Generally›KY REV ST 244.160. Presence of alcoholic beverage raises presumption of intention to sell
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages › Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations › Alcoholic Beverages Generally › KY REV ST 244.160. Presence of alcoholic beverage raises presumption of intention to sell
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 244.160. Presence of alcoholic beverage raises presumption of intention to sell (2023)
content:
Whenever any alcoholic beverage, in whatever quantity, is found on any business premises
   within this state, a prima facie presumption shall arise that the alcoholic beverage
   was upon the premises for the purpose of sale.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages›Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations›Alcoholic Beverages Generally›KY REV ST 244.200. Rights of owner or lienor as to contraband; disposition of contraband
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages › Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations › Alcoholic Beverages Generally › KY REV ST 244.200. Rights of owner or lienor as to contraband; disposition of contraband
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 244.200. Rights of owner or lienor as to contraband; disposition of contraband (2023)
content:
(1)  Contraband property included in subsectionKRS 244.180(5)shall be subject to the right of any owner or lienor, whose lien is valid and of
      record, to intervene and establish the owner or lienor's rights in the property by
      proving that the property was being used in connection with traffic in alcoholic beverages
      without the knowledge, consent, or approval of the owner or lienor.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages›Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations›Alcoholic Beverages Generally›KY REV ST 244.195. Title to contraband seized in dry territory to be vested in appropriate court; destruction of contraband upon conviction of defendant
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages › Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations › Alcoholic Beverages Generally › KY REV ST 244.195. Title to contraband seized in dry territory to be vested in appropriate court; destruction of contraband upon conviction of defendant
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 244.195. Title to contraband seized in dry territory to be vested in appropriate court; destruction of contraband upon conviction of defendant (2023)
content:
(1)  Title to seized contraband included inKRS 244.180(1),(2),(3), and(4)shall be vested in the appropriate court within whose jurisdiction the seizure occurred,
      irrespective of whether the contraband was seized by peace officers of the city or
      county or state administrators or investigators of the department, notwithstanding
      the provisions ofKRS 242.380.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages›Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations›Distilled Spirits and Wine›KY REV ST 244.210. Nonbeverage alcohol not to be sold for beverage purposes
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages › Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations › Distilled Spirits and Wine › KY REV ST 244.210. Nonbeverage alcohol not to be sold for beverage purposes
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 244.210. Nonbeverage alcohol not to be sold for beverage purposes (2023)
content:
No person shall knowingly sell any alcoholic product intended for nonbeverage purposes
   underKRS 243.320, under circumstances from which he or she might reasonably deduce the intention of
   the purchaser to use it for beverage purposes.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages›Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations›Alcoholic Beverages Generally›KY REV ST 244.190. Seizure of contraband; destruction upon conviction of defendant
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages › Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations › Alcoholic Beverages Generally › KY REV ST 244.190. Seizure of contraband; destruction upon conviction of defendant
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 244.190. Seizure of contraband; destruction upon conviction of defendant (2023)
content:
Any peace officers, state administrators, and investigators of the department may,
   upon probable cause, without warrant seize contraband regardless of whether it is
   in dry territory or not, and hold it subject to the order of the court before which
   the owner or one in possession of the contraband has been charged with violation of
   KRS Chapter 242 orKRS 243.020.  Upon conviction of the defendant, the court shall enter an order for the destruction
   of all contraband property, except firearms or ammunition, included inKRS 244.180(1),(2),(3), and(4).  Contraband firearms and ammunition shall be transferred to the Department of Kentucky
   State Police for disposition as provided inKRS 500.090.

title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages › Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations › Alcoholic Beverages Generally › KY REV ST 244.180. Contraband defined

content: The following property, even though found and seized in dry territory, is contraband:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages›Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations›Distilled Spirits and Wine›KY REV ST 244.230. Federal regulations adopted relating to labeling and standards of fill; labeling when manufactured outside country
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages › Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations › Distilled Spirits and Wine › KY REV ST 244.230. Federal regulations adopted relating to labeling and standards of fill; labeling when manufactured outside country
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 244.230. Federal regulations adopted relating to labeling and standards of fill; labeling when manufactured outside country (2023)
content:
(1)  The regulations of the Bureau of Internal Revenue in the United States Department
      of the Treasury, with respect to the labeling and standards of fill of distilled spirits
      and wine in their original sealed packages, are adopted and any distilled spirits
      and wine shall be deemed to be properly labeled under all the laws of this state,
      if the labels and standards of fill conform to those regulations.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages›Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations›Distilled Spirits and Wine›KY REV ST 244.235. “Kentucky” wine; minimum requirements for use of Kentucky products
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages › Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations › Distilled Spirits and Wine › KY REV ST 244.235. “Kentucky” wine; minimum requirements for use of Kentucky products
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 244.235. “Kentucky” wine; minimum requirements for use of Kentucky products (2023)
content:
No wine sold in Kentucky shall contain on its label or elsewhere on the wine's retail
   container or package the word “Kentucky” or any other word or phrase implying that
   the origin of the wine is Kentucky, except in the name and address of the winery as
   required by federal laws or regulations, unless seventy-five percent (75%) of all
   grapes, grape juice, other fruits, other fruit juices, and honey used in making the
   wine were produced in the Commonwealth of Kentucky.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages›Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations›Distilled Spirits and Wine›KY REV ST 244.220. Regulations of special licenses to be prescribed by board
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages › Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations › Distilled Spirits and Wine › KY REV ST 244.220. Regulations of special licenses to be prescribed by board
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 244.220. Regulations of special licenses to be prescribed by board (2023)
content:
The prohibitions, restrictions and regulations relating to special licenses shall
   be those which the board may by its regulations and in the exercise of its sound discretion
   prescribe.  For purposes of this section, a special license shall be one that is not set forth
   in KRS Chapters 241 to 244.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages›Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations›Distilled Spirits and Wine›KY REV ST 244.270. Wholesaler to have name and license number on window or building
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages › Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations › Distilled Spirits and Wine › KY REV ST 244.270. Wholesaler to have name and license number on window or building
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 244.270. Wholesaler to have name and license number on window or building (2023)
content:
Each wholesaler shall have painted on the front window of the licensed premises, or,
   if there is no window, on a sign affixed to the front of the building containing the
   licensed premises, the name of the licensee together with the inscription:  “Kentucky
   Wholesaler's Liquor License No......” in uniform letters not less than three (3) inches
   in height.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages›Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations›Distilled Spirits and Wine›KY REV ST 244.240. Distiller, rectifier, winery, or wholesaler not to be interested in retail premises; transactions prohibited; discounts in the usual course of business; retailer not to demand violation of this section; permitted activities
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages › Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations › Distilled Spirits and Wine › KY REV ST 244.240. Distiller, rectifier, winery, or wholesaler not to be interested in retail premises; transactions prohibited; discounts in the usual course of business; retailer not to demand violation of this section; permitted activities
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 244.240. Distiller, rectifier, winery, or wholesaler not to be interested in retail premises; transactions prohibited; discounts in the usual course of business; retailer not to demand violation of this section; permitted activities (2023)
content:
(1)  No distiller, rectifier, winery, or wholesaler and no employee, servant, or agent
      of a distiller, rectifier, winery, or wholesaler shall:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages›Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations›Distilled Spirits and Wine›KY REV ST 244.260. Containers that wholesaler may purchase, keep, or sell in; distilled spirits or wine to be kept by licensees in approved containers
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages › Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations › Distilled Spirits and Wine › KY REV ST 244.260. Containers that wholesaler may purchase, keep, or sell in; distilled spirits or wine to be kept by licensees in approved containers
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 244.260. Containers that wholesaler may purchase, keep, or sell in; distilled spirits or wine to be kept by licensees in approved containers (2023)
content:
(1)  No wholesaler shall purchase, import, keep upon the licensed premises, or sell
      any distilled spirits or wine in any container except in the original sealed package
      containing quantities of not less than fifty (50) milliliters each of distilled spirits
      or one hundred (100) milliliters of wine, and not exceeding the largest applicable
      federal standard of fill size for distilled spirits or two hundred twenty (220) liters
      of wine, as received from the distiller, rectifier, winery, or wholesaler.  The containers shall be in sizes authorized by federal law and at all times shall
      have affixed to them all labels required by federal law or the administrative regulations
      of the board.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages›Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations›Distilled Spirits and Wine›KY REV ST 244.250. Producer or wholesaler not to furnish sign to licensee except under administrative regulations
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages › Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations › Distilled Spirits and Wine › KY REV ST 244.250. Producer or wholesaler not to furnish sign to licensee except under administrative regulations
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 244.250. Producer or wholesaler not to furnish sign to licensee except under administrative regulations (2023)
content:
No distiller, rectifier, winery, or wholesaler shall furnish or cause to be furnished
   to any licensee any exterior or interior sign, printed, painted, electric or otherwise,
   except as authorized by the administrative regulations of the board.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages›Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations›Distilled Spirits and Wine›KY REV ST 244.280. Peddling prohibited
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages › Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations › Distilled Spirits and Wine › KY REV ST 244.280. Peddling prohibited
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 244.280. Peddling prohibited (2023)
content:
No licensee nor any of the licensee's agents, servants, or employees shall peddle
   any alcoholic beverages from house to house, by any means, where the sale is solicited
   at the residence or place of business of the consumer.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages›Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations›Distilled Spirits and Wine›KY REV ST 244.300. Extension of credit by retailers prohibited; exceptions
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages › Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations › Distilled Spirits and Wine › KY REV ST 244.300. Extension of credit by retailers prohibited; exceptions
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 244.300. Extension of credit by retailers prohibited; exceptions (2023)
content:
No retailer selling distilled spirits and wine by the package or by the drink shall
   sell, deliver, or give away, or cause, permit or procure to be sold, delivered, or
   given away any distilled spirits or wine on credit, except that a bona fide licensed
   private club, restaurant, or hotel may sell on reasonable credit to its members, customers,
   or registered guests.  Sales by any retailer selling distilled spirits or wine by the package or by the
   drink may be made by use of national or bank credit cards wherein the credit card
   company has agreed to payment to the licensee for such charges.  However, nothing in this section shall be construed to authorize a licensee to issue
   its own credit cards or extend a personal credit to patrons.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages›Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations›Distilled Spirits and Wine›KY REV ST 244.290. Sales of distilled spirits or wine when polls are open permitted in wet or moist territory; power of local governments to regulate; Sunday sales
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages › Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations › Distilled Spirits and Wine › KY REV ST 244.290. Sales of distilled spirits or wine when polls are open permitted in wet or moist territory; power of local governments to regulate; Sunday sales
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 244.290. Sales of distilled spirits or wine when polls are open permitted in wet or moist territory; power of local governments to regulate; Sunday sales (2023)
content:
(1)  (a) A licensee authorized to sell distilled spirits or wine at retail shall be
         permitted to sell and deliver distilled spirits and wine during the hours the polls
         are open on any primary, or regular, local option, or special election day unless
         it is located where the legislative body of a city, urban-county government, consolidated
         local government, charter county government, unified local government, or the fiscal
         court of a county adopts an ordinance after June 25, 2013, that prohibits the sale
         of distilled spirits and wine or limits the hours and times in which distilled spirits
         and wine may be sold within its jurisdictional boundaries on any primary, or regular,
         local option, or special election day during the hours the polls are open.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages›Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations›Distilled Spirits and Wine›KY REV ST 244.370. Whiskey to be aged; exception if not labeled as Kentucky whiskey
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages › Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations › Distilled Spirits and Wine › KY REV ST 244.370. Whiskey to be aged; exception if not labeled as Kentucky whiskey
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 244.370. Whiskey to be aged; exception if not labeled as Kentucky whiskey (2023)
content:
No whiskey produced from grains which are cooked, fermented, and distilled in Kentucky,
   except whiskey the barrel containing which is branded “Corn Whiskey” under the internal
   revenue laws, shall be bottled in Kentucky or removed from this state unless such
   whiskey has been aged in oak barrels for a period of not less than one (1) full year;
   provided, however, that whiskey aged less than one (1) year may be removed from the
   state and bottled, or bottled in Kentucky, if the word “Kentucky” or any word or phrase
   implying Kentucky origin does not appear on the front label or elsewhere on the retail
   container or package except in the name and address of the distiller as required by
   federal regulation.  For violations of this section, the department shall revoke the permit of the licensee
   from whose warehouse or premises such whiskey shall have been removed or in which
   such whiskey shall have been bottled.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages›Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations›Distilled Spirits and Wine›KY REV ST 244.461. Use of rebate coupons; redemption; retailers' loyalty cards
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages › Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations › Distilled Spirits and Wine › KY REV ST 244.461. Use of rebate coupons; redemption; retailers' loyalty cards
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 244.461. Use of rebate coupons; redemption; retailers' loyalty cards (2023)
content:
(1)  Manufacturers and importers of malt beverages, distilled spirits, and wine may
      advertise and promote, by specific brand and bottle size, malt beverages, distilled
      spirits, and wine for off-premises consumption by use of rebate coupons.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages›Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations›Distilled Spirits and Wine›KY REV ST 244.450. title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages › Chapter 244. Wholesaler not to act until receipt of license and distribution rights and after filing brand registration form with department
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 244.450. Wholesaler not to act until receipt of license and distribution rights and after filing brand registration form with department (2023)
content:

      offered for sale or sold by any out-of-state distiller, rectifier, winery, supplier,
      or wholesaler without:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages›Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations›Distilled Spirits and Wine›KY REV ST 244.440. Registration of wholesalers authorized to handle particular brands and product names
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages › Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations › Distilled Spirits and Wine › KY REV ST 244.440. Registration of wholesalers authorized to handle particular brands and product names
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 244.440. Registration of wholesalers authorized to handle particular brands and product names (2023)
content:
(1)  Every resident and nonresident distiller, rectifier, or winery and nonresident
      wholesaler who owns, is the primary source of supply, or has an exclusive interest
      in any particular brands, which are intended for sale or sold in this state, shall
      be licensed in this state and shall register on a form to be provided by the department,
      the names of the wholesalers in this state to whom distributing rights have been granted
      for one or more or all of the brands and product names of distilled spirits or wine
      offered for sale or sold in this state.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages›Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations›Malt Beverages›KY REV ST 244.480. Sales of malt beverages when polls are open permitted in wet or moist territory; power of local governments to regulate; Sunday sales
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages › Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations › Malt Beverages › KY REV ST 244.480. Sales of malt beverages when polls are open permitted in wet or moist territory; power of local governments to regulate; Sunday sales
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 244.480. Sales of malt beverages when polls are open permitted in wet or moist territory; power of local governments to regulate; Sunday sales (2023)
content:
(1)  Except as permitted by subsection (4) of this section, no brewer or distributor
      shall deliver any malt beverages on Sunday or between the hours of midnight and 6
      a.m. on any other day.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages›Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations›Malt Beverages›KY REV ST 244.590. title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages › Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations › Malt Beverages › KY REV ST 244.590. citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 244.590. content:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages›Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations›Malt Beverages›KY REV ST 244.490. Sales to persons illegally selling malt beverages prohibited
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages › Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations › Malt Beverages › KY REV ST 244.490. Sales to persons illegally selling malt beverages prohibited
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 244.490. Sales to persons illegally selling malt beverages prohibited (2023)
content:
No person shall sell any malt beverage to any person engaged in selling malt beverages
   in violation of the provisions of KRS Chapters 242, 243 and 244.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages›Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations›Malt Beverages›KY REV ST 244.500. Malt beverage premium prohibition; exceptions
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages › Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations › Malt Beverages › KY REV ST 244.500. Malt beverage premium prohibition; exceptions
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 244.500. Malt beverage premium prohibition; exceptions (2023)
content:
(1)  Except as permitted by subsection (2) of this section, a licensee shall not offer
      or give anything tangible of value as a premium, gift, or prize for:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages›Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations›Malt Beverages›KY REV ST 244.540. Advertising malt beverages near school or church prohibited
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages › Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations › Malt Beverages › KY REV ST 244.540. Advertising malt beverages near school or church prohibited
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 244.540. Advertising malt beverages near school or church prohibited (2023)
content:
(1)  No licensee shall advertise any malt beverage by trade name, trade-mark or in
      any other manner within one hundred (100) feet of the property line of any school
      or church.  The distance shall be by straight line.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages›Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations›Malt Beverages›KY REV ST 244.510. Adoption of labeling and advertising regulations of Bureau of Internal Revenue
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages › Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations › Malt Beverages › KY REV ST 244.510. Adoption of labeling and advertising regulations of Bureau of Internal Revenue
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 244.510. Adoption of labeling and advertising regulations of Bureau of Internal Revenue (2023)
content:
(1)  The department may in its discretion adopt any regulations of the Bureau of Internal
      Revenue in the United States Department of the Treasury relating to labeling and advertising
      of malt beverages.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages›Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations›Malt Beverages›KY REV ST 244.550. Adulteration of malt beverages prohibited
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages › Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations › Malt Beverages › KY REV ST 244.550. Adulteration of malt beverages prohibited
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 244.550. Adulteration of malt beverages prohibited (2023)
content:
No person shall fortify, adulterate, contaminate or in any manner change the character
   or purity of the malt beverages from that as originally marketed by the brewer or
   sell, deliver or transport malt beverages except in the original containers.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages›Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations›Distribution Agreements After June 29, 2021›KY REV ST 244.609. Resolution of disputes between microbrewer and distributor; arbitration

citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 244.609. Resolution of disputes between microbrewer and distributor; arbitration (2023)
content:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages›Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations›Malt Beverages›KY REV ST 244.560. Brewer or distributor to make accurate invoice; refund, rebate or discount prohibited
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages › Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations › Malt Beverages › KY REV ST 244.560. Brewer or distributor to make accurate invoice; refund, rebate or discount prohibited
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 244.560. Brewer or distributor to make accurate invoice; refund, rebate or discount prohibited (2023)
content:
(1)  No brewer or distributor, his agents or employees, shall make any sale or delivery
      of any malt beverage without a written invoice made concurrently with the sale or
      delivery, showing prices and conditions upon which the sale or delivery is made; 
      make any invoice which falsely indicates prices and terms of any sale;  insert in
      any invoice any statements which make the invoice a false record, wholly or in part,
      of the transaction involved or represented on the face of the invoice;  or withhold
      from any invoice any statement which properly should be included in it so that in
      the absence of such a statement the invoice does not truly reflect the transaction
      involved.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages›Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations›Malt Beverages›KY REV ST 244.580. Exclusive outlets prohibited
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages › Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations › Malt Beverages › KY REV ST 244.580. Exclusive outlets prohibited
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 244.580. Exclusive outlets prohibited (2023)
content:
No brewer, distributor or transporter of malt beverages shall require by agreement
   or otherwise, directly or indirectly or through an affiliate or subsidiary, that any
   retailer engaged in the sale of malt beverages, purchase malt beverages from him to
   the exclusion in whole or in part of malt beverages sold or offered for sale by other
   persons.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages›Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations›Malt Beverages›KY REV ST 244.600. Commercial bribery and other inducements unlawful
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages › Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations › Malt Beverages › KY REV ST 244.600. Commercial bribery and other inducements unlawful
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 244.600. Commercial bribery and other inducements unlawful (2023)
content:
No brewer shall induce through any of the following means, any retailer selling malt
   beverages by the package or drink to purchase any malt beverage products from him
   or her to the exclusion in whole or in part of malt beverages sold or offered for
   sale by other persons, if the brewer engages in the practice of using such means,
   or any of them, to such an extent as substantially to restrain or prevent transactions
   in malt beverages:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages›Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations›Malt Beverages›KY REV ST 244.570. Brewer or distributor not to be financially interested in retail premises
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages › Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations › Malt Beverages › KY REV ST 244.570. Brewer or distributor not to be financially interested in retail premises
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 244.570. Brewer or distributor not to be financially interested in retail premises (2023)
content:
(1)  No brewer or distributor shall be interested in any manner, either directly or
      indirectly, in the ownership or leasehold of any property or in any mortgage against
      the property for which a retail license is issued, nor shall a brewer or distributor
      either directly or indirectly lend any moneys, credit or the equivalent thereto to
      any retailer in equipping, fitting out or maintaining and conducting either in whole
      or in part a malt beverage retail establishment or business.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages›Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations›Malt Beverages›KY REV ST 244.585. Distributor of malt beverages not to sell outside his designated territory; contract between distributor and supplier
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages › Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations › Malt Beverages › KY REV ST 244.585. Distributor of malt beverages not to sell outside his designated territory; contract between distributor and supplier
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 244.585. Distributor of malt beverages not to sell outside his designated territory; contract between distributor and supplier (2023)
content:
(1)  It shall be unlawful for any distributor to sell any brand or product name of
      malt beverage in the Commonwealth of Kentucky, except in the territory described in
      a written agreement between the supplier or brewer and distributor, authorizing sale
      by the distributor of that brand and product name within a designated area, and within
      that designated area the distributor shall not refuse to sell or offer reasonable
      service to licensed retailers during the normal business hours of the distributor.  Where a supplier or brewer sells several brands and named products, the agreement
      need not apply to all brands and named products sold by the supplier or brewer and
      may apply to only one (1) brand and product name.  No supplier or brewer shall provide by the written agreement for the distribution
      of a brand or named product of malt beverages to more than one (1) distributor for
      all or any part of the designated territory.  Upon request, all territorial agreements shall be filed with the department.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages›Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations›Distribution of Malt Beverages›KY REV ST 244.604. Definitions for KRS 244.602. to § 244.606

citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 244.604. Definitions for KRS 244.602. to § 244.606 (2023)
content: As used inKRS 244.602to244.606, unless the context requires otherwise:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages›Chapter 244. Distribution agreements after June 29, 2021; nonapplicability of KRS 244.602. to 244.606; requirements for distribution agreements between microbrewer and distributor
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages › Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations › Distribution Agreements After June 29, 2021 › KY REV ST 244.608. Distribution agreements after June 29, 2021; nonapplicability of KRS 244.602. to 244.606; requirements for distribution agreements between microbrewer and distributor
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 244.608. Distribution agreements after June 29, 2021; nonapplicability of KRS 244.602. to 244.606; requirements for distribution agreements between microbrewer and distributor (2023)
content:
(1)  As of the effective date of June 29, 2021,KRS 244.602to244.606shall not apply to any new distribution agreement, or the renewal of an existing
      distribution agreement, between a distributor of malt beverages and a microbrewery.  Any existing distribution agreement between a distributor of malt beverages and
      a microbrewery shall be deemed to renew upon the earlier of January 1, 2022, or the
      renewal date set forth in that agreement.

citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 244.650. Sale of confections or candies containing alcohol; sales to minors prohibited; labeling required (2023)
content:
(1)  Notwithstanding any other provision of the statutes, confections or candies having
      a liquid filling or liquid center and containing more than one-half percent (0.5%)
      but not more than five percent (5%) of alcohol by volume or weight may be sold at

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages›Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations›Penalties›KY REV ST 244.990. Penalties
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XX. Alcoholic Beverages › Chapter 244. Alcoholic Beverages; Prohibitions, Restrictions, and Regulations › Penalties › KY REV ST 244.990. Penalties
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 244.990. Penalties (2023)
content:
(1)  Any person who, alone or acting through another, directly or indirectly, violates
      any of the provisions of this chapter for which no other penalty is provided shall,
      for the first offense, be guilty of a Class B misdemeanor;  and for the second and
      each subsequent violation, the person shall be guilty of a Class A misdemeanor.  The penalties provided for in this subsection shall be in addition to the revocation
      of the offender's license.  If the offender is a corporation, joint stock company, association, fiduciary, limited
      liability company, or other business entity recognized by law, the principal officer
      or officers responsible for the violation may be imprisoned.

title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 246. Department of Agriculture › KY REV ST 246.020. Purpose of department
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 246.020. Purpose of department (2023)
content:
The efforts of the department shall be directed to the promotion of the interests
   of agriculture and horticulture.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 246. Department of Agriculture›KY REV ST 246.055. Acceptance of federal aid, gifts; distribution; agreement with federal government
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 246. Department of Agriculture › KY REV ST 246.055. Acceptance of federal aid, gifts; distribution; agreement with federal government
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 246.055. Acceptance of federal aid, gifts; distribution; agreement with federal government (2023)
content:
(1)  The Department of Agriculture may accept federal aid, gifts, donations, or devises.  The Department of Agriculture is authorized in its discretion to accept the provisions
      of any Act of Congress appropriating, granting, or apportioning funds or commodities
      to the state for use in connection with any program of the Department of Agriculture.  The Commissioner shall prescribe for the proper apportionment and distribution of
      these funds, property or commodities in accordance with the state and federal laws.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 246. Department of Agriculture›KY REV ST 246.130. Meetings of board; quorum
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 246. Department of Agriculture › KY REV ST 246.130. Meetings of board; quorum
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 246.130. Meetings of board; quorum (2023)
content:
The board shall meet at least four (4) times per year to consider the general agricultural,
   horticultural, and forestry interests of the state, and to take the necessary steps
   for carrying out the purpose of the board.  The Commissioner may, and at the request of eight (8) of its voting members, call
   its meetings and the board may adjourn any meeting to a time and place as may be determined.  Eight (8) voting members shall constitute a quorum.  Eight (8) members may call the board together for the transaction of business if
   the Commissioner, upon their request, refuses to do so.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 246. Department of Agriculture›KY REV ST 246.040. Commissioner
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 246. Department of Agriculture › KY REV ST 246.040. Commissioner
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 246.040. Commissioner (2023)
content:
(1)  The Commissioner shall be the head of the department.  He shall keep his office at the seat of government and devote his entire time to
      the duties of his office.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 246. Department of Agriculture›KY REV ST 246.057. Metrology lab fees
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 246. Department of Agriculture › KY REV ST 246.057. Metrology lab fees
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 246.057. Metrology lab fees (2023)
content:
(1)  The department may promulgate administrative regulations establishing license
      fees, testing fees, and any other fees necessary to operate and maintain a metrology
      lab within the department.  Fees shall be established at a level that shall not exceed the actual cost of operating
      and maintaining the metrology lab.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 246. Department of Agriculture›KY REV ST 246.070. Functions of Commissioner
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 246. Department of Agriculture › KY REV ST 246.070. Functions of Commissioner
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 246.070. Functions of Commissioner (2023)
content:
(1)  The Commissioner shall promote and encourage, as far as practicable, the organization
      of agricultural organizations and associations.  He shall ascertain in detail the quality and quantity of land under cultivation;
      the kinds, amounts and value of the annual field crops;  the annual production of
      orchards, gardens, and dairies;  the kinds, value, and increase of livestock;  the
      character and wages of labor employed in the cultivation of the soil;  and the value
      of agricultural exports and imports.

   associations and organizations and such other organizations or persons in or out of
   the state, as he may deem proper, in order to secure information.

citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 246.245. Agriculture promotion fund (2023)
content:
(1)  There is hereby established in the State Treasury a separate trust and agency

      Department of Agriculture for the purposes provided in this section.  Any moneys accruing to this fund in any fiscal year shall not lapse but shall be
