path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 246. Department of Agriculture›KY REV ST 246.065. Identification of lands of statewide agricultural importance
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 246. Department of Agriculture › KY REV ST 246.065. Identification of lands of statewide agricultural importance
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 246.065. Identification of lands of statewide agricultural importance (2023)
content:
(1)  The State Department of Agriculture shall identify lands of statewide agricultural
      importance through the use of the United States Department of Agriculture's land evaluation
      and site assessment program and the state's geographic information system.  The department shall provide information on the location of agricultural lands of
      statewide importance to each local planning unit operating under the requirements
      of KRS Chapter 100.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 246. Department of Agriculture›KY REV ST 246.140. Compensation of board; limitation on days of session
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 246. Department of Agriculture › KY REV ST 246.140. Compensation of board; limitation on days of session

   expenses while attending meetings of the board, but the total number of days the board
   may be in session shall not exceed thirty-six (36) per year.

title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 246. Department of Agriculture › KY REV ST 246.280. Deposit and use of funds and proceeds of Kentucky Rural Rehabilitation Corporation assets
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 246.280. Deposit and use of funds and proceeds of Kentucky Rural Rehabilitation Corporation assets (2023)
content:
Funds and the proceeds of the trust assets returned to the Commissioner of Agriculture
   pursuant toKRS 246.270which are not retransferred to the Secretary of Agriculture of the United States
   pursuant toKRS 246.275, shall be paid into the State Treasury and carried in a separate account for use
   for such of the rural rehabilitation purposes permissible under the charter of the
   now dissolved Kentucky Rural Rehabilitation Corporation as may from time to time be
   agreed upon by the Commissioner and the Secretary of Agriculture of the United States,
   subject to the applicable provisions of said Public Law 499, or for the purposes ofKRS 246.275.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 246. Department of Agriculture›KY REV ST 246.275. Agreements with Secretary of Agriculture of United States for purposes of Bankhead-Jones Farm Tenant Act
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 246. Department of Agriculture › KY REV ST 246.275. Agreements with Secretary of Agriculture of United States for purposes of Bankhead-Jones Farm Tenant Act
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 246.275. Agreements with Secretary of Agriculture of United States for purposes of Bankhead-Jones Farm Tenant Act (2023)
content:
The Commissioner of Agriculture, with the advice of the state Board of Agriculture,
   is authorized to enter into agreements with the Secretary of Agriculture of the United
   States pursuant to Section 2(f) of the aforesaid act of the Congress of the United
   States, upon such terms and conditions and for such periods of time as may be mutually
   agreeable, authorizing the Secretary of Agriculture of the United States to accept,
   administer, expend and use in the Commonwealth of Kentucky all or any part of such
   trust assets, or any other funds of the Commonwealth of Kentucky which may be appropriated
   for such uses, for carrying out the purposes of Titles I and II of the Bankhead-Jones
   Farm Tenant Act, in accordance with the applicable provisions of Title IV thereof,
   as now or hereafter amended, and to do any and all things necessary to effectuate
   and carry out the purposes of said agreements.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 246. Department of Agriculture›KY REV ST 246.295. Administrative regulations relating to cervids; costs resulting from importation of diseased animal
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 246. Department of Agriculture › KY REV ST 246.295. Administrative regulations relating to cervids; costs resulting from importation of diseased animal
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 246.295. Administrative regulations relating to cervids; costs resulting from importation of diseased animal (2023)
content:
(1)  The Department of Agriculture, in cooperation with the Department of Fish and
      Wildlife Resources, shall promulgate administrative regulations pertaining to health
      requirements, eradication of diseases, importation, and unique individual identification,
      including visual identification tags, of privately owned and farm raised cervids maintained
      for the production of meat and other products.  Nothing in this section shall limit the authority of the Department of Fish and
      Wildlife Resources to regulate the unique individual identification, including visual
      identification, of captive cervids that are not privately owned and farm-raised cervids
      maintained for the production of meat and other products.  The Department of Fish and Wildlife Resources, in cooperation with the Department
      of Agriculture, shall promulgate administrative regulations pertaining to the holding
      of cervids.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 246. Department of Agriculture›KY REV ST 246.270. Commissioner authorized to receive trust assets of Kentucky Rural Rehabilitation Corporation

citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 247.015. Department authorized to provide space on state property for sale of Kentucky agricultural commodities; administrative regulations; applicability (2023)

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 248. Tobacco›KY REV ST 248.005. Legislative finding and declaration on United States Department of Agriculture's Tobacco Price Support Program
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 248. Tobacco › KY REV ST 248.005. Legislative finding and declaration on United States Department of Agriculture's Tobacco Price Support Program
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 248.005. Legislative finding and declaration on United States Department of Agriculture's Tobacco Price Support Program (2023)
content:
The General Assembly finds that the Tobacco Price Support Program administered by
   the United States Department of Agriculture under7 U.S.C. sec. 1314is the best and most efficient means of preserving the economic health of thousands
   of tobacco farms throughout the United States and throughout Kentucky.  Based upon this finding, the General Assembly declares that the Tobacco Task Force
   shall study methods to support the Tobacco Price Support Program and its continuing
   role in the economic viability of Kentucky's small tobacco farmer.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 248. Tobacco›KY REV ST 248.015. Tobacco boards of trade; powers
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 248. Tobacco › KY REV ST 248.015. Tobacco boards of trade; powers
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 248.015. Tobacco boards of trade; powers (2023)
content:
A tobacco board of trade shall be organized on every market at which tobacco is offered
   for sale at auction and each board shall have the objects, purposes, and powers to:
   promote a more orderly market for the sale of tobacco at auction;  prevent market
   gluts by arranging for a more orderly flow of tobacco through the warehouses;  encourage
   ethical practices in the auction system;  support the continuation of the production
   control program;  adopt bylaws or regulations defining voting rights of the tobacco
   board of trade members;  collect dues and initiation fees to cover the operating expenses
   of the tobacco board of trade;  adopt regulations for the conduct of the tobacco market
   including the allocation of selling time and selling space.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 248. Tobacco›KY REV ST 248.025. Membership of boards; eligibility; participation
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 248. Tobacco › KY REV ST 248.025. Membership of boards; eligibility; participation
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 248.025. Membership of boards; eligibility; participation (2023)
content:
(1)  The membership of each tobacco board of trade shall be divided into two (2) classes:
      active members and associate members.  Any person, partnership, corporation or association operating a loose leaf auction
      warehouse or warehouses shall be eligible for active membership in the tobacco board
      of trade;  provided, however, that each board of trade shall have the right to establish
      the basis of voting rights for its warehouse members according to floor space, ownership,
      number of separate warehouse buildings or otherwise.  Any person, partnership, corporation or association not eligible for active membership
      but holding a tobacco dealer's license and purchasing tobacco pursuant to said license
      upon the market governed by the tobacco board of trade shall be eligible for election
      as an associate member.  Each associate member shall have the option of becoming, upon written notice to
      the tobacco board of trade, either a participating or a nonparticipating member.  A nonparticipating member shall not have the right to vote upon any question coming
      before the tobacco board of trade.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 248. Tobacco›KY REV ST 248.035. Membership required to operate warehouse or purchase tobacco therein
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 248. Tobacco › KY REV ST 248.035. Membership required to operate warehouse or purchase tobacco therein
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 248.035. Membership required to operate warehouse or purchase tobacco therein (2023)
content:
Every tobacco warehouse offering tobacco for sale at auction shall be a member of
   its local tobacco board of trade, and membership in good standing shall be deemed
   to be a reasonable requirement by such tobacco board of trade as a condition precedent
   to participating in the business of operating a tobacco warehouse or the purchase
   of tobacco at auction therein.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 248. Tobacco›KY REV ST 248.300. Department to supervise warehouses; inspectors and employees
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 248. Tobacco › KY REV ST 248.300. Department to supervise warehouses; inspectors and employees
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 248.300. Department to supervise warehouses; inspectors and employees (2023)
content:
(1)  The department shall administerKRS 248.290to248.440, and shall have general supervision over the sale of tobacco in warehouses throughout
      the state.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 248. Tobacco›KY REV ST 248.290. Warehouse license; fees
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 248. Tobacco › KY REV ST 248.290. Warehouse license; fees
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 248.290. Warehouse license; fees (2023)
content:
(1)  Each warehouse shall pay to the department an annual license fee of one hundred
      twenty-five dollars ($125).  A license fee shall be paid on each warehouse building operated as a place of sale
      for tobacco, regardless of the number of such buildings owned by any individual, corporation,
      firm, or other type of management organization.  It shall be paid on July 1 of each year.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 248. Tobacco›KY REV ST 248.320. Auctions to be free and open
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 248. Tobacco › KY REV ST 248.320. Auctions to be free and open
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 248.320. Auctions to be free and open (2023)
content:
All sales of leaf tobacco at public auction shall be free and open to all responsible
   bidders.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 248. Tobacco›KY REV ST 248.340. Preventing persons from bidding or purchasing prohibited
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 248. Tobacco › KY REV ST 248.340. Preventing persons from bidding or purchasing prohibited
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 248.340. Preventing persons from bidding or purchasing prohibited (2023)
content:
No organization or corporation under the laws of this state shall prohibit any of
   its members or others from bidding on or purchasing leaf tobacco at any warehouse.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 248. Tobacco›KY REV ST 248.330. Combination to control or interfere with bidding prohibited
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 248. Tobacco › KY REV ST 248.330. Combination to control or interfere with bidding prohibited
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 248.330. Combination to control or interfere with bidding prohibited (2023)
content:
No persons shall combine, by any rule, bylaw or otherwise, for the purpose of controlling,
   or in any way interfering with the free and unrestricted right to bid on or purchase
   leaf tobacco offered for sale at public auction at any warehouse or place of sale
   where tobacco is sold by warehousemen for others in this state.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 248. Tobacco›KY REV ST 248.280. Storage warehouseman to grade and weigh tobacco; receipts
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 248. Tobacco › KY REV ST 248.280. Storage warehouseman to grade and weigh tobacco; receipts
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 248.280. Storage warehouseman to grade and weigh tobacco; receipts (2023)
content:
(1)  Any person engaged in the business of warehouseman for the purpose of receiving,
      grading, handling, prizing and storing tobacco, shall, upon the receipt of tobacco,
      have competent persons to grade it into distinct and proper grades and weigh it.  He shall give a warehouse receipt for the tobacco to the owner or consignor, setting
      forth each grade and the number of pounds.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 248. Tobacco›KY REV ST 248.355. Class action suit; damages, computation and distribution
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 248. Tobacco › KY REV ST 248.355. Class action suit; damages, computation and distribution
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 248.355. Class action suit; damages, computation and distribution (2023)
content:
(1)  The Attorney General shall be authorized to file a class action suit on behalf
      of all persons discriminated against in violation ofKRS 248.350and may recover monetary damages against any warehouse found to be in violation.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 248. Tobacco›KY REV ST 248.460. Liability of warehouseman for destruction of or damage to tobacco in storage
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 248. Tobacco › KY REV ST 248.460. Liability of warehouseman for destruction of or damage to tobacco in storage
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 248.460. Liability of warehouseman for destruction of or damage to tobacco in storage (2023)
content: (1)  As used in this section:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 248. Tobacco›KY REV ST 248.400. Commingling of tobacco without grower's consent prohibited
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 248. Tobacco › KY REV ST 248.400. Commingling of tobacco without grower's consent prohibited
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 248.400. Commingling of tobacco without grower's consent prohibited (2023)
content:
No person shall commingle crops of tobacco on the warehouse floor while that tobacco
   is still the property of the grower, unless express permission for the commingling
   is obtained from the grower.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 248. Tobacco›KY REV ST 248.353. Enforcement by Attorney General
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 248. Tobacco › KY REV ST 248.353. Enforcement by Attorney General
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 248.353. Enforcement by Attorney General (2023)
content:
(1)  Compliance with the provisions ofKRS 248.350shall be monitored by the department with enforcement assistance provided by the
      Special Prosecutions Unit of the Office of the Attorney General.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 248. Tobacco›KY REV ST 248.350. Discrimination prohibited
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 248. Tobacco › KY REV ST 248.350. Discrimination prohibited
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 248.350. Discrimination prohibited (2023)
content:
(1)  No warehouse or warehouseman or person acting on behalf of any warehouse or warehouseman
      shall discriminate against any grower of tobacco in any way, including but not limited
      to, the sale, transportation, or handling of tobacco.  All tobacco growers shall be entitled to the exact same considerations as all other
      tobacco growers serviced by the same warehouse, except that a warehouseman may distinguish
      among different types of packaging in setting the fee or commission.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 248. Tobacco›KY REV ST 248.310. Duties and powers of inspectors
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 248. Tobacco › KY REV ST 248.310. Duties and powers of inspectors
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 248.310. Duties and powers of inspectors (2023)
content:
(1)  The inspectors employed underKRS 248.300shall carry out a general inspection service of all warehouses and shall strictly
      enforceKRS 248.280to248.440.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 248. Tobacco›KY REV ST 248.370. Maximum basket sales per hour; hours and days of operation
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 248. Tobacco › KY REV ST 248.370. Maximum basket sales per hour; hours and days of operation
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 248.370. Maximum basket sales per hour; hours and days of operation (2023)
content:
(1)  The maximum sales of baskets of tobacco on warehouse floors shall not exceed
      three hundred and sixty (360) baskets during any one (1) hour, nor shall the rate
      of sales exceed three hundred and sixty (360) baskets per hour.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 248. Tobacco›KY REV ST 248.420. Inducement of false report by weighman prohibited
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 248. Tobacco › KY REV ST 248.420. Inducement of false report by weighman prohibited
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 248.420. Inducement of false report by weighman prohibited (2023)
content:
No warehouseman shall attempt by any means to influence a weighman to report falsely
   the weight of any tobacco sold on the floor of his warehouse.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 248. Tobacco›KY REV ST 248.380. Sales of vocational education tobacco
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 248. Tobacco › KY REV ST 248.380. Sales of vocational education tobacco
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 248.380. Sales of vocational education tobacco (2023)
content:
(1)  In addition to the days allowed for sales underKRS 248.370each warehouse may operate one (1) Saturday during each season for the sale of tobacco
      grown by persons under twenty-one (21) years of age under a vocational education program
      sponsored by county agents or other county, state or federal agencies.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 248. Tobacco›KY REV ST 248.391. Height and weight requirements for baskets of tobacco
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 248. Tobacco › KY REV ST 248.391. Height and weight requirements for baskets of tobacco
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 248.391. Height and weight requirements for baskets of tobacco (2023)
content:
The Commissioner shall promulgate administrative regulations establishing the height
   and weight requirements of a basket of tobacco when placed on a warehouse floor for
   the purpose of sale.  In establishing the requirements, the Commissioner shall consider traditional height
   and weight standards for baskets of tobacco, and shall consider experimental marketing
   standards that may be applied from time to time.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 248. Tobacco›KY REV ST 248.430. Notice of sales and producers to be posted; false notice prohibited
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 248. Tobacco › KY REV ST 248.430. Notice of sales and producers to be posted; false notice prohibited
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 248.430. Notice of sales and producers to be posted; false notice prohibited (2023)
content:
(1)  Any person who receives or undertakes to receive or take care of leaf tobacco
      for sale at public auction, whether with or without compensation, shall post or cause
      to be posted, a notice in a conspicuous place upon his premises, stating the number
      of pounds in the aggregate, actually sold, and the average price per pound received
      on account of each day's sale.  He shall post the notice not later than 9:00 a.m. on the day following the sale.  He shall also, not less than thirty (30) minutes prior to such a sale, post at a
      point in the office of his warehouse, convenient and accessible for public inspection,
      a typewritten or printed list showing the true name and post office address of the
      owner and producer and the number of pounds of tobacco of each person whose tobacco
      will that day be offered for sale in the warehouse.  No tobacco shall be delivered to or received by any warehouse for sale at public
      auction, unless the true names and post office addresses of the producer and owner
      of the tobacco are furnished the warehouse by the person delivering the tobacco.  He shall also post on the outside of the scale house and in the farmer's waiting
      room, if such places are in the warehouse, a schedule setting forth the rates of all
      commissions, fees, discounts and deductions.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 248. Tobacco›KY REV ST 248.440. Daily reports to be furnished by warehouses and released by department
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 248. Tobacco › KY REV ST 248.440. Daily reports to be furnished by warehouses and released by department
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 248.440. Daily reports to be furnished by warehouses and released by department (2023)
content:
(1)  Each warehouse shall submit, under regulations of the Commissioner, a daily system
      of sworn statements to include the total number of pounds of tobacco sold, the total
      amount paid for that tobacco and the average for the day for the particular warehouse
      reporting.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 248. Tobacco›KY REV ST 248.410. Weighmen must be bonded
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 248. Tobacco › KY REV ST 248.410. Weighmen must be bonded
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 248.410. Weighmen must be bonded (2023)
content:
(1)  Warehouses shall submit to the department a list of the names of all weighmen
      employed.  Each weighman so listed shall furnish a bond in the amount of five hundred dollars
      ($500) to the department for the faithful performance of his duty.  Should any weighman knowingly and willfully, for the purpose of misleading the public,
      misrepresent or attempt to misrepresent the weight of any tobacco weighed by him on
      the warehouse floor, his bond shall be forfeited and the proceeds of it paid into
      the State Treasury.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 249. Trees, Plants, Weeds, and Pests›General Provisions›KY REV ST 249.070. Entomologist to inspect nurseries and order management of plant pests; shipment of affected stock prohibited; exception
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 249. Trees, Plants, Weeds, and Pests › General Provisions › KY REV ST 249.070. Entomologist to inspect nurseries and order management of plant pests; shipment of affected stock prohibited; exception
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 249.070. Entomologist to inspect nurseries and order management of plant pests; shipment of affected stock prohibited; exception (2023)
content:
(1)  All nurseries in the Commonwealth of Kentucky shall be inspected by the state
      entomologist, his deputy, or by a nursery inspector, once each year.  The state entomologist may collect specimens of plant material in order to make
      cultures and positive identifications of plant pests.  The state entomologist also may inspect nursery stock which is stored in cellars,
      heeling in grounds, or warehouses, to ascertain whether it is infested with insect
      pests or plant diseases.  If, upon the inspection of any nursery, it appears that the nursery and its premises
      are not infected or infested with insect pests and plant diseases, the state entomologist
      shall issue to the nursery a certificate of inspection.  The certificate of inspection shall be valid through June 30 of the following year.  This certificate shall be prominently displayed in the main office of the building.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 249. Trees, Plants, Weeds, and Pests›General Provisions›KY REV ST 249.060. Nurseries and dealers to be licensed; fees
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 249. Trees, Plants, Weeds, and Pests › General Provisions › KY REV ST 249.060. Nurseries and dealers to be licensed; fees
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 249.060. Nurseries and dealers to be licensed; fees (2023)
content:
(1)  Every resident nursery or dealer selling nursery stock in this state shall annually
      file credentials with the state entomologist.  If these credentials are satisfactory to the state entomologist, the director, and
      the Commissioner, the state entomologist shall, upon payment by the nursery or dealer
      of the fee set out in subsection (2) of this section, issue it a license authorizing
      it to do business in the state.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 249. Trees, Plants, Weeds, and Pests›General Provisions›KY REV ST 249.010. Definitions for chapter
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 249. Trees, Plants, Weeds, and Pests › General Provisions › KY REV ST 249.010. Definitions for chapter
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 249.010. Definitions for chapter (2023)
content: As used in this chapter, unless the context requires otherwise:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 248. Tobacco›KY REV ST 248.450. Equipment used for transporting tobacco during weighing operation to be of uniform weight; copy of section to be posted in scale office
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 248. Tobacco › KY REV ST 248.450. Equipment used for transporting tobacco during weighing operation to be of uniform weight; copy of section to be posted in scale office
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 248.450. Equipment used for transporting tobacco during weighing operation to be of uniform weight; copy of section to be posted in scale office (2023)
content:
(1)  In each tobacco warehouse, redryer, prize room, or company, all pieces of each
      type of equipment used for transporting baskets of tobacco during a weighing operation
      in which the quantity value of the tobacco in the basket is determined shall be of
      uniform weight.  In any case where the equipment being used for that purpose is not the property
      of the warehouse, redryer, prize room, or company in which the weighing operation
      is taking place, the weighman shall use the same tare as that set by the Division
      of Regulation and Inspection.  In every weighing operation involving the same basket, the basket tare shall be
      the same as that originally determined by the Division of Regulation and Inspection.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 249. Trees, Plants, Weeds, and Pests›Division of Environmental Services›KY REV ST 249.400. Definitions for KRS 249.400. to § 249.430
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 249. Trees, Plants, Weeds, and Pests › Division of Environmental Services › KY REV ST 249.400. Definitions for KRS 249.400. to § 249.430
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 249.400. Definitions for KRS 249.400. to § 249.430 (2023)
content: As used inKRS 249.400to249.430unless the context otherwise requires:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 249. Trees, Plants, Weeds, and Pests›General Provisions›KY REV ST 249.020. State entomologist; deputy; inspectors
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 249. Trees, Plants, Weeds, and Pests › General Provisions › KY REV ST 249.020. State entomologist; deputy; inspectors
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 249.020. State entomologist; deputy; inspectors (2023)
content:
(1)  The chair of the Department of Entomology of the agricultural experiment station
      at the University of Kentucky shall be the state entomologist.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 249. Trees, Plants, Weeds, and Pests›General Provisions›KY REV ST 249.005. Purpose of group of sections within chapter
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 249. Trees, Plants, Weeds, and Pests › General Provisions › KY REV ST 249.005. Purpose of group of sections within chapter
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 249.005. Purpose of group of sections within chapter (2023)
content:
The purpose of this section,KRS 249.010,249.020,249.030,249.040,249.050,249.060,249.070,249.090,249.100,249.101,249.102,249.103,249.104, and249.105is to prevent the introduction and dissemination within this Commonwealth of insect
   pests, plant diseases, and weeds and to provide for their repression and control.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 249. Trees, Plants, Weeds, and Pests›General Provisions›KY REV ST 249.030. Authority for administrative regulations; publication of data
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 249. Trees, Plants, Weeds, and Pests › General Provisions › KY REV ST 249.030. Authority for administrative regulations; publication of data
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 249.030. Authority for administrative regulations; publication of data (2023)
content:
(1)  The state entomologist, with the advice and consent of the director and the Commissioner,
      may promulgate, modify, and enforce administrative regulations and orders needed to
      carry outKRS 249.020to249.100.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 249. Trees, Plants, Weeds, and Pests›General Provisions›KY REV ST 249.050. Inspection of articles and premises; diseased plants to be destroyed; hindering inspection prohibited
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 249. Trees, Plants, Weeds, and Pests › General Provisions › KY REV ST 249.050. Inspection of articles and premises; diseased plants to be destroyed; hindering inspection prohibited
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 249.050. Inspection of articles and premises; diseased plants to be destroyed; hindering inspection prohibited (2023)
content:
(1)  Whenever the state entomologist, his deputy, or a nursery inspector has reason
      to believe or is credibly informed that at any place within the state there has been
      introduced, or offered for sale, trees, plants, or parts of plants infected or infested
      with diseases or destructive pests that are likely to spread, he shall investigate
      the suspected articles and premises.  If they are found so infested or infected, he shall notify the owner or possessor,
      in writing, of the nature of the infestation, specifying the insects, weeds, or diseases
      that have been found, and demand that within a reasonable specified time the affected
      articles or premises be disinfected, or destroyed by fire, under the direction of
      the state entomologist, his deputy, or a nursery inspector, and at the expense of
      the owner or possessor.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 249. Trees, Plants, Weeds, and Pests›General Provisions›KY REV ST 249.040. Establishment of quarantines
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 249. Trees, Plants, Weeds, and Pests › General Provisions › KY REV ST 249.040. Establishment of quarantines
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 249.040. Establishment of quarantines (2023)
content:
The state entomologist shall, with the advice and consent of the director and the
   Commissioner, establish and maintain quarantines against the importation into this
   state and against the transportation within this state, of any trees, plants, and
   parts of plants, whether nursery-grown or not, from any state or from any county within
   the state where the plants or parts of plants are known to be affected with dangerous
   insect pests or plant diseases.  He shall designate in announcements of quarantines the area quarantined, whether
   it constitutes a part of this state or of some other state.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 249. Trees, Plants, Weeds, and Pests›General Provisions›KY REV ST 249.080. Entomologist to issue certificate for stock free from insects and fungus
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 249. Trees, Plants, Weeds, and Pests › General Provisions › KY REV ST 249.080. Entomologist to issue certificate for stock free from insects and fungus
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 249.080. Entomologist to issue certificate for stock free from insects and fungus (2023)
content:
When the state entomologist examines any trees, vines, plants or other nursery stock
   and finds the stock free from dangerously injurious insect and fungus enemies, he
   shall make out and deliver to the owner of the stock a certificate stating that he
   has inspected the stock and that he believes it to be free from dangerously injurious
   insect and fungus enemies.  He shall keep in his office, for the information of anyone interested, copies of
   all valid certificates issued by him.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 249. Trees, Plants, Weeds, and Pests›General Provisions›KY REV ST 249.100. Plants to bear inspection certificate
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 249. Trees, Plants, Weeds, and Pests › General Provisions › KY REV ST 249.100. Plants to bear inspection certificate
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 249.100. Plants to bear inspection certificate (2023)
content:
Trees, plants, or parts of plants, whether nursery-grown or not, that are sold, shipped,
   or transported into this state shall bear a copy of a certificate of inspection from
   a state or United States government inspector.  Transportation companies within the state shall notify the state entomologist at
   once when the trees or plants are received by them without a valid certificate.  Nursery stock or other trees, plants, or parts of plants shipped into this state
   in violation of a state or United States quarantine may be seized and destroyed or
   returned to the shipper at the expense of the owner or possessor.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 249. Trees, Plants, Weeds, and Pests›General Provisions›KY REV ST 249.104. False declaration of acreage and concealment of nursery stock prohibited
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 249. Trees, Plants, Weeds, and Pests › General Provisions › KY REV ST 249.104. False declaration of acreage and concealment of nursery stock prohibited
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 249.104. False declaration of acreage and concealment of nursery stock prohibited (2023)
content:
No person shall make a false declaration of acreage or conceal any nursery stock from
   inspection.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 249. Trees, Plants, Weeds, and Pests›General Provisions›KY REV ST 249.101. Nursery records; prohibitions
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 249. Trees, Plants, Weeds, and Pests › General Provisions › KY REV ST 249.101. Nursery records; prohibitions
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 249.101. Nursery records; prohibitions (2023)
content:
A nurseryperson and nursery dealer shall maintain for one (1) year records of plant
   purchases, acquisitions, sales, or other distributions, excluding retail sales, and
   make the records available upon request to the state entomologist for inspection.  No person shall withhold records, keep or file false records, inaccurately alter
   that person's own records, or present the department any materially false records
   requested for the administration of this section,KRS 249.005,249.010,249.020,249.030,249.040,249.050,249.060,249.070,249.090,249.100,249.102,249.103,249.104, and249.105.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 249. Trees, Plants, Weeds, and Pests›General Provisions›KY REV ST 249.103. Nursery dealer's license; application; exemption
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 249. Trees, Plants, Weeds, and Pests › General Provisions › KY REV ST 249.103. Nursery dealer's license; application; exemption
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 249.103. Nursery dealer's license; application; exemption (2023)
content:
Every nursery dealer engaged in selling nursery stock in this state shall, before
   selling, offering for sale, or delivering any stock, make annual application to the
   state entomologist and obtain a nursery dealer's license as provided in this section,KRS 249.005,249.010,249.020,249.030,249.040,249.050,249.060,249.070,249.090,249.100,249.101,249.102,249.104, and249.105.  A separate license shall be required for each location and the license shall be
   prominently displayed at each place of business.  A licensed nurseryperson who is also acting as a nursery dealer at the same location
   shall be exempt from procuring the nursery dealer's license.  The nursery dealer's certificate shall expire on December 31 of each year.  An application shall be made on forms to be furnished by the office of the state
   entomologist.  The nursery dealer or agency is required to provide to the state entomologist the
   source of nursery stock offered for sale and this stock shall originate from a certified
   nursery.  It shall be accompanied by a valid certificate of inspection of a federal or state
   inspector.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 249. Trees, Plants, Weeds, and Pests›General Provisions›KY REV ST 249.350. Control and elimination of mosquitoes; duty of Commissioner
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 249. Trees, Plants, Weeds, and Pests › General Provisions › KY REV ST 249.350. Control and elimination of mosquitoes; duty of Commissioner
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 249.350. Control and elimination of mosquitoes; duty of Commissioner (2023)
content: (1)  As used in this section, unless the context requires otherwise:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 249. Trees, Plants, Weeds, and Pests›General Provisions›KY REV ST 249.090. Shipments to be accompanied by inspection certificate or license
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 249. Trees, Plants, Weeds, and Pests › General Provisions › KY REV ST 249.090. Shipments to be accompanied by inspection certificate or license
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 249.090. Shipments to be accompanied by inspection certificate or license (2023)
content:
Whenever a resident nurseryperson or nursery dealer ships or delivers nursery stock,
   he shall send on each package or shipment so shipped or delivered a printed copy of
   the certificate or license issued to him by the state entomologist.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 249. Trees, Plants, Weeds, and Pests›General Provisions›KY REV ST 249.102. Authority to issue permit for shipment of injurious plant pests
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 249. Trees, Plants, Weeds, and Pests › General Provisions › KY REV ST 249.102. Authority to issue permit for shipment of injurious plant pests
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 249.102. Authority to issue permit for shipment of injurious plant pests (2023)
content:
When application is made, the state entomologist may issue a permit for shipment into
   or within the Commonwealth of injurious plant pests for research or diagnostic purposes.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 249. Trees, Plants, Weeds, and Pests›General Provisions›KY REV ST 249.105. Inspection of shipments
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 249. Trees, Plants, Weeds, and Pests › General Provisions › KY REV ST 249.105. Inspection of shipments
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 249.105. Inspection of shipments (2023)
content:
All shipments of nursery stock entering the state, as well as intrastate shipments,
   may be inspected in transit or at their destination in order to determine whether
   or not they are moving in compliance with the provisions of this section,KRS 249.005,249.010,249.020,249.030,249.040,249.050,249.060,249.070,249.090,249.100,249.101,249.102,249.103, and249.104.  Factors influencing the decision to inspect nursery stock include origin of plant
   material, destination of and probable distribution subsequently, whether or not a
   quarantine or other requirements exist relative to either geographic area, plant species,
   or pests, and personnel and budgetary restrictions.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 249. Trees, Plants, Weeds, and Pests›Division of Environmental Services›KY REV ST 249.410. Division of Environmental Services; supervision
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 249. Trees, Plants, Weeds, and Pests › Division of Environmental Services › KY REV ST 249.410. Division of Environmental Services; supervision
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 249.410. Division of Environmental Services; supervision (2023)
content:
The Division of Environmental Services in the Department of Agriculture shall be under
   the supervision of the Commissioner and shall consist of personnel determined and
   appointed by him.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 252. Apiaries›KY REV ST 252.990. Penalties
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 252. Apiaries › KY REV ST 252.990. Penalties
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 252.990. Penalties (2023)
content:
Any person violating any of the provisions ofKRS 252.180to252.240shall be punished by a fine of not more than one hundred dollars ($100).  In addition to the penalty hereinbefore provided, bees or combs, used hives, or
   other used apiary appliances brought into this state in violation of the provisions
   ofKRS 252.180to252.240shall be confiscated and destroyed.

title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 249. Trees, Plants, Weeds, and Pests › Division of Environmental Services › KY REV ST 249.420. Duties
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 249.420. Duties (2023)
content:
In addition to its other duties, the division shall promote and sponsor programs to
   control pests and noxious weeds, shall enforce related regulatory and service measures
   assigned to the department, and may conduct a pest and noxious weed control program.

content:
(1)  Any person who violates any of the provisions ofKRS 249.020to249.100or hinders the carrying out of any of the provisions of those sections shall be fined
      not less than twenty-five dollars ($25) nor more than five hundred dollars ($500).

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 252. Apiaries›KY REV ST 252.240. Right of access to premises to enforce law
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 252. Apiaries › KY REV ST 252.240. Right of access to premises to enforce law
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 252.240. Right of access to premises to enforce law (2023)
content:
For the purposes ofKRS 252.180to252.240the Commissioner or his duly authorized representatives shall have access and egress
   to any apiary or any premises, buildings or other place, public or private, in which
   he has reason to believe that bees, honey, wax, used hives or used appliances are
   kept, and any and all persons who shall resist, or hinder the Commissioner or his
   duly authorized representative in the discharge of his duties under the provisions
   ofKRS 252.180to252.240shall be guilty of a violation ofKRS 252.180to252.240, provided, however, that no occupied dwelling may be entered without a search warrant.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 252. Apiaries›KY REV ST 252.190. Rules and regulations for control of bee diseases; destruction of infected bees, hives, etc.; reporting and publication of information; registration fees; failure to comply a violation of statutes
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 252. Apiaries › KY REV ST 252.190. Rules and regulations for control of bee diseases; destruction of infected bees, hives, etc.; reporting and publication of information; registration fees; failure to comply a violation of statutes
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 252.190. Rules and regulations for control of bee diseases; destruction of infected bees, hives, etc.; reporting and publication of information; registration fees; failure to comply a violation of statutes (2023)
content:
(1)  The Commissioner may make and enforce such rules and orders as in his judgment
      may be necessary to control, eradicate or prevent the introduction, spread or dissemination
      of any and all bee diseases.  In the control or eradication of dangerous bee diseases the Commissioner may destroy
      by burning or otherwise any infected bees, hives, honey or appliances that he may
      deem necessary for such control or eradication, without remuneration to the owner.  Such infected bees, hives, honey and appliances shall be deemed a public nuisance.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 252. Apiaries›KY REV ST 252.185. Kentucky beekeeping fund
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 252. Apiaries › KY REV ST 252.185. Kentucky beekeeping fund
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 252.185. Kentucky beekeeping fund (2023)
content:
(1)  The Kentucky beekeeping fund is hereby established in the State Treasury as a
      separate trust and agency account to be administered by the Department of Agriculture.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 252. Apiaries›KY REV ST 252.210. Appeal from order of Commissioner or state apiarist; hearing
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 252. Apiaries › KY REV ST 252.210. Appeal from order of Commissioner or state apiarist; hearing
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 252.210. Appeal from order of Commissioner or state apiarist; hearing (2023)
content:
(1)  Any person in interest or affected by any order of the Commissioner or state
      apiarist may appeal therefrom to the Commissioner within five (5) days of the service
      of the order upon him setting forth in writing specifically and in full detail the
      order on which a hearing is desired, and every reason why the order is deemed unreasonable.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 252. Apiaries›KY REV ST 252.180. State apiarist and deputies; police powers
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 252. Apiaries › KY REV ST 252.180. State apiarist and deputies; police powers
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 252.180. State apiarist and deputies; police powers (2023)
content:
The Commissioner may appoint a competent person as state apiarist, and such number
   of deputy state apiarists as may be necessary to carry out the provisions ofKRS 252.180to252.240, and fix their compensation.  The state apiarist and deputy state apiarists shall be vested with the powers of
   police officers in the enforcement of the provisions ofKRS 252.180to252.240.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 252. Apiaries›KY REV ST 252.200. Quarantine
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 252. Apiaries › KY REV ST 252.200. Quarantine
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 252.200. Quarantine (2023)
content:
For the purposes ofKRS 252.180to252.240the Commissioner may establish and maintain quarantines prohibiting the shipment
   into or within the state, or any subdivision thereof of any bees, queen bees, used
   hives or any part thereof, used appliances or any material capable of transmitting
   any bee diseases, for such periods and under such conditions as he may deem necessary
   to control, eradicate or prevent the introduction, spread, or dissemination of any
   and all bee diseases, giving such notice thereof as may be prescribed by the Commissioner,
   and during the existence of such order no person shall remove or ship from such area
   any such material whatever except by special permission or order of the Commissioner;
   provided, however, that before the Commissioner shall promulgate the order of quarantine
   as provided in this section, the Commissioner shall, after due notice to interested
   persons, give a public hearing under such rules and regulations as the Commissioner
   shall prescribe, at which hearing any interested person may appear and be heard, either
   in person or by attorney.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 253. Marks and Brands of Livestock›KY REV ST 253.020. Approval of brands; conflicts; report
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 253. Marks and Brands of Livestock › KY REV ST 253.020. Approval of brands; conflicts; report
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 253.020. Approval of brands; conflicts; report (2023)
content:
The board shall approve brands for registration and issue certificates of approval,
   and shall serve as an adjudicating committee in the matter of deciding and determining
   conflicts of brands and its decision shall be final.  It shall publish a state report containing a facsimile of each and every brand and
   mark that is registered with the board, showing the owner's name and address, together
   with pertinent laws, rules and regulations pertaining to the registration and reregistration
   of brands.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 253. Marks and Brands of Livestock›KY REV ST 253.030. Records of brands; kept and furnished
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 253. Marks and Brands of Livestock › KY REV ST 253.030. Records of brands; kept and furnished
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 253.030. Records of brands; kept and furnished (2023)
content:
The board is the legal custodian of any county record that may have been maintained
   under prior programs and shall upon request furnish a certified copy of the record
   of any brand appearing in the county brand record books and shall charge a fee of
   one dollar ($1) for each such brand.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 253. Marks and Brands of Livestock›KY REV ST 253.070. Funds from livestock of doubtful ownership held; forfeiture
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 253. Marks and Brands of Livestock › KY REV ST 253.070. Funds from livestock of doubtful ownership held; forfeiture
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 253.070. Funds from livestock of doubtful ownership held; forfeiture (2023)
content:
Any peace officer of the state may order funds derived from the sale of livestock
   of questionable ownership held until ownership is established.  If ownership is not established within thirty (30) days, the person holding the
   funds shall remit them to the board, which shall hold the funds for one (1) year.  If the title to the livestock in question is not ascertained, then the funds shall
   be deposited in and become a part of the State Department of Agriculture trust fund.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 253. Marks and Brands of Livestock›KY REV ST 253.080. Brands reserved to state
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 253. Marks and Brands of Livestock › KY REV ST 253.080. Brands reserved to state
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 253.080. Brands reserved to state (2023)
content:
There is hereby reserved to the State of Kentucky the brands of “B” and “T” on the
   jaw of cattle, and “V” and “AV” on the body, and it shall be unlawful for any person
   other than authorized agents of the State Board of Agriculture to use any of these
   brands.  Cattle carrying the “B” on the jaw shall be recognized as reactors to brucellosis
   abortus (Bangs disease). Cattle carrying the brand “T” on the jaw shall be recognized as reactors to bovine
   tuberculosis.  Cattle carrying the brand “V” or “AV” on the body are officially calfhood vaccinated.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 253. Marks and Brands of Livestock›KY REV ST 253.060. State report evidence of ownership
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 253. Marks and Brands of Livestock › KY REV ST 253.060. State report evidence of ownership
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 253.060. State report evidence of ownership (2023)
content:
Brands appearing in the current edition of the state report, or supplements thereto,
   shall be prima facie evidence of ownership and take precedence over brands of like
   and kind should the question of ownership arise.  An owner whose brand does not appear in the state report, or a supplement thereto,
   shall produce evidence to establish his title to the property in the event of controversy.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 253. Marks and Brands of Livestock›KY REV ST 253.040. Registration of brand; application; fee
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 253. Marks and Brands of Livestock › KY REV ST 253.040. Registration of brand; application; fee
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 253.040. Registration of brand; application; fee (2023)
content:
Any application for the registration of a mark or brand with the board shall be on
   a form prescribed by the board and shall be accompanied by a fee of ten dollars ($10)
   for each mark or brand to be registered.  Any such application for a brand shall show the brand location to the following
   body regions of animals:  neck, shoulder, rib and hip.  When a requested brand has been filed previously, the Commissioner and the applicant
   shall agree on a second choice of brand and body location.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 253. Marks and Brands of Livestock›KY REV ST 253.090. Transfer or sale of registered brands; fee
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 253. Marks and Brands of Livestock › KY REV ST 253.090. Transfer or sale of registered brands; fee
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 253.090. Transfer or sale of registered brands; fee (2023)
content:
Only brands appearing in the current edition of the state report, or a supplement
   thereto, shall be subject to sale, assignment, transfer, devise or bequest.  The transfer of title must be recorded with the Commissioner.  The fee for recording the transfer of title is one dollar ($1).

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 253. Marks and Brands of Livestock›KY REV ST 253.050. Report of registered brands; registration; fee; records
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 253. Marks and Brands of Livestock › KY REV ST 253.050. Report of registered brands; registration; fee; records
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 253.050. Report of registered brands; registration; fee; records (2023)
content:
The board shall publish at such times as it deems necessary a report of the brands
   that have been registered.  Every five (5) years thereafter all brands shall be reregistered.  The Commissioner shall notify each brand owner and provide the necessary forms.  A reregistration fee of five dollars ($5) for each brand shall be charged for the
   ensuing five (5) year period or fraction thereof.  The county clerk and the sheriff of each county, or authority approved by the board
   shall receive all brand reports without cost and the books shall remain as a part
   of the permanent records of their respective offices.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 253. Marks and Brands of Livestock›KY REV ST 253.130. Unauthorized use of registered brand; misdemeanor
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 253. Marks and Brands of Livestock › KY REV ST 253.130. Unauthorized use of registered brand; misdemeanor
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 253.130. Unauthorized use of registered brand; misdemeanor (2023)
content:
Any person who knowingly places upon any livestock a mark or brand which has not been
   registered with the board shall, if such mark or brand duplicates one that is registered
   with the board, be guilty of a misdemeanor.  Such duplication shall be the use of a similar brand, used in any position on the
   livestock designated for the use of a registered brand, such as the neck, shoulder,
   rib or hip.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 253. Marks and Brands of Livestock›KY REV ST 253.110. Duties of Commissioner; administrative regulations
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 253. Marks and Brands of Livestock › KY REV ST 253.110. Duties of Commissioner; administrative regulations
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 253.110. Duties of Commissioner; administrative regulations (2023)
content:
Except as otherwise provided in this chapter and except as may be directed by the
   board, the powers, duties, and functions vested by this chapter in the board shall
   be exercised and performed by the Commissioner.  The board may promulgate administrative regulations and hold administrative hearings,
   in accordance with KRS Chapter 13B, as required to carry out the provisions and intent
   of this chapter.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 253. Marks and Brands of Livestock›KY REV ST 253.100. Transfer of branded animals in writing
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 253. Marks and Brands of Livestock › KY REV ST 253.100. Transfer of branded animals in writing
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 253.100. Transfer of branded animals in writing (2023)
content:
All persons selling livestock branded with their brand, or brand and mark, recorded
   in a current state report or a supplement thereto, shall, upon request of a purchaser
   of such livestock, execute a written transfer of ownership to the purchaser.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 253. Marks and Brands of Livestock›KY REV ST 253.120. Fees; how deposited
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 253. Marks and Brands of Livestock › KY REV ST 253.120. Fees; how deposited
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 253.120. Fees; how deposited (2023)
content:
All fees charged and collected under the provisions of this chapter shall be deposited
   in the State Department of Agriculture trust fund.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 253. Marks and Brands of Livestock›KY REV ST 253.990. Penalty
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 253. Marks and Brands of Livestock › KY REV ST 253.990. Penalty
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 253.990. Penalty (2023)
content:
Any person who knowingly alters or defaces the marks or brands on any livestock not
   his own, without the consent of the owner, shall be fined not more than two hundred
   dollars ($200), or imprisoned for not more than six (6) months, or both.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 256. Fences›KY REV ST 256.020. Agreement for division fence; effect
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 256. Fences › KY REV ST 256.020. Agreement for division fence; effect
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 256.020. Agreement for division fence; effect (2023)
content:
(1)  Persons owning adjoining lands may agree to erect division fences between them
      and keep them in repair.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 256. Fences›KY REV ST 256.120. Railroad or adjoining owner may require other to erect portion of fence
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 256. Fences › KY REV ST 256.120. Railroad or adjoining owner may require other to erect portion of fence
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 256.120. Railroad or adjoining owner may require other to erect portion of fence (2023)
content:
(1)  When a railroad or the owner of lands adjoining the railroad right-of-way constructs
      a good lawful fence on the division line between the right-of-way and the lands adjoining
      the right-of-way for one-half (1/2) the length of the line, and the other party has
      not constructed the fence on the line for half the length, nor has paid a sum sufficient
      to construct the fence, or any sum by agreement in lieu of such a sum, the party who
      has constructed the fence shall, in writing, notify the party in default of the length
      of the division line between them, and that the party serving the notice has constructed
      a good lawful fence on the division line for one-half (1/2) the length.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 256. Fences›KY REV ST 256.030. Adjoining owners to maintain fence; liability for trespassing livestock
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 256. Fences › KY REV ST 256.030. Adjoining owners to maintain fence; liability for trespassing livestock
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 256.030. Adjoining owners to maintain fence; liability for trespassing livestock (2023)
content:
(1)  When a division fence exists by agreement, acquiescence or compulsion, under
      this section orKRS 256.042, each party shall keep a lawful fence on his portion of the line.  If one party fails to do so, the person failing shall be liable for all the damages
      to trees, grass, grain, crops, livestock or land the other party may sustain from
      the trespassing of livestock over the division fence at the point at which the party
      failing was bound to keep in repair.

title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 257. Livestock and Poultry Disease Control › KY REV ST 257.010. Definitions for chapter

content: As used in this chapter, unless the context requires otherwise:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 256. Fences›KY REV ST 256.042. Action to require construction or replacement of a farm boundary line fence; apportionment of cost; enforcement of lien
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 256. Fences › KY REV ST 256.042. Action to require construction or replacement of a farm boundary line fence; apportionment of cost; enforcement of lien
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 256.042. Action to require construction or replacement of a farm boundary line fence; apportionment of cost; enforcement of lien (2023)
content:
(1)  The District Court shall have exclusive jurisdiction over all actions arising
      under this section orKRS 256.030.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 256. Fences›KY REV ST 256.045. Short title
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 256. Fences › KY REV ST 256.045. Short title
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 256.045. Short title (2023)
content: KRS 256.030and256.042shall be cited as the Kentucky Boundary Line Fence Act.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 256. Fences›KY REV ST 256.090. Liability when livestock break owner’s fence and enter uninclosed land
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 256. Fences › KY REV ST 256.090. Liability when livestock break owner’s fence and enter uninclosed land
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 256.090. Liability when livestock break owner’s fence and enter uninclosed land (2023)
content:
If the owner or bailee of livestock has a lawful fence, and his or her livestock break
   through or over the fence and upon the premises of another which are not enclosed
   by a lawful fence, he or she shall not be responsible for the first trespass, but
   shall be liable for all subsequent trespasses.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 258. Animal Control and Protection›KY REV ST 258.005. Definitions for KRS 258.005. to § 258.087
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 258. Animal Control and Protection › KY REV ST 258.005. Definitions for KRS 258.005. to § 258.087
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 258.005. Definitions for KRS 258.005. to § 258.087 (2023)
content: As used inKRS 258.005to258.087, unless the context requires otherwise:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 256. Fences›KY REV ST 256.100. Railroad treated as other landowners, in respect to fences
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 256. Fences › KY REV ST 256.100. Railroad treated as other landowners, in respect to fences
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 256.100. Railroad treated as other landowners, in respect to fences (2023)
content:
A railroad shall be on equal terms and obligations with other landowners owning adjoining
   lands in this state.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 256. Fences›KY REV ST 256.110. Railroad and adjoining owner to maintain fence
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 256. Fences › KY REV ST 256.110. Railroad and adjoining owner to maintain fence
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 256.110. Railroad and adjoining owner to maintain fence (2023)
content:
Except as otherwise provided inKRS 256.130,256.160and256.170, every railroad shall construct and maintain a good lawful fence on one-half (1/2)
   of the distance of the division line between its right-of-way and the adjoining lands,
   and every owner of lands adjoining the right-of-way of the railroad shall construct
   and maintain a good lawful fence on one-half (1/2) of the distance of the division
   between those lands and the right-of-way.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 256. Fences›KY REV ST 256.140. Owner who erected entire fence may remove half
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 256. Fences › KY REV ST 256.140. Owner who erected entire fence may remove half
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 256.140. Owner who erected entire fence may remove half (2023)
content:
Any landowner who has already erected a lawful fence along the whole distance of the
   division line between his land and the right-of-way of a railroad may, in the absence
   of any agreement to the contrary, move one-half (1/2) of the fence, after giving three
   (3) months' notice to the railroad of his intention to move one-half (1/2) of the
   fence.  Notice shall be served on the nearest station agent.  The landowner shall not, in removing such part of his fence, cause the railroad
   to erect watergaps or erect fences at points where the grade of the roadbed is of
   such character as may render fencing unnecessary.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 256. Fences›KY REV ST 256.990. Penalties
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 256. Fences › KY REV ST 256.990. Penalties
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 256.990. Penalties (2023)
content:
Any person who violates subsection (3) ofKRS 256.120shall be fined one dollar ($1) for each day, after the expiration of the time in
   which the fence should have been constructed, until the fence is constructed.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 256. Fences›KY REV ST 256.080. Liability when livestock enter through lawful fence; lien on livestock
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 256. Fences › KY REV ST 256.080. Liability when livestock enter through lawful fence; lien on livestock
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 256.080. Liability when livestock enter through lawful fence; lien on livestock (2023)
content:
If any livestock enter into any land over or through a lawful fence, the owner or
   manager of the livestock shall for the first trespass be liable to the owner or occupant
   of that land for damages to his or her trees, grass, grain, crops, livestock or land
   as he or she may have sustained by the entry of the livestock, and for every subsequent
   trespass by the livestock of the same owner, double damages.  After giving the owner or manager of the livestock at least five (5) days' notice,
   in writing, of the fact of two (2) previous breaches into the same enclosure by the
   livestock of the same owner, the owner or occupant of the enclosure shall have a lien
   on the livestock to indemnify him or her on account of any damages sustained by the
   third or any subsequent trespasses of those livestock and may enforce his or her lien
   by action as in cases of a mortgage lien.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 256. Fences›KY REV ST 256.130. Railroad to erect entire fence if given right-of-way
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 256. Fences › KY REV ST 256.130. Railroad to erect entire fence if given right-of-way
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 256.130. Railroad to erect entire fence if given right-of-way (2023)
content:
When the owner of any lands, or any immediate or remote grantor or vendor of the owner,
   has given to a railroad, after February 25, 1893, a right-of-way through the lands
   free of charge, the entire fencing on the division lines between such lands and the
   right-of-way of the railroad shall be done by and at the cost of the railroad.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 256. Fences›KY REV ST 256.160. Exemptions from KRS 256.100. to § 256.170
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 256. Fences › KY REV ST 256.160. Exemptions from KRS 256.100. to § 256.170
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 256.160. Exemptions from KRS 256.100. to § 256.170 (2023)
content: KRS 256.100to256.170shall not:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 256. Fences›KY REV ST 256.150. Railroad to erect cattle guards
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 256. Fences › KY REV ST 256.150. Railroad to erect cattle guards
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 256.150. Railroad to erect cattle guards (2023)
content:
All railroads shall erect and maintain cattle guards at all terminal points of fences
   constructed along their lines, except at points where the lines are not required to
   be fenced on both sides, and at public crossings.  Where there is a private passway across the railroad, the landowner for whose benefit
   the passway is kept open shall bear one-half (1/2) of the expense of cattle guards
   and gates, and shall erect the gates.  The railroad shall erect the cattle guards.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 256. Fences›KY REV ST 256.170. Parallel railroads need not have fence between them
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 256. Fences › KY REV ST 256.170. Parallel railroads need not have fence between them
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 256.170. Parallel railroads need not have fence between them (2023)
content:
Where the lands or rights-of-way of two (2) railroads adjoin and run parallel with
   no tillable or grazing lands between their rights-of-way, the railroad need not build
   any fence along its side next to the other railroad, unless the other railroad has
   first built its half along the division line.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 258. Animal Control and Protection›KY REV ST 258.055. Quarantine in case of rabies epidemic; emergency vaccinations
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 258. Animal Control and Protection › KY REV ST 258.055. Quarantine in case of rabies epidemic; emergency vaccinations
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 258.055. Quarantine in case of rabies epidemic; emergency vaccinations (2023)
content:
If a local board of health has reason to believe or has been notified by the Cabinet
   for Health and Family Services that there is danger that rabies may spread within
   the county, the board shall publish a notice requiring owners of specified animals
   in the affected area of the county to confine the animals for any periods that may
   be necessary to prevent the spread of rabies.  If it is deemed advisable in the interest of public health, the local board of health
   shall order all specified animals in the affected area to be vaccinated against rabies,
   except animals that have been vaccinated within the past six (6) months under the
   provisions ofKRS 258.005to258.087.  If the local board fails or neglects to order a vaccination, the Cabinet for Health
   and Family Services shall do so.  The Cabinet for Health and Family Services may aid the local health department in
   the execution of any emergency vaccinations.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 258. Animal Control and Protection›KY REV ST 258.085. Quarantine of animals suspected of having rabies; destruction of animal in lieu of quarantine; exceptions; head of animal suspected of being rabid to be sent to laboratory
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 258. Animal Control and Protection › KY REV ST 258.085. citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 258.085. Quarantine of animals suspected of having rabies; destruction of animal in lieu of quarantine; exceptions; head of animal suspected of being rabid to be sent to laboratory (2023)
content:
(1)  (a) A health officer or his agent shall have the authority to quarantine for
         a period not to exceed:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 258. Animal Control and Protection›KY REV ST 258.035. Dog, cat, or ferret vaccinated in other state need not be revaccinated
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 258. Animal Control and Protection › KY REV ST 258.035. Dog, cat, or ferret vaccinated in other state need not be revaccinated
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 258.035. Dog, cat, or ferret vaccinated in other state need not be revaccinated (2023)
content:
Any owner who has had his dog, cat, or ferret vaccinated against rabies in another
   state by the proper authority shall not be required to have the dog, cat, or ferret
   revaccinated when brought into this state provided the requirements of the state under
   which the vaccination was made were of a standard not lower than those required in
   this state, and provided further that the dog wears a tag affixed to its collar or
