   harness bearing the year of the vaccination and the owner of the cat or ferret shows
   proof of a valid rabies vaccination.  One (1) year after the date of the vaccination, the dog, cat, or ferret shall be
   revaccinated unless provided otherwise by administrative regulations promulgated by
   the secretary for health and family services.  The secretary for health and family services may promulgate administrative regulations
   governing the matter of reciprocity with other states.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 258. Animal Control and Protection›KY REV ST 258.015. Dogs, cats, and ferrets to be vaccinated against rabies; issuance and distribution of certificates; tags for dogs; requirements for compliance by qualified persons; cat and ferret owners
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 258. Animal Control and Protection › KY REV ST 258.015. Dogs, cats, and ferrets to be vaccinated against rabies; issuance and distribution of certificates; tags for dogs; requirements for compliance by qualified persons; cat and ferret owners
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 258.015. Dogs, cats, and ferrets to be vaccinated against rabies; issuance and distribution of certificates; tags for dogs; requirements for compliance by qualified persons; cat and ferret owners (2023)
content:
(1)  Every owner shall have his dog, cat, or ferret initially vaccinated against rabies
      by the age of four (4) months and revaccinated at the expiration of the immunization
      period as certified by the veterinarian.  The veterinarian who vaccinates a dog, cat, or ferret shall issue to the owner a
      vaccination certificate on a form approved by the Cabinet for Health and Family Services.  The vaccination certificate shall be prepared and issued in duplicate, one (1) copy
      to be retained by the issuing veterinarian and one (1) copy to be given to the owner
      of the dog, cat, or ferret vaccinated.  Each certificate shall bear the name and address of the veterinarian who issued
      it.  The veterinarian shall also furnish each dog owner with a rabies tag bearing a serial
      number corresponding to the vaccination certificate with the year of immunization.  The tag shall be affixed to a collar or harness furnished by the owner and shall
      be worn by the dog for which the tag was issued.  No one except the owner or his duly authorized agent shall remove the tag.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 258. Animal Control and Protection›KY REV ST 258.075. Secretary for health and family services to administer rabies law
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 258. Animal Control and Protection › KY REV ST 258.075. Secretary for health and family services to administer rabies law
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 258.075. Secretary for health and family services to administer rabies law (2023)
content:
The secretary for health and family services may administer the provisions ofKRS 258.005to258.087through the local health departments and may promulgate any administrative regulations
   and employ such personnel as are necessary to effectuate the purposes ofKRS 258.005to258.087.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 258. Animal Control and Protection›KY REV ST 258.087. Authorization to provide for more stringent regulation of rabies control
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 258. Animal Control and Protection › KY REV ST 258.087. Authorization to provide for more stringent regulation of rabies control
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 258.087. Authorization to provide for more stringent regulation of rabies control (2023)
content:
Any city, county, urban-county, charter county, or consolidated local government may,
   by the adoption of an appropriate ordinance or resolution, provide for more stringent
   regulation of rabies control in dogs, cats, ferrets, and other animals than set forth
   inKRS 258.005to258.087.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 258. Animal Control and Protection›KY REV ST 258.117. Animal Control Advisory Board; purpose; promulgation of administrative regulations; membership
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 258. Animal Control and Protection › KY REV ST 258.117. Animal Control Advisory Board; purpose; promulgation of administrative regulations; membership
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 258.117. Animal Control Advisory Board; purpose; promulgation of administrative regulations; membership (2023)
content:
(1)  The Animal Control Advisory Board is hereby created for the purposes of evaluating
      applications for and reviewing disbursements from the animal control and care fund,
      creating training programs, and other duties relating to animal control and care in
      the counties of the Commonwealth.  The Animal Control Advisory Board shall promulgate administrative regulations to
      carry out the provisions of this section.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 258. Animal Control and Protection›KY REV ST 258.135. Establishment of dog licensing program by county or city ordinance
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 258. Animal Control and Protection › KY REV ST 258.135. Establishment of dog licensing program by county or city ordinance
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 258.135. Establishment of dog licensing program by county or city ordinance (2023)
content:
(1)  The governing body of each county may establish an animal licensing program by
      ordinance.  It shall be the responsibility of each county to administer and enforce its licensing
      program.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 258. Animal Control and Protection›KY REV ST 258.095. Definitions for KRS 258.095. to § 258.500
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 258. Animal Control and Protection › KY REV ST 258.095. Definitions for KRS 258.095. to § 258.500
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 258.095. Definitions for KRS 258.095. to § 258.500 (2023)
content: As used inKRS 258.095to258.500, unless the context requires otherwise:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 258. Animal Control and Protection›KY REV ST 258.065. Physicians to report persons bitten by dogs, cats, ferrets, and other animals; reporting when local health department is closed
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 258. Animal Control and Protection › KY REV ST 258.065. Physicians to report persons bitten by dogs, cats, ferrets, and other animals; reporting when local health department is closed
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 258.065. Physicians to report persons bitten by dogs, cats, ferrets, and other animals; reporting when local health department is closed (2023)
content:
(1)  Except as provided in subsection (2) of this section, every physician shall,
      within twelve (12) hours after his first professional attendance of a person bitten
      by a dog, cat, ferret, or other animal, report to the local health department the
      name, age, sex, and precise location of the person so bitten.  If a child is bitten and no physician attends, the report shall be made by his parents
      or guardian.  If an adult is bitten and no physician attends, he or the person caring for him
      shall make the report.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 258. Animal Control and Protection›KY REV ST 258.043. Mass rabies immunization clinics
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 258. Animal Control and Protection › KY REV ST 258.043. Mass rabies immunization clinics
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 258.043. Mass rabies immunization clinics (2023)
content:
(1)  A local health department may sponsor mass rabies immunization clinics and shall
      contract with local veterinarians to administer the rabies vaccine.  If the services of veterinarians are not available in the area, the local health
      department may contract with other veterinarians.  The cabinet shall promulgate administrative regulations to establish a reasonable
      fee, not to exceed administrative costs of the program, to be charged to the owner
      of each dog, cat, or ferret to help defray the cost of the clinic.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 258. Animal Control and Protection›KY REV ST 258.195. Employment, appointment, or contract with animal control officers; establishment and maintenance of animal shelters; intergovernmental agreements; authority of animal control officers
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 258. Animal Control and Protection › KY REV ST 258.195. Employment, appointment, or contract with animal control officers; establishment and maintenance of animal shelters; intergovernmental agreements; authority of animal control officers
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 258.195. Employment, appointment, or contract with animal control officers; establishment and maintenance of animal shelters; intergovernmental agreements; authority of animal control officers (2023)
content:
(1)  The governing body of each county shall employ, appoint, or contract with an
      animal control officer, or shall contract with an entity that employs, appoints, or
      contracts with an animal control officer, and shall establish and maintain an animal
      shelter as a means of facilitating and administeringKRS 258.095to258.500.  One (1) or more counties may enter into intergovernmental agreements for the establishment
      of regional animal shelters, or may contract with entities authorized to maintain
      sheltering and animal control services.  Animal shelters shall meet the standards provided byKRS 258.119(3)(b)within three (3) years after July 13, 2004.  Governing bodies may adopt additional standards and ordinances related to public
      health, safety, enforcement, and the efficient and appropriate operation of their
      shelters and their animal control programs.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 258. Animal Control and Protection›KY REV ST 258.215. Seizure, impounding, and destruction of dog lacking rabies tag or other identification; holding period before destruction; notice to owner; reclamation of dog, cat, or ferret; fees; quarantine; exemption of hunting dog
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 258. Animal Control and Protection › KY REV ST 258.215. Seizure, impounding, and destruction of dog lacking rabies tag or other identification; holding period before destruction; notice to owner; reclamation of dog, cat, or ferret; fees; quarantine; exemption of hunting dog
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 258.215. Seizure, impounding, and destruction of dog lacking rabies tag or other identification; holding period before destruction; notice to owner; reclamation of dog, cat, or ferret; fees; quarantine; exemption of hunting dog (2023)
content:
(1)  Peace officers or animal control officers shall seize and impound any dog which
      does not bear a valid rabies tag or other legible identification which is found running
      at large.  Any dog which an officer or animal control officer seizes shall be impounded in
      the designated animal shelter of the county and confined in a humane manner.  If, after a reasonable effort, the seizure of an unrestrained dog cannot be made,
      or the dog presents a hazard to public safety or property or has an injury or physical
      condition which causes the dog to suffer, the animal control officer or peace officer
      may immediately destroy the dog by the most reasonable and humane means then available.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 258. Animal Control and Protection›KY REV ST 258.212. Tampering with or removal of domesticated animal's identification prohibited; exceptions; penalty
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 258. Animal Control and Protection › KY REV ST 258.212. Tampering with or removal of domesticated animal's identification prohibited; exceptions; penalty
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 258.212. Tampering with or removal of domesticated animal's identification prohibited; exceptions; penalty (2023)
content:
(1)  No person other than the owner shall tamper with or remove without permission
      an identification tag, chip, locator, or electronic tracking device from a domesticated
      animal of any age, including but not limited to a hound or dog used in the sport of
      hunting.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 258. Animal Control and Protection›KY REV ST 258.119. Animal control and care fund; distribution of moneys; eligibility requirements
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 258. Animal Control and Protection › KY REV ST 258.119. Animal control and care fund; distribution of moneys; eligibility requirements
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 258.119. Animal control and care fund; distribution of moneys; eligibility requirements (2023)
content:
(1)  The “Animal Control and Care Fund” is hereby created as a special fund in the
      State Treasury.  The fund may also receive gifts, grants from public and private sources, state appropriations,
      and federal funds.   Any unallotted or unencumbered balances in this fund shall be invested as provided
      for inKRS 42.500(9).  Income earned from the investments shall be credited to the fund.  Any fund balance at the close of the fiscal year shall not lapse but shall be carried
      forward to the next fiscal year, and moneys in this fund shall be continuously appropriated
      only for the purposes specified in this section.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 258. Animal Control and Protection›KY REV ST 258.225. Peace officers and animal control officers required to perform duties; interference prohibited
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 258. Animal Control and Protection › KY REV ST 258.225. Peace officers and animal control officers required to perform duties; interference prohibited
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 258.225. Peace officers and animal control officers required to perform duties; interference prohibited (2023)
content:
(1)  It shall be unlawful for any peace officer or animal control officer to refuse
      to perform his duties under the provisions of this chapter.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 258. Animal Control and Protection›KY REV ST 258.235. Authority to kill or seize dog; return by court to owner of vicious dog; liability for damage; proceeding by person attacked by dog; disposition of dog after seizure; powers of animal control officer; vicious dog not to run at large
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 258. Animal Control and Protection › KY REV ST 258.235. Authority to kill or seize dog; return by court to owner of vicious dog; liability for damage; proceeding by person attacked by dog; disposition of dog after seizure; powers of animal control officer; vicious dog not to run at large
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 258.235. Authority to kill or seize dog; return by court to owner of vicious dog; liability for damage; proceeding by person attacked by dog; disposition of dog after seizure; powers of animal control officer; vicious dog not to run at large (2023)
content:
(1)  Any person, without liability, may kill or seize any dog which is observed attacking
      any person.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 258. Animal Control and Protection›KY REV ST 258.335. False statements and concealment of facts prohibited
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 258. Animal Control and Protection › KY REV ST 258.335. False statements and concealment of facts prohibited
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 258.335. False statements and concealment of facts prohibited (2023)
content:
It shall be unlawful for any person knowingly to make any false statement or to conceal
   any fact required to be disclosed under any of the provisions of this chapter.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 258. Animal Control and Protection›KY REV ST 258.265. Care and control of dog; destruction of dog running at large at night; exemption for hunting dogs
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 258. Animal Control and Protection › KY REV ST 258.265. Care and control of dog; destruction of dog running at large at night; exemption for hunting dogs
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 258.265. Care and control of dog; destruction of dog running at large at night; exemption for hunting dogs (2023)
content:
(1)  An owner shall exercise proper care and control of his dog to prevent the dog
      from violating any local government nuisance ordinance.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 258. Animal Control and Protection›KY REV ST 258.500. Persons with assistance dogs not to be denied accommodations, transportation, or elevator service; conditions; exemption from licensing fees; denial of emergency medical treatment for assistance dog prohibited
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 258. Animal Control and Protection › KY REV ST 258.500. Persons with assistance dogs not to be denied accommodations, transportation, or elevator service; conditions; exemption from licensing fees; denial of emergency medical treatment for assistance dog prohibited
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 258.500. Persons with assistance dogs not to be denied accommodations, transportation, or elevator service; conditions; exemption from licensing fees; denial of emergency medical treatment for assistance dog prohibited (2023)
content: (1)  As used in subsections (1) to (11) of this section, “person” means a “person with a disability” as defined byKRS 210.770.  “Person” also includes a trainer of an assistance dog.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 258. Animal Control and Protection›KY REV ST 258.245. Dogs with rabies vaccination and identification considered personal property; destruction prohibited
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 258. Animal Control and Protection › KY REV ST 258.245. Dogs with rabies vaccination and identification considered personal property; destruction prohibited
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 258.245. Dogs with rabies vaccination and identification considered personal property; destruction prohibited (2023)
content:
All dogs that have a valid rabies vaccination and bear identification are hereby declared
   to be personal property and subjects of larceny.  Except as provided inKRS 258.235, it shall be unlawful for any person except a peace officer or animal control officer
   to destroy, or attempt to destroy, any dog that bears identification.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 259. Strays and Animals Running at Large›KY REV ST 259.110. Stray equine and stray cattle may be taken up; by whom; when
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 259. Strays and Animals Running at Large › KY REV ST 259.110. Stray equine and stray cattle may be taken up; by whom; when
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 259.110. Stray equine and stray cattle may be taken up; by whom; when (2023)
content:
A stray equine may be taken up and posted by any person or entity if it is found running
   at large outside of its enclosure or if it can be determined from the circumstances
   that its owner has abandoned it.  Stray cattle may be taken up and posted by any freeholder by legal or equitable
   title or by a tenant of an unexpired lease for not less than three (3) years when
   found on his place of residence.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 259. Strays and Animals Running at Large›KY REV ST 259.105. Definitions for chapter
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 259. Strays and Animals Running at Large › KY REV ST 259.105. Definitions for chapter
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 259.105. Definitions for chapter (2023)
content: The following definitions apply in this chapter unless the context otherwise requires:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 258. Animal Control and Protection›KY REV ST 258.505. Use of gunshot as euthanasia
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 258. Animal Control and Protection › KY REV ST 258.505. Use of gunshot as euthanasia
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 258.505. Use of gunshot as euthanasia (2023)
content:
Gunshot shall not be used as a routine method of euthanasia in animal shelter settings.  This prohibition shall not apply in animal shelter settings if an animal presents
   a threat to the health or safety of anyone lawfully on the premises of the shelter.  The prohibition against gunshot shall also not apply to peace officers or animal
   control officers outside animal shelter situations if an animal:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 258. Animal Control and Protection›KY REV ST 258.255. Confinement and control of female dog when in heat
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 258. Animal Control and Protection › KY REV ST 258.255. Confinement and control of female dog when in heat
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 258.255. Confinement and control of female dog when in heat (2023)
content:
Every female dog in heat shall be confined in a building or secure enclosure in such
   a manner that the female dog cannot come in contact with a male dog except for a planned
   breeding.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 259. Strays and Animals Running at Large›KY REV ST 259.120. Method of taking up and posting stray equines and stray cattle; fees
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 259. Strays and Animals Running at Large › KY REV ST 259.120. Method of taking up and posting stray equines and stray cattle; fees
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 259.120. Method of taking up and posting stray equines and stray cattle; fees (2023)
content: Stray equines and stray cattle shall be taken up and posted in the following manner:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 259. Strays and Animals Running at Large›KY REV ST 259.130. Property vests in taker-up after fifteen days following posting
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 259. Strays and Animals Running at Large › KY REV ST 259.130. Property vests in taker-up after fifteen days following posting
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 259.130. Property vests in taker-up after fifteen days following posting (2023)
content:
The absolute ownership of a stray equine shall vest in the taker-up at the expiration
   of fifteen (15) days after the county judge/executive has received the evidence of
   the required documentation, administered the oath to the taker-up, and the county
   judge/executive and taker-up have filed and posted the required documentation pursuant
   toKRS 259.120.  The absolute ownership of stray cattle shall vest in the taker-up after the expiration
   of twelve (12) months from the day on which the cattle have been posted.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 258. Animal Control and Protection›KY REV ST 258.365. Other state and local laws not affected
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 258. Animal Control and Protection › KY REV ST 258.365. Other state and local laws not affected
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 258.365. Other state and local laws not affected (2023)
content:
Nothing in this chapter shall be construed to prohibit or limit the right of any governing
   body to pass or enforce any ordinance with respect to the regulation of dogs or other
   animals, the provisions of which are not inconsistent with the provisions of this
   chapter.  Nothing in this chapter shall be construed to repeal any of the provisions of the
   fish and game laws of the Commonwealth of Kentucky now in effect, nor any laws relating
   to the powers and duties of the secretary for health and family services, or any health
   officer relating to rabid animals or animals affected with any disease, or to prohibit
   the destroying of any animal in accordance with the provisions of any quarantine regulations,
   made in accordance with the provisions of any local or state health law.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 259. Strays and Animals Running at Large›KY REV ST 259.140. Taker-up to pay owner value of stray equines or cattle, when; limitation of liability
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 259. Strays and Animals Running at Large › KY REV ST 259.140. Taker-up to pay owner value of stray equines or cattle, when; limitation of liability
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 259.140. Taker-up to pay owner value of stray equines or cattle, when; limitation of liability (2023)
content:
(1)  If cattle taken up underKRS 259.120are sold for a profit before absolute ownership of the stray cattle has vested in
      the taker-up as provided byKRS 259.130, then the taker-up shall pay to the owner upon demand and proof of ownership the
      amount received for the stray cattle less the amount owed by the owner to the taker-up
      underKRS 259.120.  The owner shall not be entitled to any payment from the taker-up under this section
      if demand for payment is made more than fifteen (15) days after the posting of the
      stray equine and vesting of ownership pursuant toKRS 259.130or more than twelve (12) months after the posting of the stray cattle underKRS 259.120.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 259. Strays and Animals Running at Large›KY REV ST 259.200. Trespassing on park, camp grounds or floodwalls prohibited
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 259. Strays and Animals Running at Large › KY REV ST 259.200. Trespassing on park, camp grounds or floodwalls prohibited
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 259.200. Trespassing on park, camp grounds or floodwalls prohibited (2023)
content:
No person shall permit any cattle to run or trespass upon any state or national parks,
   encampment grounds, scout camps, grounds dedicated to religious, educational or recreational
   purposes or floodwalls erected at public expense.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 259. Strays and Animals Running at Large›KY REV ST 259.210. Cattle not to run at large; damages; lien, impounding; powers of cities
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 259. Strays and Animals Running at Large › KY REV ST 259.210. Cattle not to run at large; damages; lien, impounding; powers of cities
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 259.210. Cattle not to run at large; damages; lien, impounding; powers of cities (2023)
content:
(1)  No person shall permit any cattle owned by him or under his control or in his
      custody, to run at large.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 259. Strays and Animals Running at Large›KY REV ST 259.990. Penalties
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 259. Strays and Animals Running at Large › KY REV ST 259.990. Penalties
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 259.990. Penalties (2023)
content:
(1)  Any person who violatesKRS 259.200shall be fined not less than ten dollars ($10) nor more than one hundred dollars
      ($100), and each head of cattle trespassing shall constitute a separate offense.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 261. Stockyards›KY REV ST 261.200. Definitions for chapter
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 261. Stockyards › KY REV ST 261.200. Definitions for chapter
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 261.200. Definitions for chapter (2023)
content: As used in this chapter, unless the context requires otherwise:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 261. Stockyards›KY REV ST 261.210. Enforcement and administration by department; administrative regulations
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 261. Stockyards › KY REV ST 261.210. Enforcement and administration by department; administrative regulations
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 261.210. Enforcement and administration by department; administrative regulations (2023)
content:
The department shall administer and enforce the provisions of this chapter and shall
   promulgate administrative regulations necessary to carry out the provisions of this
   chapter.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 261. Stockyards›KY REV ST 261.240. Monthly reports of livestock received and sold
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 261. Stockyards › KY REV ST 261.240. Monthly reports of livestock received and sold
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 261.240. Monthly reports of livestock received and sold (2023)
content:
The owner or operator of each stockyard or buying station shall file with the department,
   at the beginning of each month, a sworn statement showing the exact number of livestock
   received and sold at that stockyard or buying station during the preceding month.  The statements shall be made on forms furnished by the department.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 260. Marketing of Agricultural Products›KY REV ST 260.010. Definitions
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 260. Marketing of Agricultural Products › KY REV ST 260.010. Definitions
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 260.010. Definitions (2023)
content: As used in this chapter, unless the context requires otherwise:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 261. Stockyards›KY REV ST 261.220. Employment of inspectors and other personnel
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 261. Stockyards › KY REV ST 261.220. Employment of inspectors and other personnel
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 261.220. Employment of inspectors and other personnel (2023)
content:
The Commissioner, with the specific approval of the board, shall employ such inspectors
   and other employees as are necessary for the enforcement of this chapter.  Their duties shall be prescribed by the Commissioner and their compensation shall
   be determined under the provisions ofKRS 64.640.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 261. Stockyards›KY REV ST 261.260. Surety bond or other security instrument or agreement
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 261. Stockyards › KY REV ST 261.260. Surety bond or other security instrument or agreement
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 261.260. Surety bond or other security instrument or agreement (2023)
content:
(1)  The owner or operator of any stockyard or buying station, any market agency,
      or any livestock dealer who is required to execute and maintain a surety bond or other
      security instrument or agreement in compliance with standards set out in the Packers
      and Stockyards Act,7 U.S.C. secs. 181-229b, or regulations promulgated under the Act shall forward a copy of the bond or other
      security instrument or agreement to the department.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 261. Stockyards›KY REV ST 261.235. Licensure of market agencies
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 261. Stockyards › KY REV ST 261.235. Licensure of market agencies
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 261.235. Licensure of market agencies (2023)
content:
(1)  No person shall engage in the business of being a market agency without having
      first obtained a license from the department.  Application for a license shall be made on a form provided by the department and
      accompanied by a fee of ten dollars ($10), payable to the Kentucky State Treasurer.  The license shall expire on December 31 and shall be renewed annually.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 261. Stockyards›KY REV ST 261.250. Stockyard or buying station owner or licensee to cooperate with representatives of department
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 261. Stockyards › KY REV ST 261.250. Stockyard or buying station owner or licensee to cooperate with representatives of department
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 261.250. Stockyard or buying station owner or licensee to cooperate with representatives of department (2023)
content:
Each stockyard or buying station owner or licensee shall, during ordinary business
   hours, permit any authorized representative of the department to enter his or her
   place of business and inspect any or all property in his or her possession or control,
   and all records pertaining to the business of the stockyard or buying station owner
   or licensee, and make copies of the records.  Any necessary facilities for the inspection shall be extended to the representative
   by the stockyard or buying station owner or licensee.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 261. Stockyards›KY REV ST 261.270. Scales to be certified and tested
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 261. Stockyards › KY REV ST 261.270. Scales to be certified and tested
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 261.270. Scales to be certified and tested (2023)
content:
All scales used in stockyards or buying stations shall be certified.  The scales shall be tested at least every six (6) months by a scale agency approved
   by the department.  Certification of the scales shall be exhibited before issuance or renewal of any
   stockyard or buying station license.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 261. Stockyards›KY REV ST 261.230. Licenses to operate business of stockyard or buying station; application; fee; stockyards to annually identify and verify dealers
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 261. Stockyards › KY REV ST 261.230. Licenses to operate business of stockyard or buying station; application; fee; stockyards to annually identify and verify dealers
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 261.230. Licenses to operate business of stockyard or buying station; application; fee; stockyards to annually identify and verify dealers (2023)
content:
(1)  The owner or operator of a stockyard or buying station shall file annually with
      the department an application for a license to operate the business under the provisions
      of this chapter.  The applications shall be made on forms furnished by the department and shall state
      fully and correctly the nature of business to be conducted at the stockyard or buying
      station, the correct location and post office address, and any other additional information
      the department may require in accordance with the provisions of this chapter.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 261. Stockyards›KY REV ST 261.280. Fraudulent manipulation of scales prohibited
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 261. Stockyards › KY REV ST 261.280. Fraudulent manipulation of scales prohibited
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 261.280. Fraudulent manipulation of scales prohibited (2023)
content:
It shall be unlawful for any weighman to misweigh or falsely report any weights or
   to otherwise fraudulently manipulate scales to produce a weight other than the true
   and actual weight of any livestock consigned to and sold at any stockyard or buying
   station.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 261. Stockyards›KY REV ST 261.350. Payment for livestock purchased by market agencies or livestock dealers
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 261. Stockyards › KY REV ST 261.350. Payment for livestock purchased by market agencies or livestock dealers
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 261.350. Payment for livestock purchased by market agencies or livestock dealers (2023)
content:
Payment for livestock purchased by market agencies or livestock dealers shall be made
   in full compliance with requirements under the Packers and Stockyards Act,7 U.S.C. secs. 181-229band regulations promulgated thereto.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 261. Stockyards›KY REV ST 261.300. Payment of fees into revolving fund
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 261. Stockyards › KY REV ST 261.300. Payment of fees into revolving fund
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 261.300. Payment of fees into revolving fund (2023)
content:
All license fees and all other fees collected under this chapter shall be paid into
   the State Treasury to the credit of a revolving fund for the use of the department
   in defraying the expense of enforcing the provisions of this chapter and in conjunction
   with other funds made available for the enforcement of the provisions outlined in
   KRS Chapter 257.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 261. Stockyards›KY REV ST 261.360. Insurance of livestock
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 261. Stockyards › KY REV ST 261.360. Insurance of livestock
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 261.360. Insurance of livestock (2023)
content:
Stockyards and buying stations shall carry insurance on all livestock while the livestock
   are kept at the stockyards or buying stations in order to ensure that the livestock
   will be insured against injury or loss caused by catastrophic peril such as fire,
   windstorm, or similar occurrence.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 261. Stockyards›KY REV ST 261.375. License required; renewal, records of transactions; violations; license revocation or suspension
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 261. Stockyards › KY REV ST 261.375. License required; renewal, records of transactions; violations; license revocation or suspension
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 261.375. License required; renewal, records of transactions; violations; license revocation or suspension (2023)
content:
(1)  No person shall engage in the business of being a livestock dealer without having
      first obtained a license from the department.  Application for a license shall be made on a form provided by the department and
      accompanied by a fee of ten dollars ($10), payable to the Kentucky State Treasurer.  The license shall expire on December 31 and shall be renewed annually.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 261. Stockyards›KY REV ST 261.320. Selection of veterinarian
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 261. Stockyards › KY REV ST 261.320. Selection of veterinarian
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 261.320. Selection of veterinarian (2023)
content:
If the owner or operator of any licensed stockyard in this state is required by law
   or shall have any reason to utilize the services of a veterinarian, the veterinarian
   shall be chosen by the owner or operator of the stockyards, and may be relieved of
   his duties at the pleasure of the owner or operator.  Any veterinarian so employed shall be licensed by the Kentucky Board of Veterinary
   Examiners and accredited by the United States Department of Agriculture.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 261. Stockyards›KY REV ST 261.370. Exceptions to provisions of this chapter
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 261. Stockyards › KY REV ST 261.370. Exceptions to provisions of this chapter
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 261.370. Exceptions to provisions of this chapter (2023)
content: No provision of KRS Chapter 261 shall be construed as applicable to:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 262. Soil and Water Conservation›Soil and Water Conservation›KY REV ST 262.010. Definitions
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 262. Soil and Water Conservation › Soil and Water Conservation › KY REV ST 262.010. Definitions
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 262.010. Definitions (2023)
content: (1)  “Board” means the board of supervisors of a conservation district;

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 262. Soil and Water Conservation›Soil and Water Conservation›KY REV ST 262.020. Purpose of soil and water conservation district; methods of achieving purpose
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 262. Soil and Water Conservation › Soil and Water Conservation › KY REV ST 262.020. Purpose of soil and water conservation district; methods of achieving purpose
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 262.020. Purpose of soil and water conservation district; methods of achieving purpose (2023)
content:
The purpose of a soil and water conservation district is to conserve and develop all
   renewable natural resources within the district.  In so doing, the district is authorized to undertake, sponsor, or participate in
   projects and activities which promote the conservation, development, maintenance and
   use of the land, water, trees and other renewable natural resources of the district.  Such projects and activities shall include but not be limited to conservation practices
   on agricultural lands, the control of soil erosion, retardation of water runoff, the
   construction of flood prevention and control reservoirs, the maintenance of flood
   plains, the promotion of projects to assure an adequate municipal, industrial and
   agricultural supply of water, watershed stabilization, the avoidance and abatement
   of sedimentation and pollution in streams and other bodies of water, forestation and
   reforestation, the establishment of parks and outdoor recreation areas, the protection
   of open space, greenbelt areas and scenery, the preservation of wilderness areas,
   the protection of fish and wildlife, working for the location of highways, industries,
   housing developments, airports and other structures as are consistent with the district's
   objectives and will offer the least possible interference with the conservation and
   best multiple use of the renewable natural resources, and all other activities consistent
   with the total natural resources development of the district.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 261. Stockyards›KY REV ST 261.990. Penalties; stop-movement order; action to recover fees
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 261. Stockyards › KY REV ST 261.990. Penalties; stop-movement order; action to recover fees
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 261.990. Penalties; stop-movement order; action to recover fees (2023)
content:
(1)  Any person who violates any provision of this chapter or any administrative regulation
      promulgated under this chapter, or who refuses to pay the fees required in this chapter,
      shall be fined not less than one hundred dollars ($100) nor more than five hundred
      dollars ($500), or shall be imprisoned for not more than three (3) months, or both.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 261. Stockyards›KY REV ST 261.380. Restriction on administrative regulations
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 261. Stockyards › KY REV ST 261.380. Restriction on administrative regulations
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 261.380. Restriction on administrative regulations (2023)
content:
Notwithstanding any provision of the law to the contrary, the Department of Agriculture
   shall not enact any administrative regulations prohibiting the rights of buyers of
   any livestock to purchase the livestock.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 262. Soil and Water Conservation›Soil and Water Conservation›KY REV ST 262.110. Hearing on creation of district; matters to be considered
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 262. Soil and Water Conservation › Soil and Water Conservation › KY REV ST 262.110. Hearing on creation of district; matters to be considered
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 262.110. Hearing on creation of district; matters to be considered (2023)
content:
(1)  Within thirty (30) days after a petition has been filed with the commission underKRS 262.100, it shall cause due notice to be given of a proposed hearing upon the questions of
      the desirability and necessity, in the interest of the public health, safety and welfare,
      of the creation of the district;  of the appropriate boundaries to be assigned to
      the district;  of the propriety of the petition and other proceedings taken under
      this chapter, and upon all questions relevant to such inquiries.  All owners and occupiers of land within the limits of the territory described in
      the petition and of lands within any territory considered for addition to the described
      territory, and all other interested parties may attend the hearing and be heard.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 262. Soil and Water Conservation›Soil and Water Conservation›KY REV ST 262.100. Petition for district
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 262. Soil and Water Conservation › Soil and Water Conservation › KY REV ST 262.100. Petition for district
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 262.100. Petition for district (2023)
content:
(1)  Any twenty-five (25) owners of land lying within the limits of the territory
      proposed to be organized into a district, and within counties that maintain a full-time
      county agricultural extension agent, may file a petition with the commission asking
      that a soil conservation district be organized to function in the territory described
      in the petition.  The petition shall set forth:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 262. Soil and Water Conservation›Soil and Water Conservation›KY REV ST 262.090. Functions of state commission
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 262. Soil and Water Conservation › Soil and Water Conservation › KY REV ST 262.090. Functions of state commission
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 262.090. Functions of state commission (2023)
content: The commission shall:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 262. Soil and Water Conservation›Soil and Water Conservation›KY REV ST 262.120. Referendum on creation of district
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 262. Soil and Water Conservation › Soil and Water Conservation › KY REV ST 262.120. Referendum on creation of district
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 262.120. Referendum on creation of district (2023)
content:
After the commission has made and recorded a determination that there is need, in
   the interest of the public health, safety and welfare, for the organization of a district
   in a particular territory and has defined the boundaries of that district, it shall
   consider the question whether the operation of a district within those boundaries
   with the powers conferred upon districts in this chapter is administratively practicable
   and feasible.  To assist the commission in the determination of administrative practicability and
   feasibility, the commission shall, within a reasonable time after entry of the finding
   that there is need for the organization of the district and the determination of the
   boundaries of the district, hold a referendum within the proposed district upon the
   proposition of the creation of the district, and cause due notice of the referendum
   to be given.  The question shall be submitted to the voters in the following form:  “For creation
   of a soil conservation district of the lands below described and lying in the County
   (or Counties) of ․․․․․․․․․․․․․․․, ․․․․․․․․․․․․․․․, and ․․․․․․․․․․․․․․․” and “Against creation of a soil conservation district of the lands below described
   and lying in the County (or Counties) of ․․․․․․․․․․․․․․․, and ․․․․․․․․․․․․․․․ ” The voter shall be instructed to vote “yes” for one or the other of the propositions,
   as the voter may favor or oppose creation of the district.   The boundaries of the proposed district as determined by the commission shall be
   set forth.  Only owners of lands lying within the boundaries of the territory, as determined
   by the commission, shall be eligible to vote in the referendum.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 262. Soil and Water Conservation›Soil and Water Conservation›KY REV ST 262.097. Reports from districts; compliance with KRS 65A.010. to § 65A.090
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 262. Soil and Water Conservation › Soil and Water Conservation › KY REV ST 262.097. Reports from districts; compliance with KRS 65A.010. to § 65A.090
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 262.097. Reports from districts; compliance with KRS 65A.010. to § 65A.090 (2023)
content:
(1)  The supervisors of the respective soil conservation districts shall submit to
      the commission such statements, estimates, budgets, and other information at such
      time and in such manner as the commission requires.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 262. Soil and Water Conservation›Soil and Water Conservation›KY REV ST 262.025. Transfer of State Soil Conservation Committee functions to Soil and Water Conservation Commission
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 262. Soil and Water Conservation › Soil and Water Conservation › KY REV ST 262.025. Transfer of State Soil Conservation Committee functions to Soil and Water Conservation Commission
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 262.025. Transfer of State Soil Conservation Committee functions to Soil and Water Conservation Commission (2023)
content:
All of the functions of the State Soil Conservation Committee provided in this chapter
   are hereby transferred to and shall be exercised by the Soil and Water Conservation
   Commission.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 262. Soil and Water Conservation›Soil and Water Conservation›KY REV ST 262.150. Appointment of district supervisors by commission; qualifications; term
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 262. Soil and Water Conservation › Soil and Water Conservation › KY REV ST 262.150. Appointment of district supervisors by commission; qualifications; term
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 262.150. Appointment of district supervisors by commission; qualifications; term (2023)
content:
(1)  If the commission determines that the operation of the proposed district within
      the defined boundaries is administratively practicable and feasible, it shall appoint
      three (3) supervisors to act with the four (4) supervisors elected as provided byKRS 262.220and262.240.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 262. Soil and Water Conservation›Soil and Water Conservation›KY REV ST 262.095. Appropriations; how used
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 262. Soil and Water Conservation › Soil and Water Conservation › KY REV ST 262.095. Appropriations; how used
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 262.095. Appropriations; how used (2023)
content:
Appropriations out of the State Treasury to finance the program of the Soil and Water
   Conservation Commission shall be paid out directly on the orders of the chairman,
   and shall be used to pay the expenses of the commission.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 262. Soil and Water Conservation›Soil and Water Conservation›KY REV ST 262.140. Commission to determine feasibility of district when majority favor
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 262. Soil and Water Conservation › Soil and Water Conservation › KY REV ST 262.140. Commission to determine feasibility of district when majority favor
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 262.140. Commission to determine feasibility of district when majority favor (2023)
content:
(1)  The commission shall publish the result of the referendum held underKRS 262.120and shall then determine whether the operation of the district within the defined
      boundaries is administratively practicable and feasible.  If the commission determines that the operation of the district is not administratively
      practicable and feasible, it shall record the determination and deny the petition.  If the commission determines that the operation of the district is administratively
      practicable and feasible, it shall record the determination and shall proceed with
      the organization of the district in the manner provided inKRS 262.150.  In making the determination the commission shall give regard and weight to the attitudes
      of the owners and occupiers of lands lying within the defined boundaries, the number
      of landowners eligible to vote in the referendum who have voted, the proportion of
      the votes cast in the referendum in favor of the creation of the district to the total
      number of votes cast, the approximate wealth and income of the landowners and occupiers
      of the proposed district, the probable expense of carrying on erosion-control operations
      within the district, and such other economic and social factors as may be relevant
      to the determination, having due regard to the legislative determinations set forth
      inKRS 262.020.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 262. Soil and Water Conservation›Soil and Water Conservation›KY REV ST 262.130. Commission to pay for and supervise conduct of referendum; equal representation of opposing sides
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 262. Soil and Water Conservation › Soil and Water Conservation › KY REV ST 262.130. Commission to pay for and supervise conduct of referendum; equal representation of opposing sides
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 262.130. Commission to pay for and supervise conduct of referendum; equal representation of opposing sides (2023)
content:
(1)  The commission shall pay all expenses for the issuance of notices and the conduct
      of the hearings and referendum provided for inKRS 262.110and262.120, and shall supervise the conduct of the hearings and referendum.  It shall issue appropriate regulations governing the conduct of the hearings and
      referendum and providing for the registration prior to the date of the referendum
      of all eligible voters, or prescribing some other appropriate procedure for the determination
      of the eligibility of voters in the referendum.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 262. Soil and Water Conservation›Soil and Water Conservation›KY REV ST 262.160. Supervisors to present application to Secretary of State and file statement of committee
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 262. Soil and Water Conservation › Soil and Water Conservation › KY REV ST 262.160. Supervisors to present application to Secretary of State and file statement of committee
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 262.160. Supervisors to present application to Secretary of State and file statement of committee (2023)
content:
(1)  The three (3) supervisors appointed underKRS 262.150shall present to the Secretary of State an application signed by them, which shall
      set forth the following:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 262. Soil and Water Conservation›Soil and Water Conservation›KY REV ST 262.170. Secretary of State to record application and issue certificate of creation
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 262. Soil and Water Conservation › Soil and Water Conservation › KY REV ST 262.170. Secretary of State to record application and issue certificate of creation
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 262.170. Secretary of State to record application and issue certificate of creation (2023)
content:
(1)  The Secretary of State shall examine the application and statement and, if he
      finds that the name proposed for the district is not identical with that of any other
      district or so nearly similar as to lead to confusion or uncertainty, he shall receive
      and file the application and statement and record them in an appropriate book of record
      in his office.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 262. Soil and Water Conservation›Soil and Water Conservation›KY REV ST 262.180. Territory included in district; addition of territory; procedure
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 262. Soil and Water Conservation › Soil and Water Conservation › KY REV ST 262.180. Territory included in district; addition of territory; procedure
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 262.180. Territory included in district; addition of territory; procedure (2023)
content:
(1)  The territory of a district shall include all lands lying within the boundaries
      of a district, including incorporated cities and towns.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 262. Soil and Water Conservation›Soil and Water Conservation›KY REV ST 262.190. When subsequent petitions may be filed after denial
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 262. Soil and Water Conservation › Soil and Water Conservation › KY REV ST 262.190. When subsequent petitions may be filed after denial
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 262.190. When subsequent petitions may be filed after denial (2023)
content:
After the expiration of six (6) months from the date of entry of a determination by
   the commission, denying a petition for a proposed district, subsequent petitions covering
   the same or substantially the same territory may be filed and action taken thereon
   in accordance withKRS 262.100to262.180.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 262. Soil and Water Conservation›Soil and Water Conservation›KY REV ST 262.200. Nature of district; governing body; corporate powers; operating funds
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 262. Soil and Water Conservation › Soil and Water Conservation › KY REV ST 262.200. Nature of district; governing body; corporate powers; operating funds
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 262.200. Nature of district; governing body; corporate powers; operating funds (2023)
content:
(1)  A district shall constitute a governmental subdivision of the state and public
      body corporate and politic, exercising public power.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 262. Soil and Water Conservation›Soil and Water Conservation›KY REV ST 262.210. Nomination of supervisors by petition
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 262. Soil and Water Conservation › Soil and Water Conservation › KY REV ST 262.210. Nomination of supervisors by petition
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 262.210. Nomination of supervisors by petition (2023)
content:
Nominating petitions shall be filed with the clerk of the county in which the district
   lies to nominate candidates for supervisors of the district.  Such petitions shall be filed by at least the last date prescribed by the election
   law generally for filing certificates of nomination prior to a general election.  Such petitions shall be filed no later than 4 p.m. local time at the place of filing
   when filed on the last date on which such papers are permitted to be filed.  Each nominating petition shall be subscribed by twenty-five (25) or more qualified
   voters who are residents of the territory to be encompassed by the district.  Resident qualified voters may join in nominating by petition more than one (1) candidate
   for supervisor.  The nominating petition shall state the residence and post office address of each
   candidate, that he or she is legally qualified to hold the office, that the subscribers
   desire and are legally qualified to vote for the candidate, and for candidates who
   have not taken office prior to June 29, 2023, that the candidate is at least eighteen
   (18) years of age.  The county clerk shall certify the nomination and election of supervisors to the
   commission.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 262. Soil and Water Conservation›Soil and Water Conservation›KY REV ST 262.220. Election for supervisors; county clerk's duties
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 262. Soil and Water Conservation › Soil and Water Conservation › KY REV ST 262.220. Election for supervisors; county clerk's duties
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 262.220. Election for supervisors; county clerk's duties (2023)
content:
The county clerk shall cause the names of all nominees on behalf of whom nominating
   petitions have been filed underKRS 262.210to be prepared for presentation to the voters in the regular elections as provided
   inKRS 117.145.  In counties encompassing more than one (1) soil and water conservation district,
   where portions of more than one (1) district are within the boundaries of a single
   voting precinct, separate votes shall be taken for the election of supervisors.  The election of soil and water conservation district supervisors shall be subject
   to the provisions of KRS Chapter 118 for the conduct of regular elections, except
   that the cost of placing the names of the nominees before the voters shall be borne
   by the commission.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 262. Soil and Water Conservation›Soil and Water Conservation›KY REV ST 262.270. Board may make regulations
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 262. Soil and Water Conservation › Soil and Water Conservation › KY REV ST 262.270. Board may make regulations
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 262.270. Board may make regulations (2023)
content:
To carry into effect the purposes of this chapter, the board may make, and from time
   to time amend and repeal, regulations not inconsistent with this chapter.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 262. Soil and Water Conservation›Soil and Water Conservation›KY REV ST 262.250. Board may hire employees, delegate functions and bond employees
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 262. Soil and Water Conservation › Soil and Water Conservation › KY REV ST 262.250. Board may hire employees, delegate functions and bond employees
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 262.250. Board may hire employees, delegate functions and bond employees (2023)
content:
(1)  The board may employ such employees, permanent and temporary, as it may require,
      and shall determine their qualifications, duties and compensation.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 262. Soil and Water Conservation›Soil and Water Conservation›KY REV ST 262.280. Board to provide record; audits of district accounts; data to be furnished to commission
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 262. Soil and Water Conservation › Soil and Water Conservation › KY REV ST 262.280. Board to provide record; audits of district accounts; data to be furnished to commission
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 262.280. Board to provide record; audits of district accounts; data to be furnished to commission (2023)
content:
(1)  The board shall provide for the keeping of a full and accurate record of all
      its proceedings and of all resolutions, regulations, and orders issued or adopted
      by it.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 262. Soil and Water Conservation›Soil and Water Conservation›KY REV ST 262.230. Board chairman; quorum
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 262. Soil and Water Conservation › Soil and Water Conservation › KY REV ST 262.230. Board chairman; quorum
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 262.230. Board chairman; quorum (2023)
content: (1)  The board shall select a chairman and may, from time to time, change that selection.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 262. Soil and Water Conservation›Soil and Water Conservation›KY REV ST 262.240. Supervisors' terms; nomination and election; vacancies; compensation; requirements to hold office; removal
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 262. Soil and Water Conservation › Soil and Water Conservation › KY REV ST 262.240. Supervisors' terms; nomination and election; vacancies; compensation; requirements to hold office; removal
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 262.240. Supervisors' terms; nomination and election; vacancies; compensation; requirements to hold office; removal (2023)
content:
(1)  A supervisor's term begins on January 1 following his or her election.  Supervisors shall be elected for four (4) years as their terms expire.  Nominating petitions for supervisors shall be filed with the county clerk not later
      than the last date prescribed by the election law generally for filing certificates
      and petitions of nomination.  No such nominating petition shall be accepted by the clerk unless it is signed by
      twenty-five (25) or more qualified resident voters of the district.  Qualified resident voters may sign more than one (1) nominating petition to nominate
      more than one (1) candidate for supervisor.  In the event nominating petitions for only the number of supervisors to be elected
      are filed, the commission shall declare the nominees elected without holding an election.  The county clerk shall examine the petition of each candidate to determine whether
      it is regular on its face.  If there is an error, the county clerk shall notify the candidate by certified mail
      within twenty-four (24) hours of filing.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 262. Soil and Water Conservation›Soil and Water Conservation›KY REV ST 262.260. Designation of city or county representative to consult with board; appropriation by city or county to assist in program
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 262. Soil and Water Conservation › Soil and Water Conservation › KY REV ST 262.260. Designation of city or county representative to consult with board; appropriation by city or county to assist in program
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 262.260. Designation of city or county representative to consult with board; appropriation by city or county to assist in program (2023)
content:
The board may by resolution invite the legislative body of any city and/or administrative
   body of any county (fiscal court) in which the district is located or nearby, to select
   a representative to consult with the board of the district on all questions of program
   and policy which may affect the property, water supply, or other interests of the
   city or county, and to request by resolution that said city and/or county participate
   wholly or partially in any expense attendant to the execution of any program and/or
   policy, setting forth in said resolution all details of the program and/or policy
   together with an estimated annual cost.  Should said legislative body approve said program and/or policy, it may expend funds
   out of its respective tax levy to assist in said program and/or policy.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 262. Soil and Water Conservation›Soil and Water Conservation›KY REV ST 262.290. Board may acquire, maintain and dispose of property; other laws not to apply
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 262. Soil and Water Conservation › Soil and Water Conservation › KY REV ST 262.290. Board may acquire, maintain and dispose of property; other laws not to apply
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 262.290. Board may acquire, maintain and dispose of property; other laws not to apply (2023)
content:
(1)  The board may obtain options upon and acquire in any way any property or rights
      or interests in property.  It may maintain, administer and improve property acquired, receive the income therefrom
      and spend the income in administering this chapter.  It may dispose of any of its property or interests in furtherance of this chapter.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 262. Soil and Water Conservation›Soil and Water Conservation›KY REV ST 262.350. Land-use regulations, what they may include
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 262. Soil and Water Conservation › Soil and Water Conservation › KY REV ST 262.350. Land-use regulations, what they may include
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 262.350. Land-use regulations, what they may include (2023)
content:
(1)  Whenever the board determines that uncontrolled soil erosion on some lands within
      the district is causing damage to other lands within the district, it may propose
      regulations governing the use of lands within the district in the interest of conserving
      soil and soil resources and preventing and controlling soil erosion.  The board may conduct such public meetings and public hearings upon tentative regulations
      as may be necessary to assist it in this work.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 262. Soil and Water Conservation›Soil and Water Conservation›KY REV ST 262.300. Board may conduct research work
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 262. Soil and Water Conservation › Soil and Water Conservation › KY REV ST 262.300. Board may conduct research work
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 262.300. Board may conduct research work (2023)
content:
The board may conduct surveys, investigations and research relating to the character
   of soil erosion and the preventive and control measures needed, publish the results
   of the surveys, investigations or research and disseminate information concerning
   such preventive and control measures.  No district shall initiate any research program except pursuant to a cooperative
   agreement entered into between the agricultural experiment station and the district.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 262. Soil and Water Conservation›Soil and Water Conservation›KY REV ST 262.330. Board may furnish materials and equipment and prescribe conditions for benefits
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 262. Soil and Water Conservation › Soil and Water Conservation › KY REV ST 262.330. Board may furnish materials and equipment and prescribe conditions for benefits
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 262.330. Board may furnish materials and equipment and prescribe conditions for benefits (2023)
content:
(1)  The board may make available or lease, on such terms as it prescribes, to landowners
      and occupiers within the district, agricultural and engineering machinery and equipment,
      including heavy or specialized equipment acquired pursuant toKRS 262.610, fertilizer, seeds, seedlings, and such other material or equipment as will assist
      the landowners and occupiers to carry on operations upon their lands for the conservation
      of soil resources and for the prevention and control of soil erosion.  Any heavy or specialized equipment acquired pursuant toKRS 262.610that the board makes available, rents, or leases may be used on the lessee's or renter's
      land or on the lands of others for the purposes of conserving soil resources, the
      prevention and control of soil erosion, and the conservation and protection of water
      resources related to those purposes.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 262. Soil and Water Conservation›Soil and Water Conservation›KY REV ST 262.310. Board may develop soil conservation plans
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 262. Soil and Water Conservation › Soil and Water Conservation › KY REV ST 262.310. Board may develop soil conservation plans
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 262.310. Board may develop soil conservation plans (2023)
content:
The board may develop comprehensive plans for the conservation of soil resources and
   for the control and prevention of soil erosion within the district.  The plans shall specify in such detail as may be possible, the acts, procedures,
   performances and avoidances which are necessary or desirable for the effectuation
   of the plans, including the specification of engineering operations, methods of cultivation,
   the growing of vegetation, cropping programs, tillage practices and changes in use
   of land.  The board shall publish those plans and information and bring them to the attention
   of owners and occupiers of lands within the district.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 262. Soil and Water Conservation›Soil and Water Conservation›KY REV ST 262.340. Board may take over government projects and receive contributions
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 262. Soil and Water Conservation › Soil and Water Conservation › KY REV ST 262.340. Board may take over government projects and receive contributions
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 262.340. Board may take over government projects and receive contributions (2023)
content: The board may:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 262. Soil and Water Conservation›Soil and Water Conservation›KY REV ST 262.360. Board not to adopt land-use regulations before referendum
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 262. Soil and Water Conservation › Soil and Water Conservation › KY REV ST 262.360. Board not to adopt land-use regulations before referendum
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 262.360. Board not to adopt land-use regulations before referendum (2023)
content:
The board shall not enact land-use regulations into law until after it has caused
   due notice to be given of its intention to conduct a referendum submitting such regulations
   to the owners and occupiers of lands lying within the boundaries of the district,
   the referendum has been held, and the board has considered the result of the referendum.  The proposed regulations shall be embodied in a proposed ordinance.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 262. Soil and Water Conservation›Soil and Water Conservation›KY REV ST 262.320. Board may employ erosion-control measures; cooperation with other agencies
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 262. Soil and Water Conservation › Soil and Water Conservation › KY REV ST 262.320. Board may employ erosion-control measures; cooperation with other agencies
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 262.320. Board may employ erosion-control measures; cooperation with other agencies (2023)
content:
(1)  The board may carry out preventive and control measures within the district,
      including, but not limited to, engineering operations, methods of cultivation, the
      growing of vegetation, changes in use of land and other measures of soil conservation
      listed inKRS 262.020, on lands owned or controlled by this state or any of its agencies, with the consent
      and cooperation of the agency administering and having jurisdiction of the lands and
      on any other lands within the district, upon obtaining the consent of the owners and
      occupiers of the lands or the necessary rights or interests in those lands.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals›Chapter 262. Soil and Water Conservation›Soil and Water Conservation›KY REV ST 262.370. Notice of referendum; form of question
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXI. Agriculture and Animals › Chapter 262. Soil and Water Conservation › Soil and Water Conservation › KY REV ST 262.370. Notice of referendum; form of question
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 262.370. Notice of referendum; form of question (2023)
content:
(1)  Copies of the proposed land-use regulation shall be available for the inspection
