Any county may remove any ponds, pools, or swamp marshes, or reclaim swamp land that
   may cause sickness in the county, by ditching, leveeing, or cleaning out logs and
   brush that may cause any creek to scatter or form pools of stagnant water.  The cost shall be paid for out of the county levy or by taxation of the property
   in the county subject to taxation for state purposes.  When the fiscal court undertakes such a project, it may acquire for the county by
   contract or condemnation any land necessary to carry out the project.  If condemnation proceedings are necessary, they shall be conducted in the manner
   provided in the Eminent Domain Act of Kentucky.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXII. Levees, Drainage, and Reclamation of Lands›Chapter 269. Miscellaneous Provisions as to Ditches, Drainage, and Reclamation›KY REV ST 269.080. Election; limit of tax; issue of bonds; maturity
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXII. Levees, Drainage, and Reclamation of Lands › Chapter 269. Miscellaneous Provisions as to Ditches, Drainage, and Reclamation › KY REV ST 269.080. Election; limit of tax; issue of bonds; maturity
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 269.080. Election; limit of tax; issue of bonds; maturity (2023)
content:
If the probable cost of the improvement is more than the income and revenues of the
   county for the year in which it is to be constructed, the county judge/executive shall
   order an election to be held in the county to ascertain the will of the qualified
   voters.  The election shall be held in conjunction with a regular election, and the proposition
   shall be filed with the county clerk not later than the second Tuesday in August preceding
   the regular election.  The proposition to be submitted to the voters shall state the amount, and object
   for which it is to be expended.  The amount shall not exceed two percent (2%) of the value of the taxable property
   for state purposes, ascertained by the assessment next before the last assessment
   for state purposes.  The proposed debt shall be made payable so as not to require a tax rate of more
   than fifty cents ($0.50) on each one hundred dollars ($100) in value of property subject
   to taxation for state purposes.  If two-thirds (2/3) of those voting on the proposition vote for it, that fact shall
   be noted of record in the order book of the county judge/executive.  The county judge/executive shall then have semiannual coupon bonds of the county
   prepared, to be made payable not later than forty (40) years after date, but payable
   at the option of the county at any time after two (2) years after date.  The bonds shall be signed by the county judge/executive and countersigned by the
   county clerk.  The coupons may be signed by the county clerk only.  The bonds, when signed, shall be turned over to the fiscal court of the county.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXII. Levees, Drainage, and Reclamation of Lands›Chapter 269. Miscellaneous Provisions as to Ditches, Drainage, and Reclamation›KY REV ST 269.140. Commissioners shall assess land; file report; contents of report; error not to invalidate assessment; subsequent assessments
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXII. Levees, Drainage, and Reclamation of Lands › Chapter 269. Miscellaneous Provisions as to Ditches, Drainage, and Reclamation › KY REV ST 269.140. Commissioners shall assess land; file report; contents of report; error not to invalidate assessment; subsequent assessments
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 269.140. Commissioners shall assess land; file report; contents of report; error not to invalidate assessment; subsequent assessments (2023)
content:
(1)  The board of commissioners shall, as of July 1 succeeding its appointment, assess
      and apportion upon the land within the boundary of the district of the corporation
      a tax of not more than twenty-five cents ($0.25) and not less than ten cents ($0.10)
      per acre per year for a period of ten (10) years in proportion to the benefits conferred.  It shall file a written report of the assessment and apportionment with the county
      clerk, who shall not copy it in his records but file a certified copy in the Circuit
      Court of the county, or in the chancery branch thereof if there be one.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXII. Levees, Drainage, and Reclamation of Lands›Chapter 269. Miscellaneous Provisions as to Ditches, Drainage, and Reclamation›KY REV ST 269.100. Establishment of taxing district for drainage of part of county; election; issue of bonds
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXII. Levees, Drainage, and Reclamation of Lands › Chapter 269. Miscellaneous Provisions as to Ditches, Drainage, and Reclamation › KY REV ST 269.100. Establishment of taxing district for drainage of part of county; election; issue of bonds
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 269.100. Establishment of taxing district for drainage of part of county; election; issue of bonds (2023)
content:
If any pond, marsh or swamp land exists in a small part of any county, and the voters
   thereof desire to improve that part, and the cost of the improvement amounts to more
   than the revenue and income of the county for that year, the county judge/executive
   may lay off such part of the county into a taxing district to tax the property thereof
   subject to taxation for state purposes to make the improvement.  The county judge/executive may submit the proposition to the taxing district in
   the same way provided for submitting the proposition to the whole county.  The election shall be held in conjunction with a regular election, and the proposition
   shall be filed with the county clerk not later than the second Tuesday in August preceding
   the regular election.  If two-thirds (2/3) of the voters voting on the proposition vote for it, that fact
   shall be entered on the order book of the county and semiannual coupon bonds of the
   county shall be prepared, delivered and managed as inKRS 269.090, to be paid by taxation of the property in the district subject to taxation for state
   purposes.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXII. Levees, Drainage, and Reclamation of Lands›Chapter 269. Miscellaneous Provisions as to Ditches, Drainage, and Reclamation›KY REV ST 269.090. Contract for work; commissioner appointed if bonds are sold; tax levy for redemption of bonds
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXII. Levees, Drainage, and Reclamation of Lands › Chapter 269. Miscellaneous Provisions as to Ditches, Drainage, and Reclamation › KY REV ST 269.090. Contract for work; commissioner appointed if bonds are sold; tax levy for redemption of bonds
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 269.090. Contract for work; commissioner appointed if bonds are sold; tax levy for redemption of bonds (2023)
content:
The fiscal court may contract with any individual or corporation to do all work and
   to furnish all material in the execution of any such improvement voted for in the
   county, and may contract to pay in bonds, or may sell the bonds and pay for the improvement
   out of the proceeds.  If bonds are sold to pay for the improvement, one (1) or more commissioners shall
   be appointed by the county judge/executive, who shall give bond, with good and sufficient
   security, to sell the bonds and receive and pay out the money.  The fiscal court shall levy taxes on the taxable property of the county sufficient
   to pay the interest on the bonds and pay off enough bonds each year to discharge them
   all within the time they are payable.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXII. Levees, Drainage, and Reclamation of Lands›Chapter 269. Miscellaneous Provisions as to Ditches, Drainage, and Reclamation›KY REV ST 269.150. Tax notice; form; complaint; hearing on assessment
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXII. Levees, Drainage, and Reclamation of Lands › Chapter 269. Miscellaneous Provisions as to Ditches, Drainage, and Reclamation › KY REV ST 269.150. Tax notice; form; complaint; hearing on assessment
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 269.150. Tax notice; form; complaint; hearing on assessment (2023)
content:
(1)  The board of commissioners shall cause to be published pursuant to KRS Chapter
      424, a notice substantially as follows:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXII. Levees, Drainage, and Reclamation of Lands›Chapter 269. Miscellaneous Provisions as to Ditches, Drainage, and Reclamation›KY REV ST 269.110. Continuation of drainage corporations; to have benefit of this law
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXII. Levees, Drainage, and Reclamation of Lands › Chapter 269. Miscellaneous Provisions as to Ditches, Drainage, and Reclamation › KY REV ST 269.110. Continuation of drainage corporations; to have benefit of this law
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 269.110. Continuation of drainage corporations; to have benefit of this law (2023)
content:
Any corporation heretofore existing for the purpose of improving the public health
   by draining swamp land or lands which need drainage to make them more suitable for
   cultivation, shall be continued in force for those objects and purposes and shall
   have the benefit ofKRS 269.120to269.230.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXII. Levees, Drainage, and Reclamation of Lands›Chapter 269. Miscellaneous Provisions as to Ditches, Drainage, and Reclamation›KY REV ST 269.120. Appointment of commissioners by county judge/executive; qualifications; compensation
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXII. Levees, Drainage, and Reclamation of Lands › Chapter 269. Miscellaneous Provisions as to Ditches, Drainage, and Reclamation › KY REV ST 269.120. Appointment of commissioners by county judge/executive; qualifications; compensation
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 269.120. Appointment of commissioners by county judge/executive; qualifications; compensation (2023)
content:
Upon written petition signed by more than one-half (1/2) of the landowners residing
   within the boundary of the district of the corporation, or their agents, guardians
   or personal representatives, the county judge/executive of any county in which the
   corporation exists shall appoint a board of commissioners consisting of three (3)
   landowners over twenty-five (25) years of age, residing in that county, not interested
   in the corporation and not owning any land within its district.  Each commissioner shall be paid out of the treasury of the corporation not exceeding
   five dollars ($5) for each day's service.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXII. Levees, Drainage, and Reclamation of Lands›Chapter 269. Miscellaneous Provisions as to Ditches, Drainage, and Reclamation›KY REV ST 269.130. Oath of commissioners; filling of vacancy; quorum; removal
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXII. Levees, Drainage, and Reclamation of Lands › Chapter 269. Miscellaneous Provisions as to Ditches, Drainage, and Reclamation › KY REV ST 269.130. Oath of commissioners; filling of vacancy; quorum; removal
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 269.130. Oath of commissioners; filling of vacancy; quorum; removal (2023)
content:
(1)  Before entering upon the duties of his office, each member of the board of commissioners
      shall take the following oath before the clerk of the Circuit Court:  “I, ․․․․․․․․․․․․․․․ do solemnly swear that I will faithfully perform the duties of commissioner to assess,
      apportion and rate taxes underKRS 269.120to269.230;  that I will impartially perform the duties of my office;  that I am in no way interested
      in the company, nor holder or owner of any land within its boundary;  and that I am
      a landowner and resident of ․․․․․․․․․․․․․․․․․․․․ County, Kentucky, and over twenty-five years of age.”  Any vacancy on the board of commissioners shall be filled by the county judge/executive,
      but the failure of the county judge/executive to appoint a person to fill the vacancy
      shall not invalidate the proceedings of the board of commissioners or prevent it from
      acting.  Two (2) members shall constitute a quorum.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXII. Levees, Drainage, and Reclamation of Lands›Chapter 269. Miscellaneous Provisions as to Ditches, Drainage, and Reclamation›KY REV ST 269.170. Taxes; when assessed; when payable; discount; interest; office for collection
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXII. Levees, Drainage, and Reclamation of Lands › Chapter 269. Miscellaneous Provisions as to Ditches, Drainage, and Reclamation › KY REV ST 269.170. Taxes; when assessed; when payable; discount; interest; office for collection
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 269.170. Taxes; when assessed; when payable; discount; interest; office for collection (2023)
content:
The taxes shall be assessed as of July 1, and payable to the corporation on or after
   October 1 of the year for which assessed, and shall become due on December 1 of that
   year.  On all taxes paid during October before maturity, there shall be a discount of three
   percent (3%).  On all taxes paid during November there shall be a discount of two percent (2%).  After January 1 following maturity, all unpaid taxes shall bear interest at the
   rate of one-half percent (0.5%) a month or fraction thereof until paid.  The corporation shall keep an office where taxes are payable and the address of
   the office shall be lodged with the county clerk and enrolled in a book kept in his
   office.  Any subsequent changes in the address of the office of the company shall be enrolled
   in the same book.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXII. Levees, Drainage, and Reclamation of Lands›Chapter 269. Miscellaneous Provisions as to Ditches, Drainage, and Reclamation›KY REV ST 269.190. Collection of taxes by rule; enforcement of lien
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXII. Levees, Drainage, and Reclamation of Lands › Chapter 269. Miscellaneous Provisions as to Ditches, Drainage, and Reclamation › KY REV ST 269.190. Collection of taxes by rule; enforcement of lien
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 269.190. Collection of taxes by rule; enforcement of lien (2023)
content:
After December 1 of any year for which taxes are due, the corporation may file in
   the Circuit Court, in the proceedings in which the report has already been confirmed,
   the affidavit of one of its officers stating that the taxes are due upon a certain
   tract of land and the amount thereof, and giving a sufficient description of the land,
   together with the name of the owner or holder and alleging that the land is included
   in the assessment.  The court shall then issue a rule against the owner or holder to show cause why
   he should not be compelled to pay the tax.  The proceedings shall be had as upon rules issuing from the Circuit Court, and the
   court may render a personal judgment for the tax, interest and costs against the person
   owing the tax, and may render a judgment enforcing the lien for taxes and ordering
   a sale of the property described in the affidavit, and payment of taxes, interest
   and costs out of the proceeds.  Sales shall be conducted in the Circuit Court for foreclosure of liens.  Costs shall be paid by the losing party.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXII. Levees, Drainage, and Reclamation of Lands›Chapter 269. Miscellaneous Provisions as to Ditches, Drainage, and Reclamation›KY REV ST 269.160. Circuit Court's determination of whether assessment was properly made; court order conclusive
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXII. Levees, Drainage, and Reclamation of Lands › Chapter 269. Miscellaneous Provisions as to Ditches, Drainage, and Reclamation › KY REV ST 269.160. Circuit Court's determination of whether assessment was properly made; court order conclusive
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 269.160. Circuit Court's determination of whether assessment was properly made; court order conclusive (2023)
content:
The Circuit Court may cause proof to be taken as to whether the notice required byKRS 269.150was given by the board of commissioners, and may, in its final judgment confirming
   the report, determine this fact and any other fact necessary to establish a binding
   assessment.  The court may enter an order that all such steps have been properly taken, which
   order shall be prima facie evidence of the facts therein recited and conclusive upon
   all parties thereto.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXII. Levees, Drainage, and Reclamation of Lands›Chapter 269. Miscellaneous Provisions as to Ditches, Drainage, and Reclamation›KY REV ST 269.200. Collection of taxes by suit; rights of corporation; form of action
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXII. Levees, Drainage, and Reclamation of Lands › Chapter 269. Miscellaneous Provisions as to Ditches, Drainage, and Reclamation › KY REV ST 269.200. Collection of taxes by suit; rights of corporation; form of action
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 269.200. Collection of taxes by suit; rights of corporation; form of action (2023)
content:
(1)  Taxes shall be collectible either by rule as provided inKRS 269.190, or by action, equitable or ordinary, in any appropriate court.  Suits for taxes shall be in the name of the corporation.  The plaintiff shall have all the rights of other plaintiffs in courts of law and
      equity, and obtain a personal judgment against the owner for the amount of the tax,
      with interest and costs, as well as the enforcement of the lien.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXII. Levees, Drainage, and Reclamation of Lands›Chapter 269. Miscellaneous Provisions as to Ditches, Drainage, and Reclamation›KY REV ST 269.180. Corporation's lien for taxes; recording; limitation; procedure when tax is paid; use of taxes
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXII. Levees, Drainage, and Reclamation of Lands › Chapter 269. Miscellaneous Provisions as to Ditches, Drainage, and Reclamation › KY REV ST 269.180. Corporation's lien for taxes; recording; limitation; procedure when tax is paid; use of taxes
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 269.180. Corporation's lien for taxes; recording; limitation; procedure when tax is paid; use of taxes (2023)
content:
The corporation shall have a lien for all taxes upon the land assessed and upon all
   personal property of the owners found upon the premises not exempt from execution,
   attachment, or distraint.  This lien shall not be defeated by any means.  It is a general lien such as arises for state and county taxes, and is superior
   to all other claims and liens except state and county taxes.  For questions of limitation or apportionment as between vendor and vendee, it dates
   as of July 1 of each year.  Unless suit is commenced or proceedings had within ten (10) years from July 1 of
   any particular year, the lien for that year's taxes shall be lost.  After the action of the Circuit Court of the county upon the assessment and apportionment,
   the clerk shall certify a copy of it to the county clerk, who shall record it in his
   office, together with a map showing the boundary of the corporation, and index the
   liens in real estate indexes in the name of the owner as grantor and the corporation
   as grantee.  This record shall be notice to all persons of the taxes and any interest and costs
   thereon, and of the lien retained upon the land.  When any tax has been paid, the president or treasurer of the corporation shall
   enter the word “paid” upon the record in the proper column, and enter the amount so
   paid and subscribe thereto the name of the corporation by him.  The taxes shall be used by the corporation to maintain its system of ditches, and
   adding any necessary ditches and extensions, and for the general drainage purposes
   of the corporation.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXII. Levees, Drainage, and Reclamation of Lands›Chapter 269. Miscellaneous Provisions as to Ditches, Drainage, and Reclamation›KY REV ST 269.220. Extension of district by the county judge/executive; hearing; appeals; assessments
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXII. Levees, Drainage, and Reclamation of Lands › Chapter 269. Miscellaneous Provisions as to Ditches, Drainage, and Reclamation › KY REV ST 269.220. Extension of district by the county judge/executive; hearing; appeals; assessments
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 269.220. Extension of district by the county judge/executive; hearing; appeals; assessments (2023)
content:
Upon the petition of the corporation desiring an extension or addition to the boundaries
   of its drainage district, the petition to be accompanied by a map showing the desired
   extension or addition, the county judge/executive shall cause summons to be issued
   against the owners of lands within the proposed extension or added territory calling
   upon them to show cause why the extension or addition should not be made.  If a numerical majority of the persons owning land within the proposed extension
   or addition consent of record to it, the county judge/executive shall enter an order
   establishing the extension or additional boundary.  Appeal shall lie for sixty (60) days to the Circuit Court, and if the order is affirmed
   or reversed, then to the Court of Appeals.  The county judge/executive and Circuit Court shall certify to the county clerk their
   orders and judgments, which shall be recorded in the book showing the assessment and
   taxes.  The extension or added territory shall be subject to the same provisions as the
   original district, and an assessment may be initiated by the corporation and by the
   owners of more than half the land within the extension or addition.  The assessment shall be for the remaining years of the ten (10) year term as provided
   for other property in the district, and steps to perfect the assessment with respect
   to added or extended territory shall be had in accordance with the provisions for
   the original district.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXII. Levees, Drainage, and Reclamation of Lands›Chapter 269. Miscellaneous Provisions as to Ditches, Drainage, and Reclamation›KY REV ST 269.210. Powers of corporation as to ditches; condemnation of property
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXII. Levees, Drainage, and Reclamation of Lands › Chapter 269. Miscellaneous Provisions as to Ditches, Drainage, and Reclamation › KY REV ST 269.210. Powers of corporation as to ditches; condemnation of property
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 269.210. Powers of corporation as to ditches; condemnation of property (2023)
content:
The corporation may extend its ditches, make other ditches, connect with any creek
   or stream and straighten or cut across any curve to facilitate drainage, and, when
   necessary, take the lands of private persons.  The corporation is vested with the right and power of eminent domain for the condemnation
   of land that may be necessary, which remedy shall be pursued as provided by the Eminent
   Domain Act of Kentucky, the proceedings to be brought by the corporation in the Circuit
   Court, providing due compensation to the owners of land.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXII. Levees, Drainage, and Reclamation of Lands›Chapter 269. Miscellaneous Provisions as to Ditches, Drainage, and Reclamation›KY REV ST 269.230. Fees collected by circuit and county clerks; annual financial statement of directors of corporation
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXII. Levees, Drainage, and Reclamation of Lands › Chapter 269. Miscellaneous Provisions as to Ditches, Drainage, and Reclamation › KY REV ST 269.230. Fees collected by circuit and county clerks; annual financial statement of directors of corporation
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 269.230. Fees collected by circuit and county clerks; annual financial statement of directors of corporation (2023)
content:
(1)  The clerk of the Circuit Court shall receive from the corporation not more than
      ten cents ($0.10) for each parcel of land assessed, and shall deposit such sums in
      the manner provided for inKRS 30A.120.  The county clerk shall receive a fee pursuant toKRS 64.012for recording the assessment in his office.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXII. Levees, Drainage, and Reclamation of Lands›Chapter 269. Miscellaneous Provisions as to Ditches, Drainage, and Reclamation›KY REV ST 269.270. County surface water drainage districts
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXII. Levees, Drainage, and Reclamation of Lands › Chapter 269. Miscellaneous Provisions as to Ditches, Drainage, and Reclamation › KY REV ST 269.270. County surface water drainage districts
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 269.270. County surface water drainage districts (2023)
content:
(1)  The county judge/executive in each county of this Commonwealth, wherein the fiscal
      court has requested it, is hereby authorized to establish a countywide surface water
      drainage district for the entire county including all municipalities.  The cost of procuring the necessary rights-of-way and the construction and maintenance
      of such countywide drainage district shall be paid by the fiscal court out of the
      annual levy for county taxes.  When the fiscal court undertakes such a project it may acquire for the county by
      contract or condemnation any land necessary to carry out the project.  If condemnation proceedings are necessary they shall be conducted in the manner
      provided in the Eminent Domain Act of Kentucky.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXII. Levees, Drainage, and Reclamation of Lands›Chapter 269. Miscellaneous Provisions as to Ditches, Drainage, and Reclamation›KY REV ST 269.260. Withdrawal of land from drainage district
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXII. Levees, Drainage, and Reclamation of Lands › Chapter 269. Miscellaneous Provisions as to Ditches, Drainage, and Reclamation › KY REV ST 269.260. Withdrawal of land from drainage district
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 269.260. Withdrawal of land from drainage district (2023)
content:
(1)  If at any time any person or persons owning lands within any drainage district
      desires to withdraw his lands in whole or in part from the drainage district, such
      person or persons upon the approval of a majority of the qualified members of the
      drainage board may petition the county judge/executive for a withdrawal of his or
      their lands from the district.  The county judge/executive shall set a date for a hearing on the petition not less
      than fifteen (15) nor more than thirty (30) days after the petition is filed and issue
      and cause to be served upon the drainage board notice of the hearing.  Upon proper showing that the lands should be withdrawn from the drainage district,
      and if no valid reason is shown against the withdrawal of the lands from the drainage
      district, the county judge/executive shall enter an order withdrawing the lands.  After the order of withdrawal is entered, the lands shall cease to be within the
      drainage district, but an appeal may be taken from the order to the Circuit Court,
      and from the Circuit Court to the Court of Appeals.  All costs in any action filed are to be paid by the petitioner or petitioners regardless
      of the result of the action.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXII. Levees, Drainage, and Reclamation of Lands›Chapter 269. Miscellaneous Provisions as to Ditches, Drainage, and Reclamation›KY REV ST 269.240. Removal of obstructions from nonnavigable streams or drains by owner in counties of over 250,000; inspection and notice by county engineer
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXII. Levees, Drainage, and Reclamation of Lands › Chapter 269. Miscellaneous Provisions as to Ditches, Drainage, and Reclamation › KY REV ST 269.240. Removal of obstructions from nonnavigable streams or drains by owner in counties of over 250,000; inspection and notice by county engineer
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 269.240. Removal of obstructions from nonnavigable streams or drains by owner in counties of over 250,000; inspection and notice by county engineer (2023)
content:
(1)  The owner of land in any county containing more than 250,000 population through
      which a nonnavigable stream has its natural outlet, or through which ditches or drains
      have been constructed and other ditches have their outlet, shall keep the same free
      from driftwood, trash or any obstruction which would stop the free flow of water.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXII. Levees, Drainage, and Reclamation of Lands›Chapter 269. Miscellaneous Provisions as to Ditches, Drainage, and Reclamation›KY REV ST 269.250. County engineer to remove obstructions not removed by owner; lien for and payment of cost
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXII. Levees, Drainage, and Reclamation of Lands › Chapter 269. Miscellaneous Provisions as to Ditches, Drainage, and Reclamation › KY REV ST 269.250. County engineer to remove obstructions not removed by owner; lien for and payment of cost
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 269.250. County engineer to remove obstructions not removed by owner; lien for and payment of cost (2023)
content:
The county engineer shall remove any obstruction not removed by the property owner
   within sixty (60) days after having been notified.  The county engineer shall do this work in the same manner as road work is done in
   the county.  He or his deputies shall keep an accurate account of the cost of the work and charge
   it against the property owner whose duty it was to do it.  This cost shall be a lien upon the land and shall be added to the tax bill next
   due to the county.

citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 271B.5-010. Registered office and registered agent; requirement for agent's written acceptance of appointment (2023)
content:
Each corporation shall continuously maintain in this Commonwealth a registered office
   and a registered agent that comply withKRS 14A.4-010.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 271B. Business Corporations›Subtitle 6. Shares and Distributions›KY REV ST 271B.6-030. Issued and outstanding shares
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 271B. Business Corporations › Subtitle 6. Shares and Distributions › KY REV ST 271B.6-030. Issued and outstanding shares
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 271B.6-030. Issued and outstanding shares (2023)
content:
(1)  A corporation may issue the number of shares of each class or series authorized
      by the articles of incorporation.  Shares that are issued shall be outstanding shares until they are reacquired, redeemed,
      converted, or canceled.

citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 271B.6-040. Fractional shares (2023)
content: (1)  A corporation may:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 271B. Business Corporations›Issuance of Shares›KY REV ST 271B.6-230. Share dividends
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 271B. Business Corporations › Issuance of Shares › KY REV ST 271B.6-230. Share dividends
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 271B.6-230. Share dividends (2023)
content:
(1)  Unless the articles of incorporation provide otherwise, shares may be issued
      pro rata and without consideration to the corporation's shareholders or to the shareholders
      of one (1) or more classes or series.  An issuance of shares under this subsection shall be considered a share dividend.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 271B. Business Corporations›Issuance of Shares›KY REV ST 271B.6-200. Subscription of shares before incorporation
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 271B. Business Corporations › Issuance of Shares › KY REV ST 271B.6-200. Subscription of shares before incorporation
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 271B.6-200. Subscription of shares before incorporation (2023)
content:
(1)  A subscription for shares entered into before incorporation shall be irrevocable
      for six (6) months, unless the subscription agreement provides a longer or shorter
      period or all the subscribers agree to revocation.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 271B. Business Corporations›Issuance of Shares›KY REV ST 271B.6-220. Liability of shareholders
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 271B. Business Corporations › Issuance of Shares › KY REV ST 271B.6-220. Liability of shareholders
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 271B.6-220. Liability of shareholders (2023)
content:
(1)  A purchaser from a corporation of its own shares shall not be liable to the corporation
      or its creditors with respect to the shares except to pay the consideration for which
      the shares were authorized to be issued or specified in the subscription agreement.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 271B. Business Corporations›Issuance of Shares›KY REV ST 271B.6-240. Share options
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 271B. Business Corporations › Issuance of Shares › KY REV ST 271B.6-240. Share options
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 271B.6-240. Share options (2023)
content:
(1)  A corporation may issue rights, options, or warrants for the purchase of shares
      of the corporation.  The board of directors shall determine the terms upon which the rights, options,
      or warrants are issued, their form and content, and the terms and conditions upon
      which and the consideration for which the shares are to be issued.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 271B. Business Corporations›Issuance of Shares›KY REV ST 271B.6-250. Form and content of certificate
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 271B. Business Corporations › Issuance of Shares › KY REV ST 271B.6-250. Form and content of certificate
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 271B.6-250. Form and content of certificate (2023)
content:
(1)  Shares may but need not be represented by certificates.  Unless this chapter or another statute expressly provides otherwise, the rights
      and obligations of shareholders shall be identical whether or not their shares are
      represented by certificates.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 271B. Business Corporations›Issuance of Shares›KY REV ST 271B.6-210. Issuance of shares
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 271B. Business Corporations › Issuance of Shares › KY REV ST 271B.6-210. Issuance of shares
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 271B.6-210. Issuance of shares (2023)
content:
(1)  The powers granted in this section to the board of directors may be reserved
      to the shareholders by the articles of incorporation.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 271B. Business Corporations›Issuance of Shares›KY REV ST 271B.6-260. Shares without certificates; shares of a public benefit corporation
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 271B. Business Corporations › Issuance of Shares › KY REV ST 271B.6-260. Shares without certificates; shares of a public benefit corporation
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 271B.6-260. Shares without certificates; shares of a public benefit corporation (2023)
content:
(1)  Unless the articles of incorporation or bylaws provide otherwise, the board of
      directors of a corporation may authorize the issue of some or all of the shares of
      any or all of its classes or series without certificates.  The authorization shall not affect shares already represented by certificates until
      they are surrendered to the corporation.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 271B. Business Corporations›Subsequent Acquisition of Shares by Shareholders and Corporation›KY REV ST 271B.6-300. Shareholders' preemptive rights
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 271B. Business Corporations › Subsequent Acquisition of Shares by Shareholders and Corporation › KY REV ST 271B.6-300. Shareholders' preemptive rights
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 271B.6-300. Shareholders' preemptive rights (2023)
content:
(1)  The shareholders of a corporation shall not have a preemptive right to acquire
      the corporation's unissued shares except:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 271B. Business Corporations›Issuance of Shares›KY REV ST 271B.6-270. Restrictions on transfer or registration of shares or other securities
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 271B. Business Corporations › Issuance of Shares › KY REV ST 271B.6-270. Restrictions on transfer or registration of shares or other securities
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 271B.6-270. Restrictions on transfer or registration of shares or other securities (2023)
content:
(1)  The articles of incorporation, bylaws, an agreement among shareholders, or an
      agreement between shareholders and the corporation may impose restrictions on the
      transfer or registration of transfer of shares of the corporation.  A restriction shall not affect shares issued before the restriction was adopted
      unless the holders of the shares are parties to the restriction agreement or voted
      in favor of the restriction.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 271B. Business Corporations›Distributions›KY REV ST 271B.6-400. Distributions to shareholders
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 271B. Business Corporations › Distributions › KY REV ST 271B.6-400. Distributions to shareholders
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 271B.6-400. Distributions to shareholders (2023)
content:
(1)  A board of directors may authorize and the corporation may make distributions
      to its shareholders subject to restriction by the articles of incorporation and the
      limitation in subsection (3) of this section.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 271B. Business Corporations›Subtitle 7. Shareholders›Meetings›KY REV ST 271B.7-020. Special meeting

citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 271B.7-020. Special meeting (2023)
content: (1)  A corporation shall hold a special meeting of shareholders:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 271B. Business Corporations›Subtitle 7. Shareholders›Meetings›KY REV ST 271B.7-010. Annual meeting
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 271B. Business Corporations › Subtitle 7. Shareholders › Meetings › KY REV ST 271B.7-010. Annual meeting
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 271B.7-010. Annual meeting (2023)
content:
(1)  A corporation shall hold a meeting of shareholders annually at a time stated
      in or fixed in accordance with the bylaws.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 271B. Business Corporations›Subtitle 7. Shareholders›Meetings›KY REV ST 271B.7-040. Action without meeting
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 271B. Business Corporations › Subtitle 7. Shareholders › Meetings › KY REV ST 271B.7-040. Action without meeting
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 271B.7-040. Action without meeting (2023)
content:
(1)  Except as provided in the articles of incorporation, action required or permitted
      by this chapter to be taken at a shareholders' meeting may be taken without a meeting
      and without prior notice, except as provided in subsection (8) of this section, if
      the action is taken by all the shareholders entitled to vote on the action.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 271B. Business Corporations›Issuance of Shares›KY REV ST 271B.6-280. Expense of issue
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 271B. Business Corporations › Issuance of Shares › KY REV ST 271B.6-280. Expense of issue
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 271B.6-280. Expense of issue (2023)
content:
A corporation may pay or allow the expenses of selling or underwriting its shares
   or other securities, and of organizing or reorganizing the corporation, from the consideration
   received for shares without thereby rendering such shares or other securities not
   fully paid or assessable.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 271B. Business Corporations›Subsequent Acquisition of Shares by Shareholders and Corporation›KY REV ST 271B.6-310. Corporation's acquisition of its own shares
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 271B. Business Corporations › Subsequent Acquisition of Shares by Shareholders and Corporation › KY REV ST 271B.6-310. Corporation's acquisition of its own shares
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 271B.6-310. Corporation's acquisition of its own shares (2023)
content:
(1)  A corporation may acquire its own shares and shares so acquired shall constitute
      authorized but unissued shares.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 271B. Business Corporations›Subtitle 7. Shareholders›Meetings›KY REV ST 271B.7-030. Court-ordered meeting
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 271B. Business Corporations › Subtitle 7. Shareholders › Meetings › KY REV ST 271B.7-030. Court-ordered meeting
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 271B.7-030. Court-ordered meeting (2023)
content:
(1)  The Circuit Court for the county where a corporation's principal office (or,
      if none in this state, its registered office) is located may summarily order a meeting
      to be held:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 271B. Business Corporations›Subtitle 7. Shareholders›Meetings›KY REV ST 271B.7-050. Notice of meeting
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 271B. Business Corporations › Subtitle 7. Shareholders › Meetings › KY REV ST 271B.7-050. Notice of meeting
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 271B.7-050. Notice of meeting (2023)
content:
(1)  A corporation shall notify shareholders of the date, time, and place of each
      annual and special shareholders' meeting no fewer than ten (10) nor more than sixty
      (60) days before the meeting date.  Unless this chapter or the articles of incorporation require otherwise, the corporation
      shall be required to give notice only to shareholders entitled to vote at the meeting.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 271B. Business Corporations›Meetings›KY REV ST 271B.7-010. Annual meeting
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 271B. Business Corporations › Meetings › KY REV ST 271B.7-010. Annual meeting
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 271B.7-010. Annual meeting (2023)
content:
(1)  A corporation shall hold a meeting of shareholders annually at a time stated
      in or fixed in accordance with the bylaws.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 271B. Business Corporations›Subtitle 7. Shareholders›Meetings›KY REV ST 271B.7-060. Waiver of notice
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 271B. Business Corporations › Subtitle 7. Shareholders › Meetings › KY REV ST 271B.7-060. Waiver of notice
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 271B.7-060. Waiver of notice (2023)
content:
(1)  A shareholder may waive any notice required by this chapter, the articles of
      incorporation, or bylaws before or after the date and time stated in the notice.  The waiver shall be in writing, be signed by the shareholder entitled to the notice,
      and be delivered to the corporation for inclusion in the minutes or filing with the
      corporate records.

content: (1)  A corporation shall hold a special meeting of shareholders:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 271B. Business Corporations›Subtitle 7. Shareholders›Voting›KY REV ST 271B.7-200. Shareholders' list for meeting
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 271B. Business Corporations › Subtitle 7. Shareholders › Voting › KY REV ST 271B.7-200. Shareholders' list for meeting
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 271B.7-200. Shareholders' list for meeting (2023)
content:
(1)  After fixing a record date for a meeting, a corporation shall prepare a list
      of the names of all its shareholders who are entitled to notice of a shareholders'
      meeting.  The list shall be arranged by voting group (and within each voting group by class
      or series of shares) and show the address of and number of shares held by each shareholder.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 271B. Business Corporations›Subtitle 7. Shareholders›Voting›KY REV ST 271B.7-220. Proxies
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 271B. Business Corporations › Subtitle 7. Shareholders › Voting › KY REV ST 271B.7-220. Proxies
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 271B.7-220. Proxies (2023)
content: (1)  A shareholder may vote his or her shares in person or by proxy.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 271B. Business Corporations›Subtitle 7. Shareholders›Voting›KY REV ST 271B.7-240. Corporation's acceptance of votes and persons authorized to vote shares
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 271B. Business Corporations › Subtitle 7. Shareholders › Voting › KY REV ST 271B.7-240. Corporation's acceptance of votes and persons authorized to vote shares
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 271B.7-240. Corporation's acceptance of votes and persons authorized to vote shares (2023)
content:
(1)  If the name signed on or submitted with a vote, consent, waiver, or proxy appointment
      corresponds to the name or electronic signature of a shareholder, the corporation
      if acting in good faith shall be entitled to accept the vote, consent, waiver, or
      proxy appointment and give it effect as the act of the shareholder.  For purposes of this section, a telegram or cablegram appearing to have been transmitted
      by the proper person, or a photographic, photostatic, or equivalent reproduction of
      a writing appointing a proxy may be accepted by the corporation, if acting in good
      faith, as a sufficient, signed appointment form.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 271B. Business Corporations›Subtitle 7. Shareholders›Meetings›KY REV ST 271B.7-080. Remote communication
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 271B. Business Corporations › Subtitle 7. Shareholders › Meetings › KY REV ST 271B.7-080. Remote communication
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 271B.7-080. Remote communication (2023)
content:
(1)  If the board of directors is authorized to determine the place of an annual or
      special meeting of shareholders, the board of directors, in its sole discretion, may
      determine that the meeting shall not be held at any place but shall instead be held
      solely by means of remote communication under subsection (2) of this section.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 271B. Business Corporations›Subtitle 7. Shareholders›Meetings›KY REV ST 271B.7-070. Record date
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 271B. Business Corporations › Subtitle 7. Shareholders › Meetings › KY REV ST 271B.7-070. Record date
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 271B.7-070. Record date (2023)
content:
(1)  The bylaws may fix or provide the manner of fixing the record date for one (1)
      or more voting groups in order to determine the shareholders entitled to notice of
      a shareholders' meeting, to demand a special meeting, to vote, or to take any other
      action.  If the bylaws do not fix or provide for fixing a record date, the board of directors
      of the corporation may fix a future date as the record date.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 271B. Business Corporations›Subtitle 7. Shareholders›Voting›KY REV ST 271B.7-210. Voting entitlement of shares
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 271B. Business Corporations › Subtitle 7. Shareholders › Voting › KY REV ST 271B.7-210. Voting entitlement of shares
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 271B.7-210. Voting entitlement of shares (2023)
content:
(1)  Except as provided in subsections (2) and (4) of this section or unless the articles
      of incorporation provide otherwise, each outstanding share, regardless of class, shall
      be entitled to one (1) vote on each matter voted on at a shareholders' meeting.  Only shares shall be entitled to vote.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 271B. Business Corporations›Meetings›KY REV ST 271B.7-070. Record date
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 271B. Business Corporations › Meetings › KY REV ST 271B.7-070. Record date

      a shareholders' meeting, to demand a special meeting, to vote, or to take any other

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 271B. Business Corporations›Voting›KY REV ST 271B.7-230. Shares held by nominees
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 271B. Business Corporations › Voting › KY REV ST 271B.7-230. Shares held by nominees
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 271B.7-230. Shares held by nominees (2023)
content:
(1)  A corporation may establish a procedure by which the beneficial owner of shares
      that are registered in the name of a nominee is recognized by the corporation as the
      shareholder.  The extent of this recognition may be determined in the procedure.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 271B. Business Corporations›Subtitle 7. Shareholders›Voting›KY REV ST 271B.7-270. Greater quorum or voting requirements
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 271B. Business Corporations › Subtitle 7. Shareholders › Voting › KY REV ST 271B.7-270. Greater quorum or voting requirements
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 271B.7-270. Greater quorum or voting requirements (2023)
content:
(1)  The articles of incorporation may provide for a greater quorum or voting requirement
      for shareholders (or voting groups of shareholders) than is provided for by this chapter.

citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 271B.7-260. Action by single and multiple voting groups (2023)
content:
(1)  If the articles of incorporation or this chapter provide for voting by a single
      voting group on a matter, action on that matter shall be taken when voted upon by
      that voting group as provided inKRS 271B.7-250.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 271B. Business Corporations›Voting›KY REV ST 271B.7-220. Proxies
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 271B. Business Corporations › Voting › KY REV ST 271B.7-220. Proxies
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 271B.7-220. Proxies (2023)
content: (1)  A shareholder may vote his or her shares in person or by proxy.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 271B. Business Corporations›Subtitle 7. Shareholders›Voting›KY REV ST 271B.7-280. Voting for directors; cumulative voting
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 271B. Business Corporations › Subtitle 7. Shareholders › Voting › KY REV ST 271B.7-280. Voting for directors; cumulative voting
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 271B.7-280. Voting for directors; cumulative voting (2023)
content:
(1)  Unless otherwise provided in the articles of incorporation, directors are elected
      by a plurality of votes cast by the shares entitled to vote in the election at a meeting
      at which a quorum is present.  A “plurality” means that the individuals with the largest number of votes are elected as directors
      up to the maximum number of directors to be chosen at the election.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 271B. Business Corporations›Voting›KY REV ST 271B.7-200. Shareholders' list for meeting
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 271B. Business Corporations › Voting › KY REV ST 271B.7-200. Shareholders' list for meeting
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 271B.7-200. Shareholders' list for meeting (2023)
content:
(1)  After fixing a record date for a meeting, a corporation shall prepare a list
      of the names of all its shareholders who are entitled to notice of a shareholders'
      meeting.  The list shall be arranged by voting group (and within each voting group by class
      or series of shares) and show the address of and number of shares held by each shareholder.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 271B. Business Corporations›Subtitle 7. Shareholders›Derivative Proceedings›KY REV ST 271B.7-400. Procedure in derivative proceedings; shareholders of a public benefit corporation
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 271B. Business Corporations › Subtitle 7. Shareholders › Derivative Proceedings › KY REV ST 271B.7-400. Procedure in derivative proceedings; shareholders of a public benefit corporation
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 271B.7-400. Procedure in derivative proceedings; shareholders of a public benefit corporation (2023)
content:
(1)  A person shall not commence a proceeding in the right of a domestic or foreign
      corporation unless he was a shareholder of the corporation when the transaction complained
      of occurred or unless he became a shareholder through transfer by operation of law
      from one who was a shareholder at that time.  The derivative proceeding shall not be maintained if it appears that the person
      commencing the proceeding does not fairly and adequately represent the interests of
      the shareholders in enforcing the right of the corporation.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 271B. Business Corporations›Voting›KY REV ST 271B.7-210. Voting entitlement of shares
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 271B. Business Corporations › Voting › KY REV ST 271B.7-210. Voting entitlement of shares
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 271B.7-210. Voting entitlement of shares (2023)
content:
(1)  Except as provided in subsections (2) and (4) of this section or unless the articles
      of incorporation provide otherwise, each outstanding share, regardless of class, shall
      be entitled to one (1) vote on each matter voted on at a shareholders' meeting.  Only shares shall be entitled to vote.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 271B. Business Corporations›Subtitle 7. Shareholders›Voting Trusts and Agreements›KY REV ST 271B.7-310. Voting agreements
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 271B. Business Corporations › Subtitle 7. Shareholders › Voting Trusts and Agreements › KY REV ST 271B.7-310. Voting agreements
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 271B.7-310. Voting agreements (2023)
content:
(1)  Two (2) or more shareholders may provide for the manner in which they will vote
      their shares by signing an agreement for that purpose.  A voting agreement created under this section shall not be subject to the provisions
      ofKRS 271B.7-300.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 271B. Business Corporations›Subtitle 7. Shareholders›Voting Trusts and Agreements›KY REV ST 271B.7-300. Voting trusts
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 271B. Business Corporations › Subtitle 7. Shareholders › Voting Trusts and Agreements › KY REV ST 271B.7-300. Voting trusts
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 271B.7-300. Voting trusts (2023)
content:
(1)  One (1) or more shareholders may create a voting trust, conferring on a trustee
      the right to vote or otherwise act for them, by signing an agreement setting out the
      provisions of the trust (which may include anything consistent with its purpose) and
      transferring their shares to the trustee.  When a voting trust agreement is signed, the trustee shall prepare a list of the
      names and addresses of all owners of beneficial interests in the trust, together with
      the number and class of shares each transferred to the trust, and deliver copies of
      the list and agreement to the corporation's principal office.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 271B. Business Corporations›Subtitle 7. Shareholders›Voting›KY REV ST 271B.7-250. Quorum and voting requirements for voting groups
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 271B. Business Corporations › Subtitle 7. Shareholders › Voting › KY REV ST 271B.7-250. Quorum and voting requirements for voting groups
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 271B.7-250. Quorum and voting requirements for voting groups (2023)
content:
(1)  Shares entitled to vote as a separate voting group may take action on a matter
      at a meeting only if a quorum of those shares exists with respect to that matter.  Unless the articles of incorporation or this chapter provide otherwise, a majority
      of the votes entitled to be cast on the matter by the voting group shall constitute
      a quorum of that voting group for action on that matter.

content:

citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.1-030. Limited cooperative association subject to amendment or repeal of chapter (2023)

   or repeal of this chapter.

      a jointly owned enterprise primarily controlled by those persons, which permits combining:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 1. General Provisions›KY REV ST 272A.1-110. Effect of organic rules
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act › Subchapter 1. General Provisions › KY REV ST 272A.1-110. Effect of organic rules
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.1-110. Effect of organic rules (2023)
content:
(1)  The relations between a limited cooperative association and its members are consensual.  Unless required, limited, or prohibited by this chapter, the organic rules may provide
      for any matter concerning the relations among the members of the association and between
      the members and the association, the activities of the association, and the conduct
      of its activities.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 1. General Provisions›KY REV ST 272A.1-140. Registered office and agent

citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.1-140. Registered office and agent (2023)
content:
A limited cooperative association shall designate and continuously maintain in this
   Commonwealth a registered office and agent registered in accordance withKRS 14A.4-010.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 1. General Provisions›KY REV ST 272A.1-080. Supplemental principles of law
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act › Subchapter 1. General Provisions › KY REV ST 272A.1-080. Supplemental principles of law
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.1-080. Supplemental principles of law (2023)
content:
(1)  It shall be the policy of the General Assembly through this chapter to give maximum
      effect to the principles of freedom of contract and to the enforceability of organic
      rules.  Unless displaced by particular provisions of this chapter, the principles of law
      and equity shall supplement this chapter.

title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act › Subchapter 1. General Provisions › KY REV ST 272A.1-090. Relation to restraint of trade and antitrust laws
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.1-090. Relation to restraint of trade and antitrust laws (2023)
content:
No cooperative, foreign cooperative, or agreements between cooperatives and their
   members shall be considered a conspiracy, a combination in restraint of trade, an
   illegal monopoly, or an attempt to lessen competition, fix prices arbitrarily, or
   create a combination or pool in violation of any law of this state.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 2. Filings with the Secretary of State›KY REV ST 272A.2-030. Liability for inaccurate information in filed record
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act › Subchapter 2. Filings with the Secretary of State › KY REV ST 272A.2-030. Liability for inaccurate information in filed record
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.2-030. Liability for inaccurate information in filed record (2023)
content:
If a record delivered to the Secretary of State for filing under this chapter and
   filed by the Secretary of State contains inaccurate information, a person that suffers
   a loss by reliance on the information may recover damages for the loss from a person
   that signed the record or caused another to sign it on the person's behalf and knew
   at the time the record was signed that the information was inaccurate.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 4. Amendment of Organic Rules›KY REV ST 272A.4-040. Voting by district, class, or voting group
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act › Subchapter 4. Amendment of Organic Rules › KY REV ST 272A.4-040. Voting by district, class, or voting group
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.4-040. Voting by district, class, or voting group (2023)
content:
(1)  This section applies if the organic rules provide for voting by district or class,
      or if there is one (1) or more identifiable voting groups that a proposed amendment
      to the organic rules would affect differently from other members with respect to matters
      identified inKRS 272A.4-050(5)(a) to (e).  Approval of the amendment requires the same percentage of votes of the members of
      that district, class, or voting group required inKRS 272A.4-050and272A.5-120.

citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.3-010. Organizers; formation of limited cooperative association; articles of association (2023)

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 4. Amendment of Organic Rules›KY REV ST 272A.4-060. Restated articles of association
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act › Subchapter 4. Amendment of Organic Rules › KY REV ST 272A.4-060. Restated articles of association
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.4-060. Restated articles of association (2023)
content:
A limited cooperative association, by the affirmative vote of a majority of the board
   of directors taken at a meeting for which the purpose is stated in the notice of the
   meeting, may adopt restated articles of association that contain the original articles
   as previously amended.  Restated articles may contain amendments if the restated articles are adopted in
   the same manner and with the same vote as required for amendments to the articles
   underKRS 272A.4-050.  Upon filing, restated articles supersede the existing articles and all amendments.

citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.4-010. Authority to amend organic rules (2023)
content:
(1)  A limited cooperative association may amend its organic rules for any lawful
      purpose.  In addition, the initial board of directors may amend the bylaws of an association
      underKRS 272A.3-030.

citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.4-070. Amendment or restatement of articles of association; filing (2023)
content:
(1)  To amend its articles of association, a limited cooperative association shall
      deliver to the Secretary of State for filing an amendment of the articles, or restated
      articles of association or articles of conversion or merger pursuant to Subchapter
      16 of this chapter, which contain one (1) or more amendments of the articles of association,
      stating:

content:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 4. Amendment of Organic Rules›KY REV ST 272A.4-020. Notice and action on amendment of organic rules

citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.4-020. Notice and action on amendment of organic rules (2023)
content:
(1)  Except as provided inKRS 272A.4-010(1)and272A.4-050(6), the organic rules of a limited cooperative association may be amended only at a
      members meeting.  An amendment may be proposed by either:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 5. Members›KY REV ST 272A.5-020. No power as member to bind association
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act › Subchapter 5. Members › KY REV ST 272A.5-020. No power as member to bind association
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.5-020. No power as member to bind association (2023)
content:
A member, solely by reason of being a member, may not act for or bind the limited
   cooperative association.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 5. Members›KY REV ST 272A.5-010. Members; becoming a member
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act › Subchapter 5. Members › KY REV ST 272A.5-010. Members; becoming a member
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.5-010. Members; becoming a member (2023)
content:
(1)  To begin business, a limited cooperative association shall have at least two
      (2) patron members unless the sole member is a cooperative.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 5. Members›KY REV ST 272A.5-030. Liability as member for association's obligations
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act › Subchapter 5. Members › KY REV ST 272A.5-030. Liability as member for association's obligations
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.5-030. Liability as member for association's obligations (2023)
content:
(1)  Unless the articles of association otherwise provide, a debt, obligation, or
      other liability of a limited cooperative association is solely that of the association
      and is not the debt, obligation, or liability of a member solely by reason of being
      a member.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 5. Members›KY REV ST 272A.5-050. Annual meeting of members
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act › Subchapter 5. Members › KY REV ST 272A.5-050. Annual meeting of members
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.5-050. Annual meeting of members (2023)
content:
(1)  Members shall meet annually at a time provided in the organic rules or set by
      the board of directors not inconsistent with the organic rules.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 5. Members›KY REV ST 272A.5-090. Quorum of members
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act › Subchapter 5. Members › KY REV ST 272A.5-090. Quorum of members
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.5-090. Quorum of members (2023)
content:
Unless the organic rules otherwise require a greater number of members or percentage
   of the voting power, the voting member or members present at a members meeting constitute
   a quorum.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 5. Members›KY REV ST 272A.5-040. Right of member to information
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act › Subchapter 5. Members › KY REV ST 272A.5-040. Right of member to information
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.5-040. Right of member to information (2023)
content:
(1)  Not later than ten (10) business days after receipt of a demand made in a record,
      a limited cooperative association shall permit a member to obtain, inspect, and copy
      in the association's principal office required information listed inKRS 272A.1-120(1)(a) to (h)during regular business hours.  A member need not have any particular purpose for seeking the information.  The association is not required to provide the same information listed inKRS 272A.1-120(1)(b) to (h)to the same member more than once during a six (6) month period.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 5. Members›KY REV ST 272A.5-070. Notice of members meeting
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act › Subchapter 5. Members › KY REV ST 272A.5-070. Notice of members meeting
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.5-070. Notice of members meeting (2023)
content:
(1)  A limited cooperative association shall notify each member of the time, date,
      and place of a members meeting at least ten (10) and not more than sixty (60) days
      before the meeting.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 5. Members›KY REV ST 272A.5-060. Special meeting of members
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act › Subchapter 5. Members › KY REV ST 272A.5-060. Special meeting of members

content: (1)  A special meeting of members may be called only:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 5. Members›KY REV ST 272A.5-110. Voting by investor members
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act › Subchapter 5. Members › KY REV ST 272A.5-110. Voting by investor members
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.5-110. Voting by investor members (2023)
content:
If the organic rules provide for investor members, each investor member has one (1)
   vote, unless the organic rules otherwise provide.  The organic rules may provide for the allocation of investor member voting power
   by class, classes, or any combination of classes.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 5. Members›KY REV ST 272A.5-130. Manner of voting; proxies
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act › Subchapter 5. Members › KY REV ST 272A.5-130. Manner of voting; proxies
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.5-130. Manner of voting; proxies (2023)
content:
(1)  Unless the organic rules otherwise provide, voting by a proxy at a members meeting
      is prohibited.  This subsection does not prohibit delegate voting based on district or class.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 5. Members›KY REV ST 272A.5-080. Waiver of notice
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act › Subchapter 5. Members › KY REV ST 272A.5-080. Waiver of notice
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.5-080. Waiver of notice (2023)
content: (1)  A member may waive notice of a members meeting before, during, or after the meeting.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 5. Members›KY REV ST 272A.5-100. Voting by patron members; determination of voting power of patron member
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act › Subchapter 5. Members › KY REV ST 272A.5-100. Voting by patron members; determination of voting power of patron member
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.5-100. Voting by patron members; determination of voting power of patron member (2023)
content:
(1)  Except as provided by subsections (2) and (3) of this section, each patron member
      has one (1) vote.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 5. Members›KY REV ST 272A.5-140. Action without a meeting
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act › Subchapter 5. Members › KY REV ST 272A.5-140. Action without a meeting
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.5-140. Action without a meeting (2023)
content:
(1)  Unless the organic rules require that action be taken only at a members meeting,
      any action that may be taken by the members may be taken without a meeting if each
      member entitled to vote on the action consents in a record to the action.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 5. Members›KY REV ST 272A.5-120. Voting requirements for members

citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.5-120. Voting requirements for members (2023)
content:

   rules apply:
