content: A member's interest:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 6. Member’s Interest in Limited Cooperative Association›KY REV ST 272A.6-030. Transferability of member's interest
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act › Subchapter 6. Member’s Interest in Limited Cooperative Association › KY REV ST 272A.6-030. Transferability of member's interest
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.6-030. Transferability of member's interest (2023)
content:
(1)  The provisions of this chapter relating to the transferability of a member's
      interest are subject to the Uniform Commercial Code as enacted in the Commonwealth
      of Kentucky in KRS Chapter 355.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 6. Member’s Interest in Limited Cooperative Association›KY REV ST 272A.6-020. Patron and investor members' interests
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act › Subchapter 6. Member’s Interest in Limited Cooperative Association › KY REV ST 272A.6-020. Patron and investor members' interests
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.6-020. Patron and investor members' interests (2023)
content:
(1)  Unless the organic rules establish investor members' interests, a member's interest
      is a patron member's interest.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 6. Member’s Interest in Limited Cooperative Association›KY REV ST 272A.6-040. Security interest and set-off
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act › Subchapter 6. Member’s Interest in Limited Cooperative Association › KY REV ST 272A.6-040. Security interest and set-off
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.6-040. Security interest and set-off (2023)
content:
(1)  A member or transferee may create an enforceable security interest in its financial
      rights in a limited cooperative association.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 6. Member’s Interest in Limited Cooperative Association›KY REV ST 272A.6-050. Charging order
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act › Subchapter 6. Member’s Interest in Limited Cooperative Association › KY REV ST 272A.6-050. Charging order
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.6-050. Charging order (2023)
content:
(1)  This section provides the exclusive remedy by which the judgment creditor of
      a member or the assignee of a member may satisfy a judgment out of the judgment debtor's
      limited financial rights in a limited cooperative association.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 7. Marketing Contracts›KY REV ST 272A.7-020. Marketing contracts; title and enforcement
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act › Subchapter 7. Marketing Contracts › KY REV ST 272A.7-020. Marketing contracts; title and enforcement
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.7-020. Marketing contracts; title and enforcement (2023)
content:
(1)  If a marketing contract provides for the sale of products, commodities, or goods
      to a limited cooperative association, the sale transfers title to the association
      upon delivery or at any other specific time expressly provided by the contract.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 7. Marketing Contracts›KY REV ST 272A.7-010. Definition of marketing contract
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act › Subchapter 7. Marketing Contracts › KY REV ST 272A.7-010. Definition of marketing contract
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.7-010. Definition of marketing contract (2023)
content:
As used in this subchapter, “marketing contract” means a contract between a limited cooperative association and another person that
   need not be a patron member:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 7. Marketing Contracts›KY REV ST 272A.7-040. Remedies for breach of marketing contract
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act › Subchapter 7. Marketing Contracts › KY REV ST 272A.7-040. Remedies for breach of marketing contract
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.7-040. Remedies for breach of marketing contract (2023)
content:
(1)  Damages to be paid to a limited cooperative association for breach or anticipatory
      repudiation of a marketing contract may be liquidated, but only at an amount or under
      a formula that is reasonable in light of the actual or anticipated harm caused by
      the breach or repudiation assessed as of the time of the making of the marketing contract.  A provision that so provides is not a penalty or otherwise unreasonable.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 8. Board of Directors; Officers›KY REV ST 272A.8-040. Election of directors and composition of board
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act › Subchapter 8. Board of Directors; Officers › KY REV ST 272A.8-040. Election of directors and composition of board
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.8-040. Election of directors and composition of board (2023)
content: (1)  Unless the organic rules require a greater number:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 7. Marketing Contracts›KY REV ST 272A.7-030. Duration of marketing contracts
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act › Subchapter 7. Marketing Contracts › KY REV ST 272A.7-030. Duration of marketing contracts
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.7-030. Duration of marketing contracts (2023)
content:
The initial duration of a marketing contract may not exceed ten (10) years, but the
   contract may be self-renewing for additional periods not exceeding five (5) years
   each.  Unless the contract provides for another manner or time for termination, either
   party may terminate the contract by giving notice in a record at least ninety (90)
   days before the end of the current term.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 8. Board of Directors; Officers›KY REV ST 272A.8-010. Board of directors
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act › Subchapter 8. Board of Directors; Officers › KY REV ST 272A.8-010. Board of directors
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.8-010. Board of directors (2023)
content:
(1)  A limited cooperative association shall have a board of directors of at least
      three (3) individuals, unless the association has fewer than three (3) members.  If the association has fewer than three (3) members, the number of directors may
      not be fewer than the number of members.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 8. Board of Directors; Officers›KY REV ST 272A.8-050. Term of directors
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act › Subchapter 8. Board of Directors; Officers › KY REV ST 272A.8-050. Term of directors
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.8-050. Term of directors (2023)
content:
(1)  Unless the organic rules otherwise provide, and subject to subsections (3) and
      (4) of this section andKRS 272A.3-020(5), the term of a director expires at the annual members meeting following the director's
      election or appointment.  The term of a director may not exceed three (3) years.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 8. Board of Directors; Officers›KY REV ST 272A.8-030. Director qualifications
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act › Subchapter 8. Board of Directors; Officers › KY REV ST 272A.8-030. Director qualifications
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.8-030. Director qualifications (2023)
content:
(1)  Unless the organic rules otherwise provide, and subject to subsection (3) of
      this section, each director of a limited cooperative association shall be an individual
      who is a member of the association or an individual who is designated by an entity
      member for purposes of qualifying and serving as a director.  Initial directors need not be members.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 8. Board of Directors; Officers›KY REV ST 272A.8-060. Resignation of director
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act › Subchapter 8. Board of Directors; Officers › KY REV ST 272A.8-060. Resignation of director
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.8-060. Resignation of director (2023)
content:
A director may resign at any time by giving notice in a record to the limited cooperative
   association.  Unless the notice states a later effective date, a resignation is effective when
   the notice is received by the association.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 8. Board of Directors; Officers›KY REV ST 272A.8-100. Remuneration of directors
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act › Subchapter 8. Board of Directors; Officers › KY REV ST 272A.8-100. Remuneration of directors
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.8-100. Remuneration of directors (2023)
content:
Unless the organic rules otherwise provide, the board of directors may set the remuneration
   of directors and of nondirector committee members appointed underKRS 272A.8-170.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 8. Board of Directors; Officers›KY REV ST 272A.8-020. Liability as director for limited cooperative association's obligations
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act › Subchapter 8. Board of Directors; Officers › KY REV ST 272A.8-020. Liability as director for limited cooperative association's obligations
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.8-020. Liability as director for limited cooperative association's obligations (2023)
content:
(1)  A debt, obligation, or other liability of a limited cooperative association is
      solely that of the association and is not a debt, obligation, or liability of a director
      solely by reason of being a director.  An individual is not personally liable, directly or indirectly, for an obligation
      of an association solely by reason of being a director.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 8. Board of Directors; Officers›KY REV ST 272A.8-070. Removal of director
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act › Subchapter 8. Board of Directors; Officers › KY REV ST 272A.8-070. Removal of director
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.8-070. Removal of director (2023)
content: (1)  Members may remove a director with or without cause.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 8. Board of Directors; Officers›KY REV ST 272A.8-080. Suspension of director by board
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act › Subchapter 8. Board of Directors; Officers › KY REV ST 272A.8-080. Suspension of director by board
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.8-080. Suspension of director by board (2023)
content:
(1)  A board of directors may suspend a director if, considering the director's course
      of conduct and the inadequacy of other available remedies, immediate suspension is
      necessary for the best interests of the association and the director is engaging,
      or has engaged, in:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 8. Board of Directors; Officers›KY REV ST 272A.8-110. Board meetings
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act › Subchapter 8. Board of Directors; Officers › KY REV ST 272A.8-110. Board meetings
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.8-110. Board meetings (2023)
content:
(1)  A board of directors shall meet at least annually and may hold meetings inside
      or outside of the Commonwealth of Kentucky.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 8. Board of Directors; Officers›KY REV ST 272A.8-090. Vacancy on board

citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.8-090. Vacancy on board (2023)
content:
(1)  Unless the organic rules otherwise provide, a vacancy on the board of directors
      shall be filled:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 8. Board of Directors; Officers›KY REV ST 272A.8-120. Board action without meeting
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act › Subchapter 8. Board of Directors; Officers › KY REV ST 272A.8-120. Board action without meeting
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.8-120. Board action without meeting (2023)
content:
(1)  Unless prohibited by the organic rules, any action that may be taken by a board
      of directors may be taken without a meeting if each director consents in a record
      to the action.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 8. Board of Directors; Officers›KY REV ST 272A.8-130. Meetings and notice
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act › Subchapter 8. Board of Directors; Officers › KY REV ST 272A.8-130. Meetings and notice
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.8-130. Meetings and notice (2023)
content:
(1)  Unless the organic rules otherwise provide, a board of directors may establish
      a time, date, and place for regular board meetings, and notice of the time, date,
      place, or purpose of those meetings is not required.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 8. Board of Directors; Officers›KY REV ST 272A.8-140. Waiver of notice of meeting
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act › Subchapter 8. Board of Directors; Officers › KY REV ST 272A.8-140. Waiver of notice of meeting
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.8-140. Waiver of notice of meeting (2023)
content:
(1)  Unless the organic rules otherwise provide, a director may waive any required
      notice of a meeting of the board of directors in a record before, during, or after
      the meeting.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 8. Board of Directors; Officers›KY REV ST 272A.8-160. Voting
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act › Subchapter 8. Board of Directors; Officers › KY REV ST 272A.8-160. Voting
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.8-160. Voting (2023)
content:
(1)  Each director shall have one (1) vote for purposes of decisions made by the board
      of directors.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 8. Board of Directors; Officers›KY REV ST 272A.8-150. Quorum
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act › Subchapter 8. Board of Directors; Officers › KY REV ST 272A.8-150. Quorum
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.8-150. Quorum (2023)
content:
(1)  Unless the articles of association provide for a greater number, a majority of
      the total number of directors specified by the organic rules constitutes a quorum
      for a meeting of the directors.

citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.8-180. Fiduciary standards of directors; conflict of interest (2023)
content: Except as otherwise provided inKRS 272A.8-190:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 8. Board of Directors; Officers›KY REV ST 272A.8-170. Committees
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act › Subchapter 8. Board of Directors; Officers › KY REV ST 272A.8-170. Committees
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.8-170. Committees (2023)
content:
(1)  Unless the organic rules otherwise provide, a board of directors may create one
      (1) or more committees and appoint one (1) or more individuals to serve on a committee.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 8. Board of Directors; Officers›KY REV ST 272A.8-190. Other considerations of directors

citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.8-190. Other considerations of directors (2023)
content:
Unless the articles of association otherwise provide, in considering the best interests
   of a limited cooperative association, in discharging the duties of director, in conjunction
   with considering the long- and short-term interest of the association and its patron
   members, a director may consider:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 9. Indemnification›KY REV ST 272A.9-010. Indemnification and advancement
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act › Subchapter 9. Indemnification › KY REV ST 272A.9-010. Indemnification and advancement
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.9-010. Indemnification and advancement (2023)
content:
(1)  The organic rules may provide indemnification to a director for judgments, settlements,
      penalties, fines, or expenses incurred in a proceeding to which a director is a party
      because the person is a director.

citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.8-210. Appointment and authority of officers (2023)
content: (1)  A limited cooperative association has the officers:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 8. Board of Directors; Officers›KY REV ST 272A.8-200. Right of director or committee member to information
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act › Subchapter 8. Board of Directors; Officers › KY REV ST 272A.8-200. Right of director or committee member to information
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.8-200. Right of director or committee member to information (2023)
content:
A director or a member of a committee appointed underKRS 272A.8-170may obtain, inspect, and copy all information regarding the state of activities and
   financial condition of the limited cooperative association and other information regarding
   the activities of the association if the information is reasonably related to the
   performance of the director's duties as director or the committee member's duties
   as a member of the committee.  Information obtained in accordance with this section may not be used in any manner
   that would violate any duty of or to the association.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 8. Board of Directors; Officers›KY REV ST 272A.8-220. Resignation and removal of officers
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act › Subchapter 8. Board of Directors; Officers › KY REV ST 272A.8-220. Resignation and removal of officers
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.8-220. Resignation and removal of officers (2023)
content: (1)  The board of directors may remove an officer at any time with or without cause.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 10. Contributions, Allocations, and Distributions›KY REV ST 272A.10-010. Member contributions
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act › Subchapter 10. Contributions, Allocations, and Distributions › KY REV ST 272A.10-010. Member contributions
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.10-010. Member contributions (2023)
content:
The organic rules shall establish the amount, manner, or method of determining any
   contribution requirements for members or shall authorize the board of directors to
   establish the amount, manner, or other method of determining any contribution requirements
   for members.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 10. Contributions, Allocations, and Distributions›KY REV ST 272A.10-020. Contribution and valuation
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act › Subchapter 10. Contributions, Allocations, and Distributions › KY REV ST 272A.10-020. Contribution and valuation
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.10-020. Contribution and valuation (2023)
content:
(1)  Unless the organic rules otherwise provide, the contributions of a member to
      a limited cooperative association may consist of tangible or intangible property or
      other benefit to the association, including money, labor, or other services performed
      or to be performed, promissory notes, other agreements to contribute money or property,
      and contracts to be performed.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 10. Contributions, Allocations, and Distributions›KY REV ST 272A.10-040. Allocation of profits and losses
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act › Subchapter 10. Contributions, Allocations, and Distributions › KY REV ST 272A.10-040. Allocation of profits and losses
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.10-040. Allocation of profits and losses (2023)
content:
(1)  The organic rules may provide for allocating profits of a limited cooperative
      association among members, among persons that are not members but conduct business
      with the association, to an unallocated account, or to any combination thereof.  Unless the organic rules otherwise provide, losses of the association shall be allocated
      in the same proportion as profits.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 10. Contributions, Allocations, and Distributions›KY REV ST 272A.10-060. Redemption or repurchase of distributed property
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act › Subchapter 10. Contributions, Allocations, and Distributions › KY REV ST 272A.10-060. Redemption or repurchase of distributed property
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.10-060. Redemption or repurchase of distributed property (2023)
content:
Property distributed to a member by a limited cooperative association, other than
   money, may be redeemed or repurchased as provided in the organic rules, but a redemption
   or repurchase may not be made without authorization by the board of directors.  The board may withhold authorization for any reason in its sole discretion.  A redemption or repurchase is treated as a distribution for purposes ofKRS 272A.10-070.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 10. Contributions, Allocations, and Distributions›KY REV ST 272A.10-050. Distributions
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act › Subchapter 10. Contributions, Allocations, and Distributions › KY REV ST 272A.10-050. Distributions
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.10-050. Distributions (2023)
content:
(1)  Unless the organic rules otherwise provide and subject toKRS 272A.10-070, the board of directors may authorize, and the limited cooperative association may
      make, distributions to members.

content:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 11. Member Dissociation›KY REV ST 272A.11-010. Member's dissociation
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act › Subchapter 11. Member Dissociation › KY REV ST 272A.11-010. Member's dissociation
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.11-010. Member's dissociation (2023)
content:
(1)  A person has the power to dissociate as a member at any time, rightfully or wrongfully,
      by express will.

content: (1)  A limited cooperative association may not make a distribution if, after the distribution:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 10. Contributions, Allocations, and Distributions›KY REV ST 272A.10-080. Liability for improper distributions
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act › Subchapter 10. Contributions, Allocations, and Distributions › KY REV ST 272A.10-080. Liability for improper distributions
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.10-080. Liability for improper distributions (2023)
content:
(1)  A director who consents to a distribution that violatesKRS 272A.10-070is personally liable to the limited cooperative association for the amount of the
      distribution which exceeds the amount that could have been distributed without the
      violation if it is established that in consenting to the distribution the director
      failed to comply withKRS 272A.8-180.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 11. Member Dissociation›KY REV ST 272A.11-030. Power of estate of member
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act › Subchapter 11. Member Dissociation › KY REV ST 272A.11-030. Power of estate of member
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.11-030. Power of estate of member (2023)
content:
Unless the organic rules provide for greater rights, if a member is dissociated because
   of death or is expelled by reason of being adjudged incompetent, the member's personal
   representative or other legal representative may exercise the rights of a transferee
   of the member's financial rights and, for purposes of settling the estate of a deceased
   member, may exercise the informational rights of a current member to obtain information
   underKRS 272A.5-040.

citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.12-090. Unknown claims against dissolved limited cooperative association (2023)
content:
(1)  A dissolved limited cooperative association may publish notice of its dissolution
      and request persons having claims against the association to present them in accordance
      with the notice.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 12. Dissolution of A Limited Cooperative Association›KY REV ST 272A.12-070. Distribution of assets in winding up
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act › Subchapter 12. Dissolution of A Limited Cooperative Association › KY REV ST 272A.12-070. Distribution of assets in winding up
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.12-070. Distribution of assets in winding up (2023)
content:
(1)  In winding up a limited cooperative association's business, the association shall
      apply its assets to discharge its obligations to creditors, including members that
      are creditors.  The association shall apply any remaining assets to pay in money the net amount
      distributable to members in accordance with their right to distributions under subsection
      (2) of this section.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 12. Dissolution of A Limited Cooperative Association›KY REV ST 272A.12-080. Known claims against dissolved limited cooperative association

citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.12-080. Known claims against dissolved limited cooperative association (2023)
content:
(1)  Subject to subsection (4) of this section, a dissolved limited cooperative association
      may dispose of the known claims against it by following the procedure in subsections
      (2) and (3) of this section.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 12. Dissolution of A Limited Cooperative Association›KY REV ST 272A.12-040. Voluntary dissolution before commencement of activity
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act › Subchapter 12. citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.12-040. Voluntary dissolution before commencement of activity (2023)
content:
A majority of the organizers or initial directors of a limited cooperative association
   that has not yet begun business activity or the conduct of its affairs may dissolve
   the association.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 12. Dissolution of A Limited Cooperative Association›KY REV ST 272A.12-060. Winding up

citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.12-060. Winding up (2023)
content:
(1)  A limited cooperative association continues after dissolution only for purposes
      of winding up its activities.

title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act › Subchapter 12. Dissolution of A Limited Cooperative Association › KY REV ST 272A.12-100. Court proceedings
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.12-100. Court proceedings (2023)
content:
(1)  Upon application by a dissolved limited cooperative association that has published
      a notice underKRS 272A.12-090, the appropriate court may determine the amount and form of security to be provided
      for payment of claims against the association that are contingent, have not been made
      known to the association, or are based on an event occurring after the effective date
      of dissolution but that, based on the facts known to the association, are reasonably
      anticipated to arise after the effective date of dissolution.

citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.16-020. Conversion of foreign entity into limited cooperative association (2023)
content: A foreign entity may convert to a limited cooperative association as provided inKRS 272A.17-040(6).

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 14. Foreign Limited Cooperative Associations›KY REV ST 272A.14-020. Action by Attorney General
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act › Subchapter 14. Foreign Limited Cooperative Associations › KY REV ST 272A.14-020. Action by Attorney General
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.14-020. Action by Attorney General (2023)
content:
The Attorney General may maintain an action to restrain a foreign limited cooperative
   association from transacting business in this Commonwealth in violation of this chapter.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 15. Disposition of Assets›KY REV ST 272A.15-020. Member approval of other asset dispositions

citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.15-020. Member approval of other asset dispositions (2023)
content:
A sale, lease, exchange, license, or other disposition of assets of a limited cooperative
   association, other than a disposition described inKRS 272A.15-010, requires approval of the association's members underKRS 272A.15-030and272A.15-040if the disposition leaves the association without significant continuing business
   activity.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 16. Mergers and Conversions›KY REV ST 272A.16-030. Effect of conversion
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act › Subchapter 16. Mergers and Conversions › KY REV ST 272A.16-030. Effect of conversion
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.16-030. Effect of conversion (2023)
content:
(1)  A foreign entity that has been converted into a limited cooperative association
      is for all purposes the same entity that existed before the conversion but, after
      conversion, it is organized under this chapter and is subject to that law and other
      law as it applies thereto.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 16. Mergers and Conversions›KY REV ST 272A.16-040. Merger

content:
(1)  One (1) or more limited cooperative associations may merge with one (1) or more

      or limited liability companies may merge with and into a limited cooperative association
      pursuant to this subchapter and a plan of merger if:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 16. Mergers and Conversions›KY REV ST 272A.16-050. Notice of and action on plan of merger

citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.16-050. Notice of and action on plan of merger (2023)
content:
(1)  For a limited cooperative association to merge with another entity, a plan of
      merger shall be approved by a majority vote of the board of directors or a greater
      percentage if required by the association's organic rules.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 16. Mergers and Conversions›KY REV ST 272A.16-070. Articles of merger; effective date

content:
(1)  After each constituent entity has approved a merger, articles of merger shall
      be signed on behalf of each constituent entity by an authorized representative.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 16. Mergers and Conversions›KY REV ST 272A.16-100. Article not exclusive

content:
This subchapter shall not prohibit a limited cooperative association from being converted
   or merged pursuant to other law of the Commonwealth of Kentucky.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 17. Miscellaneous Provisions›KY REV ST 272A.17-030. Savings clause
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act › Subchapter 17. Miscellaneous Provisions › KY REV ST 272A.17-030. Savings clause
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.17-030. Savings clause (2023)
content:
This chapter shall not affect an action or proceeding commenced, or right accrued,
   before July 12, 2012.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›Religious, Charitable and Educational Societies›KY REV ST 273.070. title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › Religious, Charitable and Educational Societies › KY REV ST 273.070. Incorporated college may establish adjunct schools and colleges
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273.070. Incorporated college may establish adjunct schools and colleges (2023)
content:
Any incorporated college or university in this state may establish adjunct schools
   and colleges in any part of the state to be operated in connection with it.  In order to establish and operate any adjunct school or college the institution
   establishing it may solicit and receive subscriptions and donations.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 16. Mergers and Conversions›KY REV ST 272A.16-090. Treatment of merger as a consolidation
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act › Subchapter 16. Mergers and Conversions › KY REV ST 272A.16-090. Treatment of merger as a consolidation
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.16-090. Treatment of merger as a consolidation (2023)
content:
(1)  Constituent entities that are limited cooperative associations or foreign cooperatives
      may agree to call a merger a consolidation.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 17. Miscellaneous Provisions›KY REV ST 272A.17-040. Transition
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act › Subchapter 17. Miscellaneous Provisions › KY REV ST 272A.17-040. Transition
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.17-040. Transition (2023)
content:
(1)  This chapter does not limit, prohibit, or invalidate the existence, acts, or
      obligations of any cooperative or association created or doing business in this Commonwealth
      before, on, or after July 12, 2012.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 17. Miscellaneous Provisions›KY REV ST 272A.17-010. Uniformity of interpretation
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act › Subchapter 17. Miscellaneous Provisions › KY REV ST 272A.17-010. Uniformity of interpretation
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 272A.17-010. Uniformity of interpretation (2023)
content:
In applying and construing the Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act,
   consideration shall be given to the need to promote uniformity of the law with respect
   to its subject matter among states that enact it.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 272A. Kentucky Uniform Limited Cooperative Association Act›Subchapter 17. Miscellaneous Provisions›KY REV ST 272A.17-020. Electronic signature

This chapter modifies, limits, or supersedes, the federal Electronic Signatures in
   Global and National Commerce Act,15 U.S.C. secs. 7001 et seq.,but does not modify, limit, or supersede Section 101(c) of that act,15 U.S.C. sec. 7001(c), or authorize electronic delivery of any of the notices described in Section 103(b)
   of that act,15 U.S.C. sec. 7003(b).

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›Religious, Charitable and Educational Societies›KY REV ST 273.080. Power over adjunct school or college
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › Religious, Charitable and Educational Societies › KY REV ST 273.080. Power over adjunct school or college
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273.080. Power over adjunct school or college (2023)
content:
All property procured for any adjunct school or college shall be held and applied
   by the governing body of the institution establishing it for the purpose of establishing
   and maintaining the adjunct school.  The governing body may procure grounds and erect buildings for its use and occupation,
   appoint and remove its teachers, prescribe a course of study for its students, confer
   degrees of graduation from it, and exercise the same general supervision and control
   over it that they may exercise over their own institution.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›Religious, Charitable and Educational Societies›KY REV ST 273.100. Religious society; appointment of trustees
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › Religious, Charitable and Educational Societies › KY REV ST 273.100. Religious society; appointment of trustees
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273.100. Religious society; appointment of trustees (2023)
content:
Any religious society may, before or after the creation of the charity, by a majority
   vote, appoint one (1) to three (3) trustees in whom legal or equitable title to the
   society's property shall be vested to the use of the society.  These appointments shall be entered upon the record book of the society.  It may fill vacancies in the same manner.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›KY REV ST 273.161. Definitions for KRS 273.161. to § 273.390

citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273.161. Definitions for KRS 273.161. to § 273.390 (2023)
content: As used inKRS 273.161to273.390, unless the context otherwise requires:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›Religious, Charitable and Educational Societies›KY REV ST 273.110. Trustees may sue or be sued
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › Religious, Charitable and Educational Societies › KY REV ST 273.110. Trustees may sue or be sued
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273.110. Trustees may sue or be sued (2023)
content:
A majority of the trustees may sue or be sued in their own names on behalf of the
   religious society in any action concerning the property of the society.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›Religious, Charitable and Educational Societies›KY REV ST 273.120. Disposition of property in case of division in religious society
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › Religious, Charitable and Educational Societies › KY REV ST 273.120. Disposition of property in case of division in religious society
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273.120. Disposition of property in case of division in religious society (2023)
content:
In case of a division in a religious society, the trustees shall permit each party
   to use the church and property for divine worship a part of the time, proportioned
   to the members of each party.  The excommunication of one (1) party by the other shall not impair this right unless
   it is done in good faith, on the grounds of immorality.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›Religious, Charitable and Educational Societies›KY REV ST 273.140. Sale of property held for charity for reinvestment
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › Religious, Charitable and Educational Societies › KY REV ST 273.140. Sale of property held for charity for reinvestment
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273.140. Sale of property held for charity for reinvestment (2023)
content:
Upon petition in equity stating the necessity of such action, if it will not violate
   any reservation or limitation in any dedication or grant, the Circuit Court of the
   county in which real property is held for a religious society or other charity may
   direct a sale of the property to reinvest the proceeds in the same county and for
   the same general purposes.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›Religious, Charitable and Educational Societies›KY REV ST 273.150. Board of incorporated cemetery to make annual report
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › Religious, Charitable and Educational Societies › KY REV ST 273.150. Board of incorporated cemetery to make annual report
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273.150. Board of incorporated cemetery to make annual report (2023)
content:
On the first of January of each year the board of directors or trustees of every incorporated
   cemetery or burying ground organized for private profit shall make a complete written
   report to its stockholders and lot owners of its assets and liabilities as of that
   date.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›KY REV ST 273.162. Notice
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › KY REV ST 273.162. Notice
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273.162. Notice (2023)
content:
(1)  Notice under this chapter shall be in writing unless oral notice is reasonable
      under the circumstances.  Notice by electronic transmission is written notice.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›Religious, Charitable and Educational Societies›KY REV ST 273.130. Disposition of property in case of dissolution of religious society
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › Religious, Charitable and Educational Societies › KY REV ST 273.130. Disposition of property in case of dissolution of religious society
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273.130. Disposition of property in case of dissolution of religious society (2023)
content:
If any religious society holding land dissolves, the title shall vest in the trustees
   of the county seminary in which the land lies for the use of that seminary, and if
   there is no such seminary, then in the county judge/executive, for the benefit of
   common schools in the county.

title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › KY REV ST 273.1842. Statement of change of principal office

(1)  Meetings of members may be held at such place, either within or without this
      state, as may be provided in the bylaws.  In the absence of any such provision, all meetings shall be held at the registered
      office of the corporation in this state.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›KY REV ST 273.195. Remote communication
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › KY REV ST 273.195. Remote communication
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273.195. Remote communication (2023)
content:
(1)  If the board of directors is authorized to determine the place of an annual or
      special meeting of members, the board of directors, in its sole discretion, may determine
      that the meeting shall not be held at any place but shall instead be held solely by
      means of remote communication under subsection (2) of this section.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›KY REV ST 273.191. Bylaws
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › KY REV ST 273.191. Bylaws
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273.191. Bylaws (2023)
content:
The initial bylaws of a corporation shall be adopted by its board of directors.  The power to alter, amend or repeal the bylaws or adopt new bylaws shall be vested
   in the board of directors unless otherwise provided in the articles of incorporation
   or the bylaws.  The bylaws may contain any provisions for the regulation and management of the affairs
   of a corporation not inconsistent with law or the articles of incorporation.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›KY REV ST 273.182. Registered office and registered agent
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › KY REV ST 273.182. Registered office and registered agent
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273.182. Registered office and registered agent (2023)
content:
Each corporation shall continuously maintain in this state a registered office and
   a registered agent that comply withKRS 14A.4-010.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›KY REV ST 273.187. Members
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › KY REV ST 273.187. Members
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273.187. Members (2023)
content:
(1)  A corporation may have one (1) or more classes of members or may have no members.  If the corporation has one (1) or more classes of members, the designation of such
      class or classes, the manner of election or appointment and the qualifications and
      rights of the members of each class shall be set forth in the articles of incorporation
      or the bylaws.  If the corporation has no members, that fact shall be set forth in the articles
      of incorporation or the bylaws.  A corporation may issue certificates evidencing membership therein.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›KY REV ST 273.197. Notice of members' meetings
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › KY REV ST 273.197. Notice of members' meetings
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273.197. Notice of members' meetings (2023)
content:
Unless otherwise provided in the articles of incorporation or the bylaws, notice stating
   the place, day and hour of meeting and, in case of a special meeting, the purpose
   or purposes for which the meeting is called, shall be given not less than ten (10)
   nor more than thirty-five (35) days before the date of the meeting, by or at the direction
   of the president, or the secretary, or the officers or persons calling the meeting,
   to each member entitled to vote at such meeting.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›KY REV ST 273.201. Voting
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › KY REV ST 273.201. Voting
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273.201. Voting (2023)
content:
(1)  The right of the members, or any class or classes of members, to vote may be
      limited, enlarged or denied to the extent specified in the articles of incorporation
      or the bylaws.  Unless so limited, enlarged or denied, each member, regardless of class, shall be
      entitled to one (1) vote on each matter submitted to a vote of members.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›KY REV ST 273.215. General standards for directors
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › KY REV ST 273.215. General standards for directors
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273.215. General standards for directors (2023)
content: (1)  A director of a nonprofit corporation subject to the provisions ofKRS 273.161to273.387shall discharge his duties as a director, including his duties as a member of a committee:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›KY REV ST 273.203. Quorum
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › KY REV ST 273.203. Quorum
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273.203. Quorum (2023)
content:
The bylaws may provide the number or percentage of members entitled to vote represented
   in person or by proxy, or the number or percentage of votes represented in person
   or by proxy, which shall constitute a quorum at a meeting of members.  In the absence of any such provision, members holding one-tenth (1/10) of the votes
   entitled to be cast on the matter to be voted upon represented in person or by proxy
   shall constitute a quorum.  A majority of the votes entitled to be cast on a matter to be voted upon by the
   members present or represented by proxy at a meeting at which a quorum is present
   shall be necessary for the adoption thereof unless a greater proportion is required
   byKRS 273.161to273.390, the articles of incorporation or the bylaws.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›KY REV ST 273.207. Board of directors
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › KY REV ST 273.207. Board of directors
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273.207. Board of directors (2023)
content:
The affairs of a corporation shall be managed by a board of directors.  Directors need not be residents of this state or members of the corporation unless
   the articles of incorporation or the bylaws so require.  The articles of incorporation or the bylaws may prescribe other qualifications for
   directors.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›KY REV ST 273.213. Vacancies
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › KY REV ST 273.213. Vacancies
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273.213. Vacancies (2023)
content:
(1)  Any vacancy occurring in the board of directors and any directorship to be filled
      by reason of an increase in the number of directors may be filled by the affirmative
      vote of a majority of the remaining directors, though less than a quorum of the board
      of directors, unless the articles of incorporation or the bylaws provide that a vacancy
      or directorship so created shall be filled in some other manner, in which case such
      provision shall control.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›KY REV ST 273.211. Number and election or appointment of directors; classes; terms; removal
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › KY REV ST 273.211. Number and election or appointment of directors; classes; terms; removal
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273.211. Number and election or appointment of directors; classes; terms; removal (2023)
content:
(1)  (a) The board of directors shall consist of three (3) or more individuals, with
         the number specified in or fixed in accordance with the articles of incorporation
         or bylaws, except as to the number of the first board of directors which shall be
         fixed by the articles of incorporation.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›KY REV ST 273.217. Quorum of directors; prohibition on director voting by proxy
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › KY REV ST 273.217. Quorum of directors; prohibition on director voting by proxy
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273.217. Quorum of directors; prohibition on director voting by proxy (2023)
content:
(1)  A majority of the number of directors fixed by the bylaws, or in the absence
      of a bylaw fixing the number of directors, then of the number stated in the articles
      of incorporation, shall constitute a quorum for the transaction of business, unless
      otherwise provided in the articles of incorporation or the bylaws.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›KY REV ST 273.219. Conflict-of-interest transaction
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › KY REV ST 273.219. Conflict-of-interest transaction
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273.219. Conflict-of-interest transaction (2023)
content:
(1)  A conflict-of-interest transaction is a transaction with the corporation in which
      a director of the corporation has a direct or indirect interest.  A conflict-of-interest transaction shall not be the subject of equitable relief
      on the ground of the director's interest in the transaction if:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›KY REV ST 273.221. Committees of the board; advisory committees
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › KY REV ST 273.221. Committees of the board; advisory committees
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273.221. Committees of the board; advisory committees (2023)
content:
(1)  Unless this chapter, the articles of incorporation, or the bylaws provide otherwise,
      a board of directors may create one (1) or more committees of the board and appoint
      directors to serve on the committee or committees.  Each committee shall have two (2) or more directors, and all committee members shall
      serve at the pleasure of the board of directors.  The board may delegate to one (1) or more directors the authority to appoint or
      remove the members of the committee.  An individual who is not a director may serve on a committee of the board, but may
      not vote on any matter that binds the corporation.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›KY REV ST 273.228. Authority of officers
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › KY REV ST 273.228. Authority of officers
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273.228. Authority of officers (2023)
content:
Each officer shall have the authority and shall perform the duties set forth in the
   bylaws or, to the extent consistent with the bylaws, the duties prescribed by the
   board of directors or by direction of an officer authorized by the board of directors
   to prescribe the duties of other officers.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›KY REV ST 273.223. Place and notice of directors' meetings
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › KY REV ST 273.223. Place and notice of directors' meetings
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273.223. Place and notice of directors' meetings (2023)
content:
(1)  Meetings of the board of directors, regular or special, may be held either within
      or without this state, and upon such notice as the bylaws may prescribe.  If the bylaws are silent as to the required notice of a meeting of the board of
      directors, meetings of the board of directors shall be preceded by at least two (2)
      days notice of the time, date, and place of the meeting.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›KY REV ST 273.227. Officers
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › KY REV ST 273.227. Officers
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273.227. Officers (2023)
content:
(1)  A corporation shall have the officers described in its bylaws or appointed by
      the board of directors in accordance with the bylaws.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›KY REV ST 273.233. Books and records
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › KY REV ST 273.233. Books and records
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273.233. Books and records (2023)
content:
Each corporation shall keep correct and complete books and records of account and
   shall keep minutes of the proceedings of its members, board of directors and committees
   having any of the authority of the board of directors;  and shall keep at its registered
   office or principal office in this state a record of the names and addresses of its
   members entitled to vote.  All books and records of a corporation may be inspected and copied by any member,
   or the member's agent or attorney, for any proper purpose at any reasonable time.  The member's right of inspection may be abolished or limited by the corporation's
   articles of incorporation or bylaws.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›KY REV ST 273.229. Standards of conduct for officers
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › KY REV ST 273.229. Standards of conduct for officers
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273.229. Standards of conduct for officers (2023)
content: (1)  An officer of a nonprofit corporation subject to the provisions ofKRS 273.161to273.387, with discretionary authority, shall discharge his duties under that authority:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›KY REV ST 273.231. Removal of officers
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › KY REV ST 273.231. Removal of officers
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273.231. Removal of officers (2023)
content:
Any officer elected or appointed may be removed by the persons authorized to elect
   or appoint such officer whenever in their judgment the best interests of the corporation
   will be served thereby.  The removal of an officer shall be without prejudice to the contract rights, if
   any, of the officer so removed.  Election or appointment of an officer or agent shall not of itself create contract
   rights.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›KY REV ST 273.237. Shares of stock and dividends prohibited; permissible expenditures
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › KY REV ST 273.237. Shares of stock and dividends prohibited; permissible expenditures
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273.237. Shares of stock and dividends prohibited; permissible expenditures (2023)
content:
(1)  A corporation shall not have or issue shares of stock.  Except as authorized by subsection (2) of this section, no dividend shall be paid
      and no part of the income or profit of a corporation shall be distributed to its members,
      directors, or officers.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›KY REV ST 273.241. Loans to directors and officers prohibited
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › KY REV ST 273.241. Loans to directors and officers prohibited
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273.241. Loans to directors and officers prohibited (2023)
content:
No loans shall be made by a corporation to its directors or officers.  Any director or officer who assents to or participates in the making of any such
   loan shall be liable to the corporation for the amount of such loan until the repayment
   thereof.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›KY REV ST 273.247. Articles of incorporation

citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273.247. Articles of incorporation (2023)
content: (1)  The articles of incorporation shall set forth:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›KY REV ST 273.253. Incorporation
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › KY REV ST 273.253. Incorporation
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273.253. Incorporation (2023)
content:
Upon the filing of articles of incorporation with the Secretary of State, the corporate
   existence shall begin, and such filing shall be conclusive evidence that all conditions
   precedent required to be performed by the incorporators have been complied with and
   that the corporation has been incorporated underKRS 273.161to273.390, except as against the state in a proceeding to cancel or revoke the certificate
   of incorporation or for involuntary dissolution of the corporation.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›KY REV ST 273.243. Incorporators
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › KY REV ST 273.243. Incorporators
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273.243. Incorporators (2023)
content:
One (1) or more persons may act as the incorporator or incorporators of a corporation
   by delivering articles of incorporation to the Secretary of State for filing.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›KY REV ST 273.257. Organization of corporation
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › KY REV ST 273.257. Organization of corporation
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273.257. Organization of corporation (2023)
content:
(1)  After the filing of articles of incorporation, an organization meeting of the
      board of directors named in the articles of incorporation shall be held, either within
      or without this state, at the call of a majority of the incorporators, for the purpose
      of adopting bylaws, electing officers and the transaction of such other business as
      may come before the meeting.  The incorporators calling the meeting shall give at least three (3) days' notice
      thereof by mail to each director so named, which notice shall state the time and place
      of the meeting.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›KY REV ST 273.248. Articles of incorporation; limitation of director liability
