citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273.248. Articles of incorporation; limitation of director liability (2023)
content:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›KY REV ST 273.252. Filing requirements
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › KY REV ST 273.252. Filing requirements
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273.252. Filing requirements (2023)
content:
Each document delivered by a domestic or foreign corporation to the Secretary of State
   for filing shall satisfy the requirements ofKRS 14A.2-010to14A.2-150.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›KY REV ST 273.273. Restated articles of incorporation

citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273.273. Restated articles of incorporation (2023)
content:
(1)  A domestic corporation may at any time restate its articles of incorporation

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›KY REV ST 273.261. Right to amend articles of incorporation
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › KY REV ST 273.261. Right to amend articles of incorporation
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273.261. Right to amend articles of incorporation (2023)
content:
A corporation may amend its articles of incorporation, from time to time, in any and
   as many respects as may be desired, so long as its articles of incorporation as amended
   contain only such provisions as are lawful underKRS 273.161to273.390.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›KY REV ST 273.263. Procedure to amend articles of incorporation
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › KY REV ST 273.263. Procedure to amend articles of incorporation
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273.263. Procedure to amend articles of incorporation (2023)
content: Amendments to the articles of incorporation shall be made in the following manner:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›KY REV ST 273.2531. Incorporation
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › KY REV ST 273.2531. Incorporation
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273.2531. Incorporation (2023)
content:
(1)  Unless a delayed effective date is specified, the corporate existence shall begin
      when the articles of incorporation are filed with the Secretary of State.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›KY REV ST 273.267. Articles of amendment
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › KY REV ST 273.267. Articles of amendment

content:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›KY REV ST 273.277. Procedure for merger
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › KY REV ST 273.277. Procedure for merger
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273.277. Procedure for merger (2023)
content:
Any two (2) or more domestic corporations or a domestic corporation and a limited
   liability company may merge into one (1) of such corporations pursuant to a plan of
   merger approved in the manner provided inKRS 273.161to273.390.  Each corporation or limited liability company shall adopt a plan of merger setting

citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273.293. Merger or consolidation of domestic and foreign corporations and limited liability companies (2023)
content:
(1)  One (1) or more domestic corporations, a domestic corporation and a domestic

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›KY REV ST 273.323. Notification to Attorney General
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › KY REV ST 273.323. Notification to Attorney General
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273.323. Notification to Attorney General (2023)
content:
The Secretary of State, on or before the last day of December of each year, may certify
   to the Attorney General the names of all corporations which have given cause for dissolution
   as provided inKRS 273.161to273.390, together with the facts pertinent thereto.  Whenever the Secretary of State shall certify the name of a corporation to the Attorney
   General as having given any cause for dissolution, the Secretary of State shall concurrently
   mail to the corporation at its registered office a notice that such certification
   has been made.  Upon the receipt of such certification, the Attorney General may file an action
   in the name of the state against such corporation for its dissolution.  Every such certificate from the Secretary of State to the Attorney General pertaining
   to the failure of a corporation to file an annual report shall be taken and received
   in all courts as prima facie evidence of the facts therein stated.  If, before action is filed, the corporation shall file its annual report, or shall
   appoint or maintain a registered agent as provided inKRS 273.161to273.390, or shall file with the Secretary of State the required statement of change of registered
   agent, such fact shall be forthwith certified by the Secretary of State to the Attorney
   General and he shall not file an action against such corporation for such cause.  If, after action is filed, the corporation shall file its annual report, or shall
   appoint or maintain a registered agent as provided inKRS 273.161to273.390, or shall file with the Secretary of State the required statement of change of registered
   agent, and shall pay the costs of such action, the action for such cause shall abate.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›KY REV ST 273.3184. Permissibility of merger of subsequent reincorporation with reinstated prior corporation; effect
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › KY REV ST 273.3184. Permissibility of merger of subsequent reincorporation with reinstated prior corporation; effect
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273.3184. Permissibility of merger of subsequent reincorporation with reinstated prior corporation; effect (2023)
content:
The General Assembly finds and declares it to be the public policy of the Commonwealth
   of Kentucky that each corporation which was refused reinstatement either orally or
   in writing and subsequently reincorporated as a second corporation may reinstate the
   first corporation and merge the second corporation into the first corporation.  The first corporation shall then be treated as if it had continuous and uninterrupted
   existence and that the administrative dissolution or revocation had never occurred.

(1)  Courts of equity shall have full power to liquidate the assets and affairs of

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›KY REV ST 273.327. Venue and process
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › KY REV ST 273.327. Venue and process
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273.327. Venue and process (2023)
content:
(1)  Every action for the involuntary dissolution of a corporation shall be commenced
      by the attorney general in the circuit court of the county in which the registered
      office of the corporation is situated.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›KY REV ST 273.333. Procedure in liquidation of corporation by court
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › KY REV ST 273.333. Procedure in liquidation of corporation by court
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273.333. Procedure in liquidation of corporation by court (2023)
content:
(1)  In a proceeding to liquidate the assets and affairs of a corporation, the court
      shall have the power to issue injunctions, to appoint a receiver or receivers pendente
      lite with such powers and duties as the court from time to time may direct, and to
      take such other proceedings as may be requisite to preserve the corporate assets wherever
      situated, and to carry on the affairs of the corporation until a full hearing can
      be had.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›KY REV ST 273.337. Qualifications of receivers
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › KY REV ST 273.337. Qualifications of receivers
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273.337. Qualifications of receivers (2023)
content:
A receiver shall in all cases be a citizen of the United States or a corporation for
   profit authorized to act as receiver, which corporation may be a domestic corporation
   or a foreign corporation authorized to transact business in this state, and shall
   in all cases give such bond as the court may direct with such sureties as the court
   may require.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›KY REV ST 273.340. Filing of claims in liquidation proceedings
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › KY REV ST 273.340. Filing of claims in liquidation proceedings
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273.340. Filing of claims in liquidation proceedings (2023)
content:
In proceedings to liquidate the assets and affairs of a corporation the court may
   require all creditors of the corporation to file with the clerk of the court or with
   the receiver, in such form as the court may prescribe, proofs under oath of their
   respective claims.  If the court requires the filing of claims it shall fix a date, which shall be not
   less than four (4) months from the date of the order, as the last day for filing of
   claims, and shall prescribe the notice that shall be given to creditors and claimants
   of the date so fixed.  Prior to the date so fixed, the court may extend the time for the filing of claims.  Creditors and claimants failing to file proofs of claim on or before the date so
   fixed may be barred, by order of court, from participating in the distribution of
   the assets of the corporation.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›KY REV ST 273.343. Discontinuance of liquidation proceedings
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › KY REV ST 273.343. Discontinuance of liquidation proceedings
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273.343. Discontinuance of liquidation proceedings (2023)
content:
The liquidation of the assets and affairs of a corporation may be discontinued at
   any time during the liquidation proceedings when it is established that cause for
   liquidation no longer exists.  In such event the court shall dismiss the proceedings and direct the receiver to
   redeliver to the corporation all its remaining property and assets.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›KY REV ST 273.347. Decree of involuntary dissolution
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › KY REV ST 273.347. Decree of involuntary dissolution
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273.347. Decree of involuntary dissolution (2023)
content:
(1)  In a proceeding to liquidate the assets and affairs of a corporation, when the
      costs and expenses of such proceeding and all debts, obligations, and liabilities
      of the corporation shall have been paid and discharged and all of its remaining property
      and assets distributed in accordance with the provisions ofKRS 273.161to273.390, or in case its property and assets are not sufficient to satisfy and discharge such
      costs, expenses, debts, and obligations, and all the property and assets have been
      applied so far as they will go to their payment, the court shall enter a decree dissolving
      the corporation.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›KY REV ST 273.353. Deposits with State Treasurer
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › KY REV ST 273.353. Deposits with State Treasurer
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273.353. Deposits with State Treasurer (2023)
content:
Upon the voluntary or involuntary dissolution of a corporation, the portion of the
   assets distributable to any person who is unknown or cannot be found, or who is under
   disability and there is no person legally competent to receive such distributive portion,
   shall be reduced to cash and deposited with the State Treasurer and shall be paid
   over to such person or to his legal representative upon proof satisfactory to the
   State Treasurer of his right thereto.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›KY REV ST 273.357. Survival of remedy after dissolution
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › KY REV ST 273.357. Survival of remedy after dissolution
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273.357. Survival of remedy after dissolution (2023)
content:
The dissolution of a corporation either (1) by the filing of articles of dissolution
   with the Secretary of State, or (2) by a decree of court when the court has not liquidated
   the assets and affairs of the corporation as provided inKRS 273.161to273.390shall not take away or impair any remedy available to or against the corporation,
   its directors, officers, or members, for any right or claim existing, or any liability
   incurred, prior to the dissolution if action or other proceeding thereon is commenced
   within two (2) years after the date of such dissolution.  Any such action or proceeding by or against the corporation may be prosecuted or
   defended by the corporation in its corporate name.  The members, directors, and officers may take corporate or other action appropriate
   to protect the remedy, right, or claim.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›KY REV ST 273.361. Application for certificate of authority

   maintain in this state a registered office and a registered agent that satisfy the
   requirements ofKRS 14A.4-010.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›KY REV ST 273.375. Director action without meeting
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › KY REV ST 273.375. Director action without meeting
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273.375. Director action without meeting (2023)
content:
(1)  Unless the articles of incorporation or bylaws provide otherwise, action required
      or permitted byKRS 273.161to273.390to be taken at a board of directors meeting may be taken without a meeting if the
      action is taken by all members of the board.  The action shall be evidenced by one (1) or more written consents describing the
      action taken, signed by each director, and included in the minutes or filed with the
      corporate records reflecting the action taken.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›KY REV ST 273.3671. Annual report
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › KY REV ST 273.3671. Annual report

   Commonwealth is subject toKRS 14A.6-010.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›KY REV ST 273.380. Unauthorized assumption of corporate powers
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › KY REV ST 273.380. Unauthorized assumption of corporate powers
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273.380. Unauthorized assumption of corporate powers (2023)
content:
All persons who assume to act as a corporation without authority so to do shall be
   jointly and severally liable for all debts and liabilities incurred or arising as
   a result thereof.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›KY REV ST 273.387. Application of act to corporations in existence on June 30, § 1968
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › KY REV ST 273.387. Application of act to corporations in existence on June 30, § 1968
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273.387. Application of act to corporations in existence on June 30, § 1968 (2023)
content:
(1)KRS 273.161to273.390, so far as it can be made applicable, shall apply to any nonstock, nonprofit corporation
      in existence on June 30, 1968, which was formed under the general laws of this state
      relating to religious, educational, charitable, civic, athletic, recreational, and
      social nonstock, nonprofit corporations, or by special act, for a purpose or purposes
      for which a corporation might be formed underKRS 273.161to273.390.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›KY REV ST 273.377. Member action without meeting
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations › KY REV ST 273.377. Member action without meeting
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273.377. Member action without meeting (2023)
content:
(1)  Any action required byKRS 273.161to273.390to be taken at a meeting of the members of a corporation, or any action which may
      be taken at a meeting of the members, may be taken without a meeting if a consent
      in writing, setting forth the action so taken, shall be signed by all of the members
      entitled to vote with respect to the subject matter thereof.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273. Religious, Charitable, and Educational Societies; Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›Nonstock, Nonprofit Corporations›KY REV ST 273.373. Waiver of notice

content:
Whenever any notice is required to be given to any member or director of a corporation
   under the provisions ofKRS 273.161to273.390or under the provisions of the articles of incorporation or bylaws of the corporation,
   a waiver thereof in writing signed by the person or persons entitled to such notice,
   whether before or after the time stated therein, shall be equivalent to the giving
   of such notice.

citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273.401. Fire department membership charges and subscriber fees may be added to property tax bills; collection and distribution; collection fee for sheriff (2023)
content:
(1)  If a fire department created under the provisions of this chapter is authorized
      by law to collect membership charges or subscriber fees for combating fires or serving
      in other emergencies, the legislative body of the city or county where the fire department
      is located may require those annual membership charges or subscriber fees to be added
      to property tax bills.  The county clerk shall add the annual membership charges or subscriber fees to the
      tax bills of the affected property owners.

content:

      the federal act for the following fiscal year to the Legislative Research Commission
      no less than ninety (90) days prior to the date of submission, as required by federal
      law, of the block grant application to the federal administering agency.  The application and other material submitted to the Commission shall conform to

citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273.605. Standard of conduct in managing and investing institutional fund (2023)
content:
(1)  Subject to the intent of a donor expressed in a gift instrument, an institution,
      in managing and investing an institutional fund, shall consider the charitable purposes
      of the institution and the purposes of the institutional fund.

citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273.620. Release or modification of restrictions on management, investment, or purpose (2023)
content:
(1)  If the donor consents in a record, an institution may release or modify, in whole
      or in part, a restriction contained in a gift instrument on the management, investment,
      or purpose of an institutional fund.  A release or modification may not allow a fund to be used for a purpose other than
      a charitable purpose of the institution.

(1)  If a domestic nonprofit corporation is convicted of a violation ofKRS 506.010,506.030,506.040,521.020, or521.050, or if an officer, employee, or agent of the corporation violates any of those sections
      under circumstances which bring corporate liability underKRS 502.050(1)(b), the court shall order that the charter of the nonprofit corporation be suspended
      for a period of not more than five (5) years for a first offense, ten (10) years for
      a second offense, and permanently for a third or subsequent offense.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273A. Kentucky Uniform Unincorporated Nonprofit Association Act (2008) (Harmonized)›KY REV ST 273A.010. Entity; perpetual existence; powers

citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273A.010. Entity; perpetual existence; powers (2023)
content:
(1)  An unincorporated nonprofit association is a legal entity distinct from its members
      and managers.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273A. Kentucky Uniform Unincorporated Nonprofit Association Act (2008) (Harmonized)›KY REV ST 273A.075. Duties of members

content:

citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273A.035. Power to sue or be sued (2023)
content: (1)  An unincorporated nonprofit association may sue or be sued in its own name.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273A. Kentucky Uniform Unincorporated Nonprofit Association Act (2008) (Harmonized)›KY REV ST 273A.040. Judgment against association
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 273A. Kentucky Uniform Unincorporated Nonprofit Association Act (2008) (Harmonized) › KY REV ST 273A.040. Judgment against association
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273A.040. Judgment against association (2023)
content:
(1)  A judgment or order against an unincorporated nonprofit association is not by
      itself a judgment or order against a member or manager.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273A. Kentucky Uniform Unincorporated Nonprofit Association Act (2008) (Harmonized)›KY REV ST 273A.055. Venue

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273A. Kentucky Uniform Unincorporated Nonprofit Association Act (2008) (Harmonized)›KY REV ST 273A.050. Action or proceeding not abated by change
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 273A. Kentucky Uniform Unincorporated Nonprofit Association Act (2008) (Harmonized) › KY REV ST 273A.050. Action or proceeding not abated by change
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273A.050. Action or proceeding not abated by change (2023)
content:
An action or proceeding against an unincorporated nonprofit association shall not
   abate merely because of a change in its members or managers.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273A. Kentucky Uniform Unincorporated Nonprofit Association Act (2008) (Harmonized)›KY REV ST 273A.080. Admission, suspension, dismissal, or expulsion
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 273A. Kentucky Uniform Unincorporated Nonprofit Association Act (2008) (Harmonized) › KY REV ST 273A.080. Admission, suspension, dismissal, or expulsion
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273A.080. Admission, suspension, dismissal, or expulsion (2023)
content:
(1)  A person becomes a member and may be suspended, dismissed, or expelled in accordance
      with the association's governing principles.  If there are no applicable governing principles, a person may become a member or
      be suspended, dismissed, or expelled from an association only by a vote of its members.  A person shall not be admitted as a member without the person's consent.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273A. Kentucky Uniform Unincorporated Nonprofit Association Act (2008) (Harmonized)›KY REV ST 273A.100. Duties of managers

citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273A.100. Duties of managers (2023)
content:
(1)  A manager owes to the unincorporated nonprofit association the fiduciary duties
      of loyalty and care.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273A. Kentucky Uniform Unincorporated Nonprofit Association Act (2008) (Harmonized)›KY REV ST 273A.085. Member resignation
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 273A. Kentucky Uniform Unincorporated Nonprofit Association Act (2008) (Harmonized) › KY REV ST 273A.085. Member resignation
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273A.085. Member resignation (2023)
content: (1)  A member may resign as a member in accordance with the governing principles.  In the absence of applicable governing principles, a member may resign at any time.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273A. Kentucky Uniform Unincorporated Nonprofit Association Act (2008) (Harmonized)›KY REV ST 273A.115. Distribution prohibited; compensation and other permitted payments
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 273A. Kentucky Uniform Unincorporated Nonprofit Association Act (2008) (Harmonized) › KY REV ST 273A.115. Distribution prohibited; compensation and other permitted payments
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273A.115. Distribution prohibited; compensation and other permitted payments (2023)
content:
(1)  Except as otherwise provided in subsection (2) of this section, an unincorporated
      nonprofit association shall not pay dividends or make distributions to a member or
      manager.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273A. Kentucky Uniform Unincorporated Nonprofit Association Act (2008) (Harmonized)›KY REV ST 273A.110. Right of member or manager to information
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 273A. Kentucky Uniform Unincorporated Nonprofit Association Act (2008) (Harmonized) › KY REV ST 273A.110. Right of member or manager to information
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273A.110. Right of member or manager to information (2023)
content:
(1)  On reasonable notice and for a proper purpose, a member or manager of an unincorporated
      nonprofit association may inspect and copy during the unincorporated nonprofit association's
      regular operating hours, at a reasonable location specified by the association, any
      record maintained by the association regarding its activities, financial condition,
      and other circumstances, to the extent the information is material to the member's
      or manager's rights and duties under the governing principles.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273A. Kentucky Uniform Unincorporated Nonprofit Association Act (2008) (Harmonized)›KY REV ST 273A.090. Membership interest not transferable
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 273A. Kentucky Uniform Unincorporated Nonprofit Association Act (2008) (Harmonized) › KY REV ST 273A.090. Membership interest not transferable
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273A.090. Membership interest not transferable (2023)
content:
Except as otherwise provided in the governing principles of the association, a member's
   interest or any right under the governing principles is not transferable.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273A. Kentucky Uniform Unincorporated Nonprofit Association Act (2008) (Harmonized)›KY REV ST 273A.120. Reimbursement; indemnification; advancement; insurance
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 273A. Kentucky Uniform Unincorporated Nonprofit Association Act (2008) (Harmonized) › KY REV ST 273A.120. Reimbursement; indemnification; advancement; insurance
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273A.120. Reimbursement; indemnification; advancement; insurance (2023)
content:
(1)  Except as otherwise provided in the governing principles, an unincorporated nonprofit
      association shall reimburse a member or manager for authorized expenses reasonably
      incurred in the course of the member's or manager's activities on behalf of the association.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273A. Kentucky Uniform Unincorporated Nonprofit Association Act (2008) (Harmonized)›KY REV ST 273A.105. Procedural requirements for managers

content:
Notice and quorum requirements for meetings of managers and the conduct of meetings

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273A. Kentucky Uniform Unincorporated Nonprofit Association Act (2008) (Harmonized)›KY REV ST 273A.135. Transition concerning real and personal property
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 273A. Kentucky Uniform Unincorporated Nonprofit Association Act (2008) (Harmonized) › KY REV ST 273A.135. Transition concerning real and personal property
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273A.135. Transition concerning real and personal property (2023)
content:
(1)  If, before June 24, 2015, an interest in property was by terms of a transfer
      purportedly transferred to an unincorporated nonprofit association but under the law
      of this Commonwealth the interest did not vest in the association, or in one (1) or
      more persons on behalf of the association under subsection (2) of this section, on
      June 24, 2015, the interest vests in the association, unless the parties to the transfer
      have treated the transfer as ineffective.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273A. Kentucky Uniform Unincorporated Nonprofit Association Act (2008) (Harmonized)›KY REV ST 273A.140. Uniformity of application and construction

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273A. Kentucky Uniform Unincorporated Nonprofit Association Act (2008) (Harmonized)›KY REV ST 273A.145. Relation to Electronic Signatures in Global and National Commerce Act
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 273A. Kentucky Uniform Unincorporated Nonprofit Association Act (2008) (Harmonized) › KY REV ST 273A.145. Relation to Electronic Signatures in Global and National Commerce Act
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273A.145. Relation to Electronic Signatures in Global and National Commerce Act (2023)
content:
The provisions of this chapter governing the legal effect, validity, or enforceability
   of electronic records or electronic signatures, and of contracts formed or performed
   with the use of such records or signatures, modify, limit, and supersede the Electronic
   Signatures in Global and National Commerce Act,15 U.S.C. secs. 7001 et. seq.,but this chapter does not modify, limit, or supersede Section 101(c) of the Electronic
   Signatures in Global and National Commerce Act or authorize electronic delivery of
   any of the notices described in Section 103(b) of that Act.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273A. Kentucky Uniform Unincorporated Nonprofit Association Act (2008) (Harmonized)›KY REV ST 273A.155. Governing law
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 273A. Kentucky Uniform Unincorporated Nonprofit Association Act (2008) (Harmonized) › KY REV ST 273A.155. Governing law
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273A.155. Governing law (2023)
content:
(1)  Except as otherwise provided in subsection (2) of this section, the laws of this
      Commonwealth govern the operation in this state of all unincorporated nonprofit associations
      formed or operating in this Commonwealth.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273A. Kentucky Uniform Unincorporated Nonprofit Association Act (2008) (Harmonized)›KY REV ST 273A.165. Title
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 273A. Kentucky Uniform Unincorporated Nonprofit Association Act (2008) (Harmonized) › KY REV ST 273A.165. Title
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273A.165. Title (2023)
content:
KRS Chapter 273A shall be known and may be cited as the Kentucky Uniform Unincorporated
   Nonprofit Association Act.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273A. Kentucky Uniform Unincorporated Nonprofit Association Act (2008) (Harmonized)›KY REV ST 273A.160. Savings clause
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 273A. Kentucky Uniform Unincorporated Nonprofit Association Act (2008) (Harmonized) › KY REV ST 273A.160. Savings clause
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 273A.160. Savings clause (2023)
content:
The provisions of this chapter do not affect an action or proceeding commenced or
   right accrued before it takes effect.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 273A. Kentucky Uniform Unincorporated Nonprofit Association Act (2008) (Harmonized)›KY REV ST 273A.150. Relation to other law

content:
(1)  Principles of law and equity supplement this chapter unless displaced by a particular
      provision of it.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 274. Professional Service Corporations›KY REV ST 274.019. Proxy; voting trust
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 274. Professional Service Corporations › KY REV ST 274.019. Proxy; voting trust
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 274.019. Proxy; voting trust (2023)
content:
No proxy for shares of a professional service corporation shall be valid unless it
   shall be given to a qualified person.  A voting trust with respect to shares of a professional service corporation shall
   not be valid unless all the trustees and beneficiaries thereof are qualified persons,
   except that a voting trust may be validly continued for a period of ten (10) months
   after the death of a deceased beneficiary or for a period of five (5) months after
   a beneficiary has become a disqualified person.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 274. Professional Service Corporations›KY REV ST 274.017. Restricted issuance and transfer of shares
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 274. Professional Service Corporations › KY REV ST 274.017. Restricted issuance and transfer of shares
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 274.017. Restricted issuance and transfer of shares (2023)
content:
(1)  A professional service corporation may issue and a shareholder thereof may transfer
      or pledge shares, fractional shares, and rights or options to purchase shares only
      to:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 274. Professional Service Corporations›KY REV ST 274.055. Effect of chapter; liability
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 274. Professional Service Corporations › KY REV ST 274.055. Effect of chapter; liability
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 274.055. Effect of chapter; liability (2023)
content: (1)  Except as otherwise provided in this section,KRS 271B.6-220applies to a corporation governed by this chapter.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 274. Professional Service Corporations›KY REV ST 274.045. Persons authorized to render service
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 274. Professional Service Corporations › KY REV ST 274.045. Persons authorized to render service
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 274.045. Persons authorized to render service (2023)
content:
No professional service corporation provided for in this chapter may render professional
   services except through officers, employees and agents who are duly licensed or otherwise
   legally authorized to render such professional services within this state.  This provision shall not be interpreted to include in the term “employee” as used
   in this chapter, clerks, secretaries, bookkeepers, technicians and other assistants
   who are not usually and ordinarily considered by custom and practice to be rendering
   professional services to the public for which a license or other legal authorization
   is required.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 274. Professional Service Corporations›KY REV ST 274.005. Definitions for chapter
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 274. Professional Service Corporations › KY REV ST 274.005. Definitions for chapter
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 274.005. Definitions for chapter (2023)
content: As used in this chapter, unless the context indicates otherwise:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 274. Professional Service Corporations›KY REV ST 274.027. Qualifications of officers and members of board; voting
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 274. Professional Service Corporations › KY REV ST 274.027. Qualifications of officers and members of board; voting
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 274.027. Qualifications of officers and members of board; voting (2023)
content:
(1)  Not less than one-half (1/2) of the directors of a professional service corporation
      and all the officers other than the secretary and the treasurer shall be qualified
      persons with respect to the corporation.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 274. Professional Service Corporations›KY REV ST 274.015. Professional service corporation authorized; articles of incorporation requirements; authority; amendment of articles to become business corporation
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 274. Professional Service Corporations › KY REV ST 274.015. Professional service corporation authorized; articles of incorporation requirements; authority; amendment of articles to become business corporation
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 274.015. Professional service corporation authorized; articles of incorporation requirements; authority; amendment of articles to become business corporation (2023)
content:
(1)  One (1) or more individuals, each of whom is licensed to render the same professional
      service or who are licensed to render related professional services such that applicable
      licensing laws and regulations would not prohibit the practice of such multiple professional
      services through a single business partnership, may incorporate and form a professional
      service corporation by filing articles of incorporation in the office of the Secretary
      of State.  Such articles of incorporation shall meet the requirements of KRS Chapter 271B,
      and in addition to the information required byKRS 271B.2-020, such articles shall contain the following:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 274. Professional Service Corporations›KY REV ST 274.065. Regulation of practice unaffected
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 274. Professional Service Corporations › KY REV ST 274.065. Regulation of practice unaffected
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 274.065. Regulation of practice unaffected (2023)
content:
Nothing in this chapter shall restrict or limit in any manner the authority and duty
   of any regulating board of competent jurisdiction to license individual persons rendering
   professional services or to regulate the practice of the profession which is within
   the jurisdiction of such regulating board, even though such person is an officer,
   director, shareholder, or employee of a professional service corporation or engages
   in the practice of such profession through a professional service corporation.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 274. Professional Service Corporations›KY REV ST 274.105. Contents of annual reports
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 274. Professional Service Corporations › KY REV ST 274.105. Contents of annual reports
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 274.105. Contents of annual reports (2023)
content:
Each professional service corporation shall file an annual report as provided inKRS 14A.6-010.  A duplicate original copy of each annual report shall be filed with the regulating
   board which licenses the shareholders of the corporation.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 274. Professional Service Corporations›KY REV ST 274.095. Withdrawing shareholders; procedure for redemption of stock; procedure upon death of sole shareholder; insolvency
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 274. Professional Service Corporations › KY REV ST 274.095. Withdrawing shareholders; procedure for redemption of stock; procedure upon death of sole shareholder; insolvency
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 274.095. Withdrawing shareholders; procedure for redemption of stock; procedure upon death of sole shareholder; insolvency (2023)
content:
(1)  The articles of incorporation may provide for the purchase or redemption of all
      of the shares of any shareholder within a period not to exceed one (1) year after
      the death or disqualification to practice the profession of such shareholder, or for
      the purchase or redemption within said time of all of the shares of any shareholder
      desiring to sell them, all of whom are herein sometimes called “withdrawing shareholders” or, in default of such provisions in the articles of incorporation, the foregoing
      provisions and time limitation may be included in the bylaws of a professional service
      corporation, or, if no such provision and time limitation is made in the articles
      of incorporation or bylaws, they may be provided for by such private agreement or
      agreements as the shareholders and corporation may enter into.  If such an article, bylaw or agreement is adopted or provided for and such stock
      is not redeemed by the corporation within said one (1) year period, then within ten
      (10) days following the end of said period the president and/or secretary of the corporation
      shall give notice thereof to the Secretary of State of Kentucky and, upon receipt
      of such notice by the Secretary of State, the charter of the corporation shall be
      immediately void.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 274. Professional Service Corporations›KY REV ST 274.115. Business restrictions
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 274. Professional Service Corporations › KY REV ST 274.115. Business restrictions
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 274.115. Business restrictions (2023)
content:
No professional service corporation organized or authorized to conduct business under
   this chapter shall engage in any business other than the rendering of the professional
   service or services for which it was specifically incorporated, provided, however,
   that nothing in this chapter or in any other provisions of existing law applicable
   to corporations shall be interpreted to prohibit such corporation from investing its
   funds in real estate, mortgages, stocks, bonds or any other type of investment, or
   from owning real or personal property necessary for the rendering of professional
   services.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 274. Professional Service Corporations›KY REV ST 274.991. Additional penalties for violation of KRS 506.010, 506.030, 506.040, 521.020, or § 521.050
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 274. Professional Service Corporations › KY REV ST 274.991. Additional penalties for violation of KRS 506.010, 506.030, 506.040, 521.020, or § 521.050
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 274.991. Additional penalties for violation of KRS 506.010, 506.030, 506.040, 521.020, or § 521.050 (2023)
content:
(1)  If a domestic professional service corporation is convicted of a violation ofKRS 506.010,506.030,506.040,521.020, or521.050, or if an officer, employee, or agent of the corporation violates any of those sections
      under circumstances which bring corporate liability underKRS 502.050(1)(b), the court shall order that the charter of the professional service corporation be
      suspended for a period of not more than five (5) years for a first offense, ten (10)
      years for a second offense, and permanently for a third or subsequent offense.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 274. Professional Service Corporations›KY REV ST 274.125. Application of chapter
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 274. Professional Service Corporations › KY REV ST 274.125. Application of chapter
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 274.125. Application of chapter (2023)
content:
This chapter shall not apply to any person within this state who, prior to the passage
   of this chapter, was permitted to organize a corporation and perform professional
   services by the means of such corporation, and this chapter shall not apply to any
   corporation organized by such persons prior to the passage of this chapter, provided,
   that any such corporation may bring itself within the provisions of this chapter by
   amending its articles of incorporation in such a manner as to be consistent with all
   of the provisions of this chapter and by affirmatively stating in the amended articles
   of incorporation that the shareholders have elected to bring the corporation within,
   and have accepted the provisions of, this chapter.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 275. Limited Liability Companies›KY REV ST 275.015. Definitions for chapter
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 275. Limited Liability Companies › KY REV ST 275.015. Definitions for chapter
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 275.015. Definitions for chapter (2023)
content: As used in this chapter, unless the context otherwise requires:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 275. Limited Liability Companies›KY REV ST 275.001. Short title for chapter
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 275. Limited Liability Companies › KY REV ST 275.001. Short title for chapter
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 275.001. Short title for chapter (2023)
content:
This chapter shall be known and may be cited as the “Kentucky Limited Liability Company
   Act.”

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 275. Limited Liability Companies›KY REV ST 275.010. Powers of limited liability companies
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 275. Limited Liability Companies › KY REV ST 275.010. Powers of limited liability companies
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 275.010. Powers of limited liability companies (2023)
content:
(1)  Except as otherwise set forth in this chapter or unless the articles of organization
      or operating agreement provide otherwise, every limited liability company shall have
      the powers to do all things necessary or convenient to carry out its business and
      affairs.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 275. Limited Liability Companies›KY REV ST 275.003. Construction of chapter
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 275. Limited Liability Companies › KY REV ST 275.003. Construction of chapter
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 275.003. Construction of chapter (2023)
content:
(1)  It shall be the policy of the General Assembly through this chapter to give maximum
      effect to the principles of freedom of contract and the enforceability of operating
      agreements.  Unless displaced by particular provisions of this chapter, the principles of law
      and equity shall supplement this chapter.  Although this chapter is in derogation of common law, the rules of construction
      that require strict construction of statutes which are in derogation of common law
      shall not apply to its provisions.  This chapter shall not be construed to impair the obligations of any contract existing
      when this chapter, or any amendment of it, becomes effective, nor to affect any action
      or proceeding begun or right accrued before the chapter or amendment takes effect.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 275. Limited Liability Companies›KY REV ST 275.005. Purpose of limited liability company
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 275. Limited Liability Companies › KY REV ST 275.005. Purpose of limited liability company
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 275.005. Purpose of limited liability company (2023)
content:
A limited liability company may be organized under this chapter for any lawful purpose,
   including the provision of one (1) or more professional services conducted in or outside
   the Commonwealth.  Except as otherwise provided inKRS 275.150, if the purpose for which a limited liability company is organized or its activities
   make it subject to one (1) or more special provisions of law, the limited liability
   company shall also comply with those provisions.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 274. Professional Service Corporations›KY REV ST 274.990. Penalty
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 274. Professional Service Corporations › KY REV ST 274.990. Penalty
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 274.990. Penalty (2023)
content:
Any person who fails or refuses to do any act or perform any duty required of him
   by this chapter, or who causes or permits a false statement to be included in the
   articles of incorporation of any professional service corporation, shall be fined
   not more than one thousand dollars ($1,000) or imprisoned for a period of not more
   than one (1) year, or both.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 275. Limited Liability Companies›KY REV ST 275.040. Statement of change of mailing address
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 275. Limited Liability Companies › KY REV ST 275.040. Statement of change of mailing address
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 275.040. Statement of change of mailing address (2023)
content:
A limited liability company that changes the mailing address of its principal place
   of business shall comply withKRS 14A.5-010.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 275. Limited Liability Companies›KY REV ST 275.035. Restatement of articles of organization
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 275. Limited Liability Companies › KY REV ST 275.035. Restatement of articles of organization
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 275.035. Restatement of articles of organization (2023)
content:
(1)  A limited liability company may restate its articles of organization by delivering
      to the Secretary of State for filing articles of restatement setting forth the name
      of the limited liability company and the text of the restated articles of organization
      together with a certificate stating whether the restatement contains an amendment
      to the articles of organization requiring member approval and, if it does, setting
      forth the information required byKRS 275.030(4).

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 275. Limited Liability Companies›KY REV ST 275.145. Effect of notice to members or managers
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 275. Limited Liability Companies › KY REV ST 275.145. Effect of notice to members or managers
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 275.145. Effect of notice to members or managers (2023)
content:
(1)  Except as provided in subsection (2) of this section, notice to any member of
      any matter relating to the business or affairs of the limited liability company, and
      the knowledge of the member acting in the particular matter, acquired while a member
      or known at the time of becoming a member, and the knowledge of any other member who
      reasonably could and should have communicated the knowledge to the acting member,
      shall operate as notice to or knowledge of the limited liability company, except in
      the case of a fraud on the limited liability company committed by or with the consent
      of that member.

content: (1)  The articles of organization shall set forth:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 275. Limited Liability Companies›KY REV ST 275.045. Requirements for documents to be filed with the Secretary of State
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 275. Limited Liability Companies › KY REV ST 275.045. Requirements for documents to be filed with the Secretary of State
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 275.045. Requirements for documents to be filed with the Secretary of State (2023)
content:
Each document delivered by a domestic or foreign limited liability company to the
   Secretary of State for filing shall satisfy the requirements ofKRS 14A.2-010to14A.2-150.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 275. Limited Liability Companies›KY REV ST 275.030. Amendment of articles of organization
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 275. Limited Liability Companies › KY REV ST 275.030. Amendment of articles of organization
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 275.030. Amendment of articles of organization (2023)
content:
(1)  A limited liability company shall amend its articles of organization to add or
      change a provision that is required by this chapter to be included in the articles
      of organization.  A limited liability company may amend its articles of organization to add, change,
      or delete a provision that is permitted to be or that is not required to be in the
      articles of organization.  The articles of organization shall be amended if:

title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 275. Limited Liability Companies › KY REV ST 275.055. Fees for filing documents with Secretary of State

content:
The Secretary of State shall collect the following fees when the documents described

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 275. Limited Liability Companies›KY REV ST 275.095. Personal liability when acting without authority
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 275. Limited Liability Companies › KY REV ST 275.095. Personal liability when acting without authority
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 275.095. Personal liability when acting without authority (2023)
content:
All persons purporting to act as or on behalf of a limited liability company, knowing
   there has been no organization under this chapter, or who assume to act for a limited
   liability company without authority to do so, shall be jointly and severally liable
   for all liabilities created while so acting.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 275. Limited Liability Companies›KY REV ST 275.100. Name of limited liability company
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 275. Limited Liability Companies › KY REV ST 275.100. Name of limited liability company
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 275.100. Name of limited liability company (2023)
content: The name of each limited liability company shall satisfy the requirements ofKRS 14A.3-010.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 275. Limited Liability Companies›KY REV ST 275.115. Registered office; registered agent
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 275. Limited Liability Companies › KY REV ST 275.115. Registered office; registered agent
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 275.115. Registered office; registered agent (2023)
content:
Each domestic limited liability company shall continuously maintain in this Commonwealth
   a registered office and a registered agent that comply withKRS 14A.4-010.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 275. Limited Liability Companies›KY REV ST 275.020. Procedure for forming limited liability company
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 275. Limited Liability Companies › KY REV ST 275.020. Procedure for forming limited liability company
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 275.020. Procedure for forming limited liability company (2023)
content:
(1)  One (1) or more persons may serve as the organizer and form a limited liability
      company by delivering articles of organization to the Secretary of State for filing.  It shall not be necessary that the person or persons be members of the limited liability
      company.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 275. Limited Liability Companies›KY REV ST 275.135. Members or managers as agents
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 275. Limited Liability Companies › KY REV ST 275.135. Members or managers as agents
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 275.135. Members or managers as agents (2023)
content:
(1)  Except as provided in subsection (2) of this section, every member shall be an
      agent of the limited liability company for the purpose of its business or affairs,
      and the act of any member, including but not limited to the execution in the name
      of the limited liability company of any instrument, for apparently carrying on in
      the usual way the business or affairs of the limited liability company of which he
      is a member, shall bind the limited liability company, unless the member so acting
      has, in fact, no authority to act for the limited liability company in the particular
      matter, and the person with whom the member is dealing has knowledge or has received
      notification of the fact that the member has no such authority.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 275. Limited Liability Companies›KY REV ST 275.140. Effect of statements by members or managers
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 275. Limited Liability Companies › KY REV ST 275.140. Effect of statements by members or managers
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 275.140. Effect of statements by members or managers (2023)
content:
(1)  Except as provided in subsection (2) of this section, an admission, statement,
      or representation made by any member concerning the business or affairs of a limited
      liability company within the scope of the member's authority as provided for by this
      chapter shall be evidence against the limited liability company.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 275. Limited Liability Companies›KY REV ST 275.150. Immunity from personal liability
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 275. Limited Liability Companies › KY REV ST 275.150. Immunity from personal liability
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 275.150. Immunity from personal liability (2023)
content:
(1)  Except as provided in subsection (2) of this section or as otherwise specifically
      set forth in other sections in this chapter, no member, manager, employee, or agent
      of a limited liability company, including a professional limited liability company,
      shall be personally liable by reason of being a member, manager, employee, or agent
      of the limited liability company, under a judgment, decree, or order of a court, agency,
      or tribunal of any type, or in any other manner, in this or any other state, or on
      any other basis, for a debt, obligation, or liability of the limited liability company,
      whether arising in contract, tort, or otherwise.  The status of a person as a member, manager, employee, or agent of a limited liability
      company, including a professional limited liability company, shall not subject the
      person to personal liability for the acts or omissions, including any negligence,
      wrongful act, or actionable misconduct, of any other member, manager, agent, or employee
      of the limited liability company.  That a limited liability company has a single member or a single manager is not
      a basis for setting aside the rule otherwise recited in this subsection.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 275. Limited Liability Companies›KY REV ST 275.155. Proper parties to proceedings
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 275. Limited Liability Companies › KY REV ST 275.155. Proper parties to proceedings
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 275.155. Proper parties to proceedings (2023)
content:
A member of a limited liability company shall not be a proper party to a proceeding
   by or against a limited liability company, solely by reason of being a member of the
   limited liability company, except if the object of the proceeding is to enforce a
   member's right against or liability to the limited liability company or as otherwise
   provided in an operating agreement.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 275. Limited Liability Companies›KY REV ST 275.170. Duties of care and loyalty; approval of conflict of interest transactions; remedy for breach of the duty of loyalty
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 275. Limited Liability Companies › KY REV ST 275.170. Duties of care and loyalty; approval of conflict of interest transactions; remedy for breach of the duty of loyalty
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 275.170. Duties of care and loyalty; approval of conflict of interest transactions; remedy for breach of the duty of loyalty (2023)
content: Unless otherwise provided in a written operating agreement:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 275. Limited Liability Companies›KY REV ST 275.165. Management of company; delegation of powers; limitation on remuneration for services performed
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 275. Limited Liability Companies › KY REV ST 275.165. Management of company; delegation of powers; limitation on remuneration for services performed
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 275.165. Management of company; delegation of powers; limitation on remuneration for services performed (2023)
content:
(1)  Unless the articles of organization vest management of the limited liability
      company in a manager or managers, management of the business and affairs of the limited
      liability company shall vest in the members.  Subject to any provisions in the articles of organization, the operating agreement
      or this chapter restricting or enlarging the management rights and duties of any person
      or group or class of persons, the members shall have the right and authority to manage
      the affairs of the limited liability company and to make all decisions with respect
      thereto.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 275. Limited Liability Companies›KY REV ST 275.185. Required records; inspection right of member; limitations upon use of records
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 275. Limited Liability Companies › KY REV ST 275.185. Required records; inspection right of member; limitations upon use of records

content:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 275. Limited Liability Companies›KY REV ST 275.177. Enforcement of limitations on amendment of operating agreement
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 275. Limited Liability Companies › KY REV ST 275.177. Enforcement of limitations on amendment of operating agreement
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 275.177. Enforcement of limitations on amendment of operating agreement (2023)
content:
If a written operating agreement contains a provision to the effect that any amendment
   to the operating agreement of the limited liability company shall be in writing and
   adopted in accordance with the provisions of the operating agreement, then the provision
   shall be enforceable in accordance with its terms, and any agreement as to the conduct
   of the business and affairs of the limited liability company which is not in writing
   and adopted in accordance with the provisions of the operating agreement shall not
   be considered part of the operating agreement and shall be void and unenforceable.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 275. Limited Liability Companies›KY REV ST 275.160. Operations outside Kentucky; Kentucky law controlling in cases of conflict
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 275. Limited Liability Companies › KY REV ST 275.160. Operations outside Kentucky; Kentucky law controlling in cases of conflict
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 275.160. Operations outside Kentucky; Kentucky law controlling in cases of conflict (2023)
content:
(1)  A limited liability company may conduct its business, carry on its operations,
      and exercise the power granted by this chapter in any state or in any foreign country.

title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 275. Limited Liability Companies › KY REV ST 275.172. Expulsion of member of limited liability company; conditions

content:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 275. Limited Liability Companies›KY REV ST 275.190. Annual report
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 275. Limited Liability Companies › KY REV ST 275.190. Annual report
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 275.190. Annual report (2023)
content:
Each limited liability company and each foreign limited liability company qualified
   to transact business in this Commonwealth is subject toKRS 14A.6-010.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 275. Limited Liability Companies›KY REV ST 275.175. Number of votes required to do business; circumstances requiring affirmative vote of members; written operating agreement for company without members; no right of dissent; written operating agreement provisions relating to right to vote, approve, or consent
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 275. Limited Liability Companies › KY REV ST 275.175. Number of votes required to do business; circumstances requiring affirmative vote of members; written operating agreement for company without members; no right of dissent; written operating agreement provisions relating to right to vote, approve, or consent
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 275.175. Number of votes required to do business; circumstances requiring affirmative vote of members; written operating agreement for company without members; no right of dissent; written operating agreement provisions relating to right to vote, approve, or consent (2023)
content:
(1)  Unless otherwise provided in the articles of organization, a written operating
      agreement, or this chapter, the affirmative vote, approval, or consent of a majority-in-interest
      of the members or a simple majority of the managers, each having a single vote, shall
      be required to decide any matter connected with the business affairs of the limited
      liability company.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations›Chapter 275. Limited Liability Companies›KY REV ST 275.180. Operating agreement provisions on personal liability and indemnification
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIII. Private Corporations and Associations › Chapter 275. Limited Liability Companies › KY REV ST 275.180. Operating agreement provisions on personal liability and indemnification
