path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions›Chapter 304. Insurance Code›Subtitle 12. Trade Practices and Frauds›KY REV ST 304.12-090. Rebates prohibited
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions › Chapter 304. Insurance Code › Subtitle 12. Trade Practices and Frauds › KY REV ST 304.12-090. Rebates prohibited
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 304.12-090. Rebates prohibited (2023)
content:
(1)  No insurer or employee or representative thereof shall knowingly charge, demand,
      or receive a premium for any insurance policy except in accordance with the applicable
      filing on file with the commissioner.  No such insurer, employee, or representative shall pay, allow, or give, or offer
      to pay, allow, or give, directly or indirectly, as an inducement to insurance or after
      insurance has been effected, any rebate, discount, abatement, credit or reduction
      of the premium named in a policy, or any special favor or advantage in the dividends
      or other benefits to accrue thereon, or any valuable consideration or inducements
      whatever, or give, sell, or purchase, or offer to give, sell, or purchase anything
      of value whatsoever not specified in the policy, except to the extent provided for
      in such applicable filing.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions›Chapter 304. Insurance Code›Subtitle 12. Trade Practices and Frauds›KY REV ST 304.12-110. Illegal inducements prohibited
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions › Chapter 304. Insurance Code › Subtitle 12. Trade Practices and Frauds › KY REV ST 304.12-110. Illegal inducements prohibited
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 304.12-110. Illegal inducements prohibited (2023)
content:
No insurer, insurance producer as defined inKRS 304.9-020, or other person shall, as an inducement to insurance, or in connection with any
   insurance transaction, provide in any policy for, or offer, sell, buy, or offer or
   promise to buy, sell, give, promise, or allow to the insured or prospective insured
   or to any other person on his or her behalf in any manner whatsoever:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions›Chapter 304. Insurance Code›Subtitle 12. Trade Practices and Frauds›KY REV ST 304.12-140. Coercion in requiring insurance
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions › Chapter 304. Insurance Code › Subtitle 12. Trade Practices and Frauds › KY REV ST 304.12-140. Coercion in requiring insurance
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 304.12-140. Coercion in requiring insurance (2023)
content:
(1)  No person engaged in the business of financing the purchase of real or personal
      property or of lending money on the security of real or personal property shall require,
      as a condition to financing or lending, or varying the terms and conditions of the
      financing or lending, or as a condition to the renewal or extension of any loan or
      credit or to the performance of any other act in connection with financing or lending,
      that the purchaser or borrower, or his successors, shall negotiate through a particular
      insurer, agent, or type of insurer, any policy of insurance or renewal insuring the
      property or the life or health of the borrower.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions›Chapter 304. Insurance Code›Subtitle 12. Trade Practices and Frauds›KY REV ST 304.12-120. Desist order for defined or prohibited practices
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions › Chapter 304. Insurance Code › Subtitle 12. Trade Practices and Frauds › KY REV ST 304.12-120. Desist order for defined or prohibited practices
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 304.12-120. Desist order for defined or prohibited practices (2023)
content:
(1)  If, after a hearing conducted in accordance with KRS Chapter 13B, the commissioner
      finds that any person in this state has engaged or is engaging in any act or practice
      defined in or prohibited under this subtitle, the commissioner shall order the person
      to desist from the act or practice.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions›Chapter 304. Insurance Code›Subtitle 12. Trade Practices and Frauds›KY REV ST 304.12-150. Notice of free choice of agent or insurer
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions › Chapter 304. Insurance Code › Subtitle 12. Trade Practices and Frauds › KY REV ST 304.12-150. Notice of free choice of agent or insurer
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 304.12-150. Notice of free choice of agent or insurer (2023)
content:
Every debtor, borrower, or purchaser of property with respect to which insurance of
   any kind is required in connection with a debt or loan on the property shall be informed
   by the creditor or lender of his or her right of free choice in the selection of the
   agent and insurer through or by which such insurance is to be placed.  There shall be no interference either directly or indirectly with the borrower's,
   debtor's, or purchaser's free choice of an agent and of an insurer, the creditor or
   lender shall not collect a separate charge for the handling of insurance required
   in connection with a loan or extension of credit based on the consumer's choice of
   agent or insurer, and the creditor or lender shall not refuse an adequate policy so
   tendered by the borrower, debtor, or purchaser.  Upon notice of any refusal of an adequate policy, the commissioner shall order the
   creditor or lender to accept the tendered policy, if he or she determines that such
   refusal is not in accordance with the requirements set out in subsection (2) ofKRS 304.12-140.  Failure to comply with the order of the commissioner shall be deemed a violation
   of this section.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions›Chapter 304. Insurance Code›Subtitle 12. Trade Practices and Frauds›KY REV ST 304.12-160. Certain fees for handling insurance transactions in connection with loans prohibited
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions › Chapter 304. Insurance Code › Subtitle 12. Trade Practices and Frauds › KY REV ST 304.12-160. Certain fees for handling insurance transactions in connection with loans prohibited
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 304.12-160. Certain fees for handling insurance transactions in connection with loans prohibited (2023)
content:
No person who makes a loan on real or personal property shall in connection with such
   a transaction make any separate charge or require a fee or payment of any money for
   the substitution by a borrower or a mortgagor or a purchaser of one insurance policy
   on the property for an existing policy on the property when the existing or substituted
   policy is provided through an insurer or insurance agent licensed to do business in
   the state.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions›Chapter 304. Insurance Code›Subtitle 12. Trade Practices and Frauds›KY REV ST 304.12-180. Interlocking ownership, management
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions › Chapter 304. Insurance Code › Subtitle 12. Trade Practices and Frauds › KY REV ST 304.12-180. Interlocking ownership, management
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 304.12-180. Interlocking ownership, management (2023)
content:
(1)  Any insurer may retain, invest in or acquire the whole or any part of the capital
      stock of any other insurer or insurers, or have a common management with any other
      insurer or insurers, unless such retention, investment, acquisition or common management
      is inconsistent with any other provision of this code, or unless by reason thereof
      the business of such insurers with the public is conducted in a manner which substantially
      lessens competition generally in the insurance business or tends to create any monopoly
      therein.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions›Chapter 304. Insurance Code›Subtitle 12. Trade Practices and Frauds›KY REV ST 304.12-215. Discrimination on basis of blindness prohibited; application
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions › Chapter 304. Insurance Code › Subtitle 12. Trade Practices and Frauds › KY REV ST 304.12-215. Discrimination on basis of blindness prohibited; application
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 304.12-215. Discrimination on basis of blindness prohibited; application (2023)
content:
(1)  Unfair discrimination against individuals on the basis of blindness or partial
      blindness is prohibited.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions›Chapter 304. Insurance Code›Subtitle 12. Trade Practices and Frauds›KY REV ST 304.12-190. Illegal dealing in premiums
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions › Chapter 304. Insurance Code › Subtitle 12. Trade Practices and Frauds › KY REV ST 304.12-190. Illegal dealing in premiums
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 304.12-190. Illegal dealing in premiums (2023)
content:
(1)  No person shall willfully collect any sum as premium or charge for insurance,
      which insurance is not then provided or is not in due course to be provided (subject
      to acceptance of the risk by the insurer) by an insurance policy issued by an insurer
      as authorized by this code.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions›Chapter 304. Insurance Code›Subtitle 12. Trade Practices and Frauds›KY REV ST 304.12-200. Insurer name; deceptive use prohibited
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions › Chapter 304. Insurance Code › Subtitle 12. Trade Practices and Frauds › KY REV ST 304.12-200. Insurer name; deceptive use prohibited
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 304.12-200. Insurer name; deceptive use prohibited (2023)
content:
No person who is not an insurer shall assume or use any name which deceptively infers
   or suggests that it is an insurer.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions›Chapter 304. Insurance Code›Subtitle 12. Trade Practices and Frauds›KY REV ST 304.12-220. Definition
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions › Chapter 304. Insurance Code › Subtitle 12. Trade Practices and Frauds › KY REV ST 304.12-220. Definition
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 304.12-220. Definition (2023)
content: For the purpose ofKRS 304.12-230, “person” shall not mean an insured.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions›Chapter 304. Insurance Code›Subtitle 12. Trade Practices and Frauds›KY REV ST 304.12-255. Refusal to provide requested Medicaid information as unfair or deceptive trade practice for health insurer or administrator
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions › Chapter 304. Insurance Code › Subtitle 12. Trade Practices and Frauds › KY REV ST 304.12-255. Refusal to provide requested Medicaid information as unfair or deceptive trade practice for health insurer or administrator
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 304.12-255. Refusal to provide requested Medicaid information as unfair or deceptive trade practice for health insurer or administrator (2023)
content:
It shall be an unfair or deceptive trade practice for any health insurer or administrator
   as defined under KRS Chapter 304 to refuse to provide information requested by the
   Department for Medicaid Services underKRS 205.623, except when providing the requested information would violate any provision of federal
   law.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions›Chapter 304. Insurance Code›Subtitle 12. Trade Practices and Frauds›KY REV ST 304.12-230. Unfair claims settlement practices

content:
It is an unfair claims settlement practice for any person to commit or perform any
   of the following acts or omissions:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions›Chapter 304. Insurance Code›Subtitle 12. Trade Practices and Frauds›KY REV ST 304.12-257. Administrative regulations to protect Armed Forces service members from dishonest and predatory insurance sales practices
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions › Chapter 304. Insurance Code › Subtitle 12. Trade Practices and Frauds › KY REV ST 304.12-257. Administrative regulations to protect Armed Forces service members from dishonest and predatory insurance sales practices
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 304.12-257. Administrative regulations to protect Armed Forces service members from dishonest and predatory insurance sales practices (2023)
content:
The commissioner shall have the authority to promulgate regulations to protect service
   members of the United States Armed Forces from dishonest and predatory insurance sales
   practices by declaring certain identified practices to be false, misleading, deceptive,
   or unfair in accordance with the Military Personnel Financial Services Protection
   Act of 2006,Pub. L. No. 109-290.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions›Chapter 304. Insurance Code›Subtitle 12. Trade Practices and Frauds›KY REV ST 304.12-260. Prohibition against refusal of liability insurer to pay on policy for school's posting of Ten Commandments
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions › Chapter 304. Insurance Code › Subtitle 12. Trade Practices and Frauds › KY REV ST 304.12-260. Prohibition against refusal of liability insurer to pay on policy for school's posting of Ten Commandments
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 304.12-260. Prohibition against refusal of liability insurer to pay on policy for school's posting of Ten Commandments (2023)
content:
Because the posting of the Ten Commandments in a public school building is a lawful
   posting of a historical document underKRS 158.195, no liability insurer shall refuse to pay under the terms of the policy an insured
   who is sued for posting the Ten Commandments in compliance withKRS 158.195in a public school building on the grounds that this act by the insured constitutes
   an illegal act for which the insurer is not liable to pay under the terms of the policy.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions›Chapter 304. Insurance Code›Subtitle 12. Trade Practices and Frauds›KY REV ST 304.12-250. Exclusion of work-related health condition as unfair or deceptive trade practice for health insurance policies
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions › Chapter 304. Insurance Code › Subtitle 12. Trade Practices and Frauds › KY REV ST 304.12-250. Exclusion of work-related health condition as unfair or deceptive trade practice for health insurance policies
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 304.12-250. Exclusion of work-related health condition as unfair or deceptive trade practice for health insurance policies (2023)
content:
(1)  It shall be an unfair or deceptive trade practice for a health insurance policy
      to exclude coverage for a health condition based solely on the fact that the health
      condition is work-related, unless the claimant is eligible for benefits under any
      workers' compensation act or similar law.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions›Chapter 304. Insurance Code›Subtitle 12. Trade Practices and Frauds›KY REV ST 304.12-275. Claimant's right to repair facility of choice; appraisal of damaged vehicle to include notice of right to choose; exemption
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions › Chapter 304. Insurance Code › Subtitle 12. Trade Practices and Frauds › KY REV ST 304.12-275. Claimant's right to repair facility of choice; appraisal of damaged vehicle to include notice of right to choose; exemption
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 304.12-275. Claimant's right to repair facility of choice; appraisal of damaged vehicle to include notice of right to choose; exemption (2023)
content:
(1)  An insurer shall inform a claimant upon notification of a motor vehicle damage
      claim that he or she has the right to choose the repair facility of his or her choice
      to repair a damaged vehicle.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions›Chapter 304. Insurance Code›Subtitle 12. Trade Practices and Frauds›KY REV ST 304.12-270. Prohibited actions in connection with rental reimbursement coverage under automobile insurance policy

citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 304.12-270. Prohibited actions in connection with rental reimbursement coverage under automobile insurance policy (2023)
content:
In connection with rental reimbursement coverage under an automobile insurance policy,
   an insurer, an employee or representative of an insurer, an agent of an insurer, a
   consultant, or an insurance adjuster shall not:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions›Chapter 304. Insurance Code›Subtitle 13. Rates and Rating Organizations›KY REV ST 304.13-011. Definitions for subtitle
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions › Chapter 304. Insurance Code › Subtitle 13. Rates and Rating Organizations › KY REV ST 304.13-011. Definitions for subtitle
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 304.13-011. Definitions for subtitle (2023)
content: As used in this subtitle, unless the context requires otherwise:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions›Chapter 304. Insurance Code›Subtitle 13. Rates and Rating Organizations›KY REV ST 304.13-058. Rate increases to apply prospectively
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions › Chapter 304. Insurance Code › Subtitle 13. Rates and Rating Organizations › KY REV ST 304.13-058. Rate increases to apply prospectively
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 304.13-058. Rate increases to apply prospectively (2023)
content:
Notwithstanding any provision of this chapter or any other chapter of the Kentucky
   Revised Statutes or any rating manual or rule to the contrary, no workers' compensation
   rate increases shall be applied retroactively, but rather shall be applied only to
   policies with inception or renewal dates on or after the effective date of the rate
   increase.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions›Chapter 304. Insurance Code›Subtitle 13. Rates and Rating Organizations›KY REV ST 304.13-021. Scope of KRS 304.13-011. to § 304.13-161
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions › Chapter 304. Insurance Code › Subtitle 13. Rates and Rating Organizations › KY REV ST 304.13-021. Scope of KRS 304.13-011. to § 304.13-161
content:
KRS 304.13-011to304.13-161apply to all types of insurance written on risks in this state by any insurer authorized
   under this chapter to do business in this state, except:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions›Chapter 304. Insurance Code›Subtitle 13. Rates and Rating Organizations›KY REV ST 304.13-031. Rate standards in noncompetitive market
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions › Chapter 304. Insurance Code › Subtitle 13. Rates and Rating Organizations › KY REV ST 304.13-031. Rate standards in noncompetitive market
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 304.13-031. Rate standards in noncompetitive market (2023)
content:
(1)  In a noncompetitive market, rates shall be made in accordance with the following
      provisions:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions›Chapter 304. Insurance Code›Subtitle 13. Rates and Rating Organizations›KY REV ST 304.13-065. Premium reductions for motor vehicles equipped with antitheft device
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions › Chapter 304. Insurance Code › Subtitle 13. Rates and Rating Organizations › KY REV ST 304.13-065. Premium reductions for motor vehicles equipped with antitheft device
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 304.13-065. Premium reductions for motor vehicles equipped with antitheft device (2023)
content:
For motor vehicle insurance rates, whether in a competitive market or a noncompetitive
   market, appropriate reductions in premium charges for comprehensive coverage shall
   be applied to those motor vehicles equipped with an antitheft device as provided inKRS 304.20-410.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions›Chapter 304. Insurance Code›Subtitle 13. Rates and Rating Organizations›KY REV ST 304.13-041. Monitoring market competition
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions › Chapter 304. Insurance Code › Subtitle 13. Rates and Rating Organizations › KY REV ST 304.13-041. Monitoring market competition
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 304.13-041. Monitoring market competition (2023)
content:
(1)  A competitive market for any line of insurance is presumed to exist unless the
      commissioner, after a hearing, determines that a reasonable degree of competition
      does not exist in the market for such line and issues an order to that effect.  Such an order shall expire no later than one (1) year after it is issued.  In determining whether a reasonable degree of competition exists, the commissioner
      shall consider all relevant information pertaining to the market and the opportunities
      available to consumers in the market to acquire pricing and other consumer information,
      and to compare and obtain insurance from competing insurers.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions›Chapter 304. Insurance Code›Subtitle 13. Rates and Rating Organizations›KY REV ST 304.13-081. Filings open to inspection; consumer information system
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions › Chapter 304. Insurance Code › Subtitle 13. Rates and Rating Organizations › KY REV ST 304.13-081. Filings open to inspection; consumer information system
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 304.13-081. Filings open to inspection; consumer information system (2023)
content:
(1)  All rates, supplementary rate information, and supporting information filed underKRS 304.13-011to304.13-161shall be open to public inspection at any reasonable time.  Copies may be obtained by any person on request and on payment of a charge specified
      in Subtitle 4 of this chapter.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions›Chapter 304. Insurance Code›Subtitle 13. Rates and Rating Organizations›KY REV ST 304.13-051. Filing rates and rate information; when filing becomes effective
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions › Chapter 304. Insurance Code › Subtitle 13. Rates and Rating Organizations › KY REV ST 304.13-051. Filing rates and rate information; when filing becomes effective
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 304.13-051. Filing rates and rate information; when filing becomes effective (2023)
content:
(1)  In a competitive market, every insurer shall file with the commissioner rates
      and supplementary information to be used in this state for commercial risks as designated
      by the commissioner and for all personal risks.  The rates and supplementary rate information shall be filed not later than fifteen
      (15) days after the date of first use of the rates, unless the commissioner finds
      after a hearing that an insurer's rates require closer supervision because of the
      insurer's financial condition.  On a finding, rates for both personal and commercial risks, supplementary rate information,
      and supporting information shall be filed with the commissioner at least thirty (30)
      days before the effective date of the rates.  An order shall expire no later than one (1) year after it is issued.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions›Chapter 304. Insurance Code›Subtitle 13. Rates and Rating Organizations›KY REV ST 304.13-053. Filing procedures for rates for use after December 31, § 1998
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions › Chapter 304. Insurance Code › Subtitle 13. Rates and Rating Organizations › KY REV ST 304.13-053. Filing procedures for rates for use after December 31, § 1998
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 304.13-053. Filing procedures for rates for use after December 31, § 1998 (2023)
content:
(1)  Unless the commissioner enters an order pursuant toKRS 304.13-041declaring workers' compensation to be a noncompetitive market, rates filed for use
   after December 31, 1998, shall be filed pursuant toKRS 304.13-051(1).

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions›Chapter 304. Insurance Code›Subtitle 12. Trade Practices and Frauds›KY REV ST 304.12-235. Time of payment of claims
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions › Chapter 304. Insurance Code › Subtitle 12. Trade Practices and Frauds › KY REV ST 304.12-235. Time of payment of claims
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 304.12-235. Time of payment of claims (2023)
content:
(1)  All claims arising under the terms of any contract of insurance shall be paid
      to the named insured person or health care provider not more than thirty (30) days
      from the date upon which notice and proof of claim, in the substance and form required
      by the terms of the policy, are furnished the insurer.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions›Chapter 304. Insurance Code›Subtitle 13. Rates and Rating Organizations›KY REV ST 304.13-057. Rates based on Kentucky experience
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions › Chapter 304. Insurance Code › Subtitle 13. Rates and Rating Organizations › KY REV ST 304.13-057. Rates based on Kentucky experience
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 304.13-057. Rates based on Kentucky experience (2023)
content:
(1)  Every insurer shall provide to the commissioner information to demonstrate to
      what extent the insurer's rates are based upon its Kentucky experience.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions›Chapter 304. Insurance Code›Subtitle 13. Rates and Rating Organizations›KY REV ST 304.13-055. Reduction of rates effective upon filing
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions › Chapter 304. Insurance Code › Subtitle 13. Rates and Rating Organizations › KY REV ST 304.13-055. Reduction of rates effective upon filing
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 304.13-055. Reduction of rates effective upon filing (2023)
content:
With respect to any filing which, if approved, would result in a reduction of rates,
   the commissioner shall immediately order the proposed rates to be effective.  If upon the commissioner's review of the filing or as a result of a public hearing
   it appears that the proposed rates should be further reduced, the commissioner may
   order the insurer or rating organization to show cause within thirty (30) days why
   such rates should not be further reduced in accordance with the order.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions›Chapter 304. Insurance Code›Subtitle 13. Rates and Rating Organizations›KY REV ST 304.13-061. Information that may support rate filing; administrative regulations on recording and reporting rates and other information
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions › Chapter 304. Insurance Code › Subtitle 13. Rates and Rating Organizations › KY REV ST 304.13-061. Information that may support rate filing; administrative regulations on recording and reporting rates and other information
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 304.13-061. Information that may support rate filing; administrative regulations on recording and reporting rates and other information (2023)
content: (1)  The information furnished in support of a filing may include:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions›Chapter 304. Insurance Code›Subtitle 13. Rates and Rating Organizations›KY REV ST 304.13-091. License for advisory organization, statistical agent, or form provider; refusal to supply services; application for license; fees
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions › Chapter 304. Insurance Code › Subtitle 13. Rates and Rating Organizations › KY REV ST 304.13-091. License for advisory organization, statistical agent, or form provider; refusal to supply services; application for license; fees
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 304.13-091. License for advisory organization, statistical agent, or form provider; refusal to supply services; application for license; fees (2023)
content:
(1)  No advisory organization, statistical agent, or form provider shall provide any
      otherwise permitted service, and no insurer shall utilize the services unless the
      organization has obtained a license pursuant to subsection (3) of this section.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions›Chapter 304. Insurance Code›Subtitle 13. Rates and Rating Organizations›KY REV ST 304.13-063. Automobile liability and physical damage insurance provision for reduction in premium charges
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions › Chapter 304. Insurance Code › Subtitle 13. Rates and Rating Organizations › KY REV ST 304.13-063. Automobile liability and physical damage insurance provision for reduction in premium charges
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 304.13-063. Automobile liability and physical damage insurance provision for reduction in premium charges (2023)
content:
(1)  Any schedule of rates or rating plan for automobile liability and physical damage
      insurance filed with the commissioner shall provide for an appropriate reduction in
      premium charges for a period of at least three (3) years and up to five (5) years
      for those insureds fifty-five (55) years of age and older who successfully complete
      a motor vehicle accident prevention course meeting standards set by the Transportation
      Cabinet or insureds of any age who complete a defensive driving course provided by
      the United States Armed Forces to members of the United States Armed Forces.  The reduction in premium charges for members of the United States Armed Forces who
      complete a defensive driving course provided by the United States Armed Forces shall
      be actuarially sound.  There shall, however, be no reduction in premiums for a self-instructed course or
      for a course which does not provide for classroom or field driving instruction for
      a minimum number of hours, to be determined by the Transportation Cabinet.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions›Chapter 304. Insurance Code›Subtitle 13. Rates and Rating Organizations›KY REV ST 304.13-075. Exceptions to insurer's use of credit information
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions › Chapter 304. Insurance Code › Subtitle 13. Rates and Rating Organizations › KY REV ST 304.13-075. Exceptions to insurer's use of credit information
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 304.13-075. Exceptions to insurer's use of credit information (2023)
content:
(1)  An insurer that uses credit information shall, on written request from an applicant
      or an insured, provide reasonable exceptions to the insurer's rates, rating classifications,
      company or tier placement, or underwriting rules or guidelines for an applicant or
      insured who has experienced and whose credit information has been directly influenced
      by any of the following events:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions›Chapter 304. Insurance Code›Subtitle 13. Rates and Rating Organizations›KY REV ST 304.13-100. Excess rates
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions › Chapter 304. Insurance Code › Subtitle 13. Rates and Rating Organizations › KY REV ST 304.13-100. Excess rates
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 304.13-100. Excess rates (2023)
content:
Upon the written application of the insured, stating his or her reasons therefor,
   filed with and approved by the commissioner, a rate in excess of that provided by
   a filing otherwise applicable may be used on any specific risk.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions›Chapter 304. Insurance Code›Subtitle 13. Rates and Rating Organizations›KY REV ST 304.13-071. Disapproval of rates and rate filings
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions › Chapter 304. Insurance Code › Subtitle 13. Rates and Rating Organizations › KY REV ST 304.13-071. Disapproval of rates and rate filings
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 304.13-071. Disapproval of rates and rate filings (2023)
content:
(1)  Existing rates in a noncompetitive market may be disapproved pursuant to the
      rating standards of this chapter after a hearing.  Rates that have been filed in a noncompetitive market but that have not become effective
      may be disapproved pursuant to the rating standards of this chapter without a hearing.  However, any insurer whose rates have been disapproved without a hearing shall be
      given a hearing on a written request made within thirty (30) days after the disapproval
      order.  Hearings conducted under authority of this section shall be conducted in accordance
      with KRS Chapter 13B.  If a rate is disapproved, the commissioner shall issue a final order specifying
      the reasons for disapproval.  Any party aggrieved by the final order of the commissioner may appeal as provided
      inKRS 304.2-370.  The effect of a final order shall be stayed during the pendency of the appeal and
      the existing rate shall remain in effect until the final conclusion thereof.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions›Chapter 304. Insurance Code›Subtitle 13. Rates and Rating Organizations›KY REV ST 304.13-111. Advisory organization or statistical agent activities prohibited
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions › Chapter 304. Insurance Code › Subtitle 13. Rates and Rating Organizations › KY REV ST 304.13-111. Advisory organization or statistical agent activities prohibited
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 304.13-111. Advisory organization or statistical agent activities prohibited (2023)
content: No advisory organization or statistical agent shall:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions›Chapter 304. Insurance Code›Subtitle 13. Rates and Rating Organizations›KY REV ST 304.13-131. Insurer and advisory organization activities prohibited
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions › Chapter 304. Insurance Code › Subtitle 13. Rates and Rating Organizations › KY REV ST 304.13-131. Insurer and advisory organization activities prohibited
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 304.13-131. Insurer and advisory organization activities prohibited (2023)
content:
(1)  No insurer or advisory organization shall make any arrangement with any other
      insurer, advisory organization, or other person that has the purpose or effect of
      unreasonably restraining trade or unreasonably lessening competition in the business
      of insurance.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions›Chapter 304. Insurance Code›Subtitle 13. Rates and Rating Organizations›KY REV ST 304.13-121. Authorized activities for advisory organizations
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions › Chapter 304. Insurance Code › Subtitle 13. Rates and Rating Organizations › KY REV ST 304.13-121. Authorized activities for advisory organizations
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 304.13-121. Authorized activities for advisory organizations (2023)
content:
Any advisory organization in addition to other activities not prohibited, is authorized,
   on behalf of its members and subscribers, to:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions›Chapter 304. Insurance Code›Subtitle 13. Rates and Rating Organizations›KY REV ST 304.13-141. Examination of insurers, pools, advisory organizations, statistical agents, form providers, residual market, and joint underwriting organizations
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions › Chapter 304. Insurance Code › Subtitle 13. Rates and Rating Organizations › KY REV ST 304.13-141. Examination of insurers, pools, advisory organizations, statistical agents, form providers, residual market, and joint underwriting organizations
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 304.13-141. Examination of insurers, pools, advisory organizations, statistical agents, form providers, residual market, and joint underwriting organizations (2023)
content:
(1)  The commissioner may examine any insurer, pool, advisory organization, statistical
      agent, form provider, or residual market or joint underwriting mechanism as deemed
      necessary to ascertain compliance with this chapter.  Any examination made by the commissioner or by examiners designated by the commissioner
      shall be at the expense of the organization examined as specified in Subtitle 2 of
      KRS Chapter 304.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions›Chapter 304. Insurance Code›Subtitle 13. Rates and Rating Organizations›KY REV ST 304.13-161. Review of application of rating system to an insured; appeal to commissioner; notification of review rights to workers' compensation insureds
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions › Chapter 304. Insurance Code › Subtitle 13. Rates and Rating Organizations › KY REV ST 304.13-161. Review of application of rating system to an insured; appeal to commissioner; notification of review rights to workers' compensation insureds
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 304.13-161. Review of application of rating system to an insured; appeal to commissioner; notification of review rights to workers' compensation insureds (2023)
content:
(1)  Every insurer or advisory organization shall provide within this state reasonable
      means whereby any person aggrieved by the application of its rating system may be
      heard on written request to review the manner in which the rating system has been
      applied.  If the insurer or advisory organization grants the request, the review shall be
      conducted within ninety (90) days of receiving the request.  If the insurer or advisory organization fails to grant or rejects a request within
      thirty (30) days, the aggrieved person may proceed in the same manner as if the review
      produced no change in the application of the rate.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions›Chapter 304. Insurance Code›Fire Protection Classification Review and Appeal›KY REV ST 304.13-355. Appeal of fire protection classification
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions › Chapter 304. Insurance Code › Fire Protection Classification Review and Appeal › KY REV ST 304.13-355. Appeal of fire protection classification
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 304.13-355. Appeal of fire protection classification (2023)
content:
Any fire protection district, municipality, or locality in the state which is assigned
   a fire protection classification by any lawful advisory organization or insurer which
   makes its own rates, operating in the Commonwealth, may appeal to the commissioner
   for modification or reassignment of the classification within thirty (30) days of
   receipt of the classification.  The commissioner shall determine the manner in which an appeal may be filed.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions›Chapter 304. Insurance Code›Subtitle 13. Rates and Rating Organizations›KY REV ST 304.13-163. Authorized activities for statistical agents
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions › Chapter 304. Insurance Code › Subtitle 13. Rates and Rating Organizations › KY REV ST 304.13-163. Authorized activities for statistical agents
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 304.13-163. Authorized activities for statistical agents (2023)
content:
In addition to other activities not prohibited, any statistical agent is authorized,
   on behalf of its members and subscribers, to:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions›Chapter 304. Insurance Code›Subtitle 13. Rates and Rating Organizations›KY REV ST 304.13-151. Insurer participation in pools, joint underwriting, joint reinsurance pools, and residual market mechanisms
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions › Chapter 304. Insurance Code › Subtitle 13. Rates and Rating Organizations › KY REV ST 304.13-151. Insurer participation in pools, joint underwriting, joint reinsurance pools, and residual market mechanisms
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 304.13-151. Insurer participation in pools, joint underwriting, joint reinsurance pools, and residual market mechanisms (2023)
content:
(1)  NotwithstandingKRS 304.13-131(2)(a), insurers participating in joint underwriting, joint reinsurance pools, or residual
      market mechanisms may, in connection with such activity, cooperate with each other
      in the making of rates, rating systems, policy forms, underwriting rules, surveys,
      inspections and investigations, the furnishing of loss and expense statistics or other
      information, or carrying on research.  Joint underwriting, joint reinsurance pools, and residual market mechanisms shall
      not be deemed advisory organizations.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions›Chapter 304. Insurance Code›Subtitle 13. Rates and Rating Organizations›KY REV ST 304.13-335. Certain rates to be based on Kentucky experience
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions › Chapter 304. Insurance Code › Subtitle 13. Rates and Rating Organizations › KY REV ST 304.13-335. Certain rates to be based on Kentucky experience
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 304.13-335. Certain rates to be based on Kentucky experience (2023)
content:
Rates for professional, commercial, and governmental liability insurance shall be
   based on Kentucky experience when actuarially credible.  This section shall not apply to rates for motor vehicle liability insurance, workers'
   compensation insurance, and employers' liability insurance.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions›Chapter 304. Insurance Code›Subtitle 13. Rates and Rating Organizations›KY REV ST 304.13-167. Workers' compensation insurers; uniform classification and experience rating systems; reporting; subclassifications, rating plans, and other variations from manual rules; credit for drug-free workplace program
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions › Chapter 304. Insurance Code › Subtitle 13. Rates and Rating Organizations › KY REV ST 304.13-167. Workers' compensation insurers; uniform classification and experience rating systems; reporting; subclassifications, rating plans, and other variations from manual rules; credit for drug-free workplace program
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 304.13-167. Workers' compensation insurers; uniform classification and experience rating systems; reporting; subclassifications, rating plans, and other variations from manual rules; credit for drug-free workplace program (2023)
content:
(1)  Every workers' compensation insurer shall adhere to a uniform classification
      system and uniform experience rating system filed with the commissioner by an advisory
      organization designated by the commissioner.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions›Chapter 304. Insurance Code›Subtitle 13. Rates and Rating Organizations›KY REV ST 304.13-171. Property or casualty insurance policy underwriting fee; requirement for prior approval
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions › Chapter 304. Insurance Code › Subtitle 13. Rates and Rating Organizations › KY REV ST 304.13-171. Property or casualty insurance policy underwriting fee; requirement for prior approval
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 304.13-171. Property or casualty insurance policy underwriting fee; requirement for prior approval (2023)
content:
(1)  Any policy fee as related to underwriting expenses for a property or casualty
      insurance contract, issued or renewed on or after July 14, 2000, by an agent licensed
      underKRS 304.9-085, shall be deemed fully earned.  The fee shall only be collected if coverage is provided.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions›Chapter 304. Insurance Code›Subtitle 13. Rates and Rating Organizations›KY REV ST 304.13-165. Information to be filed by advisory organization
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions › Chapter 304. Insurance Code › Subtitle 13. Rates and Rating Organizations › KY REV ST 304.13-165. Information to be filed by advisory organization
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 304.13-165. Information to be filed by advisory organization (2023)
content:
(1)  Every advisory organization shall file with the commissioner every statistical
      plan, all prospective loss costs, provisions for special assessments, and all supplementary
      rating information, and every change or amendment or modification of any of the foregoing
      proposed for use in Kentucky.  Each filing shall be filed thirty (30) days before it becomes effective, which period
      may be extended by the commissioner for an additional period not to exceed thirty
      (30) days, if written notice is given within the initial thirty (30) day period to
      the advisory organization that additional time is needed for the consideration of
      the filing.  The commissioner may, upon giving written notice to the advisory organization, request
      additional information that is needed to complete the review of the filing.  If the commissioner requests such additional information prior to the filing becoming
      effective, the filing shall become effective thirty (30) days after the additional
      information is provided to the commissioner.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions›Chapter 304. Insurance Code›Subtitle 13. Rates and Rating Organizations›KY REV ST 304.13-320. Penalty for violation
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions › Chapter 304. Insurance Code › Subtitle 13. Rates and Rating Organizations › KY REV ST 304.13-320. Penalty for violation
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 304.13-320. Penalty for violation (2023)
content:
(1)  The commissioner may suspend the license of any advisory organization or insurer
      which fails to comply with an order of the commissioner within the time limited by
      the order, or any extension thereof which the commissioner may grant.  The commissioner shall not suspend the license of any advisory organization or insurer
      for failure to comply with an order until the time prescribed for an appeal therefrom
      has expired or if an appeal has been taken, until the order has been affirmed.  The commissioner may modify or rescind a suspension at any time.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions›Chapter 304. Insurance Code›Subtitle 13. Rates and Rating Organizations›KY REV ST 304.13-340. Phase-out of Workers' Compensation Insurance Plan; transfer of insureds to Employers' Mutual Insurance Authority
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions › Chapter 304. Insurance Code › Subtitle 13. Rates and Rating Organizations › KY REV ST 304.13-340. Phase-out of Workers' Compensation Insurance Plan; transfer of insureds to Employers' Mutual Insurance Authority
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 304.13-340. Phase-out of Workers' Compensation Insurance Plan; transfer of insureds to Employers' Mutual Insurance Authority (2023)
content:
The Workers' Compensation Insurance Plan (KWCIP), a workers' compensation residual
   market mechanism, in existence by virtue of this subtitle, shall not write new policies
   or renew policies after September 1, 1995.  The board of directors of the Employers' Mutual Insurance Authority, the commissioner
   of the Department of Workers' Claims, and the commissioner of the Department of Insurance
   shall develop a plan, which shall be reviewed by the Economic Development and Workforce
   Investment Committee and the Banking and Insurance Committee of the General Assembly,
   for the orderly and equitable phase-out of the KWCIP.  All claims on workers' compensation assigned risk policies in effect or issued prior
   to September 1, 1995, shall be paid by the KWCIP.  The plan developed shall include procedures for application and transfer of the
   insureds in the KWCIP to the authority, who shall be subject to the qualifications
   and conditions of coverage required inKRS 342.801to342.843and this section.  The authority shall not be liable for any liabilities or deficits incurred on assigned
   risk policies in effect or issued prior to September 1, 1995.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions›Chapter 304. Insurance Code›Subtitle 13. Rates and Rating Organizations›KY REV ST 304.13-169. Withholding information or giving false information
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions › Chapter 304. Insurance Code › Subtitle 13. Rates and Rating Organizations › KY REV ST 304.13-169. Withholding information or giving false information
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 304.13-169. Withholding information or giving false information (2023)
content:
No person shall willfully withhold information which will affect the rates or premiums
   chargeable under this subtitle from, or knowingly give false or misleading information
   to, the commissioner, any statistical agent, any advisory organization, or any insurer.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions›Chapter 304. Insurance Code›Fire Protection Classification Review and Appeal›KY REV ST 304.13-350. Functions of commissioner
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions › Chapter 304. Insurance Code › Fire Protection Classification Review and Appeal › KY REV ST 304.13-350. Functions of commissioner
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 304.13-350. Functions of commissioner (2023)
content:
The commissioner shall review, approve, and hear appeals on the assignment, reassignment,
   or modification of any fire protection classification of any fire protection district,
   municipality, or locality in the state which is made by any lawful insurer, advisory
   organization, or agency operating in the Commonwealth.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions›Chapter 304. Insurance Code›Fire Protection Classification Review and Appeal›KY REV ST 304.13-370. Increase in fire insurance premiums prohibited until the running of the appeal period or until approval by the board of the classification assigned
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions › Chapter 304. Insurance Code › Fire Protection Classification Review and Appeal › KY REV ST 304.13-370. Increase in fire insurance premiums prohibited until the running of the appeal period or until approval by the board of the classification assigned
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 304.13-370. Increase in fire insurance premiums prohibited until the running of the appeal period or until approval by the board of the classification assigned (2023)
content:
(1)  No insurer may increase premiums for fire insurance based on a fire protection
      classification until the expiration of the thirty (30) day period for appeal by the
      fire protection district, municipality or locality, as provided inKRS 304.13-355.  If an appeal is filed, no insurer may increase such premiums until approval of the
      fire protection classification by the commissioner.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions›Chapter 304. Insurance Code›Fire Protection Classification Review and Appeal›KY REV ST 304.13-360. Investigatory powers of the commissioner
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions › Chapter 304. Insurance Code › Fire Protection Classification Review and Appeal › KY REV ST 304.13-360. Investigatory powers of the commissioner
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 304.13-360. Investigatory powers of the commissioner (2023)
content:
(1)  The commissioner shall make such investigation as he or she deems necessary or
      convenient for proper determination regarding an appeal.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions›Chapter 304. Insurance Code›Fire Protection Classification Review and Appeal›KY REV ST 304.13-380. Reports of fire calls by fire departments; monthly summaries to be sent to commissioner
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions › Chapter 304. Insurance Code › Fire Protection Classification Review and Appeal › KY REV ST 304.13-380. Reports of fire calls by fire departments; monthly summaries to be sent to commissioner
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 304.13-380. Reports of fire calls by fire departments; monthly summaries to be sent to commissioner (2023)
content:
(1)  Each fire department operating within the Commonwealth, whether paid or volunteer,
      shall complete a report each time it responds to a fire call.  The report shall be made on a form, similar to the National Fire Protection Association's
      standard fire reporting form, to be distributed by the Kentucky Fire Commission and
      shall include but not be limited to the following information:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions›Chapter 304. Insurance Code›Fire Protection Classification Review and Appeal›KY REV ST 304.13-365. Hearing; final orders
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions › Chapter 304. Insurance Code › Fire Protection Classification Review and Appeal › KY REV ST 304.13-365. Hearing; final orders
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 304.13-365. Hearing; final orders (2023)
content:
(1)  Within thirty (30) days of the filing of an appeal, the commissioner shall hold
      an administrative hearing to be conducted in accordance withKRS 304.2-310.  Whenever the commissioner determines that a fire protection classification is unreasonable,
      he or she shall by final order prescribe a reasonable classification to be followed
      for a period not to exceed one (1) year.  A subsequent evaluation by the advisory organization or insurer shall not be permitted
      until the expiration of the period set by the commissioner.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions›Chapter 304. Insurance Code›Fire Protection Classification Review and Appeal›KY REV ST 304.13-420. Financial responsibility requirement
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions › Chapter 304. Insurance Code › Fire Protection Classification Review and Appeal › KY REV ST 304.13-420. Financial responsibility requirement
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 304.13-420. Financial responsibility requirement (2023)
content:
No insurer shall be required to offer a deductible to an employer policyholder, as
   provided inKRS 304.13-400, if the insurer determines, subject to review by the commissioner, that the prospective
   employer policyholder is not financially able to comply with the terms and conditions
   of a deductible workers' compensation policy.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions›Chapter 304. Insurance Code›Subtitle 14. The Insurance Contract›KY REV ST 304.14-010. Scope of subtitle
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXV. Business and Financial Institutions › Chapter 304. Insurance Code › Subtitle 14. The Insurance Contract › KY REV ST 304.14-010. Scope of subtitle
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 304.14-010. Scope of subtitle (2023)
content: This subtitle applies as to all insurance contracts and annuity contracts, other than:
