path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 318. Plumbers and Plumbing›KY REV ST 318.130. Kentucky State Plumbing Code; administrative regulations
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 318. Plumbers and Plumbing › KY REV ST 318.130. Kentucky State Plumbing Code; administrative regulations
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 318.130. Kentucky State Plumbing Code; administrative regulations (2023)
content:
In order to administer this chapter, the department shall promulgate and thereafter
   from time to time may amend a code to be known as the Kentucky State Plumbing Code,
   regulating the construction, installation, and alteration of plumbing and plumbing
   fixtures and appliances, house sewers and private water supplies, and methods and
   materials to be used therein within this state, using as a minimum standard the basic
   principles of the National Plumbing Code Coordinating Committee, as evidenced by that
   committee's final report of 1951 with variations thereof or additions thereto as the
   committee considers are warranted by local, climatic, or other conditions.  The code may also designate the number of plumbing fixtures for public buildings.  The department may adopt any other reasonable administrative regulation to administer
   this chapter if the administrative regulation has been subject to review and comment
   by the Housing, Buildings and Construction Advisory Committee under the requirements
   ofKRS 198B.030(8).  No rules or regulations so approved by the Housing, Buildings and Construction Advisory
   Committee shall become effective except upon adoption by the department, in satisfaction
   of the requirements of KRS Chapter 13A.  The department shall furnish to the Housing, Buildings and Construction Advisory
   Committee proposed amendments to the code for the committee's review and comment prior
   to their adoption by the department.  The department shall not promulgate any administrative regulations related to this
   chapter without granting the Housing, Buildings and Construction Advisory Committee
   the opportunity to comment on the administrative regulation.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 318. Plumbers and Plumbing›KY REV ST 318.100. Advertising by licensee

   plumber license from the department in accordance with this chapter.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 318. Plumbers and Plumbing›KY REV ST 318.110. Company or individual connected with licensed plumber may engage in plumbing business; notice of connection
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 318. Plumbers and Plumbing › KY REV ST 318.110. Company or individual connected with licensed plumber may engage in plumbing business; notice of connection
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 318.110. Company or individual connected with licensed plumber may engage in plumbing business; notice of connection (2023)
content:
A company or individual principal may engage in the business of plumbing within any
   county of the Commonwealth if a person connected with that company or individual principal
   in responsible charge of the plumbing work is a licensed master plumber.  Any master plumber, in responsible charge of plumbing work for a company or individual
   engaged in the plumbing business, shall notify the department at any time he or she
   commences or severs his or her connection with the company or individual principal.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 318. Plumbers and Plumbing›KY REV ST 318.120. Employment of unlicensed plumber prohibited
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 318. Plumbers and Plumbing › KY REV ST 318.120. Employment of unlicensed plumber prohibited
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 318.120. Employment of unlicensed plumber prohibited (2023)
content:
No person or corporation who assumes responsible charge and direction of other persons
   in the installation of plumbing shall employ or engage any person not licensed under
   this chapter to perform and install plumbing.  Provided, however, that this section shall not be deemed to prohibit the employment
   or use of an apprentice as defined in this chapter.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 318. Plumbers and Plumbing›KY REV ST 318.140. Adoption and enforcement of State Plumbing Code by local governments; local inspectors; qualifications
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 318. Plumbers and Plumbing › KY REV ST 318.140. Adoption and enforcement of State Plumbing Code by local governments; local inspectors; qualifications
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 318.140. Adoption and enforcement of State Plumbing Code by local governments; local inspectors; qualifications (2023)
content:
(1)  Any local government may, by ordinance, enact the Kentucky State Plumbing Code,
      regulating the construction, installation, or alteration of plumbing within such local
      government, providing for the issuance of plumbing installation permits and fixing
      permit and inspection fees.  Two (2) or more local governments may, by ordinance of each local government, enact
      the plumbing code as described in this section which shall be jointly enforced and
      administered by said local governments within their boundaries.  Agreements for joint enforcement shall conform to the provisions of KRS Chapter
      65.  The department may authorize any such local government or combination of local governments
      to administer, carry out, and enforce the Kentucky State Plumbing Code and the rules
      and regulations of the department relating thereto and to issue permits and make inspections
      thereunder within such local government, in which event a permit issued under the
      provisions of the local government plumbing code ordinance shall be deemed a permit
      issued by the department;  provided, however, that inspectors of the department shall
      have concurrent jurisdiction with local government plumbing inspectors in the enforcement
      in such local governments of the Kentucky State Plumbing Code.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 318. Plumbers and Plumbing›KY REV ST 318.150. Materials and methods to be used
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 318. Plumbers and Plumbing › KY REV ST 318.150. Materials and methods to be used
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 318.150. Materials and methods to be used (2023)
content:
No person shall use unsafe or defective material in the work of plumbing or drainage.  Only the best known methods of installing materials, fixtures, appurtenances and
   appliances, including water supply piping, waste, ventilating and soil piping, and
   sewage piping shall be employed.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 318. Plumbers and Plumbing›KY REV ST 318.136. Trust and agency fund
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 318. Plumbers and Plumbing › KY REV ST 318.136. Trust and agency fund
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 318.136. Trust and agency fund (2023)
content:
All license fees, permit and inspection fees and charges, and other moneys collected
   by the department, under the provisions of this chapter and the rules and regulations
   of the department adopted hereunder, shall be paid into the State Treasury and credited
   to a trust and agency fund to be used by the department in carrying out the provisions
   of this chapter.  No part of this fund shall revert to the general fund of the Commonwealth.  All moneys held in a trust and agency fund or other fund to the credit of the department
   for the administration and enforcement of this chapter on June 16, 1960, are hereby
   transferred to the trust and agency fund herein created.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 318. Plumbers and Plumbing›KY REV ST 318.165. Requisites for providing permanent water supply
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 318. Plumbers and Plumbing › KY REV ST 318.165. Requisites for providing permanent water supply
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 318.165. Requisites for providing permanent water supply (2023)
content:
No permanent water supply shall be provided to any building by any public utility
   or water district where the interior plumbing system has not been installed and approved
   in accordance with the provisions of KRS Chapter 318 and the State Plumbing Code.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 318. Plumbers and Plumbing›KY REV ST 318.200. Water heating devices; serial numbers
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 318. Plumbers and Plumbing › KY REV ST 318.200. Water heating devices; serial numbers
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 318.200. Water heating devices; serial numbers (2023)
content:
(1)  No water heating device shall be sold or offered for sale in the Commonwealth
      of Kentucky unless it contains a serial number on it.  As used in this section, “water heating device” means any pressure vessel which heats, stores, and supplies potable water for domestic
      or commercial purposes other than for space heating.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 318. Plumbers and Plumbing›KY REV ST 318.190. Jurisdiction for enforcement actions
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 318. Plumbers and Plumbing › KY REV ST 318.190. Jurisdiction for enforcement actions
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 318.190. Jurisdiction for enforcement actions (2023)
content:
(1)  The Circuit Court where the violation occurs shall have jurisdiction and venue
      in all civil and injunctive actions instituted by the department for the enforcement
      of the provisions of KRS Chapter 318 and the State Plumbing Code and the orders issued
      thereunder.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 318. Plumbers and Plumbing›KY REV ST 318.180. Enforcement of plumbing laws
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 318. Plumbers and Plumbing › KY REV ST 318.180. Enforcement of plumbing laws
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 318.180. Enforcement of plumbing laws (2023)
content:
(1)  Notwithstanding the existence or pursuit of any other remedy (civil or criminal)
      the department, or its officers, agents, or inspectors, are hereby authorized to institute
      and maintain actions to restrain and enjoin any violation of this chapter, the State
      Plumbing Code, or the rules and regulations of the department relating thereto.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 318. Plumbers and Plumbing›KY REV ST 318.160. Installation plans and specifications
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 318. Plumbers and Plumbing › KY REV ST 318.160. Installation plans and specifications
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 318.160. Installation plans and specifications (2023)
content:
Except as otherwise provided by law or by regulation of the department, no person
   shall construct, install, or extensively alter any plumbing, sewerage, or water supply
   system of any public building or establishment without having first obtained the approval
   of the department in writing.  Detailed plans and specifications of the proposed facility showing the plumbing
   system, sewage disposal system, and water supply system shall be submitted to the
   department prior to the construction or alteration of the facility.  In the event no public sewer is available, the plan shall include the proposed type
   of sewage disposal system.  In the event a sewage subsoil drainage system is used, or some other type of on-site
   sewage disposal system that does not have a surface discharge, the application for
   construction, installation, or alteration of such system shall be submitted to the
   Cabinet for Health and Family Services or its designated agent.  All other plans and specifications shall be submitted in triplicate to the department.  The department shall notify the applicant in writing of the approval or disapproval
   of the plans.  The construction, installation, or alteration shall be done in accordance with the
   approved plans.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 319. Psychologists›KY REV ST 319.054. Psychology Interjurisdictional Compact
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 319. Psychologists › KY REV ST 319.054. Psychology Interjurisdictional Compact
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 319.054. Psychology Interjurisdictional Compact (2023)
content:
Whereas, states license psychologists, in order to protect the public through verification
   of education, training and experience and ensure accountability for professional practice;

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 319. Psychologists›KY REV ST 319.005. Practice of psychology and use of title by persons not licensed or certified prohibited; voluntary health practitioners
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 319. Psychologists › KY REV ST 319.005. Practice of psychology and use of title by persons not licensed or certified prohibited; voluntary health practitioners
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 319.005. Practice of psychology and use of title by persons not licensed or certified prohibited; voluntary health practitioners (2023)
content:
(1)  No person shall engage in the practice of psychology as defined inKRS 319.010or hold himself or herself out by any title or description of services which incorporates
      the words “psychological,” “psychologist,” or “psychology”, unless licensed by the
      board.  No person shall engage in the practice of psychology in a manner that implies or
      would reasonably be deemed to imply that he or she is licensed, unless he or she holds
      a valid license issued by the board.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 318. Plumbers and Plumbing›KY REV ST 318.170. Authority of agents of department
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 318. Plumbers and Plumbing › KY REV ST 318.170. Authority of agents of department
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 318.170. Authority of agents of department (2023)
content:
For the purpose of enforcing the provisions of this chapter and the State Plumbing
   Code, officers, agents, and inspectors of the department shall have the power and
   authority to enter upon premises at all reasonable times for the purpose of making
   inspections, to interrogate all persons and to require the production of plumbing
   installation permits and other evidence.  Officers, agents, and inspectors of the department are empowered to issue a stop
   order to any owner, agent, or occupant of real property whenever the plumbing thereon
   is found by the officer, agent or inspector of the department to be in violation of
   this chapter or the State Plumbing Code.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 319. Psychologists›KY REV ST 319.010. Definitions

content: (1)  The board shall promulgate administrative regulations:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 319. Psychologists›KY REV ST 319.020. Board of Examiners of Psychology
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 319. Psychologists › KY REV ST 319.020. Board of Examiners of Psychology
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 319.020. Board of Examiners of Psychology (2023)
content:
(1)  The board shall consist of nine (9) members appointed by the Governor.  Six (6) members shall be licensed psychologists.  Two (2) members shall be credentialed by the board as certified psychologists, licensed
      psychological practitioners, or licensed psychological associates.  One (1) member shall be a citizen at large who is not associated with or financially
      interested in the practice or business regulated.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 319. Psychologists›KY REV ST 319.015. Activities not included in practice of psychology
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 319. Psychologists › KY REV ST 319.015. Activities not included in practice of psychology
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 319.015. Activities not included in practice of psychology (2023)
content: Nothing in this chapter shall be construed to limit:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 319. Psychologists›KY REV ST 319.053. “Licensed psychological practitioner”
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 319. Psychologists › KY REV ST 319.053. “Licensed psychological practitioner”
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 319.053. “Licensed psychological practitioner” (2023)
content:
(1)  A person holding a credential as a certified psychologist or as a licensed psychological
      associate may apply for a license to perform certain functions within the practice
      of psychology without supervision and to use the title of “licensed psychological
      practitioner” when all of the following conditions are met:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 319. Psychologists›KY REV ST 319.050. Examination for license; fee; supervision and temporary licensure; designation as “health service provider”
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 319. Psychologists › KY REV ST 319.050. Examination for license; fee; supervision and temporary licensure; designation as “health service provider”
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 319.050. Examination for license; fee; supervision and temporary licensure; designation as “health service provider” (2023)
content:
(1)  Before granting a license to practice psychology and to use the title “licensed
      psychologist” the board shall require the applicant to pass an examination in psychology
      and to fulfill all requirements for supervised experience.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 319. Psychologists›KY REV ST 319.056. “Certified psychologist with autonomous functioning”; “certified psychologist”; practice and title authorization
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 319. Psychologists › KY REV ST 319.056. “Certified psychologist with autonomous functioning”; “certified psychologist”; practice and title authorization
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 319.056. “Certified psychologist with autonomous functioning”; “certified psychologist”; practice and title authorization (2023)
content:
(1)  A person currently authorized to use the title “certified psychologist with autonomous
      functioning” may continue to function with that title or may choose to permanently
      change this title to “licensed psychological practitioner” and notify the board of
      this choice.  The board shall issue a license at the time of renewal to the credential holder
      with the title of choice.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 319. Psychologists›KY REV ST 319.030. Annual report of board; principal office; register
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 319. Psychologists › KY REV ST 319.030. Annual report of board; principal office; register
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 319.030. Annual report of board; principal office; register (2023)
content:
(1)  On June 30 of each year the board shall submit to the Governor a written report
      including the names of all persons to whom licenses have been granted as provided
      in this chapter and any cases heard and decisions rendered.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 319. Psychologists›KY REV ST 319.064. Psychological associate
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 319. Psychologists › KY REV ST 319.064. Psychological associate

content:
(1)  An individual credentialed as a psychological associate shall use the title “licensed
      psychological associate” and the board shall issue a license with that title at the
      time of renewal.

title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 319. Psychologists › KY REV ST 319.082. Disciplinary actions against license and credential holders

content:
(1)  The board may suspend, revoke, or refuse to issue or renew a license;  may accept

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 319. Psychologists›KY REV ST 319.118. Immunity of board members from liability; standing to institute and maintain legal actions; effect of surrender of license or certificate; representation of board by public officers
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 319. Psychologists › KY REV ST 319.118. Immunity of board members from liability; standing to institute and maintain legal actions; effect of surrender of license or certificate; representation of board by public officers
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 319.118. Immunity of board members from liability; standing to institute and maintain legal actions; effect of surrender of license or certificate; representation of board by public officers (2023)
content:
(1)  Members of the board, its agents, and employees shall be immune from personal
      liability in any action, civil or criminal, which is based upon any official act or
      acts performed by them in good faith.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 319. Psychologists›KY REV ST 319.990. Penalties
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 319. Psychologists › KY REV ST 319.990. Penalties
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 319.990. Penalties (2023)
content:
(1)  Any person who violatesKRS 319.005shall be guilty of a misdemeanor and, upon conviction, shall be punished by imprisonment
      for not more than six (6) months, or by a fine of not more than five hundred dollars
      ($500), or by both fine and imprisonment, and each violation shall be deemed a separate
      offense.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 319. Psychologists›KY REV ST 319.131. Fees credited to fund for board use
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 319. Psychologists › KY REV ST 319.131. Fees credited to fund for board use
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 319.131. Fees credited to fund for board use (2023)
content:
All fees received by the board of examiners under this chapter shall be placed in
   the State Treasury to the credit of a trust and agency fund for the use of the board
   in carrying out its functions.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 319. Psychologists›KY REV ST 319.071. Renewal of licenses and certification; fee; cancellation; restoration; inactive status
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 319. Psychologists › KY REV ST 319.071. Renewal of licenses and certification; fee; cancellation; restoration; inactive status
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 319.071. Renewal of licenses and certification; fee; cancellation; restoration; inactive status (2023)
content:
(1)  Licenses must be renewed every three (3) years on or before the anniversary date
      of issue or renewal.  Credential holders shall pay to the board a renewal fee not to exceed one hundred
      dollars ($100) and shall receive a renewal license.  The board shall cancel a license not renewed within three (3) months of the renewal
      date, but the board may reinstate any canceled license upon payment of the renewal
      fee and a penalty not to exceed the amount of the renewal fee within three (3) years
      after cancellation.  A credential holder whose license has been canceled shall not practice psychology
      until the license has been restored.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 319. Psychologists›KY REV ST 319.092. Administrative hearing; sanctions; appeal
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 319. Psychologists › KY REV ST 319.092. Administrative hearing; sanctions; appeal
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 319.092. Administrative hearing; sanctions; appeal (2023)
content:
(1)  In every proceeding for probation, suspension, or revocation of a license, an
      administrative hearing shall be conducted in accordance with KRS Chapter 13B.  The board or a hearing officer appointed by the board shall conduct the hearing.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 319A. Occupational Therapists›KY REV ST 319A.040. Meetings; quorum; officers
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 319A. Occupational Therapists › KY REV ST 319A.040. Meetings; quorum; officers
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 319A.040. Meetings; quorum; officers (2023)
content:
The board shall meet at least annually and may meet at such other times as necessary
   to complete the business required.  A majority of the members of the board shall constitute a quorum for the transaction
   of business.  Annually the board shall elect from its membership a chairman, a vice chairman,
   and a secretary to serve for one (1) year terms.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 319A. Occupational Therapists›KY REV ST 319A.030. Terms; vacancies; removal; reimbursement for expenses
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 319A. Occupational Therapists › KY REV ST 319A.030. Terms; vacancies; removal; reimbursement for expenses
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 319A.030. Terms; vacancies; removal; reimbursement for expenses (2023)
content:
The terms of the members shall be for three (3) years and until their successors are
   appointed and qualified, except of those first appointed one (1) shall serve for one
   (1) year, two (2) shall serve for two (2) years and two (2) shall serve for three
   (3) years.  Vacancies shall be filled in the manner of the original appointment for the unexpired
   portion of the term only.  The Governor, after notice and opportunity for a hearing, may remove any member
   of the board for malfeasance, neglect of duty, incompetency, or revocation or suspension
   of a license.  Members of the board shall receive no salary but shall be allowed usual mileage,
   subsistence and per diem as provided by law for members of state boards, commissions,
   and committees.  No member shall serve more than two (2) consecutive terms.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 319A. Occupational Therapists›KY REV ST 319A.050. Executive secretary and assistants; expenditure of funds
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 319A. Occupational Therapists › KY REV ST 319A.050. Executive secretary and assistants; expenditure of funds
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 319A.050. Executive secretary and assistants; expenditure of funds (2023)
content:
The board may employ an executive secretary and such clerical or other assistants
   as are necessary for the proper performance of its work and may make expenditures
   of its funds for any purpose which in the opinion of the board is necessary for proper
   performance of its duties, including compensation of the executive secretary and the
   premium on his bond.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 319A. Occupational Therapists›KY REV ST 319A.020. Board of Licensure for Occupational Therapy; appointment
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 319A. Occupational Therapists › KY REV ST 319A.020. Board of Licensure for Occupational Therapy; appointment
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 319A.020. Board of Licensure for Occupational Therapy; appointment (2023)
content:
(1)  There is hereby created the Kentucky Board of Licensure for Occupational Therapy
      which shall consist of seven (7) members to be appointed by the Governor.  Four (4) members shall be licensed occupational therapists with at least five (5)
      years' experience;  one (1) member shall be a licensed occupational therapy assistant
      with at least five (5) years' experience in the practice of occupational therapy;
      and two (2) members shall be members of the public with an interest in the rights
      of consumers of health services.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 319A. Occupational Therapists›KY REV ST 319A.060. Duties of executive secretary; bond
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 319A. Occupational Therapists › KY REV ST 319A.060. Duties of executive secretary; bond
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 319A.060. Duties of executive secretary; bond (2023)
content:
The executive secretary or any other person so designated by the board shall give
   bond to the state in such sum as determined by the board to be approved by the State
   Treasurer for the faithful performance of his duties.  The secretary shall receive and account for all moneys derived under the provisions
   of this chapter and shall pay such moneys to the State Treasurer who shall keep them
   in the manner provided for other such agencies and boards of the Commonwealth.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 319A. Occupational Therapists›KY REV ST 319A.080. License required for practice of occupational therapy or use of title “occupational therapist”; training requirements for use of deep physical agent modalities
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 319A. Occupational Therapists › KY REV ST 319A.080. citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 319A.080. License required for practice of occupational therapy or use of title “occupational therapist”; training requirements for use of deep physical agent modalities (2023)
content:
(1)  It shall be unlawful for any person to practice occupational therapy, assist
      in the practice of occupational therapy, or render services designated as occupational
      therapy in the Commonwealth of Kentucky, unless licensed under the provisions of this
      chapter.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 319A. Occupational Therapists›KY REV ST 319A.100. Temporary permit
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 319A. Occupational Therapists › KY REV ST 319A.100. Temporary permit
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 319A.100. Temporary permit (2023)
content:
A temporary permit to practice as an occupational therapist or occupational therapy
   assistant may be granted to a person who has completed the education and experience
   requirements of this chapter and has applied for licensure under the provisions of
   this chapter.  The temporary permit shall allow the applicant for licensure to practice occupational
   therapy under the supervision of a licensed occupational therapist.  The temporary permit shall be valid until the applicant for licensure is issued
   or denied a license under the provisions of this chapter, but in no instance shall
   the temporary permit extend for more than sixty (60) days following the second examination
   offered after the applicant has applied to take the examination required for licensure
   or certification.  Not more than one (1) temporary permit shall be granted per applicant.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 319A. Occupational Therapists›KY REV ST 319A.070. Powers and duties of board
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 319A. Occupational Therapists › KY REV ST 319A.070. Powers and duties of board
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 319A.070. Powers and duties of board (2023)
content:
(1)  The board shall administer and enforce the provisions of this chapter and shall
      have the responsibility of evaluating the qualifications of applicants for licensure.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 319A. Occupational Therapists›KY REV ST 319A.150. License fee; use of title
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 319A. Occupational Therapists › KY REV ST 319A.150. License fee; use of title
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 319A.150. License fee; use of title (2023)
content:
The board shall issue a license to an individual who has met the requirements of this
   chapter upon the payment of the applicable license fee.  An individual who is issued a license as an occupational therapist under the provisions
   of this chapter may use the title “occupational therapist licensed,” or use the letters
   “O.T.R./L.” in connection with the title or place of business to denote his licensure.  A person who is issued a license as an occupational therapy assistant may use the
   words “certified occupational therapy assistant licensed” or may use the letters “C.O.T.A./L.”
   in connection with the person's name or place of business to denote licensure.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 319A. Occupational Therapists›KY REV ST 319A.120. Written or computer-based examination
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 319A. Occupational Therapists › KY REV ST 319A.120. Written or computer-based examination
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 319A.120. Written or computer-based examination (2023)
content:
Individuals applying for licensure shall be required to pass a written or computer-based
   examination approved by the board, which is designed to test the knowledge and experience
   necessary to the safe, effective, and professional practice of occupational therapy
   in Kentucky.  The examination shall test the applicant's knowledge of the basic and clinical sciences
   related to the occupational therapy theory, research, practice, ethics, and professional
   behavior, and such other subjects as the board may require to determine the applicant's
   fitness to practice.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 319A. Occupational Therapists›KY REV ST 319A.200. Appeals from orders of the board
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 319A. Occupational Therapists › KY REV ST 319A.200. Appeals from orders of the board
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 319A.200. Appeals from orders of the board (2023)
content:
Any person aggrieved by an order of the board denying, suspending or revoking his
   license may appeal to the Franklin Circuit Court within thirty (30) days after entry
   of said order, for appropriate relief.  On such appeal the scope of review shall be limited to an examination of the record
   of the board's action for the purpose of determining whether the board abused its
   discretion.  The appellant shall furnish the court with a properly certified transcript of any
   evidence heard by the board, and the court may refuse to review any findings of fact
   made by the board unless such a transcript is filed within sixty (60) days after the
   filing of the appeal.

content:

   to a license issued under this chapter, or use the title “orthotist,” “prosthetist,”
   “pedorthist,” “orthotic fitter,” or any words or letters which designate or tend to
   designate to the public that the person is an orthotist, prosthetist, pedorthist,

      chapter.  Any subsequent offenses committed at any time shall be subject to the relevant penalties
      in subsection (2) of this section.

content:
Any person, who, on June 17, 1954, was the holder of a valid, unrevoked license to
   practice optometry issued to him under the laws of this state, shall not be required

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 320. Optometrists›KY REV ST 320.230. Kentucky Board of Optometric Examiners; appointment; qualifications; vacancies; quorum; compensation
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 320. Optometrists › KY REV ST 320.230. Kentucky Board of Optometric Examiners; appointment; qualifications; vacancies; quorum; compensation
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 320.230. Kentucky Board of Optometric Examiners; appointment; qualifications; vacancies; quorum; compensation (2023)
content:
(1)  The Kentucky Board of Optometric Examiners shall consist of five (5) members
      appointed by the Governor.  Four (4) members shall be Kentucky licensed practicing optometrists whose licenses
      are in good standing and who are appointed by the Governor from a list containing
      three (3) names for each appointment recommended by the Kentucky Optometric Association.  One (1) member shall be a citizen at large who is not associated with or financially
      interested in the practice or business regulated.  The members shall serve for a term of four (4) years and until their successors
      are appointed and qualified.  They shall receive per diem compensation to be determined by administrative regulations
      promulgated by the board, not to exceed one hundred twenty-five dollars ($125) per
      day for attending board meetings.  Members shall be reimbursed for actual expenses incurred in the performance of their
      duties under this chapter.

content:
(1)  The board shall meet at least once each year, at which time it shall choose from
      among its members the president, vice president, and secretary-treasurer.  In addition, the board, upon call of its officers, may hold meetings at any time
      as it deems necessary.  A full record of the board's proceedings shall be kept in the office of the board
      and shall be open to inspection at all reasonable times.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 320. Optometrists›KY REV ST 320.200. Declaration of legislative policy concerning practice of optometry
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 320. Optometrists › KY REV ST 320.200. Declaration of legislative policy concerning practice of optometry
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 320.200. Declaration of legislative policy concerning practice of optometry (2023)
content:
The practice of optometry in the Commonwealth of Kentucky is hereby declared to affect
   the public health and safety and is subject to regulation and control in the public
   interest.  Optometry is hereby declared to be a learned profession and it is further declared
   to be a matter of public interest and concern that the practice of optometry as defined
   in this chapter and the optometric profession merit and receive the confidence of
   the public and that only qualified persons be admitted to the practice of optometry
   and be permitted to so practice in the Commonwealth of Kentucky.  This chapter shall be liberally construed to carry out these objects and purposes
   in accordance with this declaration of policy.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 320. Optometrists›KY REV ST 320.242. Immunity from liability of board members and employees
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 320. Optometrists › KY REV ST 320.242. Immunity from liability of board members and employees
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 320.242. Immunity from liability of board members and employees (2023)
content:
There shall be no monetary liability on the part of, and no cause of action for damages
   shall arise against, any current or former member, officer, administrator, agent,
   or employee of the board, either as a part of the board's operation or as an individual,
   as the result of any act, omission, proceeding, conduct, or decision relating to official
   duties undertaken or performed within the scope of the function of the board, except
   where actual malice or willful misconduct is shown.  A person bringing an action under this section shall prove its elements by clear
   and convincing evidence.

title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 320. Optometrists › KY REV ST 320.295. Prohibition against false, misleading, or deceptive advertising

title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 320. Optometrists › KY REV ST 320.290. Display of licenses
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 320.290. Display of licenses (2023)
content:
Every practicing optometrist shall display in a conspicuous place at the entrance
   to his office the true full name of the person practicing therein and shall keep his
   license certificate conspicuously displayed in his place of practice so that it can
   easily be seen and read.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 320. Optometrists›KY REV ST 320.280. Renewal certificates; administrative regulations
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 320. Optometrists › KY REV ST 320.280. Renewal certificates; administrative regulations
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 320.280. Renewal certificates; administrative regulations (2023)
content:

      1, secure from the secretary-treasurer of the board a renewal certificate upon the
      payment of a fee which shall be established by administrative regulation promulgated
      by the board.  Not later than February 15 of each year, the board shall notify by mail all optometrists
      of the renewal date and fee.  Application for a renewal shall be upon a form prescribed by the board and the optometrist
      shall furnish the information required by the form.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 320. Optometrists›KY REV ST 320.340. Reissuance of revoked license
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 320. Optometrists › KY REV ST 320.340. Reissuance of revoked license
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 320.340. Reissuance of revoked license (2023)
content:
Upon application the board may reissue a license to practice optometry that has been
   revoked.  No such application shall be made prior to one (1) year after revocation.  The board may prescribe the manner and form of application.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 320. Optometrists›KY REV ST 320.331. Appeal to Circuit Court
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 320. Optometrists › KY REV ST 320.331. Appeal to Circuit Court
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 320.331. Appeal to Circuit Court (2023)
content:
An optometrist who, by final order of the board has been subjected to any disciplinary
   action may file an appeal.  The action on appeal shall be filed with the Circuit Court of the county in which
   the violation occurred in accordance with KRS Chapter 13B.  The commencement of proceedings under this section shall not operate as a stay on
   the board's order, unless specifically ordered otherwise by the court.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 320. Optometrists›KY REV ST 320.350. Places where optometry not to be practiced
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 320. Optometrists › KY REV ST 320.350. Places where optometry not to be practiced
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 320.350. Places where optometry not to be practiced (2023)
content:
No person shall practice optometry on premises not separate from premises whereon
   eyeglasses, lenses, eyeglass frames or any other merchandise or products are sold
   by any other person.  For the purposes of this section, any room or suite of rooms in which optometry
   is practiced shall be considered separate premises if it has a separate and direct
   entrance from a street or public hallway or corridor within a building, which corridor
   is partitioned off by partitions from floor to ceiling.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 320. Optometrists›KY REV ST 320.321. Grievances; disciplinary proceedings
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 320. Optometrists › KY REV ST 320.321. Grievances; disciplinary proceedings
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 320.321. Grievances; disciplinary proceedings (2023)
content:
(1)  Grievances may be submitted by an individual, organization, or entity, including
      the board based upon information within the board's knowledge.  The board may investigate any licensee or unlicensed individual or entity engaged
      in the practice of optometry suspected of conduct which would be grounds for disciplinary
      or court action and may hire or appoint persons who are knowledgeable in the practice
      of optometry to investigate on its behalf.  The board shall have the power to issue investigatory subpoenas for the appearance
      before the board of any person within the jurisdiction of the Commonwealth of Kentucky
      and to require production of any record, document, or other item.  The board may seek enforcement of investigatory subpoenas in the courts of the Commonwealth
      as may be necessary.  A copy of the grievance shall be mailed to the licensee or unlicensed individual
      or entity engaged in the practice of optometry at the last address that the board
      has on record or has been able to determine.  If the licensee or unlicensed individual or entity engaged in the practice of optometry
      chooses to respond to the grievance, he or she shall submit a response within ten
      (10) days after the date on which the grievance was mailed.

      may order the optometrist to undergo a physical or mental examination by persons designated
      by the board, at the expense of the optometrist.

   per violation.

content:
(1)  Except as provided inKRS 321.235,321.351, and321.353, the board, before suspending, revoking, imposing probationary or supervisory conditions
      upon, imposing an administrative fine, or any combination of actions regarding any
      license, certificate, permit, or registration, or regarding any veterinarian manager,
      AAHP manager, registered responsible party, or designated on-site manager under the
      provisions of this chapter, shall set the matter for hearing in accordance with KRS
      Chapter 13B.  After denying an application under the provisions of this chapter, or issuing a
      written reprimand, the board shall grant a hearing in accordance with KRS Chapter
      13B to the denied applicant only upon written request of the applicant made within
      thirty (30) days of the date of the letter advising of the denial or the reprimand.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 322. Professional Engineers and Land Surveyors›Engineers and Surveyors›KY REV ST 322.360. Public work required to be done under professional engineer or licensed architect

content:
(1)  Neither the state nor any of its political subdivisions shall engage in the construction
      of any public work involving engineering, unless the plans, specifications, and estimates
      have been prepared and the construction executed under the direct supervision of a
      professional engineer or a licensed architect.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 322. Professional Engineers and Land Surveyors›Engineers and Surveyors›KY REV ST 322.320. Board may require attendance of witnesses, production of documents
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 322. Professional Engineers and Land Surveyors › Engineers and Surveyors › KY REV ST 322.320. Board may require attendance of witnesses, production of documents
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 322.320. Board may require attendance of witnesses, production of documents (2023)
content:
(1)  In carrying this chapter into effect, the board, under the hand of its chairman
      or executive director and under its seal, may, during the investigation or an administrative
      hearing procedure, in cases involving the revocation of a license or practicing or
      offering to practice without a license, subpoena witnesses and compel their attendance
      and require the production of books, papers, and documents.  Any member may administer oaths to witnesses appearing before the board.

content:

   the executive director of the board a written complaint alleging violation of any
   provision of this chapter.  The executive director shall cause the complaint to be investigated.

title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 322. Professional Engineers and Land Surveyors › Engineers and Surveyors › KY REV ST 322.370. Incidental architectural practice permitted
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 322.370. Incidental architectural practice permitted (2023)
content:
This chapter shall not prevent a professional engineer from carrying on any architectural
   practice incident to the practice of engineering.

content:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 322. Professional Engineers and Land Surveyors›Engineers and Surveyors›KY REV ST 322.270. Compensation of board members
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 322. Professional Engineers and Land Surveyors › Engineers and Surveyors › KY REV ST 322.270. Compensation of board members
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 322.270. Compensation of board members (2023)
content:
Each member shall receive compensation as promulgated by administrative regulation
   of the board and approved by the appropriate legislative body.  Official duties include meetings of committees of the board and time spent in necessary
   travel.  Further, members shall be reimbursed for costs for all actual and necessary expenses
   incurred in carrying out their official duties as board members.

content: (1)  Each appointed member of the board shall:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 322. Professional Engineers and Land Surveyors›Engineers and Surveyors›KY REV ST 322.260. Officers of board
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 322. Professional Engineers and Land Surveyors › Engineers and Surveyors › KY REV ST 322.260. Officers of board
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 322.260. Officers of board (2023)
content: Every year the board shall elect a chair, a vice chair, and a secretary-treasurer.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 322. Professional Engineers and Land Surveyors›Engineers and Surveyors›KY REV ST 322.340. Licensee to obtain seal or stamp; use of seal or stamp
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 322. Professional Engineers and Land Surveyors › Engineers and Surveyors › KY REV ST 322.340. Licensee to obtain seal or stamp; use of seal or stamp
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 322.340. Licensee to obtain seal or stamp; use of seal or stamp (2023)
content:
(1)  Each professional engineer or professional land surveyor shall, upon licensure,
      obtain a seal or stamp of the design authorized by the board, bearing his or her name,
      license number, and the words “Licensed Professional Engineer” or “Licensed Professional
      Land Surveyor.”

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 322. Professional Engineers and Land Surveyors›Engineers and Surveyors›KY REV ST 322.280. Meetings of board
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 322. Professional Engineers and Land Surveyors › Engineers and Surveyors › KY REV ST 322.280. Meetings of board
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 322.280. Meetings of board (2023)
content: (1)  The board shall hold at least four (4) regular meetings each year.  Special meetings shall be held if the bylaws provide.  Notice of all meetings shall be given in the manner provided by the bylaws.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 322. Professional Engineers and Land Surveyors›Engineers and Surveyors›KY REV ST 322.300. Board to keep record of proceedings and register of applications

citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 322.300. Board to keep record of proceedings and register of applications (2023)
content:
The board shall keep a record of its proceedings and a register of all applications
   for licensure.  The register shall state the following:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 322A. Professional Geologists›KY REV ST 322A.020. Board of Registration for Professional Geologists; membership; removal and filling of vacancies; officers; compensation of members
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 322A. Professional Geologists › KY REV ST 322A.020. Board of Registration for Professional Geologists; membership; removal and filling of vacancies; officers; compensation of members
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 322A.020. Board of Registration for Professional Geologists; membership; removal and filling of vacancies; officers; compensation of members (2023)
content:
(1)  There is created and established the Board of Registration for Professional Geologists,
      which shall administer the provisions of this chapter.  All board members shall be residents of Kentucky and be appointed by the Governor.  The board shall consist of five (5) members, including four (4) registered geologists,
      one (1) of whom shall be the state geologist or his or her designee, and one (1) member
      representing the public at large.  Except for the state geologist or his or her designee, the term of the members of
      the board shall always be for four (4) years and until their successors are appointed
      and qualified.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 322A. Professional Geologists›KY REV ST 322A.030. Board; meetings; duties and powers; order and appeals; roster of registered professional geologists; code of professional conduct
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 322A. Professional Geologists › KY REV ST 322A.030. Board; meetings; duties and powers; order and appeals; roster of registered professional geologists; code of professional conduct
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 322A.030. Board; meetings; duties and powers; order and appeals; roster of registered professional geologists; code of professional conduct (2023)
content:
(1)  The board shall meet at least once each calendar year and at other times deemed
      necessary by the chair or a quorum of the board upon being given ten (10) days' notice.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 322. Professional Engineers and Land Surveyors›Land Surveyors›KY REV ST 322.400. Plats or surveys not to be recorded unless certified by a professional land surveyor
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 322. Professional Engineers and Land Surveyors › Land Surveyors › KY REV ST 322.400. Plats or surveys not to be recorded unless certified by a professional land surveyor
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 322.400. Plats or surveys not to be recorded unless certified by a professional land surveyor (2023)
content:
No county clerk of any county, or any other public authority, shall accept for filing,
   file, or record any map, plat, survey, or other document related to the practice of
   land surveying, unless it evidences certification by a professional land surveyor
   by whom, or under whose personal supervision and direction, the map, plat, survey,
   or other document was prepared.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 322. Professional Engineers and Land Surveyors›Engineers and Surveyors›KY REV ST 322.330. Duties of secretary-treasurer
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 322. Professional Engineers and Land Surveyors › Engineers and Surveyors › KY REV ST 322.330. Duties of secretary-treasurer
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 322.330. Duties of secretary-treasurer (2023)
content:
The secretary-treasurer, or any other officer or designee properly authorized by the
   board, shall:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 322. Professional Engineers and Land Surveyors›Engineers and Surveyors›KY REV ST 322.380. Seeking business through another to avoid chapter prohibited
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 322. Professional Engineers and Land Surveyors › Engineers and Surveyors › KY REV ST 322.380. Seeking business through another to avoid chapter prohibited
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 322.380. Seeking business through another to avoid chapter prohibited (2023)
content:
(1)  No person without a license under this chapter shall avoid or attempt to avoid
      this chapter by having a representative or employee seek engineering or land surveying
      work in his or her behalf.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 322. Professional Engineers and Land Surveyors›Land Surveyors›KY REV ST 322.450. Persons exempt from law
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 322. Professional Engineers and Land Surveyors › Land Surveyors › KY REV ST 322.450. Persons exempt from law
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 322.450. Persons exempt from law (2023)
content:
The provisions of this chapter relating to the necessity of licensure to engage in
   the practice of land surveying shall not apply to any employee or employees of the
   Kentucky Transportation Cabinet, or any other subdivision of the government of the
   Commonwealth of Kentucky, working under the direct supervision and control of a professional
   engineer or professional land surveyor.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 322A. Professional Geologists›KY REV ST 322A.050. Application fees; disposition; surety bond
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 322A. Professional Geologists › KY REV ST 322A.050. Application fees; disposition; surety bond
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 322A.050. Application fees; disposition; surety bond (2023)
content:
An applicant for registration shall pay a nonrefundable fee established by regulation
   of the board.  If the board declines to issue registration to any applicant, the initial fee paid
   by the applicant shall be retained as an application fee.  All fees paid to and collected by the board under the provisions of this section
   andKRS 322A.070shall be deposited in a revolving trust and agency account under the jurisdiction
   of the board.  The officers or employees of the board who shall be designated to collect and disburse
   funds represented by these fees shall be required to execute a bond, with corporate
   surety, in an amount to be determined by the board.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 322. Professional Engineers and Land Surveyors›Services of Engineer or Architect›KY REV ST 322.560. Maximum voltage for licensed electrical engineer
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 322. Professional Engineers and Land Surveyors › Services of Engineer or Architect › KY REV ST 322.560. Maximum voltage for licensed electrical engineer
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 322.560. Maximum voltage for licensed electrical engineer (2023)
content:
Notwithstanding Article 555.4 of the National Electrical Code or any other provision
   of law, the maximum voltage of one thousand (1,000) volts for yard and pier distribution
   systems may be exceeded when engineered by an electrical engineer licensed under this
   chapter.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 322. Professional Engineers and Land Surveyors›Services of Engineer or Architect›KY REV ST 322.550. citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 322.550. Buildings or additions to existing buildings requiring services of an architect or of either a professional engineer or an architect (2023)
content:
(1)  Except as otherwise provided in this section, the following buildings, or additions
      to existing buildings, classified by use group shall require the services of an architect
      licensed in the Commonwealth of Kentucky:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 322. Professional Engineers and Land Surveyors›Land Surveyors›KY REV ST 322.420. Disposition of fees paid to the board
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 322. Professional Engineers and Land Surveyors › Land Surveyors › KY REV ST 322.420. Disposition of fees paid to the board
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 322.420. Disposition of fees paid to the board (2023)
content:
All fees paid to and collected by the board under this chapter shall be deposited
   in a depository designated by the board and disbursed only at the direction of the
   board.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 322. Professional Engineers and Land Surveyors›Land Surveyors›KY REV ST 322.460. Officers to enforce law; employment of attorneys
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 322. Professional Engineers and Land Surveyors › Land Surveyors › KY REV ST 322.460. Officers to enforce law; employment of attorneys
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 322.460. Officers to enforce law; employment of attorneys (2023)
content:
The Attorney General of Kentucky or his or her designee shall act as legal adviser
   to the board and render legal assistance as the board may from time to time require.  In addition, the Attorney General of Kentucky, all Commonwealth's attorneys, and
   the county attorney of each county shall, upon request of the board, and without additional
   compensation, lend their assistance to the enforcement of the provisions of this chapter
   and the prosecution of any violations thereof.  The board shall employ additional counsel as necessary to effectively enforce the
   provisions of this chapter, the cost of which shall be paid exclusively from funds
   of the board.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 322A. Professional Geologists›KY REV ST 322A.090. Prohibitions relating to practice of geology by person who is not a registered geologist
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 322A. Professional Geologists › KY REV ST 322A.090. Prohibitions relating to practice of geology by person who is not a registered geologist
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 322A.090. Prohibitions relating to practice of geology by person who is not a registered geologist (2023)
content:
(1)  With the exception of persons exempted underKRS 322A.080, it shall be unlawful for any person other than a registered geologist or a subordinate
      under the direction of a registered geologist to prepare any geologic reports or documents
      that are required by statute or administrative regulation.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 322. Professional Engineers and Land Surveyors›Land Surveyors›KY REV ST 322.470. Right of entry on land of others by land surveyor; notification of landowner; liability of landowner
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 322. Professional Engineers and Land Surveyors › Land Surveyors › KY REV ST 322.470. Right of entry on land of others by land surveyor; notification of landowner; liability of landowner
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 322.470. Right of entry on land of others by land surveyor; notification of landowner; liability of landowner (2023)
content:
As used in this section, “professional land surveyor” shall include the agents, the
   employees, and any personnel under the supervision of a professional land surveyor.

title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 322A. Professional Geologists › KY REV ST 322A.990. Penalties

content: Any person who commits any of the following acts shall be guilty of a Class B misdemeanor:

content:
The board may suspend any registrant, refuse to renew or revoke the certificate of
   any registrant, reprimand any registrant, place any registrant on probation, or impose
   an administrative fine of up to one thousand dollars ($1,000) per violation when the
   registrant is found guilty by the board of:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 322. Professional Engineers and Land Surveyors›Penalties›KY REV ST 322.990. Penalties
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 322. Professional Engineers and Land Surveyors › Penalties › KY REV ST 322.990. Penalties
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 322.990. Penalties (2023)
content:
Any person who violates any provision of this chapter shall be fined not less than
   one hundred dollars ($100) nor more than one thousand dollars ($1,000), or be imprisoned
   not more than three (3) months, or both.

content:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 322A. Professional Geologists›KY REV ST 322A.070. Certificates of registration; use of seal or stamp by registrant
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 322A. Professional Geologists › KY REV ST 322A.070. Certificates of registration; use of seal or stamp by registrant
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 322A.070. Certificates of registration; use of seal or stamp by registrant (2023)
content:
(1)  The board shall issue a certificate of registration, upon payment of the registration
      fee, to any applicant who, in the opinion of the board, has satisfactorily met all
      the requirements for registration underKRS 322A.040.  Certificates of registration shall show the full name of the board.  The issuance of a certificate of registration by the board shall be prima facie
      evidence that the person named thereon is entitled to all the rights and privileges
      of a registered geologist while the certificate of registration remains in force.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 322A. Professional Geologists›KY REV ST 322A.045. Qualifications for geologist-in-training
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 322A. Professional Geologists › KY REV ST 322A.045. Qualifications for geologist-in-training

content:
The applicant for certification as a geologist-in-training shall demonstrate the following

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 322A. Professional Geologists›KY REV ST 322A.060. Renewal of certificates; suspension and revocation for nonpayment of renewal fees
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 322A. Professional Geologists › KY REV ST 322A.060. Renewal of certificates; suspension and revocation for nonpayment of renewal fees
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 322A.060. Renewal of certificates; suspension and revocation for nonpayment of renewal fees (2023)
content:
(1)  All certificates of registration shall expire biennially at a time and date designated
      by the board.  The board shall notify every person registered under this chapter of the date of
      expiration of his or her certificate and the amount of the renewal fee which shall
      be fixed by the board.

title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 323. Architects › KY REV ST 323.100. Form of license certificate
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 323.100. Form of license certificate (2023)
content:
A license certificate shall be signed by the president and the secretary of the board
   and bear its seal.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 323. Architects›KY REV ST 323.033. Buildings requiring services of licensed architect; exemptions
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 323. Architects › KY REV ST 323.033. Buildings requiring services of licensed architect; exemptions

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 323. Architects›KY REV ST 323.050. Qualifications for license; examinations
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 323. Architects › KY REV ST 323.050. Qualifications for license; examinations
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 323.050. Qualifications for license; examinations (2023)
content:
(1)  Except as otherwise provided in this chapter, an applicant seeking to obtain
      a license to practice architecture in Kentucky shall satisfactorily pass the examination
      that is prescribed by the board.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 323. Architects›KY REV ST 323.090. Reexamination
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 323. Architects › KY REV ST 323.090. Reexamination
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 323.090. Reexamination (2023)
content:
Any applicant who fails a section of the examination may retake that section if at
   least six (6) months has elapsed since the applicant took the examination in which
   he or she failed the section and upon registering with the testing service and paying
   the testing service's required fee.  An applicant shall take the examination within three (3) years of the date the applicant
   receives the board's approval to begin the examination process.  During this three (3) year period, the applicant shall be excused from paying to
   the board any additional fees for processing the application for the examination.  An applicant who does not take the examination within the applicable three (3) year
   period shall reapply with the board.  All examination fees shall be paid to the testing service.

content:
(1)  The board shall promulgate administrative regulations that establish fees for

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 323. Architects›KY REV ST 323.020. License required
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 323. Architects › KY REV ST 323.020. License required
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 323.020. License required (2023)
content:
Except as otherwise provided hereinafter, no person shall practice architecture in
   the Commonwealth of Kentucky without first obtaining a license under the provisions
   of this chapter, it being the purpose of this chapter to safeguard the life, health,
   property and welfare of the public.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 323. Architects›KY REV ST 323.095. Seal required; use
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 323. Architects › KY REV ST 323.095. Seal required; use
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 323.095. Seal required; use (2023)
content:
(1)  Each architect licensed for practice within the Commonwealth shall obtain a seal
      of the design prescribed in administrative regulations promulgated by the board.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 323. Architects›KY REV ST 323.060. Persons who may be licensed without examination
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 323. Architects › KY REV ST 323.060. Persons who may be licensed without examination
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 323.060. Persons who may be licensed without examination (2023)
content:
Any person who is a licensed architect in another state or country where the qualifications
   prescribed at the time of licensing were, in the opinion of the board, equal to those
   prescribed in the Commonwealth at the date of application, and where reciprocal licensing
   privileges satisfactory to the board are granted to licensees of the Commonwealth,
   may be granted a license without an examination.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 323. Architects›KY REV ST 323.130. Hearing in disciplinary action; appeal
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 323. Architects › KY REV ST 323.130. Hearing in disciplinary action; appeal
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 323.130. Hearing in disciplinary action; appeal (2023)

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 323. Architects›KY REV ST 323.150. Membership of board
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 323. Architects › KY REV ST 323.150. Membership of board
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 323.150. Membership of board (2023)
content:
The board shall consist of eight (8) members, seven (7) of whom shall be appointed
   by the Governor.  The eighth member of the board shall be the chief executive officer of any NAAB
   accredited architectural curriculum established in the Commonwealth of Kentucky, who
   shall be an ex officio member with voting rights.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 323. Architects›KY REV ST 323.160. Board members; appointment; terms
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions › Chapter 323. Architects › KY REV ST 323.160. Board members; appointment; terms
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 323.160. Board members; appointment; terms (2023)
content:
The Governor shall appoint one (1) member of the board each year.  Each member shall serve for a term of four (4) years, and until his successor is
   appointed and qualified.

citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 323.110. Renewal certificate; automatic revocation; voluntary surrender of license (2023)
content:
(1)  (a) All architects desiring to continue practice shall secure from the board
         a renewal certificate at the expiration of their licenses, upon the payment of the
         prescribed fee.  The board shall promulgate administrative regulations establishing the terms of
         the licenses, and may renew licenses on an annual or biannual basis.  The board may stagger the terms of the licenses, if needed, and may double the annual
         renewal fee as established pursuant toKRS 323.080for any license issued for a two (2) year period.  Not later than June 15 of each year the board shall notify by mail all architects
         of the renewal date and fee.  Application for a renewal shall be upon a form prescribed by the board and the architect
         shall furnish the information required by the form.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXVI. Occupations and Professions›Chapter 323. Architects›KY REV ST 323.120. Grounds for denial, revocation, or suspension; civil penalty

content:
