path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Uniform Partnership Act›KY REV ST 362.310. General effect of dissolution on authority of partner
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Uniform Partnership Act › KY REV ST 362.310. General effect of dissolution on authority of partner
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.310. General effect of dissolution on authority of partner (2023)
content:
Except so far as may be necessary to wind up partnership affairs or to complete transactions
   begun but not then finished, dissolution terminates all authority of any partner to
   act for the partnership,

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Uniform Partnership Act›KY REV ST 362.335. Rights of partners to application of partnership property
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Uniform Partnership Act › KY REV ST 362.335. Rights of partners to application of partnership property
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.335. Rights of partners to application of partnership property (2023)
content:
(1)  When dissolution is caused in any way, except in contravention of the partnership
      agreement, each partner as against his co-partners and all persons claiming through
      them in respect of their interest in the partnership, unless otherwise agreed, may
      have the partnership property applied to discharge its liabilities, and the surplus
      applied to pay in cash the net amount owing to the respective partners.  But if dissolution is caused by expulsion of a partner, bona fide under the partnership
      agreement and if the expelled partner is discharged from all partnership liabilities,
      either by payment or agreement under subsection (2) ofKRS 362.325, he shall receive in cash only the net amount due him from the partnership.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Uniform Partnership Act›KY REV ST 362.325. Effect of dissolution on partner's existing liability
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Uniform Partnership Act › KY REV ST 362.325. Effect of dissolution on partner's existing liability
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.325. Effect of dissolution on partner's existing liability (2023)
content:
(1)  The dissolution of the partnership shall not of itself discharge the existing
      liability of any partner.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Uniform Partnership Act›KY REV ST 362.315. Right of partner to contribution from co-partners after dissolution
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Uniform Partnership Act › KY REV ST 362.315. Right of partner to contribution from co-partners after dissolution
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.315. Right of partner to contribution from co-partners after dissolution (2023)
content:
Where the dissolution is caused by the act, death or bankruptcy of a partner, each
   partner is liable to his co-partners for his share of any liability created by any
   partner acting for the partnership as if the partnership had not been dissolved unless:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Uniform Partnership Act›KY REV ST 362.350. Liability of persons continuing the business in certain cases
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Uniform Partnership Act › KY REV ST 362.350. Liability of persons continuing the business in certain cases
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.350. Liability of persons continuing the business in certain cases (2023)
content:
(1)  When any new partner is admitted into an existing partnership, or when any partner
      retires and assigns (or the representative of the deceased partner assigns) his rights
      in partnership property to two (2) or more of the partners, or to one (1) or more
      of the partners and one (1) or more third persons, if the business is continued without
      liquidation of the partnership affairs, creditors of the first or dissolved partnership
      are also creditors of the partnership so continuing the business.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Uniform Partnership Act›KY REV ST 362.330. Right to wind up
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Uniform Partnership Act › KY REV ST 362.330. Right to wind up
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.330. Right to wind up (2023)
content:
Unless otherwise agreed the partners who have not wrongfully dissolved the partnership
   or the legal representative of the last surviving partner, not bankrupt, has the right
   to wind up the partnership affairs;  provided, however, that any partner, his legal
   representative or his assignee, upon cause shown, may obtain winding up by the court.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Uniform Partnership Act›KY REV ST 362.345. Rules for distribution
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Uniform Partnership Act › KY REV ST 362.345. Rules for distribution
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.345. Rules for distribution (2023)
content:
In settling accounts between the partners after dissolution, the following rules shall
   be observed, subject to any agreement to the contrary:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Uniform Partnership Act›KY REV ST 362.340. Rights where partnership is dissolved for fraud or misrepresentation
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Uniform Partnership Act › KY REV ST 362.340. Rights where partnership is dissolved for fraud or misrepresentation
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.340. Rights where partnership is dissolved for fraud or misrepresentation (2023)
content:
Where a partnership contract is rescinded on the ground of the fraud or misrepresentation
   of one (1) of the parties thereto, the party entitled to rescind is, without prejudice
   to any other right, entitled:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Uniform Partnership Act›KY REV ST 362.355. Rights of retiring or estate of deceased partner when the business is continued
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Uniform Partnership Act › KY REV ST 362.355. Rights of retiring or estate of deceased partner when the business is continued
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.355. Rights of retiring or estate of deceased partner when the business is continued (2023)
content:
When any partner retires or dies, and the business is continued under any of the conditions
   set forth in subsections (1), (2), (3), (5), and (6) ofKRS 362.350or paragraph (b) of subsection (2) ofKRS 362.335, without any settlement of accounts as between him or his estate and the person or
   partnership continuing the business, unless otherwise agreed, he or his legal representative
   as against such persons or partnership may have the value of his interest at the date
   of dissolution ascertained, and shall receive as an ordinary creditor an amount equal
   to the value of his interest in the dissolved partnership with interest, or, at his
   option or at the option of his legal representative, in lieu of interest, the profits
   attributable to the use of his right in the property of the dissolved partnership;
   provided that the creditors of the dissolved partnership as against the separate creditors,
   or the representative of the retired or deceased partner, shall have priority on any
   claim arising under this section, as provided by subsection (8) ofKRS 362.350.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Uniform Partnership Act›KY REV ST 362.360. Accrual of actions
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Uniform Partnership Act › KY REV ST 362.360. Accrual of actions
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.360. Accrual of actions (2023)
content:
The right to an account of his interest shall accrue to any partner, or his legal
   representative, as against the winding up partners or the surviving partners or the
   person or partnership continuing the business, at the date of dissolution in the absence
   of any agreement to the contrary.

title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Uniform Limited Partnership Act › KY REV ST 362.401. Definitions

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Uniform Limited Partnership Act›KY REV ST 362.411. Nature of business that may be carried on
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Uniform Limited Partnership Act › KY REV ST 362.411. Nature of business that may be carried on
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.411. Nature of business that may be carried on (2023)
content:
A limited partnership may carry on any business that a partnership without limited
   partners may carry on.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Uniform Limited Partnership Act›KY REV ST 362.403. Name of limited partnership
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Uniform Limited Partnership Act › KY REV ST 362.403. Name of limited partnership
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.403. Name of limited partnership (2023)
content: The name of each limited partnership shall satisfy the requirements ofKRS 14A.3-010.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Uniform Limited Partnership Act›KY REV ST 362.415. Formation; certificate of limited partnership
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Uniform Limited Partnership Act › KY REV ST 362.415. Formation; certificate of limited partnership

content:
(1)  In order to form a limited partnership, a certificate of limited partnership

      set forth:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Uniform Limited Partnership Act›KY REV ST 362.419. Cancellation of certificate
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Uniform Limited Partnership Act › KY REV ST 362.419. Cancellation of certificate

A certificate of limited partnership shall be canceled upon the dissolution and the
   completion of winding up of the partnership or at any other time there are no limited
   partners.  A certificate of cancellation shall be in the form prescribed by the Secretary of
   State and shall be filed with the Secretary of State and shall set forth:

title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Uniform Limited Partnership Act › KY REV ST 362.407. Recordkeeping office; agent for service of process

content: Each limited partnership shall continuously maintain in this Commonwealth:

title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Uniform Limited Partnership Act › KY REV ST 362.417. Amendment to or restatement of certificate
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.417. Amendment to or restatement of certificate (2023)
content:
(1)  A certificate of limited partnership may be amended by filing a certificate of
      amendment that satisfies the requirements ofKRS 14A.2-010to14A.2-150with the Secretary of State.  The certificate of amendment shall be in the form prescribed by the Secretary of
      State and shall set forth:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Uniform Limited Partnership Act›KY REV ST 362.413. Business transactions of partners with partnership
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Uniform Limited Partnership Act › KY REV ST 362.413. Business transactions of partners with partnership
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.413. Business transactions of partners with partnership (2023)
content:
Except as provided in the partnership agreement, a partner may lend money to, and
   transact other business with, the limited partnership and, subject to other applicable
   law, shall have the same rights and obligations with respect thereto as a person who
   is not a partner.

title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Uniform Limited Partnership Act › KY REV ST 362.409. Records to be kept

content: (1)  Each limited partnership shall keep, at the office referred to inKRS 362.407(2), the following records:

title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Uniform Limited Partnership Act › KY REV ST 362.421. Execution of certificates
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.421. Execution of certificates (2023)
content: (1)  Each certificate required byKRS 362.403to362.525to be filed with the Secretary of State shall be executed in the following manner:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Uniform Limited Partnership Act›KY REV ST 362.423. Execution of certificate by judicial act
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Uniform Limited Partnership Act › KY REV ST 362.423. Execution of certificate by judicial act
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.423. Execution of certificate by judicial act (2023)
content:
If a person required byKRS 362.421to execute a certificate of limited partnership, certificate of amendment or certificate
   of cancellation fails or refuses to do so, any other person who is adversely affected
   by the failure or refusal may petition the Circuit Court to direct the execution of
   the certificate.  If the court finds that it is proper for the certificate to be executed and that
   any person so designated has failed or refused to execute the certificate, the court
   shall order the Secretary of State to record an appropriate certificate.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Uniform Limited Partnership Act›KY REV ST 362.429. Scope of notice
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Uniform Limited Partnership Act › KY REV ST 362.429. Scope of notice
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.429. Scope of notice (2023)
content:
The fact that a certificate of limited partnership is on file with the Secretary of
   State shall constitute notice that the partnership is a limited partnership and the
   persons designated therein as general partners are general partners, but shall not
   constitute notice of any other fact.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Uniform Limited Partnership Act›KY REV ST 362.431. Delivery of certificate to limited partners
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Uniform Limited Partnership Act › KY REV ST 362.431. Delivery of certificate to limited partners
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.431. Delivery of certificate to limited partners (2023)
content:
Upon the return by the Secretary of State pursuant toKRS 14A.2-100(3)of a certificate, the general partners shall deliver or mail a copy of the certificate
   of limited partnership and each certificate of amendment or certificate of cancellation
   to each limited partner unless the partnership agreement provides otherwise.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Uniform Limited Partnership Act›KY REV ST 362.427. Liability for false statement in certificate
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Uniform Limited Partnership Act › KY REV ST 362.427. Liability for false statement in certificate
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.427. Liability for false statement in certificate (2023)
content:
If a certificate of limited partnership, certificate of amendment or certificate of
   cancellation contains a false statement, a person who suffers loss by reliance on
   that statement may recover damages for the loss from:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Uniform Limited Partnership Act›KY REV ST 362.437. Liability of limited partners to third parties
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Uniform Limited Partnership Act › KY REV ST 362.437. Liability of limited partners to third parties
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.437. Liability of limited partners to third parties (2023)
content:
(1)  Except as provided in subsection (4) of this section, a limited partner shall
      not be liable for the obligations of a limited partnership unless he is also a general
      partner or, in addition to the exercise of his rights and powers as a limited partner,
      he participates in the control of the business.  However, if the limited partner participates in the control of the business, he
      shall be liable only to persons who transact business with the limited partnership
      reasonably believing, based upon the limited partner's conduct, that the limited partner
      is a general partner.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Uniform Limited Partnership Act›KY REV ST 362.435. Voting rights of limited partners
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Uniform Limited Partnership Act › KY REV ST 362.435. Voting rights of limited partners
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.435. Voting rights of limited partners (2023)
content:
Subject toKRS 362.437, the partnership agreement may grant to all or a specified group of the limited partners
   the right to vote, with or without the concurrence of the general partners, on a per
   capita or any other basis on any matter and may make any appropriate provision for
   the exercise of such voting right.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Uniform Limited Partnership Act›KY REV ST 362.439. Liability of person erroneously believing to be a limited partner
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Uniform Limited Partnership Act › KY REV ST 362.439. Liability of person erroneously believing to be a limited partner
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.439. Liability of person erroneously believing to be a limited partner (2023)
content:
(1)  Except as provided in subsection (2) of this section, a person who makes a contribution
      to a business enterprise and erroneously, but in good faith, believes that he has
      become a limited partner in the enterprise shall not be a general partner in the enterprise
      and shall not be bound by its obligations by reason of making the contribution, receiving
      distributions from the enterprise, or exercising any rights of a limited partner,
      if, within a reasonable time after ascertaining the mistake he:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Uniform Limited Partnership Act›KY REV ST 362.441. Limited partner's right to information
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Uniform Limited Partnership Act › KY REV ST 362.441. Limited partner's right to information
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.441. Limited partner's right to information (2023)
content: Each limited partner may:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Uniform Limited Partnership Act›KY REV ST 362.433. Admission of limited partners
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Uniform Limited Partnership Act › KY REV ST 362.433. Admission of limited partners
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.433. Admission of limited partners (2023)
content: (1)  A person shall become a limited partner on the later of:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Uniform Limited Partnership Act›KY REV ST 362.447. General power and liabilities of general partners
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Uniform Limited Partnership Act › KY REV ST 362.447. General power and liabilities of general partners
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.447. General power and liabilities of general partners (2023)
content:
(1)  Except as provided inKRS 362.403to362.525or in the partnership agreement, a general partner of a limited partnership shall
      have all of the rights and powers, and is subject to all of the restrictions, of a
      partner in a partnership without limited partners.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Uniform Limited Partnership Act›KY REV ST 362.451. Voting rights of general partners
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Uniform Limited Partnership Act › KY REV ST 362.451. Voting rights of general partners
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.451. Voting rights of general partners (2023)
content:
The partnership agreement may grant to all, or certain identified general partners
   or a specified class or group of the general partners, the right to vote on a per
   capita or any other basis, separately or with all or any class or group of the limited
   partners or the general partners, on any matter and may make appropriate provision
   for the exercise of such voting rights.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Uniform Limited Partnership Act›KY REV ST 362.445. Events of withdrawal of general partner
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Uniform Limited Partnership Act › KY REV ST 362.445. Events of withdrawal of general partner
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.445. Events of withdrawal of general partner (2023)
content:
Except as approved by the specific written consent of all partners at the time, a
   person shall cease to be a general partner of a limited partnership upon the happening
   of any of the following events:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Uniform Limited Partnership Act›KY REV ST 362.443. Admission of additional general partners
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Uniform Limited Partnership Act › KY REV ST 362.443. Admission of additional general partners
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.443. Admission of additional general partners (2023)
content:
After the filing of a limited partnership's original certificate of limited partnership,
   additional general partners may be admitted as provided in writing in the partnership
   agreement or, if the partnership agreement does not provide in writing for the admission
   of additional general partners, with the written consent of all partners.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Uniform Limited Partnership Act›KY REV ST 362.449. Contributions by general partner
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Uniform Limited Partnership Act › KY REV ST 362.449. Contributions by general partner
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.449. Contributions by general partner (2023)
content:
A general partner of a limited partnership may make contributions to the limited partnership
   and share in the profits and losses of, and in distributions from, the limited partnership
   as a general partner.  A general partner also may make contributions to the limited partnership, and share
   in the profits and losses of, and distributions from, the limited partnership, as
   a limited partner.  A person who is both a general partner and a limited partner shall have all of the
   rights and powers, and shall be subject to all of the restrictions and liabilities
   of a general partner, and, except as provided in the partnership agreement, also shall
   have all of the powers, and shall be subject to all of the restrictions, of a limited
   partner to the extent of his participation in the partnership as a limited partner.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Uniform Limited Partnership Act›KY REV ST 362.459. Sharing of distributions
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Uniform Limited Partnership Act › KY REV ST 362.459. Sharing of distributions
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.459. Sharing of distributions (2023)
content:
Distributions of cash or other assets of a limited partnership shall be allocated
   among the partners, and among classes of partners, in the manner provided in writing
   in the partnership agreement.  If the partnership agreement does not so provide in writing, distributions shall
   be made on the basis of the value, as stated in the partnership records required to
   be kept pursuant toKRS 362.409, of the contributions made by each partner to the extent they have been received
   by the partnership and have not been returned.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Uniform Limited Partnership Act›KY REV ST 362.453. Form of contribution
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Uniform Limited Partnership Act › KY REV ST 362.453. Form of contribution
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.453. Form of contribution (2023)
content:
The contribution of a partner may be in cash, property, or services rendered, or a
   promissory note or other obligation to contribute cash or property or to perform services.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Uniform Limited Partnership Act›KY REV ST 362.455. Liability for contribution
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Uniform Limited Partnership Act › KY REV ST 362.455. Liability for contribution
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.455. Liability for contribution (2023)
content:
(1)  A promise by a limited partner to contribute to the limited partnership shall
      not be enforceable unless it is set out in a writing signed by or on behalf of, pursuant
      to a power of attorney which need not be of record, the limited partner.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Uniform Limited Partnership Act›KY REV ST 362.467. Distribution upon withdrawal
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Uniform Limited Partnership Act › KY REV ST 362.467. Distribution upon withdrawal
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.467. Distribution upon withdrawal (2023)
content:
Except as provided inKRS 362.473, upon withdrawal, a withdrawing partner shall receive any distribution to which he
   is entitled in writing under the partnership agreement.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Uniform Limited Partnership Act›KY REV ST 362.457. Sharing of profits and losses
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Uniform Limited Partnership Act › KY REV ST 362.457. Sharing of profits and losses
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.457. Sharing of profits and losses (2023)
content:
The profits and losses of a limited partnership shall be allocated among the partners,
   and among classes of partners, in the manner provided in writing in the partnership
   agreement.  If the partnership agreement does not so provide in writing, profits and losses
   shall be allocated on the basis of the value, as stated in the partnership records
   required to be kept pursuant toKRS 362.409, of the contributions made by each partner to the extent they have been received
   by the partnership and have not been returned.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Uniform Limited Partnership Act›KY REV ST 362.465. Withdrawal of limited partner
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Uniform Limited Partnership Act › KY REV ST 362.465. Withdrawal of limited partner
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.465. Withdrawal of limited partner (2023)
content:
Unless otherwise provided in a partnership agreement, a limited partner has no right
   to withdraw from a limited partnership.  If the partnership agreement does not specify a time a limited partner may withdraw,
   a limited partner may not withdraw prior to the time for the dissolution and winding
   up of the limited partnership without the unanimous consent of the partners.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Uniform Limited Partnership Act›KY REV ST 362.463. Withdrawal of general partner
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Uniform Limited Partnership Act › KY REV ST 362.463. Withdrawal of general partner
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.463. Withdrawal of general partner (2023)
content:
A general partner may withdraw from a limited partnership at any time by giving written
   notice to the other partners, but if the withdrawal violates the partnership agreement,
   the limited partnership may recover from the withdrawing general partner, in addition
   to any other remedies available to it, damages for breach of the partnership agreement
   and offset the damages against the amount otherwise distributable to him.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Uniform Limited Partnership Act›KY REV ST 362.469. Distribution in kind
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Uniform Limited Partnership Act › KY REV ST 362.469. Distribution in kind
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.469. Distribution in kind (2023)
content: Except as provided in writing in the partnership agreement:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Uniform Limited Partnership Act›KY REV ST 362.471. Right of distribution
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Uniform Limited Partnership Act › KY REV ST 362.471. Right of distribution
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.471. Right of distribution (2023)
content:
At the time a partner becomes entitled to receive a distribution, he shall have the
   status of, and be entitled to all remedies available to, a creditor of the limited
   partnership with respect to the distribution.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Uniform Limited Partnership Act›KY REV ST 362.491. Winding up
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Uniform Limited Partnership Act › KY REV ST 362.491. Winding up
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.491. Winding up (2023)
content:
Except as otherwise provided in the partnership agreement, the general partners who
   have not wrongfully dissolved a limited partnership or, if none, the limited partners,
   may wind up the limited partnership's affairs;  but the Circuit Court for the county
   in which the certificate of limited partnership is recorded, upon cause shown, may
   wind up the limited partnership affairs upon application of any partner, his legal
   representative or assignee.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Uniform Limited Partnership Act›KY REV ST 362.461. Interim distributions
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Uniform Limited Partnership Act › KY REV ST 362.461. Interim distributions
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.461. Interim distributions (2023)
content:
Except as provided inKRS 362.473, a partner shall be entitled to receive distributions from a limited partnership
   before his withdrawal from the limited partnership and before the dissolution and
   winding up thereof to the extent and at the times or upon the happening of the events
   specified in the partnership agreement.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Uniform Limited Partnership Act›KY REV ST 362.473. Limitation of distribution
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Uniform Limited Partnership Act › KY REV ST 362.473. Limitation of distribution
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.473. Limitation of distribution (2023)
content:
A partner shall not receive a distribution from a limited partnership to the extent
   that, after giving effect to the distribution, all liabilities of the limited partnership,
   other than liabilities to partners on account of their partnership interests, exceed
   the fair value of the partnership assets.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Uniform Limited Partnership Act›KY REV ST 362.475. Liability upon return of contributions
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Uniform Limited Partnership Act › KY REV ST 362.475. Liability upon return of contributions
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.475. Liability upon return of contributions (2023)
content:
(1)  (a) If a partner receives the return of any part of his contribution without
         violation of the partnership agreement orKRS 362.403to362.525, he shall be liable to the limited partnership for a period of one (1) year thereafter
         for the amount of the returned contribution, without interest, but only to the extent
         necessary to discharge the limited partnership's liabilities to creditors who extended
         credit to the limited partnership during the period the contribution was held by the
         limited partnership.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Uniform Limited Partnership Act›KY REV ST 362.485. Power of estate of deceased or incompetent partner
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Uniform Limited Partnership Act › KY REV ST 362.485. Power of estate of deceased or incompetent partner
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.485. Power of estate of deceased or incompetent partner (2023)
content:
If a partner who is an individual dies, or a court of competent jurisdiction adjudges
   a partner who is an individual to be incompetent to manage his person or his property,
   the partner's executor, administrator, guardian, conservator, or other legal representative
   may exercise all the partner's rights for the purpose of settling his estate or administering
   his property, including any power the partner had to give an assignee the right to
   become a limited partner.  If a partner is a corporation, partnership, trust, or other entity and is dissolved
   or terminated, the powers of that partner may be exercised by its legal representative
   or successor.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Uniform Limited Partnership Act›KY REV ST 362.477. Nature of partnership interest
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Uniform Limited Partnership Act › KY REV ST 362.477. Nature of partnership interest
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.477. Nature of partnership interest (2023)
content: A partnership interest shall be personal property.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Uniform Limited Partnership Act›KY REV ST 362.489. Judicial dissolution
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Uniform Limited Partnership Act › KY REV ST 362.489. Judicial dissolution
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.489. Judicial dissolution (2023)
content:
On application by or for a partner, the Circuit Court for the county in which the
   certificate of limited partnership is recorded may order dissolution of a limited
   partnership if it is not reasonably practicable to carry on the business in conformity
   with the partnership agreement.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Uniform Limited Partnership Act›KY REV ST 362.481. Rights of judgment creditor
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Uniform Limited Partnership Act › KY REV ST 362.481. Rights of judgment creditor
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.481. Rights of judgment creditor (2023)
content:
(1)  This section provides the exclusive remedy by which the judgment creditor of
      a partner or the transferee of a partner may satisfy a judgment out of the judgment
      debtor's transferable interest.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Uniform Limited Partnership Act›KY REV ST 362.487. Nonjudicial dissolution
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Uniform Limited Partnership Act › KY REV ST 362.487. Nonjudicial dissolution
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.487. Nonjudicial dissolution (2023)
content:
A limited partnership shall be dissolved, and its affairs shall be wound up, upon
   the happening of the first to occur of the following events:

title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Uniform Limited Partnership Act › KY REV ST 362.479. Assignment of partnership interest

content: Unless otherwise provided in the partnership agreement:

title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Uniform Limited Partnership Act › KY REV ST 362.483. Right of assignee to become limited partner
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.483. Right of assignee to become limited partner (2023)
content:
(1)  An assignee of a partnership interest, including an assignee of a general partner,
      may become a limited partner if and to the extent that:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Uniform Limited Partnership Act›KY REV ST 362.513. Derivative action: proper plaintiff
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Uniform Limited Partnership Act › KY REV ST 362.513. Derivative action: proper plaintiff
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.513. Derivative action: proper plaintiff (2023)
content:
In a derivative action, the plaintiff shall be a partner at the time of bringing the

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Uniform Limited Partnership Act›KY REV ST 362.511. Right of limited partner to bring derivative action
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Uniform Limited Partnership Act › KY REV ST 362.511. Right of limited partner to bring derivative action
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.511. Right of limited partner to bring derivative action (2023)
content:
A limited partner may bring an action in the right of a limited partnership to recover
   a judgment in its favor if general partners with authority to do so have refused to
   bring the action or if an effort to cause those general partners to bring the action
   is not likely to succeed.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Uniform Limited Partnership Act›KY REV ST 362.493. Distribution of assets
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Uniform Limited Partnership Act › KY REV ST 362.493. Distribution of assets
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.493. Distribution of assets (2023)
content: Upon the winding up of a limited partnership, the assets shall be distributed as follows:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Uniform Limited Partnership Act›KY REV ST 362.515. Derivative action: pleadings
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Uniform Limited Partnership Act › KY REV ST 362.515. Derivative action: pleadings
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.515. Derivative action: pleadings (2023)
content:
In a derivative action, the complaint shall set forth with particularity the effort
   of the plaintiff to secure initiation of the action by a general partner or the reasons
   for not making the effort.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Uniform Limited Partnership Act›KY REV ST 362.517. Derivative action: expenses
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Uniform Limited Partnership Act › KY REV ST 362.517. Derivative action: expenses
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.517. Derivative action: expenses (2023)
content:
If a derivative action is successful, in whole or in part, or if anything is received
   by the plaintiff as a result of a judgment, compromise, or settlement of any action
   or claim, the court may award the plaintiff reasonable expenses, including reasonable
   attorney's fees.  If anything is so received by the plaintiff, the court shall make the award of plaintiff's
   expenses payable out of those proceeds and shall direct plaintiff to remit to the
   limited partnership the remainder.  If those proceeds are insufficient to reimburse the plaintiff's reasonable expenses,
   the court may direct that any award of plaintiff's expenses, or a portion thereof,
   be paid by the limited partnership.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Uniform Limited Partnership Act›KY REV ST 362.521. Effect on existing partnerships
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Uniform Limited Partnership Act › KY REV ST 362.521. Effect on existing partnerships
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.521. Effect on existing partnerships (2023)
content:
(1)  A limited partnership formed under any statute of this state prior to the adoption
      ofKRS 362.403to362.525, until or unless it becomes a limited partnership underKRS 362.2-102to362.2-977, shall continue to be governed by the provisions of the statute under which it was
      formed.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Uniform Limited Partnership Act›KY REV ST 362.525. Effect of repeal of prior statute
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Uniform Limited Partnership Act › KY REV ST 362.525. Effect of repeal of prior statute
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.525. Effect of repeal of prior statute (2023)
content:
The repeal of any statutory provision by 1988 Acts Ch. 284, sec. 65, shall not impair,
   or otherwise affect, the organization or the continued existence of a limited partnership
   existing on July 15, 1988, nor does the repeal impair any contract or affect any right
   accrued before July 15, 1988.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Uniform Limited Partnership Act›KY REV ST 362.519. Construction and application of act
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Uniform Limited Partnership Act › KY REV ST 362.519. Construction and application of act
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.519. Construction and application of act (2023)
content:
KRS 362.403to362.525shall be applied and construed to effectuate its general purpose to make uniform
   the law with respect to the subject ofKRS 362.403to362.525among states enacting it.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Uniform Limited Partnership Act›KY REV ST 362.531. Merger of domestic limited partnerships with domestic or foreign limited partnerships, limited liability companies, or corporations
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Uniform Limited Partnership Act › KY REV ST 362.531. Merger of domestic limited partnerships with domestic or foreign limited partnerships, limited liability companies, or corporations
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.531. Merger of domestic limited partnerships with domestic or foreign limited partnerships, limited liability companies, or corporations (2023)
content:
(1)  One (1) or more domestic limited partnerships may merge pursuant to a written
      plan of merger described in subsection (2) of this section with one (1) or more domestic
      or foreign limited partnerships, limited liability companies, or corporations if:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Uniform Limited Partnership Act›KY REV ST 362.523. Applicability of Uniform Partnership Act
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Uniform Limited Partnership Act › KY REV ST 362.523. Applicability of Uniform Partnership Act
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.523. Applicability of Uniform Partnership Act (2023)
content: In any case not provided for inKRS 362.401to362.525, the provisions ofKRS 362.155to362.360and the rules of law and equity shall govern.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Uniform Limited Partnership Act›KY REV ST 362.527. Short title
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Uniform Limited Partnership Act › KY REV ST 362.527. Short title
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.527. Short title (2023)
content: KRS 362.401to362.525may be cited as the “Kentucky Revised Uniform Limited Partnership Act.”

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Registered Limited Liability Partnerships›KY REV ST 362.555. Registered limited liability partnership; manner of registration
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Registered Limited Liability Partnerships › KY REV ST 362.555. Registered limited liability partnership; manner of registration
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.555. Registered limited liability partnership; manner of registration (2023)
content:
(1)  To become and to continue as a registered limited liability partnership, a partnership
      that is not a limited partnership shall file with the Secretary of State a statement
      or a renewal statement, as the case may be, that satisfies the requirements ofKRS 14A.2-010to14A.2-150stating the name of the partnership that satisfies the requirements ofKRS 14A.3-010;  the address of its principal office;  the number of partners;  the names of the
      partners;  a brief statement of the business in which the partnership engages;  and
      that the partnership registers its status or renews its status, as the case may be,
      as a registered limited liability partnership.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Uniform Limited Partnership Act›KY REV ST 362.536. Domestic limited partnership's approval of plan of merger; amendment; abandonment
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Uniform Limited Partnership Act › KY REV ST 362.536. Domestic limited partnership's approval of plan of merger; amendment; abandonment
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.536. Domestic limited partnership's approval of plan of merger; amendment; abandonment (2023)
content:
(1)  Each domestic limited partnership that is to be a party to a proposed merger
      shall approve the proposed merger, unless the partnership agreement of that limited
      partnership provides otherwise, by the unanimous vote of the partners of the partnership.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Uniform Limited Partnership Act›KY REV ST 362.546. Effect of merger
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Uniform Limited Partnership Act › KY REV ST 362.546. Effect of merger
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.546. Effect of merger (2023)
content: When a merger takes effect:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Uniform Limited Partnership Act›KY REV ST 362.541. Articles of merger
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Uniform Limited Partnership Act › KY REV ST 362.541. Articles of merger
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.541. Articles of merger (2023)
content:
(1)  After a plan of merger is approved by each domestic or foreign limited partnership,
      limited liability company, or corporation that is a party to the merger, the surviving
      domestic or foreign limited partnership, limited liability company, or corporation
      shall deliver to the Secretary of State for filing articles of merger duly executed
      by each party to the merger setting forth:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Registered Limited Liability Partnerships›KY REV ST 362.605. Suits by and against partnerships; effect of judgments
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Registered Limited Liability Partnerships › KY REV ST 362.605. Suits by and against partnerships; effect of judgments
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.605. Suits by and against partnerships; effect of judgments (2023)
content:
(1)  A general partnership may sue or be sued in its real name.  A judgment by or against a partnership shall bind the partnership as if it were
      a legal entity.  A judgment against a partnership shall not bind a partner in his individual capacity
      except to the extent permitted byKRS 362.220.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Registered Limited Liability Partnerships›KY REV ST 362.575. Intent and policy of Commonwealth regarding registered limited liability partnerships
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Registered Limited Liability Partnerships › KY REV ST 362.575. Intent and policy of Commonwealth regarding registered limited liability partnerships
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.575. Intent and policy of Commonwealth regarding registered limited liability partnerships (2023)
content:
(1)  A registered limited liability partnership, formed and existing underKRS 362.155,362.175,362.190,362.220,362.235,362.315,362.325,362.345, andKRS 362.555to362.605, may conduct its business, carry on its operations, and have and exercise the powers
      granted byKRS 362.155,362.175,362.190,362.220,362.235,362.315,362.325,362.345, andKRS 362.555to362.605in any state, territory, district, or possession of the United States or in any foreign
      country.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Registered Limited Liability Partnerships›KY REV ST 362.595. Result of failure to comply with KRS 362.555; service of process
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Registered Limited Liability Partnerships › KY REV ST 362.595. Result of failure to comply with KRS 362.555; service of process
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.595. Result of failure to comply with KRS 362.555; service of process (2023)
content:
(1)  The failure of a registered limited liability partnership to comply with any
      requirements ofKRS 362.555shall not impair the validity of any contract, deed, mortgage, security interest,
      lien, or act of the registered limited liability partnership or prevent the registered
      limited liability partnership from defending any action, suit, or proceeding in any
      court of this Commonwealth.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006)›General Provisions›KY REV ST 362.1-101. Definitions for subchapter
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006) › General Provisions › KY REV ST 362.1-101. Definitions for subchapter
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.1-101. Definitions for subchapter (2023)
content: As used in this subchapter, unless the context otherwise requires:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006)›General Provisions›KY REV ST 362.1-103. Effect of partnership agreement; nonwaivable provisions
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006) › General Provisions › KY REV ST 362.1-103. Effect of partnership agreement; nonwaivable provisions
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.1-103. Effect of partnership agreement; nonwaivable provisions (2023)
content:
(1)  Except as otherwise provided in subsection (2) of this section, relations among
      the partners and between the partners and the partnership are governed by the partnership
      agreement.  To the extent the partnership agreement does not otherwise provide, this subchapter
      governs relations among the partners and between the partners and the partnership.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Registered Limited Liability Partnerships›KY REV ST 362.601. Circumstances preventing distribution; liability for unlawful distribution
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Registered Limited Liability Partnerships › KY REV ST 362.601. Circumstances preventing distribution; liability for unlawful distribution
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.601. Circumstances preventing distribution; liability for unlawful distribution (2023)
content:
(1)  A registered limited liability partnership shall not make a distribution to the
      extent that at the time of the distribution and after giving effect to the distribution,
      all liabilities for the registered limited liability partnership exceed the fair value
      of the assets of the registered limited liability partnership, other than liabilities
      to partners or transferees on account of their transferable interest in liabilities
      for which the recourse of creditors is limited to specified property.  The fair value of property that is subject to a liability for which the recourse
      of partners is limited shall be included in the assets of the registered limited liability
      partnership only to the extent that the fair value of that property exceeds that liability.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006)›General Provisions›KY REV ST 362.1-105. Execution, filing, and recording of statements
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006) › General Provisions › KY REV ST 362.1-105. Execution, filing, and recording of statements
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.1-105. Execution, filing, and recording of statements (2023)
content:
(1)  A statement may be filed in the office of Secretary of State.  A statement shall satisfy the requirements ofKRS 14A.2-010to14A.2-150.  A filed statement has the effect provided in this subchapter with respect to partnership
      property located in or transactions that occur in this Commonwealth.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006)›General Provisions›KY REV ST 362.1-102. Knowledge and notice
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006) › General Provisions › KY REV ST 362.1-102. Knowledge and notice
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.1-102. Knowledge and notice (2023)
content: (1)  A person knows a fact if the person has actual knowledge of it.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006)›General Provisions›KY REV ST 362.1-106. Governing law
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006) › General Provisions › KY REV ST 362.1-106. Governing law
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.1-106. Governing law (2023)
content:
(1)  Except as otherwise provided in subsection (2) of this section, the law of the
      jurisdiction in which a partnership has its chief executive office governs relations
      among the partners and between the partners and the partnership.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006)›General Provisions›KY REV ST 362.1-104. Supplemental principles of law
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006) › General Provisions › KY REV ST 362.1-104. Supplemental principles of law
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.1-104. Supplemental principles of law (2023)
content:
(1)  Unless displaced by particular provisions of this subchapter, the principles
      of law and equity supplement this subchapter.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006)›General Provisions›KY REV ST 362.1-107. Partnership subject to amendment or repeal of subchapter
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006) › General Provisions › KY REV ST 362.1-107. Partnership subject to amendment or repeal of subchapter
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.1-107. Partnership subject to amendment or repeal of subchapter (2023)
content:
A partnership governed by this subchapter is subject to any amendment to or repeal
   of this subchapter.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006)›General Provisions›KY REV ST 362.1-110. Effective time and date of document
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006) › General Provisions › KY REV ST 362.1-110. Effective time and date of document
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.1-110. Effective time and date of document (2023)
content:
A statement filed by or with respect to a partnership shall be effective as provided
   inKRS 14A.2-070.

title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006) › General Provisions › KY REV ST 362.1-114. Partnership names
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.1-114. Partnership names (2023)
content:
The name of a partnership as set forth on a statement of qualification or statement
   of foreign qualification shall satisfy the requirements ofKRS 14A.3-010.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006)›General Provisions›KY REV ST 362.1-108. Requirements for documents to be entitled to filing by Secretary of State
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006) › General Provisions › KY REV ST 362.1-108. Requirements for documents to be entitled to filing by Secretary of State
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.1-108. Requirements for documents to be entitled to filing by Secretary of State (2023)
content:
A statement delivered to the Secretary of State for filing, whether submitted by a
   partnership, a foreign partnership, or otherwise, shall satisfy the requirements ofKRS 14A.2-010to14A.2-150.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006)›Nature of Partnership›KY REV ST 362.1-202. Formation of partnership
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006) › Nature of Partnership › KY REV ST 362.1-202. Formation of partnership
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.1-202. Formation of partnership (2023)
content:
(1)  Except as otherwise provided in subsection (2) of this section, the association
      of two (2) or more persons to carry on as co-owners a business for profit forms a
      partnership, whether or not the persons intend to form a partnership.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006)›General Provisions›KY REV ST 362.1-121. Annual report
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006) › General Provisions › KY REV ST 362.1-121. Annual report
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.1-121. Annual report (2023)
content:
Each limited liability partnership and each foreign limited liability partnership
   authorized to transact business in this Commonwealth shall deliver to the Secretary
   of State for filing an annual report in the office of the Secretary of State on such
   form as shall be prescribed by the Secretary of State as provided inKRS 14A.6-010.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006)›General Provisions›KY REV ST 362.1-117. Registered office; registered agent
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006) › General Provisions › KY REV ST 362.1-117. Registered office; registered agent
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.1-117. Registered office; registered agent (2023)
content:
Each limited liability partnership and each foreign limited liability partnership
   authorized to transact business in the Commonwealth shall continuously maintain in
   this Commonwealth a registered office and a registered agent that comply withKRS 14A.4-010.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006)›Nature of Partnership›KY REV ST 362.1-201. Partnership as entity
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006) › Nature of Partnership › KY REV ST 362.1-201. Partnership as entity
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.1-201. Partnership as entity (2023)
content: (1)  A partnership is an entity distinct from its partners.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006)›General Provisions›KY REV ST 362.1-120. Service of process
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006) › General Provisions › KY REV ST 362.1-120. Service of process
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.1-120. Service of process (2023)
content:
An agent named pursuant toKRS 362.1-303(1)(a)3. is not a registered agent for the partnership, and service of process is not accomplished
   against that agent.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006)›Nature of Partnership›KY REV ST 362.1-203. Partnership property
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006) › Nature of Partnership › KY REV ST 362.1-203. Partnership property
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.1-203. Partnership property (2023)
content:
Property transferred to or otherwise acquired by a partnership is property of the
   partnership and not of the partners individually.

title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006) › Relations of Partners to Persons Dealing with Partnership › KY REV ST 362.1-302. Transfer of partnership property

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006)›Relations of Partners to Persons Dealing with Partnership›KY REV ST 362.1-306. Partner's liability
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006) › Relations of Partners to Persons Dealing with Partnership › KY REV ST 362.1-306. Partner's liability
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.1-306. Partner's liability (2023)
content:
(1)  Except as otherwise provided in subsections (2) and (3) of this section, all
      partners are liable jointly and severally for all obligations of the partnership unless
      otherwise agreed by the claimant or provided by law.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006)›Relations of Partners to Persons Dealing with Partnership›KY REV ST 362.1-307. Actions by and against partnership and partners
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Subchapter 1.
