citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.1-307. Actions by and against partnership and partners (2023)
content: (1)  A partnership may sue and be sued in the name of the partnership.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006)›Relations of Partners to Persons Dealing with Partnership›KY REV ST 362.1-305. Partnership liable for partner's actionable conduct
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006) › Relations of Partners to Persons Dealing with Partnership › KY REV ST 362.1-305. Partnership liable for partner's actionable conduct
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.1-305. Partnership liable for partner's actionable conduct (2023)
content:
(1)  A partnership is liable for loss or injury caused to a person, or for a penalty
      incurred, as a result of a wrongful act or omission, or other actionable conduct,
      of a partner acting in the ordinary course of business of the partnership or with
      authority of the partnership.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006)›Relations of Partners to Persons Dealing with Partnership›KY REV ST 362.1-304. Statement of denial
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006) › Relations of Partners to Persons Dealing with Partnership › KY REV ST 362.1-304. Statement of denial
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.1-304. Statement of denial (2023)
content:
A partner or other person named as a partner in a filed statement of partnership authority
   or in a list maintained by an agent pursuant toKRS 362.1-303(2)may file a statement of denial stating the name of the partnership, the date of filing
   of the statement of partnership authority, and the fact that is being denied, which
   may include denial of a person's authority or status as a partner.  A statement of denial is a limitation on authority as provided inKRS 362.1-303(4)and(5).

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006)›Relations of Partners to Persons Dealing with Partnership›KY REV ST 362.1-308. Liability of purported partner
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006) › Relations of Partners to Persons Dealing with Partnership › KY REV ST 362.1-308. Liability of purported partner
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.1-308. Liability of purported partner (2023)
content:
(1)  If a person, by words or conduct, purports to be a partner or consents to being
      represented by another as a partner in a partnership or with one (1) or more persons
      not partners, then the purported partner is liable to a person to whom the representation
      is made, if that person, relying on the representation, enters into a transaction
      with the actual or purported partnership and the purported partner would have been
      personally liable for obligations of the partnership underKRS 362.1-306(1).

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006)›Relations of Partners to Each Other and to Partnership›KY REV ST 362.1-401. Partner's rights and duties
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006) › Relations of Partners to Each Other and to Partnership › KY REV ST 362.1-401. Partner's rights and duties
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.1-401. Partner's rights and duties (2023)
content: (1)  Each partner is deemed to have an account that is:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006)›Relations of Partners to Each Other and to Partnership›KY REV ST 362.1-402. Distributions in kind
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006) › Relations of Partners to Each Other and to Partnership › KY REV ST 362.1-402. Distributions in kind
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.1-402. Distributions in kind (2023)
content:
(1)  A partner, regardless of the nature of the partner's contribution, has no right
      to demand and receive any distribution in kind from a partnership.  A partner shall not be compelled to accept a distribution of any asset in kind from
      a partnership to the extent that the percentage of the asset distributed to the partner
      exceeds a percentage of that asset which is equal to the percentage in which the partner
      shares in distributions from the partnership.  A partner may be compelled to accept a distribution of any asset in kind from a
      partnership to the extent that the percentage of the asset distributed to the partner
      is equal to a percentage of that asset which is equal to the percentage in which the
      partner shares in distributions from the partnership.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006)›Relations of Partners to Each Other and to Partnership›KY REV ST 362.1-404. General standards of partner's conduct
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006) › Relations of Partners to Each Other and to Partnership › KY REV ST 362.1-404. General standards of partner's conduct
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.1-404. General standards of partner's conduct (2023)
content:
(1)  The fiduciary duties a partner owes to the partnership and the other partners
      include the duty of loyalty and the duty of care set forth in subsections (2) and
      (3) of this section.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006)›Relations of Partners to Each Other and to Partnership›KY REV ST 362.1-403. Partner's rights and duties with respect to information
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006) › Relations of Partners to Each Other and to Partnership › KY REV ST 362.1-403. Partner's rights and duties with respect to information
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.1-403. Partner's rights and duties with respect to information (2023)
content:
(1)  A partnership shall keep its books and records, if any, at its chief executive
      office.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006)›Relations of Partners to Each Other and to Partnership›KY REV ST 362.1-405. Actions by partnership and partners
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006) › Relations of Partners to Each Other and to Partnership › KY REV ST 362.1-405. Actions by partnership and partners
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.1-405. Actions by partnership and partners (2023)
content:
(1)  A partnership may maintain an action against a partner for a breach of the partnership
      agreement, or for the violation of a duty to the partnership causing harm to the partnership.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006)›Transferees and Creditors of Partner›KY REV ST 362.1-502. Partner's transferable interest in partnership
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006) › Transferees and Creditors of Partner › KY REV ST 362.1-502. Partner's transferable interest in partnership
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.1-502. Partner's transferable interest in partnership (2023)
content:
The only transferable interest of a partner in the partnership is the partner's share
   of the profits and losses of the partnership and the partner's right to receive distributions.  The interest is personal property.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006)›Relations of Partners to Each Other and to Partnership›KY REV ST 362.1-406. Continuation of partnership beyond definite term or particular undertaking
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006) › Relations of Partners to Each Other and to Partnership › KY REV ST 362.1-406. Continuation of partnership beyond definite term or particular undertaking
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.1-406. Continuation of partnership beyond definite term or particular undertaking (2023)
content:
(1)  If a partnership for a definite term or particular undertaking is continued,
      without an express agreement, after the expiration of the term or completion of the
      undertaking, then the rights and duties of the partners remain the same as they were
      at the expiration or completion, so far as is consistent with a partnership at will.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006)›Partner's Dissociation›KY REV ST 362.1-602. Partner's power to dissociate; wrongful dissociation
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006) › Partner's Dissociation › KY REV ST 362.1-602. Partner's power to dissociate; wrongful dissociation
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.1-602. Partner's power to dissociate; wrongful dissociation (2023)
content:
(1)  A partner has the power to dissociate at any time, rightfully or wrongfully,
      by express will pursuant toKRS 362.1-601(1).

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006)›Transferees and Creditors of Partner›KY REV ST 362.1-504. Partner's transferable interest subject to charging order
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006) › Transferees and Creditors of Partner › KY REV ST 362.1-504. Partner's transferable interest subject to charging order
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.1-504. Partner's transferable interest subject to charging order (2023)
content:
(1)  This section provides the exclusive remedy by which the judgment creditor of
      a partner or the transferee of a partner may satisfy a judgment out of the judgment
      debtor's transferable interest.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006)›Transferees and Creditors of Partner›KY REV ST 362.1-501. Partner not co-owner of partnership property
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006) › Transferees and Creditors of Partner › KY REV ST 362.1-501. Partner not co-owner of partnership property
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.1-501. Partner not co-owner of partnership property (2023)
content:
Partnership property is owned by the partnership as an entity.  A partner is not a co-owner of partnership property and has no interest in partnership
   property which can be transferred, either voluntarily or involuntarily.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006)›Partner's Dissociation›KY REV ST 362.1-603. Effect of partner's dissociation
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006) › Partner's Dissociation › KY REV ST 362.1-603. Effect of partner's dissociation
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.1-603. Effect of partner's dissociation (2023)
content:
(1)  If a partner's dissociation results in a dissolution and winding up of the partnership
      business, thenKRS 362.1-801to362.1-807apply;  otherwise,KRS 362.1-701to362.1-705apply.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006)›Transferees and Creditors of Partner›KY REV ST 362.1-503. Transfer of partner's transferable interest
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006) › Transferees and Creditors of Partner › KY REV ST 362.1-503. Transfer of partner's transferable interest
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.1-503. Transfer of partner's transferable interest (2023)
content:
(1)  A transfer, in whole or in part, of a partner's transferable interest in the
      partnership:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006)›Partner's Dissociation›KY REV ST 362.1-601. Events causing partner's dissociation
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006) › Partner's Dissociation › KY REV ST 362.1-601. Events causing partner's dissociation
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.1-601. Events causing partner's dissociation (2023)
content:
A partner is dissociated from a partnership upon the occurrence of any of the following
   events:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006)›Partner's Dissociation When Business Not Wound Up›KY REV ST 362.1-703. Dissociated partner's liability to other persons
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006) › Partner's Dissociation When Business Not Wound Up › KY REV ST 362.1-703. Dissociated partner's liability to other persons
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.1-703. Dissociated partner's liability to other persons (2023)
content:
(1)  A partner's dissociation does not of itself discharge the partner's liability
      for a partnership obligation incurred before dissociation.  A dissociated partner is not liable for a partnership obligation incurred after
      dissociation, except as otherwise provided in subsection (2) of this section.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006)›Partner's Dissociation When Business Not Wound Up›KY REV ST 362.1-701. Purchase of dissociated partner's interest
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006) › Partner's Dissociation When Business Not Wound Up › KY REV ST 362.1-701. Purchase of dissociated partner's interest
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.1-701. Purchase of dissociated partner's interest (2023)
content:
(1)  If a partner is dissociated from a partnership without resulting in a dissolution
      and winding up of the partnership business underKRS 362.1-801, then the partnership shall cause the dissociated partner's interest in the partnership
      to be purchased for a buyout price determined pursuant to subsection (2) of this section.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006)›Partner's Dissociation When Business Not Wound Up›KY REV ST 362.1-702. Dissociated partner's power to bind and liability to partnership
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006) › Partner's Dissociation When Business Not Wound Up › KY REV ST 362.1-702. Dissociated partner's power to bind and liability to partnership
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.1-702. Dissociated partner's power to bind and liability to partnership (2023)
content:
(1)  For two (2) years after a partner dissociates without resulting in a dissolution
      and winding up of the partnership business, the partnership, including a surviving
      partnership underKRS 362.1-901to362.1-908, is bound by an act of the dissociated partner which would have bound the partnership
      underKRS 362.1-301before dissociation only if at the time of entering into the transaction the other
      party:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006)›Partner's Dissociation When Business Not Wound Up›KY REV ST 362.1-704. Statement of dissociation
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006) › Partner's Dissociation When Business Not Wound Up › KY REV ST 362.1-704. Statement of dissociation
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.1-704. Statement of dissociation (2023)
content:
(1)  A dissociated partner or the partnership may file a statement of dissociation
      stating the name of the partnership and that the partner is dissociated from the partnership.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006)›Partner's Dissociation When Business Not Wound Up›KY REV ST 362.1-705. Continued use of partnership name
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006) › Partner's Dissociation When Business Not Wound Up › KY REV ST 362.1-705. Continued use of partnership name
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.1-705. Continued use of partnership name (2023)
content:
Continued use of a partnership name, or a dissociated partner's name as part of the
   partnership name, by partners continuing the business does not of itself make the
   dissociated partner liable for an obligation of the partners or the partnership continuing
   the business.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006)›Winding Up Partnership Business›KY REV ST 362.1-804. Partner's power to bind partnership after dissolution
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006) › Winding Up Partnership Business › KY REV ST 362.1-804. Partner's power to bind partnership after dissolution
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.1-804. Partner's power to bind partnership after dissolution (2023)
content: Subject toKRS 362.1-805, a partnership is bound by a partner's act after dissolution that:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006)›Winding Up Partnership Business›KY REV ST 362.1-802. Partnership continues after dissolution
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006) › Winding Up Partnership Business › KY REV ST 362.1-802. Partnership continues after dissolution
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.1-802. Partnership continues after dissolution (2023)
content:
(1)  Subject to subsection (2) of this section, a partnership continues after dissolution
      only for the purpose of winding up its business.  The partnership is terminated when the winding up of its business is completed.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006)›Winding Up Partnership Business›KY REV ST 362.1-801. Events causing dissolution and winding up of partnership business
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006) › Winding Up Partnership Business › KY REV ST 362.1-801. Events causing dissolution and winding up of partnership business
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.1-801. Events causing dissolution and winding up of partnership business (2023)
content:
A partnership is dissolved, and its business shall be wound up, only upon the occurrence
   of any of the following events:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006)›Winding Up Partnership Business›KY REV ST 362.1-805. Statement of dissolution
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006) › Winding Up Partnership Business › KY REV ST 362.1-805. Statement of dissolution
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.1-805. Statement of dissolution (2023)
content:
(1)  After dissolution, a partner who has not wrongfully dissociated may file a statement
      of dissolution stating the name of the partnership, that the partnership has dissolved
      and is winding up its business, and the date of dissolution.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006)›Winding Up Partnership Business›KY REV ST 362.1-803. Right to wind up partnership business
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006) › Winding Up Partnership Business › KY REV ST 362.1-803. Right to wind up partnership business
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.1-803. Right to wind up partnership business (2023)
content:
(1)  After dissolution, a partner who has not wrongfully dissociated may participate
      in winding up the partnership's business, but on application of any partner, partner's
      legal representative, or transferee, the Circuit Court for the county in which the
      registered office is located or, if none, the Franklin Circuit Court, for good cause
      shown, may order judicial supervision of the winding up.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006)›Conversion and Mergers›KY REV ST 362.1-901. Definitions for KRS 362.1-901. to § 362.1-908
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006) › Conversion and Mergers › KY REV ST 362.1-901. Definitions for KRS 362.1-901. to § 362.1-908
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.1-901. Definitions for KRS 362.1-901. to § 362.1-908 (2023)
content: As used inKRS 362.1-901to362.1-908:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006)›Conversion and Mergers›KY REV ST 362.1-903. Conversion of limited partnership to partnership
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006) › Conversion and Mergers › KY REV ST 362.1-903. Conversion of limited partnership to partnership
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.1-903. Conversion of limited partnership to partnership (2023)
content: (1)  A limited partnership may be converted to a partnership pursuant to this subsection.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006)›Conversion and Mergers›KY REV ST 362.1-905. Merger of partnerships
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006) › Conversion and Mergers › KY REV ST 362.1-905. Merger of partnerships
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.1-905. Merger of partnerships (2023)
content:
(1)  Pursuant to a plan of merger approved as provided in subsection (3) of this section,
      a partnership may be merged with one (1) or more partnerships or limited partnerships.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006)›Winding Up Partnership Business›KY REV ST 362.1-807. Settlement of accounts and contributions among partners
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006) › Winding Up Partnership Business › KY REV ST 362.1-807. Settlement of accounts and contributions among partners
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.1-807. Settlement of accounts and contributions among partners (2023)
content:
(1)  In winding up a partnership's business, the assets of the partnership, including
      the contributions of the partners required by this section, shall be applied to discharge
      its obligations to creditors, including, to the extent permitted by law, partners
      who are creditors.  Any surplus shall be applied to pay the net amount distributable to partners in
      accordance with their right to distributions under subsection (2) of this section.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006)›Winding Up Partnership Business›KY REV ST 362.1-806. Partner's liability to other partners after dissolution
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006) › Winding Up Partnership Business › KY REV ST 362.1-806. Partner's liability to other partners after dissolution
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.1-806. Partner's liability to other partners after dissolution (2023)
content:
(1)  Except as otherwise provided in subsection (2) of this section andKRS 362.1-306, after dissolution a partner is liable to the other partners for the partner's share
      of any partnership liability incurred underKRS 362.1-804.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006)›Conversion and Mergers›KY REV ST 362.1-902. Conversion of partnership to limited partnership
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006) › Conversion and Mergers › KY REV ST 362.1-902. Conversion of partnership to limited partnership
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.1-902. Conversion of partnership to limited partnership (2023)
content: (1)  A partnership may be converted to a limited partnership pursuant to this section.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006)›Conversion and Mergers›KY REV ST 362.1-906. Effect of merger
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006) › Conversion and Mergers › KY REV ST 362.1-906. Effect of merger
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.1-906. Effect of merger (2023)
content: (1)  When a merger takes effect:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006)›Conversion and Mergers›KY REV ST 362.1-908. Provisions of KRS 362.1-901. to 362.1-908. nonexclusive
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006) › Conversion and Mergers › KY REV ST 362.1-908. Provisions of KRS 362.1-901. to 362.1-908. nonexclusive
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.1-908. Provisions of KRS 362.1-901. to 362.1-908. nonexclusive (2023)
content:
KRS 362.1-901to362.1-908are not exclusive.  Partnerships or limited partnerships may be converted or merged in any other manner
   provided by law.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›General Provisions›KY REV ST 362.1-103. Effect of partnership agreement; nonwaivable provisions
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › General Provisions › KY REV ST 362.1-103. Effect of partnership agreement; nonwaivable provisions
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.1-103. Effect of partnership agreement; nonwaivable provisions (2023)
content:
(1)  Except as otherwise provided in subsection (2) of this section, relations among
      the partners and between the partners and the partnership are governed by the partnership
      agreement.  To the extent the partnership agreement does not otherwise provide, this subchapter
      governs relations among the partners and between the partners and the partnership.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›General Provisions›KY REV ST 362.1-102. Knowledge and notice
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › General Provisions › KY REV ST 362.1-102. Knowledge and notice
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.1-102. Knowledge and notice (2023)
content: (1)  A person knows a fact if the person has actual knowledge of it.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›General Provisions›KY REV ST 362.1-101. Definitions for subchapter
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › General Provisions › KY REV ST 362.1-101. Definitions for subchapter
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.1-101. Definitions for subchapter (2023)
content: As used in this subchapter, unless the context otherwise requires:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006)›Conversion and Mergers›KY REV ST 362.1-907. Statement of merger
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006) › Conversion and Mergers › KY REV ST 362.1-907. Statement of merger
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.1-907. Statement of merger (2023)
content:
(1)  After a merger, the surviving partnership or limited partnership may file a statement
      that one (1) or more partnerships or limited partnerships have merged into the surviving
      entity.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006)›Conversion and Mergers›KY REV ST 362.1-904. Effect of conversion; entity unchanged
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006) › Conversion and Mergers › KY REV ST 362.1-904. Effect of conversion; entity unchanged
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.1-904. Effect of conversion; entity unchanged (2023)
content: (1)  A converted organization that has been converted pursuant toKRS 362.1-901to362.1-908is for all purposes the same entity that existed before the conversion.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›General Provisions›KY REV ST 362.1-106. Governing law
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › General Provisions › KY REV ST 362.1-106. Governing law
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.1-106. Governing law (2023)
content:
(1)  Except as otherwise provided in subsection (2) of this section, the law of the
      jurisdiction in which a partnership has its chief executive office governs relations
      among the partners and between the partners and the partnership.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›General Provisions›KY REV ST 362.1-104. Supplemental principles of law
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › General Provisions › KY REV ST 362.1-104. Supplemental principles of law
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.1-104. Supplemental principles of law (2023)
content:
(1)  Unless displaced by particular provisions of this subchapter, the principles
      of law and equity supplement this subchapter.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›General Provisions›KY REV ST 362.1-105. Execution, filing, and recording of statements
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › General Provisions › KY REV ST 362.1-105. Execution, filing, and recording of statements
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.1-105. Execution, filing, and recording of statements (2023)
content:
(1)  A statement may be filed in the office of Secretary of State.  A statement shall satisfy the requirements ofKRS 14A.2-010to14A.2-150.  A filed statement has the effect provided in this subchapter with respect to partnership
      property located in or transactions that occur in this Commonwealth.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006)›Limited Liability Partnership›KY REV ST 362.1-931. Statement of qualification

content: (1)  A partnership may become a limited liability partnership pursuant to this section.

title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › General Provisions › KY REV ST 362.1-108. Requirements for documents to be entitled to filing by Secretary of State

content:
A statement delivered to the Secretary of State for filing, whether submitted by a
   partnership, a foreign partnership, or otherwise, shall satisfy the requirements ofKRS 14A.2-010to14A.2-150.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006)›Foreign Limited Liability Partnership›KY REV ST 362.1-952. Action by Attorney General
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006) › Foreign Limited Liability Partnership › KY REV ST 362.1-952. Action by Attorney General
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.1-952. Action by Attorney General (2023)
content:
The Attorney General may maintain an action to restrain a foreign limited liability
   partnership from transacting business in this Commonwealth in violation of this subchapter.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›General Provisions›KY REV ST 362.1-114. Partnership names
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › General Provisions › KY REV ST 362.1-114. Partnership names
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.1-114. Partnership names (2023)
content:
The name of a partnership as set forth on a statement of qualification or statement
   of foreign qualification shall satisfy the requirements ofKRS 14A.3-010.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›General Provisions›KY REV ST 362.1-117. Registered office; registered agent
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › General Provisions › KY REV ST 362.1-117. Registered office; registered agent
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.1-117. Registered office; registered agent (2023)
content:
Each limited liability partnership and each foreign limited liability partnership
   authorized to transact business in the Commonwealth shall continuously maintain in
   this Commonwealth a registered office and a registered agent that comply withKRS 14A.4-010.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›General Provisions›KY REV ST 362.1-110. Effective time and date of document
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › General Provisions › KY REV ST 362.1-110. Effective time and date of document
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.1-110. Effective time and date of document (2023)
content:
A statement filed by or with respect to a partnership shall be effective as provided
   inKRS 14A.2-070.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›General Provisions›KY REV ST 362.1-120. Service of process
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › General Provisions › KY REV ST 362.1-120. Service of process
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.1-120. Service of process (2023)
content:
An agent named pursuant toKRS 362.1-303(1)(a)3. is not a registered agent for the partnership, and service of process is not accomplished
   against that agent.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›General Provisions›KY REV ST 362.1-107. Partnership subject to amendment or repeal of subchapter
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › General Provisions › KY REV ST 362.1-107. Partnership subject to amendment or repeal of subchapter
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.1-107. Partnership subject to amendment or repeal of subchapter (2023)
content:
A partnership governed by this subchapter is subject to any amendment to or repeal
   of this subchapter.

content:

title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006) › Miscellaneous Provisions › KY REV ST 362.1-972. Short title for subchapter

content: This subchapter may be cited as the Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006).

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›General Provisions›KY REV ST 362.1-121. Annual report
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › General Provisions › KY REV ST 362.1-121. Annual report
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.1-121. Annual report (2023)
content:
Each limited liability partnership and each foreign limited liability partnership
   authorized to transact business in this Commonwealth shall deliver to the Secretary
   of State for filing an annual report in the office of the Secretary of State on such
   form as shall be prescribed by the Secretary of State as provided inKRS 14A.6-010.

title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › General Provisions › KY REV ST 362.1-122. Administrative dissolution of a statement of qualification or statement of partnership authority

content:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006)›Limited Liability Partnership›KY REV ST 362.1-932. Circumstances preventing distribution; liability for unlawful distribution
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006) › Limited Liability Partnership › KY REV ST 362.1-932. Circumstances preventing distribution; liability for unlawful distribution
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.1-932. Circumstances preventing distribution; liability for unlawful distribution (2023)
content:
(1)  A limited liability partnership shall not make a distribution to the extent that
      at the time of and after giving effect to the distribution, all liabilities of the
      limited liability partnership exceed the fair value of the assets of the limited liability
      partnership, other than liabilities to partners or transferees on account of their
      transferable interest in liabilities for which the recourse of creditors is limited
      to specified property.  The fair value of property that is subject to a liability for which the recourse
      of partners is limited shall be included in the assets of the limited liability partnership
      only to the extent that the fair value of that property exceeds that liability.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006)›Miscellaneous Provisions›KY REV ST 362.1-971. Uniformity of application and construction
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006) › Miscellaneous Provisions › KY REV ST 362.1-971. Uniformity of application and construction
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.1-971. Uniformity of application and construction (2023)
content:
This subchapter shall be applied and construed to effectuate its general purpose to
   make uniform the law with respect to the subject of this subchapter among the states
   enacting it.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006)›Miscellaneous Provisions›KY REV ST 362.1-973. Severability clause
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006) › Miscellaneous Provisions › KY REV ST 362.1-973. Severability clause
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.1-973. Severability clause (2023)
content:
If any provision of this subchapter or its application to any person or circumstance
   is held invalid, then the invalidity shall not affect other provisions or applications
   of this subchapter which can be given effect without the invalid provision or application,
   and to this end the provisions of this subchapter are severable.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 362. Partnerships›Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006)›Miscellaneous Provisions›KY REV ST 362.1-975. Savings clause
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 362. Partnerships › Subchapter 1. Kentucky Revised Uniform Partnership Act (2006) › Miscellaneous Provisions › KY REV ST 362.1-975. Savings clause
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 362.1-975. Savings clause (2023)
content:
This subchapter does not affect an action or proceeding commenced or right accrued
   before this subchapter takes effect.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 364. Drifts, Logs, and Timber›KY REV ST 364.060. Property not to be secreted or grounded; liability
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 364. Drifts, Logs, and Timber › KY REV ST 364.060. Property not to be secreted or grounded; liability
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 364.060. Property not to be secreted or grounded; liability (2023)
content:
If any person who takes up any drift, log or timber secretes it or allows it to be
   so grounded that he cannot immediately, upon the demand of the owner or his agent,
   put it afloat, or if he fails to put it afloat upon such demand, he shall not receive
   any compensation for taking up or caring for the drift, log or timber, and shall,
   in addition, be responsible to the owner thereof as if it were afloat.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 364. Drifts, Logs, and Timber›KY REV ST 364.050. Unbranded timber, compensation for taking up
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 364. Drifts, Logs, and Timber › KY REV ST 364.050. Unbranded timber, compensation for taking up
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 364.050. Unbranded timber, compensation for taking up (2023)
content:
(1)  Any person who takes up unbranded timber prepared for market shall receive as
      compensation for his services only the fees provided for inKRS 364.020and no charges for keeping or caring for the timber.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 364. Drifts, Logs, and Timber›KY REV ST 364.040. Charges for keeping other timber more than thirty days
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 364. Drifts, Logs, and Timber › KY REV ST 364.040. Charges for keeping other timber more than thirty days
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 364.040. Charges for keeping other timber more than thirty days (2023)
content:
Any person who takes up any logs, or any tree prepared for sale, where the log or
   tree is not part of a fleet, raft or platform, and keeps it in his possession for
   more than thirty (30) days before the owner thereof offers to pay the fees provided
   for byKRS 364.020shall have a claim against the owner for twenty-five cents ($0.25) for every such
   log or tree, in addition to the fees provided for byKRS 364.020.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 364. Drifts, Logs, and Timber›KY REV ST 364.030. Charges for keeping fleets, rafts and platforms
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 364. Drifts, Logs, and Timber › KY REV ST 364.030. Charges for keeping fleets, rafts and platforms
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 364.030. Charges for keeping fleets, rafts and platforms (2023)

title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 364. Drifts, Logs, and Timber › KY REV ST 364.020. Fees for taking up drifts, logs and timber; lien; sale
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 364.020. Fees for taking up drifts, logs and timber; lien; sale (2023)
content:
(1)  Whenever any boat, raft or platform, or any timber prepared for market, whether
      branded or unbranded, is taken up by a person not the owner thereof, the person who
      takes it up and secures it and delivers it to the owner shall have a claim against
      the owner for the following fees:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 364. Drifts, Logs, and Timber›KY REV ST 364.070. Brand, adoption by timber dealer
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 364. Drifts, Logs, and Timber › KY REV ST 364.070. Brand, adoption by timber dealer
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 364.070. Brand, adoption by timber dealer (2023)
content: (1)  Any timber dealer may adopt a brand.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 364. Drifts, Logs, and Timber›KY REV ST 364.120. Branding of timber, effect as to third persons
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 364. Drifts, Logs, and Timber › KY REV ST 364.120. Branding of timber, effect as to third persons
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 364.120. Branding of timber, effect as to third persons (2023)
content:
(1)  When a valid sale of standing timber has been made as provided inKRS 371.100and the timber has been branded by the seller, or by another with his consent, with
      the brand of the purchaser, the sale shall have the same effect as to creditors and
      innocent purchasers as a recorded sale of land.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 364. Drifts, Logs, and Timber›KY REV ST 364.100. Defacing brand
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 364. Drifts, Logs, and Timber › KY REV ST 364.100. Defacing brand
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 364.100. Defacing brand (2023)
content:
No person shall unlawfully cut out, cancel, obliterate or deface any brand recorded
   as provided inKRS 364.070and placed upon the timber of another.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 364. Drifts, Logs, and Timber›KY REV ST 364.080. Brand to be exclusive trade-mark; infringement forbidden
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 364. Drifts, Logs, and Timber › KY REV ST 364.080. Brand to be exclusive trade-mark; infringement forbidden
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 364.080. Brand to be exclusive trade-mark; infringement forbidden (2023)
content:
(1)  Every brand adopted underKRS 364.070shall, from the date of its adoption, be the exclusive trade-mark of the person adopting
      it.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 364. Drifts, Logs, and Timber›KY REV ST 364.990. Penalties
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 364. Drifts, Logs, and Timber › KY REV ST 364.990. Penalties
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 364.990. Penalties (2023)
content: (1)  Any person who violates any of the provisions of subsection (2) ofKRS 364.050shall be guilty of a Class D felony.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 364. Drifts, Logs, and Timber›KY REV ST 364.110. Conversion of branded timber
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 364. Drifts, Logs, and Timber › KY REV ST 364.110. Conversion of branded timber
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 364.110. Conversion of branded timber (2023)
content:
No person shall unlawfully take, secrete, cut, saw, split up or destroy any timber
   branded as provided in this chapter, or remove it from the main stream on which it
   was taken up, with the intention of preventing the owner from finding it, or in any
   way convert it to his own use without the consent of the owner.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 365. Trade Practices›Assumed Business Names›KY REV ST 365.015. Certificate of assumed name; filing with state and county; certificate of withdrawal; filing fees
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 365. Trade Practices › Assumed Business Names › KY REV ST 365.015. Certificate of assumed name; filing with state and county; certificate of withdrawal; filing fees
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 365.015. Certificate of assumed name; filing with state and county; certificate of withdrawal; filing fees (2023)
content:
(1)  (a) The real name of an individual shall include his or her surname at birth,
         or his or her name as changed by a court of competent jurisdiction, or the surname
         of a married woman.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 364. Drifts, Logs, and Timber›KY REV ST 364.090. Branding of timber
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 364. Drifts, Logs, and Timber › KY REV ST 364.090. Branding of timber
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 364.090. Branding of timber (2023)
content:
(1)  The owner, in using his brand, shall cause it to be plainly stamped or otherwise
      impressed upon each separate piece of timber intended to be branded.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 364. Drifts, Logs, and Timber›KY REV ST 364.130. Liability of person entering upon and cutting timber growing upon land of another; measure of damages; exceptions with limitations on liability
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 364. Drifts, Logs, and Timber › KY REV ST 364.130. Liability of person entering upon and cutting timber growing upon land of another; measure of damages; exceptions with limitations on liability
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 364.130. Liability of person entering upon and cutting timber growing upon land of another; measure of damages; exceptions with limitations on liability (2023)
content:
(1)  Except as provided in subsections (2) and (4) of this section, any person, regardless
      of state of mind or whether the person believes to be authorized or not, who cuts
      or saws down, or causes to be cut or sawed down to convert to his own use timber growing
      upon the land of another without legal right or without color of title in himself
      to the timber or to the land upon which the timber was growing shall pay to the rightful
      owner of the timber three (3) times the stumpage value of the timber and shall pay
      to the rightful owner of the property three (3) times the cost of any damages to the
      property as well as any legal costs incurred by the owner of the timber.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 365. Trade Practices›Unfair Trade Practices›KY REV ST 365.020. Price discrimination between localities prohibited; exceptions
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 365. Trade Practices › Unfair Trade Practices › KY REV ST 365.020. Price discrimination between localities prohibited; exceptions
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 365.020. Price discrimination between localities prohibited; exceptions (2023)
content:
(1)  No person doing business in this state and engaged in the production, manufacture,
      distribution or sale of any commodity or product, or service or output of a service
      trade, of general use or consumption, or the product or service of any public utility,
      with the intent to destroy the competition of any regular established dealer in such
      commodity, product or service, or to prevent the competition of any person who in
      good faith intends and attempts to become such dealer, shall discriminate between
      different sections, communities or cities, or portions thereof or locations therein,
      in this state, by selling or furnishing such commodity, product or service at a lower
      rate in one section, community or city, or any portion thereof or location therein,
      than in another, after making allowance for difference, if any, in the grade or quality,
      and in the actual cost of transportation from the point of production, if a raw product
      or commodity, or from the point of manufacture, if a manufactured product or commodity.  The inhibition against locality discrimination shall embrace any scheme of special
      rebates, collateral contracts or any device of any nature whereby such discrimination
      is, in substance or fact, effected in violation of the spirit and intent of this section.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 365. Trade Practices›Unfair Trade Practices›KY REV ST 365.030. Sale at less than cost or gift of commodity to destroy competition prohibited
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 365. Trade Practices › Unfair Trade Practices › KY REV ST 365.030. Sale at less than cost or gift of commodity to destroy competition prohibited
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 365.030. Sale at less than cost or gift of commodity to destroy competition prohibited (2023)
content:
(1)  Except as provided inKRS 365.040, no person engaged in business within this state shall sell, offer for sale or advertise
      for sale any article or product, or service or output of a service trade, at less
      than the cost thereof to such vendor, or give, offer to give or advertise the intent
      to give away any article or product, or service or output of a service trade, for
      the purpose of injuring competitors and destroying competition.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 365. Trade Practices›Unfair Trade Practices›KY REV ST 365.040. Exceptions to KRS § 365.030
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 365. Trade Practices › Unfair Trade Practices › KY REV ST 365.040. Exceptions to KRS § 365.030
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 365.040. Exceptions to KRS § 365.030 (2023)
content: The provisions ofKRS 365.030do not apply to any sale made:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 365. Trade Practices›Unfair Trade Practices›KY REV ST 365.050. Unfair trade practices
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 365. Trade Practices › Unfair Trade Practices › KY REV ST 365.050. Unfair trade practices
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 365.050. Unfair trade practices (2023)
content:
The secret payment or allowance of rebates, refunds, commissions or unearned discounts,
   whether in the form of money or otherwise, or secretly extending to certain purchasers
   special services or privileges not extended to all purchasers purchasing upon like
   terms and conditions, to the injury of a competitor, and where such payment or allowance
   tends to destroy competition, is an unfair trade practice, and no person shall resort
   to such trade practice.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 365. Trade Practices›Unfair Trade Practices›KY REV ST 365.055. Use of mailed document purporting to inform of winning a prize
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 365. Trade Practices › Unfair Trade Practices › KY REV ST 365.055. Use of mailed document purporting to inform of winning a prize
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 365.055. Use of mailed document purporting to inform of winning a prize (2023)
content:
(1)  The use of a document mailed to members of the general public, the purpose of
      which is to market a product, when the document purports to inform the recipient that
      he has won a prize, without prominently and conspicuously communicating by clear and
      understandable language in the document the exclusions or conditions to receiving
      the prize, shall constitute an unfair trade practice and is prohibited.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 365. Trade Practices›Unfair Trade Practices›KY REV ST 365.060. Contracts violating KRS 365.020. to 365.050. are void
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 365. Trade Practices › Unfair Trade Practices › KY REV ST 365.060. Contracts violating KRS 365.020. to 365.050. are void
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 365.060. Contracts violating KRS 365.020. to 365.050. are void (2023)
content: Any contract, express or implied, made in violation of any of the provisions ofKRS 365.020to365.050is an illegal contract and no recovery shall be had thereon.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 365. Trade Practices›Unfair Trade Practices›KY REV ST 365.070. Injunction and damages for violation of KRS 365.020. to § 365.050
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 365. Trade Practices › Unfair Trade Practices › KY REV ST 365.070. Injunction and damages for violation of KRS 365.020. to § 365.050
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 365.070. Injunction and damages for violation of KRS 365.020. to § 365.050 (2023)
content:
(1)  Any person may maintain an action to enjoin a continuance of any act in violation
      of any of the provisions ofKRS 365.020to365.050, and if injured thereby for the recovery of damages.  If, in such action, the court finds that the defendant is violating or has violated
      any of the provisions ofKRS 365.020to365.050, it shall enjoin the defendant from a continuance thereof.  It shall not be necessary that actual damages to the plaintiff be alleged or proved.  In addition to such injunctive relief, the plaintiff in the action shall be entitled
      to recover from the defendant three (3) times the amount of any actual damages sustained.  Any defendant in an action brought under this section may be required to testify,
      and his books and records may be brought into court and introduced, by reference,
      into evidence, but no information so obtained shall be used against the defendant
      as a basis for a prosecution under the provisions of subsection (2) ofKRS 365.990.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 365. Trade Practices›Brands and Labels›KY REV ST 365.100. Use of false brand to deceive
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 365. Trade Practices › Brands and Labels › KY REV ST 365.100. Use of false brand to deceive
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 365.100. Use of false brand to deceive (2023)
content:
No person shall use a false brand on anything sold, or to be sold or offered for sale,
   with intent to deceive the purchaser.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 365. Trade Practices›Brands and Labels›KY REV ST 365.110. Unauthorized use of manufacturer's brand or name
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 365. Trade Practices › Brands and Labels › KY REV ST 365.110. Unauthorized use of manufacturer's brand or name
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 365.110. Unauthorized use of manufacturer's brand or name (2023)
content:
No dealer or merchant shall make or apply or cause to be made or applied to any parcel
   or package any kind or character of label bearing the brand or name of any manufacturer
   without the written authority of the manufacturer.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 365. Trade Practices›Miscellaneous›KY REV ST 365.210. Foreign corporations collecting and distributing news must furnish services to all newspapers without discrimination
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 365. Trade Practices › Miscellaneous › KY REV ST 365.210. Foreign corporations collecting and distributing news must furnish services to all newspapers without discrimination
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 365.210. Foreign corporations collecting and distributing news must furnish services to all newspapers without discrimination (2023)
content:
As a condition to carrying on any part of its business in this state, every foreign
   corporation formed for the purpose or engaged in the business of buying, gathering,
   accumulating, vending, supplying, distributing or publishing information or news shall
   at all times vend, supply, distribute and publish the news and information bought,
   gathered or accumulated by it to any person carrying on in this state the business
   of conducting or publishing a newspaper who desires to buy or be supplied with such
   news and information, and in vending, supplying, distributing and publishing such
   news and information no discrimination in charges or prices shall be made by the foreign
   corporation between any of such persons who desire to purchase or be supplied with
   the information and news.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 365. Trade Practices›Unfair Cigarette Sales Law›KY REV ST 365.260. Short title for KRS 365.260. to § 365.380
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 365. Trade Practices › Unfair Cigarette Sales Law › KY REV ST 365.260. Short title for KRS 365.260. to § 365.380
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 365.260. Short title for KRS 365.260. to § 365.380 (2023)
content:
KRS 365.260to365.380shall be known and may be cited as the “Act to Prevent Unfair Cigarette Sales in
   Kentucky.”

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 365. Trade Practices›Miscellaneous›KY REV ST 365.220. Request for news and offer to pay charges; no business to be done after refusal
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 365. Trade Practices › Miscellaneous › KY REV ST 365.220. Request for news and offer to pay charges; no business to be done after refusal
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 365.220. Request for news and offer to pay charges; no business to be done after refusal (2023)
content:
(1)  Any person carrying on in this state the business of conducting or publishing
      a newspaper may notify any foreign corporation of the kind referred to inKRS 365.210, or any agent of such corporation upon whom process can be served under the laws
      of this state, that he desires to purchase or be supplied with the news or information
      bought, gathered or accumulated by such corporation, and offer to pay the same charges
      or prices therefor that are exacted by such corporation from other persons carrying
      on in this state the business of conducting or publishing a newspaper.

content: (1)  The General Assembly hereby finds and declares as follows:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 365. Trade Practices›Unfair Cigarette Sales Law›KY REV ST 365.290. Combination sales
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 365. Trade Practices › Unfair Cigarette Sales Law › KY REV ST 365.290. Combination sales
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 365.290. Combination sales (2023)
content:
In all sales involving two (2) or more items, at least one (1) of which items is cigarettes,
   at a combined price, and in all sales involving the giving of any gift or concession
   of any kind, whether it be coupons or otherwise, the wholesaler's or retailer's combined
   selling price shall not be below the cost to the wholesaler or the cost to the retailer,
   respectively, of the total of all articles, products, commodities, gifts, and concessions
   included in the transactions, except that if any articles, products, commodities,
   gifts, or concessions, are not cigarettes, the basic cost thereof shall be determined
   in like manner as provided inKRS 365.270 (10).

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 365. Trade Practices›Miscellaneous›KY REV ST 365.230. Telegraph and telephone companies to furnish services to newspapers without discrimination
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 365. Trade Practices › Miscellaneous › KY REV ST 365.230. Telegraph and telephone companies to furnish services to newspapers without discrimination
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 365.230. Telegraph and telephone companies to furnish services to newspapers without discrimination (2023)
content:
Every telegraph company, telephone company, or other company engaged in buying, gathering
   or transmitting dispatches shall afford the same and equal facilities to all publishers
   of newspapers, and shall furnish all news or information collected by them for publication
   to all newspapers published in any one county or locality on the same conditions as
   to terms, payment and delivery.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 365. Trade Practices›Unfair Cigarette Sales Law›KY REV ST 365.300. Sales by wholesaler to any other wholesaler
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 365. Trade Practices › Unfair Cigarette Sales Law › KY REV ST 365.300. Sales by wholesaler to any other wholesaler
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 365.300. Sales by wholesaler to any other wholesaler (2023)
content:
When one (1) wholesaler sells cigarettes to any other wholesaler, the former shall
   not be required to include in his selling price to the latter, “cost to the wholesaler,”
   as provided byKRS 365.270(11), but the latter wholesaler, upon resale to a retailer, shall be subject to the provisions
   ofKRS 365.270(11).

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 365. Trade Practices›Unfair Cigarette Sales Law›KY REV ST 365.280. Sale at less than cost prohibited; fine
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 365. Trade Practices › Unfair Cigarette Sales Law › KY REV ST 365.280. Sale at less than cost prohibited; fine
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 365.280. Sale at less than cost prohibited; fine (2023)
content:
(1)  It shall be unlawful for any wholesaler or retailer to sell, at wholesale or
      retail, cigarettes at less than cost to the wholesaler or retailer, as the case may
      be, as defined inKRS 365.260to365.380, for the purpose of destroying competition or substantially lessening competition.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 365. Trade Practices›Unfair Cigarette Sales Law›KY REV ST 365.320. Transactions permitted to meet lawful competition
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 365. Trade Practices › Unfair Cigarette Sales Law › KY REV ST 365.320. Transactions permitted to meet lawful competition
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 365.320. Transactions permitted to meet lawful competition (2023)
content:
(1)  Any wholesaler may sell cigarettes to a regular customer at a price made in good
      faith to meet the legal price of a competitor selling to the same customer.  Any retailer may sell cigarettes at a price made in good faith to meet the legal
      price of a competitor.  The price of cigarettes sold under the exceptions specified inKRS 365.310shall not be considered the price of a competitor and shall not be used as a basis
      for establishing prices below cost, nor shall the price established at a bankruptcy
      sale be considered the price of a competitor within the purview of this section.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 365. Trade Practices›Unfair Cigarette Sales Law›KY REV ST 365.330. Sales contract made in violation of KRS 365.260. to 365.380. void
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 365. Trade Practices › Unfair Cigarette Sales Law › KY REV ST 365.330. Sales contract made in violation of KRS 365.260. to 365.380. void
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 365.330. Sales contract made in violation of KRS 365.260. to 365.380. void (2023)
content:
Any contract, express or implied, made by any person in violation of any of the provisions
   ofKRS 365.260to365.380, shall be void and no recovery shall be had thereon.

content: The provisions ofKRS 365.260to365.380shall not apply to a sale at wholesale or a sale at retail made:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 365. Trade Practices›Unfair Cigarette Sales Law›KY REV ST 365.350. Actions for violations or threatened violations; remedies; actual damages need not be alleged or proved; costs
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 365. Trade Practices › Unfair Cigarette Sales Law › KY REV ST 365.350. Actions for violations or threatened violations; remedies; actual damages need not be alleged or proved; costs
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 365.350. Actions for violations or threatened violations; remedies; actual damages need not be alleged or proved; costs (2023)
content:
(1)  The department, or any person injured by any violation, or who may suffer injury
      from any threatened violation ofKRS 365. 260 to 365.380, may maintain an action in any court of equitable jurisdiction to
      prevent, restrain, or enjoin the violation or threatened violation.  If a violation or threatened violation ofKRS 365.260to365.380shall be established, the court shall enjoin and restrain, or otherwise prohibit,
      the violations or threatened violation.  In addition, the court shall assess in favor of the plaintiff and against the defendant
      the cost of the suit, including reasonable attorney's fees.  It shall not be necessary that actual damages to the plaintiff be alleged or proved,
      but if alleged and proved, the plaintiff in the action, in addition to injunctive
      relief, the costs of the suit, and reasonable attorney's fees, shall be entitled to
      recover from the defendant the actual damages sustained by him.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 365. Trade Practices›Unfair Cigarette Sales Law›KY REV ST 365.340. Sales outside ordinary channels of business not to be used in establishing basic cost
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 365. Trade Practices › Unfair Cigarette Sales Law › KY REV ST 365.340. Sales outside ordinary channels of business not to be used in establishing basic cost
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 365.340. Sales outside ordinary channels of business not to be used in establishing basic cost (2023)
content:
In establishing the basic cost of cigarettes to a wholesaler or a retailer it shall
   not be permissible to use the invoice cost or the actual cost of any cigarettes purchased
   at a forced, bankrupt, or closeout sale, or other sale outside of the ordinary channels
   of trade.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 365. Trade Practices›Unfair Cigarette Sales Law›KY REV ST 365.360. Evidence admissible in determining cost to wholesaler and retailer; cost survey
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 365. Trade Practices › Unfair Cigarette Sales Law › KY REV ST 365.360. Evidence admissible in determining cost to wholesaler and retailer; cost survey
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 365.360. Evidence admissible in determining cost to wholesaler and retailer; cost survey (2023)
content:
(1)  In determining cost to the wholesaler and cost to the retailer, the court shall
      receive and consider as bearing on the bona fides of the cost, evidence tending to
      show that any person complained against under any of the provisions ofKRS 365.260to365.380purchased the cigarettes involved in the complaint, at a fictitious price, or upon
      the terms, or in a manner, or under such invoices, as to conceal the true cost, discounts
      or terms of the purchase, and shall also receive and consider as bearing on the bona
      fides of the cost, evidence of the normal, customary, and prevailing terms and discounts
      in connection with other sales of a similar nature in the trade area or state.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 365. Trade Practices›Unfair Cigarette Sales Law›KY REV ST 365.390. Payment of enforcement and administration fee by cigarette wholesaler; special account; fee deemed an additional cost
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 365. Trade Practices › Unfair Cigarette Sales Law › KY REV ST 365.390. Payment of enforcement and administration fee by cigarette wholesaler; special account; fee deemed an additional cost
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 365.390. Payment of enforcement and administration fee by cigarette wholesaler; special account; fee deemed an additional cost (2023)
content:
(1)  To provide for the enforcement ofKRS 138.146andKRS 365.260to365.380, every cigarette wholesaler licensed underKRS 138.195shall pay an enforcement and administration fee to the Department of Revenue on a
      monthly basis for each package of twenty (20) cigarettes to which evidence of Kentucky
      cigarette tax was affixed during the month as required byKRS 138.146.  The enforcement and administration fee to recover applicable costs shall be calculated
      annually by the commissioner of revenue who shall give notice thereof to licensed
      wholesalers who shall be liable for its payment.  Payments to the Department of Revenue shall be made according to provisions ofKRS 138.195and shall be subject to the same penalties and interest as levied on Kentucky cigarette
      tax not paid on or before the due date.

title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 365. Trade Practices › Unfair Cigarette Sales Law › KY REV ST 365.370. Powers and duties of department; appeals
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 365.370. Powers and duties of department; appeals (2023)
content:
(1)  The department shall promulgate administrative regulations for the enforcement
      ofKRS 365.260to365.380and may from time to time undertake and make or cause to be made one (1) or more
      cost surveys for the state or trading area or areas as it defines.  When each survey is made by or approved by the department, it may use the cost survey

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 365. Trade Practices›Unfair Cigarette Sales Law›KY REV ST 365.406. Penalties for violation of KRS 365.402. (Effective January 1, 2024)
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 365. Trade Practices › Unfair Cigarette Sales Law › KY REV ST 365.406. Penalties for violation of KRS 365.402. (Effective January 1, 2024)

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 365. Trade Practices›Fire, Removal and Other Sales of Merchandise›KY REV ST 365.425. Approval of Cabinet for Health and Family Services required
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade › Chapter 365. Trade Practices › Fire, Removal and Other Sales of Merchandise › KY REV ST 365.425. Approval of Cabinet for Health and Family Services required
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 365.425. Approval of Cabinet for Health and Family Services required (2023)
content:
No application for a going-out-of-business sale shall be accepted by the county clerk
   if the sale involves foods or drugs damaged by fire or other casualty unless the approval
   of the Cabinet for Health and Family Services has first been obtained.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXIX. Commerce and Trade›Chapter 365. Trade Practices›Unfair Cigarette Sales Law›KY REV ST 365.380. License
