path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations›Chapter 376. Statutory Liens›KY REV ST 376.281. Lien on aircraft for storage, repairs or accessories
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations › Chapter 376. Statutory Liens › KY REV ST 376.281. Lien on aircraft for storage, repairs or accessories
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 376.281. Lien on aircraft for storage, repairs or accessories (2023)
content:
As used inKRS 376.270and376.280, “motor vehicle” shall include vehicles used or designed for navigation of or flight
   in the air, as well as those used or designed for operation on the public highways.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations›Chapter 376. Statutory Liens›KY REV ST 376.272. Marina may enforce lien on boat asserted pursuant to KRS 376.270. by civil action
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations › Chapter 376. Statutory Liens › KY REV ST 376.272. Marina may enforce lien on boat asserted pursuant to KRS 376.270. by civil action
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 376.272. Marina may enforce lien on boat asserted pursuant to KRS 376.270. by civil action (2023)
content:
(1)  Any marina asserting a possessory lien pursuant toKRS 376.270may enforce the lien by filing a civil action in the county in which the boat is
      located.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations›Chapter 376. Statutory Liens›KY REV ST 376.300. Lien of dry cleaner, launderer, or tailor on article for work done; sale for charges; notification and criteria for sale
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations › Chapter 376. Statutory Liens › KY REV ST 376.300. Lien of dry cleaner, launderer, or tailor on article for work done; sale for charges; notification and criteria for sale
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 376.300. Lien of dry cleaner, launderer, or tailor on article for work done; sale for charges; notification and criteria for sale (2023)
content:
(1)  Any person who cleans, presses, glazes, launders, alters, or repairs any wearing
      apparel or household goods shall have a lien on the article remaining in his possession
      to secure the reasonable or agreed charge for the service.  If the charge is not paid within ninety (90) days, the article may be sold to pay
      the charges and costs of notice, after notice has been given the customer of the time
      and place of sale.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations›Chapter 376. Statutory Liens›KY REV ST 376.280. Sale of boat or motor vehicle for charges; advertisement of sale; definition of “boat”
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations › Chapter 376. Statutory Liens › KY REV ST 376.280. Sale of boat or motor vehicle for charges; advertisement of sale; definition of “boat”
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 376.280. Sale of boat or motor vehicle for charges; advertisement of sale; definition of “boat” (2023)
content:
(1)  Any boat or motor vehicle remaining in the possession of a person who has made
      repairs, performed labor or furnished accessories or supplies therefor and to whom
      the charges for such repairs, labor, accessories or supplies has been owing for a
      period of more than thirty (30) days, may be sold to pay such deferred purchase money
      or charges.  The proposed sale shall be advertised pursuant to KRS Chapter 424, and notice thereof
      shall be sent by certified mail, return receipt requested or by registered mail to
      the owner of the boat or motor vehicle and to any other person known to have any interest
      therein, addressed to such persons at their last known addresses, at least ten (10)
      days before the sale is held.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations›Chapter 376. Statutory Liens›KY REV ST 376.250. Withholding by public authority of funds due contractor and their payment to lien claimant; protest by contractor; suit by lien claimant
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations › Chapter 376. Statutory Liens › KY REV ST 376.250. Withholding by public authority of funds due contractor and their payment to lien claimant; protest by contractor; suit by lien claimant
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 376.250. Withholding by public authority of funds due contractor and their payment to lien claimant; protest by contractor; suit by lien claimant (2023)
content:
(1)  When an attested copy of the lien statement and proof of the delivery of an attested
      copy as provided inKRS 376.240is delivered to any public authority which has contracted for the construction or
      improvement of any bridge, public highway, or other public property owned by the state,
      a subdivision or agency thereof, or by any city, county, urban-county, or charter
      county government, the public authority shall endorse on the attested copy the date
      of its receipt, file the copy and deduct and withhold the amount thereof, plus pursuant
      toKRS 64.012to cover the fee of the county clerk for filing the statement and attesting a copy,
      from any amount then due the contractor, and if a sufficient amount is not then due
      the contractor from the next payments which become due.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations›Chapter 376. Statutory Liens›KY REV ST 376.270. Lien on motor vehicle for repairs, storage or accessories; filing of statement with county clerk
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations › Chapter 376. Statutory Liens › KY REV ST 376.270. Lien on motor vehicle for repairs, storage or accessories; filing of statement with county clerk
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 376.270. Lien on motor vehicle for repairs, storage or accessories; filing of statement with county clerk (2023)
content:
Any person engaged in the business of selling, repairing or furnishing accessories
   or supplies for motor vehicles shall have a lien on the motor vehicle for the reasonable
   or agreed charges for repairs, work done or accessories or supplies furnished for
   the vehicle, and for storing or keeping the vehicle, and may detain any motor vehicle
   in his possession on which work has been done by him until the reasonable or agreed
   charge therefor has been paid.  The lien shall not be lost by the removal of the motor vehicle from the garage or
   premises of the person performing labor, repairing or furnishing accessories or supplies
   therefor, if the lien shall be asserted within six (6) months by filing in the office
   of the county clerk a statement showing the amount and cost of materials furnished
   or labor performed on the vehicle.  The statement shall be filed in the same manner as provided in the case of a mechanic's
   and materialman's lien, after the removal of the vehicle, unless the owner of the
   vehicle consents to an additional extension of time, in which event the lien shall
   extend for the length of time the parties agree upon.  The agreement shall be reduced to writing and signed by the parties thereto.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations›Chapter 376. Statutory Liens›KY REV ST 376.310. Lien for storage and services on article prior to storage; sale for charges
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations › Chapter 376. Statutory Liens › KY REV ST 376.310. Lien for storage and services on article prior to storage; sale for charges
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 376.310. Lien for storage and services on article prior to storage; sale for charges (2023)
content:
(1)  Any person who keeps any wearing apparel or household goods in storage, or who
      has performed any of the services mentioned inKRS 376.300on such an article and then keeps it in storage, shall have a lien on the article
      as long as it remains in his possession.  If the reasonable or agreed charges have not been paid for a period of twelve (12)
      months the article may be sold to pay the charges, after the owner has been notified
      of the time and place of sale.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations›Chapter 376. Statutory Liens›KY REV ST 376.330. Posting of notices necessary to claim liens
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations › Chapter 376. Statutory Liens › KY REV ST 376.330. Posting of notices necessary to claim liens
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 376.330. Posting of notices necessary to claim liens (2023)
content:
No person shall obtain a lien underKRS 376.300or376.310unless at all times he keeps posted in prominent places in his receiving office two
   (2) notices which shall read as follows:  “All articles cleaned, pressed, glazed,
   laundered, washed, altered or repaired and not called for in 90 days will be sold
   to pay charges.  All articles stored 12 months on which charges have not been paid will be sold to
   pay charges.”

content: (1)  As used in this section, unless the context otherwise requires:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations›Chapter 376. Statutory Liens›KY REV ST 376.320. Notice of sale of article for charges; distribution of proceeds
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations › Chapter 376. Statutory Liens › KY REV ST 376.320. Notice of sale of article for charges; distribution of proceeds
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 376.320. Notice of sale of article for charges; distribution of proceeds (2023)
content:
(1)  The mailing of a registered letter with the return address marked thereon, addressed
      to the owner at the address given at the time of delivery of the article to the person
      rendering any service set out inKRS 376.300or376.310, stating the time and place of sale, shall constitute notice of the sale.  The notice shall be mailed at least fifteen (15) days before the date of sale.  The cost of mailing the letter shall be added to the charges.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations›Chapter 376. Statutory Liens›KY REV ST 376.340. Lien of keeper of hotel, inn, boarding house or house of private entertainment on personal property of guest for charges
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations › Chapter 376. Statutory Liens › KY REV ST 376.340. Lien of keeper of hotel, inn, boarding house or house of private entertainment on personal property of guest for charges
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 376.340. Lien of keeper of hotel, inn, boarding house or house of private entertainment on personal property of guest for charges (2023)
content:
Any keeper of a hotel, inn, boarding house or house of private entertainment shall
   have a lien on all baggage and other personal property owned and brought in by the
   person receiving board, nursing, care or attention from the landlord, for the contract
   price of the service received, or, if no contract price is set, for a reasonable price.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations›Chapter 376. Statutory Liens›KY REV ST 376.290. Lien on watches and jewelry for repairs; sale for charges
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations › Chapter 376. Statutory Liens › KY REV ST 376.290. Lien on watches and jewelry for repairs; sale for charges
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 376.290. Lien on watches and jewelry for repairs; sale for charges (2023)
content:
(1)  Any person performing work upon any watch, clock or jewelry for a price shall
      have a lien upon that article for the amount due for the work.  The lien shall include the value or agreed price of all materials furnished in connection
      with the work, whether added to the article or not.  The lien may be enforced by legal action or as hereafter provided.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations›Chapter 376. Statutory Liens›KY REV ST 376.350. Enforcement of lien on property of guest
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations › Chapter 376. Statutory Liens › KY REV ST 376.350. Enforcement of lien on property of guest
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 376.350. Enforcement of lien on property of guest (2023)
content:
Any person in whose favor a lien created byKRS 376.340exists may, before the District Court of the county where the debt was created, by
   himself, agent or attorney, make affidavit of the amount due him and in arrear for
   services to the person receiving them and describing, as nearly as possible, the baggage
   or other personal property owned and brought in by the guest.   The court shall then issue a warrant directed to the sheriff or any constable or
   town marshal of the county, authorizing him to levy upon and seize the property described
   in the affidavit for the amount due, with interest and costs.  If the property has been removed with the consent of the landlord, the lien shall
   not continue longer than ten (10) days from and after the removal.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations›Chapter 376. Statutory Liens›KY REV ST 376.360. Liens on steamboats and other vessels for work and supplies
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations › Chapter 376. Statutory Liens › KY REV ST 376.360. Liens on steamboats and other vessels for work and supplies
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 376.360. Liens on steamboats and other vessels for work and supplies (2023)
content:
(1)  Any officer or employee, except the captain, employed on board a steamboat, brig,
      schooner, sloop or model barge shall have a lien on the vessel or on the engine, tackle,
      furnishing and apparel for their wages, whether contracted for or earned in or out
      of this state, with priority therefor over any other debt due from the owner of the
      vessel, and over all other liens thereon.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations›Chapter 376. Statutory Liens›KY REV ST 376.390. Joinder of lienholders as plaintiffs; when lien may be enforced against purchaser without notice
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations › Chapter 376. Statutory Liens › KY REV ST 376.390. Joinder of lienholders as plaintiffs; when lien may be enforced against purchaser without notice
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 376.390. Joinder of lienholders as plaintiffs; when lien may be enforced against purchaser without notice (2023)
content:
(1)  Any person having a lien underKRS 376.360to376.380against a vessel may unite in an action to enforce the lien, and any person having
      a lien who is not so united may, by petition filed by leave of court, become a plaintiff
      in any action pending to enforce a lien without the issuing of additional process.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations›Chapter 376. Statutory Liens›KY REV ST 376.370. Liability for damage done by vessel
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations › Chapter 376. Statutory Liens › KY REV ST 376.370. Liability for damage done by vessel
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 376.370. Liability for damage done by vessel (2023)
content:
A steamboat or other vessel named inKRS 376.360and its owner shall be liable to the party injured for any damage done by her through
   the willful or negligent conduct of her officers or crew while acting for her as such.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations›Chapter 376. Statutory Liens›KY REV ST 376.380. Enforcement of lien and liability against vessel
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations › Chapter 376. Statutory Liens › KY REV ST 376.380. Enforcement of lien and liability against vessel
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 376.380. Enforcement of lien and liability against vessel (2023)
content: The lien given inKRS 376.360, and the liability provided for inKRS 376.370, may be enforced by attachment from the court having jurisdiction.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations›Chapter 376. Statutory Liens›KY REV ST 376.410. Enforcement of lien for care of livestock
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations › Chapter 376. Statutory Liens › KY REV ST 376.410. Enforcement of lien for care of livestock
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 376.410. Enforcement of lien for care of livestock (2023)
content:
Any person in whose favor a lien provided for inKRS 376.400exists may, before the District Court of the county where the cattle were fed or
   grazed, by himself or agent, make affidavit of the amount due him and in arrears for
   keeping and caring for the cattle, and describing as nearly as possible the cattle
   so kept by him.  The court shall then issue a warrant, directed to the sheriff or any constable or
   town marshal of the county, authorizing him to levy upon and seize the cattle for
   the amount due, with interest and costs.  If the cattle are removed with the consent and from the custody of the livery stable
   keeper or the person feeding or grazing them, the lien shall not continue longer than
   one (1) year from and after the removal, nor shall the lien in case of such removal
   be valid against a bona fide purchaser without notice at any time after the removal.  The warrant may be issued to a county other than that in which the cattle were fed
   or grazed, and the lien may also be enforced by action as in the case of other liens.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations›Chapter 376. Statutory Liens›KY REV ST 376.400. Lien of keeper of livery stable or agister for care of livestock; sale of livestock cared for; conditions
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations › Chapter 376. Statutory Liens › KY REV ST 376.400. Lien of keeper of livery stable or agister for care of livestock; sale of livestock cared for; conditions
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 376.400. Lien of keeper of livery stable or agister for care of livestock; sale of livestock cared for; conditions (2023)
content:
(1)  Any owner or keeper of a livery stable or other business providing for the care
      of animals, and a person feeding, grazing, or caring for any animal for compensation,
      shall, except as provided in subsection (2) of this section, have a lien for one (1)
      year upon the animal placed in the stable, kennel, or similar facility, or put out
      to be fed or grazed by the owner, for his or her reasonable charges for keeping, caring
      for, feeding, and grazing the animal.  The lien shall attach whether the animal is merely temporarily lodged, fed, grazed,
      and cared for, or is placed at the stable or other place or pasture for regular board.  The lien shall take priority over a lien created pursuant toKRS 376.420(1).

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations›Chapter 376. Statutory Liens›KY REV ST 376.990. Penalties
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations › Chapter 376. Statutory Liens › KY REV ST 376.990. Penalties
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 376.990. Penalties (2023)
content: (1)  Any person who violates the provisions of subsection (2) ofKRS 376.050shall be guilty of a Class D felony.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations›Chapter 376. Statutory Liens›KY REV ST 376.420. Lien for service fee of stallion, jack, or bull; enforcement of lien
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations › Chapter 376. Statutory Liens › KY REV ST 376.420. Lien for service fee of stallion, jack, or bull; enforcement of lien
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 376.420. Lien for service fee of stallion, jack, or bull; enforcement of lien (2023)
content:
(1)  Any licensed keeper of a stallion, jack, or bull shall have a lien for the payment
      of the service fee upon the get of the stallion, jack, or bull, for one (1) year after
      the birth of the progeny.  However, a lien created pursuant toKRS 376.400shall take priority over a lien created pursuant to this subsection.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations›Chapter 376. Statutory Liens›KY REV ST 376.440. Lien on equipment, machinery and motors for work and supplies; filing of lien statement
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations › Chapter 376. Statutory Liens › KY REV ST 376.440. Lien on equipment, machinery and motors for work and supplies; filing of lien statement
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 376.440. Lien on equipment, machinery and motors for work and supplies; filing of lien statement (2023)
content:
(1)  Any person engaged in the business of selling, repairing, or furnishing accessories,
      or supplies for any kind of equipment or machinery, including motors, shall have a
      lien on the equipment, machine, machinery, or motor, for the reasonable or agreed
      charges for repairs, work done, accessories, parts, and supplies furnished for the
      equipment, machine, machinery, or motor until the reasonable or agreed charge therefor
      has been paid.  The lien shall not be lost by the removal of the equipment, machine, machinery or
      motor from the premises of the person performing labor, repairing, or furnishing accessories,
      parts or supplies therefor, if the lien shall be asserted within three (3) months
      by filing in the office of the county clerk a statement showing the amount and cost
      of materials furnished or labor performed on the equipment, machine, machinery, or
      motor.  This statement shall be filed in the office of the county clerk of the county in
      which the owner of the equipment, machine, machinery, or motor resides, unless such
      owner be a nonresident, in which event the lien statement shall be filed in the office
      of the county clerk of the county in which such equipment, machine, machinery, or
      motor is at the time being kept or used.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations›Chapter 376. Statutory Liens›KY REV ST 376.430. Lien on radios, phonographs and other electrical or electronic devices, for repair
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations › Chapter 376. Statutory Liens › KY REV ST 376.430. Lien on radios, phonographs and other electrical or electronic devices, for repair
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 376.430. Lien on radios, phonographs and other electrical or electronic devices, for repair (2023)
content:
(1)  All persons, firms and corporations engaged in the business of repairing radios,
      phonographs, combinations thereof, automatic music instruments, refrigerators, televisions,
      electrical or electronic recording devices, and any and all portable electrical or
      electronic instruments or appliances shall have a lien upon such articles and appliances
      for the agreed or reasonable charge for parts, supplies, accessories and labor performed
      in their repair, said lien to attach upon completion of such repairs.  The lien may be enforced by legal action or as hereafter provided.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations›Chapter 376. Statutory Liens›KY REV ST 376.450. Lien inferior to mortgage or sale unless statement filed
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations › Chapter 376. Statutory Liens › KY REV ST 376.450. Lien inferior to mortgage or sale unless statement filed
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 376.450. Lien inferior to mortgage or sale unless statement filed (2023)
content:
The lien shall not take precedence over a mortgage or bona fide sale and delivery
   for value without notice, unless the person claiming the prior lien shall, before
   the recording of the mortgage, or before sale and delivery, file in the office of
   the county clerk a statement showing that he has furnished or expects to furnish labor,
   or materials, or parts, or supplies, and the amount in full thereof.  The lien shall not, as against the holder of a mortgage, or a purchaser for value,
   exceed the amount of the lien claimed, as set forth in the statement.  The statement shall in all other respects be in the form provided inKRS 376.445.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations›Chapter 378A . Kentucky Uniform Voidable Transactions Act›KY REV ST 378A.005. Short title
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations › Chapter 378A . Kentucky Uniform Voidable Transactions Act › KY REV ST 378A.005. Short title
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 378A.005. Short title (2023)
content: This chapter may be cited as the Kentucky Uniform Voidable Transactions Act.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations›Chapter 378A . Kentucky Uniform Voidable Transactions Act›KY REV ST 378A.020. Insolvency
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations › Chapter 378A . Kentucky Uniform Voidable Transactions Act › KY REV ST 378A.020. Insolvency
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 378A.020. Insolvency (2023)
content:
(1)  A debtor is insolvent if, at a fair valuation, the sum of the debtor's debts
      is greater than the sum of the debtor's assets.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations›Chapter 376. Statutory Liens›KY REV ST 376.445. Contents of lien statement; indorsement and filing by county clerk; fee
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations › Chapter 376. Statutory Liens › KY REV ST 376.445. Contents of lien statement; indorsement and filing by county clerk; fee
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 376.445. Contents of lien statement; indorsement and filing by county clerk; fee (2023)
content:
(1)  The lien statement referred to inKRS 376.440shall be construed to mean a statement in writing in which is stated the amount due
      the claimant, with all just credits and setoffs known to him, together with a description
      of the property intended to be covered by the lien sufficiently accurate to identify
      it and the name of the owner.  This statement shall be subscribed and sworn to by the person claiming the lien
      or by someone in his behalf.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations›Chapter 378A . Kentucky Uniform Voidable Transactions Act›KY REV ST 378A.050. Transfer or obligation voidable as to present creditor
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations › Chapter 378A . Kentucky Uniform Voidable Transactions Act › KY REV ST 378A.050. Transfer or obligation voidable as to present creditor
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 378A.050. Transfer or obligation voidable as to present creditor (2023)
content:
(1)  A transfer made or obligation incurred by a debtor is voidable as to a creditor
      whose claim arose before the transfer was made or the obligation was incurred if the
      debtor made the transfer or incurred the obligation without receiving a reasonably
      equivalent value in exchange for the transfer or obligation and the debtor was insolvent
      at the time or the debtor became insolvent as a result of the transfer or obligation.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations›Chapter 376. Statutory Liens›KY REV ST 376.460. Attorney's lien
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations › Chapter 376. Statutory Liens › KY REV ST 376.460. Attorney's lien
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 376.460. Attorney's lien (2023)
content:
Each attorney shall have a lien upon all claims, except those of the state, put into
   his hands for suit or collection or upon which suit has been instituted, for the amount
   of any fee agreed upon by the parties or, in the absence of such agreement, for a
   reasonable fee.  If the action is prosecuted to a recovery of money or property, the attorney shall
   have a lien upon the judgment recovered, legal costs excepted, for his fee.  If the records show the name of the attorney, the defendant shall be deemed to have
   notice of the lien.  If the parties in good faith and before judgment compromise or settle their controversy
   without the payment of money or other thing of value, the attorney for the plaintiff
   shall have no claim against the defendant for any part of his fee.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations›Chapter 376. Statutory Liens›KY REV ST 376.470. Veterinarian's lien
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations › Chapter 376. Statutory Liens › KY REV ST 376.470. Veterinarian's lien
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 376.470. Veterinarian's lien (2023)
content:
(1)  Any licensed veterinarian who performs professional services for an animal, by
      contract with, or by the written consent of, the owner or authorized agent shall have
      a lien on the animal to secure the cost of the service provided.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations›Chapter 376. Statutory Liens›KY REV ST 376.455. Sale of equipment, machinery or motor to pay charges
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations › Chapter 376. Statutory Liens › KY REV ST 376.455. Sale of equipment, machinery or motor to pay charges
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 376.455. Sale of equipment, machinery or motor to pay charges (2023)
content:
Any equipment, machine, machinery, motor or motors remaining in the possession of
   a person who has made repairs, furnished parts, performed labor, or furnished accessories
   or supplies for the equipment, machine, machinery, motor, or motors, for more than
   thirty (30) days, may be sold to pay the charges.  The proposed sale shall be advertised by publication pursuant to KRS Chapter 424.  The owner of the equipment, machine, machinery, motor or motors, shall be served
   with written notice of such proposed sale at least two (2) weeks before the date of
   such sale.  The notice may be in writing addressed to the owner at his last known address and
   sent by registered United States mail, postage prepaid.  Such written notice may be served upon the owner in any other mode generally recognized
   by the laws and practice before courts in this state.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations›Chapter 378A . Kentucky Uniform Voidable Transactions Act›KY REV ST 378A.090. Extinguishment of claim for relief
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations › Chapter 378A . Kentucky Uniform Voidable Transactions Act › KY REV ST 378A.090. Extinguishment of claim for relief
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 378A.090. Extinguishment of claim for relief (2023)
content:
A claim for relief with respect to a transfer or obligation under this chapter is
   extinguished unless action is brought:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations›Chapter 378A . Kentucky Uniform Voidable Transactions Act›KY REV ST 378A.100. Governing law
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations › Chapter 378A . Kentucky Uniform Voidable Transactions Act › KY REV ST 378A.100. Governing law
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 378A.100. Governing law (2023)
content: (1)  In this section, the following rules determine a debtor's location:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations›Chapter 376. Statutory Liens›KY REV ST 376.475. Filing requirement; indexing; dissolution for nonenforcement
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations › Chapter 376. Statutory Liens › KY REV ST 376.475. Filing requirement; indexing; dissolution for nonenforcement
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 376.475. Filing requirement; indexing; dissolution for nonenforcement (2023)
content:
(1)  Any lien provided for inKRS 376.470shall be dissolved unless the claimant, within six (6) months after he ceases to
      provide services for the animal, files in the office of the county clerk of the county
      in which the animal is located, a statement of the amount due him, together with a
      description of the animal intended to be covered by the lien sufficiently accurate
      to identify it, the name of the owner, and whether the services were furnished by
      contract or written consent of the owner or agent.  This statement shall be subscribed and sworn to by the person claiming the lien
      or by someone in his behalf.  The claimant shall send by regular mail a copy of the statement to the owner at
      his last known address within seven (7) days of filing the statement with the county
      clerk.  Any lien provided for inKRS 376.470shall be dissolved if a copy of the statement is not sent to the property owner as
      provided in this subsection.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations›Chapter 378A . Kentucky Uniform Voidable Transactions Act›KY REV ST 378A.010. Definitions for chapter
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations › Chapter 378A . Kentucky Uniform Voidable Transactions Act › KY REV ST 378A.010. Definitions for chapter
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 378A.010. Definitions for chapter (2023)
content: As used in this chapter:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations›Chapter 376. Statutory Liens›KY REV ST 376.480. Lien for rent due on space for parking abandoned house trailer or mobile home; sale of abandoned property
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations › Chapter 376. Statutory Liens › KY REV ST 376.480. Lien for rent due on space for parking abandoned house trailer or mobile home; sale of abandoned property
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 376.480. Lien for rent due on space for parking abandoned house trailer or mobile home; sale of abandoned property (2023)
content:
(1)  Any owner of real property who rents space on which a house trailer or mobile
      home is parked shall have a lien for rent due on any house trailer or mobile home,
      its contents, and other personalty abandoned by the occupant on the landowner's property
      for rent due, reasonable storage, cleanup costs, and utilities furnished to the unit
      and paid for by the landowner.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations›Chapter 379. Voluntary Assignments›KY REV ST 379.020. Deed of assignment; recordation; effect of deed; schedule of assignor
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations › Chapter 379. Voluntary Assignments › KY REV ST 379.020. Deed of assignment; recordation; effect of deed; schedule of assignor
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 379.020. Deed of assignment; recordation; effect of deed; schedule of assignor (2023)
content:
(1)  The deed of assignment shall be acknowledged by the assignor in the same manner
      as other deeds and shall be recorded in the county clerk's office of the county where
      the assignor resides, where the business in respect to which the deed is made is carried
      on, and in each county where a tract of land or the greater part thereof conveyed
      by the deed is situated.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations›Chapter 379. Voluntary Assignments›KY REV ST 379.010. Voluntary assignments for benefit of creditors; preferred claims
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations › Chapter 379. Voluntary Assignments › KY REV ST 379.010. Voluntary assignments for benefit of creditors; preferred claims
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 379.010. Voluntary assignments for benefit of creditors; preferred claims (2023)
content:
(1)  Every voluntary assignment made by a debtor to any person in trust for his creditors
      shall be for the benefit of all his creditors, except as provided in subsections (2)
      and (3) of this section, in proportion to their respective claims after the payment
      of the expenses of the trust.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations›Chapter 378A . Kentucky Uniform Voidable Transactions Act›KY REV ST 378A.070. Remedies of creditor
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations › Chapter 378A . Kentucky Uniform Voidable Transactions Act › KY REV ST 378A.070. Remedies of creditor
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 378A.070. Remedies of creditor (2023)
content:
(1)  In an action for relief against a transfer or obligation under this chapter,
      a creditor, subject to the limitations inKRS 378A.080, may obtain:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations›Chapter 378A . Kentucky Uniform Voidable Transactions Act›KY REV ST 378A.040. Transfer or obligation voidable as to present or future creditor
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations › Chapter 378A . Kentucky Uniform Voidable Transactions Act › KY REV ST 378A.040. Transfer or obligation voidable as to present or future creditor
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 378A.040. Transfer or obligation voidable as to present or future creditor (2023)
content:
(1)  A transfer made or obligation incurred by a debtor is voidable as to a creditor,
      whether the creditor's claim arose before or after the transfer was made or the obligation
      was incurred, if the debtor made the transfer or incurred the obligation:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations›Chapter 378A . Kentucky Uniform Voidable Transactions Act›KY REV ST 378A.080. Defenses, liability, and protection of transferee or obligee
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations › Chapter 378A . Kentucky Uniform Voidable Transactions Act › KY REV ST 378A.080. Defenses, liability, and protection of transferee or obligee
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 378A.080. Defenses, liability, and protection of transferee or obligee (2023)
content:
(1)  A transfer or obligation is not voidable underKRS 378A.040(1)(a)against a person that took in good faith and for a reasonably equivalent value given
      the debtor or against any subsequent transferee or obligee.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations›Chapter 378A . Kentucky Uniform Voidable Transactions Act›KY REV ST 378A.060. When transfer is made or obligation is incurred
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations › Chapter 378A . Kentucky Uniform Voidable Transactions Act › KY REV ST 378A.060. When transfer is made or obligation is incurred
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 378A.060. When transfer is made or obligation is incurred (2023)
content: For the purposes of this chapter:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations›Chapter 378A . Kentucky Uniform Voidable Transactions Act›KY REV ST 378A.030. Value
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations › Chapter 378A . Kentucky Uniform Voidable Transactions Act › KY REV ST 378A.030. Value
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 378A.030. Value (2023)
content:
(1)  Value is given for a transfer or an obligation if, in exchange for the transfer
      or obligation, property is transferred or an antecedent debt is secured or satisfied,
      but value does not include an unperformed promise made otherwise than in the ordinary
      course of the promisor's business to furnish support to the debtor or another person.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations›Chapter 378A . Kentucky Uniform Voidable Transactions Act›KY REV ST 378A.120. Supplementary provisions
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations › Chapter 378A . Kentucky Uniform Voidable Transactions Act › KY REV ST 378A.120. Supplementary provisions
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 378A.120. Supplementary provisions (2023)
content:
Unless displaced by the provisions of this chapter, the principles of law and equity,
   including the law merchant and the law relating to principal and agent, estoppel,
   laches, fraud, misrepresentation, duress, coercion, mistake, insolvency, or other
   validating or invalidating cause, supplement its provisions.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations›Chapter 378A . Kentucky Uniform Voidable Transactions Act›KY REV ST 378A.110. Application to series organization
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations › Chapter 378A . Kentucky Uniform Voidable Transactions Act › KY REV ST 378A.110. Application to series organization
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 378A.110. Application to series organization (2023)
content: (1)  In this section:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations›Chapter 379. Voluntary Assignments›KY REV ST 379.040. Resignation or removal of assignee
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations › Chapter 379. Voluntary Assignments › KY REV ST 379.040. Resignation or removal of assignee
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 379.040. Resignation or removal of assignee (2023)
content:
(1)  An assignee may resign his trust upon settling his accounts, and the settlement
      shall be confirmed and the assignee discharged from liability sixty (60) days after
      the settlement has been filed, if no exceptions are filed thereto.  If exceptions are filed, they shall be heard and determined by the court.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations›Chapter 379. Voluntary Assignments›KY REV ST 379.030. Bond of assignee; appointment of another on failure to qualify; on failure to furnish additional security
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations › Chapter 379. Voluntary Assignments › KY REV ST 379.030. Bond of assignee; appointment of another on failure to qualify; on failure to furnish additional security
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 379.030. Bond of assignee; appointment of another on failure to qualify; on failure to furnish additional security (2023)
content:
(1)  The assignee shall, when the deed of assignment is lodged for record or within
      seven (7) days thereafter, execute a bond with good security, approved by the District
      Court, conditioned upon the faithful discharge of his duties as assignee.  The bond shall be recorded in the court clerk's office.  If the person named in the deed as assignee fails for any cause within the time
      named to qualify or to execute a sufficient bond, the District Court shall, by order
      entered of record, appoint an assignee who shall, within five (5) days, give bond
      with good surety, and who shall thereupon be vested with the same rights, powers and
      responsibilities with respect to the estate assigned as if named in the deed.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations›Chapter 379. Voluntary Assignments›KY REV ST 379.050. Supervision of assignee by District Court; exception; filing of inventory of assignee
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations › Chapter 379. Voluntary Assignments › KY REV ST 379.050. Supervision of assignee by District Court; exception; filing of inventory of assignee
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 379.050. Supervision of assignee by District Court; exception; filing of inventory of assignee (2023)
content:
(1)  The assignee shall, except as provided inKRS 379.170, be subject to the orders and supervision of the District Court and may be required
      at any time upon reasonable notice to file any report ordered.  He may, when the court so directs, be examined in open court touching the condition
      of the estate and its management.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations›Chapter 379. Voluntary Assignments›KY REV ST 379.060. Proceedings, orders and summons of the court; attendance of assignor or his debtors
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations › Chapter 379. Voluntary Assignments › KY REV ST 379.060. Proceedings, orders and summons of the court; attendance of assignor or his debtors
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 379.060. Proceedings, orders and summons of the court; attendance of assignor or his debtors (2023)
content:
(1)  All orders and proceedings in the District Court, except as otherwise provided,
      shall be ex parte and upon motion, and in no case need a petition be filed.  A notice or summons shall not be issued to any person unless ordered by the court
      or requested by a person in interest.  If an exception is filed to a claim or report, the party affected thereby shall
      have ten (10) days' notice of the time of hearing.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations›Chapter 378A . Kentucky Uniform Voidable Transactions Act›KY REV ST 378A.130. Uniformity of application and construction
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations › Chapter 378A . Kentucky Uniform Voidable Transactions Act › KY REV ST 378A.130. Uniformity of application and construction
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 378A.130. Uniformity of application and construction (2023)
content:
This chapter shall be applied and construed to effectuate its general purpose to make
   uniform the law with respect to the subject of this chapter among states enacting
   it.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations›Chapter 379. Voluntary Assignments›KY REV ST 379.070. Preferential or fraudulent transfer or purchase prior to deed of assignment; effect; action by assignee or creditor
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations › Chapter 379. Voluntary Assignments › KY REV ST 379.070. Preferential or fraudulent transfer or purchase prior to deed of assignment; effect; action by assignee or creditor
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 379.070. Preferential or fraudulent transfer or purchase prior to deed of assignment; effect; action by assignee or creditor (2023)
content:
If the assignor has, before making the deed of assignment, made a preferential or
   fraudulent transfer, conveyance or gift of any of his property or a fraudulent purchase
   of any property in the name of another, the property fraudulently transferred, conveyed,
   given or purchased shall vest in the assignee.  The assignee shall institute the proceedings necessary to recover the property so
   disposed of, using any remedy which a creditor might exercise.  If the assignee upon demand refuses to institute such proceedings, any creditor
   may do so, and the property recovered shall become a part of the estate and be distributed
   as other assets.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations›Chapter 379. Voluntary Assignments›KY REV ST 379.080. Exemptions claimed by assignor; proceedings
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations › Chapter 379. Voluntary Assignments › KY REV ST 379.080. Exemptions claimed by assignor; proceedings
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 379.080. Exemptions claimed by assignor; proceedings (2023)
content:
(1)  If the assignor reserves any of his property as exempt, the court shall appoint
      three (3) competent and disinterested housekeepers, who, after being first duly sworn,
      shall set apart to the debtor the property exempt, and within ten (10) days thereafter
      the assignee shall file a report thereon.  Exceptions may be filed to the report by any person in interest but not later than
      sixty (60) days after the report has been filed.  The court shall hear and dispose of any exceptions and if none are filed it shall
      confirm the report.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations›Chapter 378A . Kentucky Uniform Voidable Transactions Act›KY REV ST 378A.140. Relation to Electronic Signatures in Global and National Commerce Act
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations › Chapter 378A . Kentucky Uniform Voidable Transactions Act › KY REV ST 378A.140. Relation to Electronic Signatures in Global and National Commerce Act
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 378A.140. Relation to Electronic Signatures in Global and National Commerce Act (2023)
content:
This chapter modifies, limits, or supersedes the Electronic Signatures in Global and
   National Commerce Act,15 U.S.C. secs. 7001 et seq.,but does not modify, limit, or supersede Section 101(c) of that Act,15 U.S.C. sec. 7001(c), or authorize electronic delivery of any of the notices described in Section 103(B)
   of that Act,15 U.S.C. sec. 7003(b).

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations›Chapter 379. Voluntary Assignments›KY REV ST 379.110. Compromise or sale of debts due or claims against estate
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations › Chapter 379. Voluntary Assignments › KY REV ST 379.110. Compromise or sale of debts due or claims against estate
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 379.110. Compromise or sale of debts due or claims against estate (2023)
content:
If it appears to be to the interest of the estate, the court may enter an order directing
   the assignee to sell, compound or compromise any debt due the estate, or to compromise
   any claim against the estate, but no such order shall be made within thirty (30) days
   after the application therefor has been made and filed.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations›Chapter 379. Voluntary Assignments›KY REV ST 379.120. Allowance or rejection of claims by assignee; report to court; exceptions; court determination
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations › Chapter 379. Voluntary Assignments › KY REV ST 379.120. Allowance or rejection of claims by assignee; report to court; exceptions; court determination
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 379.120. Allowance or rejection of claims by assignee; report to court; exceptions; court determination (2023)
content:
The assignee may administer oaths and examine witnesses concerning claims, and may
   allow or refuse to allow any claim or part thereof.  He shall file in the District Court, within six (6) months after his appointment
   and every three (3) months thereafter until discharged, a list of all claims presented
   to him, together with his reasons for refusing any claim not allowed, and sixty (60)
   days thereafter the report shall be confirmed unless exceptions to it are filed.  Any creditor may file exceptions to the report because of the failure to allow his
   claim, or because of the allowance of any claim, and the court shall hear and determine
   the exceptions.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations›Chapter 379. Voluntary Assignments›KY REV ST 379.090. Sale of property by assignee
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations › Chapter 379. Voluntary Assignments › KY REV ST 379.090. Sale of property by assignee
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 379.090. Sale of property by assignee (2023)
content:
(1)  Personal property conveyed by the deed of assignment shall be sold by the assignee
      at private or public sale as the court may direct, and the assignee may pass title
      as fully as the assignor could have done at the date of the assignment.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations›Chapter 379. Voluntary Assignments›KY REV ST 379.150. Settlement or compromise by assignor with creditors to be filed in court; assignee discharged
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations › Chapter 379. Voluntary Assignments › KY REV ST 379.150. Settlement or compromise by assignor with creditors to be filed in court; assignee discharged
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 379.150. Settlement or compromise by assignor with creditors to be filed in court; assignee discharged (2023)
content:
If the assignor settles or compromises with his creditors before the final discharge
   of the assignee or settlement of the estate, the writing showing the settlement or
   compromise shall be filed in the District Court and an order made discharging the
   assignee.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations›Chapter 379. Voluntary Assignments›KY REV ST 379.100. Receipt of claims by assignee; notice of; filing
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations › Chapter 379. Voluntary Assignments › KY REV ST 379.100. Receipt of claims by assignee; notice of; filing
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 379.100. Receipt of claims by assignee; notice of; filing (2023)
content:
The assignee shall, within two (2) months after his appointment, give notice of the
   time and place where he will sit to receive claims against the estate.  The notice shall be by publication pursuant to KRS Chapter 424.  Creditors not residing in the county where the assignee qualifies shall be notified
   by mailing notice to their last known address.  Any creditor failing to present his claim at the time named or within three (3)
   months thereafter, verified in the same manner as a claim against the estate of a
   decedent except that it need not be verified by a person other than the claimant,
   shall waive his right to any part of the assigned estate.  However, the court may direct the assignee to receive a claim at any time before
   the final distribution of the estate, and allow it and pay dividends thereon as on
   other claims, if there are sufficient unappropriated assets in his hands.  Claims not due shall be presented in the same manner as claims due, but if claims
   not due are not bearing interest a just abatement shall be made.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations›Chapter 379. Voluntary Assignments›KY REV ST 379.130. Distribution; when to be made; report on; exceptions; court determination
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations › Chapter 379. Voluntary Assignments › KY REV ST 379.130. Distribution; when to be made; report on; exceptions; court determination
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 379.130. Distribution; when to be made; report on; exceptions; court determination (2023)
content:
As soon as practicable and within nine (9) months after his appointment, the assignee
   shall pay upon the claims allowed such an amount as the means on hand permit, after
   deducting expenses and his allowance, which shall be fixed by the court.  He shall thereafter, when he has funds sufficient to pay five (5) percent on the
   claims allowed, distribute that amount.  Within fifteen (15) days after each distribution he shall file in court a report
   of the same, which shall lie over until the second regular term and if no exceptions
   are filed it shall then be confirmed.  If exceptions are filed, they shall be heard and determined by the court.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations›Chapter 379. Voluntary Assignments›KY REV ST 379.160. Appeals from judgments
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations › Chapter 379. Voluntary Assignments › KY REV ST 379.160. Appeals from judgments
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 379.160. Appeals from judgments (2023)
content:
An appeal may be taken from the judgment of the District Court overruling or sustaining
   an exception by the assignor, assignee or any party in interest, to the Circuit Court.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations›Chapter 379. Voluntary Assignments›KY REV ST 379.140. Discharge of assignee; notice; proceedings
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations › Chapter 379. Voluntary Assignments › KY REV ST 379.140. Discharge of assignee; notice; proceedings
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 379.140. Discharge of assignee; notice; proceedings (2023)
content:
The assignee may, when he believes it is no longer to the interest of the estate to
   keep the assignment open, move the District Court to discharge him from the trust
   and release him from all liability.  He shall have notice of his application to discharge published pursuant to KRS Chapter
   424.  Sixty (60) days after the motion is entered, the court shall, upon proof that the
   required notice was given, enter an order discharging the assignee from his trust
   and releasing him from all liability, unless objection is made.  If objection is made, the court shall hear the same and make such orders as are
   proper.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations›Chapter 380. Debt Adjusting›KY REV ST 380.120. Waiver of debtor’s rights void and unenforceable
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations › Chapter 380. Debt Adjusting › KY REV ST 380.120. Waiver of debtor’s rights void and unenforceable
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 380.120. Waiver of debtor’s rights void and unenforceable (2023)
content:
Any waiver by the debtor of rights or protections provided in this chapter is contrary
   to public policy, is void and unenforceable, and will not relieve the debt adjuster
   of any obligation placed upon the debt adjuster by this chapter.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations›Chapter 380. Debt Adjusting›KY REV ST 380.010. Definitions for chapter
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations › Chapter 380. Debt Adjusting › KY REV ST 380.010. Definitions for chapter
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 380.010. Definitions for chapter (2023)
content: As used in this chapter, the following terms mean:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations›Chapter 379. Voluntary Assignments›KY REV ST 379.170. Circuit court has jurisdiction of action for settlement of estate
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations › Chapter 379. Voluntary Assignments › KY REV ST 379.170. Circuit court has jurisdiction of action for settlement of estate
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 379.170. Circuit court has jurisdiction of action for settlement of estate (2023)
content:
(1)  The provisions ofKRS 379.010to379.160shall not prevent an action to settle an estate by the assignee, or by any creditor
      or creditors representing one-fourth (1/4) of the liabilities, from being brought
      in the Circuit Court.  When an action involving a settlement of the estate is brought in the Circuit Court
      of the county in which the assignment was made, the jurisdiction of the District Court
      shall cease, and all papers relating to the estate filed in the District Court shall
      be transferred by the clerk of the Circuit Court to the files of the Circuit Court.  The Circuit Court may exercise any power conferred on the District Court byKRS 379.010to379.160in administering and settling the assigned estate.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations›Chapter 380. Debt Adjusting›KY REV ST 380.030. Persons exempt from classification as debt adjuster
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations › Chapter 380. Debt Adjusting › KY REV ST 380.030. Persons exempt from classification as debt adjuster
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 380.030. Persons exempt from classification as debt adjuster (2023)
content:
The following persons shall not be considered debt adjusters for the purposes of this
   chapter:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations›Chapter 380. Debt Adjusting›KY REV ST 380.050. Administrative regulations governing debt adjusting
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations › Chapter 380. Debt Adjusting › KY REV ST 380.050. Administrative regulations governing debt adjusting
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 380.050. Administrative regulations governing debt adjusting (2023)
content:
The Attorney General shall promulgate administrative regulations in accordance with
   KRS Chapter 13A to ensure the proper administration and enforcement of this chapter.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations›Chapter 380. Debt Adjusting›KY REV ST 380.070. Debt adjuster to take reasonable measures to protect debtor’s personal information
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations › Chapter 380. Debt Adjusting › KY REV ST 380.070. Debt adjuster to take reasonable measures to protect debtor’s personal information
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 380.070. Debt adjuster to take reasonable measures to protect debtor’s personal information (2023)
content: (1)  A debt adjuster shall take reasonable measures to:

title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations › Chapter 380. Debt Adjusting › KY REV ST 380.040. Persons engaged in debt adjusting; powers and prohibitions; requirements for registration, audits, insurance, and bond or letter of credit; increase in amount of bond or insurance when debt is primarily for personal use
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 380.040. Persons engaged in debt adjusting; powers and prohibitions; requirements for registration, audits, insurance, and bond or letter of credit; increase in amount of bond or insurance when debt is primarily for personal use (2023)
content:
(1)  Subject to subsection (3) of this section, a person, whether or not located in

      any money or other thing of value, other than the fees permitted by this chapter,
      for the purpose of disbursing the money or thing of value to the debtor's creditors,
      shall do both of the following:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXI. Debtor-Creditor Relations›Chapter 380. Debt Adjusting›KY REV ST 380.100. Agreement for debt adjusting; contents; right to confer power of attorney upon debt adjuster; prohibited provisions
