path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386A. Kentucky Uniform Statutory Trust Act (2012)›Subchapter 4. Series›KY REV ST 386A.4-070. Effect of dissolution of a series
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386A. Kentucky Uniform Statutory Trust Act (2012) › Subchapter 4. Series › KY REV ST 386A.4-070. Effect of dissolution of a series
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386A.4-070. Effect of dissolution of a series (2023)
content:
(1)  A dissolved series continues its existence as a series, but may not carry on

title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386A. Kentucky Uniform Statutory Trust Act (2012) › Subchapter 6. Beneficiaries and Beneficial Rights › KY REV ST 386A.6-040. Distribution to beneficial owner
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386A.6-040. Distribution to beneficial owner (2023)
content:
(1)  Any distribution by a statutory trust before dissolution shall be made in proportion
      to the beneficial interests.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386A. Kentucky Uniform Statutory Trust Act (2012)›Subchapter 6. Beneficiaries and Beneficial Rights›KY REV ST 386A.6-030. Contribution by beneficial owner
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386A. Kentucky Uniform Statutory Trust Act (2012) › Subchapter 6. Beneficiaries and Beneficial Rights › KY REV ST 386A.6-030. Contribution by beneficial owner
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386A.6-030. Contribution by beneficial owner (2023)
content:
(1)  A contribution of a beneficial owner to a statutory trust may be in cash, property,
      or services rendered or a promissory note or other obligation to contribute cash or
      property or to perform services.  A person may become a beneficial owner of a statutory trust and may receive a beneficial
      interest in a statutory trust without making or being obligated to make a contribution
      to the trust.

content:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386A. Kentucky Uniform Statutory Trust Act (2012)›Subchapter 5. Trustees and Trust Management›KY REV ST 386A.5-050. Trustee duties
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386A. Kentucky Uniform Statutory Trust Act (2012) › Subchapter 5. Trustees and Trust Management › KY REV ST 386A.5-050. Trustee duties
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386A.5-050. Trustee duties (2023)
content:
(1)  Subject toKRS 386A.5-010(2), in exercising the powers of trusteeship, a trustee shall act in good faith, on an
      informed basis, and in a manner the trustee reasonably believes to be in the best
      interests of the statutory trust.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386A. Kentucky Uniform Statutory Trust Act (2012)›Subchapter 5. Trustees and Trust Management›KY REV ST 386A.5-060. Good faith reliance

citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386A.5-060. Good faith reliance (2023)
content:
(1)  A trustee, officer, employee, manager, committee of a statutory trust, or other
      person designated pursuant toKRS 386A.1-030(4)(h)shall be entitled to rely on information, opinions, reports, or statements, including
      financial statements and other financial data, if prepared or presented by:

content: (1)  Subject toKRS 386A.1-040(2)(q), a statutory trust may:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386A. Kentucky Uniform Statutory Trust Act (2012)›Subchapter 5. Trustees and Trust Management›KY REV ST 386A.5-080. Trustee's right to information
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386A. Kentucky Uniform Statutory Trust Act (2012) › Subchapter 5. Trustees and Trust Management › KY REV ST 386A.5-080. Trustee's right to information
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386A.5-080. Trustee's right to information (2023)
content:
A trustee has the right to receive from a statutory trust or another trustee information
   relating to the affairs of the trust which is reasonably related to the trustee's
   discharge of the trustee's duties as trustee.  The trustee may enforce this right to information by summary proceeding in the appropriate
   court.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386A. Kentucky Uniform Statutory Trust Act (2012)›Subchapter 6. Beneficiaries and Beneficial Rights›KY REV ST 386A.6-050. Redemption of beneficial interest
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386A. Kentucky Uniform Statutory Trust Act (2012) › Subchapter 6. Beneficiaries and Beneficial Rights › KY REV ST 386A.6-050. Redemption of beneficial interest
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386A.6-050. Redemption of beneficial interest (2023)
content:
On the terms set forth in the governing instrument, a statutory trust may acquire,
   by purchase, redemption, or otherwise, any beneficial interest in the trust, including
   a beneficial interest associated with a series thereof.  A beneficial interest acquired under this section is canceled.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386A. Kentucky Uniform Statutory Trust Act (2012)›Subchapter 5. Trustees and Trust Management›KY REV ST 386A.5-120. Independent trustee in registered investment company
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386A. Kentucky Uniform Statutory Trust Act (2012) › Subchapter 5. Trustees and Trust Management › KY REV ST 386A.5-120. Independent trustee in registered investment company
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386A.5-120. Independent trustee in registered investment company (2023)
content: (1)  In this section, “affiliated person” and “interested person” have the meanings set forth in the Investment Company Act of 1940,Pub. L. No. 76-7681, as amended, or any successor statute and any regulations issued thereunder.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386A. Kentucky Uniform Statutory Trust Act (2012)›Subchapter 6. Beneficiaries and Beneficial Rights›KY REV ST 386A.6-080. Distributions
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386A. Kentucky Uniform Statutory Trust Act (2012) › Subchapter 6. Beneficiaries and Beneficial Rights › KY REV ST 386A.6-080. Distributions
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386A.6-080. Distributions (2023)
content:
(1)  Subject to any restriction in the governing instrument and the limitations in
      subsection (3) of this section, the trustees may authorize and the statutory trust
      may make distributions to its beneficial owners, including distributions to the beneficial
      owners associated with a series out of property of or associated with a series.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386A. Kentucky Uniform Statutory Trust Act (2012)›Subchapter 6. Beneficiaries and Beneficial Rights›KY REV ST 386A.6-100. Beneficial owner's right to information
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386A. Kentucky Uniform Statutory Trust Act (2012) › Subchapter 6. Beneficiaries and Beneficial Rights › KY REV ST 386A.6-100. Beneficial owner's right to information
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386A.6-100. Beneficial owner's right to information (2023)
content:
(1)  A beneficial owner has the right to receive from the statutory trust or a trustee
      information relating to the affairs of a statutory trust which is reasonably related
      to the beneficial owner's interest.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386A. Kentucky Uniform Statutory Trust Act (2012)›Subchapter 6. Beneficiaries and Beneficial Rights›KY REV ST 386A.6-070. Transaction with beneficial owner
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386A. Kentucky Uniform Statutory Trust Act (2012) › Subchapter 6. Beneficiaries and Beneficial Rights › KY REV ST 386A.6-070. Transaction with beneficial owner
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386A.6-070. Transaction with beneficial owner (2023)
content:
Subject toKRS 386A.5-070, a beneficial owner may lend money to, borrow money from, act as a surety, guarantor,
   or endorser for, guarantee or assume an obligation of, provide collateral for, or
   do other business with the statutory trust and, subject to law other than this chapter,
   has the same rights and obligations with respect to those matters as a person that
   is not a beneficial owner.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386A. Kentucky Uniform Statutory Trust Act (2012)›Subchapter 6. Beneficiaries and Beneficial Rights›KY REV ST 386A.6-010. Beneficial interest
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386A. Kentucky Uniform Statutory Trust Act (2012) › Subchapter 6. Beneficiaries and Beneficial Rights › KY REV ST 386A.6-010. Beneficial interest
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386A.6-010. Beneficial interest (2023)
content:
(1)  A beneficial interest in a statutory trust is personal property regardless of
      the nature of the property of the trust.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386A. Kentucky Uniform Statutory Trust Act (2012)›Subchapter 6. Beneficiaries and Beneficial Rights›KY REV ST 386A.6-060. Charging order
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386A. Kentucky Uniform Statutory Trust Act (2012) › Subchapter 6. Beneficiaries and Beneficial Rights › KY REV ST 386A.6-060. Charging order
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386A.6-060. Charging order (2023)
content:
(1)  If a beneficial interest is not freely transferable by a beneficial owner so
      that the transferee has all rights of the transferor, this section provides the exclusive
      remedy by which the judgment creditor of a beneficial owner or a transferee of a beneficial
      owner may satisfy a judgment out of the judgment debtor's beneficial interest.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386A. Kentucky Uniform Statutory Trust Act (2012)›Subchapter 6. Beneficiaries and Beneficial Rights›KY REV ST 386A.6-090. Liability for unlawful transactions
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386A. Kentucky Uniform Statutory Trust Act (2012) › Subchapter 6. Beneficiaries and Beneficial Rights › KY REV ST 386A.6-090. Liability for unlawful transactions
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386A.6-090. Liability for unlawful transactions (2023)
content:
(1)  A trustee who votes for or assents to a distribution made in violation ofKRS 386A.6-080shall be personally liable to the statutory trust for the amount of the distribution
      that exceeds what could have been distributed without violatingKRS 386A.6-080if it is established that the trustee did not perform his or her duties in compliance
      withKRS 386A.5-050.  In any proceeding commenced under this section, a trustee shall have all of the
      defenses ordinarily available to a trustee.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386A. Kentucky Uniform Statutory Trust Act (2012)›Subchapter 7. Mergers and Conversions›KY REV ST 386A.7-040. Articles of merger

citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386A.7-040. Articles of merger (2023)
content:
(1)  The surviving constituent organization shall deliver to the Secretary of State
      for filing articles of merger duly executed by each constituent organization setting
      forth:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386A. Kentucky Uniform Statutory Trust Act (2012)›Subchapter 6. Beneficiaries and Beneficial Rights›KY REV ST 386A.6-110. Action by beneficial owner
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386A. Kentucky Uniform Statutory Trust Act (2012) › Subchapter 6. Beneficiaries and Beneficial Rights › KY REV ST 386A.6-110. Action by beneficial owner
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386A.6-110. Action by beneficial owner (2023)
content:
(1)  A beneficial owner may maintain a direct action against a statutory trust or
      a trustee to redress an injury sustained by, or to enforce a duty owed to, the beneficial
      owner if the beneficial owner can prevail without showing an injury or breach of duty
      to the trust.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386A. Kentucky Uniform Statutory Trust Act (2012)›Subchapter 7. Mergers and Conversions›KY REV ST 386A.7-020. Approval of proposed merger; no right of dissent

citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386A.7-020. Approval of proposed merger; no right of dissent (2023)
content:
(1)  With respect to each constituent statutory trust, the plan of merger shall require
      the approval of the beneficial owners.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386A. Kentucky Uniform Statutory Trust Act (2012)›Subchapter 7. Mergers and Conversions›KY REV ST 386A.7-010. Right of company to merge with other business entities; exception
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386A. Kentucky Uniform Statutory Trust Act (2012) › Subchapter 7. Mergers and Conversions › KY REV ST 386A.7-010. Right of company to merge with other business entities; exception
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386A.7-010. Right of company to merge with other business entities; exception (2023)
content:
(1)  Unless otherwise provided in a governing instrument, and if permitted by any
      law applicable to entities other than statutory trusts, one (1) or more statutory
      trusts may merge with or into one (1) or more other entities with the statutory trust
      or other business entity being the surviving organization.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386A. Kentucky Uniform Statutory Trust Act (2012)›Subchapter 7. Mergers and Conversions›KY REV ST 386A.7-080. Provisions not exclusive
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386A. Kentucky Uniform Statutory Trust Act (2012) › Subchapter 7. Mergers and Conversions › KY REV ST 386A.7-080. Provisions not exclusive
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386A.7-080. Provisions not exclusive (2023)
content:
This subchapter does not preclude an organization from being merged or converted under
   law other than this chapter.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386A. Kentucky Uniform Statutory Trust Act (2012)›Subchapter 7. Mergers and Conversions›KY REV ST 386A.7-030. Plan of merger
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386A. Kentucky Uniform Statutory Trust Act (2012) › Subchapter 7. Mergers and Conversions › KY REV ST 386A.7-030. Plan of merger
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386A.7-030. Plan of merger (2023)
content: (1)  Each constituent organization shall enter into a written plan of merger.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386A. Kentucky Uniform Statutory Trust Act (2012)›Subchapter 7. Mergers and Conversions›KY REV ST 386A.7-070. Filings required for merger; effective date

citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386A.7-070. Filings required for merger; effective date (2023)
content:

      before the conversion.

content:
(1)  An entity other than a corporation governed as to its internal affairs by KRS
      Chapter 273 or a nonprofit limited liability company may be converted to a statutory
      trust pursuant to this section.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386A. Kentucky Uniform Statutory Trust Act (2012)›Subchapter 8. Dissolution and Winding Up›KY REV ST 386A.8-050. Supervision of winding up and liquidation
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386A. Kentucky Uniform Statutory Trust Act (2012) › Subchapter 8. Dissolution and Winding Up › KY REV ST 386A.8-050. Supervision of winding up and liquidation
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386A.8-050. Supervision of winding up and liquidation (2023)
content:
(1)  Subject toKRS 386A.8-030(3), after dissolution of a statutory trust, the trustee or trustees shall wind up the

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386A. Kentucky Uniform Statutory Trust Act (2012)›Subchapter 8. Dissolution and Winding Up›KY REV ST 386A.8-060. Known claims against dissolved trust
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386A. Kentucky Uniform Statutory Trust Act (2012) › Subchapter 8. Dissolution and Winding Up › KY REV ST 386A.8-060. Known claims against dissolved trust
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386A.8-060. Known claims against dissolved trust (2023)
content:
(1)  Upon dissolution, a statutory trust may, and a series trust shall, dispose of
      the known claims against it by following the procedures described in this section.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386A. Kentucky Uniform Statutory Trust Act (2012)›Subchapter 8. Dissolution and Winding Up›KY REV ST 386A.8-040. Winding up
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386A. Kentucky Uniform Statutory Trust Act (2012) › Subchapter 8. Dissolution and Winding Up › KY REV ST 386A.8-040. Winding up
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386A.8-040. Winding up (2023)
content:
(1)  After dissolution, a statutory trust continues its existence as a statutory trust,
      but may not carry on any activities except as is appropriate to wind up and liquidate

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386A. Kentucky Uniform Statutory Trust Act (2012)›Subchapter 10. Miscellaneous Provisions›KY REV ST 386A.10-010. Uniformity of application and construction
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386A. Kentucky Uniform Statutory Trust Act (2012) › Subchapter 10. Miscellaneous Provisions › KY REV ST 386A.10-010. Uniformity of application and construction
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386A.10-010. Uniformity of application and construction (2023)
content:
In applying and construing this chapter, consideration must be given to the need to
   promote uniformity of the law with respect to its subject matter among states that
   enact it.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386A. Kentucky Uniform Statutory Trust Act (2012)›Subchapter 8. Dissolution and Winding Up›KY REV ST 386A.8-070. Other claims against dissolved trust

citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386A.8-070. Other claims against dissolved trust (2023)
content:
(1)  A statutory trust may, and a series trust shall, publish notice of its dissolution
      pursuant to this section.

content:
This chapter does modify, limit, and supersede the federal Electronic Signatures in
   Global and National Commerce Act,15 U.S.C. secs. 7001 et seq.,but does not modify, limit, or supersede Section 101(c) of that act,15 U.S.C. sec. 7001(c), or authorize electronic delivery of any of the notices described in Section 103(b)

title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386A. citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386A.10-040. Effective date; application to business trusts; application to foreign business trusts (2023)
content:
(1)  This chapter does not limit, prohibit, or invalidate the existence, acts, or
      obligations of any common-law trust created or doing business in this Commonwealth
      before, on, or after July 12, 2012.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 1 . General Provisions and Definitions›KY REV ST 386B.1-030. Default and mandatory rules
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 1 . General Provisions and Definitions › KY REV ST 386B.1-030. Default and mandatory rules
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.1-030. Default and mandatory rules (2023)
content:
(1)  Except as otherwise provided in the terms of the trust, this chapter governs
      the duties and powers of a trustee, relations among trustees, and the rights and interests
      of a beneficiary.

title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386A. Kentucky Uniform Statutory Trust Act (2012) › Subchapter 10. Miscellaneous Provisions › KY REV ST 386A.10-030. Savings clause
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386A.10-030. Savings clause (2023)

This chapter does not affect an action commenced, proceeding brought, or right accrued

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 1 . General Provisions and Definitions›KY REV ST 386B.1-040. Common law of trusts; principles of equity
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 1 . General Provisions and Definitions › KY REV ST 386B.1-040. Common law of trusts; principles of equity
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.1-040. Common law of trusts; principles of equity (2023)
content:
The common law of trusts and principles of equity supplement this chapter, except
   to the extent modified by this chapter or another statute of this Commonwealth.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 1 . General Provisions and Definitions›KY REV ST 386B.1-070. Methods and waiver of notice
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 1 . General Provisions and Definitions › KY REV ST 386B.1-070. Methods and waiver of notice
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.1-070. Methods and waiver of notice (2023)
content:
(1)  Notice to a person under this chapter or the sending of a document to a person
      under this chapter shall be accomplished in a manner reasonably suitable under the
      circumstances and likely to result in receipt of the notice or document.  Permissible methods of notice or for sending a document include first-class mail,
      personal delivery, delivery to the person's last known place of residence or place
      of business, or a properly directed electronic message.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 1 . General Provisions and Definitions›KY REV ST 386B.1-050. Governing law

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 1 . General Provisions and Definitions›KY REV ST 386B.1-090. Nonjudicial settlement agreements
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 1 . General Provisions and Definitions › KY REV ST 386B.1-090. Nonjudicial settlement agreements
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.1-090. Nonjudicial settlement agreements (2023)
content:
(1)  For purposes of this section, “interested persons” means persons whose consent would be required to achieve a binding settlement were
      the settlement to be approved by the court.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 1 . General Provisions and Definitions›KY REV ST 386B.1-100. Rules of construction
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 1 . General Provisions and Definitions › KY REV ST 386B.1-100. Rules of construction
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.1-100. Rules of construction (2023)
content:
The rules of construction that apply in this Commonwealth to the interpretation of
   and disposition of property by will also apply as appropriate to the interpretation
   of the terms of a trust and the disposition of the trust property.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 1 . General Provisions and Definitions›KY REV ST 386B.1-060. Principal place of administration

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 2. Judicial Proceedings›KY REV ST 386B.2-010. Role of court in administration of trust
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 2. Judicial Proceedings › KY REV ST 386B.2-010. Role of court in administration of trust
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.2-010. Role of court in administration of trust (2023)
content:
(1)  The court may intervene in the administration of a trust to the extent its jurisdiction
      is invoked by an interested person or as provided by law.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 1 . General Provisions and Definitions›KY REV ST 386B.1-110. Doctrines of worthier title and reversions not in force as rules of law and as rules of construction
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 1 . General Provisions and Definitions › KY REV ST 386B.1-110. Doctrines of worthier title and reversions not in force as rules of law and as rules of construction
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.1-110. Doctrines of worthier title and reversions not in force as rules of law and as rules of construction (2023)
content:
The doctrine of worthier title and the doctrine of reversions shall not be in force
   in this Commonwealth as rules of law and as rules of construction.  Language in a governing instrument describing the beneficiaries of a disposition
   as the transferor's “heirs,” “heirs at law,” “next of kin,” “distributees,” “relatives,”
   or “family,” or language of similar import, shall not create or presumptively create
   a reversionary interest in the transferor.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 2. Judicial Proceedings›KY REV ST 386B.2-020. Jurisdiction over trustee and beneficiary
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 2. Judicial Proceedings › KY REV ST 386B.2-020. Jurisdiction over trustee and beneficiary
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.2-020. Jurisdiction over trustee and beneficiary (2023)
content:
(1)  By accepting the trusteeship of a trust having its principal place of administration
      in this Commonwealth or by moving the principal place of administration to this Commonwealth,
      the trustee submits personally to the jurisdiction of the courts of this Commonwealth
      regarding any matter involving the trust.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 1 . General Provisions and Definitions›KY REV ST 386B.1-120. Insurable interest of trustee
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 1 . General Provisions and Definitions › KY REV ST 386B.1-120. Insurable interest of trustee
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.1-120. Insurable interest of trustee (2023)
content: (1)  As used in this section, “settlor” means a person that executes a trust instrument.  The term includes a person for which a fiduciary or agent is acting.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 2. Judicial Proceedings›KY REV ST 386B.2-030. Subject-matter jurisdiction
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 2. Judicial Proceedings › KY REV ST 386B.2-030. Subject-matter jurisdiction

content: Except with regard to matters otherwise provided for by statute:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 2. Judicial Proceedings›KY REV ST 386B.2-040. Venue
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 2. Judicial Proceedings › KY REV ST 386B.2-040. Venue
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.2-040. Venue (2023)
content:
(1)  Venue for proceedings under this chapter involving registered trusts is in the

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 3. Representation›KY REV ST 386B.3-020. Representation by holder of general testamentary power of appointment
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 3. Representation › KY REV ST 386B.3-020. Representation by holder of general testamentary power of appointment
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.3-020. Representation by holder of general testamentary power of appointment (2023)
content:
To the extent there is no conflict of interest between the holder of a general testamentary
   power of appointment and the persons represented with respect to the particular question
   or dispute, the holder may represent and bind persons whose interests, as permissible
   appointees, takers in default, or otherwise, are subject to the power.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 3. Representation›KY REV ST 386B.3-030. Representation by fiduciaries and parents

citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.3-030. Representation by fiduciaries and parents (2023)
content:
To the extent there is no conflict of interest between the representative and the
   person represented or among those being represented with respect to a particular question

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 3. Representation›KY REV ST 386B.3-040. Representation by person having substantially identical interest
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 3. Representation › KY REV ST 386B.3-040. Representation by person having substantially identical interest
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.3-040. Representation by person having substantially identical interest (2023)
content:
Unless otherwise represented, a minor, incapacitated, or unborn individual, or a person
   whose identity or location is unknown and not reasonably ascertainable, may be represented
   by and bound by another having a substantially identical interest with respect to
   the particular question or dispute, but only to the extent there is no conflict of
   interest between the representative and the person represented.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 2. Judicial Proceedings›KY REV ST 386B.2-050. Registration of trust

content:
(1)  The trustee of a trust having its principal place of administration in this Commonwealth

      place of administration.  Unless otherwise designated in the trust instrument, the principal place of administration
      of a trust is the trustee's usual place of business where the records pertaining to

      business.  In the case of cotrustees, the principal place of administration, if not otherwise
      designated in the trust instrument, is:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 3. Representation›KY REV ST 386B.3-050. Appointment of guardian ad litem
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 3. Representation › KY REV ST 386B.3-050. Appointment of guardian ad litem
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.3-050. Appointment of guardian ad litem (2023)
content:
(1)  If the court determines that an interest is not represented under this subchapter,
      or that the otherwise available representation might be inadequate because of conflict
      or otherwise, the court may appoint a guardian ad litem to receive notice, give consent,
      and otherwise represent, bind, and act on behalf of a minor, incapacitated, or unborn
      individual, or a person whose identity or location is unknown.  A guardian ad litem may be appointed to represent several persons or interests.

content: (1)  A trust is created only if:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 3. Representation›KY REV ST 386B.3-010. Representations; basic effect
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 3. Representation › KY REV ST 386B.3-010. Representations; basic effect
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.3-010. Representations; basic effect (2023)
content:
(1)  Notice to a person who may represent and bind another person under this subchapter
      has the same effect as if notice were given directly to the other person.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 4. Creation, Validity, Modification, and Termination of Trust›KY REV ST 386B.4-040. Trust purposes
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 4. Creation, Validity, Modification, and Termination of Trust › KY REV ST 386B.4-040. Trust purposes
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.4-040. Trust purposes (2023)
content:
A trust may be created only to the extent its purposes are lawful, not contrary to
   public policy, and possible to achieve.  A trust and its terms shall be for the benefit of its beneficiaries.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 4. Creation, Validity, Modification, and Termination of Trust›KY REV ST 386B.4-030. Trusts created in other jurisdictions

citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.4-030. Trusts created in other jurisdictions (2023)
content:
A trust not created by will is validly created if its creation complies with the law
   of the jurisdiction in which the trust instrument was executed, or the law of the

title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 4. Creation, Validity, Modification, and Termination of Trust › KY REV ST 386B.4-060. Creation of trust induced by fraud, duress, or undue influence
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.4-060. Creation of trust induced by fraud, duress, or undue influence (2023)
content:
A trust is void to the extent its creation was induced by fraud, duress, or undue
   influence.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 4. Creation, Validity, Modification, and Termination of Trust›KY REV ST 386B.4-050. Charitable purposes; enforcement
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 4. Creation, Validity, Modification, and Termination of Trust › KY REV ST 386B.4-050. Charitable purposes; enforcement
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.4-050. Charitable purposes; enforcement (2023)
content:
(1)  A charitable trust may be created for the relief of poverty, the advancement
      of education or religion, the promotion of health, governmental or municipal purposes,
      or other purposes the achievement of which is beneficial to the community.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 4. Creation, Validity, Modification, and Termination of Trust›KY REV ST 386B.4-070. Evidence of oral trust
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 4. Creation, Validity, Modification, and Termination of Trust › KY REV ST 386B.4-070. Evidence of oral trust
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.4-070. Evidence of oral trust (2023)
content:
Except as required by a statute other than those in this chapter, a trust need not
   be evidenced by a trust instrument, but the creation of an oral trust and its terms
   may be established only by clear and convincing evidence.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 4. Creation, Validity, Modification, and Termination of Trust›KY REV ST 386B.4-080. Trust for care of animal
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 4. Creation, Validity, Modification, and Termination of Trust › KY REV ST 386B.4-080. Trust for care of animal
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.4-080. Trust for care of animal (2023)
content:
(1)  A trust may be created to provide for the care of an animal alive during the
      settlor's lifetime.  The trust terminates on the death of the animal or, if the trust was created to
      provide for the care of more than one (1) animal alive during the settlor's lifetime,
      on the death of the last surviving animal.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 4. Creation, Validity, Modification, and Termination of Trust › KY REV ST 386B.4-100. Modification or termination of trust; proceedings for approval or disapproval
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.4-100. Modification or termination of trust; proceedings for approval or disapproval (2023)
content:
(1)  In addition to the methods of termination prescribed byKRS 386B.4-110,386B.4-120,386B.4-130, and386B.4-140, a trust terminates to the extent the trust is revoked or expires pursuant to its
      terms, no purpose of the trust remains to be achieved, or the purposes of the trust
      have become unlawful, contrary to public policy, or impossible to achieve.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 4. Creation, Validity, Modification, and Termination of Trust›KY REV ST 386B.4-120. Modification or termination because of unanticipated circumstances or inability to administer trust effectively
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 4. Creation, Validity, Modification, and Termination of Trust › KY REV ST 386B.4-120. Modification or termination because of unanticipated circumstances or inability to administer trust effectively
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.4-120. Modification or termination because of unanticipated circumstances or inability to administer trust effectively (2023)
content:
(1)  The court may modify the administrative or dispositive terms of a trust or terminate
      the trust if, because of circumstances not anticipated by the settlor, modification
      or termination will further the purposes of the trust.  To the extent practicable, the modification shall be made in accordance with the
      settlor's probable intention.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 4. Creation, Validity, Modification, and Termination of Trust›KY REV ST 386B.4-090. Noncharitable trust without ascertainable beneficiary

content:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 4. Creation, Validity, Modification, and Termination of Trust›KY REV ST 386B.4-150. Reformation to correct mistakes
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 4. Creation, Validity, Modification, and Termination of Trust › KY REV ST 386B.4-150. Reformation to correct mistakes
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.4-150. Reformation to correct mistakes (2023)
content:
The court may reform the terms of a trust, even if unambiguous, to conform the terms
   to the settlor's intention if it is proved by clear and convincing evidence what the
   settlor's intention was and that the terms of the trust were affected by a mistake
   of fact or law, whether in expression or inducement.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 4. Creation, Validity, Modification, and Termination of Trust›KY REV ST 386B.4-170. Combination and division of trusts
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 4. Creation, Validity, Modification, and Termination of Trust › KY REV ST 386B.4-170. Combination and division of trusts
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.4-170. Combination and division of trusts (2023)
content:
(1)  After notice to the qualified beneficiaries, a trustee may combine two (2) or
      more trusts into a single trust or divide a trust into two (2) or more separate trusts,
      if the result does not impair rights of any beneficiary or adversely affect achievement
      of the purposes of the trust.

content:
(1)  Except as otherwise provided in the terms of the trust, a noncharitable irrevocable
      trust may be modified or terminated upon consent of the settlor and all beneficiaries,
      without court approval, even if the modification or termination is inconsistent with
      a material purpose of the trust.  A settlor's power to consent to a trust's modification or termination may be exercised:

title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 4. Creation, Validity, Modification, and Termination of Trust › KY REV ST 386B.4-160. Modification to achieve settlor’s tax objectives
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.4-160. Modification to achieve settlor’s tax objectives (2023)
content:
To achieve the settlor's tax objectives, the court may modify the terms of a trust
   in a manner that is not contrary to the settlor's probable intention.  The court may provide that the modification has retroactive effect.  The District Court shall have exclusive jurisdiction over matters under this section.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 4. Creation, Validity, Modification, and Termination of Trust›KY REV ST 386B.4-140. Modification or termination of uneconomic trust
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 4. Creation, Validity, Modification, and Termination of Trust › KY REV ST 386B.4-140. Modification or termination of uneconomic trust
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.4-140. Modification or termination of uneconomic trust (2023)
content:
(1)  After notice to the qualified beneficiaries, the trustee of a trust consisting
      of trust property or a personal representative holding or controlling an amount directed
      by will to be held in trust, having a total value less than one hundred thousand dollars
      ($100,000) may terminate the trust if the trustee concludes that the value of the
      trust property is insufficient to justify the cost of administration.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 5. Creditor’s Claims--Spendthrift and Discretionary Trusts›KY REV ST 386B.5-020. Spendthrift trusts
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 5. Creditor’s Claims--Spendthrift and Discretionary Trusts › KY REV ST 386B.5-020. Spendthrift trusts
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.5-020. Spendthrift trusts (2023)
content:
(1)  As used in this section, unless the context otherwise requires, “spendthrift trust” means a trust in which by the terms of the instrument creating it a valid restraint
      on the voluntary and involuntary alienation of the interest of a beneficiary is imposed.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 5. Creditor’s Claims--Spendthrift and Discretionary Trusts›KY REV ST 386B.5-060. Personal obligations of trustee
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 5. Creditor’s Claims--Spendthrift and Discretionary Trusts › KY REV ST 386B.5-060. Personal obligations of trustee
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.5-060. Personal obligations of trustee (2023)
content:
Trust property is not subject to personal obligations of the trustee, even if the
   trustee becomes insolvent or bankrupt.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 5. Creditor’s Claims--Spendthrift and Discretionary Trusts›KY REV ST 386B.5-030. Discretionary trusts; effect of standard

citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.5-030. Discretionary trusts; effect of standard (2023)
content:
(1)  As used in this section, “child” includes any person for whom an order or judgment for child support has been entered
      in this Commonwealth or another state.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 5. Creditor’s Claims--Spendthrift and Discretionary Trusts›KY REV ST 386B.5-010. Rights of beneficiary’s creditor or assignee
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 5. citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.5-010. Rights of beneficiary’s creditor or assignee (2023)
content:
(1)  To the extent a beneficiary's interest is not subject to a spendthrift provision,
      the court may authorize a creditor or assignee of the beneficiary to reach the beneficiary's
      interest by attachment of present or future distributions to or for the benefit of
      the beneficiary or other means.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 5. Creditor’s Claims--Spendthrift and Discretionary Trusts›KY REV ST 386B.5-040. Creditor’s claim against settlor

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 6. Revocable Trusts›KY REV ST 386B.6-020. Revocation or amendment of revocable trust
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 6. Revocable Trusts › KY REV ST 386B.6-020. Revocation or amendment of revocable trust
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.6-020. Revocation or amendment of revocable trust (2023)
content:
(1)  Unless the terms of a trust expressly provide that the trust is irrevocable,
      the settlor may revoke or amend the trust.  This subsection shall not apply to a trust created under an instrument signed before
      July 15, 2014.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 6. Revocable Trusts›KY REV ST 386B.6-030. Settlor’s powers; powers of withdrawal
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 6. Revocable Trusts › KY REV ST 386B.6-030. Settlor’s powers; powers of withdrawal
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.6-030. Settlor’s powers; powers of withdrawal (2023)
content:
(1)  While a trust is revocable and, in the reasonable belief of the trustee, the
      settlor has capacity to revoke the trust, rights of the beneficiaries are subject
      to the control of, and the duties of the trustee are owed exclusively to, the settlor.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 5. Creditor’s Claims--Spendthrift and Discretionary Trusts›KY REV ST 386B.5-050. Overdue distribution

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 6. Revocable Trusts›KY REV ST 386B.6-010. Capacity of settlor of revocable trust
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 6. Revocable Trusts › KY REV ST 386B.6-010. Capacity of settlor of revocable trust
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.6-010. Capacity of settlor of revocable trust (2023)
content:
The capacity required to create, amend, revoke, or add property to a revocable trust,
   or to direct the actions of the trustee of a revocable trust, is the same as that
   required to make a will.
