path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 7. Office of Trustee›KY REV ST 386B.7-020. Trustee’s bond
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 7. Office of Trustee › KY REV ST 386B.7-020. Trustee’s bond
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.7-020. Trustee’s bond (2023)
content:
(1)  A trustee shall give bond to secure performance of the trustee's duties only
      if the court finds that a bond is needed to protect the interests of the beneficiaries
      or is required by the terms of the trust and the court has not dispensed with the
      requirement.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 7. Office of Trustee›KY REV ST 386B.7-040. Vacancy in trusteeship; appointment of successor
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 7. Office of Trustee › KY REV ST 386B.7-040. Vacancy in trusteeship; appointment of successor
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.7-040. Vacancy in trusteeship; appointment of successor (2023)
content: (1)  A vacancy in a trusteeship occurs if:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 7. Office of Trustee›KY REV ST 386B.7-060. Removal of trustee
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 7. Office of Trustee › KY REV ST 386B.7-060. Removal of trustee
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.7-060. Removal of trustee (2023)
content:
(1)  The settlor, a cotrustee, or a beneficiary may request the court to remove a
      trustee, or a trustee may be removed by the court on its own initiative.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 7. Office of Trustee›KY REV ST 386B.7-080. Compensation of trustee
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 7. Office of Trustee › KY REV ST 386B.7-080. Compensation of trustee
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.7-080. Compensation of trustee (2023)
content:
(1)  If the terms of a trust do not specify the trustee's compensation, a trustee
      is entitled to compensation that is reasonable under the circumstances.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 8. Duties and Powers of Trustee›KY REV ST 386B.8-020. Duty of loyalty
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 8. Duties and Powers of Trustee › KY REV ST 386B.8-020. Duty of loyalty
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.8-020. Duty of loyalty (2023)
content: (1)  A trustee shall administer the trust solely in the interests of the beneficiaries.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 8. Duties and Powers of Trustee›KY REV ST 386B.8-010. Duty to administer trust
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 8. Duties and Powers of Trustee › KY REV ST 386B.8-010. Duty to administer trust
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.8-010. Duty to administer trust (2023)
content:
Upon acceptance of a trusteeship, the trustee shall administer the trust in good faith,
   in accordance with its terms and purposes and the interests of the beneficiaries,
   and in accordance with this chapter.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 7. Office of Trustee›KY REV ST 386B.7-030. Cotrustees
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 7. Office of Trustee › KY REV ST 386B.7-030. Cotrustees
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.7-030. Cotrustees (2023)
content: (1)  Cotrustees who are unable to reach a unanimous decision may act by majority decision.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 7. Office of Trustee›KY REV ST 386B.7-070. Delivery of property by former trustee
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 7. Office of Trustee › KY REV ST 386B.7-070. Delivery of property by former trustee
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.7-070. Delivery of property by former trustee (2023)
content:
(1)  Unless a cotrustee remains in office or the court otherwise orders, and until
      the trust property is delivered to a successor trustee or other person entitled to
      it, a trustee who has resigned or been removed has the duties of a trustee and the
      powers necessary to protect the trust property.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 7. Office of Trustee›KY REV ST 386B.7-050. Resignation of trustee
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 7. Office of Trustee › KY REV ST 386B.7-050. Resignation of trustee
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.7-050. Resignation of trustee (2023)
content: (1)  A trustee may resign:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 7. Office of Trustee›KY REV ST 386B.7-100. Exclusive jurisdiction of District Court
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 7. Office of Trustee › KY REV ST 386B.7-100. Exclusive jurisdiction of District Court
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.7-100. Exclusive jurisdiction of District Court (2023)
content:
The District Court shall have exclusive jurisdiction over matters under this subchapter
   relating to the office of the trustee.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 8. Duties and Powers of Trustee›KY REV ST 386B.8-050. Costs of administration
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 8. Duties and Powers of Trustee › KY REV ST 386B.8-050. Costs of administration
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.8-050. Costs of administration (2023)
content:
In administering a trust, the trustee may incur only costs that are reasonable in
   relation to the trust property, the purposes of the trust, and the skills of the trustee.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 7. Office of Trustee›KY REV ST 386B.7-090. Reimbursement of expenses
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 7. Office of Trustee › KY REV ST 386B.7-090. Reimbursement of expenses
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.7-090. Reimbursement of expenses (2023)
content:
(1)  A trustee is entitled to be reimbursed out of the trust property, with interest
      as appropriate, for:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 8. Duties and Powers of Trustee›KY REV ST 386B.8-070. Delegation by trustee
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 8. Duties and Powers of Trustee › KY REV ST 386B.8-070. Delegation by trustee
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.8-070. Delegation by trustee (2023)
content:
(1)  A trustee may delegate duties and powers that a prudent trustee of comparable
      skills could properly delegate under the circumstances.  The trustee shall exercise reasonable care, skill, and caution in:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 8. Duties and Powers of Trustee›KY REV ST 386B.8-030. Impartiality
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 8. Duties and Powers of Trustee › KY REV ST 386B.8-030. Impartiality
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.8-030. Impartiality (2023)
content:
If a trust has two (2) or more beneficiaries, the trustee shall act impartially in
   investing, managing, and distributing the trust property, giving due regard to the
   beneficiaries' respective interests.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 8. Duties and Powers of Trustee›KY REV ST 386B.8-060. Trustee’s skills
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 8. Duties and Powers of Trustee › KY REV ST 386B.8-060. Trustee’s skills
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.8-060. Trustee’s skills (2023)
content:
A trustee who has special skills or expertise, or is named trustee in reliance upon
   the trustee's representation that the trustee has special skills or expertise, shall
   use those special skills or expertise.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 8. Duties and Powers of Trustee›KY REV ST 386B.8-040. Prudent administration
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 8. Duties and Powers of Trustee › KY REV ST 386B.8-040. Prudent administration
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.8-040. Prudent administration (2023)
content:
A trustee shall administer the trust as a prudent person would, by considering the
   purposes, terms, distributional requirements, and other circumstances of the trust.  In satisfying this standard, the trustee shall exercise reasonable care, skill,
   and caution.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 8. Duties and Powers of Trustee›KY REV ST 386B.8-090. Control and protection of trust property
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 8. Duties and Powers of Trustee › KY REV ST 386B.8-090. Control and protection of trust property
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.8-090. Control and protection of trust property (2023)
content: A trustee shall take reasonable steps to take control of and protect the trust property.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 8. Duties and Powers of Trustee›KY REV ST 386B.8-080. Powers to direct
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 8. Duties and Powers of Trustee › KY REV ST 386B.8-080. Powers to direct
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.8-080. Powers to direct (2023)
content:
(1)  While a trust is revocable, the trustee may follow a direction of the settlor
      that is contrary to the terms of the trust.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 8. Duties and Powers of Trustee›KY REV ST 386B.8-100. Recordkeeping and identification of trust property
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 8. Duties and Powers of Trustee › KY REV ST 386B.8-100. Recordkeeping and identification of trust property
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.8-100. Recordkeeping and identification of trust property (2023)
content: (1)  A trustee shall keep adequate records of the administration of the trust.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 8. Duties and Powers of Trustee›KY REV ST 386B.8-110. Enforcement and defense of claims
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 8. Duties and Powers of Trustee › KY REV ST 386B.8-110. Enforcement and defense of claims
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.8-110. Enforcement and defense of claims (2023)
content:
A trustee shall take reasonable steps to enforce claims of the trust and to defend
   claims against the trust.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 8. Duties and Powers of Trustee›KY REV ST 386B.8-140. Discretionary powers; tax savings
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 8. Duties and Powers of Trustee › KY REV ST 386B.8-140. Discretionary powers; tax savings
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.8-140. Discretionary powers; tax savings (2023)
content:
(1)  The judicial standard of review for a discretionary power is that the trustee
      shall exercise the power reasonably, in good faith, and in accordance with the terms
      and purposes of the trust and the interests of the beneficiaries, except that a reasonableness
      standard shall not be applied to the exercise of discretion by the trustee if the
      terms of the trust so provide.  The words “sole,” “absolute,” “uncontrolled,” or words of similar import in the absence of any standards to guide the trustee
      in exercising its discretion mean that a reasonableness standard will not apply.  The greater the grant of discretion by the settlor to the trustee, the broader the
      range of permissible conduct by the trustee in exercising it.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 8. Duties and Powers of Trustee›KY REV ST 386B.8-130. Duty to inform and report
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 8. Duties and Powers of Trustee › KY REV ST 386B.8-130. Duty to inform and report
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.8-130. Duty to inform and report (2023)
content: (1)  Except as otherwise provided in the terms of the trust:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 8. Duties and Powers of Trustee›KY REV ST 386B.8-120. Collecting trust property
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 8. Duties and Powers of Trustee › KY REV ST 386B.8-120. Collecting trust property
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.8-120. Collecting trust property (2023)
content:
A trustee shall take reasonable steps to compel a former trustee or other person to
   deliver trust property to the trustee, and to redress a breach of trust known to the
   trustee to have been committed by a former trustee.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 8. Duties and Powers of Trustee›KY REV ST 386B.8-150. General powers of trustee
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 8. Duties and Powers of Trustee › KY REV ST 386B.8-150. General powers of trustee
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.8-150. General powers of trustee (2023)
content: (1)  A trustee, without authorization by the court, may exercise:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 8. Duties and Powers of Trustee›KY REV ST 386B.8-180. Duties of trustee upon termination or upon removal of trustee; objection
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 8. Duties and Powers of Trustee › KY REV ST 386B.8-180. Duties of trustee upon termination or upon removal of trustee; objection
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.8-180. Duties of trustee upon termination or upon removal of trustee; objection (2023)
content:
(1)  (a) When a trust terminates pursuant to the terms of the trust, the trustee may
         follow the requirements for distribution upon termination as provided inKRS 386B.8-170or, if proceeding under this section, within a reasonable amount of time after such
         termination, the trustee shall provide to the qualified beneficiaries a statement
         showing the fair market value of the net assets to be distributed, a trust accounting
         for the prior five (5) years and an estimate for any items reasonably anticipated
         but not yet received or disbursed, the amount of any fees, including trustee fees,
         remaining to be paid, and notice that the trust is terminating.  The trustee may also provide such statement and notice to any other person whom
         the trustee reasonably believes may have an interest in the trust.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 9. Uniform Prudent Investor Act›KY REV ST 386B.9-010. Trustee to act as prudent investor
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 9. Uniform Prudent Investor Act › KY REV ST 386B.9-010. Trustee to act as prudent investor
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.9-010. Trustee to act as prudent investor (2023)
content:
All trustees acting under this chapter with respect to investments shall have the
   authority and duties as set forth inKRS 286.3-277to act as a prudent investor.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 8. Duties and Powers of Trustee›KY REV ST 386B.8-170. Distribution upon termination
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 8. Duties and Powers of Trustee › KY REV ST 386B.8-170. Distribution upon termination
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.8-170. Distribution upon termination (2023)
content:
(1)  Upon termination or partial termination of a trust, the trustee may send to the
      beneficiaries a proposal for distribution.  The right of any beneficiary to object to the proposed distribution terminates if
      the beneficiary does not notify the trustee of an objection within thirty (30) days
      after the proposal was sent, but only if the proposal informed the beneficiary of
      the right to object and of the time allowed for objection.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 10. Liability of Trustees and Rights of Persons Dealing with Trustees›KY REV ST 386B.10-030. Damages in absence of breach
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 10. Liability of Trustees and Rights of Persons Dealing with Trustees › KY REV ST 386B.10-030. Damages in absence of breach
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.10-030. Damages in absence of breach (2023)
content:
(1)  A trustee is accountable to an affected beneficiary for any profit made by the
      trustee arising from the administration of the trust, except the reasonable fee charged
      by the trustee, even absent a breach of trust.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 10. Liability of Trustees and Rights of Persons Dealing with Trustees›KY REV ST 386B.10-050. Limitation of action against trustee
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 10. Liability of Trustees and Rights of Persons Dealing with Trustees › KY REV ST 386B.10-050. Limitation of action against trustee
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.10-050. Limitation of action against trustee (2023)
content:
(1)  For the purposes of this section, a “report” is an account statement or other form of written disclosure made by the trustee
      to the beneficiary.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 8. Duties and Powers of Trustee›KY REV ST 386B.8-160. Specific powers of trustee
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 8. Duties and Powers of Trustee › KY REV ST 386B.8-160. Specific powers of trustee
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.8-160. Specific powers of trustee (2023)
content: Without limiting the authority conferred byKRS 386B.8-150, a trustee may:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 10. Liability of Trustees and Rights of Persons Dealing with Trustees›KY REV ST 386B.10-040. Attorney’s fees and costs
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 10. Liability of Trustees and Rights of Persons Dealing with Trustees › KY REV ST 386B.10-040. Attorney’s fees and costs
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.10-040. Attorney’s fees and costs (2023)
content:
In a judicial proceeding involving the administration of a trust, the court, as justice
   and equity may require, may award costs and expenses, including reasonable attorney's
   fees, to any party, to be paid by another party or from the trust that is the subject
   of the controversy.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 10. Liability of Trustees and Rights of Persons Dealing with Trustees›KY REV ST 386B.10-010. Remedies for breach of trust
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 10. Liability of Trustees and Rights of Persons Dealing with Trustees › KY REV ST 386B.10-010. Remedies for breach of trust
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.10-010. Remedies for breach of trust (2023)
content:
(1)  A violation by a trustee of a duty the trustee owes to a beneficiary is a breach
      of trust.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 10. Liability of Trustees and Rights of Persons Dealing with Trustees›KY REV ST 386B.10-020. Damages for breach of trust
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 10. Liability of Trustees and Rights of Persons Dealing with Trustees › KY REV ST 386B.10-020. Damages for breach of trust
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.10-020. Damages for breach of trust (2023)
content:
(1)  A trustee who commits a breach of trust is liable to the beneficiaries affected
      for the greater of:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 10. Liability of Trustees and Rights of Persons Dealing with Trustees›KY REV ST 386B.10-080. Exculpation of trustee
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 10. Liability of Trustees and Rights of Persons Dealing with Trustees › KY REV ST 386B.10-080. Exculpation of trustee
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.10-080. Exculpation of trustee (2023)
content:
(1)  A term of a trust relieving a trustee of liability for breach of trust is unenforceable
      to the extent that it:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 10. Liability of Trustees and Rights of Persons Dealing with Trustees›KY REV ST 386B.10-070. Event affecting administration or distribution
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 10. Liability of Trustees and Rights of Persons Dealing with Trustees › KY REV ST 386B.10-070. Event affecting administration or distribution
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.10-070. Event affecting administration or distribution (2023)
content:
If the happening of an event, including marriage, divorce, performance of educational
   requirements, or death, affects the administration or distribution of a trust, a trustee
   who has exercised reasonable care to ascertain the happening of the event is not liable
   for a loss resulting from the trustee's lack of knowledge.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 10. Liability of Trustees and Rights of Persons Dealing with Trustees›KY REV ST 386B.10-060. Reliance on trust instrument
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 10. Liability of Trustees and Rights of Persons Dealing with Trustees › KY REV ST 386B.10-060. Reliance on trust instrument
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.10-060. Reliance on trust instrument (2023)
content:
A trustee who acts in reasonable reliance on the terms of the trust as expressed in
   the trust instrument is not liable to a beneficiary for a breach of trust to the extent
   the breach resulted from the reliance.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 10. Liability of Trustees and Rights of Persons Dealing with Trustees›KY REV ST 386B.10-100. Limitation on personal liability of trustee
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 10. Liability of Trustees and Rights of Persons Dealing with Trustees › KY REV ST 386B.10-100. Limitation on personal liability of trustee
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.10-100. Limitation on personal liability of trustee (2023)
content:
(1)  Except as otherwise provided in the contract, a trustee is not personally liable
      on a contract properly entered into in the trustee's fiduciary capacity in the course
      of administering the trust if the trustee in the contract disclosed the fiduciary
      capacity.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 10. Liability of Trustees and Rights of Persons Dealing with Trustees›KY REV ST 386B.10-120. Certification of trust
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 10. Liability of Trustees and Rights of Persons Dealing with Trustees › KY REV ST 386B.10-120. Certification of trust
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.10-120. Certification of trust (2023)
content:
(1)  Instead of furnishing a copy of the trust instrument to a person other than a
      beneficiary, the trustee may furnish to the person a certification of trust containing
      the following information:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 11. Miscellaneous Provisions›KY REV ST 386B.11-030. Severability clause
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 11. Miscellaneous Provisions › KY REV ST 386B.11-030. Severability clause
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.11-030. Severability clause (2023)
content:
If any provision of this chapter or its application to any person or circumstances
   is held invalid, the invalidity does not affect other provisions or applications of
   this chapter which can be given effect without the invalid provision or application,
   and to this end the provisions of this chapter are severable.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 10. Liability of Trustees and Rights of Persons Dealing with Trustees›KY REV ST 386B.10-110. Protection of person dealing with trustee
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 10. Liability of Trustees and Rights of Persons Dealing with Trustees › KY REV ST 386B.10-110. Protection of person dealing with trustee
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.10-110. Protection of person dealing with trustee (2023)
content:
(1)  A person other than a beneficiary who in good faith assists a trustee, or who
      in good faith and for value deals with a trustee, without knowledge that the trustee
      is exceeding or improperly exercising the trustee's powers is protected from liability
      as if the trustee properly exercised the power.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 10. Liability of Trustees and Rights of Persons Dealing with Trustees›KY REV ST 386B.10-090. Beneficiary’s consent, release, or ratification
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 10. Liability of Trustees and Rights of Persons Dealing with Trustees › KY REV ST 386B.10-090. Beneficiary’s consent, release, or ratification
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.10-090. Beneficiary’s consent, release, or ratification (2023)
content:
A trustee shall not be liable to a beneficiary for breach of trust if the beneficiary,
   while having capacity, consented to the conduct constituting the breach, released
   the trustee from liability for the breach, or ratified the transaction constituting
   the breach, unless:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 387. Guardians; Conservators; Curators of Convicts›KY REV ST 387.010. Definitions for KRS 387.010. to § 387.280

citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 387.010. Definitions for KRS 387.010. to § 387.280 (2023)
content: As used inKRS 387.010to387.280, unless the context requires otherwise:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 11. Miscellaneous Provisions›KY REV ST 386B.11-020. Electronic records and signatures
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 11. Miscellaneous Provisions › KY REV ST 386B.11-020. Electronic records and signatures
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.11-020. Electronic records and signatures (2023)
content:
The provisions of this chapter governing the legal effect, validity, or enforceability
   of electronic records or electronic signatures, and of contracts formed or performed
   with the use of such records or signatures, conform to the requirements of Section
   102 of the Electronic Signatures in Global and National Commerce Act,15 U.S.C. sec. 7002, and supersede, modify, and limit the requirements of the Electronic Signatures in
   Global and National Commerce Act,15 U.S.C. secs. 7001 et seq.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 11. Miscellaneous Provisions›KY REV ST 386B.11-010. Uniformity of application and construction
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 11. Miscellaneous Provisions › KY REV ST 386B.11-010. Uniformity of application and construction
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.11-010. Uniformity of application and construction (2023)
content:
In applying and construing the Uniform Trust Code, as enacted in this chapter, consideration
   shall be given to the need to promote uniformity of the law with respect to its subject
   matter among states that enact it.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 11. Miscellaneous Provisions›KY REV ST 386B.11-040. Application to existing relationships

citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.11-040. Application to existing relationships (2023)
content: (1)  Except as otherwise provided in this chapter, on July 15, 2014:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 387. Guardians; Conservators; Curators of Convicts›KY REV ST 387.111. Compensation for guardians, limited guardians, and conservators; reimbursement for expenses
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 387. Guardians; Conservators; Curators of Convicts › KY REV ST 387.111. Compensation for guardians, limited guardians, and conservators; reimbursement for expenses
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 387.111. Compensation for guardians, limited guardians, and conservators; reimbursement for expenses (2023)
content:
Guardians, limited guardians, and conservators shall receive reasonable compensation
   for services rendered and reimbursement for reasonable and necessary expenses incurred
   in the exercise of their assigned duties and powers, including reimbursement for room,
   board, and clothing personally provided to the ward and shall not exceed that provided
   for inKRS 387.760.  The compensation and reimbursement shall be paid from the estate of the ward.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 387. Guardians; Conservators; Curators of Convicts›KY REV ST 387.032. Matters to be considered by court when making appointment
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 387. Guardians; Conservators; Curators of Convicts › KY REV ST 387.032. Matters to be considered by court when making appointment
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 387.032. Matters to be considered by court when making appointment (2023)
content:
In appointing a guardian, limited guardian, or conservator, the District Court shall
   appoint any person or entity whose appointment would be in the best interest of the
   minor, taking into consideration the ability of the person or entity to manage and
   preserve the minor's estate, and taking into consideration the person or entity nominated
   pursuant toKRS 387.040or387.050.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 387. Guardians; Conservators; Curators of Convicts›KY REV ST 387.020. Jurisdiction of District Courts over guardians, limited guardians, and conservators; venue of proceedings
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 387. Guardians; Conservators; Curators of Convicts › KY REV ST 387.020. Jurisdiction of District Courts over guardians, limited guardians, and conservators; venue of proceedings
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 387.020. Jurisdiction of District Courts over guardians, limited guardians, and conservators; venue of proceedings (2023)
content:
(1)  District Courts shall have exclusive jurisdiction for the appointment and removal
      of guardians, limited guardians, and conservators for minors, and for the management
      and settlement of their accounts.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 387. Guardians; Conservators; Curators of Convicts›KY REV ST 387.040. Appointment by will
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 387. Guardians; Conservators; Curators of Convicts › KY REV ST 387.040. Appointment by will
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 387.040. Appointment by will (2023)
content:
The last surviving parent of a minor may by will nominate a guardian, or alternatively
   a limited guardian, or conservator, or both, for the minor.  One (1) person or entity may be nominated to manage the minor's financial resources
   and another to have care, custody, and control of the minor.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code›Subchapter 11. Miscellaneous Provisions›KY REV ST 386B.11-050. Short title
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 386B. Uniform Trust Code › Subchapter 11. Miscellaneous Provisions › KY REV ST 386B.11-050. Short title
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 386B.11-050. Short title (2023)
content: This chapter may be cited as the Uniform Trust Code.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 387. Guardians; Conservators; Curators of Convicts›KY REV ST 387.025. Application for appointment as guardian, limited guardian, or conservator
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 387. Guardians; Conservators; Curators of Convicts › KY REV ST 387.025. Application for appointment as guardian, limited guardian, or conservator
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 387.025. Application for appointment as guardian, limited guardian, or conservator (2023)
content:
(1)  Any interested person or entity may petition the District Court for the appointment
      of a guardian or limited guardian for an unmarried minor.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 387. Guardians; Conservators; Curators of Convicts›KY REV ST 387.050. Nomination by minor fourteen years of age or older
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 387. Guardians; Conservators; Curators of Convicts › KY REV ST 387.050. Nomination by minor fourteen years of age or older
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 387.050. Nomination by minor fourteen years of age or older (2023)
content:
If the minor is fourteen (14) years of age or older, the minor may, in the presence
   of the District Court, or by a writing signed in the presence of the judge, after
   privy examination, nominate his own guardian, limited guardian, or conservator, or
   if the minor be absent from the county, the minor may after privy examination, in
   the presence of the District Judge of the county where the minor is, or if the minor
   be in the military or naval services of the United States, after privy examination,
   in the presence of a superior commanding officer, by a writing signed in the presence
   of the judge or superior officer nominate his own guardian, limited guardian, or conservator,
   provided that the judge or the commanding officer certify to the District Judge of
   the county having jurisdiction to appoint a guardian, limited guardian, or conservator
   for the minor that the writing was signed by the minor after privy examination in
   the presence of the judge or officer.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 387. Guardians; Conservators; Curators of Convicts›KY REV ST 387.065. Powers, duties, and responsibilities of guardian
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 387. Guardians; Conservators; Curators of Convicts › KY REV ST 387.065. Powers, duties, and responsibilities of guardian
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 387.065. Powers, duties, and responsibilities of guardian (2023)
content:
(1)  A guardian of a ward shall have the powers and responsibilities of a parent regarding
      the ward's support, care, and education, but a guardian shall not be personally liable
      for the ward's expenses and shall not be liable to third persons by reason of the
      relationship for acts of the ward.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 387. Guardians; Conservators; Curators of Convicts›KY REV ST 387.070. Bonding of guardian or conservator
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 387. Guardians; Conservators; Curators of Convicts › KY REV ST 387.070. Bonding of guardian or conservator
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 387.070. Bonding of guardian or conservator (2023)
content:
(1)  Except as provided in subsections (2) and (3) of this section, no guardian or
      conservator shall act until the guardian or conservator has been appointed by the
      proper District Court, and given bond to the Commonwealth of Kentucky with good surety,
      either corporate or personal, approved by the District Court to faithfully discharge
      the trust of guardian or conservator.  The bond shall be carefully kept by the clerk of the District Court in a book to
      be provided for that purpose.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 387. Guardians; Conservators; Curators of Convicts›KY REV ST 387.090. Removal of guardian, limited guardian or conservator
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 387. Guardians; Conservators; Curators of Convicts › KY REV ST 387.090. Removal of guardian, limited guardian or conservator
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 387.090. Removal of guardian, limited guardian or conservator (2023)
content:
(1)  The District Court shall remove a guardian, limited guardian, or conservator
      if:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 387. Guardians; Conservators; Curators of Convicts›KY REV ST 387.122. Certain assets subject to withdrawal only upon authorization of court
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 387. Guardians; Conservators; Curators of Convicts › KY REV ST 387.122. Certain assets subject to withdrawal only upon authorization of court
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 387.122. Certain assets subject to withdrawal only upon authorization of court (2023)
content:
The District Court may direct that all or some part of the assets of a ward's estate
   be deposited in a bank, trust company, or insured savings and loan company authorized
   to transact business in the Commonwealth or in a single-premium deferred annuity,
   subject to withdrawal by the guardian or conservator only upon authorization of the
   District Court.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 387. Guardians; Conservators; Curators of Convicts›KY REV ST 387.080. Recovery of damages on bond
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 387. Guardians; Conservators; Curators of Convicts › KY REV ST 387.080. Recovery of damages on bond
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 387.080. Recovery of damages on bond (2023)
content:
(1)  Anyone damaged by the act or omission of the ward's guardian or conservator may
      sue upon the bond of the guardian or conservator for damages, including reasonable
      attorney's fees and costs incurred in collecting damages.  With the assent of the District Court, anyone may sue on the bond as next friend
      of the ward before the ward has attained full age.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 387. Guardians; Conservators; Curators of Convicts›KY REV ST 387.100. Inventory of ward's estate
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 387. Guardians; Conservators; Curators of Convicts › KY REV ST 387.100. Inventory of ward's estate
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 387.100. Inventory of ward's estate (2023)
content:
(1)  A guardian or conservator shall, within sixty (60) days after appointment, file
      with the District Court a true and correct inventory of the ward's real and personal
      property and other financial resources, signed by the guardian or conservator and
      verified by the affidavit of the guardian or conservator.  If other property afterward comes to the guardian's or conservator's knowledge,
      the guardian or conservator shall file a supplementary inventory thereof within sixty
      (60) days from the time of obtaining such knowledge.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 387. Guardians; Conservators; Curators of Convicts›KY REV ST 387.135. Powers and duties of limited guardian
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 387. Guardians; Conservators; Curators of Convicts › KY REV ST 387.135. Powers and duties of limited guardian
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 387.135. Powers and duties of limited guardian (2023)
content: (1)  A limited guardian shall have the powers and duties specified inKRS 387.065(1)to(3).

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 387. Guardians; Conservators; Curators of Convicts›KY REV ST 387.125. Guardian's duty as to use of ward's assets
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 387. Guardians; Conservators; Curators of Convicts › KY REV ST 387.125. Guardian's duty as to use of ward's assets
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 387.125. Guardian's duty as to use of ward's assets (2023)
content:
(1)  A guardian shall apply the income or principal of the ward's estate to the payment
      of debts, taxes, claims, charges, and expenses of the guardianship and, in accordance
      withKRS 387.065, for the support, care, and education of the ward or the ward's dependents.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 387. Guardians; Conservators; Curators of Convicts›KY REV ST 387.137. Powers and duties of conservator
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 387. Guardians; Conservators; Curators of Convicts › KY REV ST 387.137. Powers and duties of conservator
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 387.137. Powers and duties of conservator (2023)
content: A conservator shall have the powers and duties specified inKRS 387.125andKRS 387.065(4)to(8).

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 387. Guardians; Conservators; Curators of Convicts›KY REV ST 387.175. Accountings of the execution of the trust
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 387. Guardians; Conservators; Curators of Convicts › KY REV ST 387.175. Accountings of the execution of the trust
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 387.175. Accountings of the execution of the trust (2023)
content:
A guardian and conservator shall file accounts of the execution of the guardian's
   or conservator's trust.  The accountings shall be subject to the provisions ofKRS 395.610to395.657andKRS 395.990, and shall be made in accordance with those provisions, except as follows:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 387. Guardians; Conservators; Curators of Convicts›KY REV ST 387.270. Interest charged guardians or conservators
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 387. Guardians; Conservators; Curators of Convicts › KY REV ST 387.270. Interest charged guardians or conservators
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 387.270. Interest charged guardians or conservators (2023)
content:
(1)  If from any source a balance is owing by a guardian or conservator at the end
      of any year, counting from the time of appointment of the guardian or conservator,
      which should have been invested for the benefit of the ward in reasonable time but
      which remains in the guardian's or conservator's hands, the guardian or conservator
      shall be charged with the legal rate of interest compounded annually from the end
      of the year in which the balance arose.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 387. Guardians; Conservators; Curators of Convicts›KY REV ST 387.278. Settlement agreement by person with legal custody of minor; affidavit or verified statement; payment; withdrawal or transfer from account; effect of agreement; liability; filing for guardianship or conservatorship
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 387. Guardians; Conservators; Curators of Convicts › KY REV ST 387.278. Settlement agreement by person with legal custody of minor; affidavit or verified statement; payment; withdrawal or transfer from account; effect of agreement; liability; filing for guardianship or conservatorship
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 387.278. Settlement agreement by person with legal custody of minor; affidavit or verified statement; payment; withdrawal or transfer from account; effect of agreement; liability; filing for guardianship or conservatorship (2023)
content:
(1)  A person having legal custody of a minor may settle or compromise and enter into
      a settlement agreement with a person against whom the minor has a claim or from whom
      the minor is to receive proceeds from the sale of real estate, for the settlement
      of any estate, or from any other source if:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 387. Guardians; Conservators; Curators of Convicts›KY REV ST 387.200. Removal of property of ward from state
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 387. Guardians; Conservators; Curators of Convicts › KY REV ST 387.200. Removal of property of ward from state
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 387.200. Removal of property of ward from state (2023)
content:
Resident guardians and conservators shall not remove out of this Commonwealth any
   of the property of their wards without first obtaining the approval of a District
   Court of the county in which the guardian or conservator was qualified.  The District Court, upon the petition sworn to by the guardian or conservator and
   such proof as may be deemed necessary, may authorize the removal of the property of
   the ward out of this Commonwealth, upon terms and conditions that are equitable and
   just and will secure and protect the rights and interests of the ward.  Guardians and conservators may be restrained from the unlawful removal of property
   of their wards out of this Commonwealth upon the petition of the ward by next friend,
   or upon the petition of any surety on the bond of the guardian or conservator.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 387. Guardians; Conservators; Curators of Convicts›KY REV ST 387.280. Handling amount of not more than $10,000. due to person under disability who has reached age of § 18
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 387. Guardians; Conservators; Curators of Convicts › KY REV ST 387.280. Handling amount of not more than $10,000. due to person under disability who has reached age of § 18
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 387.280. Handling amount of not more than $10,000. due to person under disability who has reached age of § 18 (2023)
content:
(1)  When a person under disability who has reached the age of eighteen (18), having
      no guardian or conservator, is entitled to receive a sum not exceeding ten thousand
      dollars ($10,000), exclusive of interest, in any action in which real estate has been
      sold, or in the settlement of any estate, or from any other source, the person having
      custody of the person under disability may settle or compromise the dollar amount
      when in the interest of the person under disability.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 387. Guardians; Conservators; Curators of Convicts›KY REV ST 387.185. Powers of foreign guardian or conservator
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 387. Guardians; Conservators; Curators of Convicts › KY REV ST 387.185. Powers of foreign guardian or conservator
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 387.185. Powers of foreign guardian or conservator (2023)
content:
(1)  A foreign guardian or conservator of a ward who is not a resident of the Commonwealth
      of Kentucky may sue for, collect, receive, and remove from the Commonwealth the ward's
      personal property located in the Commonwealth, if the District Court of the county
      having venue pursuant toKRS 387.020, after notice and hearing determines that:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 387. Guardians; Conservators; Curators of Convicts›KY REV ST 387.289. Application of KRS 387.010. to § 387.280
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 387. Guardians; Conservators; Curators of Convicts › KY REV ST 387.289. Application of KRS 387.010. to § 387.280
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 387.289. Application of KRS 387.010. to § 387.280 (2023)
content: (1)  The provisions ofKRS 387.010to387.280shall apply to:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 387. Guardians; Conservators; Curators of Convicts›KY REV ST 387.300. Qualifications of persons suing as next friend; liability for costs
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 387. Guardians; Conservators; Curators of Convicts › KY REV ST 387.300. Qualifications of persons suing as next friend; liability for costs
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 387.300. Qualifications of persons suing as next friend; liability for costs (2023)
content:
(1)  No person shall sue as next friend unless he reside in this state and be free
      from disability, nor unless he file his own affidavit showing his right to sue as
      next friend according to the provisions of this chapter.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 387. Guardians; Conservators; Curators of Convicts›KY REV ST 387.290. Curator for convict; appointment; powers and duties
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 387. Guardians; Conservators; Curators of Convicts › KY REV ST 387.290. Curator for convict; appointment; powers and duties
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 387.290. Curator for convict; appointment; powers and duties (2023)
content:
(1)  The District Court of the county from which the convict was sent to the penitentiary,
      or of the county of his residence if he had one in this state, may, upon the application
      of anyone interested, appoint a suitable curator of the estate of any person over
      the age of twenty-one (21) years confined in the penitentiary.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 388. Uniform Veterans' Guardianship Act›KY REV ST 388.190. Definitions
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 388. Uniform Veterans' Guardianship Act › KY REV ST 388.190. Definitions
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 388.190. Definitions (2023)
content: As used in this chapter:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability›Chapter 388. Uniform Veterans' Guardianship Act›KY REV ST 388.220. Guardian or conservator representing five or more wards not eligible; exceptions
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXIII. Administration of Trusts and Estates of Persons Under Disability › Chapter 388. Uniform Veterans' Guardianship Act › KY REV ST 388.220. Guardian or conservator representing five or more wards not eligible; exceptions
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 388.220. Guardian or conservator representing five or more wards not eligible; exceptions (2023)
content:
(1)  Except as hereinafter provided, it shall be unlawful for any person to accept
      appointment as guardian or conservator of any minor or mentally disabled beneficiary
      of the Veterans Affairs if such proposed guardian or conservator shall at that time
      be acting as guardian or conservator for five (5) wards.  In any case, upon presentation of a petition by an attorney of the Veterans Affairs
      under this section alleging that a guardian or conservator is acting in a fiduciary
      capacity for more than five (5) wards and requesting his discharge for that reason,
      the court, upon proof substantiating the petition, shall require a final accounting
      forthwith from such guardian or conservator and shall discharge such guardian or conservator
      in said case.
