path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody›Domestic Violence and Abuse›KY REV ST 403.751. Entry of summons or order of protection issued pursuant to KRS 403.715. to 403.785. into Law Information Network of Kentucky
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody › Domestic Violence and Abuse › KY REV ST 403.751. citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403.751. Entry of summons or order of protection issued pursuant to KRS 403.715. to 403.785. into Law Information Network of Kentucky (2023)
content:
(1)  All forms, affidavits, and orders of protection issued or filed pursuant toKRS 403.715to403.785which require entry into the Law Information Network of Kentucky shall be entered
      on forms prescribed by the Administrative Office of the Courts after consultation
      with the Justice and Public Safety Cabinet.  If the provisions of an order of protection are contained in an order which is narrative
      in nature, the prescribed form shall be used in addition to the narrative order.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody›Domestic Violence and Abuse›KY REV ST 403.7535. Duty to notify court of change in foreign protective order
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody › Domestic Violence and Abuse › KY REV ST 403.7535. Duty to notify court of change in foreign protective order
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403.7535. Duty to notify court of change in foreign protective order (2023)
content:

      a continuing obligation to inform the court of any expiration, vacation, modification,
      or other change in the order which the person filing the order has received from the

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody›Domestic Violence and Abuse›KY REV ST 403.7531. Clearing of foreign protective orders from Law Information Network of Kentucky

      of Kentucky shall be immediately cleared as an active record from the computer system
      when:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody›Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act›Article 1. General Provisions›KY REV ST 403.806. International application
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody › Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act › Article 1. General Provisions › KY REV ST 403.806. International application
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403.806. International application (2023)
content:
(1)  A court of this state shall treat a foreign country as if it were a state of
      the United States for the purpose of applying Articles 1 and 2.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody›Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act›Article 1. General Provisions›KY REV ST 403.804. Application to Indian tribes
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody › Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act › Article 1. General Provisions › KY REV ST 403.804. Application to Indian tribes
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403.804. Application to Indian tribes (2023)
content:
(1)  A child custody proceeding that pertains to an Indian child as defined in the
      Indian Child Welfare Act,25 U.S.C. secs. 1901 et seq.,is not subject toKRS 403.800to403.880to the extent that it is governed by the Indian Child Welfare Act.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody›Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act›Article 1. General Provisions›KY REV ST 403.800. Definitions for KRS 403.800. to § 403.880
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody › Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act › Article 1. General Provisions › KY REV ST 403.800. Definitions for KRS 403.800. to § 403.880
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403.800. Definitions for KRS 403.800. to § 403.880 (2023)
content: As used inKRS 403.800to403.880:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody›Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act›Article 1. General Provisions›KY REV ST 403.802. Proceedings governed by other law
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody › Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act › Article 1. General Provisions › KY REV ST 403.802. Proceedings governed by other law
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403.802. Proceedings governed by other law (2023)
content:
KRS 403.800to403.880shall not govern an adoption proceeding or a proceeding pertaining to the authorization
   of emergency medical care for a child.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody›Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act›Article 1. General Provisions›KY REV ST 403.808. Effect of child custody determination
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody › Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act › Article 1. General Provisions › KY REV ST 403.808. Effect of child custody determination
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403.808. Effect of child custody determination (2023)
content:
A child custody determination made by a court of this state that had jurisdiction
   underKRS 403.800to403.880binds all persons who have been served in accordance with the laws of this state
   or notified in accordance withKRS 403.812or who have submitted to the jurisdiction of the court, and who have been given an
   opportunity to be heard.  As to those persons, the determination is conclusive as to all decided issues of
   law and fact except to the extent the determination is modified.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody›Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act›Article 1. General Provisions›KY REV ST 403.812. Notice to persons outside state
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody › Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act › Article 1. General Provisions › KY REV ST 403.812. Notice to persons outside state
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403.812. Notice to persons outside state (2023)
content:
(1)  Notice required for the exercise of jurisdiction when a person is outside this
      state shall be given in a manner prescribed by the law of this state for service of
      process or by the law of the state in which the service is made.  Notice shall be given in a manner reasonably calculated to give actual notice but
      may be by warning order if other means are not effective.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody›Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act›Article 1. General Provisions›KY REV ST 403.810. Priority
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody › Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act › Article 1. General Provisions › KY REV ST 403.810. Priority
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403.810. Priority (2023)
content:
If a question of existence or exercise of jurisdiction underKRS 403.800to403.880is raised in a child custody proceeding, the question, upon request of a party, shall
   be given priority on the calendar and handled expeditiously.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody›Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act›Article 1. General Provisions›KY REV ST 403.814. Appearance and limited immunity
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody › Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act › Article 1. General Provisions › KY REV ST 403.814. Appearance and limited immunity
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403.814. Appearance and limited immunity (2023)
content:
(1)  A party to a child custody proceeding, including a modification proceeding, or
      a petitioner or respondent in a proceeding to enforce or register a child custody
      determination, is not subject to personal jurisdiction in this state for another proceeding
      or purpose solely by reason of having participated, or of having been physically present
      for the purpose of participating, in the proceeding.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody›Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act›Article 1. General Provisions›KY REV ST 403.816. Communication between courts
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody › Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act › Article 1. General Provisions › KY REV ST 403.816. Communication between courts
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403.816. Communication between courts (2023)
content:
(1)  A court of this state may communicate with a court in another state concerning
      a proceeding arising underKRS 403.800to403.880.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody›Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act›Article 2. Jurisdiction›KY REV ST 403.824. Exclusive, continuing jurisdiction
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody › Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act › Article 2. Jurisdiction › KY REV ST 403.824. Exclusive, continuing jurisdiction
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403.824. Exclusive, continuing jurisdiction (2023)
content: (1)  Except as otherwise provided inKRS 403.828, a court of this state which has made a child custody determination consistent withKRS 403.822or403.826has exclusive, continuing jurisdiction over the determination until:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody›Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act›Article 1. General Provisions›KY REV ST 403.818. Taking testimony in another state
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody › Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act › Article 1. General Provisions › KY REV ST 403.818. Taking testimony in another state
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403.818. Taking testimony in another state (2023)
content:
(1)  In addition to other procedures available to a party, a party to a child custody
      proceeding may offer testimony of witnesses who are located in another state, including
      testimony of the parties and the child, by deposition or other means allowable in
      this state for testimony taken in another state.  The court on its own motion may order that the testimony of a person be taken in
      another state and may prescribe the manner in which and the terms upon which the testimony
      is taken.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody›Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act›Article 1. General Provisions›KY REV ST 403.820. Cooperation between courts; preservation of records
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody › Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act › Article 1. General Provisions › KY REV ST 403.820. Cooperation between courts; preservation of records
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403.820. Cooperation between courts; preservation of records (2023)
content: (1)  A court of this state may request the appropriate court of another state to:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody›Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act›Article 2. Jurisdiction›KY REV ST 403.822. Initial child custody jurisdiction
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody › Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act › Article 2. Jurisdiction › KY REV ST 403.822. Initial child custody jurisdiction
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403.822. Initial child custody jurisdiction (2023)
content:
(1)  Except as otherwise provided inKRS 403.828, a court of this state shall have jurisdiction to make an initial child custody determination
      only if:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody›Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act›Article 2. Jurisdiction›KY REV ST 403.830. Notice; opportunity to be heard; joinder
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody › Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act › Article 2. Jurisdiction › KY REV ST 403.830. Notice; opportunity to be heard; joinder
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403.830. Notice; opportunity to be heard; joinder (2023)
content:
(1)  Before a child custody determination is made underKRS 403.800to403.880, notice and an opportunity to be heard in accordance with the standards ofKRS 403.812shall be given to all persons entitled to notice under the law of this state as in
      child custody proceedings between residents of this state, any parent whose parental
      rights have not been previously terminated, and any person having physical custody
      of the child.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody›Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act›Article 2. Jurisdiction›KY REV ST 403.834. Inconvenient forum
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody › Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act › Article 2. Jurisdiction › KY REV ST 403.834. Inconvenient forum
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403.834. Inconvenient forum (2023)
content:
(1)  A court of this state which has jurisdiction underKRS 403.800to403.880to make a child custody determination may decline to exercise its jurisdiction at
      any time if it determines that it is an inconvenient forum under the circumstances
      and that a court of another state is a more appropriate forum.  The issue of inconvenient forum may be raised upon motion of a party, the court's
      own motion, or request of another court.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody›Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act›Article 2. Jurisdiction›KY REV ST 403.826. Jurisdiction to modify determination
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody › Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act › Article 2. Jurisdiction › KY REV ST 403.826. Jurisdiction to modify determination
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403.826. Jurisdiction to modify determination (2023)
content:
Except as otherwise provided inKRS 403.828, a court of this state shall not modify a child custody determination made by a court
   of another state unless a court of this state has jurisdiction to make an initial
   determination underKRS 403.822(1)(a) or (b)and:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody›Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act›Article 2. Jurisdiction›KY REV ST 403.828. Temporary emergency jurisdiction
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody › Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act › Article 2. Jurisdiction › KY REV ST 403.828. Temporary emergency jurisdiction
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403.828. Temporary emergency jurisdiction (2023)
content:
(1)  A court of this state has temporary emergency jurisdiction if the child is present
      in this state and the child has been abandoned or it is necessary in an emergency
      to protect the child because the child, or a sibling or parent of the child, is subjected
      to or threatened with mistreatment or abuse.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody›Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act›Article 2. Jurisdiction›KY REV ST 403.832. Simultaneous proceedings
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody › Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act › Article 2. Jurisdiction › KY REV ST 403.832. Simultaneous proceedings
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403.832. Simultaneous proceedings (2023)
content:
(1)  Except as otherwise provided inKRS 403.828, a court of this state shall not exercise jurisdiction under Article 2 if, at the
      time of the commencement of the proceeding, a proceeding concerning the custody of
      the child has been commenced in a court of another state having jurisdiction substantially
      in conformity withKRS 403.800to403.880, unless the proceeding has been terminated or is stayed by the court of the other
      state because a court of this state is a more convenient forum underKRS 403.834.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody›Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act›Article 2. Jurisdiction›KY REV ST 403.840. Appearance of parties and child
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody › Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act › Article 2. Jurisdiction › KY REV ST 403.840. Appearance of parties and child
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403.840. Appearance of parties and child (2023)
content:
(1)  In a child custody proceeding in this state, the court may order a party to the
      proceeding who is in this state to appear before the court in person with or without
      the child.  The court may order any person who is in this state and who has physical custody
      or control of the child to appear in person with the child.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody›Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act›Article 3. Enforcement›KY REV ST 403.846. Duty to enforce
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody › Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act › Article 3. Enforcement › KY REV ST 403.846. Duty to enforce
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403.846. Duty to enforce (2023)
content:
(1)  A court of this state shall recognize and enforce a child custody determination
      of a court of another state if the latter court exercised jurisdiction in substantial
      conformity withKRS 403.800to403.880or the determination was made under factual circumstances meeting the jurisdictional
      standards ofKRS 403.800to403.880and the determination has not been modified in accordance withKRS 403.800to403.880.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody›Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act›Article 2. Jurisdiction›KY REV ST 403.838. Information to be submitted to court
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody › Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act › Article 2. Jurisdiction › KY REV ST 403.838. Information to be submitted to court
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403.838. Information to be submitted to court (2023)
content:
(1)  In a child custody proceeding, each party, in its first pleading or in an attached
      affidavit, shall give information, if reasonably ascertainable, under oath as to the
      child's present address or whereabouts, the places where the child has lived during
      the last five (5) years, and the names and present addresses of the persons with whom
      the child has lived during that period.  The pleading or affidavit shall state whether the party:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody›Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act›Article 3. Enforcement›KY REV ST 403.844. Enforcement under Hague Convention
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody › Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act › Article 3. Enforcement › KY REV ST 403.844. Enforcement under Hague Convention
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403.844. Enforcement under Hague Convention (2023)
content:
Under Article 3, a court of this state may enforce an order for the return of the
   child made under the Hague Convention on the Civil Aspects of International Child
   Abduction as if it were a child custody determination.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody›Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act›Article 3. Enforcement›KY REV ST 403.842. Definitions for Article § 3
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody › Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act › Article 3. Enforcement › KY REV ST 403.842. Definitions for Article § 3
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403.842. Definitions for Article § 3 (2023)
content: As used in Article 3:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody›Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act›Article 2. Jurisdiction›KY REV ST 403.836. Jurisdiction declined by reason of conduct
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody › Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act › Article 2. Jurisdiction › KY REV ST 403.836. Jurisdiction declined by reason of conduct
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403.836. Jurisdiction declined by reason of conduct (2023)
content:
(1)  Except as otherwise provided inKRS 403.828, or by other law of this state, if a court of this state has jurisdiction underKRS 403.800to403.880because a person seeking to invoke its jurisdiction has engaged in unjustifiable
      conduct, the court shall decline to exercise its jurisdiction unless:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody›Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act›Article 3. Enforcement›KY REV ST 403.848. Temporary visitation
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody › Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act › Article 3. Enforcement › KY REV ST 403.848. Temporary visitation
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403.848. Temporary visitation (2023)
content:
(1)  A court of this state which does not have jurisdiction to modify a child custody
      determination may issue a temporary order enforcing:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody›Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act›Article 3. Enforcement›KY REV ST 403.854. Simultaneous proceedings
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody › Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act › Article 3. Enforcement › KY REV ST 403.854. Simultaneous proceedings
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403.854. Simultaneous proceedings (2023)
content:
If a proceeding for enforcement under Article 3 is commenced in a court of this state
   and the court determines that a proceeding to modify the determination is pending
   in a court of another state having jurisdiction to modify the determination under
   Article 2, the enforcing court shall immediately communicate with the modifying court.  The proceeding for enforcement continues unless the enforcing court, after consultation
   with the modifying court, stays or dismisses the proceeding.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody›Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act›Article 3. Enforcement›KY REV ST 403.850. Registration of child custody determination
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody › Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act › Article 3. Enforcement › KY REV ST 403.850. Registration of child custody determination
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403.850. Registration of child custody determination (2023)
content:
(1)  A child custody determination issued by a court of another state may be registered
      in this state, with or without a simultaneous request for enforcement, by sending
      to a court with jurisdiction in this state:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody›Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act›Article 3. Enforcement›KY REV ST 403.852. Enforcement of registered determination
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody › Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act › Article 3. Enforcement › KY REV ST 403.852. Enforcement of registered determination
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403.852. Enforcement of registered determination (2023)
content:
(1)  A court of this state may grant any relief normally available under the law of
      this state to enforce a registered child custody determination made by a court of
      another state.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody›Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act›Article 3. Enforcement›KY REV ST 403.856. Expedited enforcement of child custody determination
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody › Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act › Article 3. Enforcement › KY REV ST 403.856. Expedited enforcement of child custody determination
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403.856. Expedited enforcement of child custody determination (2023)
content:
(1)  A petition under Article 3 shall be verified.  Certified copies of all orders sought to be enforced and of any order confirming
      registration shall be attached to the petition.  A copy of a certified copy of an order may be attached instead of the original.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody›Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act›Article 3. Enforcement›KY REV ST 403.858. Service of petition and order
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody › Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act › Article 3. Enforcement › KY REV ST 403.858. Service of petition and order
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403.858. Service of petition and order (2023)
content:
Except as otherwise provided inKRS 403.862, the petition and order shall be served, by any method authorized by the law of this
   state, upon respondent and any person who has physical custody of the child.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody›Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act›Article 3. Enforcement›KY REV ST 403.864. Costs, fees, and expenses
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody › Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act › Article 3. Enforcement › KY REV ST 403.864. Costs, fees, and expenses
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403.864. Costs, fees, and expenses (2023)
content:
(1)  The court may award the prevailing party, including a state, necessary and reasonable
      expenses incurred by or on behalf of the party, including costs, communication expenses,
      attorney's fees, investigative fees, expenses for witnesses, travel expenses, and
      child care during the course of the proceedings, unless the party from whom fees or
      expenses are sought establishes that the award would be clearly inappropriate.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody›Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act›Article 3. Enforcement›KY REV ST 403.860. Hearing and order
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody › Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act › Article 3. Enforcement › KY REV ST 403.860. Hearing and order
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403.860. Hearing and order (2023)
content:
(1)  Unless the court issues a temporary emergency order pursuant toKRS 403.828, upon a finding that a petitioner is entitled to immediate physical custody of the
      child, the court shall order that the petitioner may take immediate physical custody
      of the child unless the respondent establishes that:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody›Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act›Article 3. Enforcement›KY REV ST 403.870. Role of county attorney or other appropriate public official
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody › Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act › Article 3. Enforcement › KY REV ST 403.870. Role of county attorney or other appropriate public official
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403.870. Role of county attorney or other appropriate public official (2023)
content:
(1)  In a case arising underKRS 403.800to403.880or involving the Hague Convention on the Civil Aspects of International Child Abduction,
      the county attorney or other appropriate public official may take any lawful action,
      including resort to a proceeding under Article 3 or any other available civil proceeding
      to locate a child, obtain the return of a child, or enforce a child custody determination
      if there is:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody›Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act›Article 3. Enforcement›KY REV ST 403.868. Appeals
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody › Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act › Article 3. Enforcement › KY REV ST 403.868. Appeals
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403.868. Appeals (2023)
content:
A party may move for an expedited appeal from a final order in a proceeding under
   Article 3.  Unless the court enters a temporary emergency order underKRS 403.828, the enforcing court shall not stay an order enforcing a child custody determination
   pending appeal.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody›Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act›Article 3. Enforcement›KY REV ST 403.862. Warrant to take physical custody of child
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody › Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act › Article 3. Enforcement › KY REV ST 403.862. Warrant to take physical custody of child
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403.862. Warrant to take physical custody of child (2023)
content:
(1)  Upon the filing of a petition seeking enforcement of a child custody determination,
      the petitioner may file a verified application for the issuance of a warrant to take
      physical custody of the child if the child is immediately likely to suffer serious
      physical harm or be removed from this state.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody›Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act›Article 3. Enforcement›KY REV ST 403.872. Role of peace officers
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody › Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act › Article 3. Enforcement › KY REV ST 403.872. Role of peace officers
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403.872. Role of peace officers (2023)
content:
At the request of a county attorney or other appropriate public official acting underKRS 403.870, a peace officer may take any lawful action reasonably necessary to locate a child
   or a party and assist a county attorney or other appropriate public official with
   responsibilities underKRS 403.870.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody›Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act›Article 3. Enforcement›KY REV ST 403.866. Recognition and enforcement
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody › Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act › Article 3. Enforcement › KY REV ST 403.866. Recognition and enforcement
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403.866. Recognition and enforcement (2023)
content:
A court of this state shall accord full faith and credit to an order issued by another
   state and consistent withKRS 403.800to403.880which enforces a child custody determination by a court of another state unless the
   order has been vacated, stayed, or modified by a court having jurisdiction to do so
   under Article 2.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody›Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act›Article 4. Miscellaneous Provisions›KY REV ST 403.876. Application and construction of KRS 403.800. to § 403.880
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody › Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act › Article 4. Miscellaneous Provisions › KY REV ST 403.876. Application and construction of KRS 403.800. to § 403.880
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403.876. Application and construction of KRS 403.800. to § 403.880 (2023)
content:
In applying and construingKRS 403.800to403.880, consideration shall be given to the need to promote uniformity of the law with respect
   to its subject matter among states that enact it.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody›Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act›Article 4. Miscellaneous Provisions›KY REV ST 403.878. Transitional provisions
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody › Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act › Article 4. Miscellaneous Provisions › KY REV ST 403.878. Transitional provisions
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403.878. Transitional provisions (2023)
content:
(1)  A motion or other request for relief made in a child custody proceeding or to
      enforce a child custody determination which was commenced before July 13, 2004, is
      governed by the law in effect at the time the motion or other request was made.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody›Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act›Article 4. Miscellaneous Provisions›KY REV ST 403.880. Short title for KRS 403.800. to § 403.880
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody › Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act › Article 4. Miscellaneous Provisions › KY REV ST 403.880. Short title for KRS 403.800. to § 403.880
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403.880. Short title for KRS 403.800. to § 403.880 (2023)
content: KRS 403.800to403.880may be cited as the Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403A. Uniform Deployed Parents Custody and Visitation Act›General Provisions›KY REV ST 403A.103. Remedies for noncompliance
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403A. Uniform Deployed Parents Custody and Visitation Act › General Provisions › KY REV ST 403A.103. Remedies for noncompliance
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403A.103. Remedies for noncompliance (2023)
content:
In addition to other remedies under law of this state other than this chapter, if
   a court finds that a party to a proceeding under this chapter has acted in bad faith
   or intentionally failed to comply with this chapter or a court order issued under
   this chapter, the court may assess reasonable attorney's fees and costs against the
   party and order other appropriate relief.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody›Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act›Article 3. Enforcement›KY REV ST 403.874. Costs and expenses
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403. Dissolution of Marriage; Child Custody › Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act › Article 3. Enforcement › KY REV ST 403.874. Costs and expenses
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403.874. Costs and expenses (2023)
content:
If the respondent is not the prevailing party, the court may assess against the respondent
   all direct expenses and costs incurred by the county attorney or other appropriate
   public official and peace officers underKRS 403.870or403.872.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403A. Uniform Deployed Parents Custody and Visitation Act›General Provisions›KY REV ST 403A.102. Definitions for chapter
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403A. Uniform Deployed Parents Custody and Visitation Act › General Provisions › KY REV ST 403A.102. Definitions for chapter
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403A.102. Definitions for chapter (2023)
content: As used in this chapter:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403A. Uniform Deployed Parents Custody and Visitation Act›General Provisions›KY REV ST 403A.101. Short Title
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403A. Uniform Deployed Parents Custody and Visitation Act › General Provisions › KY REV ST 403A.101. Short Title
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403A.101. Short Title (2023)
content: This chapter may be cited as the Uniform Deployed Parents Custody and Visitation Act.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403A. Uniform Deployed Parents Custody and Visitation Act›General Provisions›KY REV ST 403A.106. Duty to notify of change of address
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403A. Uniform Deployed Parents Custody and Visitation Act › General Provisions › KY REV ST 403A.106. Duty to notify of change of address
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403A.106. Duty to notify of change of address (2023)
content:
(1)  Except as otherwise provided in subsection (2) of this section, an individual
      to whom custodial responsibility has been granted during deployment pursuant toKRS 403A.201to403A.205or403A.301to403A.311shall notify the deploying parent and any other individual with custodial responsibility
      of a child of any change of the individual's mailing address or residence until the
      grant is terminated.  The individual shall provide the notice to any court that has issued a custody or
      child support order concerning the child which is in effect.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403A. Uniform Deployed Parents Custody and Visitation Act›Agreement Addressing Custodial Responsibility During Deployment›KY REV ST 403A.202. Nature of authority created by agreement
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403A. Uniform Deployed Parents Custody and Visitation Act › Agreement Addressing Custodial Responsibility During Deployment › KY REV ST 403A.202. Nature of authority created by agreement
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403A.202. Nature of authority created by agreement (2023)
content:
(1)  An agreement underKRS 403A.201to403A.205is temporary and terminates pursuant toKRS 403A.401to403A.404after the deploying parent returns from deployment, unless the agreement has been
      terminated before that time by court order or modification underKRS 403A.203.  The agreement does not create an independent, continuing right to caretaking authority,
      decision-making authority, or limited contact in an individual to whom custodial responsibility
      is given.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403A. Uniform Deployed Parents Custody and Visitation Act›General Provisions›KY REV ST 403A.104. Jurisdiction
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403A. Uniform Deployed Parents Custody and Visitation Act › General Provisions › KY REV ST 403A.104. Jurisdiction
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403A.104. Jurisdiction (2023)
content:
(1)  A court may issue an order regarding custodial responsibility under this chapter
      only if the court has jurisdiction under the Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and
      Enforcement Act,KRS 403.800to403.880.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403A. Uniform Deployed Parents Custody and Visitation Act›General Provisions›KY REV ST 403A.107. General consideration in custody proceeding of parent’s military service
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403A. Uniform Deployed Parents Custody and Visitation Act › General Provisions › KY REV ST 403A.107. General consideration in custody proceeding of parent’s military service
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403A.107. General consideration in custody proceeding of parent’s military service (2023)
content:
In a proceeding for custodial responsibility of a child of a service member, a court
   may not consider a parent's past deployment or possible future deployment in itself
   in determining the best interest of the child but may consider any significant impact
   on the best interest of the child of the parent's past or possible future deployment.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403A. Uniform Deployed Parents Custody and Visitation Act›Agreement Addressing Custodial Responsibility During Deployment›KY REV ST 403A.203. Modification of agreement
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403A. Uniform Deployed Parents Custody and Visitation Act › Agreement Addressing Custodial Responsibility During Deployment › KY REV ST 403A.203. Modification of agreement
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403A.203. Modification of agreement (2023)
content:
(1)  By mutual consent, the parents of a child may modify an agreement regarding custodial
      responsibility made pursuant toKRS 403A.201to403A.205.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403A. Uniform Deployed Parents Custody and Visitation Act›General Provisions›KY REV ST 403A.105. Notification required of deploying parent
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403A. Uniform Deployed Parents Custody and Visitation Act › General Provisions › KY REV ST 403A.105. Notification required of deploying parent
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403A.105. Notification required of deploying parent (2023)
content:
(1)  Except as otherwise provided in subsection (4) of this section, and subject to
      subsection (3) of this section, a deploying parent shall notify in a record the other
      parent of a pending deployment not later than seven (7) days after receiving notice
      of deployment unless reasonably prevented from doing so by the circumstances of service.  If the circumstances of service prevent giving notification within the seven (7)
      days, the deploying parent shall give the notification as soon as reasonably possible.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403A. Uniform Deployed Parents Custody and Visitation Act›Agreement Addressing Custodial Responsibility During Deployment›KY REV ST 403A.204. Power of attorney
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403A. Uniform Deployed Parents Custody and Visitation Act › Agreement Addressing Custodial Responsibility During Deployment › KY REV ST 403A.204. Power of attorney
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403A.204. Power of attorney (2023)
content:
A deploying parent, by power of attorney, may delegate all or part of custodial responsibility
   to an adult nonparent for the period of deployment if no other parent possesses custodial
   responsibility under law of this state other than this chapter, or if a court order
   currently in effect prohibits contact between the child and the other parent.  The deploying parent may revoke the power of attorney by signing a revocation of
   the power.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403A. Uniform Deployed Parents Custody and Visitation Act›Agreement Addressing Custodial Responsibility During Deployment›KY REV ST 403A.201. Form of agreement
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403A. Uniform Deployed Parents Custody and Visitation Act › Agreement Addressing Custodial Responsibility During Deployment › KY REV ST 403A.201. Form of agreement
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403A.201. Form of agreement (2023)
content: (1)  The parents of a child may enter into a temporary agreement underKRS 403A.201to403A.205granting custodial responsibility during deployment.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403A. Uniform Deployed Parents Custody and Visitation Act›Agreement Addressing Custodial Responsibility During Deployment›KY REV ST 403A.205. Filing agreement or power of attorney with court
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403A. Uniform Deployed Parents Custody and Visitation Act › Agreement Addressing Custodial Responsibility During Deployment › KY REV ST 403A.205. Filing agreement or power of attorney with court
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403A.205. Filing agreement or power of attorney with court (2023)
content:
An agreement or power of attorney underKRS 403A.201to403A.205shall be filed within a reasonable time with any court that has entered an order
   on custodial responsibility or child support that is in effect concerning the child
   who is the subject of the agreement or power.  The case number and heading of the pending case concerning custodial responsibility
   or child support shall be provided to the court with the agreement or power.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403A. Uniform Deployed Parents Custody and Visitation Act›Judicial Procedure for Granting Custodial Responsibility During Deployment›KY REV ST 403A.304. Testimony by electronic means
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403A. Uniform Deployed Parents Custody and Visitation Act › Judicial Procedure for Granting Custodial Responsibility During Deployment › KY REV ST 403A.304. Testimony by electronic means
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403A.304. Testimony by electronic means (2023)
content:
In a proceeding underKRS 403A.301to403A.311, a party or witness who is not reasonably available to appear personally may appear,
   provide testimony, and present evidence by electronic means unless the court finds
   good cause to require a personal appearance.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403A. Uniform Deployed Parents Custody and Visitation Act›Judicial Procedure for Granting Custodial Responsibility During Deployment›KY REV ST 403A.302. Proceeding for temporary custody order
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403A. Uniform Deployed Parents Custody and Visitation Act › Judicial Procedure for Granting Custodial Responsibility During Deployment › KY REV ST 403A.302. Proceeding for temporary custody order
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403A.302. Proceeding for temporary custody order (2023)
content:
(1)  After a deploying parent receives notice of deployment and until the deployment
      terminates, a court may issue a temporary order granting custodial responsibility
      unless prohibited by the Servicemembers Civil Relief Act,50 U.S.C.  Appendix Sections 521and522.  A court may not issue a permanent order granting custodial responsibility without
      the consent of the deploying parent.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403A. Uniform Deployed Parents Custody and Visitation Act›Judicial Procedure for Granting Custodial Responsibility During Deployment›KY REV ST 403A.305. Effect of prior judicial order or agreement
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403A. Uniform Deployed Parents Custody and Visitation Act › Judicial Procedure for Granting Custodial Responsibility During Deployment › KY REV ST 403A.305. Effect of prior judicial order or agreement
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403A.305. Effect of prior judicial order or agreement (2023)
content: In a proceeding for a grant of custodial responsibility pursuant toKRS 403A.301to403A.311, the following rules apply:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403A. Uniform Deployed Parents Custody and Visitation Act›Judicial Procedure for Granting Custodial Responsibility During Deployment›KY REV ST 403A.301. Close and substantial relationship defined
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403A. Uniform Deployed Parents Custody and Visitation Act › Judicial Procedure for Granting Custodial Responsibility During Deployment › KY REV ST 403A.301. Close and substantial relationship defined
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403A.301. Close and substantial relationship defined (2023)
content: As used inKRS 403A.301to403A.311, “close and substantial relationship” means a relationship in which a significant bond exists between a child and a nonparent.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403A. Uniform Deployed Parents Custody and Visitation Act›Judicial Procedure for Granting Custodial Responsibility During Deployment›KY REV ST 403A.307. Grant of limited contact
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403A. Uniform Deployed Parents Custody and Visitation Act › Judicial Procedure for Granting Custodial Responsibility During Deployment › KY REV ST 403A.307. Grant of limited contact
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403A.307. Grant of limited contact (2023)
content:
On motion of a deploying parent, and in accordance with law of this state other than
   this chapter, unless the court finds that the contact would be contrary to the best
   interest of the child, a court shall grant limited contact to a nonparent who is a
   family member of the child or an individual with whom the child has a close and substantial
   relationship.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403A. Uniform Deployed Parents Custody and Visitation Act›Judicial Procedure for Granting Custodial Responsibility During Deployment›KY REV ST 403A.311. Modifying or terminating grant of custodial responsibility to nonparent
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403A. Uniform Deployed Parents Custody and Visitation Act › Judicial Procedure for Granting Custodial Responsibility During Deployment › KY REV ST 403A.311. Modifying or terminating grant of custodial responsibility to nonparent
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403A.311. Modifying or terminating grant of custodial responsibility to nonparent (2023)
content:
(1)  Except for an order underKRS 403A.305, except as otherwise provided in subsection (2) of this section, and consistent with
      the Servicemembers Civil Relief Act,50 U.S.C.  Appendix Sections 521and522, on motion of a deploying or other parent or any nonparent to whom caretaking authority,
      decision-making authority, or limited contact has been granted, the court may modify
      or terminate the grant if the modification or termination is consistent withKRS 403A.301to403A.311and it is in the best interest of the child.  A modification is temporary and terminates pursuant toKRS 403A.401to403A.404after the deploying parent returns from deployment, unless the grant has been terminated
      before that time by court order.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403A. Uniform Deployed Parents Custody and Visitation Act›Miscellaneous Provisions›KY REV ST 403A.502. Relation to Electronic Signatures in Global and National Commerce Act
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403A. Uniform Deployed Parents Custody and Visitation Act › Miscellaneous Provisions › KY REV ST 403A.502. Relation to Electronic Signatures in Global and National Commerce Act
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403A.502. Relation to Electronic Signatures in Global and National Commerce Act (2023)
content:
This chapter modifies, limits, or supersedes the Electronic Signatures in Global and
   National Commerce Act,15 U.S.C. sec. 7001 et seq.,but does not modify, limit, or supersede Section 101(c) of that act,15 U.S.C. sec. 7001(c), or authorize electronic delivery of any of the notices described in Section 103(b)
   of that act,15 U.S.C. sec. 7003(b).

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403A. Uniform Deployed Parents Custody and Visitation Act›Judicial Procedure for Granting Custodial Responsibility During Deployment›KY REV ST 403A.309. Content of temporary custody order
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403A. Uniform Deployed Parents Custody and Visitation Act › Judicial Procedure for Granting Custodial Responsibility During Deployment › KY REV ST 403A.309. Content of temporary custody order
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403A.309. Content of temporary custody order (2023)
content: (1)  An order granting custodial responsibility under this article shall:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403A. Uniform Deployed Parents Custody and Visitation Act›Judicial Procedure for Granting Custodial Responsibility During Deployment›KY REV ST 403A.303. Expedited hearing
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403A. Uniform Deployed Parents Custody and Visitation Act › Judicial Procedure for Granting Custodial Responsibility During Deployment › KY REV ST 403A.303. Expedited hearing
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403A.303. Expedited hearing (2023)
content:
If a motion to grant custodial responsibility is filed under 403A.302(2) before a
   deploying parent deploys, the court shall conduct an expedited hearing.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403A. Uniform Deployed Parents Custody and Visitation Act›Miscellaneous Provisions›KY REV ST 403A.503. Savings clause
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403A. Uniform Deployed Parents Custody and Visitation Act › Miscellaneous Provisions › KY REV ST 403A.503. Savings clause
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403A.503. Savings clause (2023)
content:
This chapter does not affect the validity of a temporary court order concerning custodial
   responsibility during deployment which was entered before June 29, 2021.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403A. Uniform Deployed Parents Custody and Visitation Act›Return from Deployment›KY REV ST 403A.402. Consent procedure for terminating temporary grant of custodial responsibility established by court order
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403A. Uniform Deployed Parents Custody and Visitation Act › Return from Deployment › KY REV ST 403A.402. Consent procedure for terminating temporary grant of custodial responsibility established by court order
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403A.402. Consent procedure for terminating temporary grant of custodial responsibility established by court order (2023)
content:
At any time after a deploying parent returns from deployment, the deploying parent
   and the other parent may file with the court an agreement to terminate a temporary
   order for custodial responsibility issued underKRS 403A.301to403A.311.  After an agreement has been filed, the court shall issue an order terminating the
   temporary order effective on the date specified in the agreement.  If a date is not specified, the order is effective immediately.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403A. Uniform Deployed Parents Custody and Visitation Act›Judicial Procedure for Granting Custodial Responsibility During Deployment›KY REV ST 403A.306. Grant of caretaking or decision-making authority to nonparent
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403A. Uniform Deployed Parents Custody and Visitation Act › Judicial Procedure for Granting Custodial Responsibility During Deployment › KY REV ST 403A.306. Grant of caretaking or decision-making authority to nonparent
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403A.306. Grant of caretaking or decision-making authority to nonparent (2023)
content:
(1)  On motion of a deploying parent and in accordance with law of this state other
      than this chapter, if it is in the best interest of the child, a court may grant caretaking
      authority to a nonparent who is an adult family member of the child or an adult with
      whom the child has a close and substantial relationship.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403A. Uniform Deployed Parents Custody and Visitation Act›Judicial Procedure for Granting Custodial Responsibility During Deployment›KY REV ST 403A.310. Order for child support
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403A. Uniform Deployed Parents Custody and Visitation Act › Judicial Procedure for Granting Custodial Responsibility During Deployment › KY REV ST 403A.310. Order for child support
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403A.310. Order for child support (2023)
content:
If a court has issued an order granting caretaking authority under this article, or
   an agreement granting caretaking authority has been executed underKRS 403A.201to403A.205, the court may enter a temporary order for child support consistent with law of this
   state other than this chapter if the court has jurisdiction under the Uniform Interstate
   Family Support Act,KRS 407.5101to407.5902.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403A. Uniform Deployed Parents Custody and Visitation Act›Return from Deployment›KY REV ST 403A.401. Procedure for terminating temporary grant of custodial responsibility established by agreement
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403A. Uniform Deployed Parents Custody and Visitation Act › Return from Deployment › KY REV ST 403A.401. Procedure for terminating temporary grant of custodial responsibility established by agreement
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403A.401. Procedure for terminating temporary grant of custodial responsibility established by agreement (2023)
content:
(1)  At any time after return from deployment, a temporary agreement granting custodial
      responsibility underKRS 403A.201to403A.205may be terminated by an agreement to terminate signed by the deploying parent and
      the other parent.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403A. Uniform Deployed Parents Custody and Visitation Act›Judicial Procedure for Granting Custodial Responsibility During Deployment›KY REV ST 403A.308. Nature of authority created by temporary custody order
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403A. Uniform Deployed Parents Custody and Visitation Act › Judicial Procedure for Granting Custodial Responsibility During Deployment › KY REV ST 403A.308. Nature of authority created by temporary custody order
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403A.308. Nature of authority created by temporary custody order (2023)
content:
(1)  A grant of authority underKRS 403A.301to403A.311is temporary and terminates underKRS 403A.401to403A.404after the return from deployment of the deploying parent, unless the grant has been
      terminated before that time by court order.  The grant does not create an independent, continuing right to caretaking authority,
      decision-making authority, or limited contact in an individual to whom it is granted.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403A. Uniform Deployed Parents Custody and Visitation Act›Miscellaneous Provisions›KY REV ST 403A.501. Uniformity of application and construction
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403A. Uniform Deployed Parents Custody and Visitation Act › Miscellaneous Provisions › KY REV ST 403A.501. Uniformity of application and construction
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403A.501. Uniformity of application and construction (2023)
content:
In applying and construing the Uniform Deployed Parents Custody and Visitation Act,
   consideration shall be given to the need to promote uniformity of the law with respect
   to its subject matter among states that enact it.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 404. Contracts and Separate Estate of Married Women›KY REV ST 404.010. Effect of marriage on wife's property; separate estate; subjection of estate to debts
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 404. Contracts and Separate Estate of Married Women › KY REV ST 404.010. Effect of marriage on wife's property; separate estate; subjection of estate to debts
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 404.010. Effect of marriage on wife's property; separate estate; subjection of estate to debts (2023)
content:
(1)  Marriage shall give to the husband, during the life of the wife, no estate or
      interest in the wife's property, real or personal, owned at the time or acquired after
      the marriage.  During the existence of the marriage relationship the wife shall hold and own all
      her estate to her separate and exclusive use, and free from the debts, liabilities
      or control of her husband.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403A. Uniform Deployed Parents Custody and Visitation Act›Return from Deployment›KY REV ST 403A.403. Visitation before termination of temporary grant of custodial responsibility
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403A. Uniform Deployed Parents Custody and Visitation Act › Return from Deployment › KY REV ST 403A.403. Visitation before termination of temporary grant of custodial responsibility
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403A.403. Visitation before termination of temporary grant of custodial responsibility (2023)
content:
After a deploying parent returns from deployment until a temporary agreement or order
   for custodial responsibility established underKRS 403A.201to403A.205orKRS 403A.301to403A.311is terminated, the court shall issue a temporary order granting the deploying parent
   reasonable contact with the child unless it is contrary to the best interest of the
   child, even if the time of contact exceeds the time the deploying parent spent with
   the child before the deployment.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 403A. Uniform Deployed Parents Custody and Visitation Act›Return from Deployment›KY REV ST 403A.404. Termination by operation of law of temporary grant of custodial responsibility established by court order
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 403A. Uniform Deployed Parents Custody and Visitation Act › Return from Deployment › KY REV ST 403A.404. Termination by operation of law of temporary grant of custodial responsibility established by court order
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 403A.404. Termination by operation of law of temporary grant of custodial responsibility established by court order (2023)
content:
(1)  If an agreement between the parties to terminate a temporary order for custodial
      responsibility underKRS 403A.301to403A.311has not been filed, the order terminates sixty (60) days after the deploying parent
      gives notice to the other parent and any nonparent granted custodial responsibility
      that the deploying parent has returned from deployment.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 404. Contracts and Separate Estate of Married Women›KY REV ST 404.040. Liability of husband for wife's debts
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 404. Contracts and Separate Estate of Married Women › KY REV ST 404.040. Liability of husband for wife's debts
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 404.040. Liability of husband for wife's debts (2023)
content:
The husband shall not be liable for any debt or responsibility of the wife contracted
   or incurred before or after marriage, except to the amount or value of the property
   he received from or by her by virtue of the marriage;  but he shall be liable for
   necessaries furnished to her after marriage.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 404. Contracts and Separate Estate of Married Women›KY REV ST 404.030. Conveyance or encumbrance of real property by married woman; husband's curtesy right; conveyance by married woman through agent
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 404. Contracts and Separate Estate of Married Women › KY REV ST 404.030. Conveyance or encumbrance of real property by married woman; husband's curtesy right; conveyance by married woman through agent
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 404.030. Conveyance or encumbrance of real property by married woman; husband's curtesy right; conveyance by married woman through agent (2023)
content:
(1)  A married woman may sell, convey or encumber any of her lands and chattels real,
      but such sale, conveyance or encumbrance shall not bar the husband's right to curtesy
      unless he joins in the instrument of sale, conveyance or encumbrance or releases his
      right to curtesy by separate instrument.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 404. Contracts and Separate Estate of Married Women›KY REV ST 404.020. Property rights; contract rights; transfer of personal property between husband and wife
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 404. Contracts and Separate Estate of Married Women › KY REV ST 404.020. Property rights; contract rights; transfer of personal property between husband and wife
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 404.020. Property rights; contract rights; transfer of personal property between husband and wife (2023)
content:
(1)  A married woman may acquire and hold property, real and personal, by gift, devise
      or descent, or by purchase, and may, in her own name, as if she were unmarried, sell
      and dispose of her personal property.  She may make contracts, and sue and be sued, as a single woman.  She may rent out her real estate, and collect, receive and recover in her own name
      the rents thereof, and make contracts for the improvement thereof.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 405. Parent and Child›Parent and Child›KY REV ST 405.010. Parents entitled to services and earnings of child; suit for loss of
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 405. Parent and Child › Parent and Child › KY REV ST 405.010. Parents entitled to services and earnings of child; suit for loss of
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 405.010. Parents entitled to services and earnings of child; suit for loss of (2023)
content:
The father and mother of a child under the age of eighteen are equally entitled to
   its services and earnings.  If one of the parents is dead, or has abandoned the child, or been deprived of its
   custody by court decree, the other is entitled to its services and earnings.  The parents jointly may maintain an action for loss of the services or earnings
   of their child under the age of eighteen when the loss is occasioned by an injury
   wrongfully or negligently inflicted upon the child.  But if either the father or mother is dead, or has abandoned the child, or has been
   deprived of its custody by court decree, or refuses to sue, the other may sue alone.  This section shall not affect the existing law relating to workers' compensation
   and industrial accidents.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 404. Contracts and Separate Estate of Married Women›KY REV ST 404.050. When wife may convey or mortgage her real estate free from husband's claim
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 404. Contracts and Separate Estate of Married Women › KY REV ST 404.050. When wife may convey or mortgage her real estate free from husband's claim
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 404.050. When wife may convey or mortgage her real estate free from husband's claim (2023)
content:
When a husband has been adjudged mentally disabled by a court of competent jurisdiction,
   the wife, by judgment of a court of equity, may be empowered to sell and convey by
   her own deed, or to mortgage by appropriate instrument, any of her real estate freed
   as to it and its proceeds from any claim of her husband.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 405. Parent and Child›Parent and Child›KY REV ST 405.025. Parent or guardian liable for willful damage to property caused by minor
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 405. Parent and Child › Parent and Child › KY REV ST 405.025. Parent or guardian liable for willful damage to property caused by minor
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 405.025. Parent or guardian liable for willful damage to property caused by minor (2023)
content:
(1)  The parent or guardian of any unemancipated minor, in his care and custody, against
      whom judgment has been rendered for the willful marking upon, defacing or damaging
      of any property, shall be liable for the payment of that judgment up to an amount
      not to exceed twenty-five hundred dollars ($2500), if the parent or guardian has been
      joined as a party defendant in the original action.  The judgment provided herein to be paid shall be paid to the owner of the property
      damaged but such payment shall not be a bar to any criminal action or any proceeding
      against the unemancipated minor committing such damage for the balance of the judgment
      not paid by the parent or guardian.  No parent or guardian shall be liable under the provisions of this subsection in
      a cumulative amount in excess of ten thousand dollars ($10,000) for the willful marking
      upon, defacing or damaging of any property by any child.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 405. Parent and Child›Parent and Child›KY REV ST 405.021. Reasonable visitation rights to grandparents
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 405. Parent and Child › Parent and Child › KY REV ST 405.021. Reasonable visitation rights to grandparents
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 405.021. Reasonable visitation rights to grandparents (2023)
content:
(1)  (a) The Circuit Court may grant reasonable visitation rights to either the paternal
         or maternal grandparents of a child and issue any necessary orders to enforce the
         decree if it determines that it is in the best interest of the child to do so.  Once a grandparent has been granted visitation rights under this subsection, those
         rights shall not be adversely affected by the termination of parental rights belonging
         to the grandparent's son or daughter, who is the father or mother of the child visited
         by the grandparent, unless the Circuit Court determines that it is in the best interest
         of the child to do so.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXV. Domestic Relations›Chapter 405. Parent and Child›Parent and Child›KY REV ST 405.390. Adoption of an adult
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXV. Domestic Relations › Chapter 405. Parent and Child › Parent and Child › KY REV ST 405.390. Adoption of an adult
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 405.390. Adoption of an adult (2023)
content:
An adult person over eighteen (18) years of age may be adopted in the same manner
   as provided by law for the adoption of a child and with the same legal effect, except
   that his consent alone to such adoption shall be required.
