   brought against all or any of them, at the plaintiff's option.  If any of the persons so bound be dead, the action may be brought against any or
   all of the survivors with the representatives of all or any of the decedents, or against
   the latter or any of them.  If all the persons so bound be dead, the action may be brought against the representatives
   of all or any of them.  An action or judgment against any one (1) or more of several persons jointly bound
   shall not be a bar to proceedings against the others.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 411. Rights of Action and Survival of Actions›KY REV ST 411.182. Allocation of fault in tort actions; award of damages; effect of release
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 411. Rights of Action and Survival of Actions › KY REV ST 411.182. Allocation of fault in tort actions; award of damages; effect of release
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 411.182. Allocation of fault in tort actions; award of damages; effect of release (2023)
content:
(1)  In all tort actions, including products liability actions, involving fault of
      more than one (1) party to the action, including third-party defendants and persons
      who have been released under subsection (4) of this section, the court, unless otherwise
      agreed by all parties, shall instruct the jury to answer interrogatories or, if there
      is no jury, shall make findings indicating:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 411. Rights of Action and Survival of Actions›KY REV ST 411.184. Definitions; punitive damages; proof of punitive damages
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 411. Rights of Action and Survival of Actions › KY REV ST 411.184. Definitions; punitive damages; proof of punitive damages
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 411.184. Definitions; punitive damages; proof of punitive damages (2023)
content: (1)  As used in this section andKRS 411.186, unless the context requires otherwise:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 411. Rights of Action and Survival of Actions›KY REV ST 411.187. Supersedeas bond to stay execution of judgment granting any relief during appeal; limit; rescission of limit if assets diverted or dissipated
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 411. Rights of Action and Survival of Actions › KY REV ST 411.187. Supersedeas bond to stay execution of judgment granting any relief during appeal; limit; rescission of limit if assets diverted or dissipated
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 411.187. Supersedeas bond to stay execution of judgment granting any relief during appeal; limit; rescission of limit if assets diverted or dissipated (2023)
content:
(1)  In any civil action brought under any legal theory, the amount of a supersedeas
      bond necessary to stay execution of a judgment granting legal, equitable, or any other
      relief during the entire course of all appeals or discretionary reviews of the judgment
      by all appellate courts shall be set in accordance with applicable law, except that
      the total amount of the supersedeas bonds that are required collectively of all appellants
      during the appeal of a civil action may not exceed one hundred million dollars ($100,000,000)
      in the aggregate, regardless of the amount of the judgment that is appealed.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 411. Rights of Action and Survival of Actions›KY REV ST 411.190. Obligations of owner to persons using land for recreation
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 411. Rights of Action and Survival of Actions › KY REV ST 411.190. Obligations of owner to persons using land for recreation
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 411.190. Obligations of owner to persons using land for recreation (2023)
content: (1)  As used in this section:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 411. Rights of Action and Survival of Actions›KY REV ST 411.188. Notification of parties holding subrogation rights; collateral source payments and subrogation rights admissible
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 411. Rights of Action and Survival of Actions › KY REV ST 411.188. Notification of parties holding subrogation rights; collateral source payments and subrogation rights admissible
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 411.188. Notification of parties holding subrogation rights; collateral source payments and subrogation rights admissible (2023)
content:
(1)  This section shall apply to all actions for damages, whether in contract or tort,
      commenced after July 15, 1988.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 411. Rights of Action and Survival of Actions›KY REV ST 411.186. Assessment of punitive damages
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 411. Rights of Action and Survival of Actions › KY REV ST 411.186. Assessment of punitive damages
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 411.186. Assessment of punitive damages (2023)
content:
(1)  In any civil action where claims for punitive damages are included, the jury
      or judge if jury trial has been waived, shall determine concurrently with all other
      issues presented, whether punitive damages may be assessed.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 411. Rights of Action and Survival of Actions›KY REV ST 411.195. Enforceability of written agreement to pay attorney fees in event of default
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 411. Rights of Action and Survival of Actions › KY REV ST 411.195. Enforceability of written agreement to pay attorney fees in event of default
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 411.195. Enforceability of written agreement to pay attorney fees in event of default (2023)
content:
Any provisions in a writing which create a debt, or create a lien on real property,
   requiring the debtor, obligor, lienor or mortgagor to pay reasonable attorney fees
   incurred by the creditor, obligee or lienholder in the event of default, shall be
   enforceable, provided, however, such fees shall only be allowed to the extent actually
   paid or agreed to be paid, and shall not be allowed to a salaried employee of such
   creditor, obligor or lienholder.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 411. Rights of Action and Survival of Actions›KY REV ST 411.200. Immunity from civil liability of officer, director or trustee of nonprofit organization
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 411. Rights of Action and Survival of Actions › KY REV ST 411.200. Immunity from civil liability of officer, director or trustee of nonprofit organization
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 411.200. Immunity from civil liability of officer, director or trustee of nonprofit organization (2023)
content:
Any person who serves as a director, officer, volunteer or trustee of a nonprofit
   organization qualified as a tax-exempt organization underSection 501(c) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as from time to time amended, and who is not compensated for such services on a
   salary or prorated equivalent basis, shall be immune from civil liability for any
   act or omission resulting in damage or injury occurring on or after July 15, 1988,
   if such person was acting in good faith and within the scope of his official functions
   and duties, unless such damage or injury was caused by the willful or wanton misconduct
   of such person.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 411. Rights of Action and Survival of Actions›KY REV ST 411.210. Action for theft of identity or trafficking in stolen identities; statute of limitations
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 411. Rights of Action and Survival of Actions › KY REV ST 411.210. Action for theft of identity or trafficking in stolen identities; statute of limitations
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 411.210. Action for theft of identity or trafficking in stolen identities; statute of limitations (2023)
content:
(1)  In addition to pursuing any other remedy, anyone who is a victim underKRS 434.872,434.874,514.160, or514.170, shall have a cause of action, either where the victim resides or the defendant resides,
      for compensatory and punitive damages against anyone who violatesKRS 434.872,434.874,514.160, or514.170and, if successful, shall be awarded reasonable costs and attorneys' fees.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 411. Rights of Action and Survival of Actions›KY REV ST 411.212. Action for damages caused by falsely reporting an incident; liability
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 411. Rights of Action and Survival of Actions › KY REV ST 411.212. Action for damages caused by falsely reporting an incident; liability
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 411.212. Action for damages caused by falsely reporting an incident; liability (2023)
content:
(1)  In addition to any restitution ordered by the court underKRS 519.040(4), any person who suffers harm as a result of a violation ofKRS 519.040(1)(a) or (e)may recover damages in a civil cause of action against the alleged perpetrator, including
      but not limited to damages for infliction of emotional distress, compensatory and
      punitive damages, court costs, and reasonable attorney's fees.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 411. Rights of Action and Survival of Actions›KY REV ST 411.225. Employer immunity from civil liability for disclosure of employee information; exceptions; effect of provision
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 411. Rights of Action and Survival of Actions › KY REV ST 411.225. Employer immunity from civil liability for disclosure of employee information; exceptions; effect of provision
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 411.225. Employer immunity from civil liability for disclosure of employee information; exceptions; effect of provision (2023)
content:
(1)  An employer who provides information about the job performance, professional
      conduct, or evaluation of a former or current employee to a prospective employer of
      that employee, at the request of that employee or prospective employer, shall be immune
      from civil liability arising out of the disclosure unless the plaintiff in the civil
      action proves:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 411. Rights of Action and Survival of Actions›KY REV ST 411.215. Action for failure to remove sexually explicit image from Web site, online service or application, or mobile application upon request; damages; statute of limitations
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 411. Rights of Action and Survival of Actions › KY REV ST 411.215. Action for failure to remove sexually explicit image from Web site, online service or application, or mobile application upon request; damages; statute of limitations
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 411.215. Action for failure to remove sexually explicit image from Web site, online service or application, or mobile application upon request; damages; statute of limitations (2023)
content:
(1)  A civil action may be maintained under this section against any person who, in
      violation ofKRS 531.120(3), does not remove a sexually explicit image upon the request of the person depicted
      in the image.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 411. Rights of Action and Survival of Actions›KY REV ST 411.220. Action by crime stalking victim against stalker; damages; statute of limitations
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 411. Rights of Action and Survival of Actions › KY REV ST 411.220. Action by crime stalking victim against stalker; damages; statute of limitations
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 411.220. Action by crime stalking victim against stalker; damages; statute of limitations (2023)
content:
A civil action may be maintained under this section against any person who commits
   the conduct prohibited underKRS 508.140or508.150.  A civil action may be maintained under this section whether or not the individual
   who is alleged to have violatedKRS 508.140or508.150has been charged or convicted of the alleged crime.  Liability under this section shall include the actual damages caused by the violation
   and may include punitive damages, court costs, and reasonable attorney's fees.  An action under this section shall be brought within two (2) years of the last act
   of conduct in violation of this section.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 411. Rights of Action and Survival of Actions›KY REV ST 411.230. Action for damages caused by tampering with operations of key infrastructure asset
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 411. Rights of Action and Survival of Actions › KY REV ST 411.230. Action for damages caused by tampering with operations of key infrastructure asset
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 411.230. Action for damages caused by tampering with operations of key infrastructure asset (2023)
content:
A civil action may be maintained under this section against any person that knowingly
   directs or causes a person to violateKRS 512.020(1)(b).  Liability shall include actual damages to personal or real property caused by the
   offense and may include punitive damages and court costs.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 412. Suretyship, Joint Obligations, and Contribution›KY REV ST 412.030. Contribution among negligent wrongdoers
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 412. Suretyship, Joint Obligations, and Contribution › KY REV ST 412.030. Contribution among negligent wrongdoers
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 412.030. Contribution among negligent wrongdoers (2023)
content:
Contribution among wrongdoers may be enforced where the wrong is a mere act of negligence
   and involves no moral turpitude.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 412. Suretyship, Joint Obligations, and Contribution›KY REV ST 412.020. Extent of recovery in contribution is the same at law as in equity
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 412. Suretyship, Joint Obligations, and Contribution › KY REV ST 412.020. Extent of recovery in contribution is the same at law as in equity
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 412.020. Extent of recovery in contribution is the same at law as in equity (2023)
content:
The extent of recovery, in cases of contribution, shall be the same in a court of
   law that it is in a court of equity.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions›Actions Relating to Real Property›KY REV ST 413.010. Action for recovery of real property; fifteen year limitation
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions › Actions Relating to Real Property › KY REV ST 413.010. Action for recovery of real property; fifteen year limitation
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 413.010. Action for recovery of real property; fifteen year limitation (2023)
content:
Subject toKRS 411.190(8), an action for the recovery of real property may be brought only within fifteen (15)
   years after the right to institute it first accrued to the plaintiff, or to the person
   through whom he claims.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 412. Suretyship, Joint Obligations, and Contribution›KY REV ST 412.010. Survival of liability of joint obligor; right of contribution
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 412. Suretyship, Joint Obligations, and Contribution › KY REV ST 412.010. Survival of liability of joint obligor; right of contribution
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 412.010. Survival of liability of joint obligor; right of contribution (2023)
content:
(1)  If any person jointly bound with another in any contract, or by judgment, dies
      in the lifetime of the other obligor, his heir, devisee, or representative may be
      charged in the same manner as if the contract or judgment had been separate as against
      the decedent.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 412. Suretyship, Joint Obligations, and Contribution›KY REV ST 412.040. Effect of insolvency or nonresidence on right of contribution
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 412. Suretyship, Joint Obligations, and Contribution › KY REV ST 412.040. Effect of insolvency or nonresidence on right of contribution
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 412.040. Effect of insolvency or nonresidence on right of contribution (2023)
content:
The insolvency or nonresidence of any person liable to contribution shall affect the
   rights of the others in like manner as the insolvency of one (1) obligor affects the
   others.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 412. Suretyship, Joint Obligations, and Contribution›KY REV ST 412.090. Assignment of right of action to surety paying judgment
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 412. Suretyship, Joint Obligations, and Contribution › KY REV ST 412.090. Assignment of right of action to surety paying judgment
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 412.090. Assignment of right of action to surety paying judgment (2023)
content:
If the surety pays any part of a judgment he shall have a right to an assignment of
   the judgment from the plaintiff or the plaintiff's attorney, in whole or in part.  When the plaintiff has been fully satisfied, the assignment shall give the surety
   the right to sue out or use any existing execution or otherwise control the judgment
   for his own benefit, against the other defendants, so far as to obtain satisfaction
   from the principal for the whole amount so paid by him, with interest, or from any
   cosurety his proper part of such payment, according toKRS 412.080.  This assignment shall also transfer to the sureties so paying the benefit of any
   lien existing under or by virtue of the judgment, and the right of assignment shall
   exist, though the money was made or secured by sale of the property of the surety
   under execution.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 412. Suretyship, Joint Obligations, and Contribution›KY REV ST 412.100. Rights of co-obligors and cocontractors
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 412. Suretyship, Joint Obligations, and Contribution › KY REV ST 412.100. Rights of co-obligors and cocontractors
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 412.100. Rights of co-obligors and cocontractors (2023)
content:
Co-obligors and cocontractors shall, as between each other, have the full benefit
   ofKRS 412.080and412.090as if they were cosureties.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 412. Suretyship, Joint Obligations, and Contribution›KY REV ST 412.060. Interest
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 412. Suretyship, Joint Obligations, and Contribution › KY REV ST 412.060. Interest
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 412.060. Interest (2023)
content: In all cases of contribution, interest shall be allowed from the time the right accrues.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 412. Suretyship, Joint Obligations, and Contribution›KY REV ST 412.080. Action by surety who pays, against principal; against cosurety
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 412. Suretyship, Joint Obligations, and Contribution › KY REV ST 412.080. Action by surety who pays, against principal; against cosurety
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 412.080. Action by surety who pays, against principal; against cosurety (2023)
content:
If a surety pays any part of a debt or liability for which he is bound as surety,
   he may recover the amount, with interest from time of payment, from the principal
   by action at law or by motion, after ten (10) days' notice in writing.  He may also sue a cosurety, separately or as a joint defendant with the principal,
   in such proceeding, and in like manner recover judgment against him, separately or
   jointly, at the same time, for his proper part of the debt or liability so paid, as
   if the sureties were the sole obligors.  If one (1) or more of several cosureties is insolvent, or resides out of the state,
   the recovery against the solvent and resident sureties shall also be for a proper
   part of the share of liability pertaining to the insolvent or nonresident surety.  If the surety afterwards makes further payment on the debt or liability, he may
   again have like remedy therefor.  But nothing in this section shall preclude the party sued from making any defense
   that might have been made against the original demand, unless the payment was made
   after and in consequence of a judgment in an action of which he had notice.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 412. Suretyship, Joint Obligations, and Contribution›KY REV ST 412.050. Contribution among persons in trust or official capacity
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 412. Suretyship, Joint Obligations, and Contribution › KY REV ST 412.050. Contribution among persons in trust or official capacity
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 412.050. Contribution among persons in trust or official capacity (2023)
content:
Contribution shall take place between all persons jointly liable, by civil action,
   for any act or omission in a trust or official capacity.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 412. Suretyship, Joint Obligations, and Contribution›KY REV ST 412.110. Person jointly liable may require suit or execution issued; notice
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 412. Suretyship, Joint Obligations, and Contribution › KY REV ST 412.110. Person jointly liable may require suit or execution issued; notice
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 412.110. Person jointly liable may require suit or execution issued; notice (2023)
content:
A surety, co-obligor, or cocontractor, or one (1) of several defendants to a judgment
   may, by notice in writing served in person within the state on the creditor or plaintiff,
   or, if the plaintiff is a nonresident or absent from the place of his residence for
   the period of thirty (30) days consecutively, upon his agent or his attorney, require
   him to sue or issue execution.  If the creditor does not in good faith prosecute the suit with reasonable diligence,
   or if the plaintiff does not, within ten (10) days after judgment, sue out execution
   and in good faith prosecute the collection, the cosurety, co-obligor, cocontractor,
   or defendant shall be discharged from all liability, except for his proper share according
   to the then existing condition of the several obligors, contractors, or defendants.  In any joint suit against the whole, or separate suit against him, judgment shall
   be rendered against him separately, and only for such proper share.  The written notice required in this section shall not be waived, unless the waiver
   is in writing.  No waiver of the notice shall be pleaded as a defense or given in evidence, unless
   it is in writing.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 412. Suretyship, Joint Obligations, and Contribution›KY REV ST 412.070. Compensation of party pressing claims in common interest for others; notice to interested persons
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 412. Suretyship, Joint Obligations, and Contribution › KY REV ST 412.070. Compensation of party pressing claims in common interest for others; notice to interested persons
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 412.070. Compensation of party pressing claims in common interest for others; notice to interested persons (2023)
content:
(1)  In actions for the settlement of estates, or for the recovery of money or property
      held in joint tenancy, coparcenary, or as tenants in common, or for the recovery of
      money or property which has been illegally or improperly collected, withheld or converted,
      if one (1) or more of the legatees, devisees, distributees or parties in interest
      has prosecuted for the benefit of others interested with him, and has been to trouble
      and expense in that connection, the court shall allow him his necessary expenses,
      and his attorney reasonable compensation for his services, in addition to the costs.  This allowance shall be paid out of the funds recovered before distribution.  The persons interested shall be given notice of the application for the allowance,
      provided, however, that if the court before whom the action is pending should determine
      that it is impracticable and too expensive to notify all of the parties individually,
      then by order of said court, personal notice may be dispensed with and in lieu thereof,
      notice of the application shall be given by an advertisement pursuant to KRS Chapter
      424.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 412. Suretyship, Joint Obligations, and Contribution›KY REV ST 412.130. Release of surety on lost or destroyed judgment or bond
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 412. Suretyship, Joint Obligations, and Contribution › KY REV ST 412.130. Release of surety on lost or destroyed judgment or bond
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 412.130. Release of surety on lost or destroyed judgment or bond (2023)
content:
No surety shall be released from his obligation on any lost or destroyed judgment,
   or bond having the force of a judgment, because of any failure to sue out execution
   thereon for twelve months, unless the failure was for twelve months after the reentry
   of judgment or order of execution.  However, this section shall not apply to a surety who was released by law at the
   time of the destruction or loss of the record or bond, nor unless proceedings to have
   a reentry of the judgment or order of execution had been commenced as provided inKRS 422.210and422.220.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 412. Suretyship, Joint Obligations, and Contribution›KY REV ST 412.160. Proceedings against surety after bankruptcy of principal
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 412. Suretyship, Joint Obligations, and Contribution › KY REV ST 412.160. Proceedings against surety after bankruptcy of principal
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 412.160. Proceedings against surety after bankruptcy of principal (2023)
content:
In an action for the recovery of money in which the defendant may have given bond
   with sureties, or for whom sureties may have given bond, pursuant to the provisions
   of subsection (1) ofKRS 425.116;  or in which an appellant may have given bond with sureties, or for whom sureties
   may have given bond, for the purpose of appeal from an inferior court to a circuit
   court or for the purpose of a supersedeas pending an appeal to the Court of Appeals--if
   such defendant or appellant have thereafter become a bankrupt under the laws of the
   United States, upon notice thereof from his adversary being served on the sureties,
   by summons, the court shall decide whether or not anything, and, if anything, how
   much, should have been adjudged against the defendant or appellant, but for the bankruptcy;
   and such decision shall be conclusive as to the liability of the sureties;  but they
   shall not be liable upon a bond given pursuant to subsection (1) ofKRS 425.116, if property released from an attachment by reason thereof, or its proceeds, have
   lawfully come to the defendant's or appellant's assignee in bankruptcy.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions›Actions Relating to Real Property›KY REV ST 413.050. Limitation on action by city on public easement; on action for possession of public road; effect of notice
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions › Actions Relating to Real Property › KY REV ST 413.050. Limitation on action by city on public easement; on action for possession of public road; effect of notice
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 413.050. Limitation on action by city on public easement; on action for possession of public road; effect of notice (2023)
content:
(1)  The limitations mentioned inKRS 413.010to413.040shall not begin to run in respect to actions by a city for the recovery of any part
      of any street, alley or other public easement or the use thereof in the city, until
      the legislative body of the city has been notified in writing by the party in possession
      or about to take possession that his possession will be adverse to the right or title
      of the city.  Until such notice is given, all possession of any part of any street, alley or public
      easement in any city shall be deemed amicable, and the person in possession the tenant
      at will of the city.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 412. Suretyship, Joint Obligations, and Contribution›KY REV ST 412.120. Release of surety on bond for delay in execution
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 412. Suretyship, Joint Obligations, and Contribution › KY REV ST 412.120. Release of surety on bond for delay in execution
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 412.120. Release of surety on bond for delay in execution (2023)
content:
If the plaintiff in any bond having the force of a judgment fails, at any time for
   the space of a year during which he is entitled to have execution, to issue execution
   and in good faith prosecute the collection, the surety in the bond shall be released
   from all liability.  Any execution thereafter issuing on the bond shall be so endorsed.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 412. Suretyship, Joint Obligations, and Contribution›KY REV ST 412.150. Creditor to be made defendant; provisional remedies allowed
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 412. Suretyship, Joint Obligations, and Contribution › KY REV ST 412.150. Creditor to be made defendant; provisional remedies allowed
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 412.150. Creditor to be made defendant; provisional remedies allowed (2023)
content: (1)  The creditor must be made defendant to an action brought pursuant toKRS 412.140, but shall not be liable for costs.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 412. Suretyship, Joint Obligations, and Contribution›KY REV ST 412.140. Action by surety against principal or cosurety after maturity of debt
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 412. Suretyship, Joint Obligations, and Contribution › KY REV ST 412.140. Action by surety against principal or cosurety after maturity of debt
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 412.140. Action by surety against principal or cosurety after maturity of debt (2023)
content:
After the maturity of a debt or liability, an equitable action may be brought by a
   surety against his principal to compel payment of it, or by one who is jointly liable
   therefor with another to compel him to pay so much of it as he may be equitably liable
   for as between him and the plaintiff.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions›Actions Relating to Real Property›KY REV ST 413.020. Action for recovery of real property; plaintiff under disability
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions › Actions Relating to Real Property › KY REV ST 413.020. Action for recovery of real property; plaintiff under disability
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 413.020. Action for recovery of real property; plaintiff under disability (2023)
content:
If, at the time the right of any person to bring an action for the recovery of real
   property first accrued, he was an infant or of unsound mind, he or the person claiming
   through him may, though the period of fifteen (15) years has expired, bring the action
   within three (3) years after the time the disability is removed.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions›Actions Other Than Those Relating to Real Property›KY REV ST 413.125. Actions relating to personal property to be brought within two years
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions › Actions Other Than Those Relating to Real Property › KY REV ST 413.125. Actions relating to personal property to be brought within two years
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 413.125. Actions relating to personal property to be brought within two years (2023)
content:
An action for the taking, detaining or injuring of personal property, including an
   action for specific recovery shall be commenced within two (2) years from the time
   the cause of action accrued.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions›Actions Relating to Real Property›KY REV ST 413.030. Action for recovery of real property; extension for disability limited; no extension past thirty years
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions › Actions Relating to Real Property › KY REV ST 413.030. Action for recovery of real property; extension for disability limited; no extension past thirty years
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 413.030. Action for recovery of real property; extension for disability limited; no extension past thirty years (2023)
content:
(1)  The time within which an action for the recovery of real property may be brought
      shall not be extended by reason of any disability that did not exist when the right
      to bring the action first accrued, nor by reason of any disability of the heirs of
      the person to whom the right first accrued.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions›Actions Relating to Real Property›KY REV ST 413.040. Claim not to preserve right of action
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions › Actions Relating to Real Property › KY REV ST 413.040. Claim not to preserve right of action
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 413.040. Claim not to preserve right of action (2023)
content: No continual claim upon or near real property shall preserve a right to bring an action.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions›Actions Other Than Those Relating to Real Property›KY REV ST 413.140. Actions to be brought within one year
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions › Actions Other Than Those Relating to Real Property › KY REV ST 413.140. Actions to be brought within one year
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 413.140. Actions to be brought within one year (2023)
content:
(1)  The following actions shall be commenced within one (1) year after the cause
      of action accrued:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions›Actions Relating to Real Property›KY REV ST 413.060. Person holding land under adverse title for seven years; extension for disability
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions › Actions Relating to Real Property › KY REV ST 413.060. Person holding land under adverse title for seven years; extension for disability
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 413.060. Person holding land under adverse title for seven years; extension for disability (2023)
content:
(1)  No action shall be brought under or by virtue of an adverse, interfering entry,
      survey or patent to recover the title or possession of land from an occupant if he,
      or the person under whom he claims, has a connected title thereto in law or equity,
      deducible of record from the Commonwealth, and has an actual occupancy of it by settlement
      thereon, under such title, for seven (7) years before the commencement of the action.  This possession of land shall bar the right of entry into it by any person, under
      an adverse title or claim, and sufficient possession to bar the right to recover it
      shall vest the title in the occupant or his vendee.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions›Actions Other Than Those Relating to Real Property›KY REV ST 413.100. Lienee not to extend limitation as against purchasers or creditors; exception
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions › Actions Other Than Those Relating to Real Property › KY REV ST 413.100. Lienee not to extend limitation as against purchasers or creditors; exception
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 413.100. Lienee not to extend limitation as against purchasers or creditors; exception (2023)
content:
No promise, acknowledgment or payment of money by any person bound on any bond or
   obligation for the payment of money secured by a lien shall operate as a prolongation
   or extension of the time within which the lien may be enforced as against purchasers
   or creditors, unless the promisor and the holder of the lien, before fifteen (15)
   years after the maturity of the debt, enters a memorandum on the margin of the record
   of the deed or mortgage, attested by the clerk, showing that the debt is extended,
   for what time it is extended and the amount still due thereon.  The payee shall pay the clerk a fee pursuant toKRS 64.012for his services.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions›Actions Relating to Real Property›KY REV ST 413.070. Action upon equity of redemption in real property
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions › Actions Relating to Real Property › KY REV ST 413.070. Action upon equity of redemption in real property
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 413.070. Action upon equity of redemption in real property (2023)
content:
After a mortgagee of real property or any person claiming under him has had fifteen
   (15) years' continued adverse possession, no action shall be brought by the mortgagor
   or anyone claiming under him to redeem the property.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions›Actions Other Than Those Relating to Real Property›KY REV ST 413.090. Action upon judgment, contract, or bond; fifteen-year limitation; action for child support arrearages; time to commence action tolled until obligations cease as to last child on order
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions › Actions Other Than Those Relating to Real Property › KY REV ST 413.090. Action upon judgment, contract, or bond; fifteen-year limitation; action for child support arrearages; time to commence action tolled until obligations cease as to last child on order
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 413.090. Action upon judgment, contract, or bond; fifteen-year limitation; action for child support arrearages; time to commence action tolled until obligations cease as to last child on order (2023)
content:
Except as provided inKRS 396.205,413.110,413.220,413.230and413.240, the following actions shall be commenced within fifteen (15) years after the cause
   of action first accrued:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions›Actions Other Than Those Relating to Real Property›KY REV ST 413.120. Actions to be brought within five years
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions › Actions Other Than Those Relating to Real Property › KY REV ST 413.120. Actions to be brought within five years
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 413.120. Actions to be brought within five years (2023)
content:
The following actions shall be commenced within five (5) years after the cause of
   action accrued:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions›Actions Other Than Those Relating to Real Property›KY REV ST 413.110. Action against county on bonded obligation; three year limitation; action on state warrant; two year limitation
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions › Actions Other Than Those Relating to Real Property › KY REV ST 413.110. Action against county on bonded obligation; three year limitation; action on state warrant; two year limitation
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 413.110. Action against county on bonded obligation; three year limitation; action on state warrant; two year limitation (2023)
content:
(1)  A cause of action existing against a county by virtue of its bonded obligation
      for the payment of money, after the county has in good faith offered to redeem the
      obligations that have matured by the payment in full of all principal and interest
      due, expires and becomes ineffective at the end of three (3) years after the offer.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions›Actions Other Than Those Relating to Real Property›KY REV ST 413.135. Action for damages arising out of injury
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions › Actions Other Than Those Relating to Real Property › KY REV ST 413.135. Action for damages arising out of injury
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 413.135. Action for damages arising out of injury (2023)
content:
(1)  No action to recover damages, whether based upon contract or sounding in tort,
      resulting from or arising out of any deficiency in the construction components, design,
      planning, supervision, inspection, or construction of any improvement to real property,
      or for any injury to property, either real or personal, arising out of such deficiency,
      or for injury to the person or for wrongful death arising out of any such deficiency,
      shall be brought against any person after the expiration of seven (7) years following
      the substantial completion of such improvement.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions›Actions Other Than Those Relating to Real Property›KY REV ST 413.080. Action upon equity of redemption in personal property
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions › Actions Other Than Those Relating to Real Property › KY REV ST 413.080. Action upon equity of redemption in personal property
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 413.080. Action upon equity of redemption in personal property (2023)
content:
After a mortgagee of personal property or any person claiming under him has had five
   (5) years' continued adverse possession, no action shall be brought by the mortgagor
   or any person claiming under him to redeem the property.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions›Actions Relating to Real Property›KY REV ST 413.072. Relationship of agricultural and silvicultural operations to law of nuisance and trespass; preemption of local ordinances; sustainable agriculture and best management practices
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions › Actions Relating to Real Property › KY REV ST 413.072. Relationship of agricultural and silvicultural operations to law of nuisance and trespass; preemption of local ordinances; sustainable agriculture and best management practices
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 413.072. Relationship of agricultural and silvicultural operations to law of nuisance and trespass; preemption of local ordinances; sustainable agriculture and best management practices (2023)
content:
(1)  It is the declared policy of the Commonwealth to conserve, protect, and encourage
      the development and improvement of its agricultural land and silvicultural land for
      the production of food, timber, and other agricultural and silvicultural products.  When nonagricultural land uses extend into agricultural and silvicultural areas,
      agricultural and silvicultural operations often become the subject of nuisance suits
      or legal actions restricting agricultural or silvicultural operations.  As a result, agricultural and silvicultural operations are sometimes either curtailed
      or forced to cease operations.  Investments in farm and timber improvements may be discouraged.  It is the purpose of this section to reduce the loss to the state of its agricultural
      and silvicultural resources by clarifying the circumstances under which agricultural
      and silvicultural operations may be deemed to be a nuisance or interfered with by
      local ordinances or legal actions.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions›Actions Other Than Those Relating to Real Property›KY REV ST 413.150. Actions by the Commonwealth
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions › Actions Other Than Those Relating to Real Property › KY REV ST 413.150. Actions by the Commonwealth
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 413.150. Actions by the Commonwealth (2023)
content:
The limitations prescribed in this chapter shall apply to actions brought by or in
   the name of the Commonwealth the same as to actions by private persons, except where
   a different time is prescribed by statute.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions›Actions Other Than Those Relating to Real Property›KY REV ST 413.137. Action for damages for injury or illness suffered as a result of female genital mutilation
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions › Actions Other Than Those Relating to Real Property › KY REV ST 413.137. Action for damages for injury or illness suffered as a result of female genital mutilation
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 413.137. Action for damages for injury or illness suffered as a result of female genital mutilation (2023)
content:
(1)  A civil action for recovery of damages for injury or illness suffered as a result
      of female genital mutilation as defined inKRS 508.125shall be brought within ten (10) years:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions›Actions Other Than Those Relating to Real Property›KY REV ST 413.130. When certain actions in KRS 413.120. accrue
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions › Actions Other Than Those Relating to Real Property › KY REV ST 413.130. When certain actions in KRS 413.120. accrue
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 413.130. When certain actions in KRS 413.120. accrue (2023)
content:
(1)  In every action upon a merchants' account as described in subsection (9) ofKRS 413.120, the limitation shall be computed from January 1 next succeeding the respective dates
      of the delivery of the several articles charged in the account.  Judgment shall be rendered for no more than the amount of articles actually charged
      or delivered within five (5) years preceding that in which the action was brought.  If any merchant willfully postdates any article charged in such account, or the
      receipt for the delivery of it, he shall forfeit ten (10) times the amount of the
      article postdated, to be credited against the account.  This credit shall be allowed in an action on the account, without any written pleadings
      setting it up.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions›Actions Other Than Those Relating to Real Property›KY REV ST 413.170. Limitations of actions in KRS 413.090. to 413.160. do not run until removal of disability or death
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions › Actions Other Than Those Relating to Real Property › KY REV ST 413.170. Limitations of actions in KRS 413.090. to 413.160. do not run until removal of disability or death
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 413.170. Limitations of actions in KRS 413.090. to 413.160. do not run until removal of disability or death (2023)
content:
(1)  If a person entitled to bring any action mentioned inKRS 413.090to413.160, except for a penalty or forfeiture, was, at the time the cause of action accrued,
      an infant or of unsound mind, the action may be brought within the same number of
      years after the removal of the disability or death of the person, whichever happens
      first, allowed to a person without the disability to bring the action after the right
      accrued.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions›Actions Other Than Those Relating to Real Property›KY REV ST 413.160. Actions upon written contract or not provided for by statute; ten-year limitation
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions › Actions Other Than Those Relating to Real Property › KY REV ST 413.160. Actions upon written contract or not provided for by statute; ten-year limitation
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 413.160. Actions upon written contract or not provided for by statute; ten-year limitation (2023)
content:
An action upon a written contract executed after July 15, 2014, unless otherwise provided
   by statute, and an action for relief not provided for by statute can only be commenced
   within ten (10) years after the cause of action accrued.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions›Actions Other Than Those Relating to Real Property›KY REV ST 413.190. Result of absence from the state or obstruction of action under KRS 413.090. to § 413.160
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions › Actions Other Than Those Relating to Real Property › KY REV ST 413.190. Result of absence from the state or obstruction of action under KRS 413.090. to § 413.160
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 413.190. Result of absence from the state or obstruction of action under KRS 413.090. to § 413.160 (2023)
content:
(1)  If, at the time any cause of action mentioned inKRS 413.090to413.160accrues against a resident of this state, he is absent from it, the period limited
      for the commencement of the action against him shall be computed from the time of
      his return to this state.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions›Actions Other Than Those Relating to Real Property›KY REV ST 413.220. Sureties who are discharged after seven years
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions › Actions Other Than Those Relating to Real Property › KY REV ST 413.220. Sureties who are discharged after seven years
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 413.220. Sureties who are discharged after seven years (2023)
content:
(1)  A surety shall be discharged from all liability under any judgment or decree,
      after the lapse of seven (7) years without the issue of execution and prosecution
      in good faith for collection.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions›Actions Other Than Those Relating to Real Property›KY REV ST 413.180. Action by or against personal representative under KRS 413.090. to § 413.160
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions › Actions Other Than Those Relating to Real Property › KY REV ST 413.180. Action by or against personal representative under KRS 413.090. to § 413.160
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 413.180. Action by or against personal representative under KRS 413.090. to § 413.160 (2023)
content:
(1)  If a person entitled to bring any action mentioned inKRS 413.090to413.160dies before the expiration of the time limited for its commencement and the cause
      of action survives, the action may be brought by his personal representative after
      the expiration of that time, if commenced within one (1) year after the qualification
      of the representative.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions›Actions Other Than Those Relating to Real Property›KY REV ST 413.241. Legislative finding; limitation on liability of licensed sellers or servers of intoxicating beverages; liability of intoxicated person
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions › Actions Other Than Those Relating to Real Property › KY REV ST 413.241. Legislative finding; limitation on liability of licensed sellers or servers of intoxicating beverages; liability of intoxicated person
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 413.241. Legislative finding; limitation on liability of licensed sellers or servers of intoxicating beverages; liability of intoxicated person (2023)
content:
(1)  The General Assembly finds and declares that the consumption of intoxicating
      beverages, rather than the serving, furnishing, or sale of such beverages, is the
      proximate cause of any injury, including death and property damage, inflicted by an
      intoxicated person upon himself or another person.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions›Actions Other Than Those Relating to Real Property›KY REV ST 413.240. Action against surety; when limitation does not run
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions › Actions Other Than Those Relating to Real Property › KY REV ST 413.240. Action against surety; when limitation does not run
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 413.240. Action against surety; when limitation does not run (2023)
content:
The limitations given inKRS 413.220and413.230shall not apply to the time elapsed when there was no executor, administrator or
   other person authorized to commence an action, nor to the six (6) months during which
   an action cannot be brought against a personal representative, nor to any delay assented
   to by the surety in writing.  If judgment is rendered for the plaintiff in any case provided for in those sections
   and it is afterwards reversed or arrested so that the plaintiff takes nothing by it,
   he may commence another action within one (1) year thereafter.  If the surety absconds, conceals himself or by removal from the state or otherwise,
   obstructs or hinders his being sued the time of such obstruction shall not be counted
   as part of the time of limitation allowed by those sections.  If the judgment is obstructed by appeal, supersedeas or injunction the time of such
   obstruction shall also be disallowed.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions›Actions Other Than Those Relating to Real Property›KY REV ST 413.242. Prerequisite to action against purchaser or selling agent of equine interest
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions › Actions Other Than Those Relating to Real Property › KY REV ST 413.242. Prerequisite to action against purchaser or selling agent of equine interest
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 413.242. Prerequisite to action against purchaser or selling agent of equine interest (2023)
content:
Before a party possessing a security interest or lien against an equine interest that
   has been sold without the debt to the party being discharged may bring an action against
   the purchaser or selling agent of the equine interest, the secured party shall pursue
   a remedy against the debtor to the point where a judgment is rendered on the merits
   or the suit is dismissed with prejudice.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions›Actions Other Than Those Relating to Real Property›KY REV ST 413.245. Actions for professional service malpractice
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions › Actions Other Than Those Relating to Real Property › KY REV ST 413.245. Actions for professional service malpractice
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 413.245. Actions for professional service malpractice (2023)
content:
Notwithstanding any other prescribed limitation of actions which might otherwise appear
   applicable, except those provided inKRS 413.140, a civil action, whether brought in tort or contract, arising out of any act or omission
   in rendering, or failing to render, professional services for others shall be brought
   within one (1) year from the date of the occurrence or from the date when the cause
   of action was, or reasonably should have been, discovered by the party injured.  Time shall not commence against a party under legal disability until removal of
   the disability.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions›Actions Other Than Those Relating to Real Property›KY REV ST 413.243. “Professional services” defined
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions › Actions Other Than Those Relating to Real Property › KY REV ST 413.243. “Professional services” defined
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 413.243. “Professional services” defined (2023)
content:
As used inKRS 413.245, “professional services” means any service rendered in a profession required to be licensed, administered
   and regulated as professions in the Commonwealth of Kentucky, except those professions
   governed byKRS 413.140.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions›Actions Other Than Those Relating to Real Property›KY REV ST 413.2485. Action relating to injury to or illness of an adult as a result of a sexual offense
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions › Actions Other Than Those Relating to Real Property › KY REV ST 413.2485. Action relating to injury to or illness of an adult as a result of a sexual offense
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 413.2485. Action relating to injury to or illness of an adult as a result of a sexual offense (2023)
content: (1)  As used in this section, “injury or illness” means either a physical or psychological injury or illness.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions›Actions Other Than Those Relating to Real Property›KY REV ST 413.230. Sureties who are discharged after five years
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions › Actions Other Than Those Relating to Real Property › KY REV ST 413.230. Sureties who are discharged after five years
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 413.230. Sureties who are discharged after five years (2023)
content:
A surety for an executor, administrator, guardian or curator, or for a sheriff to
   whom a decedent's estate has been transferred, shall be discharged from all liability
   to a distributee, devisee or ward when five (5) years have elapsed without suit after
   the cause of action accrued, and after the devisee, distributee or ward attained full
   age.  But the failure of one to commence action in time shall not affect the right of
   another.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions›Actions Other Than Those Relating to Real Property›KY REV ST 413.246. Action for damages based on professional services rendered by licensed home inspector
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions › Actions Other Than Those Relating to Real Property › KY REV ST 413.246. Action for damages based on professional services rendered by licensed home inspector
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 413.246. Action for damages based on professional services rendered by licensed home inspector (2023)
content:
(1)  An action for damages, whether brought in contract or tort, or on any other basis,
      based on professional services that were rendered or that should have been rendered
      by a licensed home inspector underKRS 198B.700to198B.738shall not be brought, commenced, or maintained unless the action is filed within
      one (1) year of the time that the claimant knew or should have known of a deficient
      inspection and damages and injuries resulting therefrom.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions›Actions Other Than Those Relating to Real Property›KY REV ST 413.249. Action relating to childhood sexual abuse or childhood sexual assault
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions › Actions Other Than Those Relating to Real Property › KY REV ST 413.249. Action relating to childhood sexual abuse or childhood sexual assault
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 413.249. Action relating to childhood sexual abuse or childhood sexual assault (2023)
content: (1)  As used in this section:

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions›Provisions for Application of Limitations›KY REV ST 413.260. Effect of injunction or other restraint on limitation
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions › Provisions for Application of Limitations › KY REV ST 413.260. Effect of injunction or other restraint on limitation
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 413.260. Effect of injunction or other restraint on limitation (2023)
content:
(1)  If the doing of an act necessary to save any right or benefit is restrained or
      suspended by injunction or other lawful restraint, vacancy in office, absence of an
      officer or his refusal to act, the time covered by the injunction, restraint, vacancy,
      absence or refusal to act shall not be counted in the application of any statute of
      limitations.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions›Provisions for Application of Limitations›KY REV ST 413.265. Validity of agreements extending limitations periods
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions › Provisions for Application of Limitations › KY REV ST 413.265. Validity of agreements extending limitations periods
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 413.265. Validity of agreements extending limitations periods (2023)
content:
Written agreements entered into in good faith and at arms length to extend limitations
   periods for the filing of civil actions, including agreements entered into prior to
   July 15, 1988, shall be valid and enforceable according to their terms.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions›Provisions for Application of Limitations›KY REV ST 413.270. Effect of judgment of no jurisdiction; application to administrative agencies
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions › Provisions for Application of Limitations › KY REV ST 413.270. Effect of judgment of no jurisdiction; application to administrative agencies
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 413.270. Effect of judgment of no jurisdiction; application to administrative agencies (2023)
content:
(1)  If an action is commenced in due time and in good faith in any court of this
      state and the defendants or any of them make defense, and it is adjudged that the
      court has no jurisdiction of the action, the plaintiff or his representative may,
      within ninety (90) days from the time of that judgment, commence a new action in the
      proper court.  The time between the commencement of the first and last action shall not be counted
      in applying any statute of limitation.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 415. Repeal or Vacation of Charters; Usurpation›KY REV ST 415.060. Proceedings for usurpation against person holding office
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 415. Repeal or Vacation of Charters; Usurpation › KY REV ST 415.060. Proceedings for usurpation against person holding office
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 415.060. Proceedings for usurpation against person holding office (2023)
content:
A person who continues to exercise an office after having committed an act, or omitted
   to do an act, the commission or omission of which, by law, creates a forfeiture of
   his office, may be proceeded against for usurpation thereof.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions›Provisions for Application of Limitations›KY REV ST 413.250. When action commences
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions › Provisions for Application of Limitations › KY REV ST 413.250. When action commences
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 413.250. When action commences (2023)
content:
An action shall be deemed to commence on the date of the first summons or process
   issued in good faith from the court having jurisdiction of the cause of action.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 415. Repeal or Vacation of Charters; Usurpation›KY REV ST 415.050. Duties of the Attorney General
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 415. Repeal or Vacation of Charters; Usurpation › KY REV ST 415.050. Duties of the Attorney General
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 415.050. Duties of the Attorney General (2023)
content:
For usurpation of other than county offices or franchises, the action by the Commonwealth
   shall be instituted and prosecuted by the Attorney General.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions›Provisions for Application of Limitations›KY REV ST 413.290. Limitations only to residents; notice
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions › Provisions for Application of Limitations › KY REV ST 413.290. Limitations only to residents; notice
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 413.290. Limitations only to residents; notice (2023)
content:
Limitations shall not begin to run in favor of persons coming temporarily into this
   state, but shall attach only in favor of actual residents in good faith, and after
   notice to the person to be affected thereby.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions›Provisions for Application of Limitations›KY REV ST 413.300. Plaintiff a citizen of enemy country
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions › Provisions for Application of Limitations › KY REV ST 413.300. Plaintiff a citizen of enemy country
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 413.300. Plaintiff a citizen of enemy country (2023)
content:
If the plaintiff is an alien and a subject or citizen of a country at war with the
   United States, the time of the continuance of the war shall not be counted as part
   of the period limited for the commencement of an action.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions›Provisions for Application of Limitations›KY REV ST 413.280. Person under more than one disability
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions › Provisions for Application of Limitations › KY REV ST 413.280. Person under more than one disability
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 413.280. Person under more than one disability (2023)
content:
When two (2) or more disabilities exist in the same person at the time the cause of
   action accrues, the limitation does not attach until they are all removed.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions›Provisions for Application of Limitations›KY REV ST 413.320. Cause of action barred here if barred where it accrued
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions › Provisions for Application of Limitations › KY REV ST 413.320. Cause of action barred here if barred where it accrued
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 413.320. Cause of action barred here if barred where it accrued (2023)
content:
When a cause of action has arisen in another state or country, and by the laws of
   this state or country where the cause of action accrued the time for the commencement
   of an action thereon is limited to a shorter period of time than the period of limitation
   prescribed by the laws of this state for a like cause of action, then said action
   shall be barred in this state at the expiration of said shorter period.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions›Provisions for Application of Limitations›KY REV ST 413.330. Action on judgment barred here if barred where rendered; exception
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 413. Limitation of Actions › Provisions for Application of Limitations › KY REV ST 413.330. Action on judgment barred here if barred where rendered; exception
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 413.330. Action on judgment barred here if barred where rendered; exception (2023)
content:
If, by the laws of any other state or country, an action upon a judgment or decree
   rendered in that state or country cannot be maintained there by reason of the lapse
   of time, and the judgment or decree is incapable of being otherwise enforced there,
   an action upon it may not be maintained in this state, except in favor of a resident
   thereof who has had the cause of action from the time it accrued.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 415. Repeal or Vacation of Charters; Usurpation›KY REV ST 415.030. Action to prevent usurpation of office or franchise
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 415. Repeal or Vacation of Charters; Usurpation › KY REV ST 415.030. Action to prevent usurpation of office or franchise
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 415.030. Action to prevent usurpation of office or franchise (2023)
content:
If a person usurp an office or franchise, the person entitled thereto, or the Commonwealth,
   may prevent the usurpation by an ordinary action.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 415. Repeal or Vacation of Charters; Usurpation›KY REV ST 415.040. Duties of Commonwealth's attorneys
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 415. Repeal or Vacation of Charters; Usurpation › KY REV ST 415.040. Duties of Commonwealth's attorneys
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 415.040. Duties of Commonwealth's attorneys (2023)
content:
It shall be the duty of the several Commonwealth attorneys to institute the actions
   mentioned in this chapter against usurpers of county offices or franchises, if no
   other person be entitled thereto, or if the person entitled fail to institute the
   same during three (3) months after the usurpation.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 415. Repeal or Vacation of Charters; Usurpation›KY REV ST 415.020. Order of Legislature needed to repeal or vacate certain charters
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 415. Repeal or Vacation of Charters; Usurpation › KY REV ST 415.020. Order of Legislature needed to repeal or vacate certain charters
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 415.020. Order of Legislature needed to repeal or vacate certain charters (2023)
content:
Actions to repeal or vacate the charters of municipal corporations;  banks, railroad,
   turnpike road and internal improvement companies, shall only be instituted by order
   of the Legislature, unless otherwise expressly provided.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 415. Repeal or Vacation of Charters; Usurpation›KY REV ST 415.010. Style of action to repeal charter; prosecution
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 415. Repeal or Vacation of Charters; Usurpation › KY REV ST 415.010. Style of action to repeal charter; prosecution
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 415.010. Style of action to repeal charter; prosecution (2023)
content:
The action to repeal or vacate a charter shall be in the name of the Commonwealth,
   and be brought and prosecuted by the Attorney General, or under his sanction and direction
   by an attorney for the Commonwealth.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 415. Repeal or Vacation of Charters; Usurpation›KY REV ST 415.080. Recovery of fees and emoluments from usurper
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 415. Repeal or Vacation of Charters; Usurpation › KY REV ST 415.080. Recovery of fees and emoluments from usurper
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 415.080. Recovery of fees and emoluments from usurper (2023)
content:
If the usurper has received fees and emoluments arising from the office or franchise,
   he shall be liable therefor to the person entitled thereto, who may claim the same
   in the action brought to deprive him of the office or franchise;  or in a separate
   action.  If no one is entitled to them, they may be recovered by the Commonwealth, and shall
   be paid into the public Treasury.

path: Kentucky Revised Statutes›Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations›Chapter 415. Repeal or Vacation of Charters; Usurpation›KY REV ST 415.070. Judgment against usurper; enforcement
title: KY Statutes › Kentucky Revised Statutes › Title XXXVI. Statutory Actions and Limitations › Chapter 415. Repeal or Vacation of Charters; Usurpation › KY REV ST 415.070. Judgment against usurper; enforcement
citation: KY Stat § KY REV ST 415.070. Judgment against usurper; enforcement (2023)
content:
A person adjudged to have usurped an office or franchise shall be deprived thereof
   by the judgment of the court, and the person adjudged entitled thereto shall be placed
   in possession thereof;  but no one shall be adjudged entitled thereto, unless the
   action be instituted by him.  And the court shall have power to enforce its judgment by causing the books and
   papers, and all other things pertaining to the office or franchise, to be surrendered
